Job Title: Senior Manager, Software Engineer

Job Code: 39849

Job Location: Colorado Springs, CO

Job Schedule: 9/80

Job Description:

The Technical Manager – Software, Integration & Test Engineering leads and directs a multi-discipline engineering team of approximately 20–30 engineers of various levels of experience across software development, systems integration, verification, validation, and test. This leader must possess extensive knowledge of Software Engineering, Integration and Test Engineering, and associated principles of software development, system integration, verification, validation, and test execution for complex engineering solutions.

Provides technical guidance and leadership to subordinate engineers and maintains proper staffing levels and domain expertise to meet business objectives. Develops and conducts programs in accordance with program contractual requirements, company policies, priorities, and budget constraints. Contributes directly to program performance by leveraging technical expertise and experience in software solution architecture, design, implementation, integration, verification, validation, qualification, deployment, and sustainment. Leads root cause and corrective action investigations, provides independent review team perspectives, and participates in program reviews. Manages and/or develops budgets for assigned function or department, including operating requirements, training, equipment, lab/test assets, and material purchases. Provides technical oversight and assistance to other departments as required.

Makes significant improvements in processes, systems, products, and test capabilities. Manages the implementation of the technical strategy for Software Engineering and Integration & Test and establishes short-term operational plans with measurable contribution to function and program results. Meets functional requirements for hiring, staffing, training, talent development, engagement, retention, and overall management of the department. Responsible for the technical execution, staffing, and oversight of all programs/projects assigned to the organizational unit. Acts as an advisor to subordinate staff members to meet schedules and resolve technical or operational problems spanning software development, system integration, lab execution, verification, and field support.

Exerts influence the development of overall objectives and short-term operational plans of the organization. Frequently contacts equivalent-level managers, customer representatives, and program stakeholders concerning projects, operational decisions, scheduling requirements, contractual clarifications, test readiness, system integration planning, and talent development. Works to influence others to accept the function’s views or practices and agree/accept new concepts, practices, and approaches. Requires ability to communicate with executive leadership regarding matters of significant importance to the organization.

Works with Business Development, Program Management, Systems Engineering, and Business Leadership to provide input for Strategic Planning, Research and Development Planning, test infrastructure planning, and Inter-Corporation Resource Sharing. Stays abreast of state-of-the-art technology; identifies disruptive or emerging technology trends for inclusion in Internal Research and Development or pursuit/program engineering change proposal opportunities. Ability to enable teams to resolve issues across programs, drive innovative solutions, and solve execution and technical challenges on time and within budget.

Essential Functions:

Lead a multi-discipline engineering team across software development, software integration, system integration, verification, validation, and test to meet customer requirements within allocated cost/scope/schedule commitments.
Provide technical and organizational leadership for software development and Integration & Test activities across the full lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, implementation, integration, verification, validation, qualification, deployment, and sustainment.
Oversee planning and execution of integration and test efforts, including test strategy, test readiness, test procedures, test automation, test environments, lab resources, troubleshooting, defect tracking, and requirements sell-off.
Participate in architecture, design, code, integration, and test readiness reviews.
Collaborate with Systems Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Program Management, and Operations to develop reliable, supportable, and testable solutions.
Ensure the team follows disciplined engineering and development processes, including Agile software development, systems integration processes, verification planning, and formal test execution practices.
Support software and integrated system troubleshooting for units under test, deployed systems, and operational assets, as applicable.
Communicate with leadership on status, issues, milestones, technical performance, integration readiness, test results, and successes.
Strong technical skillset, able to contribute to requirements analysis, design, code and unit test, integration and test, verification closure, discrepancy resolution, and customer acceptance activities. Drive root cause analysis and corrective action for software, system, and test anomalies.
Support development and maintenance of labs, test tools, test automation frameworks, simulators, emulators, and hardware/software integration environments.
Lead staffing, mentoring, career development, and performance management for engineers across multiple disciplines.
These positions require you to obtain a DoD TS/SCI Clearance, which requires U.S. Citizenship.
Lead and support technical proposal development and review for government programs, including solicitation analysis, compliance assessment, technical solution development, cross-functional coordination, risk identification, basis of estimate support, and proposal content review to ensure quality, accuracy, and executable planning.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 12 years prior related experience, including substantial background in software development, system integration, and/or verification and test. Graduate Degree with a minimum of 10 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 16 years of prior related experience.
3 years of management and leadership experience with demonstrated success leading technical teams across full product lifecycle development, including executing performance appraisals, managing staffing allocation, process leadership, and career development.
5 years of experience with Software Development methodologies like Agile/Scrum, Agile/SAFe, Waterfall, Kanban, and TDD.
5 years of experience with DevSecOps and a proven track record leading teams to leverage CI/CD pipelines and automated build/test capabilities.
8 years of experience leading or contributing to engineering development through various phases including design, coding, integration, deployment, sustainment, verification, and test.
Experience with system integration, verification, validation, test planning, test execution, defect tracking, and troubleshooting in complex development environments.
Ability to acquire Top Secret Clearance.

Preferred Additional Skills:

Experience as a Lead Software Engineer, Integration Lead, Test Lead, Chief Engineer, or Subject Matter Expert on a product development effort.
Software development and/or integration and test experience with OOD, UML, C/C++, Java, scripting, test automation, and web development.
Experience developing or leading Enterprise Software Systems with high availability requirements.
Experience with hardware/software integration, system test, lab architecture, environmental test coordination, and qualification/certification support.
Experience with automated test frameworks, test orchestration, data collection, log analysis, and requirements verification/traceability tools.
Ability to clearly and succinctly convey information and ideas, including strong executive communication and presentation skills.
High expectations for continuous improvement and sustained excellence for self and team members – Lean Six Sigma, data-based decision making, engineering performance metrics, and test effectiveness metrics
Certified SCRUM Master, Product Owner, Release Train Engineer, Coach, and/or relevant test or quality certifications.
Experience with lab/resource planning, capital planning for test infrastructure, and cross-functional coordination for integration events and formal test campaigns.
Familiarity with regulated, mission-critical, or defense/aerospace environments requiring formal verification, configuration control, and customer acceptance testing.

jobs.title: Sr Director Revenue Mgmt Tech Delivery
jobs.description:
GROW YOUR CAREER WITH US

At Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings (NCLH), we know our future success depends on our ability to attract and retain the very best talent. Our brands deliver vacations of a lifetime with innovative product offerings, a high level of service and unique guest experiences aboard each vessel and we’re continually seeking applicants who are passionate about hospitality and committed to being their personal best. As you learn more about our company, we think you will agree that there is no better time than now to become a member of the NCLH family!

APPLY ONLINE

If you’re interested to be considered for this position, please click the blue APPLY button at the top of the page to get started. All candidates must complete an on-line application to be considered.

Position Summary

The Senior Director, Revenue Management Technology Delivery leads the technology organization that enables Revenue Management through data, analytics, and application platforms. This is a senior technology and delivery leadership role accountable for translating Revenue Management strategy into business capabilities, product roadmaps, and measurable outcomes that support pricing, demand forecasting, inventory management, and yield optimization.

This leader does not personally design models, write production code, or build pipelines. Instead, they serve as the primary bridge between Revenue Management business leaders and technology teams, driving alignment between business priorities, product roadmaps, and delivery execution. Positioned within the IT PMO, this role does not have direct reports and achieves results through influence, collaboration, and coordination across multiple product, engineering, data, and architecture teams. Success in this role requires a strong understanding of Revenue Management concepts, agile delivery, stakeholder alignment, and cross-functional leadership, supported by sufficient technical fluency to guide decisions, assess risks, and partner effectively with product owners, architects, engineers, and data science teams.

Key Responsibilities

Organizational Leadership

Provide leadership, coordination, and strategic direction across multidisciplinary product, engineering, data, and architecture teams supporting Revenue Management initiatives.
Set the product, delivery, and technology enablement vision for the Revenue Management Technology portfolio, ensuring alignment with business priorities, enterprise architecture, security, and delivery standards.
Influence and support talent development through coaching, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and collaboration with functional leaders across technology and business teams.
Cultivate a culture of engineering excellence, data-driven decision making, operational discipline, and continuous improvement.
Partner with business and technology leaders to develop, prioritize, and govern investment plans, budgets, vendor relationships, and resource allocations in support of Revenue Management objectives.

Business Partnership

Serve as the primary technology partner to the Revenue Management business leadership, building deep understanding of pricing, forecasting, yield, and inventory optimization workflows.
Partner with business stakeholders to elicit, prioritize, and translate data needs - including new data sources, data quality expectations, latency requirements, governance, and analytical use cases - into a technology roadmap.
Collaborate with Revenue Management, data science, and technology teams to ensure platforms and tools support forecasting, pricing, optimization, experimentation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement needs.
Translate business outcomes into measurable technology objectives (e.g., forecast accuracy lift, time-to-deploy a new model, data freshness SLAs, decision-support latency), and report progress to senior business and technology leadership.
Influence executive stakeholders by communicating complex data and ML concepts in plain, business-relevant language.

Technology Strategy and Architecture

Own the multi-year technology roadmap for Revenue Management data platforms, ML infrastructure, and application portfolio.
Provide business-informed oversight on architecture and platform decisions, ensuring technical approaches support Revenue Management outcomes, delivery commitments, scalability, reliability, and enterprise standards.
Ensure platforms support the end-to-end Revenue Management analytics lifecycle, from data availability and model enablement through deployment, monitoring, adoption, and business performance measurement.
Partner with architects and engineering leaders to evaluate and select appropriate data, analytics, ML, and cloud tooling, balancing business value, delivery speed, enterprise standards, maintainability, and cost.
Champion modern delivery, operational, and engineering practices that improve reliability, security, transparency, speed to market, and cost discipline.

Delivery and Product Management

Lead an agile delivery model across multiple product teams, ensuring clear product ownership, well-defined backlogs, predictable delivery cadence, and measurable outcomes.
Partner with product owners and delivery leaders to ensure roadmaps reflect business priorities, are sequenced for value delivery, and are grounded in realistic engineering estimates.
Drive operational excellence for business-facing Revenue Management capabilities, including service expectations, incident response, adoption, continuous reliability improvement, and measurable business impact.
Ensure compliance with enterprise standards for security, privacy, data governance, change management, and audit.

Required Knowledge And Experience

This leader should bring strong Revenue Management business acumen, product and delivery leadership, and practical technology fluency. The role is not intended to be the primary technical architect or hands-on engineering authority; rather, it requires enough understanding to ask the right questions, identify delivery and business risks, and ensure technology teams are enabling Revenue Management outcomes effectively.

Revenue Management and Business Domain

Strong understanding of Revenue Management concepts such as pricing, demand forecasting, inventory control, yield optimization, and decision-support workflows.
Ability to translate Revenue Management strategy, pain points, and operational needs into prioritized technology capabilities and measurable outcomes.
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to define success measures such as forecast accuracy, speed to market, data freshness, user adoption, and decision latency.
Ability to communicate data, analytics, and optimization concepts in practical business terms for executive and operational audiences.

Delivery and Product Leadership

Experience leading agile delivery across multiple teams, with clear ownership, prioritization, roadmap governance, and value-based sequencing.
Ability to coach product owners and delivery leads on backlog management, stakeholder alignment, dependency management, and outcome-based planning.
Strong delivery discipline, including risk management, trade-off decisions, progress reporting, and accountability for business outcomes.
Experience balancing near-term delivery needs with longer-term platform and capability investments.

Data, Analytics, and ML Enablement

Practical understanding of how data, analytics, and machine learning support Revenue Management use cases, including forecasting, pricing, optimization, and performance monitoring.
Ability to partner with data engineering, data science, and architecture teams to ensure required data sources, quality, governance, and platform capabilities are available.
Conversational fluency in data pipelines, analytics platforms, model deployment, monitoring, and retraining concepts, sufficient to evaluate risk and support informed decision-making.
Ability to ensure technical work is connected to business adoption, operational readiness, and measurable Revenue Management value.

Software Development

General understanding of modern software delivery practices, quality engineering, security, operational reliability, and technology lifecycle management.
Familiarity with modern application architectures and delivery patterns sufficient to engage product, engineering, and architecture teams effectively.
Awareness of enterprise security, compliance, governance, and operational standards that support reliable technology delivery.

Technology Oversight and Partnership

Ability to work effectively with solution architects, engineering leaders, data teams, security, infrastructure, and enterprise architecture partners.
General understanding of cloud-based data, analytics, and application platforms, including the ability to evaluate options at the business capability and delivery level.
Familiarity with modern engineering and operational practices such as automated delivery, observability, security-by-design, reliability, and cost management, without needing to personally implement them.
Ability to challenge technical proposals constructively by focusing on business fit, scalability, reliability, cost, risk, and delivery feasibility.

Experience

QUALIFICATIONS

15+ years of progressive technology, product, delivery, or business technology leadership experience, with significant experience leading cross-functional teams.
Demonstrated experience delivering data, analytics, application, or decision-support capabilities for a quantitative business function such as Revenue Management, pricing, supply chain, risk, marketing analytics, or similar.
Experience leading complex cross-functional portfolios and influencing teams across product, delivery, engineering, analytics, and business functions.
Proven ability to translate business strategy into roadmaps, delivery plans, investment priorities, and measurable outcomes.
Experience managing operating and capital budgets, vendor relationships, SaaS/platform investments, and delivery trade-offs.

Leadership Attributes

Strong executive presence; able to translate between Revenue Management leaders, product teams, delivery teams, and technical experts.
Outcome-oriented leader who prioritizes business value, adoption, delivery predictability, and operational excellence.
Comfortable holding teams accountable to delivery, quality, reliability, and enterprise standards without personally owning detailed technical implementation.
Collaborative partner to peer technology leaders across enterprise architecture, security, infrastructure, data, and business technology functions.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Analytics, or a related discipline required; advanced degree preferred.

About Nclh

Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. (NYSE: NCLH) is a leading global cruise company which operates the Norwegian Cruise Line®, Oceania Cruises® and Regent Seven Seas Cruises® brands. The combined brands currently operate 32 ships, employ over 35,000 shipboard crew from more than 110 different countries and visit approximately 700 different port destination each year.

Brief Description

Are you ready to embark on an extraordinary career journey? Look no further than The Austin Company, where greatness is not just a goal, but a way of life. The Vice President of Design and Engineering will provide technical and engineering leadership for both design-build and engineering only projects and pursuits. Requirements

Education: a bachelor’s degree in engineering or architecture from an accredited engineering school. This position requires professional registration and the ability to secure reciprocity in multiple states via NCEES or NCARB programs.
Experience: Minimum of 15 years of experience of which at least five years being the manager or director level of an engineering department.
Skills: Good oral and written communication skills are essential; strong leadership and team management skills; strong understanding of regulatory requirements and compliance standards in the engineering sector; ability to drive change and foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement; Experience with financial management and budgeting for engineering projects.

Summary

Provide strategic leadership and direction to the design and engineering team, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and innovation. Hold the team accountable for their individual duties and responsibilities.
Develop the vision for engineering success and own the outcome of the overall engineering strategy.
Work with Directors of Engineering to assign resources to project teams. These resources must be capable of supplying the expertise necessary for successful project performance.
Monitor and measure the quality of design and engineering capability and performance in all operations, ensuring that operational teams maintain client satisfaction, produce high quality service and deliverables, and produce a profit that meets or exceeds Austin’s annual plan for both dollar amount and margin.
Ensure distribution to projects and pursuits for all design and engineering personnel to meet established and budgeted amounts.
Maintain and develop new company policies, process, and procedures in connection with the professional and technical aspects of Austin’s design and engineering function. Monitor and ensure the compliance of these policies, processes, and procedures.
Identify and lead the development of market-specific engineering standards, resources, and tools to improve design production and efficiency.
Ensure proper architecture and engineering registration and licenses are maintained in all locations in which Austin operates.
Monitor Austin’s professional architecture and engineering practices to assure compliance with all laws and regulations pertaining to the professional practice of architecture and engineering in all locations where Austin is active.
Investigate significant design errors and implement actions and programs to avoid their repetition as well as to generally reduce engineering overhead costs.
Periodically, review representative drawings, specifications, preliminary studies and reports to ensure conformity with good practice.
Actively participate in professional organizations. Prepare and make presentations to clients and professional organizations.
Review and, if appropriate, recommend for approval requests for computerized equipment and software to support the design and engineering functions, which ensures cost effectiveness, high productivity, and maximum flexibility.
Identify, recommend, and monitor the training and development of designers, architects, and engineers to ensure high-level performance by these individuals.
Approve succession plans throughout the engineering department and ensure that training and development for key individuals are completed so that the individuals are prepared to take on increased responsibilities when appropriate.
Assist marketing, communication, and sales when their need involves design or engineering information to assist in the success of Company’s sales and marketing efforts.
Review and submit for management approval annual budgets for the engineering department.
For historical and planning purposes maintain a monthly index of engineering backlog.
Maintain liaison with Risk Management on all matters of professional liability to assist in successful prevention of liability problems and successful defense of possible liability cases should they occur.

Austin offers a comprehensive benefit package including Medical and Dental, Life, STD, LTD, and 401K with matching as well as a competitive salary with opportunity for advancement.

Austin is wholly owned subsidiary of Kajima.

The VP of Technical Operations will serve as a key strategic and operational leader to support the safe, compliant, and efficient operation of our fleet. Reporting directly to the SVP of Technical Operations, this role will serve as a critical link between the fleet and shoreside leadership, with direct oversight of vessel maintenance strategy, drydock execution, engineering performance, and technical compliance. Direct lifecycle management and scheduling of major drydock including cost estimation, contractor negotiations, and project execution oversight.
Drive adoption of predictive and condition-based maintenance practices to improve reliability and minimize unplanned downtime.

Collaborate with the Environmental and Marine Operations teams to implement energy efficiency initiatives and reduce carbon intensity.

Partner with procurement and supply chain to evaluate technical vendor performance, improve spare parts logistics, and standardize critical components across the fleet.
Ensure all systems and processes comply with environmental standards and Carnival’s sustainability commitments, including emissions reduction, waste treatment, and energy efficiency.

Champion a safety-first culture across shipboard and shoreside teams; support root cause analysis and corrective actions following technical incidents.
Lead technical audits and inspections, coordinate with internal auditors and external regulators on safety and compliance reviews.

Leadership & Collaboration
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of technical professionals including Technical Operations Directors, managers, technical superintendents.
Provide feedback on development and succession planning of shipboard engineering leadership roles.
Foster cross-functional collaboration with Marine Operations, Environmental Compliance, Finance, and Supply Chain, and Finance teams to align strategies, share resources, and manage costs.

Performs other duties as assigned

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, Mechanical Engineering, or related technical discipline.
Chief Engineer license or equivalent credential preferred.
Master’s degree is a plus.
Demonstrated expertise in marine systems, drydock execution, fuel optimization, and regulatory compliance.
Strong business acumen, with experience managing technical OPEX and CAPEX budgets.
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills; able to influence across all levels.
Strong understanding of international maritime regulatory frameworks and classification society requirements.
Experience managing multi-million-dollar technical budgets and large-scale projects.
Ability to assess operational risks and implement mitigation strategies.
Technically proficient with maintenance management systems (e.g., AMOS, Maximo), ship automation platforms, and data analytics tools.
10–15 years of experience in shipboard and shoreside technical roles, including drydock oversight.
At least 5 years in a senior leadership position with multi-vessel responsibility.

Employees may work from their home on Fridays. Candidates must be located in (or willing to relocate to) the Miami/Ft. Lauderdale area.

At Carnival, your total rewards package is much more than your base salary. All non-sales roles participate in an annual cash bonus program, while sales roles have an incentive plan. Director and above roles may also be eligible to participate in Carnival’s discretionary equity incentive plan. Plus, Carnival provides comprehensive and innovative benefits to meet your needs, including:

Health Benefits:
Cost-effective medical, dental and vision plans
Employee Assistance Program and other mental health resources
Additional programs include company paid term life insurance and disability coverage

Financial Benefits:
401(k) plan that includes a company match
Employee Stock Purchase plan

Paid Time Off:
Holidays – All full-time and part-time with benefits employees receive days off for 8 company-wide holidays, plus 2 additional floating holidays to be taken at the employee’s discretion.
Vacation Time – All full-time employees at the manager and below level start with 14 days/year; director and above level start with 19 days/year. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering - Robotics Manipulation
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is the engine of modern AI, and robotics is where AI meets the physical world. The Isaac robotics platform — spanning Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, Isaac ROS, the foundation models behind Isaac GR00T, and the accelerated libraries that run on Jetson and in the data center — is how the world’s developers and industrial leaders build intelligent robots.

We are looking for an exceptional engineering leader and manager to head up Isaac for Manipulation: giving robotic arms and dexterous systems the perception, grasping, motion, and learned skills they need to do real, impactful work. You will be responsible for the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Manipulation — turning hard, contact-rich problems in manufacturing, logistics, and industrial automation into shipping capabilities that our partners and developers can build on. This is a high-visibility role with direct line of sight to the most consequential problems in robotics today. You will grow and mentor a team of world-class robotics and machine-learning engineers, set a bold technical direction, and partner deeply with the robot-arm and industrial-automation ecosystem to make NVIDIA the default platform for robotic manipulation.

What You’ll Be Doing

Lead the Isaac Manipulation team. Recruit, grow, and mentor a high-performing team of robotics software engineers; set direction, raise the technical bar, and manage the team’s health, velocity, and delivery.
Shape the roadmap. Collaborate with Product Management to define and drive the strategy and roadmap for grasping, motion planning and control, perception-for-manipulation, and learned manipulation policies — from research to productized, supported platform capabilities.
Apply creative solutions to real industrial problems. Translate the hardest contact-rich manipulation tasks in manufacturing, logistics, assembly, and machine tending into robust capabilities that work in the real world, not just the lab.
Bridge research and product. Partner with NVIDIA Research, the Isaac Sim/Lab teams, and foundation-model teams (e.g., Isaac GR00T, Cosmos) to bring sim-to-real, imitation, and reinforcement learning approaches into the platform and onto physical arms.
Engage partners and developers. Serve as a technical face of Isaac Manipulation to robot-arm OEMs, system integrators, and the developer community — gathering requirements, running joint engineering, and ensuring our APIs and tools meet real workflows. Support our ecosystem of developers through responsible migration handling of their solutions built on our durable platform.
Leverage accelerated compute. Drive architecture and execution that fully uses NVIDIA GPUs, CUDA, and the accelerated-computing stack across simulation, training, and on-robot inference on Jetson and edge platforms.
Deliver. Drive planning and execution of complex, multi-functional programs; own quality, performance, and the real-world deployment of learned policies and manipulation stacks on physical robots.
Influence the strategy. Represent manipulation in platform-level technical and business decisions, and help shape where NVIDIA invests across the robotics stack.

What We Need To See

BS, MS, or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
12+ total years of relevant industry experience building robotics or robotics-adjacent systems, including 3+ years leading, mentoring, and managing engineering teams.
Robotic arm depth. Hands-on expertise with robotic arms, manipulation, and physics from grasping, motion planning (across both numerical optimization and sampling-based approaches), and control (including force/impedance and contact-rich control) to perception-guided manipulation.
Accelerated compute. Working understanding of GPU-accelerated computing and modern ML infrastructure, and how to architect robotics software to take advantage of it (CUDA, PyTorch, GPU-accelerated simulation, edge inference).
Partner and developer interface. Demonstrated ability to work directly with external partners, customers, and developer communities and to translate their needs into roadmap and shipping product.
Technical credibility. Strong software engineering fundamentals (modern C++ and Python) and the ability to engage substantively in technical and architectural decisions with your team.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Industry leadership and fluency. Experience building manipulation or industrial automation products at an established robot-arm company or manipulation startup, and a strong understanding of the product landscape including use cases, the integrators, and the platforms from leading vendors.
Hardware-agnostic platforms. A track record building developer-facing or low-code platforms and tooling that abstract across multiple robot-arm brands and make manipulation accessible to non-experts.
Learned manipulation. Deep experience with imitation learning, reinforcement learning, sim-to-real transfer, or manipulation foundation models, and shipping learned policies onto real hardware.
Ecosystem & OSS. Contributions to ROS 2, ros2_control, MoveIt, or the broader robotics open-source and standards community.
Founder / 0-to-1 instincts. Experience starting or scaling a product or team from the ground up and operating with speed in ambiguous, fast-pace problem spaces.

Manipulation is one of the defining unsolved problems in robotics, and NVIDIA is uniquely positioned — across simulation, foundation models, and accelerated compute — to solve it at platform scale. You’ll lead a team that the entire robotics industry builds on, and your work will show up on factory floors and in warehouses around the world!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 272,000 USD - 431,250 USD for Level 4, and 320,000 USD - 488,750 USD for Level 5.

Operational Compliance & Audit Readiness: Ensure that infrastructure operations consistently comply with enterprise security policies, baselines, and regulatory requirements. Supervise recurring operational compliance checks and evidence collection for internal and external audits. Proactively address and remediate compliance deviations, maintaining audit readiness and documentation of controls at all times.
Secure Build Coordination: Collaborate with Cloud, Systems, Network, and Identity & Access Management (IAM) teams to integrate security requirements into infrastructure builds and changes. Validate that new systems and services are built in accordance with secure-by-default Ensure patch cycles, backups, and recovery processes for new deployments meet security and resilience standards.
Privileged Access Management Operations: Provide oversight for the enterprise’s privileged access management (PAM) operations and tooling. Ensure secure administration of privileged account vaults and credentials, enforcement of break-glass procedures (in partnership with IAM), and regular review/rotation of privileged access across all infrastructure teams.
Security Tooling & Monitoring: Ensure effective operation of key infrastructure security tools and monitoring processes. Oversee the team in maintaining and optimizing tools such as vulnerability scanners, EDR platforms, and configuration compliance systems. Leverage dashboards and reports to monitor infrastructure security alerts and the overall protection posture, driving continuous improvements in threat detection and response.
Governance & ARB Alignment: Represent the IPO team in governance processes and Architecture Review Board (ARB) discussions. Ensure that proposed infrastructure changes meet security control requirements and obtain necessary approvals. Drive the submission and tracking of any security exceptions or control deviations through governance workflows, partnering with Enterprise Architecture, Security Engineering, and other stakeholders to align on secure design and policy enforcement.
Disaster Recovery Alignment: Maintain disaster recovery (DR) readiness for IPO-managed security tools and processes. Ensure that procedures for recovering critical security infrastructure (e.g., security monitoring consoles, vulnerability scanners, policy stores) are documented and periodically tested. Align the IPO team’s DR plans with the broader enterprise DR/BCP (Business Continuity Plan) to guarantee rapid restoration of security capabilities during disruptions.
Security Engineering Partnership: Drive alignment between Security Engineering priorities and Infrastructure Operations and Architecture outcomes to support the desired future technology footprint (secure, compliant, and supportable).

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
7+ years of experience in enterprise IT infrastructure security, operations, or systems administration, including at least 3 years in a people leadership role.
ITIL 4 Certification completed or ability to complete within 90 days of employment.
Strong technical background in vulnerability management, endpoint security, network security operations, and infrastructure protection. Hands-on experience with patch management processes, endpoint protection (AV/EDR), and firewall/proxy administration.
Deep understanding of security frameworks, standards, and compliance requirements (e.g., CIS benchmarks, NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and a track record of ensuring operational adherence to these standards.

Preferred Skills

Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, or a related field.
Relevant industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or GIAC certifications (e.g., GCCC, GCWN).

We're seeking a Director of Engineering to lead our Central AI Engineering team. This role is focused on transforming how we deliver software
—driving adoption of agentic workflows, accelerators, and AI-first engineering practices that fundamentally change delivery speed, quality, and team effectiveness across our organization.

You'll lead an internal platform team whose primary customers are our client delivery teams. You own both the systems that enable delivery and the adoption that makes them successful. This requires technical depth, people leadership, influential communication, and the ability to build compelling investment cases for technology initiatives across a matrixed organization.

The ideal candidate is intellectually curious and continuously experimenting with new AI capabilities, often building side prototypes or exploring emerging tools to understand what is possible.

Curious how Home fits into Red Ventures? Click here.

What You’ll Do

Transform Delivery Through Agentic Workflows

Lead adoption of agentic workflows and AI-first delivery models across client delivery teams
Build shared services, accelerators, and reusable patterns that materially reduce delivery timelines
Measure and continuously improve delivery efficiency, quality, and consistency
Ensure agentic systems are reliable, maintainable, and applied with clear leverage
Define and scale AI-assisted development practices (Cursor, Windsurf, agent frameworks)
Partner closely with delivery teams to understand friction points and build solutions that drive adoption

Build Investment Cases & Drive Strategic Alignment

Develop compelling business cases for technology investments in agentic systems and AI infrastructure
Quantify impact through metrics like delivery time reduction, quality improvements, and team velocity gains
Communicate technical strategy and ROI to senior leadership and stakeholders
Influence resource allocation and prioritization across competing initiatives
Translate technical capabilities into business value that resonates with non-technical audiences

Provide Technical & Architectural Leadership

Set architectural direction for agentic systems, accelerators, and shared AI services
Ensure systems are modular, secure, observable, and production-ready
Uphold strong engineering discipline while balancing innovation and pragmatism
Provide hands-on guidance to Senior and Staff engineers when needed
Define standards across Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, testing, CI/CD, and MLOps

Build and Scale the Team

Hire, develop, and retain AI engineers
Set clear expectations, career paths, and growth plans
Foster a culture of accountability, curiosity, experimentation, and delivery
Coach teams to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
Build a team that thinks like internal entrepreneurs; focused on customer (delivery team) adoption and impact

Lead Cross-Functionally

Act as a trusted partner to delivery teams, Product, Design, and Data leadership
Translate business strategy into executable technical plans
Communicate tradeoffs, progress, and impact to senior leaders with clarity and conviction
Influence effectively in a matrixed organization where adoption matters as much as technical execution
Build coalitions and drive alignment across stakeholders with competing priorities

10+ years of engineering experience, including leadership of high-performing teams
Experience building and operating production AI, ML, or data-driven systems

Track record of improving delivery velocity and engineering maturity through platform or tooling investments

Experience with modern AI stacks, including LLMs, agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph), and ML platforms

Strong Python experience; familiarity with JavaScript and TypeScript
Experience with Databricks, MLflow, and modern data platforms

jobs.title: Director, Production and Test Engineering
jobs.description:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.
What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.
It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

YOUR MISSION

As Director, Production and Test Engineering, you will lead the Denver-based team of technicians, production engineers, test engineers, and manufacturing engineers to deliver fully qualified spacecraft on aggressive timelines. You will own the build and test processes, schedules, and capacity planning required to execute production commitments. You will partner closely with Program Management and Engineering to provide inputs to the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS), align capacity with demand, and drive disciplined execution against production milestones. Beyond delivery, you will be accountable for continuously improving efficiency, automation, and process maturity to reduce turn time and increase throughput. This role requires both strategic foresight and hands-on leadership: setting standards, driving automation, solving problems, and developing people to their full potential while ensuring every spacecraft meets mission assurance standards.

Responsibilities

Lead and mentor a high-performing team across production, test, and manufacturing engineering.
Own execution of production and test schedules to meet program delivery commitments.
Drive load capacity planning - forecast demand, balance resources, and ensure teams are properly staffed and focused.
Provide accurate inputs to the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS), aligning production and test activities with program needs.
Own and continuously improve build and test processes, ensuring efficiency, repeatability, and compliance with AS9100/ISO9001 standards.
Champion efficiency and automation initiatives to reduce cycle time, improve first-time yield, and scale production capability.
Oversee test execution, including requirements verification, procedure development, data analysis, and anomaly resolution.
Lead root cause investigations and ensure corrective actions are implemented effectively.
Invest in developing team members through coaching, mentorship, and growth opportunities, enabling them to reach their full potential.
Ensure facilities and workspaces are clean, organized, and optimized for safety and efficiency.

What Success Looks Like

Production and test schedules executed predictably, with milestones met or exceeded.
Efficiency and automation drive measurable reductions in turn time and increase throughput.
Capacity plans that accurately anticipate workload and prevent bottlenecks.
High first-time yield and reduced anomalies demonstrate process maturity.
Denver team engagement, technical excellence, and professional growth consistently visible.
Build and test processes that are scalable, disciplined, and trusted by stakeholders.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in manufacturing, Mechanical, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.
Over 10 years of experience in space component, spacecraft production, and testing.
In-depth knowledge of AS9100/ISO9001 production standards, requirements, and testing protocols.
Proven track record in managing high-rate, complex components and assemblies, as well as executing detailed test plans.
Extensive experience with MRP, PLM, and MES application systems, and the integration of automation components across these systems.
Strong expertise in lean manufacturing principles, rapid prototyping methodologies, and environmental testing such as vibration, thermal, or shock testing.
Solid understanding of spacecraft testing facilities and tooling, including vibration tables, TVAC, EMI/EMC chambers, optical alignment stations, and FlatSats.
Experience with ESD sensitive component and assembly manufacturing.
Demonstrated ability to effectively manage and maintain a cleanroom environment, ensuring organization and cleanliness to the highest standards.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in manufacturing, mechanical, aerospace engineering or equivalent discipline.
15+ years of experience in space component and/or spacecraft production and testing.
Experience with CNC, tube bending, and other production equipment.
Familiarity with LabVIEW, MATLAB, or Python for data processing or test automation.
Capable of building and maintaining IMS schedules with Program Management and schedulers with a deep understanding of critical paths and mitigation techniques.
Active DoD clearance or ability to obtain one is a plus.

Compensation

Base Salary: $175,000 - $240,000
Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience.

Additional Requirements

Work Location—Successful candidates will be located near Denver, CO. While we observe a hybrid work environment, some work must be done on site.
Work environment—the work environment; temperature, noise level, inside or outside, or other factors that will affect the person's working conditions while performing the job.
Physical demands—the physical demands of the job, including bending, sitting, lifting and driving.

jobs.description:
About Arcade

Arcade is building the world’s first AI physical product creation platform, where imagination becomes reality. Our platform lets anyone design, purchase, and sell custom, manufacturable products using natural language and generative AI. We believe everyone should have the power to create physical goods as easily as they post online, and we’re building the infrastructure to make that real for both consumers and businesses.

We’ve raised $42M from a world-class group of investors, including Reid Hoffman, Forerunner Ventures (Kirsten Green), Canaan Partners (Laura Chau), Adverb Ventures (April Underwood), Factorial Funds (Sol Bier), Offline Ventures (Brit Morin), Sound Ventures (Ashton Kutcher), Inspired Capital (Alexa von Tobel), and Torch Capital (Jonathan Keidan). Our angel investors include Elad Gil, Ev Williams, Marissa Mayer, Sara Beykpour, Kayvon Beykpour, Anna Veronika Dorogush, Eugenia Kuyda, David Luan, Sharon Zhou, Kelly Wearstler, Karlie Kloss, Colin Kaepernick, Christy Turlington Burns, and Jeff Wilke.

Arcade is headquartered in San Francisco’s Presidio and led by serial entrepreneur Mariam Naficy (Minted, Eve), and a mission-driven team from Google, Apple, Stability AI, Glean, NVIDIA, Databricks, LinkedIn, Stanford, MIT, Berkeley, and more. Arcade’s Chief AI Officer is Varun Jampani, a leading researcher who co-authored Dreambooth and created Stable Diffusion 3.5, among other things. Raghudeep Gadde, Head of Research at Arcade, was formerly a Principal Scientist at Amazon. Together, we’re pioneering a new category at the intersection of AI, personal expression, and on-demand manufacturing, and we’re building fast.

The role

We’re early and moving fast. The core platform is the backbone of Arcade: order management, fulfillment pipelines, pricing engine, and manufacturer operations that sit underneath everything we ship. We need someone to own this system end to end — and make it robust, scalable, and built to last.

We’re hiring a Director of Core Platform Engineering to own Arcade’s mission critical commerce and operations infrastructure. This is a leadership role – you’ll work directly with our CEO and product leadership, and be the point person in charge of architecting, implementing, and evolving this system to scale to millions of end users.

Some concrete problems you’ll own

Platform architecture. Enforce clean APIs, horizontally scalable microservices, and modern deployment practices. Create the foundation that allows our entire engineering org to ship fast.
Order fulfillment pipeline. End-to-end order lifecycle from checkout through manufacturer fulfillment — webhooks, status tracking, notifications, and more across a global supply chain.
Real-time pricing engine. Dynamic pricing across a wide variety of product categories. Volume discounts, drop-ship surcharges, and — all exposed as clean, reliable backend APIs for both internal and external stakeholders.
AI inference workloads. Arcade runs image generation jobs at scale. You’ll own the infrastructure that makes these jobs reliable, cost-efficient, and production-grade — think batching, parallelization, auto-scaling, and observability.
Client SDK and MCP. Own the integration layer that allows developers to build applications on top of Arcade — think product creation, order lifecycle management, authentication, and billing.

What We’re Looking For

8+ years of backend engineering experience. You’ve built and owned production systems that processed real transactions at scale. You’ve seen growing pains going from 0-1, and 1-100, and know how to solve them.
Commerce or marketplace experience. You’ve worked with order management, fulfillment pipelines, payment systems, or multi-sided marketplace infrastructure. Shopify ecosystem experience is a bonus.
Strong systems instincts. You think in APIs, schemas, and service boundaries. You know how to build for long term maintainability and scalability. You’re the person who catches issues before they become a production incident.
You simplify things. You look at a complex system and see the unnecessary parts. You have a bias toward fewer moving pieces, typed data, and clean contracts.
Comfortable with ambiguity. The product is moving fast. You’ll make architectural decisions before every requirement is clean — and you’ll make good ones.

Nice to have:

Expert-level proficiency in Typescript and/or Python.
Familiarity with scaled GPU inference infrastructure.
Background in multi-tenant SaaS, subscription/metering systems, or volume pricing engines.
Interest in design, art, or physical goods — Arcade lives at the intersection of all three.

What You’ll Get

Compensation: Top-of-market base salary plus meaningful early-stage equity — a level of ownership you cannot get at a large company.
Ownership: You will own the system that every order flows through. As the platform scales, your architecture and technical decisions will directly shape the company's future.
Mentorship: Direct collaboration with Mariam Naficy (CEO, founder of Minted and Eve) and Michael Mader (Head of Product), plus access to senior advisors who have built commerce systems at scale.
Learning velocity: Twelve months at Arcade will teach you more than three years anywhere else. We mean that literally.
Mission: You’ll help artists and makers build real businesses on top of AI — not help advertisers target more people. That matters.

Competitive compensation
Lunch provided daily
Company events

jobs.title: Senior Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
About The Campaign Finance Board

The Campaign Finance Board is a nonpartisan, independent city agency that empowers New Yorkers to have a greater impact on their elections. Our mission is to make local democracy more open, transparent, and equitable by removing barriers to participation.

We make it easier for New Yorkers to vote, meaningfully support candidates for city office, and run for office themselves. NYC Votes, our voter engagement initiative, meets people where they are to share trustworthy election information and help New Yorkers make a plan to vote. We publish the citywide Voter Guide, which delivers information about candidates directly to voters’ doors. Our public matching funds program ensures small contributions can make a big difference, allowing regular people to run for office by relying on the support of other regular people, not just wealthy donors and special interests. And we lift the veil on how candidates raise and spend money, increasing transparency and accountability in local government.

We believe that when every New Yorker is empowered to participate meaningfully in elections, candidates will better reflect the communities they serve, elected leaders will be more accountable to the public, and New Yorkers will have a democracy they can truly trust.

About The Unit

Strategy, Products, and Innovation Division

The Strategy, Products, and Innovation (SPI) division is where the agency plans its future and builds it. SPI brings together long-term planning, research and policy implementation, product development, and technology modernization operating across the agency to test new ideas and turn them into lasting improvements and new experiences. Across all of its work, the division is committed to advancing a democracy that is more open, transparent, and equitable for all New Yorkers.

Technology Department

The Technology Department builds, maintains, and secures the systems that make New York City’s campaign finance program work. This is the team behind CSMART, CFIS, FACTS, and the agency’s website, the platforms that power public matching funds, disclosure, and compliance for campaigns across the city. The department is in the middle of an ambitious modernization migrating core systems to the cloud, integrating modern software solutions where they fit, and building infrastructure engineered for the security, reliability, and scale that high-stakes public systems demand. Members of the team write and maintain custom software, strengthen the agency’s cybersecurity posture, and turn a legacy environment into a modern one. For engineers who want their work to matter, the mission of this team is to build the technology that makes democracy work better for all.

Job Description

The New York City Campaign Finance Board seeks a Senior Director of Engineering to lead the engineering function that builds and runs the technology behind New York City's public matching funds program, the Voter Guide, and the agency's campaign finance disclosure and compliance systems. For engineers who want their work to matter, this is the seat that shapes how campaign finance, voter education, and public matching funds get built for the next decade of New York elections.

The platforms that power every city election are in the middle of a multi-year modernization from legacy .NET onto cloud-native Python infrastructure, targeting completion in 2027.

This senior leadership role owns the multi-year technical roadmap end to end, supervising software development, quality assurance, and Salesforce engineering, with data engineering operating as an agency-wide shared platform service that supports analytics and research teams across the agency. Within 6 to 12 months of hire, the role expands to include direct oversight of Infrastructure and Cybersecurity, consolidating engineering accountability across the agency's technical stack.

This is a turnaround leadership role. The Senior Director inherits a function with inconsistent engineering practice, meaningful technical debt, and technical leaders who are being tasked with growing their managerial capabilities. Building baseline engineering discipline, developing managerial capability, and delivering reliable services through active transformation are the core of the first two years.

This is also a build role. The Senior Director stands up a Salesforce engineering function from scratch, matures a data engineering operation into a shared platform service, and reskills a technical workforce alongside vendor knowledge transfer.

The role is designed for an engineering leader earlier in their leadership career, someone with the technical credibility to earn trust across engineering teams and the appetite to build practices where they do not yet exist.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership Development and Organizational Management

Build, supervise and mentor a leadership team across engineering functions (software development, quality assurance, Salesforce engineering, data engineering, and infrastructure), establishing clear accountability and developing managerial capability within the engineering organization.
Work with CFB leadership and internal partners to implement baseline people management practices, including hiring, performance management, career development, feedback, evaluation and retention strategies that attract and retain engineering talent in the public sector.
Foster an engineering culture that prioritizes collaborative problem-solving, knowledge-sharing, accountability, and continuous improvement across technical teams and agency-wide partnerships.
In partnership with the Senior Director of Product, work with CFB leadership and internal partners to expand knowledge, engagement and comfort with the software development lifecycle, agile processes and product thinking, to ensure a balanced mixture of maintenance and stability, quality-of-life improvements and ambitious experimentation and innovation.

Strategic Technology Planning and Engineering Standards

Set and track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
Develop and maintain a multiyear technical roadmap that aligns engineering work with the agency's product roadmap, digital priorities, and modernization goals.
Establish, document, and enforce engineering standards, including coding standards, branching strategy, security policies, compliance requirements, and architecture review practices.
Evaluate emerging technologies (including cloud-based solutions, open-source tools, and AI applications) and recommend adoption decisions appropriate to public-sector cost, risk, and capability constraints.

Software Development, QA, and AI Implementation Leadership

Develop and maintain a standard tracking system and reporting standards to track delivery flow, predictability, quality, and end-to-end traceability.
Lead the agency's software development and quality assurance functions, including supervision of engineering managers.
Own the software development lifecycle, DevOps, and CI/CD pipelines. Drive agile delivery practices in coordination with product leadership.
Own the technical implementation of AI use cases (building, integrating, and operating models in production as software delivery) and the technical evaluation of whether a model performs against the data provided (capability, accuracy, latency, cost, and technical security).
Manage technical debt proactively and make sound architecture decisions.

Infrastructure and Cybersecurity Oversight

Provide senior-level oversight of the agency's IT infrastructure and cybersecurity functions, including network architecture, cloud infrastructure, end-user computing, helpdesk operations, and the agency's cybersecurity posture.
Ensure alignment with citywide IT standards (NYC Office of Technology and Innovation) and cybersecurity requirements (NYC Cyber Command).
Lead disaster readiness and business continuity planning.

Data Engineering Build and Operations

Oversee the agency's data engineering build-and-operations function, delivering secure, scalable data infrastructure to enterprise governance standards.
Oversee design, construction, and operation of modern data architecture (the data lakehouse, real-time API integrations, and ETL/ELT pipelines).
Provide senior technical oversight of major data-architecture build decisions, including evaluating vendor-built data infrastructure for soundness and scalability.
Operate the function as an agency-wide shared platform service serving distributed analytics and research teams.

Salesforce Engineering Buildout

Build, from the ground up, an in-house Salesforce engineering function responsible for the codebase, configurations, documentation, and infrastructure of the agency's Salesforce instances.
Hire a Director of Salesforce Engineering and establish team structure, processes, and standards.
Establish in-house procedures for bug fixes, service requests, and feature enhancements.
Ensure Salesforce use aligns with NYC Cyber Command, internal security policy, and records retention requirements.

Vendor Delivery Oversight and Workforce Development

Provide senior technical oversight of strategic technology vendors, with the depth required to evaluate what is being built rather than relying on vendor self-reporting.
Hold vendors accountable for scope, quality, and delivery commitments.
Lead the agency's technical workforce development strategy, including reskilling programs and structured, time-bound knowledge transfer from vendors to internal staff.
Manage technical hiring across engineering teams, in coordination with the agency's hiring prioritization plan.

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES & OTHER BEHAVIORS (KSAOs)

We're seeking individuals eager to make an impact, even if they don't tick every box on our job description. We believe in the power of diverse perspectives and the unique blend of lived experiences, non-traditional education pathways, practical know-how, and a variety of skills and abilities that each candidate brings to the table. If you're ready to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply and be part of our dynamic team.

Knowledge

Software development lifecycle, DevOps, and CI/CD practices applied to enterprise-scale systems.
Building, integrating, and operating AI/ML use cases in production as software delivery, and technical model evaluation (capability, accuracy, latency, cost, and technical security).
Modern data architecture build, including data lakehouse construction, ETL/ELT pipelines, and real-time API integrations, sufficient to oversee delivery.
Enterprise network architecture, cloud infrastructure, and the relationship between infrastructure decisions and application engineering outcomes.
Building a technical function from scratch (Salesforce, data engineering), including team structure, hiring plan, and operating model.

Supervising and developing engineering managers and directors, including building managerial capability in technical leaders who have functioned primarily as individual contributors, with genuine investment in growing technical leaders into effective managers and patience for development timelines.
Establishing, documenting, and enforcing engineering standards across teams previously operating without consistent practice.
Providing senior technical oversight of vendor-built data infrastructure, with the depth to evaluate architectural soundness rather than rely on vendor self-reporting.

Diagnosing root causes across technical debt, organizational structure, and people capability simultaneously, distinguishing between individual capability gaps and systemic process gaps.

About Acasia
Acasia builds, deploys, and operates high-performance GPU infrastructure for enterprise AI workloads. Our customers rely on Acasia to deliver production-grade GPU environments that are performant, reliable, scalable, and supportable in real-world data center conditions.

As Acasia expands across multiple data center markets, we are hiring a Vice President of Infrastructure & Deployment to serve as our senior infrastructure subject matter expert, technical authority, and escalation leader for GPU infrastructure design, deployment readiness, complex troubleshooting, ongoing support, and production reliability.

Role Summary
The Vice President of Infrastructure & Deployment owns the successful delivery, implementation, commissioning, and operational readiness of Acasia's AI infrastructure across customer and data center environments.

This executive owns the complete delivery lifecycle—from customer handoff after contract execution through deployment planning, installation, networking, cluster bring-up, validation, production acceptance, and ongoing optimization—ensuring every GPU cluster is delivered safely, on schedule, on budget, and to Acasia's standards before entering production.

The VP will build and lead Acasia's Infrastructure Delivery organization, managing field engineering teams that implement large-scale GPU clusters across multiple data centers and customer locations. They will establish deployment methodologies, technical standards, playbooks, commissioning procedures, and quality controls while driving continuous improvement in deployment speed, consistency, and customer experience. They will work hand-in-hand with customers, Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, Product, Operations, Procurement, OEM partners, networking vendors, and data center operators.

Mission:
Build the industry's fastest, most reliable GPU infrastructure deployment organization—taking customer environments from signed contract to production in weeks instead of months.

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure Architecture & Technical Leadership

Own infrastructure architecture standards for GPU clusters across all Acasia deployments.
Define reference architectures for rack layouts, power distribution, cooling, networking, storage, monitoring, telemetry, and remote management.
Review customer infrastructure designs for scalability, resilience, serviceability, deployment efficiency, and lifecycle management.
Identify technical and deployment risks before implementation begins.
Establish repeatable infrastructure standards that simplify deployment while improving reliability and operational excellence.
Partner with Engineering, Product, Security, Sales, Customer Success, Procurement, OEMs, and customers to ensure infrastructure designs meet both technical and commercial objectives.

Networking & Cluster Integration

Own deployment and validation of high-performance AI networking environments.
Lead implementation of InfiniBand, Ethernet, RoCE, RDMA, NVLink, NVSwitch, GPUDirect, and NVIDIA networking technologies.
Oversee spine-leaf architecture deployment, east-west networking, switch configuration, storage networking, and cluster connectivity.
Establish standards for network validation, benchmarking, congestion analysis, latency optimization, and fabric performance tuning.
Validate cluster communication performance using NCCL, MPI, RDMA, and other AI infrastructure benchmarking tools.
Partner with NVIDIA and networking OEMs to optimize production environments.

Production Readiness & Commissioning

Define production acceptance standards for every customer deployment.
Own Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), cluster commissioning, and customer handoff.
Establish standards for hardware acceptance, BIOS and firmware consistency, GPU validation, driver installation, CUDA readiness, storage validation, telemetry, monitoring, and observability.
Lead burn-in procedures, stress testing, soak testing, redundancy validation, performance baselining, and workload validation before production acceptance.
Ensure every customer environment meets Acasia's technical standards before entering production.

Program Management & Deployment Execution

Build and manage deployment schedules for large-scale infrastructure implementations.
Coordinate execution across internal teams, customers, OEMs, contractors, and deployment partners.
Track milestones, critical path activities, dependencies, and implementation risks.
Lead executive deployment reviews and customer implementation meetings.
Develop standardized governance, reporting, and deployment management processes.
Drive continuous improvement in deployment efficiency, predictability, and execution quality.

Technical Escalation & Problem Resolution

Lead cross-functional war-room responses during critical deployments or production-impacting incidents.
Troubleshoot issues spanning GPU hardware, Linux, networking, firmware, drivers, storage, environmental systems, and customer workloads.
Partner with Engineering, OEMs, vendors, data center providers, and customers on root cause analysis and permanent corrective actions.
Convert recurring issues into improved standards, tooling, automation, documentation, and deployment methodologies.

Leadership & Organizational Development

Build and lead Acasia's Infrastructure Delivery and Field Engineering organization.
Recruit, mentor, and develop world-class infrastructure engineers and deployment leaders.
Establish technical certification and training programs across the organization.
Build repeatable knowledge transfer mechanisms, technical playbooks, deployment standards, and troubleshooting frameworks.
Foster a culture of accountability, precision, technical excellence, customer obsession, and continuous improvement.

Vendor & Strategic Partner Management

Build executive technical relationships with NVIDIA, OEM partners, networking providers, storage vendors, and data center operators.
Evaluate new infrastructure technologies, deployment methodologies, and vendor capabilities.
Participate in technical due diligence for new data center markets and deployment strategies.
Hold strategic partners accountable during implementation and complex technical escalations.

Define and own the technical vision, strategy and metrics for your area, ensuring its teams and the rest of Wayve are aligned and galvanised.

Drive an eval-driven culture to reach KPI targets with high predictability and resource efficiency.
Partner with the senior leadership team to maintain a culture of impact, performance, and health.
Build technical capabilities across the division and develop talented engineers as Wayve grows. Build resilient and reliable systems, teams and individuals.
Work closely with team members to develop career plans and growth trajectories based on each individual’s strengths and weaknesses and their own aspirations.

Our Team

The team is passionate, talented, and customer-focused. They embody core leadership principles in their work and culture. The organization is a distributed team with remote employees across every US time zone, as well as select offices in the US and internationally.

Who You Are

This individual takes ownership beyond their remit and does not wait for a clean, fully-scoped mandate before moving. They lead through strong managers, but do not hide behind them: when something needs fixing, they are just as likely to jump in and fix it themselves as they are to coach someone else through it. They think critically and move fast, comfortable making calls with incomplete information and adjusting as they learn more.

This person will thrive in this role if they get energy from operating across multiple different functions, some they know deeply, some they are learning as they go, and they are honest with themselves and others about which is which. They will thrive here if they see an evolving scope as an opportunity rather than a liability.

What You'll Do

Own the tech stack and teams that run operations at the organization.
Lead established technical systems architecture and admin teams, redesigning the go-to-market stack for efficiency in an AI-first world.
Personally own and drive select high-priority workstreams and initiatives directly, not solely through delegation.
Deliver impactful, company-wide capabilities that improve business outcomes and drive key decisions, while supporting the business’s operating cadence.
Manage a team of managers and individual contributors across functions, stepping in directly wherever the situation requires it.
Drive AI-native transformation across every function owned, including hands-on build where appropriate.

What You've Done

Led a multi-function technical or operational organization, managing managers across domains.
Owned outcomes, not just outputs. Achieved business impact like growth, efficiency, conversion, retention, not just dashboards or insights. This role will help shape the future of the company.
Worked closely enough with data engineering, software engineering, or technical systems to troubleshoot issues directly, not just interpret reports from others.
Operated in a mid-size, high-growth company where building was required without inheriting mature infrastructure.
Navigated a role or organization structure that changed shape over time, and adapted their own scope and approach accordingly.
Built AI-native workflows or tooling that materially changed how a team or company operated, not incremental automation, but real step-function change in how work got done.
Collaborated closely with C-suite and executive leaders to shape strategy using data, including creating structure in ambiguity.

This role is not a fit if...

You prefer a role with a fully-defined, static scope; this organization and mandate are still being shaped, and will continue to shift based on where strengths land.
You lead primarily through delegation and expect managers to fully own execution; this role requires you to personally step in and drive work directly, not just direct others.
You rely on authority to get things done; success in this role requires influencing across teams with competing priorities, not just managing within your organization.
