About Hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we’re building the AI-powered platform that enables the world’s most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We’re changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we’re scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world’s largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure; it’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About The Team

Solutions (Field Engineering) sits at the technical heart of hx’s go-to-market engine, owning the ‘Technical Win’ in every opportunity. The team operates at the intersection of product, sales, and customer success, working directly with underwriters, actuaries, IT leaders, and security teams at some of the world’s most sophisticated insurers.

This is where deep technical capability, domain expertise, and commercial insight come together to solve complex problems and design solutions customers trust to run their most critical pricing and underwriting decisions.

The team thrives at the edge of what’s possible — tackling the hardest integration and implementation challenges where creativity, rigour, and technical depth are essential. Every engagement is high-stakes, highly visible, and directly influences both revenue outcomes and product direction.

This is a high-ownership, collaborative environment where consistency of execution matters as much as innovation. Field Engineering doesn’t just support deals — it accelerates them, de-risks them, and shapes how hx shows up in the market.

This is a people-first leadership role focused on team performance, coaching, and operational excellence. You will be accountable for how effectively the Solutions Engineering team supports revenue, while partnering closely with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to ensure strong, consistent technical execution.

Drive optimal win rates across qualified opportunities by coaching Solutions Team (Solutions Engineers and Architects) through discovery, demos, architectural workshops, and proof-of-value engagements with clear, technically and commercially aligned execution
Drive optimal Technical Win conversion from proof-of-value to closed deals by analysing outcomes, capturing learnings, and refining how the team builds customer confidence
Reduce sales cycle length and improve forecast accuracy by identifying technical risks early and partnering with Sales to proactively unblock deals
Build and develop a high-performing, engaged team through clear standards, structured feedback, and defined career progression pathways
Establish consistent execution frameworks across discovery, solution design, and POV delivery, using metrics and AI-enabled workflows to scale quality
Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to align technical execution with revenue goals and influence product direction

What you'll need to have done

Led or significantly contributed to Solutions Engineering or Solutions Architecture teams in a B2B SaaS or similarly complex environment
Demonstrated measurable impact on presales metrics such as win rates, POV conversion, sales cycle length, or forecast accuracy
Built or improved presales processes (discovery frameworks, demo structures, POV execution) that brought consistency and quality to how technical teams engage with customers.
Coached and developed individual contributors, improving technical storytelling, solution design, and stakeholder management, alongside experience (or clear readiness) in hiring, onboarding, and managing performance. Used data and metrics to drive team performance and accountability.
Partnered effectively with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to align technical strategy with commercial outcomes
Maintained technical credibility with customers, senior stakeholders and internal teams by staying current with product capabilities, guiding solution design, and supporting the team through complex technical conversations.
AI-native in practice - Uses AI tools as a natural part of technical and delivery work — documentation, troubleshooting, scaling the team practice - not exploring what's possible but already doing it.

You prefer to stay hands-on as an individual contributor rather than building leverage through coaching and team development.
You're uncomfortable holding people accountable to clear standards or providing direct feedback when performance falls short.
You default to process over judgment, or struggle to operate effectively in a fast-changing, high-stakes environment where the playbook is still being written.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energized, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

You’ll establish foundational architectural frameworks, technology standards, and best practices for our cloud-native platform, with AWS as the core environment. We celebrate diversity--of your background, your experiences and your unique identity. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and equitable workplace where all of our employees can Come as They Are. We believe that when we bring our different perspectives to work, we are truly Better Together.

Establish principles and patterns for platform scalability, reliability, security, observability, and cost optimization across platform services and shared capabilities

Partner with domain architects and engineering teams to ensure shared platform services are reusable, modular, and governed, and that domain teams can self-serve effectively

What Makes Us A Great Place To Work  

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on  Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list  and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)

Bain’s  AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team  works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.

The Impact You’ll Have

Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization. 

As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries. 

The Role  

The Expert Senior Manager / Associate Partner AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle — from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization — and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders.

You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time

What You'll Do:  

Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
Architect multi-component pipelines, including: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
Embedding generation and optimization
Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)

Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows
Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems
Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment
Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment
Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design: Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards

Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering: Hallucination rate and factual consistency
Relevance and precision/recall
Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
Cost tracking and efficiency

Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps
Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

What We’re Looking For (Qualifications):

8–12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities
Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders
Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups

Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design
Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps
Deep experience with: Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval)
Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection)
ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems

Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads
Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
Clear ability to lead, mentor, and inspire technical teams
Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

Working Model & Travel

This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

U.S. Compensation Information

Compensation for this role includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, 401(k) plan with an annual employer contribution based on years of service and Bain’s best in class benefits package (details listed below).

Some local governments in the United States require a good-faith, reasonable salary range be included in job postings for open roles. The estimated annualized compensation for this role is as follows:

In New York City, California, Washington State, and Washington D.C, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary for this role is $293,500; In the state of Illinois, Georgia, Massachusetts, and Texas, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary for this role is $258,000. 

For all other locations, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is commensurate with competitive geographic market rates for this role and will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to experience, education, licensure/certifications, training and skill level.  

Annual discretionary performance bonus  
This role may also be eligible for other elements of discretionary compensation 
4.5% 401(k) company contribution, which increases after 3 years of service and is 100% vested upon start date 
Bain & Company's comprehensive benefits and wellness program is designed to help employees achieve personal independence, protection and stability in the areas most important to you and your family. 
Bain pays 100% individual employee premiums for medical, dental and vision programs, offering one of the most comprehensive medical plans for employees without impacting your paycheck 
Generous paid time off, including parental leave, sick leave and paid holidays 
Fully vested 401(k) company contribution 
Paid Life and Long-Term Disability insurance

jobs.title: Director Loan Origination Platform
jobs.description:
Overview

At First Citizens Bank, we're transforming the lending experience through innovation, technology, and customer-centric solutions. We are seeking a visionary leader to serve as our Senior Director, Head of General Bank Lending Platform
, responsible for defining and driving the strategy, governance, and evolution of our loan origination technology ecosystem across consumer, small business, and commercial lending. This highly visible leadership role will own the bank's lending platform strategy, with primary responsibility for the nCino Loan Origination Platform
, ensuring it enables business growth, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and an exceptional client experience.

As a key partner to Lending, Operations, Credit, Technology, Digital, Risk, and Compliance leaders, you'll shape the future of lending by driving modernization initiatives, optimizing platform capabilities, and delivering innovative solutions that support the bank's long-term strategy.

Responsibilities & Qualifications

What You'll Do

Define and Execute Lending Platform Strategy

Lead the strategic roadmap and long-term evolution of the bank's loan origination technology platform.
Drive platform capabilities across consumer, business, and commercial lending.
Establish priorities that align with enterprise growth objectives, operational efficiency goals, and regulatory requirements.
Assess emerging technologies, industry trends, and vendor solutions to continuously improve lending experiences.

Partner Across Business and Technology

Serve as the primary bridge between lending business leaders and technology teams.
Translate business strategies into scalable platform enhancements and technology initiatives.
Champion platform modernization, workflow automation, and digital transformation efforts.
Facilitate governance, prioritization, and executive stakeholder forums to ensure alignment across the organization.

Drive Product Governance and Delivery Excellence

Lead the intake, prioritization, and execution of platform enhancements and strategic initiatives.
Ensure successful delivery of business requirements through strong partnership with technology teams.
Advance Agile product management practices, release governance, and performance measurement.
Manage strategic relationships with technology vendors, implementation partners, and third-party providers.

Strengthen Operational Excellence and Risk Management

Ensure lending platforms support efficient, compliant, and well-controlled business processes.
Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Audit teams to maintain strong governance standards.
Drive improvements in operational efficiency, automation, data quality, and reporting capabilities.
Support platform resiliency, business continuity, and operational risk management programs.

Build and Develop High-Performing Teams

Lead and inspire teams responsible for lending platform strategy and product management.
Mentor product managers, business analysts, and platform specialists.
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Deliver executive-level insights, metrics, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

Additional Information

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree and 10+ years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale lending technology ecosystems.

Preferred Qualifications

Extensive experience with the nCino platform and related lending technology solutions.
Deep knowledge of consumer, commercial, and small business lending operations.
Experience leading enterprise product management, platform strategy, or lending transformation initiatives within a financial services organization.
Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies, systems integration, and digital transformation practices.
Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders and drive enterprise-wide initiatives.
Excellent analytical, organizational, and strategic planning skills
Experience partnering with senior business and technology leaders to deliver transformative solutions.
Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management capabilities.
Expertise in risk identification, risk mitigation, and governance frameworks.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Technology Alliances & (SaaS/ERP Ecosystems)
jobs.description:
Saviynt's AI-powered identity platform manages and governs human and non-human access to all of an organization's applications, data, and business processes. Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is today helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world’s leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. For more information, please visit  www.saviynt.com .

The Mission: Building the Commercial Engine for the AI Era

Following our $700M KKR-led funding round, Saviynt is aggressively expanding its footprint as the foundational identity layer for the modern enterprise. We are seeking a heavy-hitting Business Development leader to define and execute our global technology alliances strategy.

This isn't just about managing relationships—it’s about revenue engineering. You will identify the high-growth categories—ERP giants like SAP, Oracle, HubSpot, Workday, Salesforce, ServiceNow and familiarity with their programs and Agentic platforms—and architect strategic partnerships and or OEM and embedded deals

Preferred Location is the Bay Area (California). 

What You'll Be Doing

The Impact: Strategy, Categories & Revenue

1. Define the Global Alliance Blueprint You will own the master strategy for our technology ecosystem. You aren't just reacting to the market; you are choosing the winners. You will prioritize and penetrate critical categories:

Enterprise Core: SAP, Oracle, Workday, Salesforce etc. as well as Agentic platforms

Ecosystem Essentials: ITSM (ServiceNow), Security Platforms

Architect strategic partnerships, joint co-sell use cases, build and manage senior relationships and pursue OEM & Embedded Revenue opportunities as they arise. We are looking for an expert in high-scale monetization and someone with deep relationships. You will lead the program structure for:

Co-Sell & Referral: Building the frameworks that turn partner sales forces into an extension of our own.

3. Drive Technical & Commercial Alignment You will sit at the center of Product, Engineering, and Sales to ensure our integrations aren't just "technical wins" but market-ready products. You’ll oversee integration roadmaps that align our platform extensibility with the strategic goals of our highest-value partners.

What You Bring:

10+ Years of High-Stakes Experience: A proven track record in enterprise technology alliances, ISV ecosystems, or strategic business development with direct, measurable revenue impact.

Strategic Category Expertise: You understand the landscape of Identity, ERP (SAP/Workday), and the emerging world of Agentic AI and LLMs.

Commercial Architecture: You don't just sign MOUs; you build co-sell frameworks, referral programs, and joint GTM engines that move the needle on the P&L.

Executive Presence: You can navigate a boardroom at a Fortune 500 partner just as easily as you can white-board an integration roadmap with a Product VP.

Nice to have - The OEM Experience: Direct experience launching or managing OEM, embedded, or white-label partnerships. You understand the unique legal, financial, and technical hurdles of these high-value deals.

Why Saviynt?

Unprecedented Capital: With $700M in fresh backing, you have the resources to build a world-class alliance organization.

Market Dominance: We are positioning Identity as the core of the AI era. You will be the primary architect of the partnerships that make this a reality.

High-Velocity Growth: This role is central to our valuation and global expansion strategy, offering elite visibility and impact.

The Essentials

Location/Travel: 25–50% travel. You’ll be on the ground with our most strategic global partners.

Role Level: Director / Senior Director (commensurate with experience and track record of OEM success).

Ready to architect the next generation of strategic alliances? Let’s build.

If required for this role, you will:

- Complete security & privacy literacy and awareness training during onboarding and annually thereafter
- Review (initially and annually thereafter), understand, and adhere to Information Security/Privacy Policies and Procedures such as (but not limited to):

> Data Classification, Retention & Handling Policy
> Incident Response Policy/Procedures
> Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery Policy/Procedures
> Mobile Device Policy
> Account Management Policy
> Access Control Policy
> Personnel Security Policy
> Privacy Policy

Saviynt is an amazing place to work. We are a high-growth, Platform as a Service company focused on Identity Authority to power and protect the world at work. You will experience tremendous growth and learning opportunities through challenging yet rewarding work which directly impacts our customers, all within a welcoming and positive work environment. If you're resilient and enjoy working in a dynamic environment you belong with us!

Saviynt is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome everyone to our team.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.title: Director, Information Technology
jobs.description:
As the Director of Information Technology, with a primary emphasis on public safety and justice, you will not simply guide systems - you will help shape the digital foundation that supports law enforcement, corrections, emergency response, and community protection in one of the most dynamic regions in the nation. This is your opportunity to build a secure, resilient, integrated technology environment that directly enhances public safety and community services for millions of residents.

Your Mission

Lead the development and execution of a cohesive technology vision that strengthens the County’s public safety and justice ecosystem. Reporting directly to the Chief Information Officer, you will oversee complex, mission critical technology platforms, coordinate enterprise-wide systems integrations, and ensure that the County’s investments elevate both operational efficiency and excellence in service.

What Makes This Role Unique

Mission Critical Impact:
You will support the technology backbone of the Sheriff’s Office Enforcement and Custody Bureaus, Probation Department, District Attorney’s Office, Public Defender’s Office, County 911 Communications, Office of Emergency Management, and related public safety and justice partners. These systems must be highly secure, interoperable, reliable, and responsive 24/7.
Public Safety Driven Innovation:
From data interoperability to digital evidence systems, field mobility, emergency communications, and case management platforms — you will help modernize how public safety and justice agencies serve and protect the community.
Enterprise Leadership:
You will serve on IT governance boards that shape Countywide technology direction, focusing on mission critical systems, cross department workflows, and the technology infrastructure that connects public safety operations with broader County services.
Equity & Community Trust:
Technology plays a defining role in equitable justice. You will help ensure systems are transparent, ethical, and designed to support fair outcomes for all residents.

What You Bring

A bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Business/Public Administration, or a related field.
Ten to fifteen years of IT leadership experience in complex organizations, with expertise in public safety or justice systems, or sensitive, mission critical technology domains.
At least five years in senior level IT management over seeing high risk, high impact technology environments.
Strong communication skills and the ability to build high trust relationships with executive leaders, sworn personnel, justice partners, and community facing stake holders.
Proven ability to modernize systems, enhance interoperability, and lead change across multidisciplinary environments.
Deep understanding of cybersecurity, compliance, continuity of operations, and technology strategies supporting public safety and justice systems.

Quynh Truong, Executive Services at quynh.truong@esa.sccgov.org

jobs.title: VP Product Manager, Credit Technology
jobs.description:
We are a leading global asset management firm with over 3,000 employees across 20 offices in 15 countries; we help millions of investors around the world pursue their financial goals.

We hire critical thinkers. People who thrive in a collaborative culture like ours where we solve real problems while building the future of finance.

You

Are excited to be part of a vibrant engineering community that values diversity, hard work, and continuous learning.
Love solving complex real-world business problems.
Recognize that cross-functional collaboration is a core component of success for the team.
Believe there are multiple ways to solve most technical problems and are willing to debate the trade-offs.
Have become a stronger engineer by making mistakes and learning from them.
Are a doer, someone who wants to grow their career and gain experience across technologies and business functions.

We

Continuously invest in a high-performance and inclusive culture, in which a diversity of backgrounds, experiences and viewpoints are celebrated and valued.
Encourage career mobility, so you can benefit from learning different functions and technologies, and we gain the benefits of your experience across teams.
Run technology pro bono programs that help the non-profit community and give our engineering community opportunities to volunteer and participate.
Offer education reimbursements and ongoing training in technology, communication, and diversity & inclusion.
Embrace knowledge sharing through lunch-and-learns, demos, and technical forums.
Consider our people to be our greatest asset—we will help you learn what PIMCO Technology has to offer so you can participate in activities that benefit your career while delivering impactful technology solutions.

We are seeking a senior, business-oriented Vice President, Product Manager to lead multi-year product strategy and execution for Credit Technology platforms that support investment research, analytics, and trading workflows. This leader will partner closely with credit analysts, portfolio managers, traders, credit analytics teams, engineers, data teams, and senior stakeholders to deliver scalable technology solutions that improve workflow efficiency, enhance data accessibility, and strengthen decision-making across the credit lifecycle. The role also provides senior leadership across governance, roadmap prioritization, resourcing, operating model maturity, and post-release accountability to ensure product outcomes are adopted, measured, and continuously improved.

Key Responsibilities

Own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Credit Technology platforms supporting research, analytics, trading, and portfolio management workflows.
Serve as a senior product partner to credit analysts, portfolio managers, traders, credit analytics teams, engineering leads, and technology leadership.
Translate complex credit business needs into clear product priorities, requirements, business cases, and delivery plans for engineering and data teams.
Lead roadmap prioritization across competing stakeholder needs, balancing business value, regulatory and operational risk, technical feasibility, scalability, and time-to-market.
Lead cross-functional governance and decision forums to align stakeholders on priorities, scope, dependencies, risks, tradeoffs, and measurable outcomes.
Drive delivery of tools, dashboards, data products, workflow applications, analytics capabilities, and AI-enabled solutions that improve credit decision-making and operating efficiency.
Establish product success measures, adoption metrics, data quality indicators, and performance dashboards to evaluate impact and guide investment decisions.
Oversee testing, validation, rollout, change management, and user adoption for complex business logic and mission-critical credit applications.
Partner with engineering leadership on platform architecture, system design trade-offs, API strategy, data integration, and long-term modernization opportunities.
Partner with engineering leadership on capacity planning, sequencing, dependency management, and resourcing decisions across the Credit Technology portfolio.
Own post-release accountability by monitoring adoption, operational health, product stability, user feedback, and continuous improvement opportunities after rollout.
Communicate product strategy, delivery progress, risks, and recommendations to senior business and technology stakeholders in an executive-ready format.
Coach and mentor junior product managers, analysts, and cross-functional contributors while scaling consistent product practices, governance, prioritization discipline, and operating model maturity within Credit Technology.

Required Qualifications

8+ years of product management, technology strategy, business analysis, or related experience within financial services, asset management, capital markets, or enterprise technology.
Demonstrated experience leading product strategy and roadmap execution for complex platforms, data products, workflow tools, analytics applications, or trading and investment technology solutions.
Strong understanding of fixed income, credit markets, investment research, portfolio management, trading workflows, or related asset management processes.
Proven ability to partner with senior investment professionals, business stakeholders, engineers, data teams, and technology leaders to define and deliver high-impact solutions.
Experience gathering and refining complex requirements, structuring business cases, prioritizing roadmaps, and translating ambiguous needs into actionable product deliverables.
Strong analytical and technical fluency, including familiarity with data models, relational databases, APIs, dashboards, reporting tools, and modern software delivery practices.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, executive presentation, and influence skills in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, Financial Engineering, Business, or a related technical or quantitative field.

Preferred Qualifications

PhD, MBA, CFA, or advanced degree in a quantitative, technical, or finance-related field preferred.
Experience with credit investment platforms, trading systems, portfolio analytics, research management tools, risk analytics, or investment data platforms.
Hands-on familiarity with SQL, Python, Power BI, or similar data analysis and visualization tools.
Experience delivering AI-enabled, data science, or automation capabilities for investment, research, trading, or operational workflows.
Experience operating in a highly regulated financial services environment with strong attention to controls, resiliency, auditability, and data quality.
Track record of mentoring product talent and improving product operating models, governance, prioritization, and stakeholder engagement practices.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will bring strategic direction and execution discipline to Credit Technology, strengthen alignment between investment teams and engineering, improve the quality and usability of credit data and analytics, and deliver platforms that enhance research, trading, portfolio management, and decision-making across the credit lifecycle.

PIMCO follows a total compensation approach when rewarding employees which includes a base salary and a discretionary bonus. Base salary is the fixed component of compensation that is determined by core job responsibilities, relevant experience, internal level, and market factors. The discretionary bonus is used to award performance and therefore is determined by company, business, team, and individual performance.

jobs.title: Expert Senior Manager, AI Engineering
jobs.description:
What Makes Us A Great Place To Work  

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on  Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list  and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)

Bain’s  AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team  works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.

The Impact You’ll Have

Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization. 

As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries. 

The Role  

The Expert Senior Manager / Associate Partner AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle — from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization — and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders.

You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time

What You'll Do:  

Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
Architect multi-component pipelines, including: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
Embedding generation and optimization
Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)

Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows
Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems
Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment
Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment
Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design: Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards

Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering: Hallucination rate and factual consistency
Relevance and precision/recall
Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
Cost tracking and efficiency

Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps
Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

What We’re Looking For (Qualifications):

8–12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities
Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders
Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups

Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design
Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps
Deep experience with: Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval)
Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection)
ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems

Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads
Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
Clear ability to lead, mentor, and inspire technical teams
Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

Working Model & Travel

This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

U.S. Compensation Information

Compensation for this role includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, 401(k) plan with an annual employer contribution based on years of service and Bain’s best in class benefits package (details listed below).

Some local governments in the United States require a good-faith, reasonable salary range be included in job postings for open roles. The estimated annualized compensation for this role is as follows:

In New York City, California, Washington State, and Washington D.C, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary for this role is $293,500; In the state of Illinois, Georgia, Massachusetts, and Texas, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary for this role is $258,000. 

For all other locations, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is commensurate with competitive geographic market rates for this role and will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to experience, education, licensure/certifications, training and skill level.  

Annual discretionary performance bonus  
This role may also be eligible for other elements of discretionary compensation 
4.5% 401(k) company contribution, which increases after 3 years of service and is 100% vested upon start date 
Bain & Company's comprehensive benefits and wellness program is designed to help employees achieve personal independence, protection and stability in the areas most important to you and your family. 
Bain pays 100% individual employee premiums for medical, dental and vision programs, offering one of the most comprehensive medical plans for employees without impacting your paycheck 
Generous paid time off, including parental leave, sick leave and paid holidays 
Fully vested 401(k) company contribution 
Paid Life and Long-Term Disability insurance

jobs.title: Sr. Engineering Manager/Leading P&C Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

The Engineering Manager/Leading P&C Engineer is responsible for leading the design, development, configuration, testing, and commissioning of protection, control and integrity schemes for electrical substations, power plants, and industrial power systems. This role provides technical leadership across the full project lifecycle, ensuring that protection and control solutions are delivered in accordance with customer requirements, applicable standards, and company engineering practices.

The role requires strong expertise in protection applications, control logic, relay configuration, substation automation, and system integration, as well as the ability to coordinate engineering activities, interface with customers, support tendering and training delivery. The Engineering Manager is expected to drive technical quality, support project execution, and provide mentoring and guidance to other engineers.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Lead the engineering and technical execution of protection, control and integrity schemes projects for substations, power plants, and industrial electrical systems.
Define, develop and review protection and control applications in line with customer specifications, project requirements, grid codes and company standards.
Take ownership of the technical design and configuration including:
Busbar protection
Line differential protection
Transformer protection
Generator and motor protection
Automatic transfer and interlocking schemes
System Integrity Protection Schemes

Lead the design and review of protection philosophies, control logic, interlocking schemes, integrity schemes, and relay coordination studies.
Configure and validate protection relays and associated control devices, including preparation of relay settings, logic configuration, and communication interfaces.
Coordinate and perform protection relay testing, functional testing, panel testing, and integrated system verification.
Plan, organize, and lead pre-FAT, FAT, SAT, and site commissioning activities for protection and control systems.
Provide technical leadership during installation, energization, testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning at site.
Act as the primary technical point of contact for customers, consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders on protection and control matters.
Review technical documentation and ensure delivery of high-quality engineering outputs, including design documents, test procedures, reports, and as-built files.
Support tendering and sales activities by preparing technical solutions, reviewing customer specifications, identifying risks, and contributing to proposal development.
Deliver and coordinate technical training for customers and internal teams on protection relays, control schemes, integrity schemes, testing methods, and system operation.
Support service teams and customers with advanced troubleshooting, technical clarifications, and hotline support under service and framework contracts.
Drive standardization and continuous improvement of engineering practices, tools, templates, and testing procedures.
Provide technical mentoring and day-to-day guidance to engineers within the protection and control team.
Apply sound engineering judgment to solve complex technical issues and make recommendations beyond standard solutions where required.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, preferably with specialization in power systems, protection, and control.
Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in protection and control engineering for substations, power plants or industrial power systems.
Strong knowledge of protection, control, and integrity schemes in utility and industrial electrical applications.
Proven experience in the design, configuration, testing, and commissioning of protection and control systems.
Demonstrated hands-on experience with protection relays such as MiCOM and/or GE Multilin.
Proven experience leading or executing FAT, SAT and commissioning activities.
Solid understanding of relay coordination, protection philosophies, control logic, and substation engineering practices.
Strong knowledge of substation communication protocols and substation automation systems.
Familiarity with modern technologies in substation automation, particularly digital substations and IEC 61850-based solutions.
Experience with OMICRON Control Center and related protection testing tools.
Experience in preparing and delivering technical training.
Fluent in English.
Fluent in Russian.

Desired Characteristics

Experience with communication networks, including switches, routers, and network architecture in substation environments.
Knowledge of SCADA, DCS or electrical control systems.
Experience with Engineering Base or Eplan is a plus.
Experience with Cyber Secure solutions is a strong plus
Strong technical leadership and coordination skills.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving capability.
Strong attention to detail and document quality.
Ability to manage multiple assignments and priorities while meeting deadlines.
Strong customer focus with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Team-oriented approach with the ability to collaborate across engineering, project management, service, tendering, and sales functions.
Sound judgment and ability to remain effective under pressure.
High self-motivation, flexibility, and commitment to continuous improvement.
Kazakh speaking is a plus
Willingness and ability to travel locally and internationally.

Leadership Expectations

Lead technical activities within the protection and control scope of projects.
Ensure technical consistency, quality, and timely delivery of engineering outputs.
Support project planning and execution through proactive identification of risks and resolution of technical issues.
Provide coaching and mentoring to less experienced engineers.
Promote best practices, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement within the engineering team.

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a technically strong and customer-focused Protection & Control professional with proven experience leading engineering activities for complex power system projects. They bring deep expertise in protection, control, and integrity schemes, along with the ability to guide project execution, support customers, lead FAT/SAT and commissioning, and develop team capability through mentoring and training.

jobs.title: Head of Operational Excellence, Mission Readiness
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

The duty of this organization is to enable our Customers’ ongoing Mission Readiness
. From the moment they say '“go” until the contract is fulfilled. We are only successful when the customer's mission is successful.

Mission Readiness is the post-production shared services organization for Anduril. This team supports the Business Lines and Divisions throughout the lifecycle of their product, from initial sustainment concept through delivery, installation, operation, repair and return. These service offerings also include providing technical publications, training, customer support, connectivity services and other value-added services. To the degree the Business elects, we accept the delegated responsibility for upfront and continued delivery of the committed service solutions. This team endeavors to provide the Business Lines, as our internal customers, shared mission services that are more efficient and cost effective than if they chose to provide them directly. By offering mission support capabilities and capacity that are not “core” to the Business, the Business can focus resources on addressing the next big need while we ensure existing commitments are met.

About The Job

We are looking for a Head of Operational Excellence
(OpEx) to join our rapidly growing team in Costa Mesa, CA
. In this role, you will be responsible for driving the systems, processes and projects that yield productivity and scale of the aftermarket service offerings.

You will run the Management Operating System (MOS) - ensuring visibility to success measures that lead the team to define, prioritize and execute improvement actions and initiatives. This will require business acumen and analytical thinking to determine the most impactful priorities, as well as excellent project and people management to keep initiatives on track.

You and your team will be lead representatives of Mission Readiness to the Business Line leadership and the primary touchpoint for functional integration with Finance, People (Talent Acquisition), Business Operations, and Quality. This will require the ability to influence others using both logic and force of will. You will also be asked to develop your own approach for balancing the requests brought by customers with internally derived initiatives.

You will manage the central core for process definition, process improvement, and the systems & tools to enable them, serving as a resource and coordination point for all of Mission Readiness and adjacent functions. In order to ensure effective application of resources, this role will also be central to business analysis and special projects for the organization.

If you like to think big picture but can manage to the details, this role could be for you. If you like to get involved in the action and connect the dots to make things happen, this role is definitely for you.

What You’ll Do

Lead a team of direct reports (both people managers and individual contributors) and indirect team members (including peers and other levels in other functions) to accomplish the objectives of Mission Readiness’ Operational Excellence
Organize and run the Management Operating System (MOS) of Mission Readiness, which monitors key performance indicators of the business, institutes the cadence of performance review and the actions that result from it. Engage with and deliver the Business Line perspective to cross-functional leadership each quarter.
Determine priorities for process definition/improvement and enabling systems/tools within Mission Readiness, then manage the planning, execution and results of the initiatives undertaken. Lead and/or oversee leadership of projects championed by Mission Readiness.
Manage the portfolio of projects and strategic initiatives for Mission Readiness, driving follow-through and measurable results.
Convene and conduct robust, hypothesis-driven business analyses that yield actionable insights and outcome-changing decisions. Become the trusted embedded research capability for the Mission Readiness organization.
Coordinate with Finance to understand and refine the economics of Mission Readiness services. Instigate and generate views of revenues and costs that enable Mission Readiness to increase impact for the businesses. Implement cost allocation mechanisms and manage adherence.
Coordinate with Talent Acquisition and People teams to ensure internal MOS is prioritizing recruiting efforts and onboarding for the fast-growing organization. Oversee programmatic labor charging compliance.
Lead the development of inputs to feed annual and periodic business forecasting activities for capacity, investment and cost. Tie the strategic direction of Mission Readiness to that of the Business Lines to enable a cohesive story that generates growth and efficiencies.
Serve as a key leadership team member in Mission Readiness, partnering with the VP and peers to coordinate cross-functional strategy, responsibilities and enable organizational success.

Required Qualifications

Bachelors degree in an engineering or business discipline with technical emphasis
10+ years of professional experience in some combination of operations, process improvement, project management, business analysis, business systems, engineering and/or finance.
Minimum of two years of experience directly managing 5+ employees
Ability to travel up to 25% of the time
This position is based in Costa Mesa, CA and requires being onsite - remote work not considered
Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret or Top Secret security clearance

Preferred Qualifications

Prior work in/with a sustainment or aftermarket solutions business (such as logistics, sustainment, repairs, spare parts, connectivity services or other related services)
Demonstrated experience maturing processes and/or operations from prototype/early stage through to repeatable volume or automation
Prior work in/with industry with complex, technical products, preferably durable assets with embedded software
Ability and willingness to dig in to systems and digital tools to inform and iterate process designs and direct improvements
Strong organizational and self management discipline; desire to keep things on track and organized
Ability and willingness to make tradeoffs for speed, impact and risk
Demonstrated team builder and developer of people
Six Sigma and/or Lean training and application

US Salary Range

$220,000—$293,000 USD

The VP, Enterprise Applications & Engineering Platforms
provides senior leadership across ACR Technology Services’ application and engineering functions, including Application Development, API & Integration Delivery, ERP & EDI Systems, Microsoft Application Development, and Automation, AI & Data Integration. Reporting directly to the CIO, this critical leadership role is accountable for establishing the functional strategy, delivery standards, operating practices, and platform roadmaps required to translate approved business and technology priorities into reliable execution.

The VP leads a multi-layered organization of directors, managers, architects, senior engineers, and delivery partners. This leader maintains active oversight of major initiatives, resource capacity, technical decisions, delivery risks, engineering quality, and partner performance. Success requires a leader who can set direction while remaining closely connected to execution. The VP must have sufficient technical depth to evaluate solution approaches, challenge estimates and delivery plans, assess engineering quality, remove execution barriers, and intervene when initiatives are at risk. This leader is accountable for the quality and effectiveness of delivery across internal teams and external partners, including technical design, development practices, testing, documentation, knowledge transfer, production readiness, and measurable business outcomes.

We are looking for a candidate who can work hybrid in our Exton, PA location.

How you will make the impact:

Lead execution across the application and engineering portfolio, including Application Development, API & Integration Delivery, ERP & EDI Systems, Microsoft Application Development, and Automation, AI & Data Integration.
Translate approved business and technology priorities into actionable plans, clear ownership, realistic resource commitments, and measurable outcomes.
Lead directors, managers, architects, senior engineers, and delivery partners while strengthening engineering excellence, delivery discipline, cross-functional alignment, and organizational accountability.
Maintain active oversight of major initiatives through delivery reviews, architecture checkpoints, capacity planning, dependency management, risk resolution, and operational-readiness assessments.

Manage application and engineering budgets, capital requirements, and investment recommendations in partnership with the CIO and Finance, ensuring decisions are supported by clear business value and aligned with the broader technology portfolio.

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field required, or equivalent relevant experience.

Strong vendor and partner management experience, including contract oversight, delivery governance, resource planning, quality management, and performance accountability.
Senior-level verbal and written communication skills, including executive reporting, delivery updates, risk communication, decision facilitation, and cross-functional alignment.

We strive to build meaningful connections with each other as we believe that employee happiness and business success are linked. Join us in our mission to transform the power of diagnostics into a healthier future for all.

The Role

At QuidelOrtho ,
we’re advancing the power of diagnostics for a healthier future for all .
Join our mission as our next Senior Manager, Systems Engineering, supporting our Point-of-Care instruments.

This Senior Manager of Systems Engineer provides technical leadership and accountability for the development of complex, multi-disciplinary systems—spanning hardware, software, consumable and assay integration in complex diagnostic systems. Systems Engineering & Integration

Systems lead in new product development programs
Systems Engineering subject matter expert within systems team
Oversee the architecture, integration, and verification of complex diagnostic systems, ensuring alignment with product requirements and regulatory standards.

Provides solutions to complex system-level technical problems

Interfaces with manufacturing partners for effective system design transfer

Drive technical decision-making and resolve integration challenges

Keep abreast and share knowledge of updates to technical standards
Perform other work-related duties as assigned.

Required

Minimum of 10+ years’ experience with bachelor’s degree in engineering or related field, master’s degree preferred; and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Proven track record of successfully bringing medical devices or Point of Care IVD instruments Demonstrated experience leading a systems design effort from concept to commercial launch in a regulated environment.
Experience in medical devices/diagnostics and regulated environments
Experience managing external development partners and/or working with contract manufacturing partners
Experience and training in a specific discipline such as Mechanical,
Electrical, Fluidics or SW engineering working knowledge in both hardware and software systems
Strong Familiarity with ISO 13485, IEC 62366, IEC 60601, ISO 14971 standards
Understanding of verification and validation strategies for complex systems
Proven ability to lead without direct authority and influence cross-functional teams
Strong communication, analytical, and teamwork skills
Ability to travel up to 10%
This position is not currently eligible for visa sponsorship.

The Key Working Relationships

Internal Partners

Engineering Team
Program Managers
Assay Development Scientists
Manufacturing Team
Design Quality
Regulatory Affairs

External Partners

Contract design and manufacturers
Electrical Safety Test Contacts
Vendors

At QuidelOrtho, our culture is shaped by four core behaviors that guide how we collaborate, make decisions, and support each other and those we serve. The ideal candidate will exhibit these behaviors, as we believe they’re essential to how we thrive as a team and achieve meaningful impact:

Thrive Together – Collaborate intentionally, grow as a team
Make It Happen – Focus on priorities, embrace continuous improvement
Commit to Service – Cultivate a service mindset
Embrace Inclusion – Be open and authentic, welcome diverse perspectives

The Work Environment

The work environment characteristics are representative of a manufacturing, laboratory, or warehouse environment and include handling of viral and bacterial hazards, potentially hazardous chemicals, as well as infectious or potentially infectious bodily fluids, tissues, and samples. Up to 75% of the time at desk, standing or sitting extended periods of time. Flexible work hours to meet project deadlines

No strenuous physical activity required. Occasional light lifting of materials may be needed. Substantial time will be spent in virtual or in-person meetings, engaging with customers, and working on scientific content and documentation.

jobs.title: Head of Product, Technology
jobs.description:
About Us

Sage Bionetworks uses open science and collaboration to improve human health. We turn complex biomedical data into actionable insights through responsible sharing, strong governance, and innovative tools like AI. Our team values curiosity, diverse perspectives, and experimentation.

The Opportunity

Sage Bionetworks is looking for a Head of Product for Synapse.org and its ecosystem of biomedical tools, knowledge portals, and services. The ecosystem serves tens of thousands of individual scientists and the institutions and programs they work within. Serving this broad community well is at the heart of this role. The Head of Product will spend significant time in the field—with individual scientists, PIs, program officers, and institutional partners—and bring that ground truth back into every roadmap and portfolio decision.

This is a new, integrating role. Our product domains have owners and our engineering operation has leads, but no one today is responsible for making the portfolio add up across programs while holding the end-to-end experience of the people who actually use the ecosystem. The Head of Product will be that connector: partnering closely with the CTO, product owners, engineering leaders, and program teams to create clarity across the portfolio.

You will sit in real ambiguity: what we want to build, what we are already funded to build, how to prioritize across both, and how product strategy can help create new funding opportunities. You will help translate that ambiguity into decisions—a portfolio roadmap, build/no-build calls, and sequenced priorities. Reporting to Sage’s CTO, you will be accountable for outcomes, not just plans: the success of the products that serve our research programs, the balance between strategy and delivery, and the adoption and impact of what we build, both inside Sage and across the broader research community.

AI is rapidly reshaping how researchers work with data. The ecosystem already includes AI-powered tools and AI research partnerships, and a central part of this role is applying strong product judgment to identify where AI creates genuine value for researchers—and where it does not. Working closely with technical and research leaders, this role will help Sage build and evolve AI-enabled capabilities responsibly.

Most of our product portfolio is grant-funded and serves our research programs. A smaller, emerging part of the picture is helping the ecosystem grow more sustainably, including a modest and growing set of commercial offerings. That commercial dimension is a tiny slice today; we are looking for someone who can help shape and grow it carefully and thoughtfully, without losing sight of the much larger community of researchers the ecosystem exists to serve. Like the rest of our team, you will work in an AI-forward environment and prioritize productivity and impact over arbitrary processes.

Note:
Please do not upload your resume as your cover letter (required)

Key Responsibilities

Lead the product portfolio and its outcomes. In close partnership with the CTO, ensure the product portfolio meets the needs of our programs and users—not just that it is coordinated. Bring clarity to competing priorities, make tradeoffs visible, and drive the cross-portfolio prioritization, build/no-build, and sequencing decisions that no single domain owner can make alone. Ensure capabilities that serve multiple teams are thoughtfully aligned and built once, rather than duplicated across the ecosystem.
Balance strategy with delivery. Partner with the CTO and engineering leadership to evolve the long-term product vision while maintaining focus on near-term execution. Translate strategy into actionable priorities and remain accountable not only for the roadmap, but for what gets built, delivered, and adopted.
Drive adoption and impact, internally and externally. Measure success by whether products are genuinely used and create value: internally by Sage’s programs and teams, and externally by researchers, institutions, and partners. Establish a strong understanding of adoption and impact, and close the gap between what we build and what our users need.
Stay close to users and funders. Build trusted relationships with researchers, principal investigators, program officers, and institutional partners. Maintain a direct listening cadence, bring user insights into product decisions, and partner with program teams to ensure the ecosystem continues to evolve around real research needs.
Shape where AI fits in the product. Partner with the CTO, engineering teams, and research leaders to identify where AI-powered capabilities and partnerships create genuine value for researchers—and where they do not. Apply strong product judgment to help Sage build and deliver AI-enabled products responsibly, thoughtfully, and in alignment with our mission.
Grow the ecosystem’s commercial offerings thoughtfully. Partner with leadership to shape a modest and growing set of commercial offerings, including their positioning, pricing, and user experience, helping the ecosystem become more sustainable while remaining grounded in Sage’s mission and research community.
Connect product strategy to funding opportunities. Work closely with principal investigators, program leaders, and executive leadership to make product investments clear, compelling, and fundable. Identify opportunities where product strategy can support new research initiatives and partnerships, and help shape product concepts into proposals that can be carried forward.
Lead and grow the Product Team. Provide direction and support for product managers and portfolio owners who define, validate, and steward products across the ecosystem. Partner with the CTO to continue evolving the product function, develop talent, establish effective product practices, and grow the team along the product career ladder.
Champion product design and user experience. Partner with design leadership to establish product design principles, standards, and practices across the ecosystem. Ensure Sage’s products provide a coherent, intuitive experience for researchers and partners, with hands-on craft supported by senior design expertise.
Partner with executive leadership on product direction. Serve as a strategic thought partner to the CTO and senior leadership team, helping translate organizational goals, research priorities, and technical opportunities into a cohesive product strategy. Collaborate across Sage to make thoughtful decisions about where to invest, where to experiment, and where to say no.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Life Sciences, Business, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Advanced degree in a relevant technical, scientific, or business discipline is a plus.

Experience

10+ years of progressive experience in product management and product leadership, including responsibility for defining strategy and delivering outcomes across multiple products or an enterprise product portfolio.
Demonstrated success defining product vision and portfolio strategy, setting organizational priorities, and translating user needs into measurable product outcomes.
Experience building and leading high-performing product teams, developing product leaders, and establishing scalable product practices that enable teams to move quickly and make sound decisions.
Strong user-centered product judgment. You know how to listen to a broad community of users—from individual researchers to institutional stakeholders—and turn what you hear into clear product decisions.
A track record of influencing executive leaders and aligning engineering, design, science, and business stakeholders around difficult prioritization decisions and strategic tradeoffs.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and turning competing priorities, incomplete information, and funding constraints into clear direction, sequencing, and execution.
Experience leading product strategy in a rapidly evolving AI landscape, with sound judgment about where AI creates genuine value for users—and where it doesn't.
Experience bringing AI-powered products, platforms, or strategic partnerships to market, with an appreciation for responsible AI development and governance.
Demonstrated accountability for product outcomes—not just roadmaps—including adoption, customer value, and organizational impact.
Excellent communication skills with the executive presence and credibility to influence senior leaders, represent product strategy with funders and external partners, and confidently make difficult prioritization decisions.

Nice to Have

Experience growing or scaling commercial products, including pricing, packaging, monetization, or taking products from free to paid while maintaining a strong user experience.
Experience balancing mission-driven impact with business sustainability in a nonprofit, research, academic, or grant-funded organization.
Experience in scientific research, biomedical data, healthcare, life sciences, or other data-intensive technical domains.
Familiarity with open science, research data platforms, data-sharing ecosystems, or open-source software communities.
Experience partnering with principal investigators, research institutions, government agencies, or funding organizations to shape product investments and support new funding opportunities.
Experience establishing product operating models, portfolio governance, and organizational product strategy across multiple teams.
Product design leadership experience, with a strong appreciation for usability, accessibility, and creating cohesive experiences across an interconnected product ecosystem.

Job Functions And Physical Requirements

The following cognitive and physical activities outline the essential functions required for successful job performance. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to fulfill these functions.

Physical Demands

Extended periods of sitting at a desk and using a computer.
Repeated wrist, hand, and finger movements.
Requires clear vision for tasks like data analysis, transcribing, computer use, and reading.
Occasionally lifting or moving objects weighing up to 10 pounds.

Cognitive Demands

Able to work effectively under deadlines.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy.
Flexibility to adapt to changing environments, priorities and multitask.

Additional Functions

Travel two times per year for on-site events in Seattle, WA.
Effective verbal and written communication skills.
Works well in a team and maintains professionalism.
Follows company policies, procedures, and relevant laws and regulations.

Note: This list is not exhaustive and may be subject to modification as job duties evolve.
