jobs.title: Director, Test Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Director, Test Engineering
is responsible for defining, governing, and coordinating Vertiv’s Engineering test strategy across product development, validation, manufacturing, and certification activities. This role establishes common testing standards, methodologies, and release requirements, and ensures their consistent implementation across Lines of Business (LoBs) and regions.

The position provides technical leadership, standards, and orchestration for testing activities, including Design Verification Testing (DVT), test automation, certification testing, Design for Test (DFT), and coordinates with Advanced Manufacturing Engineering on End‑of‑Line (EOL) testing.

The Director of Test Engineering owns the Core Engineering Test Automation team and serves as the primary Engineering interface to external certification agencies.

Key Responsibilities

Test Strategy & Standards

Define and maintain enterprise-wide test strategies for NPDI, ETO, and Sustaining Engineering programs.
Establish common test standards, procedures, and acceptance criteria for:
Design Verification Testing (DVT)
Reliability and environmental testing (in coordination with Quality and Reliability teams)
Automated testing

Define product release test requirements and ensure alignment with DFMEA, PFMEA, and reliability expectations.
Drive consistency in test planning, execution, reporting, and traceability across businesses and regions.

Design Verification Testing (DVT) Leadership

Own the DVT methodology and governance model, including test scope definition, readiness criteria, and exit criteria.
Coordinate DVT execution across LoBs and regions, ensuring alignment to Vertiv standards.
Ensure DVT results are effectively correlated with simulation data, historical performance, and field feedback.

Test Automation

Directly lead the Core Engineering Test Automation team.
Define and execute the test automation roadmap for product validation and regression testing.
Drive increased adoption of automation in both engineering validation and manufacturing test environments.
Promote reuse of automation frameworks, tools, and test assets across product families.

Manufacturing Test Collaboration

Partner closely with Manufacturing Engineering to:
Define Design for Test (DFT) requirements early in product development.
Align engineering test strategies with End‑of‑Line (EOL) and factory acceptance testing.
Ensure smooth transition from engineering validation to production test.

Support continuous improvement of manufacturing test coverage, efficiency, and robustness.

Certification & External Relationships

Serve as the primary Core Engineering interface to external certification agencies (e.g., UL, IEC, CE).
Coordinate certification test strategies, scheduling, and technical alignment across LoBs.
Ensure engineering test plans anticipate and support certification requirements.
Maintain strong working relationships with third‑party test houses and certification partners.

Governance, Metrics & Continuous Improvement

Establish KPIs and dashboards for test effectiveness, cycle time, coverage, and automation maturity.
Identify gaps, redundancies, and inefficiencies in current testing approaches and drive corrective actions.
Support Vertiv Operating System (VOS) initiatives related to quality, speed, and cost.

Scope & Authority

Global testing standards ownership; no direct ownership of lab facilities or daily lab operations
Direct management of the Core Engineering Test Automation team
Influences product release decisions through test readiness and results

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or Systems Engineering (required)
Master’s degree preferred
12+ years of experience in product development and engineering test environments
Demonstrated leadership in:
Design Verification Testing (DVT)
Test automation
Product validation and reliability testing
Manufacturing test (DFT and EOL)

Experience working with certification agencies and compliance testing
Proven ability to lead cross‑functional, globally distributed teams without direct line authority
Data center, power electronics, thermal, or industrial systems experience preferred
Strong systems‑level engineering mindset
Ability to define standards and drive adoption at scale
Excellent communication skills in English and stakeholder management skills
Comfortable operating at both strategic and hands‑on technical levels
Lean / Six Sigma experience a plus

About Us

The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.

OUR CORE PRINCIPLES:
Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.

OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES

High-Performance Culture
Customer Focus
Operational Excellence
Innovation
Financial Strength

VERTIV BEHAVIORS

Own it
Act with urgency
Foster a customer-first mindset
Think big and execute
Lead by example
Drive continuous improvement
Learn and seek out development
Promote transparent & open communication

Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. The Director of Software Engineering – Payroll leads the design, execution, and modernization of Walmart’s enterprise payroll ecosystem. Atwell, LLC
is a bold leader in the consulting, engineering, and construction services industry, delivering a broad range of creative solutions to clients in the real estate & land development, and energy markets. Ten consecutive years in a row as a “Best Place to Work” by Zweig Group (#11)

Atwell is seeking a Director, Hydrocarbons Operations to help establish and grow our presence in Midland, Texas. This is a high-impact leadership opportunity for someone who can help build a practice in one of the most important energy markets in the country.
We are open to leaders coming from either a Survey background or an Engineering background, as long as they bring strong experience supporting oil and gas, pipeline, facilities, and broader hydrocarbon projects. The ideal person will be someone who can lead teams, grow client relationships, oversee project execution, and help expand Atwell’s footprint across West Texas.
This role is well suited for a proven leader who wants to help shape strategy, build a team, and play a major role in the continued growth of our Hydrocarbons business.

Practice Leadership and Growth

Help establish and lead Atwell’s Hydrocarbons presence in the Midland market
Build and grow a local practice supporting oil and gas, CO2, hydrogen, RNG, pipeline, and facilities projects
Lead, mentor, and develop a team of technical professionals across survey, engineering, design, and project delivery
Partner with executive leadership on growth strategy, staffing plans, and service expansion
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, and strong client service

Client Development and Market Expansion

Strengthen existing client relationships while building new partnerships with operators, developers, and industry stakeholders
Support proposals, presentations, pricing strategy, and contract negotiations
Represent Atwell in the market as a trusted partner and technical leader

Coordinate multidisciplinary teams to drive efficient project execution
Support forecasting, utilization, staffing, and operational performance across the practice
Monitor project health, identify risks early, and implement solutions to keep projects moving successfully

Technical and Operational Leadership

Act as a bridge between technical teams, operations, and client stakeholders
Bring practical understanding of how field execution, technical design, and client needs come together on energy projects
Support quality control, technical review, and process improvement efforts
Help identify opportunities to improve service delivery and expand capabilities in the region

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Surveying, or a related technical field preferred
10+ years of progressive experience supporting oil and gas, hydrocarbon, pipeline, facilities, or energy infrastructure projects
Demonstrated success in a leadership role involving team development, project oversight, and client relationship management
Strong understanding of hydrocarbon project execution, whether from a survey, engineering, or multidisciplinary operations background

Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing multiple priorities effectively

We are:

A forward-thinking services company at the forefront of AI-native innovation. We partner with enterprise clients to create next-generation, agent-powered workflows engineered to scale in real-world settings. Our engineers embed deeply with customers, moving projects beyond experimentation into operational reality.

You are:

An AI Native Engineer with a minimum of 5 years of experience building cloud-native solutions, and deep expertise in designing and deploying agentic systems, especially for enterprise environments. You are a critical thinker that thrives in ambiguity, delivering concrete results by designing, building, and running custom AI agents that augment workflows and scale across modern infrastructure. You’ll help shape the playbook for how enterprises adopt and scale AI-native engineering globally.

The Work:

You’ll embed directly with clients — acting as both technologist and trusted advisor. You’ll partner with stakeholders to define use cases, rapidly prototype, and deploy agentic workflows that are robust, secure, and operational in complex enterprise domains. Often, these will be completely net new platforms and systems that need to be stitched together in our clients' environments alongside our Ecosystem partners.

Responsibilities:

Agent Architecture and Engineering: Design and engineer enterprise-ready AI agents encompassing retrieval, orchestration, policy-based routing, tool invocation, evaluation harnesses, and lifecycle observability.

AI Platform Integration: Develop abstraction layers across AI providers (Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, etc. ) to enable seamless integration and enablement.

Cloud-Native Engineering: Leverage containerization (Kubernetes, Docker), microservices, serverless, event-driven architectures, CI/CD, and observability to deliver scalable AI-native systems.

Domain-Specific Workflows: Tailor and deploy agentic applications across verticals — e.g., finance, healthcare, retail — addressing domain-specific processes via intelligent automation.

Client Engagement: Conduct design workshops, POCs, and code-with sessions to shape data-driven agent workflows with stakeholders, fostering trust and adoption.

Measure & Improve: Define and use key metrics, test harnesses, and evaluation plans to measure agent accuracy, latency, safety, and cost effectiveness.

Knowledge Sharing: Craft reusable patterns, documentation, and best practices to influence internal assets and client roadmaps.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Job Qualifications

What You Need:

Minimum of 10 years engineering experience with cloud-native systems (APIs, microservices, containerization, serverless).

Minimum of 1 years of deep expertise in designing and deploying agentic solutions (agents, orchestration, context engineering, RAG, workflows) in production environments.

Minimum of 7 years of experience with AI platforms — OpenAI, Claude, Vertex AI, plus open-source models — including building abstraction layers to manage multi-provider pipelines.

Minimum of 10 years of experience programming in Python, Java, or equivalent; familiarity with evaluation tooling, logging, monitoring, and agent observability.

Minimum of 10 years of experience deploying to production — CI/CD, infrastructure as code (Terraform, Helm), monitoring, and debugging.

Minimum of 10 years of experience in client communication and collaboration, including being capable of leading technical workshops and delivering under ambiguity.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent; additional AI certifications or agentic tool experience is a plus.

Bonus Points If:

You’ve served as an Agentic AI Engineer in an Enterprise environment

You’ve defined or worked with enterprise-grade architectures for compound AI systems, orchestration frameworks, or agent registry/stream-based architectures.

You understand the AI-native paradigm — blending cloud-native with generative model architectures — optimizing for performance, modularity, and efficiency.

You’ve delivered solutions across multiple industries (e.g., finance, healthcare) by tailoring agentic workflows to industry needs.

jobs.title: Sr Manager, Design Engineering
jobs.description:
Join the Cold Chain That Feeds the World.

For over 120 years, Americold has connected producers, processors, distributors, and retailers to ensure food stays safe, fresh, and accessible. With 240+ facilities across four continents and 14,000+ team members, we’re a global leader in temperature-controlled logistics. Our mission is to help our customers feed the world – and we’re looking for people who share that purpose. We value customer service, innovation, and inclusion, and we invest in our people’s growth and well-being. If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact in a company that puts people first, Americold is the place for you.

Primary Responsibility

Lead design concepting for new and existing facilities to include layouts, bidding, material handling and refrigeration engineering. Develop RFQ/RFP documents to enable supplier selection and score carding. Scope facility design options (racking, conveyor, automation) to match new or changing business requirements. Provide capital budgetary estimates. Support sales and business development efforts including attending presentations to explain solutions. Mentor other members of the Design Engineering team.

What You’ll Do

Develop preliminary solution concepts for customer needs and RFQ requests from sales/business development
Develop racking designs for storage requirements for various businesses and product type
Define when conventional racking or automated robotic/ASRS solutions are the right application; design concept layouts that can be issued to suppliers
Develop automation equipment calculations, volume flow chart, Power Point slides, videos and other materials to defend and showcase a design
Match business requirements (pallet height, SKU velocity, pick face count) to design solutions
Direct in-house ACAD efforts to layout facility and provide drawing solutions and/or modifications clearly, in executive-type presentations
Work with regional general managers and facility management to develop layouts, cost estimates and implementation schedules
Develop temperature-controlled refrigeration solutions with supplier support to accommodate changing customer needs
Assist in supplier selection phase in developing detailed RFPs for obtaining competitive bids; analyze bids to determine successful providers; provide recommendations through qualitative and quantitative comparisons
Work with various general contractors in developing solutions for lighting, fire protection, automation, refrigeration, and general construction
Assist business development solutions group with cost justifications for proposed projects
Support cross-functional teams in solutions development and project qualification (engineering, sales, finance, legal, field maintenance, operations) …
Keep abreast of the latest technology in building design, refrigeration systems, automation, controls, and evaluate for applications for use in Americold facilities.
Lead detailed design engineering and define scope and capabilities of WCS, as it integrates with WMS
Other duties as assigned

What Experience And Education You Need

Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or similar and 10-15 years of experience in consulting, automation, construction, or mechanical design in a warehouse/distribution environment
5 to 10 years of implementation or project management experience preferred

What Could Set You Apart

Good verbal and written communication and strong analytical skills
Solid decision-making and project management skills
The ability to organize and manage multiple priorities
Problem analysis and problem resolution at both a strategic and functional level
Ability to excel in team working environment
Strong customer orientation and presentation
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, able to interact with all management levels within the Americold organization, both up and down as well as with external contacts.
Solid computer skills required, primarily with Microsoft Excel and Project software. Knowledge and skills using AutoCAD or simulation software is a plus
Must be able to travel approximately 40% to 60%, with some international

Physical Requirements

Requires the ability to sit for long periods of time, with frequent interruptions
Requires several hours per day of sitting, getting up and down from chairs, and reaching, or bending
Requires manual dexterity with normal hand and finger movements for typical office work
Talking, hearing, and seeing are important elements of completing assigned tasks
May require travel by automobile and airplane up for business
May require a visit facility operations in temperatures at or below freezing
May carry loads related to travel and occasionally lifts, carries, positions, or moves objects weighing up to 20 pounds
Requires the use of various electronic tools
Requires the ability to relate to others beyond giving and receiving instructions: must partner with colleagues without exhibiting behavioral extremes
Requires the performance of work activities including reasoning, negotiating, instructing, persuading, or speaking with others; and respond appropriately to constructive feedback from executive management

At Americold, we believe in taking care of our people. We offer benefits designed to support your health, financial well-being, and future. and Excellence

jobs.title: Director, ServiceNow Platform
jobs.description:
Overview

Live the experience
. From professional empowerment to continual learning opportunities. From ongoing investment in new and emerging technologies to a career of self-determination. At Ulta Beauty, our tech team is critical to our scalability—and is recognized that way. We’ve been defined as a “mature start-up.” A place where interdepartmental exposure, open doors, and genuine collaboration is ubiquitous. Where challenges come fast and furious, requiring agility, mental dexterity, and creativity. Where our passion for better solutions
drives us and is core to who we are.

We’re engineering for the future of retail, and it’s no-holds-barred. But for those motivated by continual change and ambiguity, by superior leadership, by whip smart colleagues who will press you daily for your very best, you’ll find that virtually nothing’s impossible at Ulta Beauty.

THE IMPACT YOU CAN MAKE:

The Director, ServiceNow Platform Lead is accountable for the strategy, operating model, architecture standards, governance, delivery quality, financial stewardship, and long-term health of Ulta Beauty's enterprise ServiceNow platform.

This leader will own the platform as a strategic enterprise capability, balancing business demand, technical sustainability, operational stability, vendor delivery, platform security, and roadmap execution. The role spans current and emerging ServiceNow capabilities across IT, People Success, Store Operations, Supplier and Brand experiences, Risk, Security, and enterprise workflow automation.

The Director will lead the ServiceNow platform team and partner closely with Product, Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, Operations, Enterprise Applications, business stakeholders, and implementation partners. This role does not own business product management or business product backlogs; instead, it ensures that ServiceNow demand is governed, sequenced, designed, delivered, and supported in a way that protects platform integrity and maximizes enterprise value.

Platform Scope

This role will provide leadership across current and emerging ServiceNow capabilities including, but not limited to:

IT Service Management, including Incident, Problem, Change, Knowledge, Virtual Agent, and Service Operations Workspace
IT Operations Management, including Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, CMDB, and operational integrations
Integrated Risk Management and Security Vulnerability Response
HR Service Delivery and People Success service experiences
Customer Service Management and enterprise case management patterns
App Engine, custom applications, citizen development, and low-code governance
Hardware Asset Management, Software Asset Management, certificate management, and related asset processes
Strategic Portfolio Management capabilities where aligned to enterprise direction
Brand, supplier, store operations, and associate experience workflow automation
Now Assist, Virtual Agent, agentic AI, and AI-enabled service experiences
Enterprise integrations, including automation, monitoring, vulnerability scanning, asset, service, and workflow data integrations
Platform upgrades, patching, release governance, testing, hypercare, and operational readiness

YOU’LL ACCOMPLISH THESE GOALS BY:

Platform Strategy & Roadmap Enablement

Own and evolve the ServiceNow platform strategy, operating model, architecture standards, and enablement roadmap in alignment with enterprise priorities.
Partner with Product Owners and business leaders to translate demand into platform-ready delivery plans, ensuring requests are clear, feasible, supportable, and aligned to platform standards.
Support enterprise demand intake and portfolio governance by providing platform capacity, technical feasibility, sequencing, risk, cost, and dependency input.
Partner with senior leaders across IT, People Success, Store Operations, Supplier, Brand, Risk, Security, Finance, and other functions to identify high-value workflow automation opportunities.
Ensure the ServiceNow platform roadmap supports improved operational efficiency, employee and associate experience, risk reduction, compliance, scalability, and cost effectiveness.

Platform Architecture & Technical Standards

Own ServiceNow platform architecture standards and technical guardrails in partnership with Enterprise Architecture.
Ensure solutions remain scalable, secure, upgradeable, supportable, and aligned with enterprise architecture principles.
Lead architecture review governance for high-impact, cross-platform, integration-heavy, or strategically significant ServiceNow changes.
Define and enforce standards for configuration, customization, data models, integrations, reusable components, update sets, source control practices where applicable, and application repository discipline.
Guide decisions around reuse, rationalization, technical debt, platform patterns, and avoidance of duplicate or conflicting designs.

Platform Governance & Operating Model

Establish and mature the ServiceNow Center of Excellence operating model, including intake, prioritization support, governance, delivery standards, release management, and support transition.
Define platform guardrails for configuration, customization, data model design, integration patterns, reuse, security, and maintainability.
Lead governance for citizen development and low-code application delivery, including application intake, review, enablement, training, and risk-based escalation.
Partner with Architecture, Security, Compliance, and Operations to ensure platform changes meet enterprise standards and regulatory expectations.
Ensure high-impact and cross-platform changes receive appropriate review, testing, approval, and operational readiness planning.

Security, Risk & Compliance Governance

Ensure platform security controls, privileged access management, elevated access processes, segregation of duties, and compliance requirements are consistently enforced across ServiceNow environments.
Partner with Security, Risk, Compliance, and Audit teams to maintain appropriate controls for sensitive workflows, regulated data, administrative access, and production changes.
Drive governance for roles, groups, permissions, delegated administration, support access, emergency access, and vendor access.
Ensure security and compliance requirements are incorporated into design reviews, testing, release readiness, and operational support processes.

Delivery Leadership & Execution

Lead delivery across platform enhancements, module implementations, integrations, upgrades, AI-enabled capabilities, and custom application development.
Ensure delivery teams produce scalable, supportable, secure, and maintainable solutions that follow ServiceNow and Ulta development standards.
Oversee release planning, defect triage, regression testing, ATF adoption, deployment readiness, hypercare, and post-release stabilization.
Coordinate delivery across internal teams, system integrators, ServiceNow, managed service partners, and business stakeholders.
Drive accountability for milestones, risks, dependencies, quality, documentation, and handoff into steady-state operations.

Platform Health, Reliability & Technical Sustainability

Own the health and sustainability of the ServiceNow platform across production and non-production environments.
Lead platform upgrade, patching, clone, test, and release-readiness processes across impacted modules and stakeholder teams.
Drive reduction of technical debt, customization risk, duplicate solutions, integration fragility, and data-quality issues.
Establish meaningful platform health metrics, including stability, adoption, usage, backlog health, defect trends, automation outcomes, CMDB health, SLA performance, release quality, and operational readiness.
Ensure support processes are in place for incidents, emergency changes, vendor support cases, maintenance windows, and business-critical platform issues.

CMDB, Data & Integration Leadership

Lead the strategy and governance for CMDB data quality, ownership, lifecycle management, and integration alignment.
Partner with IT Operations, Infrastructure, Security, and application teams to strengthen CI accuracy, completeness, service mapping, and operational dependency data.
Guide integrations with automation tools, vulnerability scanners, monitoring systems, asset sources, service channels, workforce systems, and other enterprise platforms.
Ensure data models, integration patterns, APIs, import sets, transform maps, and automation flows are documented, supportable, and aligned to platform architecture.

Vendor, Partner & Financial Management

Own annual platform budget planning input, license strategy, vendor expenditure planning, business case support, and investment-value tracking for ServiceNow.
Manage delivery performance across ServiceNow, system integrators, implementation partners, and managed service providers.
Ensure partners follow Ulta's development standards, documentation expectations, security requirements, and operational readiness criteria.
Evaluate vendor deliverables for quality, maintainability, scalability, and alignment with platform architecture.
Support license, renewal, utilization, and value-realization discussions to ensure Ulta maximizes its ServiceNow investment.
Identify opportunities to rationalize spend, increase reuse, reduce duplicate tooling, improve license utilization, and improve platform ROI.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

Build, lead, and develop a high-performing ServiceNow platform team across architecture, development, administration, QA, release, and operations capabilities.
Provide clear direction, coaching, performance management, and growth paths for platform team members.
Raise the technical bar for ServiceNow delivery through standards, code reviews, design reviews, knowledge sharing, and reusable patterns.
Create a collaborative culture that balances speed, quality, accountability, and long-term platform stewardship.
Represent the ServiceNow platform in leadership forums and communicate complex technical topics clearly to executive and business audiences.

ESSENTIALS FOR SUCCESS:

10+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, including enterprise platform, workflow, ITSM, enterprise applications, or digital transformation leadership.
5+ years of ServiceNow experience or comparable leadership of large-scale workflow/platform ecosystems.
Experience establishing and scaling a ServiceNow Center of Excellence or enterprise platform operating model.
Experience leading managers, technical teams, system integrators, and cross-functional delivery teams.
Strong understanding of ServiceNow platform capabilities, including ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, IRM/GRC, HRSD, CSM, App Engine, Flow Designer, UI Builder, Virtual Agent, Now Assist, integrations, and platform administration.
Experience with platform architecture governance, release management, testing, upgrade planning, operational readiness, and post-go-live support models.
Experience establishing technical standards for configuration, customization, data models, integrations, source control practices, update sets, application repository discipline, and reusable components.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex programs with multiple vendors, business stakeholders, security/compliance requirements, and enterprise dependencies.
Strong understanding of CMDB governance, data quality, CI lifecycle, Discovery, Service Mapping, and operational integrations.
Ability to translate enterprise strategy into a practical platform roadmap, delivery plan, operating model, and measurable outcomes.

Preferred Experience

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator, Certified Application Developer, Certified Implementation Specialist, or Certified Technical Architect credentials.
Experience in retail, multi-site operations, associate experience, HR service delivery, supplier/brand workflows, or enterprise shared services.

Overview

Frontdoor is reimagining how homeowners maintain and repair their most valuable asset – their home. As the parent company of two leading brands, we bring over 50 years of experience in providing our members with comprehensive options to protect their homes from costly and unexpected breakdowns through our extensive network of pre-qualified professional contractors. American Home Shield, the category leader in home service plans with approximately two million members, gives homeowners budget protection and convenience, covering up to 23 essential home systems and appliances. Frontdoor is a cutting edge, one-stop app for home repair and maintenance. Enabled by our Streem technology, the app empowers homeowners by connecting them in real time through video chat with pre-qualified experts to diagnose and solve their problems. The Frontdoor app also offers homeowners a range of other benefits including DIY tips, discounts and more. For more information about American Home Shield and Frontdoor, please visit frontdoorhome.com .

Responsibilities

Summary
The Senior Manager, Cloud & Platform Engineering leads teams responsible for designing, building, and operating cloud infrastructure and internal platforms that power mission‑critical services at scale. This role is accountable for cloud foundations, platform reliability and resiliency, automation, and recoverability by design, while ensuring a strong partnership with other cross-functional teams to deliver results.

This is a technical leadership role requiring deep experience in cloud and platform engineering, combined with strong people leadership, execution discipline, and the ability to translate business needs into scalable engineering solutions.

Responsibilities:

Lead and develop Cloud Engineers and Platform Engineers, fostering a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.
Own the technical vision and roadmap for cloud foundations and internal platforms.
Establish cloud standards, architectural patterns, and governance frameworks across the organization.
Define and evolve AWS infrastructure – networking, compute, storage, IAM, security, and resiliency.
Ensure all cloud and platform services are reliable and resilient by design, not by operational heroics.
Drive adoption of multi‑AZ and multi‑region resilience patterns where required.
Plan and lead large infrastructure projects in collaboration with Engineering, Corporate IT, GRC, and Security teams, and partner with peer leaders across Product and Engineering to deliver end‑to‑end outcomes
Partner with Security and GRC teams to meet security standards, end-of-life and vulnerability remediations, audit and compliance (e.g., PCI, SOX controls), data protection and recovery expectations.
Champion automation‑first and infrastructure‑as‑code practices.
Manage cloud budgets, forecast usage, and drive cost optimization initiatives.
Recommend software improvements to achieve higher availability, scalability, and efficiency.
Manage on-call rotations and be on the escalation path of the on-call rotation to respond to incidents.
May include other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

Deep hands‑on knowledge of AWS at an architectural level.
Excellent problem solving, analytical, and decision-making skills
Proven people‑management experience leading cloud or platform engineering teams.
Experience managing direct reports remotely.
Experience leading large‑scale cloud migrations or platform transformations.
Experience managing complex projects.
Proven experience building internal platforms or shared engineering services at scale.
Deep understanding of Linux environments, networking, and cloud architecture fundamentals.

Experience with software development and testing processes in an agile environment
Experience with Kubernetes, Helm-charts, Gitlab, Elasticsearch, Confluent Kafka.

Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive alignment across competing priorities.

Able to manage multiple priority projects at the same time.

Strong communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and executive audiences (verbal and written).
Able to go deep technically when needed, while operating primarily at the systems and strategy level.
Demonstrated ability to use data to make informed decisions about priorities and measure the cost of problems and the impact of solutions.
Demonstrated ability to build solutions to automate monitoring systems to ensure the highest level of uptime for production systems.
Experience managing cloud costs, budgets, and optimization initiatives.

AWS

Job Title: Optical Photonics Validation Leader

Overview

We are looking for an Optical Validation Engineering, Senior Director to drive the characterization, validation, and qualification of near-packaged optics (NPO) and co-packaged optics (CPO) systems. In this role, you will define and implement the validation approach that ensures the optical, electrical, and thermal performance of advanced photonic interconnects used in next-generation data center and networking platforms.

You will work at the intersection of silicon photonics, packaging, electrical design, and systems engineering to ensure robust product performance from prototype to production.

Key Responsibilities

Lead a team that owns the optical validation strategy and roadmap for optical connectivity products.
Develop and execute comprehensive validation and test plans covering optical coupling, insertion loss, signal integrity, thermal stability, and reliability metrics.
Define optical test methodologies for complex integrated systems involving photonic, electrical, and mechanical interfaces.
Collaborate with design, packaging, and system architecture teams to translate product specifications into measurable validation criteria.
Establish automated test frameworks for high-throughput optical and electrical validation (instrument control, data analysis, and reporting).
Analyze measurement data to identify performance trends, failure modes, and root causes.
Lead design-of-experiments (DOE) initiatives to optimize system performance and yield.
Interface with manufacturing, reliability, and quality teams to ensure seamless transition to volume production and long-term reliability.
Mentor junior engineers and promote best practices in optical validation and measurement science.

Qualifications

M.S. or Ph.D. in Optical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, or equivalent field.
8+ years of experience in optical module testing, photonic component validation, or high-speed interconnect qualification.
Deep understanding of optical measurements (IL, RL, BER, eye diagrams, mode coupling), optical alignment, and signal characterization.
Hands-on experience with optical instrumentation (optical spectrum analyzers, BERTs, network analyzers, power meters, interferometers).
Strong background in data analysis, automation scripting (Python, LabVIEW, MATLAB), and statistical validation methods.
Familiarity with packaging-related optical performance dependencies (thermo-mechanical stress, optical coupling efficiency, etc.).
Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with a proven ability to align across multidisciplinary hardware teams.

Preferred Experience

Experience with co-packaged optics, silicon photonics assemblies, and near-packaged optical interfaces.
Knowledge of industry standards and compliance testing (IEEE 802.3, OIF, or custom CPO protocols).
Understanding of reliability qualification (HTOL, TC, mechanical shock/vibration for optical components).
Familiarity with system-level validation for networking and hyperscale data center environments.

jobs.title: Head of AI Enablement Engineering
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

The Opportunity

Deepgram's ambition is to build a generational company with a small, exceptional team — which only works if every engineer and every function operates with serious AI leverage. We're looking for a Head of AI Enablement Engineering
to own that mission end to end: making Deepgram one of the most AI-native companies in the world, in practice and not just in principle.

This is a build-first leadership role, not a steward or training role. You'll personally evaluate tools, build the agents and workflows that show what great looks like, and set the standards that the rest of the company adopts. You'll turn our AI-native strategy into shipped capability — reusable agents and skills, MCP integrations, paved-road workflows, and the enablement hub and patterns that let any team go from idea to working tool fast and safely. You'll partner closely with Engineering, Platform/Internal Tools, People Ops, and functional leaders across the company, and you'll be measured on real outcomes: adoption, productivity, and the quality of what people build.

You'll lead largely through building and influence, with the runway to grow a small team and a network of champions as the function scales. It's a high-visibility seat with executive sponsorship and a mandate to set direction where there is no established playbook.

What You'll Do

Own and drive AI enablement engineering across Deepgram — the strategy, the standards, and the hands-on building that make AI leverage real in every function.
Personally evaluate, prototype with, and make the calls on the AI tools, agents, models, and orchestration layers Deepgram adopts; avoid tool sprawl and make pragmatic build-vs-buy decisions.
Build the reference implementations: reusable agents and skills, MCP servers, paved-road workflows, prompt and pattern libraries, and the enablement hub where the best internally-built tools are surfaced and elevated.
Set and run the company-wide AI adoption strategy — the metrics, milestones, and reporting cadence leadership uses to track progress, framed around measurable productivity and quality, not activity.
Partner with Platform/Internal Tools, Security, and Data to define guardrails that are embedded into platforms rather than enforced through gates — safe-use patterns, access, and data handling that make adoption easier, not harder.
Build and lead a distributed champions network embedded in teams, and grow a small central team over time as impact scales.
Partner with People Ops on AI-native onboarding and fluency, so new and existing teammates do real reps inside the tools and leave the system better than they found it.
Stay ahead of a fast-moving landscape and translate emerging AI capabilities into pragmatic, Deepgram-ready practice.

You'll Love This Role If You

Want to define how an entire company works with AI — and you'd rather build the proof than write the memo.
Are energized by ambiguity and a blank page, and you set direction where there's no playbook yet.
Are hands-on and current: you build agents and workflows yourself and can sit across from senior engineers as a peer on day one.
Care about real outcomes — adoption, time saved, quality — not vanity metrics or shelf-ware.
Like operating across an org, bringing skeptical teams along through demonstrated value rather than mandate.
Believe a small, AI-leveraged team can outbuild a much larger one.

It's Important To Us That You Have

A strong engineering background with the hands-on ability to build production-quality agents, tools, and automations yourself.
Deep, current fluency with the modern AI tooling landscape — coding agents, LLM application patterns, prompting, retrieval, MCP/agent tooling, and orchestration.
A track record of driving technology adoption and changing how people work at scale, in environments that didn't start out asking for it.
The ability to operate across business and technical functions and influence without direct authority, including credibility with senior engineering leaders.
Strong product and platform instincts — you treat enablement as a product, with users, adoption, and a roadmap.
Excellent communication — you can demo, document, evangelize, and report outcomes to executives in plain language.
Comfort defining safe-use guardrails and data-handling practices in partnership with Security and Platform.

It Would Be Great if You Had

Experience standing up an AI enablement, developer productivity, or engineering effectiveness function from scratch.
Background building internal platforms or developer-facing tooling that engineers actually adopted.
Experience leading a small team and/or a distributed champions/center-of-excellence model.
Familiarity with enterprise AI search and knowledge tooling (e.g., Glean, Notion AI) and agent orchestration frameworks.
A point of view on measuring developer productivity and AI impact, with the nuance that entails.
Experience in a fast-moving, AI-native engineering organization.

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The engineering professional we seek is a leader and a strong strategic problem solver with these qualifications.

jobs.title: Director, Data Engineering
jobs.description:
About EAB

At EAB , our mission is to make education smarter and our communities stronger. We work with more than 2,800 institutions to drive transformative change through data-driven insights and best-in-class capabilities. From kindergarten to college to career, EAB partners with leaders and practitioners to accelerate progress and drive results across enrollment, student success, institutional strategy, data analytics, and advancement. We work with each partner differently, tailoring our portfolio of research, technology, and marketing and enrollment solutions to meet the unique needs of every leadership team, as well as the students and employees they serve.

At EAB, we serve not only our partner institutions but each other—that's why we are always working to make sure our employees love their jobs and are invested in their communities. See how we've been recognized for this dedication to our employees by checking out our recent awards .

For more information, visit our Careers page.

The Role In Brief

Director, Data Engineering

The Director of Data Engineering for Navigate360 leads the team responsible for implementing Navigate360 data integrations across partner campuses. This role oversees delivery for Navigate Student Success, EAB’s foundational student success technology, while charting and scaling implementation practices for newer Navigate Enrollment CRM and Advancement CRM offerings. The role combines people leadership, technical and operational judgment, and a partner-first mindset to help campuses realize successful, durable implementations. Working at the intersection of data, product, and customer outcomes, this leader establishes clear operating processes, removes barriers, and ensures the team delivers reliable integrations that create value in practice.

This position is ideally based out of EAB’s Washington, D.C. office or Richmond, VA office. It is also open to remote work within the continental U.S.

This hire may be required to travel to EAB’s central office in Washington, D.C. on a quarterly basis, and occasionally visit partners to firm up engagement and kick off high-touch projects. The current travel expectation does not exceed 12 days per year.

Primary Responsibilities

Lead, coach, and develop a team of data engineers implementing Navigate modules for partner campuses; set clear expectations, priorities, and delivery standards.
Own the implementation approach for Navigate Student Success and help define scalable delivery practices for newer Navigate Enrollment CRM and Advancement CRM offerings.
Establish repeatable processes, playbooks, and quality controls that enable the team to deliver high-quality data integrations consistently at scale.
Unblock partner-facing and technical challenges throughout implementation projects, escalating and coordinating decisions as needed to protect partner outcomes.
Partner with Product on data-integration issues, requirements, and product enhancements that improve implementation quality and the partner experience.
Collaborate closely with Launch and Partner Success teams to align implementation plans, manage risk, and support successful partner adoption and outcomes.
Guide solution design for integrations, data mapping, validation, reconciliation, and data quality across all Navigate implementations.
Oversee delivery planning, capacity, and project health across the team; use organized, methodical processes to manage competing priorities and drive predictable execution.
Foster a culture of technical excellence through mentoring, thoughtful code and design review, documentation, and continuous improvement of team practices.
Represent the Data Engineering team with internal and external stakeholders, communicating progress, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations with clarity and credibility.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience
8+ years of database programming experience, including advanced SQL
3-4+ years leading, managing, or serving as a team lead for data engineering teams
Experience delivering data integration, warehousing, or analytics solutions in partner-facing or customer implementation environments
2+ years of Python programming experience for relational data management, including commonly used data-management libraries
Deep understanding of how data flows across systems, including ETL pipelines, data mapping, validation, and reconciliation
Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical and partner challenges, make sound decisions, and unblock teams
Experience ensuring data integrity through standard rules, procedures, testing, validation, and quality controls
Highly organized, process-oriented, and effective at managing multiple priorities in a changing environment; strong written and verbal communication skills

Ideal Qualifications

Master’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience
Experience working directly with external partners and executive stakeholders to solve problems, build trust, and drive successful implementations
Practical knowledge of data warehouse design, scalable data pipelines, integrations across platforms, and complex stored procedures
Experience leading teams through growth, change, and continuous improvement, including developing repeatable operating processes
Ability to work collaboratively across Product, Launch, Partner Success, and technical teams to accomplish shared partner outcomes in a fast-paced environment
Commitment to a continual learning environment and to a dynamic, welcoming culture of fairness, authenticity, and belonging in support of EAB’s mission, values, and aspiration

If you’ve reached this section of the job description and are unsure of whether to apply, please do! At EAB, we welcome new perspectives and learn from each other’s unique experiences. We would encourage you to submit an application if this is a role you would be passionate about doing every day.

Compensation

The anticipated starting salary range for this role is $103,500 – $130,000 per year. Actual salary varies due to factors that may include but not be limited to relevant experience, skills, and location. At EAB, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the starting salary range for their role.

This hire will additionally be eligible for discretionary bonus or incentive compensation. Variable compensation may depend on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Benefits

Consistent with our belief that our employees are our most valuable resource, EAB offers a competitive and inclusive benefits package. Our benefits currently include:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans; dependents and domestic partners eligible
20+ days of PTO annually, in addition to paid firm and floating holidays
Daytime leave policy for community service and flextime for fitness activities (up to 10 hours per month each)
401(k) retirement savings plan with annual discretionary company matching contribution
Health savings account, healthcare and dependent care flexible spending account, and pre-tax commuter plans
Employee assistance program with counseling services and resources available to all employees and immediate family
Wellness programs including gym discounts, incentives to promote healthy living, and family access to the leading app for sleep, meditation, and relaxation
Fertility treatment coverage and adoption or surrogacy assistance
Paid parental leave with phase back to work program for birthing and non-birthing parents
Access to milk shipping service to support nursing employees during business travel
Discounted pet health insurance coverage for dog and cat family members
Company-provided life, AD&D, and disability insurance
Financial wellness resources and membership in a robust employee discount program
Access to employee resource groups, merit-based advancement, and dynamic professional growth opportunities

Benefits kick in day one; learn more at eab.com/careers/benefits .

This opening is not eligible for visa sponsorship at this time; EAB will thus consider candidates who possess U.S. work authorization that does not require employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future.

At EAB, we believe that to fulfill our mission to “make education smarter and our communities stronger” we need team members who bring a diversity of perspectives to the table and a workplace where each team member is valued, respected and heard.

To that end, EAB is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we make employment decisions on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

jobs.title: Director Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Overview

About PHOENIX

PHOENIX Retail, LLC is a retail platform operating the Express and Bonobos brands worldwide.

About Express

Express is a multichannel apparel brand dedicated to a design philosophy rooted in modern, confident and effortless style whether dressing for work, everyday or special occasions. Since its launch in 1980, the brand has embraced a design philosophy rooted in modern, confident and effortless style. Express ensures you look and feel your best, wherever life takes you. The Company operates over 400 retail and outlet stores in the United States and Puerto Rico, the express.com online store and the Express mobile app.

About Bonobos

Our Bonobos menswear brand is known for being a style instigator and offering perfect-fit risks through our innovative retail model and personalized experience. Launched online in 2007 with its signature line of chinos, Bonobos now offers a variety of styles available to order online and to try on at any one of our 50 Guideshop locations and at www.bonobos.com. Our Guideshops are in-real-life stores that deliver one-on-one service and expert fit advice. Don't think traditional retail, Bonobos is something you haven't seen before.

Location Name

Columbus Corporate Headquarters

Responsibilities

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Director of Infrastructure is responsible for the strategic planning, execution, and operational management of Phoenix's IT infrastructure. This role includes ownership of Local Data Centers, AWS Cloud Technologies, GCP Cloud Technologies, Networking, Database, Servers & Storage, Disaster Recovery Planning, and PCI/Regulatory Audits. This role is responsible for ensuring Phoenix systems remain available at all times in order to meet its business objectives.

This person will play a key role in defining the strategic and tactical direction, and the ongoing operations, of functions noted above. This position will engage cross-functionally at all levels of the organization and requires focus on, experience with, and knowledge of, retail business, technical operations and people management- particularly in critical, fast-paced environments.

The desired candidate will be a leader and mentor to the team, that is willing and able to jump in, when needed as well as perform as an expert in domains of relevance. This person will lead with emotional intelligence and is expected to be available and involved with resolving complex technical challenges within the enterprise. This Director will work directly with our key vendor and business partners in support of the existing operations and will plan strategically to ensure the Phoenix technology operations can support dynamic business initiatives and a robust application and infrastructure portfolio. This person will be responsible for taking part in the collaborative process of creating and supporting annual capital and expense budgets as well as multiyear, strategic roadmaps.

This role is a critical, high-visibility role within the organization and includes 24x7 management responsibilities within a team of peers with similar responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities
Develops, implements, and manages technical operations in support of Phoenix business requirements. Drives strategic initiatives within the team and supports the strategic initiatives across Phoenix brands. Establishes and cultivates relationships with peers within and beyond the Technology organization.
Leads and oversees the design, implementation and ongoing management of support functions and technology solutions supporting Phoenix. Facilitates the creation of relevant multiyear, strategic roadmaps.
Leads and assists the troubleshooting of technical or operational problems and takes corrective action as necessary to resolve. Serves as a key member of the Incident Management team focused on rapid service restoration when disruptions occur.
Responsible for performance, capacity, monitoring and upgrades necessary to enable successful organizational execution and end-user productivity. Directs and ensures successful team execution on multiple projects and support functions simultaneously.
Ensures team compliance with applicable change and incident management policies when implementing system changes and addressing problem resolution. Manages team to ensure security, compliance and operational stability and sustainability is a focus behind everything we do.
Supports multiple sites and remote associates.

Required Experience & Qualifications
Education: Bachelor's in Computer Science, IT, or relevant area of study
Experience: 10+ years hands-on experience with IT Infrastructure and technical design, deployment, operational management and troubleshooting
Experience: 5+ years hands-on experience with Cloud Platforms, preferably GCP
Experience: 7-10 years supervising or managing a team of technical engineers
Demonstrated ability to create multiyear, strategic plans leveraging technology in service of business objectives
Significant knowledge of networking, compute, storage and database technologies
Significant knowledge of IT facility management and complex support functions
Ability to maintain confidentiality with sensitive customer and internal information
Proven ability to work collaboratively / cross functionally and influence stake holders; manage and balance stakeholder expectations
Demonstrated ability to analyze and improve complex processes with a track record of successfully leading and delivering projects
Ability to manage projects and multiple tasks in an organized fashion
Ability to consistently support and lead teams on daily basis, or during emergencies, and regularly provide honest, direct feedback
Ensure accountability of individual, team and department goals.
Foster an environment of curiosity.
Superior communication skills both written and verbal
Effective communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills
Excellent organizational, planning, and coordination skills
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build collaborative relationships
Experience working in the retail industry required

Critical Skills & Attributes
Approaches obstacles proactively and looks for ways to resolve problems and issues
Ability to multi-task and re-prioritize as needed
Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize, cope with change and maintain composure under pressure
Desire to take full ownership of assigned projects and ability to work independently or as a member of a team
Accountable for results
Ability to multi-task and manage multiple projects simultaneously
Possesses a sense of urgency; self-motivated and detail-minded
Solid verbal presentation, group dynamic, and facilitation skills
Proactive approach to resolving problems and issues
Dedication to meeting requirements of internal and external customers, responding to all customer requests promptly and thoroughly

jobs.title: Senior Director, Data Center Operations
jobs.description:
Job Description

This position is based in Abilene, TX.

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is continuing its rapid expansion across parts of North America, delivering next-generation cloud infrastructure to support enterprise and AI-driven workloads. As our cloud footprint continues to grow, we are seeking an accomplished executive to lead Cloud Hardware Support (CHS) across parts of North America.

This Senior Director will provide strategic and operational leadership for a rapidly growing regional organization, with responsibility spanning Build & Deployment, steady-state operations, hardware maintenance, and break-fix support across Oracle's cloud infrastructure.

The successful candidate will establish a scalable operating model that enables rapid regional expansion while maintaining operational excellence, customer service, and workforce effectiveness. This leader will build high-performing teams, standardize operations across multiple countries, and drive continuous improvement through automation, AI, process engineering, and operational innovation.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of Oracle's cloud operations across one of its fastest-growing regions.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

We are seeking a dynamic and visionary executive with a proven track record of leading hyperscale infrastructure organizations through periods of rapid growth and transformation. This leader will be responsible for scaling Cloud Hardware Support operations across parts of North America while ensuring the organization remains operationally efficient, customer-focused, and ready to support Oracle's continued cloud expansion.

Additional responsibilities include:

Provide executive leadership for Cloud Hardware Support operations across parts of North America, including Build & Deployment, production readiness, hardware lifecycle management, and break-fix operations.
Develop and execute a scalable regional operating model capable of supporting continued hyperscale growth across multiple countries.
Lead a large, geographically dispersed organization that is expected to grow significantly as Oracle expands its cloud footprint throughout the region.
Drive operational excellence by standardizing deployment methodologies, improving service delivery, and implementing best practices across all regional operations.
Champion the use of AI, automation, process engineering, and data-driven decision making to improve productivity, increase operational efficiency, and reduce the dependency between infrastructure growth and headcount expansion.
Build and develop high-performing leadership teams while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Partner closely with Engineering, Networking, Software Development, Product, Supply Chain, Data Center Engineering, and other cross-functional organizations to ensure successful delivery of new cloud regions and ongoing operational excellence.
Establish strong contractor, partner, and vendor relationships to support regional deployment and operational readiness.
Ensure customer commitments and operational service levels are consistently achieved while proactively managing operational risk.
Act as the senior Cloud Hardware Support leader across parts of North America, influencing strategic priorities and representing the organization with executive stakeholders across Oracle.

Preferred Skills And Experience

Executive leadership experience within hyperscale cloud infrastructure, cloud operations, hardware support, data center operations, or infrastructure engineering.
Proven experience leading large, geographically distributed organizations across multiple countries and cultures.
Demonstrated success scaling operations within rapidly growing cloud or technology organizations.
Strong understanding of hyperscale data center operations, infrastructure deployment, hardware lifecycle management, and operational support.
Proven track record of driving operational transformation through AI, automation, intelligent tooling, process engineering, and scalable operating models.
Experience leveraging emerging AI capabilities and operational analytics to improve workforce productivity, operational performance, and service quality.
Exceptional strategic thinking, organizational leadership, and execution capabilities.
Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior stakeholders across engineering, infrastructure, product, and business organizations.
Experience building high-performing leadership teams and developing organizational capability through periods of significant growth.
Demonstrated ability to manage complex regional operations while balancing customer requirements, operational excellence, and business priorities.

Leadership Competencies

Performance, drive, and execution—Holds self and others accountable for delivering shareholder value. Creates and instills a performance driven, results-orientation culture based on data and facts. Takes full accountability for the achievement of organizational results. Delivers audience-appropriate messages about financial performance and future expectations.
Collaboration—Fosters collaboration between business leaders. Facilitates consensus among diverse stakeholders with opposing viewpoints on critical issues. Drives a diverse and inclusive culture throughout the organization. Instills a sense of common purpose, joint mission, and mutual responsibility to create and support business outcomes. Aligns strategic priorities of own area with the direction and priorities of the broader organization.
Communicating for impact—Ensures clarity around organization's strategic intent and business objectives. Champions strategic initiatives in ways that generate organization-wide understanding and support. Builds confidence and inspires support through a convincing presentation style.
Inspirational leadership—Establishes and models authentic leadership across internal and external boundaries. Builds internal and external reputation as a strategic business leader. Inspires and empowers others toward achievement of goals and strategies. Employs and develops the right talent at every level.
Competitive edge—Predicts changes in customer expectations; takes advantage of opportunities to shape and re-shape market propositions. Builds long-term business value. Creates a culture of innovation and encourages entrepreneurship. Strategically develops a range of options/paths to achieve business objectives within a changing environment.
Change agility—Initiates strategic change initiatives in anticipation of a changing external environment. Champions organizational change initiatives in a way that helps people understand, appreciate, and support them. Guides the organization to remain flexible in a changing, competitive environment. Fosters creativity, measured risk-taking actions, and entrepreneurial thinking in others
Mastering complexity—Makes decisions about the long-term strategy to sustainably grow the business. Creates an environment that shapes and supports cross-functional analysis of problems and decision-making. Actively supports the resolution of ambiguous, complex problems that cross organizational boundaries. Creates an environment of personal accountability and ownership for problem-solving.

Education

A Bachelors’ degree is preferred. An advanced degree is a plus.

Qualifications

jobs.description:
Job Description

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineering Manager to lead the engineering strategy, delivery, and technical execution of software applications across a diverse portfolio of business-critical platforms, products, integrations, and modernization initiatives.

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role. The successful candidate must bring the same technical depth, engineering judgment, and delivery credibility expected of a Principal Software Engineer, while also leading teams, growing talent, and driving execution across a complex application portfolio. This role is not intended for an architect-only or people-only leader. The right candidate is expected to stay close to the code, lead technical design, perform code reviews, solve complex engineering problems, and coach engineers through direct technical engagement and example.

What You Will Do

Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for the design, build, modernization, integration, and support of software applications
Own technical direction across a portfolio that includes modern platforms, business-critical applications, integrations, APIs, and legacy systems
Partner with product, business, architecture, operations, and delivery leaders to translate business needs into scalable engineering solutions
Drive modernization strategies for legacy applications, including decomposition, platform evolution, integration simplification, and reduction of technical debt
Act as the senior technical leader for the organization by making sound architecture decisions, reviewing designs, and setting a high bar for engineering quality
Contribute directly when needed through design reviews, debugging, code reviews, solution modeling, technical spike work, and hands-on problem solving
Establish and enforce strong software engineering practices including testing, observability, CI/CD, version control discipline, secure coding, and operational readiness
Build strong engineering teams by hiring, coaching, mentoring, and developing software engineers and technical leaders
Create a culture of accountability, technical excellence, continuous learning, and customer-focused delivery
Lead incident response and escalation management for critical production issues, ensuring fast resolution and durable corrective action
Manage delivery across multiple workstreams with clear prioritization, measurable outcomes, and transparent communication to stakeholders

What Makes This Role Different

This leader is expected to operate with principal-level engineering capability, not simply manage engineers
The role requires strong technical credibility across application architecture, software delivery, integration patterns, modernization, and production support
The leader must be able to challenge designs, improve implementation approaches, and personally help teams through difficult technical situations
Success in this role depends on balancing strategic leadership with direct engineering engagement

Your Skills And Abilities (Required Qualifications)

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
10+ years experience in software engineering, with progressive responsibility across application development, and 5+ years of technical people leadership experience
Proven experience leading engineering teams and engineering managers responsible for complex enterprise application portfolios
Deep hands-on experience in software design, coding, code review, debugging, and technical problem solving
Demonstrated success modernizing legacy systems while supporting ongoing delivery for business-critical applications
Strong understanding of distributed systems, application integration, APIs, event-driven patterns, data flows, and enterprise architecture
Experience establishing and improving engineering standards, development lifecycle practices, and delivery discipline
Ability to lead across ambiguity, influence senior stakeholders, and align technical decisions with business outcomes
Strong coaching and mentoring capability, with a track record of raising the technical effectiveness of engineers and managers
Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to both engineering and business audiences

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

12+ years experience in software engineering, with progressive responsibility across application development, and 7+ years of technical people leadership experience
Experience supporting complex customer-facing, operational, or enterprise business domains
Experience with legacy platform transformation, including mainframe-connected or deeply integrated enterprise systems
Experience with cloud platforms, DevOps tooling, automated testing, observability, and modern software delivery practices
Experience leading globally distributed engineering teams
Experience operating in environments that require both speed of delivery and high operational reliability

Job Title
Executive Director of Technology Operations

Detailed Job Description

Job Overview

The Executive Director of Technology Operations is responsible for leading the operational management, governance, and execution of the company’s technology organization. This role ensures that technology resources, systems, infrastructure, development processes, and operational activities are aligned with business objectives and delivered efficiently, securely, and at scale.

The Executive Director of Technology Operations serves as the critical bridge between technology strategy and operational execution, driving operational excellence, technology governance, digital transformation, and cross-functional collaboration to support sustainable business growth and innovation.

Key Responsibilities
I. Technology Operations Strategy and Execution

Develop and implement technology operations strategies aligned with corporate and technology objectives.
Translate technology roadmaps into operational plans and measurable outcomes.
Drive operational excellence across software development, infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud operations, and IT service delivery.
Establish governance frameworks to ensure efficient execution of technology initiatives.

II. Technology Program and Portfolio Management

Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of enterprise technology projects and programs.
Manage technology portfolios, budgets, resources, and priorities to maximize business value.
Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.
Develop executive dashboards and reporting mechanisms to provide visibility into technology performance.

III. Technology Process Optimization and Governance

Establish and standardize technology operational processes, policies, and procedures.
Implement best practices across software development lifecycle (SDLC), DevOps, ITSM, Agile, and project management disciplines.
Continuously improve operational efficiency through process automation and workflow optimization.
Ensure compliance with internal controls, governance standards, and regulatory requirements.

IV. Infrastructure, Cloud, and Service Operations

Oversee enterprise technology infrastructure, cloud platforms, networks, and operational support services.
Ensure system availability, scalability, reliability, and performance.
Drive service delivery excellence through effective monitoring, incident management, and problem resolution.
Lead business continuity, disaster recovery, and operational resilience initiatives.

V. Cybersecurity, Risk Management, and Compliance

Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to ensure protection of enterprise systems, applications, and data assets.
Identify and mitigate technology-related operational risks.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, security frameworks, and corporate governance requirements.
Establish risk management and escalation procedures for critical technology operations.

VI. Data, Analytics, and Performance Management

Define and monitor technology KPIs, SLAs, and operational performance metrics.
Utilize data analytics to improve operational efficiency and support decision-making.
Develop performance reporting frameworks for executive leadership.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives based on operational insights and business needs.

VII. Cross-functional Collaboration and Business Alignment

Partner with product management, engineering, IT, finance, HR, and business leaders to align technology operations with business priorities.
Facilitate communication between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Support enterprise transformation initiatives and technology-enabled business growth.
Ensure effective coordination across global technology teams.

VIII. Leadership and Organizational Development

Build and lead high-performing technology operations teams.
Develop leadership capabilities, succession planning, and talent development programs.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
Promote employee engagement and collaboration across technology functions.

Qualifications
Education Background

Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or related fields.
Master’s degree or MBA preferred.

Work Experience

Typically 18+ years of experience in technology operations, IT management, engineering operations, or related functions, including 8+ years in senior leadership roles.
Proven experience managing large-scale technology organizations, digital transformation programs, and enterprise operations.
Strong background in software development operations, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, and technology governance.
Experience in multinational corporations or high-growth technology-driven organizations preferred.
