jobs.title: Director, Growth Engineering
jobs.description:
ABOUT OnX

We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further.

We’re a high-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt - continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver.

Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals - Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish - is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most.

We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact.

Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.

About This Opportunity

The Director of Growth Engineering will lead the Growth engineering teams with strong partnership with growth product, overseeing all software engineering efforts dedicated to driving user acquisition, activation, and conversion across iOS, Android, and Web platforms. This role is a critical blend of strategic vision, technical leadership, and cross-functional collaboration aimed at scaling our growth platform and services to maximize User Acquisition, Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) and user lifetime value while maintaining engineering standards and excellence.

What You'll Do

Essential Job Duties & Functions

Strategic Engineering Leadership

Define and articulate a multi-year Growth Engineering Strategy aligned with corporate goals such as new market entry and feature expansion.
Facilitate long-term engineering strategies in partnership with the Product organization.
Collaborate with Marketing to develop and optimize the marketing technology stack strategy.
Champion an innovation-led culture focused on A/B testing infrastructure and rapid experimentation to optimize the conversion funnel.

Technical Oversight & Architecture

Oversee the design and evolution of highly available, secure growth foundational systems
Push for more scalable and maintainable future systems within the Growth teams and establish technical standards.
Drive the development of personalization engineering, including User Personalization systems.
Bridge the gap between Growth data and Data Engineering/BI to improve data warehousing and business metric reporting.
Own the SDLC and enable and execute on solid foundations for operational excellence.

Team Management & Development

Lead and evolve a team of Engineering Managers and Software Engineers across multiple platforms: backend, mobile, and Web.
Mentor and coach technical leaders while driving hiring, performance reviews, and career progression plans.
Educate the team on growth strategies and building future-proof technical solutions.
Refine the Growth-domain career ladder to ensure alignment with broader engineering leveling.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner closely with User Acquisition (UA) and Marketing Automation (MA) teams to align engineering deliverables with campaign goals.
Coordinate with Data Engineering and Business Intelligence to ensure accurate measurements of growth funnel events to downstream reporting and analysis.
Partner with vertical Product and Engineering leads to ensure horizontal Growth initiatives integrate seamlessly with the overall product roadmap.

What You’ll Bring

Proven experience at least 4+ years in technical leadership across growth teams, specifically within mobile and web environments.
Strong background in technical solutions involving marketing, product, and engineering teams.
Track record instituting sound SDLC practices (testing, code review, incident response, observability) in high-velocity environment, can balance speed with system quality
Expertise in managing complex subscription lifecycles and payment integration systems.
Ability to act as a multiplier for teams, proactively identifying and owning areas of improvement.
Deep understanding of experimentation methodologies, including A/B testing and instrumentation.
A strong curiosity for exploring new technologies, including AI
A shared passion for and ability to demonstrate onX’s Company Values.
Permanent US work authorization is a condition of employment with onX.
Ability to travel quarterly for multiple days to a corporate office or other onX strategic location, such as a Basecamp.

ADDED BONUSES

Though not required, we would be thrilled to consider candidates with any of the following:

Experience working and integrating with user attribution and marketing automation technologies
Experience with analytics technology that tracks and reports website and app traffic, user behavior, and visitor data
Experience with reporting tools like Tableau, Looker, etc.

The Onx Experience

onX is a distributed company with more than 400 employees across the country. We come together regularly to work in person and stay connected through regional basecamps and a culture that balances individual ownership with deep collaboration.

While we move quickly, we’re not a scrappy start-up. We operate with clear goals, structure, and frameworks that guide how we prioritize and execute. Priorities matter. While they may shift, data shapes how we evolve as our business, products, and the world around us change.

Clear priorities and structure don’t limit ownership - they make it possible. You’ll have the autonomy to define your work and make meaningful decisions within clear strategic boundaries. You’ll partner closely with others to solve complex problems and build solutions that scale across teams and platforms. Along the way, you’ll be supported with feedback, tools, and opportunities to grow your craft as you take on new challenges.

WHERE YOU CAN WORK

onX has created a thriving distributed workforce designed to foster connection, collaboration, and shared experience across several US locations. We have two HQ locations in Bozeman and Missoula, MT and established virtual workforce Basecamps in Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Kalispell, MT; Minneapolis, MN; Portland, OR; Salt Lake City, UT; and Seattle, WA.

How You’ll Be Compensated

onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. For this position, applicants can expect to make between $200,000 and $249,000 upon hire. The pay range will vary based upon experience, skills, certifications, education, among other factors as required in the job description. In addition, full-time onX employees are eligible for a grant of common share options with a vesting schedule and an annual bonus of 10% based on company performance.

What We’re Offering You

Competitive salaries, annual bonuses, equity, and opportunities for growth
Comprehensive health benefits, including a no-monthly-cost medical plan
Paid parental leave of 13 weeks for birthing parents and 5 weeks for non-birthing parents
401k matching at 100% for the first 3% you save and 50% from 3-5%
Company-wide outdoor adventures and amazing outdoor industry perks
Annual “Get Out, Get Active” funds to fuel your active lifestyle
Flexible time away package that includes PTO, STO, VTO, and paid holidays

Performance Essentials

In this role, success is driven by cognitive abilities such as concentration and problem-solving, essential for our computer-centric tasks. onX will explore reasonable accommodations to ensure that individuals with diverse abilities can fully engage in and contribute to the essential physical and mental functions of the job. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact us at PC@onxmaps.com.

Position open until filled.

At onX, we believe that unique perspectives make us stronger.
By bringing together people with different experiences, ideas, and viewpoints, we fuel innovation and move closer to our mission of awakening the adventurer in everyone. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fairness not only in hiring, but also in development, compensation, and promotion. Our goal is to build an inclusive community where every team member can show up authentically and thrive. Together, we win as one team. Come join us!

Drive resource planning, prioritization, and organizational design to support product and technology goals.

Lead escalation resolution for critical product and customer issues. Interface with internal and external stakeholders to resolve complex engineering issues and meet customer commitments.

Hanna Andersson is a Portland, Oregon-based premier kids and baby clothing brand . Our clothes are made to play, made to last, and designed to let kids be kids
. We have core commitments to design, quality, and sustainability,
and we believe in helping families create meaningful everyday moments.

We cultivate our unique brand by hiring team members who believe in these values, own a customer service mindset, and who are innovative, results-oriented, and comfortable working in a collaborative and growth-driven work environment. We all share in our brand’s success, and we actively encourage our team members to maintain a healthy balance in their daily lives.

Position Summary

The Director of Ecommerce Engineering is a technology leader responsible for delivering secure, scalable, reliable, and high-performing digital commerce solutions that enable exceptional customer experiences and support Hanna Andersson's long-term growth.

Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, this role leads the ecommerce engineering organization through people leadership, technical stewardship, operational excellence, and cross-functional partnership. The Director is accountable for building high-performing engineering teams, delivering strategic initiatives, modernizing the commerce platform, and ensuring technology investments align with business objectives.

The Director will lead the evolution of Hanna's commerce ecosystem - including Salesforce Commerce Cloud, headless commerce, payment platforms, customer data capabilities and CRM, AI-enabled engineering practices, OMS, product information mangement, POS, and future omnichannel initiatives - while driving continuous improvement in engineering quality, delivery, reliability, and operational efficiency.

This is a full-time, exempt position. The role may be remote or hybrid based on business needs and requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams. The Director is expected to support critical production events, peak business periods, and high-priority initiatives while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence.

What You'll Do

Engineering Leadership & Organizational Health

Build, lead, coach, and retain a high-performing engineering organization of 1-4 scrum teams, through hiring, mentoring, performance management, career development, and contracting.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, quality of craft, continuous learning, and operational excellence.
Establish clear expectations, monitor organizational health, and ensure the team has the skills, capacity, and engagement necessary to meet business objectives.
Work closely with other IT leaders across Infrastructure, Data, Technical, Operations and Infosec to ensure platforms, integrations, and services meet enterprise standards for security, reliability, scalability, performance, and operational excellence.

Delivery Execution & Engineering Operations

Own delivery of the ecommerce engineering roadmap, ensuring predictable execution of strategic initiatives, releases, operational priorities, and production support.
Manage priorities, dependencies, risks, resourcing, and release readiness while improving delivery quality, transparency, and predictability.
Continuously improve engineering operating practices, including Agile delivery, SDLC, QA, DevOps, CI/CD, release management, incident response, and operational support.
Establish and monitor KPIs to assess team and stack performance and use data-driven insights to inform decisions.

Technical Leadership & Platform Stewardship

Provide technical leadership across ecommerce applications, integrations, architecture, and platform modernization initiatives.
Establish engineering standards that promote scalability, maintainability, extendability and performance.
Work with cross functional teams to build in security, accessibility, and reliability, and long-term platform health.
Champion the long-term health of Hanna’s ecommerce technology ecosystem by establishing technical direction, architecture, and governance that enable efficient sustainable growth and operational excellence.
Lead modernization of Hanna's commerce ecosystem, including Salesforce Commerce Cloud, composable commerce, APIs, integrations, cloud services, and supporting technologies.

Platform Reliability & Customer Experience

Ensure the availability, scalability, security, and performance of customer-facing ecommerce platforms.
Proactively prepare systems for seasonal peaks, product launches, and other high-volume events while minimizing operational risk and customer impact.

Why Join Subway?

At Subway, we are not standing still. We are building.

This is a business focused on what matters most: growing franchisee profitability, strengthening our brand and creating long-term value. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to make a real impact.

You will not just do the work. You will shape it.

We take the work seriously, but we also know the best results come from teams that support each other, celebrate wins and show up ready to build something better every day.

This is your chance to be part of what’s next.

Position Overview

The Director, Guest Engineering is the single technical and organizational leader for Subway's full guest-facing digital stack — mobile (iOS, Android), web, kiosk, and the middleware/API platform layer that powers ordering, loyalty, identity, and guest data across every channel. Reporting to the VP of Guest Engineering, this Director owns end-to-end delivery across a full-stack, pod-based engineering organization spanning four cross-functional pods, each combining mobile, web, and middleware engineers under a single roadmap. This is a new role requiring a deeply technical leader who can set architectural direction across front-end and back-end domains, build and retain a high-performing multi-disciplinary organization of 20+ engineers, and operate with significant autonomy in a complex, high-stakes consumer digital environment — with a genuine commitment to AI-assisted development practices.

Responsibilities

jobs.description:
About Coinflow

Coinflow is the next-generation payment service provider revolutionizing global financial infrastructure with stablecoins, AI-driven fraud prevention, and instant settlement. Coinflow enables businesses to grow faster with instant settlement, fraud & chargeback indemnity, global pay-ins, multi-currency FX, and unified payouts. Founded in 2023, the company serves marketplaces, fintechs, remittance providers, gaming platforms, and ecommerce merchants worldwide.

Since our seed round in 2024, we’ve achieved 23x revenue growth and scaled to multi-billion-dollar annual transaction volume. In response to this growth, Coinflow announced a $25M Series A in October 2025—led by Pantera Capital, CMT Digital, Coinbase Ventures, Jump Crypto, and Reciprocal Ventures—accelerating our mission to power the world’s fastest-moving businesses with innovative, reliable global payments.

Coinflow is proudly headquartered in Chicago, IL. Learn more at coinflow.cash.

Role Overview

Coinflow is seeking a Head of Engineering to lead our engineering team and take ownership of day-to-day engineering, including prioritization, delivery, technical direction, and team health, that currently runs through the CTO. Coinflow is white-label payments infrastructure: card acquiring, payin/payout across numerous methods, hosted and embedded checkout, and merchant onboarding, operating in a heavily regulated environment where the bar for correctness, security, and reliability is high and non-negotiable.

This is a player-coach role, not a hands-off management job. You'll be in the codebase shipping real work on critical payment paths while building and leading the team. You own the team's deliverables — when something is late, broken, or unclear, it's yours to drive to done.

The first 6-12 months:
this role is built around a handoff. Early on, you'll work closely with the CTO and ship alongside the team to earn context and trust. As you prove out judgment and delivery, more of the day-to-day — planning, technical decisions, team ownership — shifts to you. Success looks like the team running confidently under you while the CTO steps back from operational engineering.

Key Responsibilities

In the trenches (player)

Write, review, and ship production code on critical payment paths — you stay hands-on
Debug the hard stuff: production incidents, reliability gaps, performance and correctness issues
Set the technical direction and make the architecture calls that matter
Raise the engineering bar through code review, standards, and example

Leading the team (coach)

Own delivery — break work down, sequence it, and make sure it lands
Mentor every engineer on the team, from senior to junior, leveling people up rather than just directing them
Manage and grow the engineers: 1:1s, feedback, performance, hiring, and the occasional hard conversation
Own the process — clear requirements before work hits engineering, real ownership per project (DRI), and a feedback loop that catches problems early
Be the point of accountability for the team's output to the founders
Report to the CTO on personnel matters — performance, team health, and people decisions run through you and surface to the CTO directly

Required Qualifications

Senior engineering leader who is still a strong, current IC — able to hold your own in the codebase, not just review it
Track record owning delivery for a team: shipping real product, on a real cadence, with real accountability
Experience building process without bureaucracy — you know the difference between rigor and overhead
Comfortable in our stack: TypeScript/Node (Express, React), MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis/queues
High bar for reliability, security, and correctness — you've operated where mistakes cost money
Direct communicator — you write things down and don't hide bad news

Preferred Qualifications

Payments experience (acquiring, card networks, ACH, chargebacks, PCI)
Stablecoin or blockchain infrastructure experience (Solana programs, EVM smart contracts, on-chain settlement)
Experience working in a regulated, compliance-forward environment
Early-stage startup experience

What we offer

Competitive compensation including base salary, performance bonus, and meaningful ownership
Opportunity to own engineering delivery and team leadership at a rapidly scaling fintech company
Collaborative and innovative work environment with world-class investors
Direct impact on core product and company trajectory during a hyper growth phase

The base salary range for this role is $220,000 - $275,000 USD. The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including but not limited to experience, education, skills, qualifications and business needs.

In addition, the employee who fills this role will be eligible for an equity grant, allowing you to share in the long-term success of the company. You will also have access to a wide array of benefits, including health and wellness benefits, 401(k) savings plan, and flexible time off.

Join the team rewriting how money moves worldwide—and become a driving force in the $194 trillion cross-border payments market.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering - Robotics Manipulation
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is the engine of modern AI, and robotics is where AI meets the physical world. The Isaac robotics platform — spanning Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, Isaac ROS, the foundation models behind Isaac GR00T, and the accelerated libraries that run on Jetson and in the data center — is how the world’s developers and industrial leaders build intelligent robots.

We are looking for an exceptional engineering leader and manager to head up Isaac for Manipulation: giving robotic arms and dexterous systems the perception, grasping, motion, and learned skills they need to do real, impactful work. You will be responsible for the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Manipulation — turning hard, contact-rich problems in manufacturing, logistics, and industrial automation into shipping capabilities that our partners and developers can build on. This is a high-visibility role with direct line of sight to the most consequential problems in robotics today. You will grow and mentor a team of world-class robotics and machine-learning engineers, set a bold technical direction, and partner deeply with the robot-arm and industrial-automation ecosystem to make NVIDIA the default platform for robotic manipulation.

What You’ll Be Doing

Lead the Isaac Manipulation team. Recruit, grow, and mentor a high-performing team of robotics software engineers; set direction, raise the technical bar, and manage the team’s health, velocity, and delivery.
Shape the roadmap. Collaborate with Product Management to define and drive the strategy and roadmap for grasping, motion planning and control, perception-for-manipulation, and learned manipulation policies — from research to productized, supported platform capabilities.
Apply creative solutions to real industrial problems. Translate the hardest contact-rich manipulation tasks in manufacturing, logistics, assembly, and machine tending into robust capabilities that work in the real world, not just the lab.
Bridge research and product. Partner with NVIDIA Research, the Isaac Sim/Lab teams, and foundation-model teams (e.g., Isaac GR00T, Cosmos) to bring sim-to-real, imitation, and reinforcement learning approaches into the platform and onto physical arms.
Engage partners and developers. Serve as a technical face of Isaac Manipulation to robot-arm OEMs, system integrators, and the developer community — gathering requirements, running joint engineering, and ensuring our APIs and tools meet real workflows. Support our ecosystem of developers through responsible migration handling of their solutions built on our durable platform.
Leverage accelerated compute. Drive architecture and execution that fully uses NVIDIA GPUs, CUDA, and the accelerated-computing stack across simulation, training, and on-robot inference on Jetson and edge platforms.
Deliver. Drive planning and execution of complex, multi-functional programs; own quality, performance, and the real-world deployment of learned policies and manipulation stacks on physical robots.
Influence the strategy. Represent manipulation in platform-level technical and business decisions, and help shape where NVIDIA invests across the robotics stack.

What We Need To See

BS, MS, or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
12+ total years of relevant industry experience building robotics or robotics-adjacent systems, including 3+ years leading, mentoring, and managing engineering teams.
Robotic arm depth. Hands-on expertise with robotic arms, manipulation, and physics from grasping, motion planning (across both numerical optimization and sampling-based approaches), and control (including force/impedance and contact-rich control) to perception-guided manipulation.
Accelerated compute. Working understanding of GPU-accelerated computing and modern ML infrastructure, and how to architect robotics software to take advantage of it (CUDA, PyTorch, GPU-accelerated simulation, edge inference).
Partner and developer interface. Demonstrated ability to work directly with external partners, customers, and developer communities and to translate their needs into roadmap and shipping product.
Technical credibility. Strong software engineering fundamentals (modern C++ and Python) and the ability to engage substantively in technical and architectural decisions with your team.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Industry leadership and fluency. Experience building manipulation or industrial automation products at an established robot-arm company or manipulation startup, and a strong understanding of the product landscape including use cases, the integrators, and the platforms from leading vendors.
Hardware-agnostic platforms. A track record building developer-facing or low-code platforms and tooling that abstract across multiple robot-arm brands and make manipulation accessible to non-experts.
Learned manipulation. Deep experience with imitation learning, reinforcement learning, sim-to-real transfer, or manipulation foundation models, and shipping learned policies onto real hardware.
Ecosystem & OSS. Contributions to ROS 2, ros2_control, MoveIt, or the broader robotics open-source and standards community.
Founder / 0-to-1 instincts. Experience starting or scaling a product or team from the ground up and operating with speed in ambiguous, fast-pace problem spaces.

Manipulation is one of the defining unsolved problems in robotics, and NVIDIA is uniquely positioned — across simulation, foundation models, and accelerated compute — to solve it at platform scale. You’ll lead a team that the entire robotics industry builds on, and your work will show up on factory floors and in warehouses around the world!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 272,000 USD - 431,250 USD for Level 4, and 320,000 USD - 488,750 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

About Us

Graphcore is a globally recognised leader in Artificial Intelligence computing systems. The company designs advanced semiconductors and data centre hardware that provide the specialised processing power needed to drive AI innovation, while delivering the efficiency required to support its broader adoption. 

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. We are opening a new AI Engineering Campus in Austin, which will play a central role in Graphcore's work building the future of AI computing.

Job Overview

Graphcore is seeking a Principal Engineer, Power Engineering to aid in defining the architecture of the power delivery components from grid to chip. You will work closely with multiple cross-functional teams, including hardware engineers, firmware developers, and data center operations, to ensure the infrastructure we build meets customer requirements as well as attaining standards of performance, reliability, and scalability.

This role will be based in Austin or San Jose and could potentially be performed onsite or remotely within the US.

Responsibilities

Provide thought leadership, planning, and design for power delivery from data center power drop through delivery to systems & chips
Establish power roadmap. Work with vendors to ensure their planned future technologies are pulled into our system engineering roadmap AND ensure that our (system engineering) required technological innovation is being driven into their (power vendor) roadmap. Work to improve reliability and efficiency of power engineering component over time.
Rack-level power components. Competency with specification of hardware and firmware for rack-level power shelves. Competency with design for resiliency.
Set power policies in the data center for: power buffer/oversubscription, scheduling of jobs based on power, and monitoring (power quality faults) / accommodation faults. Resolve telemetry and data needed to support power policy algorithms.
Ensure robustness of IT power in the presence of grid disturbances and make sure that IT power loads are compatible with grid power requirements (“good grid power citizen”)
Board and system-level power regulation components. Understand and able to apply current VRM, TLDR, and POL technologies. Help to develop new technologies to increase efficiency. Understand manufacturing capabilities and limitations of new technology. Drive
Provide guidance to the power equipment manufacturers, ODM and engineering teams on the required testing and validation procedures for power hardware and firmware components.
Develop and test hardware prototypes as needed to support the exploration and validation of new concepts in power delivery.
Tackle and resolve sophisticated power hardware and firmware issues as needed.
Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations.

Required Skills And Experience

Bachelor’s or Master’s or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering with a specialized knowledge of Power Engineering.
demonstrated ability in power system and delivery architecture, design, and development.
Experience with rack-level hardware design, including servers, storage, networking, and power distribution.
Proficiency in power hardware and firmware development and debugging.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
Strong communication and teamwork skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, multifaceted environment.

"Nice to Have" Skills and Experience:

Familiarity with new technologies in AI and data center infrastructure.
Comfortable meeting with and engaging directly with customers (internal and external) during requirements gathering and solution development

jobs.description:
Description

The Manager, SRE & Cloud Engineering manages Cloud Engineering and Site Reliability Engineering teams responsible for cloud infrastructure, service reliability, automation, observability and operational excellence to support the delivery of highly available business-critical applications.

Here’s what you can expect from the job and what you need to be successful:

Essential Functions

What You’ll Do :

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Lead and develop engineering staff setting clear performance expectations, supporting professional growth, and fostering a high-performance, accountable culture.
Responsible for day-to-day operations and technical escalations for Cloud Engineering & Architecture, and Site Reliability Engineering staff and processes.
Work collaboratively with Incident Management teams and leadership to build observability dashboards to monitor environmental and applications.
Execute on the agreed upon direction for cloud engineering and architecture by designing and managing scalable infrastructure across public cloud, driving IaC adoption, CI/CD (Azure/AWS)and automation best practices.
Build and mature SRE practices across the organization, including defining and enforcing SLOs/SLIs, establishing observability (metrics, logs, tracing), automating incident response and runbooks, and reducing operational toil through tooling and process automation.
Drive transparencies into environment variables assisting a metrics-centric operating model providing executive visibility into system reliability, incident trends, infrastructure health, and team performance.
Partner with information security to ensure cloud environments meet security, risk, and compliance requirements, implement guardrails, enforce policies, and maintain audit readiness.

Role Specific Responsibilities

Hire, mentor, and develop a team of Site Reliability and Cloud Engineers, providing regular feedback and career growth guidance
Define and track key reliability metrics (SLIs, SLOs, error budgets) across services owned by the team
Partner with engineering leadership to influence system design decisions for scalability, resilience, and observability
Manage day-to-day workload and priorities for a team of SRE and cloud engineers

Typical Scope

Possesses expert-level understanding of their functional area and competent knowledge of the broader organization and competitive environment.
Manages staff. Develop staff for both current and long-term departmental needs. Build tactical relationships across the organization to drive process improvements.

Essential Skills

Education & Experience:

Required Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or 4 additional years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree).
Required Experience: 5+ years of progressive experience in technology operations, infrastructure engineering, cloud architecture, or site reliability engineering, with 3+ years in a people leadership role managing managers.

Qualifications & Skills

Proven track record of leading and scaling high-performing engineering teams across distributed locations. Strong focus on accountability and transparency.
Deep expertise in cloud platforms and modern infrastructure practices including IaC, containerization, and CI/CD pipelines.
Strong understanding of SRE principles, observability tooling, and incident management platforms.
Strong communication skills. Able to translate complex technical topics into clear, business-aligned strategies.
Track record of driving operational efficiency through automation, process improvement, and metrics-driven decision making.
Cloud architecture or ITIL certifications a plus.

Marlboro or Chelmsford, MA

Target Compensation

Schedule

Monday - Friday 8am - 5pm

jobs.title: VP, Sales Engineering
jobs.description:
Brightcore Energy provides end-to-end energy efficiency and clean energy measures to commercial, industrial, and institutional clients. We have the intellectual and financial capital to develop, implement, fund, operate, and maintain clean energy solutions. Our diverse solutions range from lighting, controls, geothermal heating and cooling, and other energy efficiency measures to renewable energy solutions such as solar and battery storage. We are about Building Energy Performance.
Summary/Primary Role:

The Vice President of Sales Engineering will lead the technical and commercial sales engineering strategy for Brightcore’s commercial HVAC and energy-efficiency solutions. This individual will serve as the critical link between Brightcore’s Business Development leaders, mechanical engineering partners, HVAC manufacturers, contractors, and customers. The ideal candidate combines deep technical HVAC expertise with a demonstrated ability to develop relationships, achieve significant revenue goals, and close complex opportunities. This leader must be credible in discussions with mechanical engineers and capable of advancing opportunities from initial customer engagement through contract execution. The Vice President of Sales Engineering will initially supplement and support Brightcore’s Vice Presidents of Business Development while helping strengthen and expand the company’s HVAC sales capabilities.
Principal Duties & Responsibilities:

(Management may amend or assign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time)

Lead Brightcore’s sales engineering strategy for commercial HVAC, mechanical systems, and energy-efficiency solutions.
Partner with Vice Presidents of Business Development to identify, develop, and close complex HVAC opportunities.
Serve as Brightcore’s senior technical sales authority during customer meetings, engineering discussions, presentations, and contract negotiations.
Maintain ownership and momentum throughout the sales lifecycle, ensuring opportunities progress from initial engagement through contract execution.
Engage confidently with mechanical engineers, consulting firms, building owners, developers, contractors, manufacturers, and other technical stakeholders.
Evaluate customer needs and recommend appropriate HVAC equipment, system configurations, and energy-efficient solutions.
Lead the development of technical and commercial proposals that communicate system performance, financial value, operational benefits, and Brightcore’s competitive advantages.
Establish and maintain strategic relationships with HVAC manufacturers, manufacturer representatives, engineering firms, contractors, and key industry partners.
Leverage industry relationships and market knowledge to identify new customers, partnerships, and revenue opportunities.
Lead technical presentations, system-selection discussions, proposal reviews, and customer negotiations.
Collaborate with Engineering, Estimating, Operations, and Project Management to ensure proposed solutions are technically sound, financially viable, and executable.
Oversee the transition of signed opportunities from the sales process to project execution.
Gather market intelligence and customer feedback to inform Brightcore’s commercial HVAC growth strategy.
Represent Brightcore at customer meetings, industry events, manufacturer trainings, and professional networking opportunities.
Help develop the structure, processes, and long-term capabilities of Brightcore’s sales engineering function.
Provide executive-level leadership and technical direction for commercial HVAC sales opportunities.
Establish sales engineering standards, processes, performance expectations, and revenue goals.
All other duties and projects as assigned.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, engineering technology, business, or a related field preferred.
Minimum of 10 years of commercial HVAC sales, sales engineering, applications engineering, or business-development experience.
Leadership experience within a major HVAC equipment manufacturer, manufacturer’s representative, or comparable commercial HVAC organization strongly preferred.
Demonstrated success developing and closing complex, high-value commercial HVAC opportunities.
Advanced technical knowledge of commercial HVAC equipment, mechanical systems, system design, and energy-efficient applications.
Ability to communicate confidently and credibly with mechanical engineers and other highly technical stakeholders.
Established relationships within the HVAC manufacturing, engineering, construction, and building-owner communities strongly preferred.
Experience with manufacturers such as Trane, Carrier, Bosch, WaterFurnace, Marley Company, or similar organizations is highly desirable.
Exceptional leadership, presentation, negotiation, relationship-management, and closing skills.
Ability to translate technical HVAC concepts into clear commercial and financial value propositions.
Strong strategic judgment with the ability to remain closely involved in day-to-day sales execution.
Proficiency with CRM platforms and Microsoft Office applications.
Ability to travel to customer sites, meetings, and industry events as required.

Supervisory Responsibility: 

This position may have supervisory responsibility.

Expected Hours of Work & Compensation: 

An employee is expected to work a minimum of forty (40) hours per week. Non-exempt employees are eligible for overtime pay in accordance with applicable wage and hour laws, while exempt employees may be required to work additional hours as necessary to fulfill their job responsibilities. Overtime requirements will be determined based on the operational needs of the organization. The salary range and/or hourly rate listed is a good faith determination of potential base compensation that may be offered to a successful applicant for this position at the time of this job advertisement and may be modified in the future. When determining an employee’s base salary and/or rate, several factors may be considered as applicable (e.g., location, specialty, years of relevant experience, education, credentials, and internal equity). Brightcore also offers a comprehensive set of benefits to complement the base salary. The base annual salary range for this position is $180,000-$200,000 and is eligible for an annual performance-based bonus.
Travel Requirements:  

Travel may be required up to 50% to office/work/project sites in the greater Northeast Region and/or East Coast (but not limited to) of the United States.
Office presence required at least three (3) days per week, unless otherwise agreed upon with final approval by direct supervisor.

Work Environment:

Office setting.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
This is not a safety sensitive position.

Drug & Alcohol-Free Workplace:

Brightcore Energy is committed to a safe workplace free of drugs and alcohol. All Brightcore Energy positions require a pre-employment background check that includes prior employment verifications, a criminal history check, and a pre-employment drug screen.
In accordance with DOT regulations (49 CFR § 40.25), Brightcore Energy is required to obtain prior drug and alcohol testing records for applicants/employees intending to perform safety-sensitive duties for covered Department of Transportation positions. If an applicant/employee refuses to provide written consent for Brightcore Energy to obtain these records, the individual will not be permitted to perform safety-sensitive functions.
Office/Remote/Field Work:

We offer a variety of structured work arrangements, including remote, hybrid, and field-based assignments, aligned with organizational needs and role-specific requirements. Work arrangements are role-dependent, with guidelines established based on position requirements and business needs. This policy is subject to change at Brightcore's discretion.
Brightcore Health Benefits Overview:

Brightcore offers a full slate of medical, dental, and vision benefits including options to enroll in a Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and a Health Savings Account (HSA).
401k Plan:

Brightcore currently offers both traditional and Roth 401k plans with a dollar-for-dollar match of up to 3% of contributions and $0.50 on the next 2% for a total potential match of 4% annually.

EAP - Employee Assistance Program

Job Description

University of Missouri Academic Technology is seeking a Senior Director of Academic Technology (AT) and Design Services (DS) to provide bold, visionary leadership for our system-wide academic technology ecosystem and online design and media services for the Columbia campus. This leader excels at building relationships with academic leaders and can execute by translating vision into action—establishing governance, optimizing resources, and leveraging data to continuously understand impact. Within this role exists the exciting opportunity to shape how design and technology come together to support faculty and drive student success at scale.

Reporting to the Chief Online Learning Officer, this role partners with faculty, academic leadership, and IT to bring a shared vision for digitally enabled learning to life. The Senior Director will set strategy, lead high-performing teams, and maintain an active portfolio of support services and tools that promote faculty excellence and high quality student experiences.

The Senior Director of Academic Technology and Design Services will be required to attend retreats and other on-site events or meetings as business needs dictate. This is a remote opportunity with an estimated requirement for travel for 5-10%.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the development and execution of a unified academic technology strategy across the UM system, ensuring alignment with institutional goals for teaching, learning, research, access, and

student success.

Oversee the implementation and continuous improvement of learning management systems, instructional technologies, and digital learning platforms. Partner with academic affairs, faculty leadership, and instructional design teams to advance innovative (e.g., AI integration), evidence-based teaching practices that enhance learner engagement, equity, and outcomes across modalities.

Serve as a strategic partner to academic leadership, IT, libraries, accessibility services, and campus stakeholders to drive adoption and effective use of academic technologies.

Lead the strategic vision, development, and drive the implementation of online learning experiences, overseeing the function of instructional and media design for online courses and programs.

advancing strategic priorities and fostering a culture of trust, engagement, and shared contribution that values different perspectives.

Ability to successfully navigate higher education governance, shared decision-making models, and the intersection of academic affairs, academic technologies and student success.

Understanding of data governance, privacy, and security principles as they relate to academic systems and student data.

Embody and model Mizzou Online/UMAT Values of Be a Collaborator, Be a Champion, Be Curious, Be Transparent and Be Invested.

Exceptional ability to convey and receive information clearly, both verbally and in writing.

Excellent ability to problem-solve and make decisions.

Excellent critical thinker: Ability to analyze information objectively, evaluate evidence, and draw well-reasoned conclusions.

Ph.D. in education technology, instructional design, higher education administration or related field.
Previous success leading large-scale academic technology ecosystems and online learning design functions in a research university or system-level environment.
4+ years senior leadership experience in an R1 university
Demonstrated knowledge of artificial intelligence applications in higher education and the ability to develop and lead institution wide AI strategy, policies, and governance frameworks aligned with institutional priorities.
Experience managing large vendor relationships and enterprise-wide contracts.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Product and Technology Partnerships
jobs.description:
Job Description

About Semarchy

Semarchy was founded in 2011 in Lyon, France, by a team of passionate data experts with a clear mission: modernizing master data management. Over the years, we’ve expanded our capabilities into Data Management, Integration, and Intelligence, building a unified design experience that accelerates revenue growth, modernizes workflows, and boosts enterprise AI initiatives.
Headquartered in Arizona, USA, with global offices across France, the UK, and India, Semarchy serves over 400 clients worldwide, including Fortune 500 leaders. Trusted by industry innovators, our adaptive, modular approach helps organizations achieve data-driven success in as fast as 12 weeks.
About the Role

Semarchy’s Snowflake Native App achieved proven product-market fit in Year One of the partnership, with multiple enterprise wins already on the books. Rapid growth in pipeline, awareness, and interest — combined with the joint Semarchy/Snowflake roadmap — is creating a major scaling opportunity for 2026 and beyond.
The Sr. Director, Product and Technology Partnerships is a unique hybrid leadership role that sits at the intersection of product and partnerships. You will own two tightly connected missions: driving deep technical and product alignment with our strategic technology partners — initially with Snowflake and Microsoft — and driving product management for Semarchy’s Snowflake-native solutions so that our roadmap and our partners’ platforms advance together as one strategy.
This role is strictly focused on technical alignment with partners — product roadmaps, platform capabilities, integrations, and joint solution architecture — not on commercial or sales plays, which are owned by our alliance and sales teams. That said, you must bring strong commercial savvy: an understanding of go-to-market practices and the ability to work effectively with product, product marketing, marketing, and sales so that technical alignment translates into market impact.
You will report to the Chief Product Officer, with a dotted-line relationship to the Head of Product Management (based in France) for your product management responsibilities. Snowflake is our most mature partnership and the immediate priority, with Microsoft — where our technology works with Microsoft Fabric and Purview — as the second strategic focus. Beyond these, this role owns Semarchy’s broader technology partnership strategy and will explore potential technical alignment with other technology vendors across the data and AI ecosystem.
This is a senior individual contributor role to start, with the opportunity to build and lead a team as the partnership portfolio scales. It is built for someone with high agency: a builder who creates structure, drives follow-through, and earns the trust of partner product and engineering organizations.
Location:
USA, remote, in the Central or Eastern time zone. You will collaborate daily with our product and engineering teams in France and coordinate regularly with technology partners primarily based in the western USA, so working hours that bridge both are essential.
Job Requirements

Must Have
10+ years in enterprise software, including 5+ years in technical partnerships, partner engineering, solutions leadership, or product management roles within cloud ecosystems.
Proven success driving technical and product alignment with one or more of: Snowflake, Microsoft/Azure, or other major cloud data platforms.
Hands-on product management experience: gathering requirements, writing specifications, managing a backlog, and partnering with engineering to ship.
Deep working knowledge of the modern data stack (cloud data platforms, data management, integration, or analytics).
Commercial savvy: a strong understanding of go-to-market practices and the ability to work effectively with product, product marketing, marketing, and sales teams.
Comfortable operating across technology, product, and executive relationships, including with senior partner product and engineering leaders.
Strong program management skills and high agency — driven to get things done; elite communication and soft skills, including the ability to translate technical depth for commercial audiences.
Based in the US Central or Eastern time zone, with the flexibility to overlap with teams in France (mornings) and partners on the US West Coast (afternoons); willingness to travel (~25%) for partner meetings, customer engagements, and industry events.

Nice to Have
Direct experience with Snowflake Native Apps, Snowpark, or building solutions on the Snowflake Marketplace.
Experience with the Microsoft Partner ecosystem and marketplaces.
Domain expertise in master data management (MDM), data integration, data products, semantic intelligence.
Experience working in a globally distributed organization across US and European time zones; French language skills are a plus.
Experience building and leading partner engineering or product teams.

Job Responsibilities

Technology Partnership Strategy & Technical Alignment (initially with Snowflake and Microsoft)
Define and own Semarchy’s technology partnership strategy, exploring and prioritizing potential technical alignment with other technology vendors across the data and AI ecosystem.
Own the technical relationship with our strategic technology partners: lead roadmap discussions, technical alignment, and advanced configuration conversations with partner product and engineering counterparts.
Ensure Semarchy capitalizes early on new Snowflake platform capabilities, and that our Native App strategy stays ahead of the Snowflake roadmap.
Deepen technical alignment with Microsoft — where Semarchy’s technology works with Microsoft Fabric and Purview — including integration architecture, platform certifications, and marketplace technical requirements.
Build relationships with partner engineering, partner technical, and ISV teams to establish Semarchy’s technical credibility on each platform.
Establish and maintain joint technical escalation paths with Support and Professional Services for pre/post-sales support and joint problem resolution.
Serve as the technical voice of the partnerships in reviews with Semarchy leadership.
Establish the repeatable playbook — technical evaluation, product integration, roadmap alignment — that future technology partnerships will follow.
As the portfolio scales, help define the team needed to support it, with the opportunity to hire and lead.

Product Management
Drive product management for Semarchy’s partner-aligned solutions — expanding our Snowflake-aligned capabilities and our alignment with Microsoft Fabric — working day-to-day with the Head of Product Management and engineering teams in France.
Gather and synthesize requirements from customers, partners, partner field teams, analysts, and competitive intelligence into a prioritized roadmap for the Snowflake Native App and related capabilities.
Produce specifications, refine and organize the product backlog, and partner with engineering to deliver high-value features and product iterations.
Champion the solutions internally and externally — with customers, partners, analysts, and field teams — and feed their input back into product strategy and positioning.

Cross-Functional & GTM Collaboration
Work closely with product marketing and marketing to ensure positioning, launch content, and partner-facing assets accurately reflect joint technical capabilities.
Support sales and alliance teams as the technical authority on partner platforms — helping them understand what is possible, what is roadmapped, and how joint solutions are architected.
Partner with enablement teams to develop technically accurate training, demos, and assets for internal teams and partner field organizations.
Ensure Snowflake, Microsoft, and Semarchy owners are connected across Product Management, Support, and Professional Services, and keep Product, GTM, and Operations working against one shared partner plan.

What Success Looks Like
Snowflake and Microsoft product and engineering teams know exactly who owns the technical relationship with Semarchy.
The Snowflake solutions roadmap is visibly shaped by partner and customer input, and product releases land in sync with partner platform milestones and joint GTM motions.
Sales, marketing, and alliance teams have a trusted technical authority on partner platforms — joint solutions are well-architected and well-understood.
Product, GTM, and Operations work against one shared partner plan.

Job Benefits

We are committed to making Semarchy an even better place to work, and this means creating a high performing environment where everyone can do their Best Work, where they can Grow in their career path, and Be Accountable – to each other and Semarchy.

jobs.title: Senior Director, PMO - Data Center Infrastructure
jobs.description:
About Nscale

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About The Role

The Senior Director, PMO - Data Center Infrastructure will lead the Program Management Office responsible for enabling predictable, coordinated, and transparent delivery across the data center infrastructure portfolio. This role serves as a critical connective function across internal teams, ensuring stakeholders are aligned on priorities, dependencies, risks, decisions, and execution plans required to deliver data center capacity successfully.

This leader will partner closely with Data Center Development, Design & Construction, Engineering, Power & Utilities, Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, Legal, Commercial, Security, Network, Operations, Project Controls, and Executive Leadership to create a single operating rhythm across complex infrastructure programs. The role is accountable for driving internal alignment, facilitating decision-making, removing blockers, and ensuring teams are coordinated from planning through operational readiness.

The ideal candidate has deep experience leading PMO or strategic program functions in data center infrastructure, cloud, AI, colocation, construction, energy, or mission-critical environments. They should be highly effective at influencing without authority, aligning senior stakeholders, translating complexity into clear decisions, and ensuring disciplined execution of established delivery, governance, and controls standards.

What You'll be Doing

Internal Stakeholder Engagement & Alignment

Act as the central coordination and alignment leader across internal teams involved in data center infrastructure delivery.
Build trusted partnerships with functional leaders across Development, Engineering, Construction, Power, Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, Legal, Network, Operations, Security, Project Controls, and Commercial teams.
Establish clear communication channels, decision forums, escalation paths, and operating rhythms to keep stakeholders aligned across the full delivery lifecycle.
Drive alignment on program priorities, delivery milestones, ownership, dependencies, risk mitigation plans, and executive decisions required to maintain momentum.
Proactively identify areas of misalignment, ambiguity, or competing priorities and facilitate resolution with the appropriate stakeholders.
Translate complex technical, commercial, operational, and financial inputs into clear, actionable plans and decision points for leadership.

PMO Leadership & Operating Model

Lead the Data Center Infrastructure PMO, including governance structure, program cadence, stakeholder engagement model, executive reporting rhythm, and delivery assurance mechanisms.
Execute established PMO and Project Controls standards across the data center infrastructure portfolio, ensuring consistent adoption by program teams.
Drive adherence to defined processes for milestone tracking, risk review, decision management, change governance, dependency management, and issue resolution.
Ensure the PMO operates as an enablement function that improves execution, transparency, and accountability across delivery teams.
Establish clear ownership models, RACI frameworks, stage gates, and handoff points across the end-to-end data center infrastructure lifecycle.

Portfolio Governance & Executive Reporting

Own portfolio-level visibility across active and planned data center infrastructure programs.
Develop executive dashboards, business reviews, steering committee materials, and leadership reporting that clearly communicate program health, risks, dependencies, decisions, and required actions.
Facilitate executive governance forums to align leadership on priorities, trade-offs, resource constraints, critical path decisions, and delivery commitments.
Track and communicate key risks, milestone status, budget exposure, delivery constraints, and decision requirements across the portfolio using established reporting standards.

Cross-Functional Delivery Coordination

Serve as the connective tissue across internal delivery teams to ensure workstreams are integrated and sequenced effectively.
Partner with functional owners to align plans across site acquisition, power availability, utility interconnection, design, permitting, procurement, construction, commissioning, network readiness, security readiness, and operational handoff.
Drive integrated planning across long-lead equipment, vendor commitments, internal approvals, commercial obligations, resource availability, and operational readiness requirements.
Facilitate working sessions, leadership reviews, and escalation meetings to ensure issues are resolved quickly and decisions are made at the right level.
Maintain clear documentation of decisions, action items, owners, timelines, and follow-through across stakeholder groups.

Team Leadership

Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing PMO team of program managers, portfolio managers, delivery managers, and program analysts.
Set clear expectations for stakeholder engagement, communication quality, program discipline, standards execution, and delivery enablement.
Coach the team on executive communication, cross-functional influence, issue resolution, and structured decision-making.
Promote a PMO culture grounded in service, accountability, transparency, and business impact.

About You

10+ years of experience in program management, PMO leadership, infrastructure delivery, data center development, construction program management, cloud infrastructure, or large-scale capital programs.
5+ years of people leadership experience, including managing senior program managers or cross-functional PMO teams.
Experience supporting large-scale data center, hyperscale, colocation, cloud, AI infrastructure, telecom, energy, or mission-critical infrastructure programs.
Demonstrated success aligning senior internal stakeholders across technical, commercial, operational, financial, legal, project controls, and executive functions.
Strong ability to influence without direct authority and drive accountability across matrixed organizations.
Experience executing established portfolio governance, program reporting, delivery assurance, risk review, dependency management, decision tracking, and change governance processes.
Proven ability to manage complex, multi-site, multi-stakeholder programs with significant capital, schedule, operational, and organizational dependencies.
Experience creating executive-level reporting, steering committee materials, decision memos, and stakeholder communications.
Strong financial and commercial acumen, including familiarity with CapEx planning, budget tracking, forecasting, procurement dependencies, and vendor-related risks.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex program information for executive audiences.
High degree of ownership, judgment, urgency, and comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-scaling environments.

Nice to Have

Experience in hyperscale data center delivery, AI infrastructure, GPU clusters, cloud regions, or high-density compute environments.
Experience with end-to-end data center lifecycle management, including site development, power, utilities, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, network, security, and operations handoff.
Familiarity with data center power infrastructure, utility interconnection, substations, generators, switchgear, cooling systems, and MEP dependencies.
Experience implementing or operating within PMO tooling such as Smartsheet, Jira, Asana, Monday.com, MS Project, Primavera P6, Power BI, Tableau, or similar systems.
Experience scaling a PMO operating model in a high-growth infrastructure organization.
PMP, PgMP, Agile, Lean Six Sigma, or similar certification preferred but not required.

Why this role matters

Nscale is scaling its data center infrastructure at pace, and this role is the operating backbone that makes it possible. The Senior Director, PMO will ensure that every internal team from Engineering to Finance to Construction is working from a shared view of priorities, dependencies, and delivery commitments. Without this function, complexity compounds and execution suffers. With it, the organization moves faster, makes smarter decisions, and delivers capacity reliably at scale.

What We Can Offer You

At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core.

Highly competitive package (base + equity) with reviews every 12 months. 🚀
Join the fastest-growing tech startup — your chance to push boundaries, collaborate with brilliant minds, and make your mark on cutting-edge AI. ✨
Expect a dynamic progression plan tailored to your ambitions. Grow by trying new things, leading, challenging the status quo, and owning your impact, always with our full support.
Human-First Flexibility: We treat you as humans first. 🫶🏽 Our flexible workplace trusts Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments.

Join our thriving remote-first team. Geography is no barrier to impact or connection. We build seamless virtual collaboration, empowering you, wherever you work.

Equal Opportunities Statement

At Nscale, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there's anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

The range below reflects the base salary for the position. Actual compensation may vary based on job-related factors such as skill set, experience, education, and location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus, equity, and/or commission programs. Nscale may offer a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, flexible paid time off, parental leave, and retirement plan participation.

Salary Range: $220,000 USD - $270,000 USD

NeoGenomics is looking for a Senior Manager, Software Engineering who wants to continue to learn in order to allow our company to grow. This is a hybrid in office position with Monday - Friday schedule to work out of either Ramsey, NJ, Durham, NC or Fort Myers, FL locations.

As an employer, we promise to provide you with a purpose driven mission in which you have the opportunity to save lives by improving patient care through the exceptional work you perform. Together, we will become the world's leading cancer reference laboratory.

As a Senior Manager, Laboratory Software Engineering you will lead a team of developers and engineers responsible for the technical design, development, delivery, and support of NeoGenomics' Laboratory IT platforms and applications. Demonstrated experience leading software implementations in scientific or healthcare related environments

jobs.title: Director, Product Management - Data Platform
jobs.description:
Summary

The Basics:

Our Product Management team is actively seeking a new Director of Product Management focused on Data Platform, Cloud, and SaaS Architecture
to join our passionate, driven, and fast-paced team. In this role, you will own and shape Tanium’s end-to-end data strategy across cloud and SaaS environments, partnering closely with engineering, product, design, and cross-functional leadership to define how Tanium stores, accesses, queries, moves, and visualizes data across the platform.

You will bring deep experience in cloud and SaaS architectures, data platforms, and enterprise-scale systems, with the ability to translate complex customer, product, and technical requirements into actionable strategy and execution. You will need to be successful influencing cross-functionally across all levels of the organization, operating horizontally across multiple teams and pods, and drive clarity in ambiguous, complex technical domains. You must also be comfortable setting strategic direction while staying close enough to the work to make high-quality product and architecture decisions.

This is an individual contributor role.

Responsibilities

Own the product strategy and roadmap for Tanium’s cloud/SaaS data platform, from ideation through launch, in close partnership with engineering teams.
Define and drive the short- and long-term roadmap for Tanium’s end-to-end data architecture, including storage, access, query, visualization, and data movement capabilities.
Partner with Product Managers, Engineering, Design, and leadership across the organization to align priorities across multiple pods and ensure teams are building toward a cohesive data strategy.
Lead product direction for how data is surfaced and experienced in Atlas and the UI, with a focus on improving trust, usability, reliability, and customer value.
Drive the strategy for data movement and integration capabilities, including export, import, and scalable data exchange patterns across products and use cases.
Establish clear product requirements, technical specifications, use cases, business logic, and success metrics for data platform capabilities.
Partner with engineering leadership to make durable architectural decisions across complex, distributed cloud and SaaS systems.
Champion data quality as a core product priority, setting expectations and mechanisms to improve consistency, reliability, and trust throughout the data lifecycle.
Collaborate with internal teams on enablement, training, and launch materials to ensure successful adoption of new data capabilities and platform improvements.
Work closely with business, technical, customer-facing, and go-to-market teams to understand customer needs, solve daily challenges, and identify opportunities for product differentiation.
Leverage innovation and trends in cloud, SaaS, data architecture, analytics, and enterprise platform technologies to develop strategic solutions.

Requirements

Education

BA/BS required
MA/MS or equivalent advanced technical/business degree preferred

Experience

Significant product management experience within an enterprise B2B environment, ideally supporting a SaaS, cloud platform, data platform, infrastructure, or security technology product.
Proven experience leading product strategy for complex technical platforms, including the ability to define opportunities, translate customer needs into requirements, and deliver products at enterprise scale.
Deep experience with cloud and SaaS architectures, with strong working knowledge of hyperscaler environments such as Azure and/or AWS.
Strong data platform experience, including one or more of the following:
Data storage and data access architectures
Query layers and large-scale database systems
Data visualization and analytics experiences
Data movement, export/import, integration, or interoperability capabilities
Data quality, reliability, governance, and lifecycle considerations

Experience working across distributed systems and multiple product surfaces, rather than a single narrowly defined application or monolith.
Experience with large-scale enterprise data systems; experience with graph databases is a plus.
Strong track record of working with engineering and business stakeholders to drive product definition, strategic alignment, prioritization, and execution.
Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, quickly ramp into new technical domains, and bring structure to broad, evolving problem spaces.
Proven ability to influence horizontally across cross-functional teams, product pods, and senior stakeholders.
Technology background preferred, ideally with experience in security, systems management, IT operations, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, or enterprise platform products.

Nice to have

Experience with graph databases or graph-based data models.
Experience with large-scale database systems, analytics platforms, or enterprise data visualization products.
Broader hyperscaler depth across Azure, AWS, and/or other cloud providers.
Experience building durable export/import patterns and integrations across complex enterprise products.
Experience leading product teams through organizational growth, hiring, or team structure evolution.

About Tanium

Tanium is the Autonomous IT company. Driven by AI and real-time endpoint intelligence, Tanium Autonomous IT empowers IT and security teams to make their organizations unstoppable.

Many of the world’s leading organizations trust Tanium’s single, unified platform for endpoint management and security to innovate faster, stay resilient and move business forward with confidence, at scale. To learn how Tanium delivers Autonomous IT for unstoppable business – visit www.tanium.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

On a mission. Together.

At Tanium, we are stewards of a culture that emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect, and diversity. In our pursuit of revolutionizing the way some of the largest enterprises and governments in the world solve their most difficult IT challenges, we are strengthened by our unique perspectives and by our collective actions.

As a global organization with stakeholders around the world, it’s imperative that the diversity of our customers and communities is reflected internally in our team members. We strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels they have opportunities to succeed and grow because we know that only together can we do great things.

Our commitment to excellence and innovation has earned us a place on the Forbes Cloud 100 list for ten consecutive years, and we continue to be recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Each of our team members has 5 days set aside as volunteer time off (VTO) to contribute to the communities they live in and give back to the causes they care about most.

What You’ll Get

The annual base salary range for this full-time position is $214,000 to $328,000. This range is an estimate for what Tanium will pay a new hire. The actual annual base salary offered may be adjusted based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, location, education, skills, training, and experience.

In addition to an annual base salary, team members will receive equity awards and a generous benefits package consisting of medical, dental and vision plan, family planning benefits, health savings account, flexible spending account, transportation savings account, 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match, life, accident and disability coverage, business travel accident insurance, employee assistance programs, disability insurance, and other well-being benefits.

Tanium is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, protected Veteran status, or other legally protected categories. If you require a reasonable accommodation in searching for a job opening, completing an application, interviewing, or completing any pre-employment testing or requirements, please contact accommodations@tanium.com. For more information refer to the “Know Your Rights” poster which is available here - https://www.eeoc.gov/poster.

Please be aware of job offers coming from people claiming to be Tanium employees. Tanium employees will only use @tanium.com email addresses to communicate with you, will have video interviews with you, and will never ask you for money.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

State Street’s IS Sales Enablement
business delivers institutional grade custody, clearing, and platform services to wealth managers, broker dealers, and financial institutions.
