jobs.title: Senior Director, Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Altana is the network for trusted trade. Our AI-powered product network empowers governments and businesses to build a more resilient and secure global economy while keeping trade flowing.

The Opportunity at Altana

As the Senior Director of Platform Engineering, you will own the foundation that the entire Altana engineering organization builds on: the cloud infrastructure that runs our products and the developer experience that determines how fast and how safely we ship. You will lead a multidisciplinary organization spanning Cloud Engineering, Developer Experience, Site Reliability, and DevSecOps / Release Engineering — with end-to-end ownership of our build, test, and release pipelines.

This is a moment of real transformation in how software is built. We are reorganizing our engineering practice around an AI-first, agent-first model, where AI coding harnesses and autonomous agents are first-class participants in the software development lifecycle. We are looking for a leader who has done this work before — someone who has built and scaled developer experience and platform organizations, and who has direct, hands-on experience and strong, well-formed opinions about agentic coding, AI-assisted development, and what it takes to make an engineering org dramatically more productive.

You will set the technical strategy, build and develop the team, and personally raise the bar on engineering excellence. You will be measured by the reliability and cost-efficiency of our platforms, the velocity and happiness of every engineer who depends on them, and how effectively Altana adopts AI across the development lifecycle.

Key areas under your stewardship

Cloud Engineering:
You will design, manage, and secure the multi-cloud infrastructure that powers our products — architectures that are scalable, flexible, resilient, and cost-performant across both commercial and government-compliant deployments. This includes the data platforms that support large-scale data processing, analytics, and machine learning, enabling our teams to work with world-scale datasets and build data-driven solutions.

Developer Experience:
You will own the infrastructure and tooling the engineering organization relies on every day — our monorepo, CI/CD platform, build systems, local development environments, and internal tooling — and the end-to-end experience of working in our codebase from clone to production. This is the center of gravity for the role: driving Developer Acceleration across the board and making AI-first, agent-first development the default way Altana engineers work.

Site Reliability:
You will ensure our systems are reliable, available, performant, and efficient. The SRE function establishes and monitors SLOs and error budgets, owns observability, drives toil reduction, and leads incident management so our services run smoothly and recover quickly from disruption.

DevOps / Release Engineering:
You will bridge development and operations, automating and optimizing the software delivery lifecycle from commit to deploy. Through robust CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code, your team ensures new features and updates ship rapidly, safely, and consistently.

Your Responsibilities

Technical Strategy & Execution

Define and own a clear, multi-year technical strategy for Platform Engineering, ensuring the team stays focused on the highest-leverage work while advancing long-term architectural goals.
Set the reference architecture and standards for cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and developer tooling, balancing immediate operational needs against strategic investment.
Make and guide key decisions on scalability, performance, security, and cost, working closely with engineers on the hardest problems rather than from a distance.
Lead build-vs-buy and platform investment decisions, including which tools, vendors, and open-source technologies to adopt across the SDLC.

Developer Experience & Acceleration

Own the Developer Acceleration program: instrument and continuously improve developer workflows, driving measurable gains in build times, PR cycle time, flaky-test rate, and deployment frequency (DORA / SPACE).
Drive an AI-first, agent-first transformation of the software development lifecycle — making AI coding harnesses and agents reliable, governed, first-class participants in how Altana writes, reviews, tests, and ships code.
Set strategy for integrating AI-assisted development tools and agentic coding harnesses (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and agent frameworks) into CI/CD, code review, local development, and release pipelines at scale.
Establish how AI-assisted and agent-generated code is reviewed, tested, secured, and governed — including LLM-aware testing strategies, evaluation and guardrails, and the supporting context engineering and tooling that make agents effective in a large monorepo.
Treat the engineering organization as your customer: gather requirements from application teams, translate vague friction into well-scoped platform work, and prove impact through before/after measurement.
Evolve our monorepo strategy — code organization, dependency management, build caching, and testing patterns — so it works consistently across our multi-cloud and compliance-constrained environments.

Operational Excellence

Establish and continuously improve best practices for monitoring, incident response, automation, and performance optimization across production and the delivery pipeline.
Drive a culture of ownership, resilience, and accountability to ensure high availability, performance, and security in our production environments.
Own reliability and cost across cloud infrastructure; conduct regular post-incident reviews and capacity planning to anticipate and mitigate risk before it reaches customers.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

Partner across product, engineering, security, data science, and commercial teams to align platform investment with business objectives.
Communicate trade-offs, constraints, and roadmap clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and represent Platform Engineering to senior leadership.
Manage relationships with external vendors and partners, including cloud providers and tooling vendors.

Team Leadership & Development

Lead, coach, and inspire a multidisciplinary organization of engineers and managers across software, infrastructure, reliability, and developer tooling.
Manage distributed teams across multiple time zones, maintaining alignment and a cohesive culture in a remote-friendly environment.
Recruit top-tier talent and act as a top-notch recruiter yourself; foster professional development, recognize outstanding performance, and address underperformance constructively and in a timely way.

About You

Experience building, leading, and scaling best-in-class platform and/or developer experience organizations, ideally in a rapidly scaling environment, including leading managers and senior engineers.
10+ years of real-world experience developing or managing complex engineering systems, with significant time spent owning developer experience, platform engineering, or the build/test/release pipeline end to end.
A proven track record of driving developer experience and developer productivity across an organization — you can point to concrete before/after outcomes (build times, PR cycle time, deployment frequency, reliability) from initiatives you led.
Direct, hands-on experience with AI-assisted and agentic development — AI coding harnesses, agent-first / AI-first workflows, and coding agents — and clear, well-formed opinions about how they change code review, testing, pipeline design, and engineering org structure.
Deep expertise with CI/CD systems (Buildkite, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar) and a demonstrated ability to scale them, ideally in a monorepo at scale.
Strong software engineering fundamentals — you design well-architected systems and lead from the front, not just from the org chart.
Production experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code (Terraform / OpenTofu).
A track record tackling large-scale infrastructure in support of fast-paced ML/AI-enabled products and services.
Experience designing tooling and patterns that work across multiple clouds or isolated / air-gapped and compliance-constrained environments (FedRAMP, SOC 2, or similar) is a strong plus.
Strong sense of shared ownership, a collaborative disposition, and excellent written and verbal communication skills.
You don’t hesitate to go to the dentist during the work day, but you’re also the person on your laptop working on the team’s hardest problems to relax.

jobs.title: Head of Platform Product Reliability
jobs.description:
About Etched

Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference
. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly technical and execution-focused Head of Platform Product Reliability to lead reliability engineering across Etched's server, rack, and datacenter platform products.

This role owns system-level product reliability from architecture through fleet deployment. You will define reliability strategy, qualification methodologies, accelerated stress testing programs, failure analysis processes, and long-term reliability standards for complex AI infrastructure systems. This team focuses specifically on product reliability engineering for platform hardware and deployed systems — ensuring every Etched product ships with the reliability profile that enterprise and hyperscale customers demand.

You will work cross-functionally with Platform Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Thermal, Firmware, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Datacenter Operations, and Program teams to ensure Etched products achieve exceptional reliability at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Define and own the end-to-end reliability strategy for AI servers, accelerator platforms, rack systems, and datacenter infrastructure, from design requirements through field deployment
Establish reliability requirements, qualification standards, and validation methodologies that scale across product generations
Build and institutionalize reliability engineering processes spanning the full product lifecycle:
EVT / DVT / PVT qualification gates and exit criteria
Accelerated life testing (ALT) and accelerated stress testing (AST)
Environmental testing: temperature, humidity, altitude, contamination
HALT / HASS programs for design margin and production screening
Vibration, shock, and transportation stress testing
Power cycling, thermal cycling, and long-duration soak testing

Lead root-cause investigations for reliability failures surfaced during development, manufacturing, and field deployment, driving corrective actions across hardware, firmware, thermal, and mechanical domains
Develop comprehensive system reliability models including MTBF projections, FIT rate analysis, Weibull lifetime modeling, component derating methodologies, and reliability growth tracking
Ensure reliability is considered early, partnering with Platform Engineering architects and design leads so reliability requirements shape decisions before they become expensive to change
Work closely with ODMs, JDMs, contract manufacturers, and component suppliers to validate and enforce long-term platform reliability commitments
Build fleet reliability infrastructure: telemetry analysis pipelines, field feedback loops, and monitoring frameworks that give Etched visibility into deployed system health at scale
Drive reliability signoff criteria and lead product release readiness reviews across engineering and program teams
Build and lead a high-performing product reliability engineering organization — hiring, developing, and retaining technical talent as the company scales

You may be a good fit if you have (Must-have qualifications)

BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Reliability Engineering, or a related technical field
10+ years of reliability engineering experience in hardware-centric organizations, with meaningful time spent on complex systems rather than component-level work
Experience leading reliability programs for one or more of:
AI accelerator or GPU-class compute systems
Hyperscale or cloud server infrastructure
Networking platforms, storage systems, or rack-scale infrastructure

Deep understanding of system-level failure mechanisms — including thermal, power delivery, mechanical, and connector/interconnect failure modes — and how design decisions affect long-term field reliability
Hands-on experience with FMEA, Weibull analysis, HALT/HASS, qualification planning, failure analysis methodologies, and reliability statistics and modeling
A track record of driving cross-functional root-cause investigations in fast-moving hardware organizations where schedule pressure is real and accountability is high
Strong technical judgment — capable of making defensible tradeoffs between reliability targets, cost, schedule, and performance without losing sight of customer expectations
Excellent communication skills and the credibility to influence design decisions with engineering leads, program managers, and executive stakeholders

Strong Candidates May Also Have Experience With (Nice-to-have Qualifications)

Experience with liquid-cooled systems, high-density power delivery, or thermal management for high-power AI infrastructure
Direct experience supporting hyperscale or cloud datacenter deployments at scale, including customer-facing reliability commitments and SLA management
Demonstrated experience building a reliability organization from early-stage — establishing processes, tooling, and team norms in environments without established infrastructure
Familiarity with fleet telemetry systems, large-scale field reliability analytics, and data-driven approaches to proactive reliability management
Experience working closely with ODM or JDM partners in Taiwan or broader Asia, including NPI support and on-site qualification engagement
Background in high-speed digital systems, GPU compute platforms, or accelerator-based architectures — with an understanding of how these affect system-level reliability behavior

Benefits

$500 per month credit for waiving medical benefits

Housing subsidy of $2k per month for those living within walking distance of the office
Relocation support for those moving to San Jose (Santana Row)
Various wellness benefits covering fitness, mental health, and more
Daily lunch and dinner in our office
Unlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification

How We’re Different

Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson. We are the first inference-focused frontier AI system. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors.

We are a fully in-person team in San Jose (Santana Row), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

Anduril's Maritime Division is responsible for planning and executing Anduril's product and revenue roadmap for maritime missions. Working across product, engineering, business development, logistics, and operations, the Maritime team develops, tests, deploys, and sustains the Anduril maritime capabilities in a challenging operational environment worldwide. As a leader in the Maritime Division, you must be a technical leader with the expertise to evaluate, qualify, manage, and advocate for an increasing number of sophisticated parallel pursuits. This role is crucial in ensuring that each initiative aligns with the company's strategic direction and receives the appropriate resourcing, balancing innovation with practical execution to drive the business line's success.

About The Job

You will lead the technical development of maritime products from concept to delivery. You will work closely with Anduril’s Strategy team and strategic opportunity customers to develop these designs so that requirements are tied to customer inputs and there is traceability to program office technical decisions.

Your spectrum of support will be diverse in nature and require you to leverage your technical expertise as well as leadership skills to set objectives, build cross-functional teams, and rapidly drive to completion. The ability to leverage your intuition and prior experience in programmatic level decision will play a key component in making sure the right design/analysis/ and test steps are being completed to ensure success. The ideal candidate will leverage their experience executing and successfully completing prior highly optimized multi-disciplinary projects.

What You’ll Do

Lead and manage the initial design, prototyping, capability verification, and delivery of a maritime autonomous weapon system

Perform systems engineering and trade analyses to enable the exploration and rapid iteration of early conceptual designs, while working closely with technical SME’s and strategic growth team to provide creative solutions to current and future gaps in the DOD capability. Ensure that the warfighter is provided with the best solution for current and future conflicts.
Coordinate closely with manufacturing and supply chain teams to ensure design for manufacturing is embedded in early concepts and matured to support full rate production at scale. Drive product differentiation through manufacturing capability and novel manufacturing techniques
Work with senior leadership to ensure resource plans are adequate for work scope
Oversee technical execution of the generation of a new surface product for Anduril Maritime
Define key capabilities, milestones, and demonstrations to enable continuous development and maturation of autonomous systems

Bachelor’s degree in Naval Architecture, Systems Engineering, Marine Engineering, or equivalent, or proven experience in a relevant field

Strong Systems engineering and architecture definition background to bridge software service and hardware product developments
Strong working understanding of how product development rolls into program acquisitions, to ensure alignment of HW/SW roadmaps and program requirements
Strong leadership qualities and collaborative/integrative leadership demonstrated capacity
Experience working with, defining, and fielding sensing payloads and comms architectures
Ability to work across a dynamic and multi-product environment to manage complex integration of product and technology roadmaps, and build consensus on integrated capabilities

jobs.title: Engineering - SRE Platforms - Site Reliability Engineer - Vice President - Dallas
jobs.description:
Job Description

Site Reliability Engineer - Vice President

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is an engineering discipline that combines software and systems engineering to build and run scalable, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. At Goldman Sachs, SRE is responsible for improving the availability and reliability of the firm’s most critical platform services and ensures they meet the requirements of our internal and external users. It is also responsible for firmwide policies and standards focused on firm’s digital resilience. We are looking for engineers who are motivated to collaborate with our businesses to build and run sustainable production systems, which can evolve and adapt to changes in our fast-paced, global business environment.

The SRE team develops and maintains platforms and tools which help other Engineering teams in Goldman Sachs to build and operate reliable and resilient systems. These systems span on-premises datacenters and multiple public cloud environments. The platforms we offer include central logging, monitoring, agents and alerting and we provide tools to drive adoption and improvements to capacity planning, operational readiness assessments, production incident postmortems, SLIs / SLOs, and deployment automation including canary releases.

The products and services we provide to our internal customers are used by thousands of engineers every day. We believe that reliability is the most important feature of any system, and we are devoted to giving our engineers the platforms and tools they need to build and operate reliable products.

Role Overview

As a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at Goldman Sachs, you will be a pivotal leader in ensuring the availability, reliability, and scalability of the firm's most critical platform applications and services. You will combine deep software and systems engineering expertise to architect, build, and run large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. This role involves providing technical leadership, mentoring senior engineers, and collaborating closely with internal teams and executive stakeholders to build and operate sustainable production systems that can adapt to our dynamic global business environment. You will drive a culture of continuous improvement, championing the adoption of advanced SRE principles and best practices across the organization.

Responsibilities

Strategic Reliability & Performance: Drive the strategic direction for availability, scalability, and performance of mission-critical applications and platform services, ensuring alignment with firm-wide objectives.
Architectural Leadership: Lead the design, build, and implementation of highly available, resilient, and scalable infrastructure and application architectures.
Advanced Automation & Tooling: Architect and develop sophisticated platforms, tools, and automation solutions to eliminate toil, optimize operational workflows, and enhance deployment processes across the enterprise.
Complex Incident Management & Post-Mortem Analysis: Lead critical incident response, conduct in-depth root cause analysis for systemic issues, and implement long-term preventative measures to significantly enhance system stability and resilience.
System Design & Capacity Planning: Partner with development teams to embed reliability into application design from inception, provide expert system design consulting, and lead comprehensive capacity planning initiatives for future growth.

jobs.title: AI-Ops Engineering Lead - Director
jobs.description:
SMBC Group is a top-tier global financial group. Headquartered in Tokyo and with a 400-year history, SMBC Group offers a diverse range of financial services, including banking, leasing, securities, credit cards, and consumer finance. The Group has more than 130 offices and 80,000 employees worldwide in nearly 40 countries. Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group, Inc. (SMFG) is the holding company of SMBC Group, which is one of the three largest banking groups in Japan. SMFG’s shares trade on the Tokyo, Nagoya, and New York (NYSE: SMFG) stock exchanges.

In the Americas, SMBC Group has a presence in the US, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, and Peru. Backed by the capital strength of SMBC Group and the value of its relationships in Asia, the Group offers a range of commercial and investment banking services to its corporate, institutional, and municipal clients. It connects a diverse client base to local markets and the organization’s extensive global network. The Group’s operating companies in the Americas include Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corp. (SMBC), SMBC Nikko Securities America, Inc., SMBC Capital Markets, Inc., SMBC MANUBANK, JRI America, Inc., SMBC Leasing and Finance, Inc., Banco Sumitomo Mitsui Brasileiro S.A., and Sumitomo Mitsui Finance and Leasing Co., Ltd.

Role Description

As the AI-Ops Engineering Lead in the Platform Engineering team, you will define and drive the strategy for operationalizing, monitoring, and governing the AI/GenAI platform and the models, pipelines, and agents that run on it. You will set the standards, reference patterns, and operating model that the broader engineering organization adopts, and partner with Azure, Databricks, and other infrastructure providers to build and operate the MLOps/LLMOps backbone of the platform. As a senior technical leader, you will influence architecture, technology, data, and business stakeholders, shape the AI-Ops roadmap, and champion operational excellence—reliable, observable, secure, and cost-efficient AI systems—across the enterprise. This role begins as a hands-on technical leader and is expected to grow into building and leading a dedicated AI-Ops team over time.

This is a unique opportunity to own and lead the operational excellence of the GenAI technology stack—bridging the gap between one-off experiments and production-grade AI systems—while shaping the practices, governance, and culture that ensure industrial-grade reliability, compliance, and efficiency in a high-stakes financial environment.

Role Objectives

Set AI-Ops strategy and standards: Define the enterprise vision, operating model, and reference patterns for MLOps/LLMOps on Databricks and Azure Cloud Services, and drive their adoption across engineering, architecture, and data teams.
Operationalize the AI Platform: Own the MLOps/LLMOps backbone for the AI platform, standardizing how models, prompts, pipelines, and agents are built, promoted, and run reliably in production.
Build CI/CD and release engineering: Establish automated CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code for models, prompts, and agents using Databricks Asset Bundles across DEV/QA/REL/PROD, with canary, blue/green, shadow, and automated-rollback deployment strategies.
Own governance, versioning and auditability: Implement end-to-end lineage and version control across data, prompts, retrievals, models, and responses using MLflow (Prompt Registry, Tracing, Experiments/Runs), delivering audit-ready artifacts and enforceable quality gates for internal and regulatory review.
Monitoring, drift and cost governance: Build observability for data quality, data and model drift, retrieval and hallucination/grounding health, application performance, and business KPIs, with cost visibility, inference optimization, and FinOps-aligned governance.
Testing, evaluation and validation: Establish automated regression, A/B, canary, shadow, and champion-challenger validation with golden datasets, evaluation rubrics, and human-in-the-loop review to certify quality and safety before and after release.
Drive responsible AI, security and governance adoption: Partner with architecture, risk, security, and business leaders to embed responsible-AI guardrails (bias/harm detection, explainability, safety) and security/privacy controls into the enterprise path-to-production.
Operational readiness and run management: Ensure reliable day-2 operations through model cards, API/SLA contracts, runbooks, incident response, and escalation readiness.
Evaluate emerging technology: Proactively identify and evaluate emerging AI-Ops tooling and integrate those that improve reliability, observability, and cost efficiency.
Technical leadership and team building: Mentor and uplift broader engineering teams on MLOps/LLMOps best practices, establish the AI-Ops discipline, and build and eventually lead a dedicated AI-Ops team as the function scales.

Qualifications And Skills

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or related field (advanced degree a plus).
8+ years of hands-on experience deploying, operating, and maintaining GenAI or advanced ML models in production environments, including 3+ years in a technical leadership, lead engineer, or architect capacity. Demonstrated ability to set technical direction, define standards, and drive cross-functional adoption of MLOps/LLMOps practices at enterprise scale.
3+ years of experience in Python and GenAI frameworks/tools e.g. Databricks Vector Search, Azure AI Search, document intelligence, LangGraph, haystack, Llama Index etc.
Deep, hands-on expertise with MLOps/LLMOps tooling (e.g. MLflow — Prompt Registry, Tracing, Experiments, Model Serving), data platforms (e.g. Databricks, Databricks Asset Bundles) and cloud platforms (e.g. Azure).
Demonstrated experience developing and deploying RESTful services, containerization, and automated CI/CD systems.
Proven experience building observability, monitoring, and alerting for AI systems — data and model drift, evaluation metrics, hallucination/grounding health, performance, and cost (FinOps).
Working knowledge of prompt engineering, embedding models, RAG evaluation, and vector databases sufficient to instrument, test, and monitor GenAI applications.
Working knowledge of ML libraries e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face Transformers.
Experience mentoring engineers, with the ability and appetite to build and lead a dedicated AI-Ops team as the function grows.
Familiarity with AI governance, responsible-AI, and security/privacy controls in a regulated (e.g. financial services) environment.
Executive-level communication and collaboration skills; proven ability to influence and partner with senior technical and non-technical stakeholders.

jobs.description:
Overview

Fleet Data Centers designs, builds and operates mega-scale data center campuses. Fleet provides its customers flexibility and predictability to meet their upside demand forecasts, addressing a key need in the market as traditional leased models are struggling to keep pace with the demand for new Cloud and AI infrastructure. Fleet is led by a team of industry veterans that have already made a lasting imprint on the evolution of global digital infrastructure and are committed and uniquely capable of upleveling data center development scale and operations in the face of rising demand.

Fleet is well positioned to bring in-house design, engineering and operational capabilities to collaborate with customers on tailored solutions for campuses of 500MW+. This unique model enables Fleet to provide the world’s largest and most sophisticated customers a seamless extension of their own data center fleets with constant access to design innovation. Fleet is headquartered in Denver, Colorado, with satellite offices in Seattle, WA and Arlington, VA.

Position Overview

The Director Network Engineer is responsible for the architecture, design, deployment, and operational ownership of Fleet Data Centers' corporate LAN/WAN, wireless, OT core, and physical security network infrastructure across global data center campuses. This role owns the network lifecycle from concept through commissioning and ongoing operations, ensuring secure, resilient, and scalable solutions that support Fleet's growing portfolio. The position serves as the technical authority for network architecture, deployment standards, automation, and operational escalations.

Key Responsibilities

Own the architecture, design, deployment, and operational lifecycle of Fleet's corporate LAN/WAN, wireless, OT core, and physical security networks across global data center campuses.
Lead network planning and execution from due diligence through commissioning, including design documentation, scope definition, standards development, cost, schedule, and quality metrics, and multi-site deployments.
Partner with engineering, construction, operations, vendors, and contractors to integrate network infrastructure with data center systems while ensuring compliance, quality, safety, and security requirements.
Serve as the technical authority for network design decisions, risk mitigation, resiliency planning, path diversity, carrier strategy, and complex operational escalations.
Drive continuous improvement through root-cause analysis, network automation, emerging technologies, and scalable design standards that support future campus growth.

Basic & Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, with 10+ years of network engineering experience, including 8+ years supporting mission-critical data center environments.
Deep expertise in enterprise and cloud-scale networking, including BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, VXLAN, VRF, routing and switching, optical transport, and large-scale network operations.
Strong experience with leading networking platforms and providers, including Cisco, Arista, Juniper, Ciena, fiber carriers, and internet service providers.
Proven experience delivering large-scale, multi-region data center network deployments, including automation technologies such as Ansible, ZTP, SDN, and Infrastructure-as-Code methodologies.
Preferred certifications include ACE Level 5, CCNP/CCIE, or equivalent, along with demonstrated success influencing stakeholders, defining KPIs, and supporting global regulatory and compliance requirements.

Key Competencies

Strategic leadership with the ability to balance long-term vision, technical depth, and execution across complex multi-site projects.
Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, including engagement with executive leadership, vendors, and cross-functional teams.
High integrity, professionalism, and emotional intelligence, with the ability to build trusted relationships and perform effectively in high-pressure environments.
Adaptability and problem-solving skills, with proven success managing ambiguity, troubleshooting complex issues, and driving continuous improvement.
Strong organizational and project management capabilities, including managing multiple priorities, external partners, and tight delivery timelines.

Working Conditions

Up to 25% travel to data center sites across multiple regions.
Ability to work in both office environments and active construction sites while adhering to all safety protocols.

Expected Salary Range

$185,000 - $225,000 Base Salary + Discretionary Bonus

Summary

The Head of Hardware Platform Solutions (HPS) IT Solutions & Technology Delivery’s role is to provide senior, visionary IT leadership operating at the intersection of an advanced engineering technology director and a highly strategic IT Business Partner. The central objective of this role is to design, plan, monitor, and improve specialized IT capabilities tailored specifically to the high-performance engineering organization. Rather than acting reactively or being dragged along by development timelines, this leader ensures the HPS IT function remains "in front"—setting the technical vision, anticipating shifts in the networking and storage industries, and introducing cutting-edge, value-added capabilities.

Reporting directly to the Chief Information Officer (CIO) and overseeing a dedicated global team of 20–30 HPS IT members, this individual will lay down an agile technical environment that enables the global engineering teams to execute at maximum velocity. To succeed, this leader must balance deep hands-on software engineering insight and advanced networking architecture skills with a highly collaborative approach—partnering closely with the global IT organization to qualify new HPS initiatives, leverage enterprise systems, and ensure corporate alignment.

Detailed Description

Performs tasks such as, but not limited to, the following:

Strategy & Planning

Participate in strategic and operational governance processes of the HPS business as a member of the senior IT management team, reporting directly to the CIO.
Act as the forward-looking visionary for HPS' IT needs, anticipating disruptive changes in the networking, storage, and software industries to capture competitive advantages ahead of business demand.
Lead strategic and operational planning to embed value-added technical capabilities across global Design Centers, ensuring infrastructure plans are proactively established to prevent engineering bottlenecks.
Partner closely with the global IT Business Partnership and Project Management teams to co-develop frameworks that successfully qualify, prioritize, and ingest new business initiatives into the pipeline.
Formulate and execute a progressive endpoint technology framework that bridges corporate compliance with fluid developer productivity across Windows and native Linux platforms.
Establish foundational, next-generation network architecture models for highly complex Research & Development Labs (RDL), securing segmented customer networks and remote access pathways.

Evaluate and deploy advanced platform capabilities—such as automated, cloud-hosted developer VMs, sandbox architectures, and integrated developer environments (IDEs).
Oversee facility build-outs, greenfield network expansions, and specialized lab engineering provisions across distributed technical hubs.

Operational Management

Direct and lead a global, multi-disciplinary team of 20–30 IT professionals and engineering specialists, fostering an agile, forward-thinking, and high-performance team culture.
Ensure responsiveness and high-availability continuous delivery of specialized IT capabilities to worldwide engineering cohorts.
Partner with the global IT Security team to orchestrate secure software chains of custody through robust code-signing infrastructures, automated digital certificate distributions, and hardware security modules extending safely to manufacturing floors.
Align specialized lab access controls with global IT Security standards, supervising the end-to-end management of complex network segmentations, dedicated hardware layers, and secure remote customer access tunnels to guarantee complete RDL isolation.
Triage, adjust, and optimize endpoint application security controls (such as default-deny policies) to protect corporate intellectual property while ensuring a friction-free developer experience.
Monitor service metrics, resolve infrastructure bottlenecks, and continually adapt IT systems to support rapid software development lifecycles and continuous product deployment schedules.

Knowledge & Experience

Significant experience managing and directing specialized enterprise IT operations, infrastructure architecture, or software engineering infrastructure teams in a global capacity.
Proven track record serving as a senior technical IT Business Partner or technology delivery lead, with a demonstrated ability to set architectural visions and build systems that allow technical teams to execute rapidly.
Strong, forward-looking knowledge of the networking and storage industries, including high-throughput storage architectures, software-defined networking (SDN), firewall topologies, and zero-trust remote access models.
Deep technical expertise in software engineering paradigms, automated continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and modern developer workflows.
Demonstrated experience collaborating with global corporate IT functions—specifically IT Security, Enterprise Applications, PMO, and Business Relationship Management—to qualify and deliver large-scale initiatives.
Comprehensive understanding of cross-platform endpoint engineering, including automated configuration management and MDM/UEM frameworks (e.g., Jamf Pro) for macOS, Linux baseline configurations, and Windows environments.
Direct experience managing or partnering with hardware and software engineering labs utilizing specialized product development suites (PLM, CAD, and advanced compilation environments).
Strong working knowledge of corporate governance, software supply chain security, and international export control frameworks (such as dual-use technical restrictions) governing clean rooms and isolated labs.

Exceptional visionary leadership and relationship-building skills, with a proven ability to manage, inspire, and scale a global team of 20–30 technical professionals.
Strong diplomatic and matrix-management skills, with a demonstrated ability to establish collaborative, trust-based partnerships with global IT counterparts.
Superb written, oral, and presentation skills, with a distinct talent for translating future-state architectural concepts into business-friendly and developer-friendly language.
Proactive, self-motivated, and highly resilient; a leader who thrives on pushing boundaries and keeping IT in front of business requirements rather than operating reactively.
Advanced analytical, risk-assessment, and strategic problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to prioritize massive project portfolios, negotiate competing resource demands, and execute flawless mitigation strategies in fast-paced product environments.
Strong developer-centric service orientation, intensely focused on accelerating engineer velocity and eliminating operational downtime.

The ideal candidate has deep expertise in distributed systems, modern cloud data architectures, and a proven track record of leading high-impact engineering teams, particularly within the financial or capital markets sector.

High-Performance Data Solutions: Oversee the design and implementation of ETL/ELT pipelines using Cloud Data warehouses like Snowflake ensuring data quality and compliance for multi-terabyte scale data stores.

Advanced Analytics & ML Integration: Drive the integration of advanced data science workflows, leveraging cloud-native ML services to enhance predictive models and analytical dashboards.

Stakeholder & Customer Success: Partner with investment, risk, and product teams to translate complex business requirements into high-performance database solutions.

Infrastructure Management: Guide best practices for cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS) and containerized data services (Enterprise-grade container orchestration platform supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, Snowpark Container Services).

Position at Imagine Learning

Great Purpose. Great People. Great Opportunities.

At Imagine Learning, we Empower Potential - in students, educators, and each other. Every day, our team designs innovative tools that help educators personalize instruction and engage students in meaningful ways. We’re shaping the future of learning through our Curriculum-Informed AI™ approach - technology that understands instructional context, respects educator judgment, and transforms how teachers personalize learning at scale to unlock each student’s potential. Together, we’re reimagining what’s possible and transforming education.

That same spirit of innovation and purpose drives our team culture. At Imagine Learning, you’ll find opportunities for meaningful work, continuous growth, and connection with passionate colleagues who care deeply about making a difference. We celebrate collaboration, embrace change, and believe in lifelong learning - for our students and ourselves.

As a remote-friendly company, Imagine Learning offers flexible work arrangements across the U.S. and internationally. Most of our U.S.-based employees work from home or on a hybrid schedule at one of our office locations in Tempe, AZ (HQ), Austin, TX, Petaluma, CA, Rock Rapids, IA, or Bloomington, MN.

Imagine Your Impact.

The VP of Product Management, Platform leads the strategy, roadmap, and execution for the technical foundation that powers Imagine Learning's product portfolio. This role owns the platform layer: shared services, APIs, data infrastructure, identity, and the integrations that products across ELA, math, science, social studies, and courseware build on. You will translate a fragmented set of product needs into a coherent, scalable platform strategy that accelerates delivery, reduces duplication, and creates durable technical advantage.

This is a builder role for a leader who has shipped complex technical systems at scale and who works AI-natively. You will partner closely with Engineering, Design, and the product leaders who serve as your internal customers. You will make hard tradeoffs between shared infrastructure and product-specific speed. You will report to the SVP of Product, Design, and AI Initiatives and lead a team of platform-focused product managers.

For more information on what it’s like to work at Imagine Learning, including our culture, benefits, and products, visit us HERE.

To learn more about a typical applicant journey at Imagine Learning, click HERE.

Position Information: This is a regular, full-time position, reporting to SVP Product Management, AI, and Data.

Compensation: Base pay is anticipated to be between $183,249.00 and $230,000.00 per year. Eligible employees may also receive incentive/commission/annual bonus pay based on individual and/or company performance. Compensation may vary based on factors such as, but not limited to, individual skills, experience, training, education/certifications, geographic location, internal equity, and local market conditions.

Location: In this US-based position your location will be remote.

Travel: You can also expect up to approximately 30% travel, so be sure you have a valid driver’s license and automobile insurance and a clean driving record for at least the preceding 39 months.

Benefits: Imagine Learning provides a comprehensive benefits program to eligible employees, including:

Multiple health, dental, and vision plans, including medical plans with zero employee premiums
401k plan with a company match
16 paid holidays, which include 2 floating holidays and a winter shutdown from Christmas Eve through New Year’s Day
Paid Time Off
Comprehensive maternity and fertility/family building benefits
Paid bonding leave when a new child joins your family
Access to on-demand mental health resources
Life and short and long-term disability insurance
Pre-tax savings plans
Paid volunteer time off
A wide variety of professional development programs, including tuition reimbursement
Work from home opportunities that foster work/life balance

Envision Your Experience.

In this role you’ll have the opportunity to:

Own the platform product strategy and multi-year roadmap. Aligning it to portfolio needs, business priorities, and the company's AI direction.
Define and manage the API, data, identity, and integration surfaces that product teams depend on. Treat internal teams as customers with real SLAs and clear contracts.
Lead platform product managers. Set direction, coach, and build a high-performing team that operates with technical depth and product judgment and exercise judgment about where AI incrementally improves a practice and where it should transform it entirely.
Use AI to improve your own product practice, from discovery to spec to decision-making, and set the standard for what AI-native product leadership looks like.
Partner with Engineering leadership on architecture decisions, build-vs-buy calls, and delivery planning.
Drive the platformization of shared AI capabilities so product teams can build curriculum-grounded features without rebuilding foundations each time.
Establish platform metrics that matter: adoption by product teams, reliability, delivery velocity gained, cost efficiency, and reduction in duplicated work.
Manage dependencies across product lines. Sequence platform investments so they unblock the highest-priority product outcomes.
Represent platform strategy to executive leadership. Communicate roadmap, risk, and progress clearly.
Enforce data governance, privacy, and security requirements (FERPA, COPPA) at the platform layer so downstream products inherit strong defaults.
Other duties as required.

Share Your Expertise.

Experience, education, and qualifications essential for success in this role, include:

Bachelor's degree required. Technical or advanced degree a plus.
At least 12 years in product management, with at least 5 years leading product teams. Prior platform, infrastructure, or developer-facing product ownership required.
Demonstrated track record of delivering complex technical solutions at scale. You have shipped systems other teams built on, not just end-user features.
Demonstrated experience working AI-natively as a product leader, using AI to improve personal practice, team workflows, and product outcomes and a track record of redesigning team processes and operating models around AI capabilities.
Experience shipping AI-forward products or platforms in production, with real users preferred.
Strong technical fluency. You can engage credibly with engineers on architecture, APIs, data models, and system tradeoffs.
Experience building and running APIs, data platforms, identity, or shared services as products with internal customers.
Familiarity with AI/ML systems and how to expose them as reusable platform capabilities.
Proven ability to lead through influence across a matrixed organization and manage competing product-line demands.
Experience coaching and growing product managers into a strong team.
Excellent communication skills, including the ability to make technical strategy legible to executives.
Experience in EdTech, regulated data environments, or K-12 preferred. Working knowledge of student data privacy (FERPA, COPPA) a plus.
Ability to travel up to 30%.

As a Senior Engineering Manager for the AI/ML Platform team, you will lead the group responsible for productizing and operating our inference offering. In partnership with CoreWeave AI platform team, you will ensure the service becomes a polished, reliable, developer-friendly product within the AI/ML Platform.

You will guide engineers working on areas such as service reliability, observability, operational excellence, packaging, developer-facing tooling, and application-layer enhancements. You will partner closely with Product, CoreWeave engineering teams, Design, Support, and GTM stakeholders to ensure the inference experience meets the needs of practitioners deploying and scaling real-world AI workloads. jobs.title: Head of Engineering Systems - Cloud Operations, Reliability & Engineering (CORE)
jobs.description:
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

Position Overview:

Cloud Operations, Reliability & Engineering (CORE) is an organization within Siemens Digital Industries Software. CORE is responsible for the end-to-end operational lifecycle of Siemens DISW’s SaaS portfolio — from product onboarding and platform engineering through production operations, site reliability, and customer-facing cloud delivery — serving customers across multiple product lines worldwide.

The Director of Cloud Operations, Reliability & Engineering provides the engineering foundations that enable CORE to operate better, faster, and more efficiently. This is the role that builds and delivers the tooling, automation, AI Ops capabilities, and platform services that empower operations, SRE, and customer-facing teams to deliver world-class SaaS experiences at scale.

The central mandate is operational improvement through innovation — designing and delivering automation and AI-driven services that reduce manual effort, accelerate provisioning and deployment, improve quality, and drive margin improvement across the SaaS fleet. This leader must be able to evaluate, adopt, integrate, and execute with the right mix of build/buy, and partner to deliver outcomes.

This role also serves as the Product and SaaS Security Officer (PSSO), providing security governance, risk oversight, and compliance accountability across CORE’s cloud operations (~20% of scope). The PSSO responsibility requires visibility across the full engineering and operations landscape and the judgment to enforce security standards when they are at risk.

Key Responsibilities:

Engineering Foundations & Operational Enablement
Lead a globally distributed engineering organization spanning platform engineering, process engineering, product onboarding, AI engineering, automation, sovereign cloud engineering, and tool configuration/integrations
Deliver the engineering foundations — tooling, automation, platform capabilities, and AI Ops services — that enable CORE’s operations, SRE, and customer delivery teams to operate at scale
Drive continuous operational improvement through innovative use of automation and AI — reducing manual effort, accelerating time-to-value for customers, and improving the reliability and efficiency of SaaS operations
Lead platform engineering across multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure), including infrastructure-as-code, container orchestration (Kubernetes), CI/CD pipeline architecture, and cloud-native platform capabilities
Own the product onboarding engineering process — ensuring new products and releases from multiple product segments are production-ready, with ops readiness checklists, release verification, and customer journey testing
Lead containerization and modernization efforts across the SaaS fleet, including migration of process-based deployments to containerized architectures
Manage engineering budgets, vendor relationships (including cloud service providers), and technology selection decisions — balancing build vs. buy vs. partner to deliver outcomes efficiently
AI Ops & Automation
Design and deliver impactful AI Ops services that transform how CORE operates — including digital agents for operational workflows, AI-assisted knowledge management, intelligent runbook automation, and predictive operations capabilities
Drive a unified AI Ops strategy that consolidates fragmented point tools into a coherent framework, delivering measurable efficiency gains and enabling operations teams to scale without proportional headcount growth
Evaluate and adopt emerging AI capabilities (agentic AI, LLM-based operations tools, automated diagnostics) with a focus on practical impact — moving from proof-of-concept to production-grade operational services
Establish an automation-first culture within engineering — systematically identifying manual processes across the SaaS operations lifecycle and delivering automation that reduces toil, improves consistency, and frees teams to focus on higher-value work
Product & Solution Security Officer (PSSO)
Serve as the security governance authority for CORE’s SaaS and cloud operations — with the backbone, visibility, and mandate to enforce standards when security is at risk
Own security policy, standards, and compliance across the CORE production environment, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, and regulated/sovereign deployment requirements
Drive vulnerability management, cloud account hardening, and security incident response in partnership with the enterprise cybersecurity organization
Oversee certifications lifecycle and audit readiness across SaaS, managed services, and specialized customer-facing environments
Govern security engineering practices including vulnerability remediation, IAM compliance, encryption standards, and cross-tenant isolation
Cross-Functional Execution in a Matrixed Environment
Work across multiple product segments — not just a single product line — to ensure engineering foundations support the full breadth of CORE’s SaaS portfolio and the diverse requirements of each segment’s cloud journey
Influence and drive to conclusion programs that span participation of multiple organizations — product segments, cloud platform providers, enterprise IT, cybersecurity, and commercial teams — without direct authority over all participants
Partner with Operations leadership to bridge the engineering-to-operations gap, ensuring engineering delivers in formats operations can support and maintains shared accountability for customer outcomes
Collaborate with Commercials on infrastructure cost modeling, container pricing, and FinOps governance to support SaaS margin improvement
Work with Systems Architecture on infrastructure evolution, performance optimization, and cloud provider technology decisions
Represent CORE engineering in enterprise-wide initiatives, positioning CORE as a consumer and contributor to enterprise engineering standards

Qualifications:

Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related field
Master's degree or MBA preferred
Required Leadership Experience
12+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, DevOps, platform engineering, or cloud infrastructure — with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role managing multi-functional engineering teams
Demonstrated experience leading engineering organizations of 50+ people across globally distributed teams, including offshore/nearshore delivery centers
Track record of leading engineering functions within SaaS or cloud operations organizations at enterprise scale (hundreds of customers, multi-cloud, multi-product)
Experience managing engineering through organizational transformation, including team integration, capability consolidation, and culture-building across previously separate teams
Proven ability to influence and drive cross-organizational programs to conclusion in a matrixed enterprise environment — delivering results through alignment and influence, not just direct authority
Required Technical Depth
Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures across AWS and Azure, including Kubernetes orchestration, container-based deployment models, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible), and CI/CD pipeline design at scale
Strong background in SaaS operations engineering — including change management, release governance, production readiness, and incident management frameworks (ITIL/ITSM)
Demonstrated experience designing and delivering AI Ops or intelligent automation services that produced measurable operational impact — not just prototypes, but production-grade capabilities that changed how an operations organization works
Working knowledge of security and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST) and experience driving vulnerability management, IAM, and audit programs
Familiarity with observability and SRE practices — including monitoring, incident response, SLA/SLO management, and blameless post-incident review
Experience with enterprise ITSM platforms (ServiceNow), ticketing ecosystems, and change control workflow
Required Work Experience
Track record of delivering engineering capabilities that measurably improved the speed, efficiency, and quality of SaaS operations — automation, tooling, and AI-driven services that transformed operational outcomes, not just technical architecture
Demonstrated ability to evaluate and execute with the right mix of build, buy, and partner — not defaulting to building everything, but ensuring the organization can execute effectively regardless of approach
Experience establishing and maintaining engineering standards across a complex ecosystem of dependencies — including multiple product development teams, cloud platform providers, and enterprise IT organizations
Track record of improving SaaS margins through engineering efficiency, automation, and cost optimization
Experience working across multiple product lines or business units in a matrixed enterprise software environment
Desired Attributes
Experience with Siemens SaaS product portfolio and associated build and release processes
Execution mentality — focused on delivering outcomes, not just designs. Able to move from strategy to implementation to measurable results, and to drive teams to do the same
Innovative thinker who challenges conventional approaches to operational problems — bringing fresh ideas about how AI, automation, and modern engineering practices can fundamentally improve how a SaaS organization operates
Comfortable operating in a matrix environment with significant dependencies on organizations outside direct control — and skilled at influencing those organizations toward shared outcomes
Strong communicator who can translate complex technical capabilities into business impact for executive leadership
Judgment to know when to build, when to buy, and when to partner — and the ability to execute effectively in all three modes
Executive presence to enforce security and quality standards when they are at risk
Travel & location
Required amount of travel with the position is up to 20%, including international travel to global delivery centers (India, Mexico, Poland, Malaysia) and customer sites
Preferred location is in the United States of America in the pacific time zone. Other global locations can also be considered.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Altana is the network for trusted trade. Our AI-powered product network empowers governments and businesses to build a more resilient and secure global economy while keeping trade flowing.

The Opportunity at Altana

As the Senior Director of Platform Engineering, you will own the foundation that the entire Altana engineering organization builds on: the cloud infrastructure that runs our products and the developer experience that determines how fast and how safely we ship. You will lead a multidisciplinary organization spanning Cloud Engineering, Developer Experience, Site Reliability, and DevSecOps / Release Engineering — with end-to-end ownership of our build, test, and release pipelines.

This is a moment of real transformation in how software is built. We are reorganizing our engineering practice around an AI-first, agent-first model, where AI coding harnesses and autonomous agents are first-class participants in the software development lifecycle. We are looking for a leader who has done this work before — someone who has built and scaled developer experience and platform organizations, and who has direct, hands-on experience and strong, well-formed opinions about agentic coding, AI-assisted development, and what it takes to make an engineering org dramatically more productive.

You will set the technical strategy, build and develop the team, and personally raise the bar on engineering excellence. You will be measured by the reliability and cost-efficiency of our platforms, the velocity and happiness of every engineer who depends on them, and how effectively Altana adopts AI across the development lifecycle.

Key areas under your stewardship

Cloud Engineering:
You will design, manage, and secure the multi-cloud infrastructure that powers our products — architectures that are scalable, flexible, resilient, and cost-performant across both commercial and government-compliant deployments. This includes the data platforms that support large-scale data processing, analytics, and machine learning, enabling our teams to work with world-scale datasets and build data-driven solutions.

Developer Experience:
You will own the infrastructure and tooling the engineering organization relies on every day — our monorepo, CI/CD platform, build systems, local development environments, and internal tooling — and the end-to-end experience of working in our codebase from clone to production. This is the center of gravity for the role: driving Developer Acceleration across the board and making AI-first, agent-first development the default way Altana engineers work.

Site Reliability:
You will ensure our systems are reliable, available, performant, and efficient. The SRE function establishes and monitors SLOs and error budgets, owns observability, drives toil reduction, and leads incident management so our services run smoothly and recover quickly from disruption.

DevOps / Release Engineering:
You will bridge development and operations, automating and optimizing the software delivery lifecycle from commit to deploy. Through robust CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code, your team ensures new features and updates ship rapidly, safely, and consistently.

Your Responsibilities

Technical Strategy & Execution

Define and own a clear, multi-year technical strategy for Platform Engineering, ensuring the team stays focused on the highest-leverage work while advancing long-term architectural goals.
Set the reference architecture and standards for cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and developer tooling, balancing immediate operational needs against strategic investment.
Make and guide key decisions on scalability, performance, security, and cost, working closely with engineers on the hardest problems rather than from a distance.
Lead build-vs-buy and platform investment decisions, including which tools, vendors, and open-source technologies to adopt across the SDLC.

Developer Experience & Acceleration

Own the Developer Acceleration program: instrument and continuously improve developer workflows, driving measurable gains in build times, PR cycle time, flaky-test rate, and deployment frequency (DORA / SPACE).
Drive an AI-first, agent-first transformation of the software development lifecycle — making AI coding harnesses and agents reliable, governed, first-class participants in how Altana writes, reviews, tests, and ships code.
Set strategy for integrating AI-assisted development tools and agentic coding harnesses (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and agent frameworks) into CI/CD, code review, local development, and release pipelines at scale.
Establish how AI-assisted and agent-generated code is reviewed, tested, secured, and governed — including LLM-aware testing strategies, evaluation and guardrails, and the supporting context engineering and tooling that make agents effective in a large monorepo.
Treat the engineering organization as your customer: gather requirements from application teams, translate vague friction into well-scoped platform work, and prove impact through before/after measurement.
Evolve our monorepo strategy — code organization, dependency management, build caching, and testing patterns — so it works consistently across our multi-cloud and compliance-constrained environments.

Operational Excellence

Establish and continuously improve best practices for monitoring, incident response, automation, and performance optimization across production and the delivery pipeline.
Drive a culture of ownership, resilience, and accountability to ensure high availability, performance, and security in our production environments.
Own reliability and cost across cloud infrastructure; conduct regular post-incident reviews and capacity planning to anticipate and mitigate risk before it reaches customers.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

Partner across product, engineering, security, data science, and commercial teams to align platform investment with business objectives.
Communicate trade-offs, constraints, and roadmap clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and represent Platform Engineering to senior leadership.
Manage relationships with external vendors and partners, including cloud providers and tooling vendors.

Team Leadership & Development

Lead, coach, and inspire a multidisciplinary organization of engineers and managers across software, infrastructure, reliability, and developer tooling.
Manage distributed teams across multiple time zones, maintaining alignment and a cohesive culture in a remote-friendly environment.
Recruit top-tier talent and act as a top-notch recruiter yourself; foster professional development, recognize outstanding performance, and address underperformance constructively and in a timely way.

About You

Experience building, leading, and scaling best-in-class platform and/or developer experience organizations, ideally in a rapidly scaling environment, including leading managers and senior engineers.
10+ years of real-world experience developing or managing complex engineering systems, with significant time spent owning developer experience, platform engineering, or the build/test/release pipeline end to end.
A proven track record of driving developer experience and developer productivity across an organization — you can point to concrete before/after outcomes (build times, PR cycle time, deployment frequency, reliability) from initiatives you led.
Direct, hands-on experience with AI-assisted and agentic development — AI coding harnesses, agent-first / AI-first workflows, and coding agents — and clear, well-formed opinions about how they change code review, testing, pipeline design, and engineering org structure.
Deep expertise with CI/CD systems (Buildkite, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar) and a demonstrated ability to scale them, ideally in a monorepo at scale.
Strong software engineering fundamentals — you design well-architected systems and lead from the front, not just from the org chart.
Production experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code (Terraform / OpenTofu).
A track record tackling large-scale infrastructure in support of fast-paced ML/AI-enabled products and services.
Experience designing tooling and patterns that work across multiple clouds or isolated / air-gapped and compliance-constrained environments (FedRAMP, SOC 2, or similar) is a strong plus.
Strong sense of shared ownership, a collaborative disposition, and excellent written and verbal communication skills.
You don’t hesitate to go to the dentist during the work day, but you’re also the person on your laptop working on the team’s hardest problems to relax.

This role can be fully remote or based in any of our US Altana hub locations, with hybrid work flexibility: Brooklyn, NY, Washington, DC, Boston, MA, or San Francisco, CA

US Salary Range and Benefits

The VP of Cloud Platform Engineering
is responsible for defining and executing the enterprise platform engineering vision, strategy, and operating model across cloud infrastructure, platform services, automation, DevSecOps, reliability engineering, and developer enablement capabilities. This executive leader oversees multiple platform engineering organizations and establishes enterprise standards that ensure secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-effective technology platforms. The VP partners with executive leaders across engineering, architecture, cybersecurity, operations, data, product, and business functions to align platform investments with strategic business priorities. This role drives multi-year modernization initiatives, operational excellence, cloud transformation, platform adoption, engineering productivity, and enterprise technology governance while developing high-performing leadership teams and fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Essential Job Functions

Define and execute the enterprise platform engineering strategy, roadmaps, standards, and governance frameworks aligned to organizational objectives. Lead enterprise modernization, cloud transformation, engineering enablement, and platform adoption initiatives that improve scalability, reliability, security, and developer productivity. - (20%)
Provide executive oversight for platform engineering organizations responsible for cloud infrastructure, DevSecOps, infrastructure as code, platform services, automation frameworks, and engineering tooling. Ensure delivery excellence, operational effectiveness, and alignment with enterprise technology priorities. - (15%)
Establish enterprise standards and operating principles for cloud platforms, resilience, observability, availability, recovery, and performance engineering. Drive continuous improvement programs that enhance reliability, efficiency, and customer experience while reducing operational risk. - (15%)
Ensure platform services meet enterprise security, regulatory, compliance, audit, and risk management objectives. Sponsor security-by-design practices, cloud governance frameworks, and proactive risk mitigation strategies across the platform ecosystem. (10%)
Partner with executive stakeholders across technology and business organizations to prioritize investments, evaluate emerging technologies, and align platform capabilities with growth, innovation, and operational objectives. Serve as a trusted advisor on platform engineering strategy and technology direction. - (10%)
Oversee platform investment planning, workforce strategy, vendor management, and technology financial management practices. Optimize operational expenditures, cloud consumption, and platform investments while balancing business priorities, risk, and long-term strategic objectives. - (10%)
Champion adoption of emerging technologies, automation capabilities, AI-enabled engineering solutions, and modern platform practices that improve engineering velocity, scalability, and business value delivery across the enterprise. - (10%)
Lead and develop a diverse organization of senior leaders and engineering professionals. Build leadership capability, succession pipelines, organizational effectiveness, and a culture of accountability, inclusion, innovation, and continuous learning. - (10%)

12+ years leadership experience.
Demonstrated success leading enterprise-scale platform transformation and modernization initiatives.
