About The Role

Peraton is looking for a Director,
Systems Engineering, C2, and Networks Architect
to join the Corporate Growth, Enterprise Capabilities and Solutions team as one of the technical leads behind our most competitive pursuits. You will provide thought leadership and design differentiated service offerings, architectures, and technical strategies mission systems engineering, command and control, and intelligence and defense applications. These provide the people and process elements to the Peraton Labs technology developments. You will work directly alongside capture teams, growth leaders, sector CTOs, and technical SMEs from early strategic opportunity shaping through proposal submission to build solutions that win contracts and frameworks that make winning repeatable. If you are energized by high-stakes technical challenges and want to see your work translate directly into contract wins, this role was built for you.

What you'll do:

Lead the Peraton Enterprise Capabilities and Solutions Portfolio for mission systems engineering, command and control, and intelligence and defense applications from strategy through execution, ensuring every offering is aligned to business priorities, technically sound, and built to compete across all Peraton customer's market spaces.
Work directly with capture teams, sector growth leaders, and SMEs to shape Mission Engineering solutions from early opportunity identification through proposal submission.
Develop technical discriminators, solution narratives, and competitive positioning materials that support capture and proposal efforts across the enterprise, with deep credibility in mission systems engineering, command and control architecture, and intelligence and defense applications.
Design and develop scalable, reusable mission engineering service offerings, architectures, and technical frameworks that give Peraton's sector teams a competitive edge on federal pursuits.
Continuously evolve the portfolio by analyzing capability gaps, technology readiness, and market trends across mission systems, defense acquisition, and national security requirements to identify portfolio enhancements and competitive differentiation opportunities that strengthen Peraton's position in core markets.
Provide thought leadership and author white papers and other solution artifacts to support customer engagement efforts highlighting newly developed frameworks and Peraton Labs applicable technologies.
Partner with sector growth teams, business stakeholders, and engineering leadership to translate market opportunities into viable, differentiated service offerings.
Drive the design and architecture of services across the portfolio. Ensure each service is fully defined with supporting sales assets, cost models, and solution guides that equip sector teams to sell and deliver.
Present technical strategies, mission architecture roadmaps, and solution recommendations to customers, capture teams, and executive leadership with the clarity and confidence to drive decisions.
Engage with key customers, industry partners, and technology vendors to stay ahead of evolving mission requirements, emerging defense capabilities, and competitive dynamics across Peraton's national security customer base.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

16+ years of industry experience
Deep expertise in systems engineering principles and methodologies aligned to INCOSE and DoD systems engineering frameworks, with demonstrated experience applying them across the full defense acquisition lifecycle
Proven experience with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) using tools such as Cameo, Rhapsody, or MATLAB/Simulink to design, analyze, and communicate complex mission system architectures
Demonstrated experience designing and integrating C4ISR systems and mission applications, with working knowledge of DoDAF viewpoints and their application to mission architecture development
Working knowledge of interoperability standards including and tactical data links such as Link 16, and experience designing systems that operate across multi-domain environments
Experience with real-time and embedded systems engineering for mission-critical applications, including sensor fusion and multi-domain data integration across air, land, sea, space, and cyber domains
Demonstrated experience with digital engineering practices and model-based design applied across defense acquisition programs
Direct experience supporting federal government customers in a contractor environment, with a working understanding of mission requirements, acquisition processes, and the competitive federal market
Proven experience contributing to competitive federal pursuits, including technical solution development, architecture design, or competitive positioning in support of capture or proposal efforts
Demonstrated ability to translate complex mission engineering concepts into compelling solution narratives for capture teams, executive leadership, and government evaluators
A demonstrated bias for action and a track record of delivering technical work that contributed directly to competitive wins
US citizenship and ability to obtain a Top Secret security clearance

Desired Qualifications:

Active TS/SCI with Polygraph eligibility
Direct experience in capture management, proposal development, or technical volume leadership on large-scale, competitive federal mission systems or defense acquisition bids
Experience with Joint All-Domain Command and Control (JADC2) architecture, cross-domain integration, and the technical frameworks that enable multi-domain operations at scale
Familiarity with autonomous systems design and human-machine teaming architectures for contested and operationally demanding environments
Experience with space systems architecture including proliferated low earth orbit (pLEO) constellation integration and space-ground link design for mission applications
Working knowledge of AI-enabled mission systems and algorithm-driven decision support architectures operating at the tactical edge in degraded or contested environments
Experience designing resilient and survivable communications architectures for denied, degraded, intermittent, and limited (DDIL) operational environments
Familiarity with digital twin modeling applied to mission systems testing, simulation, and operational readiness assessment across the defense acquisition lifecycle
Working knowledge of Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA) and open systems architecture principles aligned to DoD acquisition policy and program office expectations
Experience presenting mission system architectures and technical solutions directly to senior government customers, program offices, or operational commands
Prior experience developing competitive positioning materials, technical discriminators, or solution playbooks that supported pursuit efforts in the federal mission systems or defense market
Relevant certifications such as INCOSE Certified Systems Engineering Professional (CSEP), defense acquisition certifications aligned to DAU or DoD 5000 series programs, PMP, or relevant domain-specific defense technology credentials

Partner with business to translate needs into solutions

Partner with UX/Product to improve conversion, performance, and accessibility

Ensure reliable routing, IVR, telephony, and case workflows
Enable seamless data flow across Salesforce and custom applications

Drive CI/CD, performance, and tight integration with CRM and contact center platforms
Partner with Product to evolve capabilities aligned to business goals

Enable a unified customer data model and Customer 360 view

7+ years of engineering experience and 4+ years leading engineering managers, tech leads, or senior technical specialists.  
Deep, hands-on leadership experience across the Salesforce ecosystem, including Sales Cloud and Service Cloud at scale (Salesforce certifications strongly preferred).  
Demonstrated experience delivering Experience Cloud capabilities in a regulated, customer-facing environment.  
Experience leading a contact center platform in production (Amazon Connect strongly preferred; equivalent CCaaS experience considered) including IVR, routing, telephony, recording, and CTI integration with Salesforce.  
Hands-on experience leading custom-built .NET application engineering including architecture, performance, modernization, CI/CD, and production operations in a contact center or CRM-adjacent context.  
Strong understanding of CRM data model, integration patterns, APIs, eventing, identity, and customer 360 across heterogeneous platforms including .NET applications.  
Working knowledge of data privacy and regulatory requirements (GDPR, CCPA, PCI, HIPAA where applicable) and partnership with Security and Legal teams.  
Track record of running engineering operating cadences, vendor management, and budget discipline.  

Preferred  

Hands-on experience with Agentforce and Einstein, including responsible AI guardrails and adoption measurement.  
Experience with AWS services adjacent to Amazon Connect (Lex, Lambda, Kinesis, Contact Lens, Connect Cases).  
Experience integrating CRM and .NET applications with ERP and data platforms.  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree a plus.

N/A

jobs.description:
About Faire

Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

About The Role

The Discovery Experience team at Faire sits at the intersection of search, evaluate, and personalization — shaping how retailers find the products they love. Our mission is to build the most intuitive, intelligent, and delightful discovery experience in wholesale: one that feels less like a search engine and more like a trusted merchant with an encyclopedic knowledge of what's in stock and what will sell.

We're looking for an experienced leader to lead our Discovery Experience team. In this role, you will partner closely with product, design, and machine learning teams to craft search and discovery experiences that are fast, relevant, and deeply personalized. You bring a strong point of view on what great search UX looks like, you believe AI is transforming how people find things, and you're excited to build at that frontier.

You will own a critical part of the discovery experience, spanning search, recommendations, and Gen-AI experience that drives a meaningful share of marketplace engagement, conversion, and retailer success. This role sits at the center of some of Faire’s most important product and technical challenges: building high-scale, low-latency systems that help retailers navigate millions of products with speed, relevance, and trust, while pushing the frontier of AI-powered discovery.

As a leader in Discovery, you will shape not only team execution, but also the longer-term technical and organizational direction of discovery at Faire — influencing strategy across product engineering, ML, and infrastructure. You’ll help unify retrieval, ranking, personalization, and UX into a cohesive system, while enabling fast experimentation and measurable business impact.

What You'll Do

Define and execute the technical vision for Faire's discovery experience, spanning search UX, recommendations, and AI-powered discovery, ensuring every retailer can effortlessly find what they're looking for.
Lead, mentor, and grow a team of engineers focused on the retailer-facing discovery surface, fostering a culture of craft, ownership, and continuous learning.
Drive the integration of Algo and AI/LLM-powered capabilities into the discovery experience — from natural language search to intelligent query understanding and personalized results.
Partner with product and design to raise the bar on search UX, ensuring the experience is intuitive, accessible, and optimized for how retailers actually shop.
Enable rapid experimentation across discovery surfaces, working closely with ML teams to iterate on ranking, surfacing, and personalization.
Champion observability and quality across the discovery stack, building the right instrumentation to understand user behavior and proactively improve the experience.
Drive cross-functional collaboration across relevance, ML, infrastructure, and product engineering to deliver cohesive, end-to-end discovery improvements.
Attract, hire, and retain top engineering talent, fostering an inclusive and psychologically safe team culture that encourages bold ideas and diverse perspectives.
Work closely with leadership to align discovery investments with Faire's growth strategy and marketplace priorities.

You Might Thrive In This Role If You

Have experience building search or discovery products end-to-end, with a strong appreciation for the interplay between UX, relevance, and infrastructure.
Are genuinely excited about AI-powered discovery — you've worked with LLMs, semantic search, or conversational interfaces and believe they're reshaping how people find things.
Have a user-first mindset: you think deeply about search UX, query understanding, and how small UI decisions drive big differences in retailer satisfaction and conversion.
Have a strong background in building and shipping consumer or B2B product features at scale, with experience collaborating closely with product and design.
Have led high-performing engineering teams, with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
Enjoy working across disciplines — with relevance engineers, ML practitioners, product managers, and designers — to deliver experiences that are greater than the sum of their parts.
Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and bringing clarity and structure to complex, multi-team problems.
Believe in a culture of radical candor and psychological safety, and lead by example in encouraging diverse viewpoints and open discussion.

Qualifications

8+ years of experience in engineering roles, with at least 3+ years in engineering leadership positions.
Demonstrated experience working on search, discovery, recommendations, or related product domains — either on the UX/product side or the relevance/infrastructure side (ideally both).
Hands-on familiarity with AI and ML-powered product development, including experience integrating or shipping LLM-based features, semantic search, or personalization systems.
Strong product sensibility and communication skills, with the ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear technical direction.
Experience driving cross-functional initiatives and aligning engineering roadmaps with product and business priorities.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Salary Range

San Francisco: The salary range for this role is $231,000 - $318,000 per year.

This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors such as transferable skills, work experience, market demands, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday). Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting.

Why you’ll love working at Faire

Move fast: You'll own meaningful problems that serve customers around the globe with the agency to move fast and see your results clearly.
Equipped to scale: We invest in what matters, including the latest enterprise AI tools, to help you work smarter and get more out of every day.
Best in class: Our team is full of sharp, kind, and generous colleagues who care about their craft and about helping you grow in yours.
Real rewards. Competitive pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits designed to support your life inside and outside of work.
Belonging: We're intentional about building an environment where every Faire employee has equal access to opportunities, growth, and success.

Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. We’re backed by some of the top investors in retail and tech including: Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Forerunner Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, and DST Global. We have headquarters in San Francisco and Kitchener-Waterloo, and a global employee presence across offices in Toronto, London, and New York. Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq ARWR) is a commercial stage biopharmaceutical company that develops medicines that treat intractable diseases by silencing the genes that cause them. Using a broad portfolio of RNA chemistries and efficient modes of delivery, Arrowhead therapies trigger the RNA interference mechanism to induce rapid, deep, and durable knockdown of target genes. RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead’s RNAi-based therapeutics leverage this natural pathway of gene silencing.
Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. The depth and versatility of our RNAi technologies enables us to potentially address conditions in virtually any therapeutic area and pursue disease targets that are not otherwise addressable by small molecules and biologics. Arrowhead is leading the field in bringing the promise of RNAi to address diseases outside of the liver, and our clinical pipeline includes disease targets in the liver and lung with a promising pipeline of preclinical candidates.
Arrowhead’s corporate headquarters is in Pasadena, CA with research and development teams in Madison, WI & San Diego, CA, and a state of the art manufacturing facility in Verona, WI.  Our employees are nimble, science-driven innovators who are collaborating to bring new therapies to patients in need.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Infrastructure Security
jobs.description:
The Senior Manager, Infrastructure Security, is responsible for defining, maturing, and advancing the Firm's infrastructure security strategy across servers, operating systems, cloud platforms, data protection technologies, core infrastructure networks, and foundational technology services. This leader will establish security standards, drive engineering excellence, and ensure security controls are consistently designed, implemented, measured, and continuously improved across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. The role partners closely with Infrastructure Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Architecture, Identity & Access Management, Network Engineering, Risk Management, and Technology Operations teams to reduce cyber risk while enabling business growth and innovation.

The successful candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership skills and is equally comfortable developing long-term security roadmaps and rolling up their sleeves to solve technical challenges. This individual must be highly analytical, detail-oriented, adaptable, and capable of navigating ambiguity while driving measurable security outcomes in a fast-paced enterprise environment.

Essential Job Duties & Responsibilities

Define and execute the Firm's infrastructure security strategy, roadmap, and operating model.
Develop and maintain plans to mature infrastructure security capabilities aligned with business objectives and enterprise risk priorities.
Establish security standards, architectural patterns, engineering principles, and technical guardrails across infrastructure platforms.
Lead the design, implementation, and management of security controls across: Windows and Linux server environments, Endpoint platforms (Windows, macOS, mobile), Cloud environments (Azure, SaaS/PaaS etc.), Storage and data protection platforms, Network security technologies (Firewalls, IDS/IPS etc.), Virtualization and container platforms, Remote access technologies
Partner with cloud and infrastructure engineering teams to ensure secure deployment patterns for compute, storage, identity integration, and networking.
Establish and execute governance and monitoring processes for cloud security posture management and workload protection
Provide strategic oversight for network security controls, segmentation, secure connectivity, and perimeter defense technologies.
Govern and oversee optimization of security technologies such as firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, network access control, and remote access (VPN).
Drive automation and engineering excellence through infrastructure-as-code, policy-as-code, and security automation initiatives.
Evaluate, select, and manage lifecycle of security-owned infrastructure protection technologies in partnership with enterprise infrastructure and application teams.
Identify and drive remediation of infrastructure security risks including misconfigurations, missing controls, unpatched systems, and excessive system-level privileges.
Support secure adoption of new infrastructure technologies including container platforms, platform services, and automation frameworks.
Establish metrics, key performance indicators (KPIs), and key risk indicators (KRIs) to measure program effectiveness and security maturity.
Influence engineering and technology decisions to ensure security requirements are integrated early in the design and delivery lifecycle.
Communicate infrastructure security risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to senior leadership and technical stakeholders.
Stay current on emerging infrastructure threats, vulnerabilities, and defensive technologies.
Drive continuous improvement of infrastructure security controls and detection capabilities.
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of infrastructure security engineers.
Promote a security engineering culture focused on automation, resilience, and measurable risk reduction.
Participate in on-call rotation to support after-hours incident response and critical security operations as needed.

EDUCATION

Bachelor’s degree in information security, IT, risk management, related discipline, or equivalent experience
Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or similar preferred

Skills And Experience

10+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure security, network security, cloud security, or related cybersecurity disciplines, including experience within complex, large-scale enterprise environments
Proven experience developing, implementing, and maturing security programs that protect critical infrastructure across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid technology environments.
Demonstrated success leading security engineering initiatives that reduce risk, improve security posture, and strengthen resilience across enterprise technology platforms.
Experience partnering closely with infrastructure, cloud, network, and application engineering teams to design and implement security controls at scale while enabling business and technology objectives.
Deep technical knowledge across several of the following domains: Operating system security (Windows and Linux), Network security including firewalls, segmentation, remote access technologies, intrusion detection and prevention systems, and Zero Trust principles, Cloud security controls and configuration management for Azure and Saas/PaaS environments, Data protection and DLP technologies, Infrastructure logging, monitoring, and telemetry pipelines, Security automation and scripting using technologies such as PowerShell, Python, Terraform, or similar tools
Experience evaluating and implementing enterprise security tooling for infrastructure protection.
Proven people leadership experience, including building, developing, mentoring, and managing high-performing technical teams.
Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and cross-functional stakeholders.
Exceptional organizational, planning, and program management skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, make sound decisions under pressure, balance strategic planning with hands-on technical engagement, and communicate effectively with both technical and business audiences.
Highly analytical with exceptional problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity and drive results in complex, fast-paced environments.

Salary Information

NY Only: The estimated base salary range for this position is $190,000 to $220,000 at the time of posting.

The actual salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including without limitation, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and if applicable, the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job. This role is exempt meaning it is not overtime pay eligible.

Simpson Thacher will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

jobs.title: Director, Platform Architect Principal - Wealth Management
jobs.description:
Your opportunity

At Schwab, you’re empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us “challenge the status quo” and transform the finance industry together.

We believe in the importance of in-office collaboration and fully intend for the selected candidate for this role to work on site in the specified location(s).

Schwab Technology Services enables the future of how clients manage their money by providing innovative and reliable technology products and services as a part of our ongoing commitment to democratize access to investing and financial planning.

Wealth and Advice Solutions Technology (WAS Tech) is an organization within Schwab Technology Services dedicated to supporting the technology needs of the Wealth and Advice Solutions (WAS) business. Our mission is to empower high-net-worth (HNW) and ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) clients by delivering differentiated offerings and tailored financial advice that meet their unique needs.

This role is part of a highly talented and experienced architecture team responsible for setting the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Schwab Wealth and Advice Solutions platform. The team works in close partnership with Enterprise Architecture, ensuring architectural decisions support long-term business goals, future scalability and high resiliency. The team’s collaborative approach with product leaders fosters an environment where cutting-edge technology solutions are appreciated as a critical component of achieving business objectives which drive ongoing market leadership.

In this position, you will collaborate closely with a talented, motivated team of technologists who are passionate about making technology a strategic differentiator for Schwab’s WAS business and its clients. Your leadership and technical acumen will be essential in shaping a cohesive architecture strategy that aligns with business objectives and industry best practices.

This role requires a strong background in leading architecture strategy as well as hands-on experience throughout the implementation lifecycle. You should be comfortable influencing technology direction, providing expert guidance, and ensuring the successful delivery of complex, integrated solutions in a fast-paced, agile environment.

Key Responsibilities

Define and evolve the target architecture for wealth management platforms, including Schwab Wealth advisory systems, portfolio management, CRM integrations, client portals, digital advice, Wealth vendor integration.
Lead architecture strategy, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps that improve scalability, security, availability, and advisor and client experiences.
Design secure, scalable integration patterns across core wealth applications, custodians, market data providers, enterprise services, third-party fintech platforms, and AI-enabled capabilities.
Drive platform modernization through cloud adoption, API enablement, microservices, event-driven architecture, containerization, and selective AI/ML implementation.
Collaborate with business leaders, product teams, peer architects, enterprise architects, engineers, and external vendors to translate business capabilities into cohesive technical solutions and interoperable platform designs.
Evaluate and recommend wealth technology platforms, vendor ecosystem capabilities, and emerging technologies to enhance advisor productivity, client experience, and operational efficiency.
Provide architectural leadership across the software delivery lifecycle, resolving complex technical challenges and guiding implementation decisions.
Ensure solutions comply with financial services regulations, cybersecurity standards, AI governance, and data privacy requirements.
Stay current on industry trends in wealth management technology, generative AI, analytics, and digital advisory platforms, and apply that insight to drive innovation.

What you have

Required Qualifications

Extensive experience serving as a Technical Architect for large-scale, enterprise-wide wealth management platforms, with deep expertise across portfolio management, trading and rebalancing, risk, reporting, financial planning, CRM, client engagement, and wealth management operations.
10+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, preferably in Java, with at least 5+ years designing, developing, and integrating solutions in the investment services or wealth management industry.
Strong technical depth in enterprise application architecture across distributed systems, APIs, middleware, microservices, event-driven systems, and hybrid cloud environments.
Hands-on experience designing and implementing cloud-native solutions, with expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) strongly preferred.
Solid understanding of the wealth management technology ecosystem, including custodians, portfolio management platforms, CRM solutions, reporting tools, financial planning systems, and advisor workstation technologies.
Experience leading cloud transformation and digital modernization initiatives in financial services.
Knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements, data governance, cybersecurity principles, responsible AI practices, and security controls relevant to financial services environments.
Experience supporting production operations and applying Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles to improve system reliability, observability, performance, and operational excellence.
Familiarity with AI/ML integration patterns, modern data architecture concepts, and the practical application of emerging technologies in enterprise platforms.
Excellent communication, documentation, stakeholder management, and leadership skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, build alignment, and drive decisions across diverse teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Utilizes intelligence of the investment services industry, market, and competition to influence business strategy.
Promotes creativity, experimentation, and strategic thinking to differentiate Schwab from its competitors.
Experience with Enterprise Architecture practices and standards.
10+ years architecting scalable, highly available web, UI/UX, and microservices-based solutions.
Hands-on experience with Angular and modern front-end architecture patterns.
Strong experience architecting and building cloud-based or cloud-ready applications strongly preferred.
Experience with cloud-native architecture and platforms such as Kubernetes, GKE, API management, and Apigee.
Experience with relational or cloud-native databases, including Oracle and Cloud SQL PostgreSQL.
Experience with security, IAM, and enterprise-grade financial systems integration is a plus.
Familiarity with AI/ML integration concepts, Vertex AI, BigQuery, data analytics, and observability and monitoring tools.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, with GitHub suite preferred.
Experience working in Agile development environments.

In addition to the salary range, this role is also eligible for bonus or incentive opportunities.

What’s in it for you

At Schwab, you’re empowered to shape your future. We champion your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture of trust and collaboration—so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our Hybrid Work and Flexibility approach balances our ongoing commitment to workplace flexibility, serving our clients, and our strong belief in the value of being together in person on a regular basis.

We offer a competitive benefits package that takes care of the whole you – both today and in the future:

401(k) with company match and Employee stock purchase plan
Paid time for vacation, volunteering, and 28-day sabbatical after every 5 years of service for eligible positions
Paid parental leave and family building benefits
Tuition reimbursement
Health, dental, and vision insurance

About the Role

We're seeking a Director of Engineering to lead a small, established engineering team through its next stage of growth. Recently acquired by Metro Global, the company has the stability and backing of institutional ownership and is at an inflection point: ready to modernize its development practices, sharpen execution, and accelerate delivery.

This is a hands-on, player-coach role, combining small-company freedom, influence, and growth with stable backing and resources. You'll lead a team of ~twenty engineers across backend, frontend, and QA while staying close enough to the code and architecture to make technical decisions. You'll partner closely with existing technical leadership to set direction and own the day-to-day execution that turns vision into shipped product.

You should be passionate about designing and iterating on development processes, leveraging AI tools, helping the team perform at their best, and solving varied problems as the company grows. No specific prior title is required, as long as you have experience working with a team to improve processes and output.

Responsibilities

Lead and mentor the engineering team across backend, frontend, and QA
Own the overall technical architecture and make key decisions on system design and technology choices
Diagnose and eliminate the bottlenecks slowing delivery, implementing improvements quickly

About Syngene

Incorporated in 1993, Syngene International Ltd. is an innovation-focused global discovery, development and manufacturing organization providing integrated scientific services to the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, nutrition, animal health, consumer goods and specialty chemical industries around the world. Syngene’ s clientele includes world leaders such as Bristol-Myers Squibb, Baxter, Amgen, GSK, Merck KGaA and Herbalife. Its innovative culture is driven by the passion of its 4240- strong team of scientists who work with clients from around the world to solve their scientific problems, improve R&D productivity, speed up time to market and lower the cost of innovation.

At Syngene, safety is at the heart of everything we do personally and professionally. Syngene has placed safety at par with business performance with shared responsibility and accountability, including following safety guidelines, procedures and SOPs, in letter and spirit.

The Director, Engineering and Maintenance provides strategic and technical leadership across engineering, facilities, and maintenance functions. The Director partners with senior leadership to drive capital projects, continuous improvement, and technology implementation to enhance equipment reliability, site capabilities, and operational performance. The director is accountable for Facilities operations, ensuring maintenance, utilities, and infrastructure are effectively maintained. Additionally, this role establishes engineering standards, supports new product introductions, and builds and develops high-performing team.

Oversee Facilities, Utilities, Maintenance, and Engineering functions, ensuring alignment with site and business objectives

Establish and maintain engineering standards, best practices, and governance across all systems and processes
Lead cross-functional teams to drive equipment reliability, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement initiatives
Serve as a departmental point of contact during internal and external audits and regulatory inspections
Collaborate with senior leadership to develop business cases, resource plans, and engineering strategies
Manage departmental budgets, resource allocation, and site capital planning.
Oversee external engineering contractors, consultants, and service providers
Support troubleshooting and resolution of complex technical issues impacting manufacturing and facility systems and operations
Promote professional development of staff through coaching, mentoring, and training

Demonstrated career progression with increasing scope of responsibility, leadership, and organizational impact

Experience in facility planning, asset lifecycle management, and infrastructure strategy

Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
Customer-focused and quality-driven, with a commitment to operational excellence and continuous improvement

The Role

The Sr. Director of Software Development leads our engineering organization with a sharp focus on quality, platform stability, and execution discipline across a complex, mature software ecosystem. This role ensures that software delivered to franchisees and customers is reliable, predictable, and scalable, and that issues are prevented early in the development lifecycle rather than discovered late or in production.

This role pairs executive leadership with strong technical depth. The Sr. Director of Software Development will establish development standards, enforce accountability, and partner cross-functionally to streamline release processes while remaining close enough to the architecture to review complex implementations and drive root-cause problem solving.

Work Location: This position follows a hybrid work schedule. We are seeking candidates based in the Greater Los Angeles area, or within a reasonable commuting distance, who can work from our Los Angeles headquarters on Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday to support collaboration and business needs. Remote work is available on the remaining weekdays.

Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship. At this time, we are unable to sponsor or transfer employment visas. Candidates who require visa sponsorship now or in the future will not be considered.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Leadership & Process Discipline

Establish and enforce a strong Definition of Done (DoD) so work is complete, thoroughly tested, and production-ready before deployment.
Drive execution discipline and accountability across Software Development for correctness, completeness, and system impact.
Streamline release processes to improve predictability, reduce last-minute deployment risk, and eliminate post-release fixes.
Build a culture of engineering excellence through accountability, ownership, continuous improvement, and disciplined execution.

Platform Quality & Technical Execution

Own overall platform stability and output quality, systematically minimizing regressions and production defects.
Provide technical leadership and guidance, including reviewing complex architectural implementations and ensuring sound design decisions.
Ensure developers understand, design for, and manage cross-system dependencies in a complex multi-tenant environment.
Lead root-cause analysis (RCA) for production incidents and implement systemic safeguards to prevent recurrence.
Develop and execute technical improvement plans that address technical debt, simplify architecture, improve maintainability, and increase long-term platform reliability.
Own the quality of software releases by ensuring engineering practices, validation, and release readiness consistently reduce production defects and improve predictability.
Help establish and enforce Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD) standards to improve execution quality throughout the development lifecycle.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Talent Development

Partner closely with Product and QA leadership to ensure requirements are build-ready upstream before development begins.
Mentor and coach Senior Developers and Developers, fostering their technical growth while strengthening problem-solving abilities, technical expertise, and overall execution across the team.
Collaborate cross-functionally to align software delivery with broader business imperatives and franchisee operational needs.

Candidate Profile

The strongest candidate is part executive leader and part technical strategist: someone who has a track record of instilling discipline and reducing incidents in complex software systems, but who can still go deep into architectural and debugging discussions when needed.

Experience: Typically 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including at least 5 years leading software development organizations with responsibility for engineering quality, delivery, and people leadership.
Leadership Background: Proven experience leading software engineering organizations (VP, Director, or Head of Engineering level) within mid-sized, growing companies (approx. 100–1,000 employees).
Hands-on Technical Credibility: Earlier in their career, the successful candidate was an accomplished software engineer and still possesses the technical depth to challenge architectural decisions, mentor senior engineers, and quickly understand complex production issues.
System Experience: Significant experience working on mature, complex codebases and multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
Quality & SDLC Track Record: Demonstrated success improving software quality, stabilizing platforms, reducing production incidents, and enforcing SDLC discipline.
Systems Mindset: Thinks in terms of full system health rather than isolated features, with a relentless focus on preventing problems before they hit production.
Decisive & Accountable: Comfortable setting a high bar, enforcing development standards, holding teams accountable, and making tough technical decisions.
Cross-Functional Communicator: Strong communicator who effectively translates technical risks and system trade-offs for Product, QA, and executive leadership.

jobs.title: Sr Manager, Salesforce Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About The Role

The Senior Manager, Salesforce Platform Engineering leads a team of Salesforce engineers responsible for building and supporting reliable, secure, and scalable solutions across our Salesforce platform. This role owns the engineering behind our Go-To-Market processes, spanning Lead-to-Opportunity, Opportunity-to-Quote, and Quote-to-Cash, along with the integrations that connect Salesforce to billing, provisioning, ERP, and enterprise data warehouse systems, while managing, mentoring, and growing the engineers who deliver them. The ideal candidate combines hands-on Salesforce platform development and data migration/integration experience with proven team leadership, and is fluent in applying cutting-edge AI technologies to real engineering work.

What You’ll Do

Own and lead engineering delivery for Salesforce-based Go-To-Market platforms supporting Lead-to-Opportunity, Opportunity-to-Quote, and Quote-to-Cash processes.
Lead and manage a team of engineers, including hiring, onboarding, workforce planning, regular feedback, performance management, and career development.
Drive platform modernization and consolidation efforts, including org consolidation, data migrations, and lifecycle improvements delivered with strong data integrity and minimal business disruption.
Partner with product, sales operations, revenue operations, business stakeholders, QA, data warehouse, and data quality teams to align priorities, manage risk, and deliver successful outcomes.
Champion the adoption of cutting-edge AI technologies within the team, applying AI-powered tools and agentic approaches beyond basic chat use, to automate workflows, accelerate delivery, and improve sales and service productivity.
Improve platform health by simplifying data flows, reducing technical debt, strengthening data quality controls, and improving observability and supportability.
Advance engineering practices through CI/CD automation, static code analysis, AI engineering, and code review standards.
Guide technical decisions through design reviews, code and automation reviews, troubleshooting, and knowledge sharing.

What You’ll Bring

7+ years of experience in software engineering, with 5+ years developing on the Salesforce platform.
4+ years of people management experience leading Salesforce or enterprise engineering teams, including hiring, performance management, and career development. Experience leading other leaders.
Hands-on experience developing on the Salesforce platform (Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, REST/SOAP APIs, and related tools), with strong expertise in Salesforce data modeling, SQL, SOQL, CPQ and Quote-to-Cash architectures, security, automation, platform design patterns, and data lifecycle management.
Proven experience designing, delivering, and supporting integrations, migrations, transformations, reconciliations, and monitoring across Salesforce and enterprise systems; direct hands-on experience with org consolidations, org-to-org data migrations, or Salesforce-to-Salesforce integrations strongly preferred.
Experience across Salesforce Sales, Revenue, and Experience Clouds, with a working understanding of GTM processes such as lead management, forecasting, territory management, renewals, and amendments. Experience with CPQ or Agentic Revenue Management strongly preferred.
Experience with CI/CD and DevOps tooling for Salesforce (such as Git, Jenkins, Gearset, Copado, or similar) and with enterprise ETL or data movement tools (such as MuleSoft, DB Amp or Apache HOP).
Demonstrated, hands-on proficiency with cutting-edge AI technologies, such as building or deploying AI agents, LLM-powered automation, or applied AI/ML tooling in engineering workflows, beyond general-purpose chat usage.
Strong strategic prioritization and problem-solving skills, including triage, debugging, performance optimization, root cause analysis, and incident support.
Clear communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical direction and align senior stakeholders across technical and non-technical teams.
Experience leading distributed, global, or vendor/offshore teams preferred.

Bonus Skills

Salesforce Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Salesforce Platform Developer certifications required.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent practical experience also considered.
Demonstrated application of AI/agentic tooling in professional projects (portfolio, case studies, or concrete examples) strongly preferred.

What You'll Get

Unlimited paid time off, 12 paid holidays including 4 global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
Paid parental leave: 8 weeks for all parents, 16 weeks for birthing parents
Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on your first day

Tax-advantaged spending accounts for healthcare, dependent care, and commuting
Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

jobs.description:
At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.

Position Overview

The Senior Director is responsible for leading the site’s process-facing engineering functions—including process engineering, automation, and maintenance—to ensure the team has the capacity, capability, and leadership to support site startup and long-term manufacturing goals. This role provides both administrative and technical leadership for engineering operations.

As a member of the Lilly Site Lead Team, the Senior Director contributes to shaping the site’s strategic direction, building organizational capability, and managing cross-functional issues. The team works collectively to achieve long-term business objectives, adapt to evolving corporate and external environments, and develop the site for future success.

During the project delivery and startup phases, the Site Lead Team will operate dynamically to support project execution, build the organization, implement GMP systems and processes, and establish site culture. This will require strong collaboration, creativity, and resilience.

Responsibilities

Pre-Startup & Startup Phase

Organizational Development: Collaborate with the Site Lead Team to build a capable, inclusive, and resilient organization focused on safety, quality, and operational excellence.
Functional Strategy: Define priorities and roadmap for process engineering, automation, and maintenance. Develop systems and processes by leveraging internal expertise and external best practices.
Safety Leadership: Actively contribute to the site HSE Lead Team to ensure safety is embedded throughout project delivery and startup.
Project Support: Act as end user for process equipment—providing input on design, commissioning, and startup plans to align with both project and long-term site goals.
Team Structure: Design and evolve the engineering organization to ensure the right resources and leadership are in place for GMP manufacturing.
System Readiness: Ensure qualified and safe states for equipment, processes, utilities, and facilities are established and maintained.
Corporate Alignment: Build strong technical relationships with corporate teams and champion strategic initiatives at the site level.

Post-Startup Phase

Ongoing Strategy Execution: Continue refining and executing the engineering roadmap, aligning functional goals with site priorities.
Compliance & Standards: Ensure adherence to corporate policies and standards across environmental, safety, and quality domains.
External Benchmarking: Maintain an outward focus to identify and apply best practices from across the industry and internal network.
Asset Management: Partner with Facilities Engineering to manage site investments—planning, prioritizing, and executing capital projects aligned with site objectives.
Operational Integrity: Ensure equipment remains in a qualified and safe state, and that maintenance is performed and documented to the highest standards.
Governance & Controls: Establish and maintain robust control systems to manage compliance and escalate issues appropriately.
Leadership Development: Cultivate future technical and managerial leaders for the site and potential global roles.

Basic Requirements

Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline.
10+ years of experience in a leadership role managing teams within the pharmaceutical industry.

Additional Preferences

Experience in API manufacturing, including implementation of a Process Safety Management program.
Strong understanding of cGMPs and their application to manufacturing operations.
Proven ability to build effective relationships across all organizational levels—from site leadership to frontline teams.
Demonstrated success in leading projects from initiation to completion, meeting timelines, budgets, and performance standards.
Track record of developing and managing high-performing, engaged teams with a focus on safety, quality, and strong team culture.

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Vice President, Product Management – AI Platform Experience

As Vice President of Product Management for Lux
, ServiceNow’s AI-native experience platform, you will define and lead the strategy for the next generation of enterprise AI experiences. Lux provides the common platform that brings together AI-first user experiences, agentic AI, contextual intelligence, and reusable platform capabilities that enable every Business Unit to build consistent, intelligent, and enterprise-grade applications.

You will partner closely with executive leaders across Product, Engineering, Design, Research, Customer Success, and Go-to-Market teams to define the long-term vision, product strategy, and roadmap for Lux while driving adoption across ServiceNow’s product portfolio. Your leadership will establish the standards, governance, and reusable platform capabilities that enable innovation at scale, ensuring customers receive a cohesive, high-quality AI-native experience regardless of the applications they use.

As AI rapidly transforms enterprise software, you will lead one of ServiceNow’s most strategic platform investments, shaping how millions of users interact with AI across the platform through consumer grade experiences. By balancing long-term platform strategy with the evolving needs of Business Units and customers, you will accelerate AI adoption, improve customer efficiency, and strengthen ServiceNow’s leadership in enterprise AI.

Define and execute the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Lux, ServiceNow’s AI-native experience platform, aligning platform investments with the company’s AI strategy and long-term growth objectives.
Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Product Management leaders responsible for the AI-native platform experience.

Drive innovation by shaping the future of AI-first experiences, agentic workflows, contextual intelligence, and next-generation interaction models.

Partner closely with Engineering, Design, and Architecture to deliver scalable, secure, compliant, and enterprise-ready platform capabilities.

Represent the Lux platform strategy with executive leadership, strategic customers, and key partners while helping shape ServiceNow’s long-term AI vision.

Qualifications

15+ years of product management experience, including 8+ years leading high-performing product management organizations and senior product leaders.
Proven experience defining and executing product strategy for enterprise platforms, AI products, cloud platforms, or developer ecosystems at scale.
Deep understanding of enterprise software architecture, distributed systems, AI technologies, large language models (LLMs), agentic AI, and modern application platforms.

Experience leading organizations through ambiguity, rapid technology evolution, and organizational change while maintaining a strong focus on execution and customer outcomes.

Experience defining and scaling AI-native platforms, enterprise AI experiences, or agentic AI solutions used across multiple products or business units.

Head of Investor Relations
US-Based | Executive Leadership

The Opportunity

Our client is building the infrastructure backbone of the AI era, developing large-scale, purpose-built data center campuses engineered for hyperscale computing. With committed capital, campuses in active development, and ambitious growth plans, the business requires a disciplined and sophisticated capital markets function.
Our client is seeking a Head of Investor Relations to lead relationships with the investors supporting its growth. As the business expands across multiple campuses and financing structures, its investor base will grow in size and complexity—spanning institutional equity, project finance, corporate debt, and potentially the public markets.
This executive will shape how the company communicates its strategy, reports its progress, and earns investors’ confidence. It is a company-defining opportunity to build the capital narrative and investor relations function of a rapidly growing infrastructure platform.

The Role

Reporting to the President and working closely with the CEO and CFO, the Head of Investor Relations will serve as the primary bridge between our client and its investors.
The successful candidate will own the investor narrative, reporting strategy, and relationships across the capital stack. They will translate operational progress into a clear and credible investment story for equity investors, lenders, and rating agencies while establishing the reporting systems and disclosure practices needed to support future fundraising and growth.

Key Responsibilities

Investor Narrative and Positioning

Own and continually refine the company’s equity story and investment thesis as its portfolio, financing structures, and market conditions evolve.
Develop messaging, presentations, supporting data, and other materials for each stage of capital formation.
Position the company within the competitive landscape of infrastructure, data center, and AI platforms.

As the Senior Manager of the Security Posture Management (SPM) team within the Product Security Department, you lead the team that secures GitLab's own software factory: the estate we build and ship from. jobs.title: Chief Digital Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

The Role

Anduril's Multi-National Digital Infrastructure (MDI) team builds and sustains the sovereign cloud, classified networks, edge compute, and coalition interoperability layer that Anduril's products depend on across nations and classification levels. The Principal Systems Engineer is MDI's chief engineer -- owning the technical vision, architectural coherence, and engineering standard for this infrastructure globally.

This is not a staff role that writes architecture docs and advises. You build. You ship. You set the standard by doing the work and then codifying the pattern so it scales without you in the room.

What You'll Do

Architectural Vision & Coherence

Own the MDI technical architecture end-to-end: sovereign cloud (IL5/IL6), classified bilateral networks, maritime C2 patterns, edge-to-cloud pipelines, and coalition interoperability
Ensure decisions in one workstream don't create debt in another -- hold the full picture across 8+ concurrent milestones
Make the hard architectural calls: technology selection, accreditation-driven design constraints, build vs. buy, when to diverge from common baseline
Drive the "build once, deploy per nation" model -- common baseline infrastructure with intentional, late divergence

Engineering Standards & Quality

Define and enforce the engineering bar: IaC practices, security baselines, deployment patterns, documentation requirements, peer review process
Establish RFC-governed decision processes so architectural choices are deliberate, recorded, and reviewable
Own reliability and quality improvement -- set measurable targets and drive the team toward them
Translate national accreditation requirements (DCSA, IRAP/ISM, NCSC) into engineering work, not paperwork

Scale & Reuse

Build the common infrastructure patterns that let MDI expand to new nations and classification levels without proportional engineering effort
Each subsequent national deployment should be faster than the last -- configuration over engineering
Own the module library, deployment templates, and accreditation frameworks that make this possible
Prevent the bespoke/incompatible pattern that every other defense company falls into at scale

Team Leadership

Technical leader for MDI's distributed engineering team across US, UK, and AUS
Set direction, mentor IC3-IC5 engineers, review work, raise the bar
Define the technical hiring bar and skills framework for MDI engineering roles
Establish cross-timezone collaboration patterns that function without requiring you as a bottleneck

Division Interface

Represent MDI's technical capabilities and constraints to Maritime and (2027+) Maneuver Dominance leadership
Shape what's technically possible -- translate engineering reality into program decisions
Interface with adjacent technical teams (InfoSec, CorpTech, MTOC, Enabling Technology) on shared concerns

What You Bring

Required

Deep experience designing and building classified network infrastructure across multiple nations or accreditation frameworks
Hands-on with sovereign cloud architecture -- not just design, but implementation (IaC, module development, deployment automation)
Experience with COMSEC integration, HAIPE/KG-175X, and the intersection of network sovereignty and cryptographic key management
Demonstrated ability to set engineering standards for a distributed team and drive adoption without micromanagement
Track record of building reusable infrastructure patterns that scale -- not one-off builds that require re-engineering for each deployment
Understanding of multinational compliance and accreditation (at least 2 of: DCSA/NIST 800-53, IRAP/ISM, NCSC Cyber Essentials+/OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE)
Experience operating as the architectural decision-maker -- not waiting for direction, but setting it
Ability to hold both tactical delivery and strategic architecture simultaneously without sacrificing either

Preferred

Experience in the AUKUS or Five Eyes defense industrial context
Familiarity with bilateral/multilateral classified data sharing mechanisms (CDS, policy-controlled release)
Background in both network engineering and cloud infrastructure (not just one)
Experience with defense accreditation processes from the engineering side -- building systems that pass, not just documenting compliance
Prior experience working with or within allied Defence organizations (US DoD, Australian Defence, UK MOD)

What Success Looks Like

First 90 Days

Document MDI's architectural strategy: current state, target state, and gaps
Establish RFC/review process for architectural decisions across the team
Identify the top 3 reuse opportunities across current national builds and begin codifying them
Build relationships with adjacent technical leaders (InfoSec, CorpTech, MTOC, Enabling Technology)

First 6 Months

Common baseline infrastructure pattern proven across at least 2 nations -- deployment to a new nation demonstrably faster than the first
Engineering standards documented and adopted by the team with measurable quality improvement
Accreditation engineering approach established -- national frameworks translated into repeatable engineering controls
Sovereign cloud and classified network architectures aligned under a single coherent technical strategy

First 12 Months

MDI's infrastructure model is the reference architecture for how Anduril builds sovereign systems globally
Expansion to new divisions scoped and technically ready -- an extension of proven patterns, not a new engineering effort
Reliability and quality metrics trending in the right direction with clear ownership
Engineering team operating at a higher standard -- evidenced by faster deployments, fewer rework cycles, stronger accreditation posture
Technical career path established for MDI engineers with clear growth trajectory

How This Role Fits

This role works in partnership with the MDI Lead. The MDI Lead owns what we build and why -- stakeholder relationships, program prioritization, BD pipeline, team growth strategy, and cross-division influence. The Principal Systems Engineer owns how it's built and how it scales -- architecture, engineering standards, technical feasibility, capability roadmap, hiring bar, and accreditation engineering.

Why This Role Matters

Every nation MDI expands to should get faster -- not harder. The Principal Systems Engineer builds the infrastructure once, codifies the pattern, and ensures each subsequent deployment is a configuration change, not a new engineering effort. That's how one team supports multiple divisions and multiple nations without breaking.

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:
Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

Prioritize automation investments that reduce toil, increase change velocity, and improve MTTR; track benefits through measurable KPIs and error budget adherence.
Ensure secure-by-design automation practices, including access controls, audit trails, and compliance checkpoints; drive adoption across all regions and teams in group.

Testing and Quality Assurance:

Own group wide test strategy and acceptance criteria for configurations, images, and changes; mandate automated regression, canary/blue-green rollouts, and production-safety checks.
Institutionalize quality gates and change readiness reviews; ensure RCAs and corrective actions are systematically integrated into test plans and playbooks.
Run governance forums to assess test coverage, defect escape, and reliability risk; direct group-wide Corrective and Preventive Actions priorities and timelines.

Monitoring and Reliability:

Define network health strategy, SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets across services and regions; enforce consistent telemetry, alerting, and runbook standards.
Lead executive-level incident management for high-severity events; require consistent RCA quality, cross-org learnings, and durable remediation at scale.
Drive resiliency investments (e.g., redundancy, fault isolation, DR exercises); validate business continuity and recovery outcomes against policy and regulatory needs.

Cross-Team Collaboration and Leadership:

Align network strategy with Cloud/Infra, SRE, Security, Product, and Finance; chair architecture and change boards to manage dependencies and risks.
Build leadership capacity through coaching, succession planning, and inclusive practices; set clear expectations for managers and technical leaders across group.
Own strategic vendor relationships and contract negotiations; drive joint roadmaps, performance SLAs, and remediation plans for systemic issues.

Performance and Capacity Management:

Govern capacity planning and forecasting models to meet growth, launches, and expansion; tie plans to budget cycles and supply constraints.
Set performance targets (latency, jitter, packet loss, throughput) and optimization strategies; eliminate hotspots via routing policy, peering, placement, and traffic engineering.
Balance cost, performance, and resiliency trade-offs; implement continuous cost optimization and value tracking for network investments.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

Provides strategic oversight on the management and execution of large-scale projects or initiatives, monitoring timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable to ensure success. Sets strategies for appropriately delegating work, setting priorities, and aligning projects with business needs. Drives the strategic planning process across teams, providing guidance on resources or timelines in anticipation of changes.

Collaboration & Partnership:

Drives a culture of teamwork, empowering teams to build and maintain partnerships with business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to contribute to organizational success. Promotes a culture of transparency and inclusivity where all voices are valued and respected.

Oversees teams leveraging innovative techniques to address significant ambiguous issues, identify root causes, and prevent recurrence, reviewing solutions as needed.

Continuous Learning:

Champions continuous learning to maintain cutting-edge skills and influence organizational best practices. Inspires teams to build and maintain expertise in relevant areas by proactively monitoring emerging trends, technologies, and industry standards to help position the organization as an industry leader. Contributes to the organization’s strategy for learning and development, influencing leadership to foster learning opportunities for the team.

Drives a culture of continuous improvement that sets a standard for efficient and effective processes, protocols, and workflows across the organization. Oversees work to implement large-scale approaches and methods for continued improvement, ensuring changes align with organizational goals. Today, we’re harnessing the boundless possibilities of AI to build the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. At NVIDIA, our storage platforms support some of the most advanced AI and high performance computing work in the world. In this role, you will lead the team that keeps these systems fast, reliable, and ready to scale. This is a chance to grow people, improve systems, and see your work have clear impact.

What You’ll Be Doing

Leading and coaching a team of Storage Production Engineers, creating a collaborative, inclusive, and learning focused environment.
Designing, deploying, and improving large scale storage systems, including distributed storage, parallel file systems, and object storage.
Using automation, monitoring, and analytics to make storage services more reliable, efficient, and easier to operate.
Owning capacity planning, data lifecycle management, cost awareness, and high availability and disaster recovery plans for storage.
Evaluating and adopting modern storage approaches such as NVMe over Fabrics, RDMA, high speed interconnects, and cloud based storage.

Partnering with engineering, DevOps, and AI/ML teams to improve data pipelines, access patterns, and workflow performance.

BS or MS in Computer Science, Storage Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
12+ overall years of experience in large scale storage architecture, operations, production engineering, or infrastructure.

Direct experience managing infrastructure operations including on-call rotations, incident response, ongoing maintenance, troubleshooting, and optimization of production systems, managing SLOs and operational KPIs
Hands on experience with parallel file systems (such as Lustre or GPFS), distributed storage (such as Ceph or MinIO), and enterprise object or NAS platforms (such as S3 compatible systems, NetApp, or Pure Storage).
Strong knowledge of block, file, and object storage, including how to tune performance, protect data, and design for high availability.

Experience managing and scaling SRE/Production Engineering teams in large scale, mission critical environments with focus on operational excellence, service availability, and performance

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

At Snowflake, we empower both enterprises and individuals to reach their full potential. Our culture prioritizes impact, innovation, and collaboration, making Snowflake the ideal place to build ambitious projects, execute quickly, and advance technology — and your career — to the next level.

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Applied Field Engineering — AI/ML Product Specialists to lead a high-performing team of AI/ML specialists at the intersection of product, field, and customer success.

In this hands-on leadership role, you will manage a team of Applied Field Engineers who are deep practitioners in Snowflake's AI/ML product portfolio — including Cortex AI, ML modeling, and agentic workflows. You will drive product adoption and customer outcomes, ensuring customers move beyond initial activation to unlock the full depth of Snowflake's AI/ML capabilities. Critically, you will serve as a strategic bridge between the field and Snowflake's product organization — translating customer experience into structured product insight that directly shapes roadmap priorities. You will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, and Sales leadership to ensure Snowflake builds the right things and customers realize their full potential.
