jobs.title: Director, Forward Deployed Engineering
jobs.description:
About Viam

Founded by Eliot Horowitz, co-founder and former CTO of MongoDB, Viam is a novel robotics engineering platform that lets you configure, control, and manage robots intuitively and quickly. We're inspiring a generation of engineers to solve complicated automation problems with our uniquely powerful suite of software tools.

We're a ~100-person company headquartered in New York City.

About the Role

Hybrid 3 days/week in NYC office, with occasional travel to customer sites

We're looking for a Director of Forward Deployed Engineering to lead the team responsible for getting Viam's customers into production. You'll manage a team of five engineers working across our most strategic accounts, own the technical approach to each deployment, and serve as the senior technical partner to our customers' engineering and operations leaders.

This is a leadership role for someone who is still technical. You'll spend your time on architecture decisions, design reviews, coaching, and customer conversations. Prior professional robotics experience isn't required, but you should be comfortable around hardware and physical systems, and able to get fluent in a new platform quickly.

What you'll own:

Manage a team of five forward deployed engineers: coaching, performance, hiring, and how they are resourced across accounts.
Own the technical approach across deployments and make the architecture and prioritization calls.
Be the senior technical voice with customer leadership, from kickoff through escalation.
Work with Viam leadership on account direction, and keep them current on progress, risks, and blockers.
Drive deployments to production: hold the schedule, unblock what's stuck, and change approach when a site demands it.
Turn field learnings into platform priorities with Product and Engineering.

What you bring:

Experience managing engineers who deploy software in customer environments.
Deep systems experience and the ability to get fluent in an unfamiliar platform quickly. You can review a design and read code, though you won't be coding day to day.
Judgment across systems integration, SDKs, and edge/cloud architectures, including what breaks when networks and hardware are unreliable.
A track record with enterprise customers, including the credibility to hold a hard conversation with their leadership.
Comfort deciding with incomplete information and owning the outcome.
Experience building structure where none existed, in an environment where most of the work is still bespoke.
Willingness to balance one customer's urgency against what scales across the portfolio.

Experience With Robotics Or IoT Is Not Required.

The salary for this role is between $225,000 - $275,000 /year.

Full-time Benefits

Viam's base salary range for this role is posted above. In addition to cash compensation, Viam offers a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants, health benefits, and more.

100% covered medical/dental/vision insurance plans, commuter benefits
25 days paid vacation and generous holiday observances
Free lunch every day that you're in the office

Monthly wellness stipend to be used for a variety of fitness-related items like gym memberships, fitness classes, fitness equipment, and more
Paid parental leave
Reproductive Health Benefits, including Fertility Benefits and Abortion Access Travel Benefits
Yearly Learning and Development Budget for your own personal learning goals

Values:

Vision Driven
Collaborate Openly
Act Decisively
Succeed Through Diversity
Hold Ourselves Accountable
Lead with Curiosity

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. Caterpillar is seeking a Senior Manager of Test Engineering to lead a critical program supporting the company’s AI and autonomy efforts. In this role, you will shape the test strategy, quality standards, and execution model for intelligent systems that power the next generation of connected, autonomous, and software-defined machines. This leader will guide cross-functional teams through complex technical challenges, build AI tools that improve software testing products, advance modern test automation and AI-enabled quality practices, and ensure Caterpillar delivers safe, reliable, and scalable technology for customers working in the world’s most demanding environments.

jobs.title: Director of Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Job Summary 

The Director of Infrastructure is responsible for the strategic direction, architecture, management, and continuous improvement of Farmers & Merchants Bank's enterprise infrastructure and technology operations. Reporting to the Chief Information Officer, this role oversees networks, cloud platforms, data centers, workplace technologies, and infrastructure service delivery to ensure secure, reliable, and scalable technology services that support business objectives, operational excellence, and regulatory compliance. The Director establishes infrastructure standards, service levels, performance metrics, and long-term technology roadmaps while leading infrastructure modernization and operational efficiency initiatives. 

This position develops long-term infrastructure roadmaps and architectures, establishes service level agreements (SLAs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and operational metrics, and drives continuous improvement initiatives that enhance performance, resiliency, security, and customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure Strategy & Architecture

Develops and executes the Bank's enterprise infrastructure strategy, architecture roadmap, and technology standards.

Defines long-term infrastructure plans that support business growth, operational scalability, regulatory requirements, and technology modernization initiatives.

Evaluates emerging technologies, industry trends, and leading practices to improve infrastructure capabilities and service delivery.

Leads infrastructure transformation initiatives, including cloud adoption, automation, platform modernization, and lifecycle management.

Enterprise Infrastructure Management

Provides leadership and oversight for enterprise infrastructure including networks, cloud services, servers, storage, virtualization platforms, telecommunications, data center technologies, and workplace technologies.

Ensures infrastructure solutions are secure, scalable, resilient, and aligned with business and technology objectives.

Oversee infrastructure design, engineering, implementation, maintenance, and operational support activities.

Service Delivery & Operational Excellence

Establishes infrastructure service delivery standards and operational procedures.

Defines and monitors service level agreements (SLAs), operational level agreements (OLAs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and service metrics.

Identifies opportunities to improve service quality, customer experience, operational efficiency, and infrastructure performance.

Ensures the availability, reliability, and performance of critical technology platforms and services.

Security, Risk & Compliance

Partners with Information Security to implement infrastructure security controls, monitoring, vulnerability management, patch management, identity management, and secure configuration standards.

Supports compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, security standards, audit requirements, and Bank policies.

Participate in technology risk assessments, audits, regulatory examinations, and remediation activities.

Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity

Oversees business continuity and disaster recovery strategies for infrastructure systems and services.

Ensure recovery solutions meet organizational resilience objectives.

Directs disaster recovery testing, infrastructure recovery planning, and operational resiliency initiatives.

Manages infrastructure-related vendors, service providers, contracts, licensing agreements, and technology partners.

will lead a team responsible for developing AI-enabled marketing platforms, focusing on scalable, reusable data capabilities and real-time decisioning systems in cloud and AI environments. jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Customer Deployments and Partner Integrations
jobs.description:
Who we are

Video is 90% of the world's data. Most of it is invisible to machines.

TwelveLabs builds the intelligence layer to change that. Our multimodal AI models understand video the way humans do — across sight, sound, and motion — and power production-scale AI workloads across media, entertainment, sports, security, and government.

We have raised more than $210 million from NEA, Radical Ventures, Amazon, NVIDIA, Snowflake, Databricks, Index Ventures, NAVER Ventures, Korea Investment Partners, Quadrille Capital, Red Bull Ventures, and AI pioneers including Fei-Fei Li, Silvio Savarese, and Alexandr Wang.

We are a global company, headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Seoul, New York, and London, and employees around the world. We believe the differences in our cultural, educational, and life experiences make our products stronger. Building technology that understands the world in all its complexity requires people who see it from every angle. We are looking for individuals who are driven by hard problems and want their work to matter. Come build it with us!

About The Role

With our Series B, we are entering our next chapter: building a full-stack video AI company with frontier models at the foundation, an enterprise platform in the middle, and agentic systems that turn raw video into actionable knowledge and insights.

Our customers include some of the world’s leading companies across media, sports, advertising, security, and the public sector. They are asking us to solve increasingly complex problems—not only through our APIs, but by deploying TwelveLabs technology securely and reliably into their environments.

As Director of Engineering, Deployment & Integrations, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for deploying TwelveLabs technology into our customers' and partners’ environments and integrating it deeply into their existing technology ecosystems.

You will own the engineering strategy and execution for customer and distribution partner deployments across hyperscalers, private cloud, on-premise, and other complex enterprise environments. You will work closely with our Engineering and Go to Market teams to turn complex customer requirements into scalable, repeatable deployment and integration capabilities.

This is a highly cross-functional and customer-facing engineering leadership role. You will be equally comfortable working through architecture with a customer's technical team, diving into a complex deployment or integration challenge, and building the systems and processes that allow the next customer to move faster.

Your goal is to make TwelveLabs easy to deploy, easy to integrate, and reliable to operate — while turning the lessons from each customer into capabilities that scale across the business.

In this role, you will focus on the core competencies listed below

Customer Deployment

Own the engineering lifecycle for customer and partner deployments, from technical discovery and architecture through implementation, production launch, and ongoing operations.
Lead deployments across public cloud, customer VPCs, private cloud, on-premise infrastructure, and other customer-controlled environments.
Partner directly with strategic customers, partners and their engineering, infrastructure, security, and IT teams to solve complex deployment challenges.
Establish the technical standards, tooling, and playbooks required to make deployments predictable and repeatable.
Turn recurring customer deployment requirements into scalable product and platform capabilities wherever possible.

Integrations & Enterprise Architecture

Own the engineering strategy for integrating TwelveLabs into customers' existing technology ecosystems.
Build scalable integration patterns across enterprise applications, data platforms, storage systems, identity and access management, APIs, and AI/ML infrastructure.
Partner with Product and Engineering to translate recurring customer integration requirements into reusable platform capabilities.
Establish standards and tooling that make integrations faster, more reliable, and increasingly self-service.
Balance customer-specific requirements with a long-term architecture that prevents TwelveLabs from accumulating one-off integrations.
Help define the technical architecture and interfaces that allow TwelveLabs to become deeply embedded in customer workflows and applications.

Deployment Automation & Developer Experience

Build the tooling, automation, and internal platforms that allow engineering teams to provision, configure, upgrade, integrate, and operate customer environments efficiently.
Develop deployment and integration architectures that move TwelveLabs from bespoke implementations toward repeatable, highly automated capabilities.
Establish strong CI/CD, release management, configuration management, and observability practices for distributed customer environments.
Create an exceptional internal developer experience for engineers responsible for building and supporting deployments and integrations.

Product & Engineering Partnership

Work closely with Product and Engineering leadership to ensure deployment and integration requirements are incorporated into product architecture from the beginning.
Identify recurring friction across customer deployments and integrations and turn those insights into product and platform improvements.
Partner with Research and ML teams to understand the operational requirements of serving increasingly capable multimodal models in production environments.
Help define the technical roadmap for deployment and integration infrastructure as TwelveLabs expands its product portfolio and customer footprint.

Customer, Partnerships & Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as a senior technical partner to Solutions Engineering, Sales, and Product on the most complex customer opportunities.
Translate customer requirements into clear technical decisions, engineering priorities, and execution plans.
Establish a strong operating rhythm across customer-facing and engineering teams to ensure deployments and integrations move quickly without compromising quality.
Communicate complex technical tradeoffs clearly to both highly technical audiences and executive stakeholders.

Security, Compliance & Trust

Build deployment and integration architectures suitable for enterprise and public sector customers with demanding security and compliance requirements.
Partner with Security and Infrastructure teams to support requirements around data isolation, identity, access control, encryption, auditability, and compliance.
Help establish deployment patterns capable of supporting increasingly regulated and security-sensitive environments.

Team Building & Culture

Build and lead a world-class Deployment & Integrations Engineering organization.
Recruit, develop, and retain engineers who thrive at the intersection of distributed systems, infrastructure, product engineering, enterprise integrations, and customer problem-solving.
Create a culture of high ownership, technical excellence, urgency, and disciplined execution.
Establish the processes and operating mechanisms that allow the team to move quickly while maintaining a high bar for reliability and customer experience.

You May Be a Good Fit If You Have

10+ years of experience in software engineering, infrastructure, platform engineering, or distributed systems, with significant experience leading globally distributed engineering teams.
Experience leading engineering organizations responsible for deploying complex software, AI/ML systems, or infrastructure into enterprise customer environments.
Deep technical understanding of cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, networking, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability, and production operations.
Experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, infrastructure-as-code, and automated deployment systems.
Experience deploying software across multiple cloud environments and/or customer-controlled infrastructure, including air-gapped, disconnected, regulated, or highly secure environments
Hands-on experience owning the software deployment lifecycle end-to-end — versioning, release management, rollout + rollback strategy, upgrade paths, and post-deployment operations across distributed customer environments.
Deep experience with software packaging patterns for shipping into customer-controlled environments — container images, Helm charts, operator patterns, installer + bootstrap flows, air-gapped bundles, and dependency + configuration management.
A track record of turning bespoke customer implementations into scalable, repeatable engineering systems.
Strong customer-facing instincts and the ability to operate credibly with senior engineers, architects, security teams, and technical executives at large enterprises.
A bias toward action and a willingness to get into the technical details when the situation demands it.
Excellent judgment about when to build a one-off solution for a strategic customer versus investing in a scalable platform capability.
Experience operating in a high-growth startup where product requirements and customer needs evolve rapidly.
Experience working with globally distributed teams

Strong Candidates May Also Have

Experience deploying AI/ML or GPU-intensive workloads into customer environments.
Experience with public sector, defense, financial services, or other highly regulated customers.
Experience taking an enterprise deployment motion from bespoke implementations to a standardized platform.
Experience building or leading Solutions Engineering, Field Engineering, Deployment Engineering, or Professional Services Engineering organizations.

We are a global company that values the uniqueness of each person’s journey. The differences in our cultural, educational, and life experiences are what allow us to challenge the status quo. We’re looking for people motivated by our mission and ready to help build the company that defines how the world understands video.

Benefits and Perks

🤝 An open and inclusive culture and work environment

🚀 Work closely with a collaborative, mission-driven team on cutting-edge AI technology

🌴 Extremely flexible PTO and parental leave policy. Office closed the week of Christmas and New Years

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Manager
jobs.description:
About Mainspring
Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more.

The core values that ground our work, guide our decisions, and connect us together:

Pragmatic Optimism

Excellence without Ego

Proactive Collaboration

Job Overview
Mainspring Energy’s revolutionary linear generator is a sophisticated robot. Inside the generator is a network of computers combining embedded Linux and real-time bare metal applications. These orchestrate the critical tasks of shaping control signals and collecting data from a wide variety of sensors which make this technology possible. Our embedded platform is rapidly evolving, and we need great managers to lead the engineering team making it happen. If you love leading people to solve challenging technological problems and are passionate about driving an efficient, agile process, then we need you!

Responsibilities

This is a managing role for an embedded software team. 

As a leader in the organization you will:

Strategic Leadership:
Define the long-term technical roadmap and align engineering deliverables with overarching business goals

Team Leadership:
Supervise, mentor, and guide a team of software engineers, conducting regular one-on-ones and performance reviews

Project Management:
Oversee the full software development lifecycle, setting clear milestones, managing timelines, and removing roadblocks

Process and Architecture:
Drive engineering excellence by defining org-wide standards for code quality, architectural governance, and system reliability

Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Partner with product managers, executives, and QA teams to align technical goals with business needs

Technical Guidance:
Provide high-level architectural and technical feedback during design reviews

Hiring and Growth:

Success in this role means building an IT and security organization that becomes more scalable, automated, secure, and cost-efficient as the company grows.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Experience Foundations - Confluent
jobs.description:
Introduction

At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world’s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You’ll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM’s product and technology landscape. Here, you’ll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world. With Confluent, data doesn’t sit still. We put information in motion, streaming in near real time so organizations can react faster, build smarter, and deliver experiences as dynamic as the world around them.

Your Role And Responsibilities

About the Role:

We're seeking a hands-on Senior Engineering Manager to join our Experience Foundations team. This team owns critical TEAR (Trusted Experiences Access & Revenue) domains including Security UI, Networking UI, and Billing UI, as well as the shared experience foundations infrastructure (formerly UIF/UI Foundations team).

You'll lead the evolution of our foundations infrastructure from UI-only support to serving the entire Experience organization which includes several other interfaces (API/CLI/TF/VSCode/MCP). Along with this you will help establish patterns and best practices that enable UI engineers to confidently develop security and networking features across our application portfolio—including Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, and Tableflow.

In this role, you'll also support the evolution of Networking, Security, and Billing UI experiences, especially as we adopt and integrate the latest and greatest technologies in these domains. As cloud providers introduce new networking capabilities, security standards evolve, and billing models become more sophisticated, you'll ensure our UI stays at the forefront—providing intuitive, scalable interfaces that make complex technical capabilities accessible to our customers.

The Experience Foundations Team Owns Several Critical Pillars

Security: User authentication, authorization, and security experiences (RBAC, BYOK, SSO, API keys, encryption management)
Networking: Network configuration and connectivity interfaces (private networking, VPC peering, PrivateLink across AWS, GCP, Azure)
Billing UI: Revenue-critical billing and payment experiences (subscription models, multi-month commits, promotional offers, chargebacks, usage tracking
Experience Foundations Infrastructure: Shared UI/UX infrastructure and tooling (formerly UIF/UI Foundations), this includes our design system, compliance support, experience performance, accessibility and more.

These capabilities sit at the intersection of trust, infrastructure control, and revenue generation—foundational pillars that support our entire application ecosystem across Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, Tableflow, and future products.

What You Will Do:
Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence

Establish clear, reusable patterns and best practices for UI engineers developing security and networking code
Elevate the impact of all UI engineers across multiple product teams (Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, Tableflow)
Take a depth-first, hands-on approach to understanding systems and unblocking teams
Go deep in domain areas—understand the technical intricacies of networking protocols, security models, and billing systems to make sound architectural decisions
Drive the evolution of Experience Foundations infrastructure from UI-only to supporting the entire Experience organization, partner with the existing Engineering Manager to shape and execute the foundations roadmap

Cross-Functional Partnership

Own PM and Design partnerships for Security, Networking, and Billing domains
Ensure smooth execution and delivery of product initiatives across these verticals
Bridge technical and product perspectives to drive aligned outcomes
Translate domain complexity into clear execution plans
Challenge product specs when necessary to ensure technical feasibility
Partner with product teams across the portfolio to ensure patterns meet their needs
Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs transparently to senior leadership

Team & People Management

Collaborate with existing engineering leadership to build cohesive team strategy, including existing manager in the foundations space as your direct report
Mentor and develop engineers across multiple disciplines and experience levels
Foster a culture of ownership, excellence, and continuous improvement
Create leverage by empowering engineers with patterns, tools, and knowledge
Build strong connections between Experience Foundations and application teams
Champion developer productivity through AI tooling adoption, test automation, and improved engineering processes

Your work will enable UX engineers across our entire application portfolio to build consistent, high-quality security and networking experiences. By establishing clear patterns and evolving our foundations infrastructure, you'll multiply the impact of every engineer working on Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, Tableflow, and future products—while supporting the foundational pillars that drive over 70% of Confluent's revenue.

If you're energized by the challenge of transforming foundations infrastructure while elevating engineering capabilities across critical product domains, we'd love to talk.

Preferred Education

None

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

5+ years of experience leading software engineering teams
Strong hands-on technical background with ability to dive deep into complex systems
Deep frontend engineering expertise: Strong understanding of modern web development (React, TypeScript, component design systems)
Proven ability to distill complex technical domains into clear patterns and best practices
Experience creating reusable patterns/frameworks adopted across multiple teams or products
Track record of elevating team capabilities through mentorship and knowledge sharing
Demonstrated success partnering with Product and Design to drive execution
Experience managing or collaborating closely with other engineering managers
Experience managing multiple product areas or technical domains simultaneously

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

Experience managing managers or leading leaders
Domain knowledge in at least one TEAR area: Security (RBAC, SSO, BYOK, encryption), Networking (VPC, PrivateLink, routing), or Billing/Payments (subscription models, usage tracking)
Experience evolving platform teams to serve broader organizational needs
Proficient with or highly curious about AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, etc.)
Track record of driving developer productivity improvements through tooling, automation, or process innovation

We are seeking a highly experienced Director of Engineering
to be a leader in SIT's multidisciplinary engineering organization and drive technical excellence across hydraulic, electric, and electrohydraulic system solutions. This role is responsible for engineering strategy, technical execution, talent development, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, on budget, and to the highest quality standards. The Director of Engineering will work closely with integrated systems, engineering operations, sales, project management, and key customers to translate complex requirements into engineered-to-order solutions that support SIT's long-term growth strategy.

Key Responsibilities:

Engineering Leadership & Strategy: participate in SIT's engineering leadership team to define and execute SIT's engineering strategy aligned with business objectives, market opportunities, and emerging technologies in electrification, automation, and fluid power systems
Technical Oversight: Provide senior-level technical guidance and design review for complex hydraulic, electric and structural projects, ensuring compliance with customer requirements, codes, standards, and best practices
Team Development: Build technical depth, promote knowledge sharing, and support succession planning
Project Execution & Accountability: Partner with project management and operations to ensure engineering deliverables support efficient fabrication, testing, installation, and commissioning
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales, system integration and engineering operation teams during pursuit and proposal phases to support solution development, technical risk assessment, and cost accuracy
Defense Compliance & Security Standards: Provide engineering leadership for defense-related programs by ensuring projects comply with CMMC 2.0 cybersecurity requirements and applicable MIL-SPEC standards. Partner with internal stakeholders, customers, and suppliers to uphold security, documentation, and technical compliance across the full project lifecycle
Process Improvement & Standards: Establish and maintain engineering processes, design standards, documentation practices, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance quality, consistency, and scalability
Customer & Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as a technical interface with key customers, OEMs, classification societies, and regulatory bodies for high-visibility or technically complex programs
Technology & Innovation: Stay current on industry trends in electrification, controls, energy storage, and fluid power to guide technology adoption and future system architectures
Safety & Quality Leadership: Promote a culture of safety, quality, and accountability within the engineering team and across the project lifecycle
Other duties as assigned

Requirements

Education:

BSEE, BSME, BAET (ABET accredited university), or equivalent technical degree with relevant experience
Advanced technical training or certifications related to hydraulics and/or fluid power are a plus
MBA is a plus but not required

Experience:

10+ years of progressive engineering experience in hydraulic or electrohydraulic system design and integration
5+ years in an engineering leadership or management role
Experience delivering engineered-to-order systems in marine, oil & gas, defense, civil infrastructure, or heavy industrial environments
Strong understanding of system-level engineering, design reviews, and lifecycle execution
Experience in negotiating, reviewing, and developing contract technical specifications

Desired Experience, Knowledge & Skills:

Deep knowledge of electric power systems, controls, PLC programming, and/or fluid power systems
Ability to read, interpret, and approve electrical, hydraulic, and control schematics
Proven ability to lead teams in a fast-paced, project-driven environment with shifting priorities
Strong communication skills—both written and verbal—with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders
Results-oriented, hands-on leadership style with strong organizational and decision-making skills
High level of accountability, professionalism, and customer focus

jobs.title: Senior Director, Test & Product Engineering
jobs.description:
The Senior Director of Test & Product Engineering leads the strategy and execution of test and product engineering for power semiconductor modules, power ICs, and controllers supporting data center and high-performance applications. This role owns end-to-end product execution across characterization, qualification, yield ramp, test development, and high-volume manufacturing. The leader ensures delivery of scalable, cost-competitive, and high-quality products through strong cross-functional alignment with Design, Product Line, Quality, Reliability, and Operations.

Job Description

The role defines and executes a unified strategy across test and product engineering while leading global teams and establishing scalable processes for new product introduction, yield ramp, and sustaining operations. It requires a balance of strategic leadership and hands-on execution to drive predictable delivery and continuous improvement.
From a product engineering perspective, this leader owns the full product lifecycle, including silicon bring-up, qualification, ramp, and sustaining. Responsibilities include driving yield ramp and improvement, managing excursions, and optimizing product cost through yield, test efficiency, and manufacturing performance. The role ensures manufacturing readiness, production stability, and resolution of yield issues across fab, assembly, and test. It also owns product KPIs, manages change control processes (ECO/PCN), and partners with design teams on design-for-yield, parametric margining, and specification alignment.
From a test engineering standpoint, the role leads development and deployment of wafer sort, final test, and characterization solutions, ensuring strong test coverage while optimizing cost and efficiency. Responsibilities include driving test time reduction, multisite efficiency, and ATE platform standardization to enable scalable high-volume manufacturing.
The leader is accountable for resolving yield excursions, test escapes, and customer returns while partnering with Quality and Reliability teams to ensure robust qualification and mission-profile alignment. This includes establishing monitoring systems and controls to proactively manage risk and maintain alignment between product performance, test limits, and reliability targets.
The role works closely with Operations and manufacturing partners to ensure production readiness, capacity alignment, and continuous improvement across internal and OSAT sites. Strong cross-functional collaboration is required to align with Design, Product Line, and Applications teams on methodologies, cost targets, and customer requirements.
From a business standpoint, the Senior Director owns budget, headcount, and capital planning, while driving performance against key metrics such as yield, cost, quality, and cycle time. The role is also responsible for building a strong organization through hiring, development, and succession planning.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field (advanced degree preferred) with 15+ years of semiconductor experience across test and/or product engineering, including leadership of global teams. Strong technical background in power semiconductors (Si, SiC, GaN, modules, or power ICs) and a proven track record in yield ramp, cost optimization, and high-volume manufacturing execution are required. Deep understanding of ATE, characterization, and yield analysis, along with experience driving cross-functional execution across the full product lifecycle, is essential.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with data center power architectures (AC-DC, DC-DC) and familiarity with power module packaging, thermal behavior, and high-current test methods are preferred. Additional strengths include statistical yield analysis, reliability and qualification methodologies, and experience with test automation and data analytics in manufacturing environments.

Key Performance Indicators

Success in this role is measured by yield performance and improvement, cost of test reduction, product cost competitiveness, execution of NPI and ramp schedules, product quality and reliability, and improvements in cycle time and manufacturing efficiency.

What Success Looks Like

Success is defined by consistent product ramps with strong yield, quality, and cost performance, supported by predictable execution from development through production. The organization demonstrates rapid resolution of yield and quality issues and is recognized as a key driver of product competitiveness and customer satisfaction.

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier

This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

Company Description Freely Payments is a venture-backed fintech company transforming payment acceptance for the $1 trillion-plus food distribution industry.
Most wholesale distributors have historically avoided or limited card acceptance because of high processing costs. Freely changes that. Through exclusive network rates, intelligent transaction routing, interchange optimization, and innovative cash-back programs, Freely helps distributors reduce payment processing costs by as much as 50%—and, in certain programs, to near zero.
Our platform enables distributors to improve cash flow, reduce credit risk, streamline accounts receivable, and offer customers greater payment flexibility and rewards. We are building an integrated B2B payments ecosystem that includes payment acceptance, automated reconciliation and cash application, merchant analytics, and co-branded card programs.
Freely has already signed several of the largest distributors in the industry, with a growing backlog of contracted customers ready to be integrated and launched.
Mastercard is both an investor and strategic partner in Freely, giving us access to differentiated network relationships and helping us build a new category of B2B payments. Our team is composed of experienced leaders in payments, food distribution, financial technology, and enterprise software who share a commitment to modernizing how distributors accept and manage payments.
Role Description The Vice President of Engineering is a full-time, on-site leadership position based in Arlington, Virginia. This is a founding-level engineering role with responsibility for building and leading Freely’s engineering organization while shaping the architecture and technical direction of our payments platform.
This is not a maintenance role. You will join a company with demonstrated product-market fit, meaningful payment volume, and signed customer demand. Your immediate priority will be translating that demand into live production volume by accelerating customer integrations and strengthening the systems that support onboarding, payment processing, billing, reconciliation, analytics, and reporting.
As the platform grows, you will lead the development of automated reconciliation and cash-application capabilities that allow Freely to scale to billions of dollars in payment volume without increasing operational headcount at the same rate.
You will work directly with the CEO, founders, product leaders, customers, processors, and strategic partners to translate business requirements into reliable and scalable technical solutions. You will also build and mentor the engineering team, establish development standards, and create a culture of accountability, urgency, collaboration, and technical excellence.

A robust interchange-optimization and billing engine.

A scalable engineering organization and operating model capable of supporting rapid growth.

Backend: Node.js, TypeScript, and REST APIs
Infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform, Cloud Run, GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, and Firestore

Strong hands-on software development background, with the ability to provide credible architectural and technical leadership.

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

At Medtronic, we bring bold ideas forward with speed and decisiveness to put patients first in everything we do. In-person exchanges are invaluable to our work. We’re working a minimum of 4 days a week onsite as part of our commitment to fostering a culture of professional growth and cross-functional collaboration as we work together to engineer the extraordinary.

The Senior Engineering Manager, Software Development will lead a team responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining software for the Affera mapping system. The Affera Mapping and Ablation System is an innovative medical technology designed to treat patients with cardiac arrhythmias. The system involves advanced mapping techniques to create detailed images of the heart's electrical activity, helping physicians identify abnormal areas causing arrhythmias. Once identified, the Affera Ablation System delivers targeted energy to disrupt these abnormal signals, restoring normal heart rhythm.

Edmentum is a dynamic educator and student-focused company dedicated to tech-enabled learning solutions. Our goal is to ensure that all students have access to flexible learning environments and educators have the tools they need to support their students. What You'll Do

As our Automation Engineering Director, you'll lead Edmentum's enterprise capability for workflow automation, internal tooling, business alerting, and low-code and no-code enablement. You'll define the roadmap, design and build the highest-impact solutions yourself, and stand up the standards, governance, and enablement model that let teams across the company scale automation safely. You'll bring AI into the toolkit where it sharpens what automation can do, while keeping solid engineering at the core. You'll partner with Business Systems, Data, Technology, RevOps, Customer Success, Support, Product, and Finance to find where automation can reduce manual effort, sharpen operating visibility, and unlock new ways of working. This is a hands-on builder role with a thought-leadership mandate: you'll be a multiplier, coding when it matters, coaching when it counts, and setting the patterns that make adoption safe and repeatable. If you love turning ambiguous problems into durable, well-engineered solutions, this is your platform to shape how Edmentum works.

In this role you will:

Define and execute the enterprise roadmap for automation, internal tools, business alerting, and citizen-development enablement, applying AI where it adds value.
Design and build workflow automations, integrations, dashboards, and internal tools that interact with Salesforce, ADO/Jira, data platforms, and other enterprise systems.
Establish standards for development, QA, release, monitoring, and governance, including the responsible use of AI, and embed them across the organization.
Partner with Business Systems, Technology, InfoSec, and Legal to ensure solutions meet security, privacy, and data integrity expectations.
Build the enablement playbooks, office hours, and mentorship routines that turn functional teams and citizen builders into safe, capable automation contributors.
Convert prototypes and proofs of concept into durable, supported capabilities when value is proven.
Communicate progress, impact, risk, and trade-offs to executives in clear, actionable terms, and expand the team and partner ecosystem as the capability scales.

Who You Are

You have 8 or more years of experience in automation engineering, software engineering, business systems, internal tools, data engineering, or related technology leadership roles.
You have led complex workstreams that delivered workflow automation, internal tools, integrations, and low-code and no-code solutions.
You have a strong technical foundation in APIs, data flows, ETL and integration patterns, scripting, cloud or SaaS ecosystems, and modern software delivery practices.
You have practical, hands-on experience applying AI to automation, including AI-assisted workflow design, evaluation, and responsible adoption practices.
You are familiar with Salesforce, ADO/Jira, BI and reporting tools, knowledge systems, support tooling, and enterprise application ecosystems.
You set the bar for development, QA, release management, code governance, documentation, monitoring, and supportability, and bring others along.
You think like a product person, turning business pain points into simple, scalable tools and automations.
You are an excellent coach, communicator, and stakeholder partner who leads change with clarity and credibility.
You bring a bias for action paired with sound judgment around risk, privacy, security, and long-term maintainability.
You are willing to take on evolving responsibilities based on business needs.

Company Overview

Steelcrest Precision is a family own Tier II aerospace precision machining company serving leading OEM and defense customers across commercial aerospace, defense, and space markets. Operating under AS9100, ITAR, and CMMC readiness standards, Steelcrest is executing an ambitious strategy to become one of North America's premier precision machining companies through operational excellence, technology investment, and customer-focused growth.

POSITION MISSION

The Director of Engineering & Estimating is responsible for transforming Steelcrest's engineering organization into a world-class competitive advantage. This executive will lead Manufacturing Engineering, Process Engineering, Program Engineering, and Estimating while driving engineering excellence from quotation through production. The position is accountable for improving profitability, estimating accuracy, manufacturing efficiency, scalability, and customer satisfaction, while serving as a strategic advisor to the President & CEO.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute the company's engineering and estimating strategy aligned with long-term growth objectives.
Own engineering performance across manufacturing, including productivity, manufacturability, quality, cost, and delivery.
Lead all manufacturing, process, tooling, CAM/CAD, and program engineering activities.
Own the estimating function, including standardized cost models, should-cost analysis, pricing strategy, and quotation governance.
Reduce quote turnaround time while improving estimating accuracy and gross margin performance.
Drive Industry 4.0, automation, AI-enabled estimating, digital manufacturing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Lead New Product Introduction (NPI), AS9102 First Article Inspection readiness, and engineering change management.
Partner with Sales to win strategic programs through superior manufacturability and competitive pricing.
Develop engineering talent, succession plans, and a culture of accountability, urgency, innovation, and technical excellence.
Recommend capital investments and ensure measurable return on investment.
Represent Engineering during customer, OEM, DCMA, AS9100, and regulatory audits.

FIRST 12-MONTH SUCCESS METRICS

Increase estimating accuracy to greater than 95%.
Reduce quote turnaround time by at least 30%.
Implement executive engineering KPI dashboards.
Standardize estimating methodology across all business units.
Develop a scalable engineering organization capable of supporting significant revenue growth.
Become a trusted strategic advisor to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial, or Aerospace Engineering.
10+ years of progressive engineering leadership in aerospace precision machining or similarly regulated manufacturing.
Demonstrated leadership of engineering organizations supporting approximately $30M–$100M manufacturing operations.
Expert knowledge of CNC machining, GD&T, AS9102, AS9100, ITAR, and estimating methodologies.
Experience leading multi-site engineering teams and driving operational transformation.
U.S. Person status as defined by ITAR.

Master's degree or MBA.
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or higher.
Experience with ERP/MRP, Paperless Parts, Global Shop, E2, JobBOSS, or similar systems.
Experience implementing automation, digital manufacturing, and AI-enabled engineering processes.

EXECUTIVE COMPETENCIES

Strategic leadership
Financial and business acumen
Executive communication
Customer-facing leadership
Talent development
Data-driven decision making
Change management
Operational excellence mindset

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive executive compensation, annual performance incentive, comprehensive health benefits, 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and executive development opportunities.

ITAR REQUIREMENT

This position requires access to export-controlled technical data. Candidates must qualify as a U.S. Person under 22 CFR 120.15 or otherwise be eligible for U.S. Government authorization.

1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.
We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 75,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 1 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

As Senior Manager, Data Engineering, you will define and lead the technical strategy for Headway's data infrastructure. The team's mission is to build and maintain the reliable, scalable data systems that power analytics, machine learning, and operational decision-making across the company.

Define and champion engineering standards: data modeling conventions, pipeline observability, SLA frameworks, and data quality monitoring.
Partner cross-functionally to design and build the data infrastructure that powers analytics, experimentation, ML models, and operational tooling at scale.
Stay close to the work by engaging directly with strategic technical challenges, surfacing gaps in our platform capabilities before they become bottlenecks.
Translate complex data decisions into clear, actionable recommendations for executive stakeholders.

You have 8+ years of experience in data engineering or related roles
You have 3+ years of experience managing and developing teams

jobs.title: Director, Infrastructure Operations
jobs.description:
How You’ll Contribute

The Director, Infrastructure Operations oversees the operations of the Society’s computing architecture. This includes the Society’s wired and wireless data networks, telecommunications networks, computing and storage platforms, OS images, and the equipment on-premise platforms. Additionally, the Director, Infrastructure Operations is responsible for planning and executing infrastructural upgrades as well as ongoing patch management. The Director tracks and refines KPIs and other operational metrics to evaluate the health and performance of the infrastructure, identify defects, efficiencies, enhancements, and ensure a cycle of continuous improvement. Reporting to the Sr. Director, Infrastructure and Security, the Director, Infrastructure Operations manages the personnel and budget allocated to the infrastructure operations, including tracking and reporting usage of on-premise infrastructure resources by business unit or program. This role will recommend and implement technology solutions and integrate them with the service catalog and IT operational processes; Leveraging project management, leadership and technical expertise, ensuring optimal user satisfaction through reliable service delivery and effective change management.

The ideal candidate will have a natural curiosity, proactive approach to find and recommend new solutions, and strong commitment to deadlines. To sustain a culture of innovation and fulfill NGS mission of illuminating and protecting the wonder of the world, it is expected a continued learning mindset and commitment to excellence from all outward-facing programs, services, products, as well as the systems and teams that support the Society’s work.

Your Impact

Your Impact & Responsibilities

Planning and Governance (40%)

Develops and manages the infrastructure operations team roadmap, budget, and project plans and schedules under the direction of the Sr. Director, Infrastructure and Security. Meets with key stakeholders to review project plans and establish measurable objectives before submitting plans for approval.
Works with the Sr. Director, Infrastructure and Security to establish policies, standards, procedures, and governance activities related to infrastructure. Defines and executes plans to incorporate policies and procedures into daily operations and systems design.
Directs compute and network engineering teams to develop innovative architecture and features to advance the goals of the organization.
Monitors benchmarks, trends, and product developments to anticipate change, minimize risk, and identify growth opportunities.

Infrastructure Operations (40%)

Directs the operational support of technology infrastructure, ensuring that all components meet service-level objectives for availability, capacity, performance, and other KPIs.
Leads infrastructure projects and supports all technology projects requiring team subject matter expertise or resources.
Monitors service level objectives, optimizes operational activities, and brings visibility into operations through analysis, trends, and measurement.
Ensures that the technology infrastructure adheres to NGS policies regarding information security, business continuity, etc.
Develops and maintains relationships with external IT vendors and service providers to ensure alignment in goals and seamless execution.

Leadership and Management (20%)

Performs personnel management and development for new and existing staff, ensuring that the team has the appropriate skills and depth to meet service level objectives and customer service standards.
Leads or participates in appropriate steering committees and internal technology working groups.
Collaborates with procurement, legal, and other administrative teams on RFP documents and processes, statements of work, contract negotiations and disputes, and other vendor performance management activities.

What You’ll Bring

Minimum Years and Type of Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related discipline, or equivalent experience.

Minimum Years And Type Of Experience

A minimum of 10 years of experience in the information technology field, with at least 5 years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, and maintaining enterprise infrastructure including networks and hosts. Candidates must also have at least 5 years of management experience.

Necessary Knowledge And Skills Required

Extensive experience managing the 24/7 operation of network, storage, and computing infrastructure, including implementing new products as well executing regular maintenance. Able to translate business requirements into technical specifications.
Exceptional organizational and project management skills, including the ability to plan, schedule, and successfully carry out multiple projects at the same time to a successful conclusion.
Broad knowledge of technology infrastructure on-premise including network systems and management, computing and storage, telecommunications, data center operations, and virtualization. Experience managing vendor relationships for all infrastructure services and solutions and reviewing vendor contracts, statements of work, and related documents.
Excellent oral and written communication skills. Able to interact positively and productively with teams across the organization. Strong customer service, troubleshooting, and problem-solving are a must.
Excellent leadership, management, and team-building skills. Able to attract, mentor, and develop staff to ensure skills align and adapt to the mission and business goals. Able to inspire and motivate others by example, and achieve positive outcomes through a balance of strong leadership and open collaboration.
Architectural understanding of enterprise network protocols (e.g., BGP, OSPF) and modern data center fabric topologies (such as spine-and-leaf or EVPN/VXLAN) to oversee our Arista environments.
Strategic oversight of corporate Wireless LAN (WLAN) infrastructure, focusing on high-density capacity planning, seamless mobility, and secure authentication frameworks (e.g., 802.1x, NAC).
A comprehensive understanding of cloud technologies for directory services and backups solutions.

Desired Qualifications

Knowledge of distributed antenna systems (DAS) and public safety radio systems/equipment.
Relevant enterprise management certifications (e.g., PMP or ITIL).
Knowledge of hybrid data center models and secure infrastructure connectivity to major public cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP).

Supervision

3-5 staff members

The National Geographic Society offers a competitive and holistic total rewards package. Our compensation structure and transparent pay philosophy are based on industry-specific market data for similar-sized nonprofit organizations.

The salary range for this position accounts for a wide range of factors including but not limited to organizational need; specific skill sets; experience and training; certifications; and more. Please check with the hiring manager for confirmation.); paid parental leave, adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility benefits; learning and development opportunities; Lifestyle Spending Account; pet adoption assistance and insurance; pre-tax transportation benefits with a generous employer subsidy; employer-paid life insurance and disability benefit; and a variety of National Geographic discounts and perks.

7-Eleven is an iconic family of brands with over 86,000 locations, surpassing every retailer in the world. We revolutionize convenience, restaurants and fuel through cutting edge innovation — working hard to be the customer's first choice. 7-Eleven empowers our employees to "activate awesome" and make a meaningful impact in their stores and communities every day. If you're ready to grow, lead and make a difference, come join our team and help shape the future of convenience.

Job Summary

The Senior Manager, Equipment, Packaging & System Design leads the technical innovation strategy for 7-Eleven's Fresh Food & Beverage operations, driving the development and optimization of equipment, packaging, and operational systems across the entire store network. This role owns the end-to-end technical solution lifecycle from concept through commercialization, ensuring seamless integration of product, equipment, and packaging requirements that enable consistent, efficient, and profitable delivery of food and beverage products. The position requires strategic partnership with Product Development, Operations, Design, Supply Chain, and external manufacturers to deliver scalable solutions that transform store operations and enhance customer experience. This leader will build organizational capability while establishing technical standards and driving automation opportunities that redefine convenience retail foodservice.

Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team of engineers and technical specialists in creating innovative equipment, packaging, and system solutions for fresh food and beverage operations across all store formats
Own the complete technical solution lifecycle including concept development, prototyping, testing protocols, pilot validation, commercialization planning, and post-launch optimization to ensure successful implementation
Establish and maintain comprehensive technical standards, specifications, testing protocols, and qualification processes that ensure seamless integration of product, equipment, packaging, and system requirements
Partner strategically with Product Development, Store Operations, Design, Supply Chain, Quality Assurance, and external equipment manufacturers to deliver scalable solutions that improve consumer experience, product quality, store implementation, and operational execution
Drive the strategic roadmap for Food & Beverage equipment engineering and operational innovation, identifying and evaluating emerging technologies, automation platforms, and smart kitchen solutions that transform the store operating model
Manage capital project budgets, vendor partnerships, and equipment procurement processes while ensuring cost-effective solutions that deliver strong return on investment and operational efficiency
Conduct comprehensive equipment specification, testing, and validation activities across complex, multi-site operational environments to ensure reliability, food safety compliance, and operational scalability
Build organizational capability by coaching talent, setting team priorities, allocating resources effectively, and fostering a culture of innovation, technical rigor, and continuous improvement
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business objectives into technical requirements and actionable implementation plans that drive enterprise-scale transformation
Monitor and analyze equipment performance data, store feedback, and operational metrics to identify optimization opportunities and drive continuous improvement initiatives
Ensure all equipment and packaging solutions comply with food safety regulations, health codes, environmental standards, and corporate quality requirements
Present technical recommendations, project updates, and strategic initiatives to senior leadership and executive stakeholders with clear business impact analysis

Education And Experience

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Industrial Engineering, Food Engineering, Packaging Engineering, Food Science, or related technical field required

YEARS OF RELEVANT WORK EXPERIENCE:
10+ years

YEARS OF MANAGEMENT EXPERIENCE:
5+ years

Advanced knowledge of foodservice equipment design, specification, and integration including cooking equipment, refrigeration systems, food preparation tools, and packaging machinery
Expertise in packaging engineering principles including material selection, sustainability considerations, food safety requirements, and supply chain optimization
Proficiency in technical testing protocols, validation methodologies, and quality assurance processes for food contact equipment and packaging materials
Strong understanding of food safety regulations, health codes, HACCP principles, and compliance requirements for retail foodservice operations
Experience with automation technologies, IoT-enabled equipment, smart kitchen systems, and emerging foodservice innovations
Exceptional project management skills with ability to manage multiple complex initiatives simultaneously while meeting deadlines and budget constraints
Advanced analytical and problem-solving abilities with experience using data-driven decision making to optimize equipment performance and operational efficiency
Excellent communication and presentation skills with ability to influence and build consensus across all organizational levels including executive leadership
Strategic thinking capability with ability to translate business objectives into technical solutions and actionable implementation roadmaps
Strong vendor management and negotiation skills with experience building productive partnerships with equipment manufacturers and suppliers
Demonstrated ability to foster innovation, drive organizational change, and build high-performing technical teams in dynamic business environments

Breakthru Beverage Group (BBG) is in the midst of a major enterprise transformation to modernize our technology landscape, simplify enterprise integrations, and enable AI-driven capabilities across the business. As part of this transformation, we are building a modern, cloud-native technology ecosystem powered by SAP S/4HANA, Snowflake, AWS, and next-generation AI capabilities. We are seeking a strategic, hands-on technology leader to define and execute BBG's enterprise integration strategy while establishing the architecture, engineering standards, and governance that will serve as the digital backbone of the organization.

The Director, Enterprise Integration, EDI & AI Agent Platform will lead the teams responsible for enterprise application integration, APIs, event-driven architecture, EDI, managed file transfer, and AI agent integration. This leader will partner closely with Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Data Engineering, Data Governance, and the AI Center of Excellence to deliver secure, resilient, and scalable integration capabilities that accelerate BBG's digital transformation and enable next-generation intelligent automation.

At LPL, people leaders and senior individual contributors hold the key to the employee experience — shaping culture, driving performance, and guiding individuals to new heights. Because when that happens, we all win – clients, LPL, and most importantly, our employees.

Strategic systems thinking with the ability to translate business strategy into executable architecture.

About This Role

Join the Portfolio Analytics Group (PAG)
, a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary team of forward-deployed engineers and data scientists at the forefront of applied analytics at BlackRock.

As part of the Aladdin Financial Engineering (AFE)
organization, PAG designs, develops, and deploys advanced analytical solutions that combine Aladdin’s technology platform, financial models, and data to solve complex real-world investment and business challenges. Our solutions are used across BlackRock’s investment, product, and distribution organizations, helping drive better portfolio insights, support strategic decision-making, improve client outcomes, and contribute to winning new business.

The team works across the full spectrum of asset classes—including equities, fixed income, derivatives, and private markets—providing exposure to a diverse range of investment strategies, products, and client needs. PAG sits at the intersection of technology, analytics, and business, partnering directly with stakeholders to translate complex challenges into scalable, impactful solutions.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and driven individual to join our San Francisco team and help build the next generation of analytical capabilities that sit alongside and extend the Aladdin platform. These tools support a broad range of use cases, including portfolio analysis, product strategy, sales enablement, client engagement, and increasingly, AI-powered decision support.

In this role, you will partner closely with product, distribution, and technology teams to identify high-impact opportunities, rapidly prototype solutions, and iterate based on real-world feedback. Success requires the ability to bridge sophisticated analytical concepts and practical business needs, creating fit-for-purpose solutions that integrate seamlessly into established workflows.

Successful candidates will wear multiple hats, acting as hands-on analytics developers, internal technology advocates, and business-oriented project managers. On the technical side, they will demonstrate a strong aptitude for learning our proprietary technology ecosystem, and for working with various programming languages and technology stacks. They should also possess technical fluency in AI, Python, and database languages, along with experience building end-to-end analytical applications. Equally important are the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders and a solid understanding of financial markets and instruments.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the end-to-end design and delivery of complex, cross-functional analytics initiatives.
Develop analytical products and frameworks that empower product teams, sales organizations, and clients.
Partner closely with technical partners, product leaders, and client teams to define and execute against strategic roadmaps.
Translate business challenges into scalable, data-driven solutions leveraging Aladdin capabilities.
Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, influencing decisions and helping shape strategic direction.
Provide technical excellence through mentorship, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Communicate complex analytical concepts and business insights effectively to technical and non-technical audiences.

Qualifications & Experience

7+ years of experience across financial markets, analytics, and software engineering.
Proven track record of delivering complex, cross-functional analytics and technology solutions.
Strong Python programming skills and experience working with large-scale analytical systems and production-quality codebases.
Deep understanding of investment products, portfolio analytics, and investment workflows.
Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate with senior stakeholders.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts.
