jobs.title: Senior Manager, Customer Service Technology Systems
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Brother is a leading provider of home and office equipment, sewing and crafting products, and industrial solutions. With a legacy spanning over 115 years, our brand is renowned for producing award-winning printers, sewing machines, P-touch labelers, and more. Brother International Corporation (BIC) was established in 1954, marking over 70 years of operations in the United States. Our Americas headquarters is located in Bridgewater, New Jersey. BIC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Brother Industries Limited (BIL), which was founded in 1908 in Nagoya, Japan, and operates in more than 30 countries worldwide. Brother’s Americas presence includes subsidiaries in Canada, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Chile, and Peru.

Why Work at Brother?

Brother USA has consistently been recognized as a best place to work, reflecting our commitment to fostering a workplace culture aligned with our core values of being inclusive, collaborative, customer-centric, and socially responsible. We value work-life balance and flexibility, and as a result have introduced policies such as our hybrid office schedule, casual dress code, and flexible Fridays, which allow us to wrap up meetings for dedicated focus time or to start our weekends sooner, year-round. Our commitment to employee growth and development is demonstrated through our offering of facilitated courses and certificate programs and our investment in resources that enable self-paced learning.

Role Overview

The Senior Manager, Customer Service Technology & Systems, defines and executes the technology strategy that powers the end-to-end customer service experience across the Americas region, including the U.S. and Pan-LATAM markets. This role owns the roadmap, implementation, optimization, and ongoing performance of all customer service platforms, including telephony, IVR, CRM, chat, and web-based support tools.

The Senior Manager serves as the primary owner of vendor relationships and platform performance, ensuring systems are scalable, regionally adaptable, and aligned with broader business objectives across multiple countries and languages. Partnering closely with IT, Digital, regional CX leaders, and local market teams, this role drives innovation, automation, and continuous improvement across all customer service channels.

Duties & Responsibilities

CX Technology Strategy & Platform Ownership

Own the end-to-end Customer Service technology ecosystem, including phone, IVR, CRM, chat, and web
Define and manage the multi-year roadmap for customer service technology
Ensure seamless omnichannel integration and customer journey continuity
Act as the business owner of all customer service platforms
Partner with IT on architecture, integrations, and security while maintaining business ownership
Evaluate and recommend new technologies to enhance customer and agent experiences
Balance global platform standardization with local market needs
Ensure systems support multi-language experiences (Spanish, Portuguese, English)
Design solutions that accommodate regional regulatory and operational differences

Implementation, Optimization & Automation

Lead end-to-end system implementations, upgrades, and enhancements
Drive continuous improvement of workflows, automation, and system performance
Oversee configuration, releases, and system administration
Implement and expand self-service capabilities, including IVR, chatbots, and help centers
Identify inefficiencies and deploy solutions to improve resolution times and productivity
Lead implementations across multiple countries and business units
Ensure platforms are configured to support localized workflows and customer journeys

Vendor & Partner Management

Own relationships with all technology vendors and service providers
Lead vendor selection, contract negotiation, and performance management
Ensure vendors meet SLAs, innovation expectations, and roadmap alignment
Manage budgets associated with platforms, tools, and external partners
Manage vendors across multiple regions, ensuring alignment with local market requirements and service expectations

Reporting, Analytics, & Insights

Establish KPIs and dashboards to measure system performance and CX impact
Deliver actionable insights to leadership on trends, opportunities, and ROI
Ensure data accuracy, governance, and compliance across systems
Leverage analytics to improve customer satisfaction and operational efficiency

Team Leadership & Project Management

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of system administrators and analysts
Oversee project prioritization, planning, and execution across multiple initiatives
Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure alignment and successful delivery of initiatives

Experience & Qualifications

Education:

Bachelor's Degree (or equivalent experience) in Business or related field
Master's Degree (or equivalent experience) in Business or related field Preferred

Experience:

8+ years of experience in leading customer service technology operations and strategy, including CRM, telephony, IVR, chat, and web-based platforms, with 8+ years managing teams responsible for system implementations, digital transformation, automation initiatives, vendor management, and cross-functional stakeholder collaboration
8+ years of experience supporting multi-country or global operations, preferably across the Americas, and familiarity with LATAM market dynamics and localization challenges Preferred

Languages:

Spanish Preferred
Portuguese Preferred

Software/Technical Skills

Advanced knowledge of CRM and contact center platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Oracle, Zendesk, etc.)
Advanced experience with telephony systems, IVR, chat platforms, and web self-service tools
Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, and cloud-based systems
Intermediate experience with reporting and analytics tools
Intermediate experience MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams)

Other Skills/Knowledge/Abilities

Strong leadership skills with the ability to take initiative and strategically lead change
Ability to effectively resolve conflicts, identify alternatives, and provide solutions
Strong project management and time management skills, with the ability to oversee multiple projects at once while meeting deadlines
Excellent communication skills (verbal, written, interpersonal)
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
Ability to effectively build relationships and communicate with IT, operations, and customer service teams to align technology with business goals
Ability to work across time zones and geographically distributed teams

Additional Details For This Role

This role will be a hybrid role. Subject to business needs, employees may work remotely up to two days per week. Assigned office days will be determined by your manager.

Base Salary

The targeted base salary range for this position if based in TN will be $125,000 - $150,000 per year.
The targeted base salary range for this position if based in NJ will be $145,000 - $170,000 per year.
Base salary is determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the successful candidate, as well as factors such as internal equity, cost of labor in the hiring location, and alignment with market data.

Additional Compensation

This position is eligible for a 20% bonus at 100% of target, with the opportunity to achieve above 100% dependent on company performance and in alignment with company bonus plans.
Bonus awards are discretionary and contingent upon individual performance as well as Brother achieving its corporate objectives, in accordance with the applicable bonus plan in effect.

Our Benefits

We offer a comprehensive benefits package with diverse plan options to meet your family’s needs, including health, vision, and dental insurance—all effective from day one of employment. Under our 401(k) retirement savings plan, we match up to 100% of the first 4% of employee contributions, with employer matches vesting immediately. Additionally, we offer an educational assistance program that reimburses up to 100% of tuition, lab fees, textbooks, and other related expenses for qualifying programs. Details are available at  https://mybenefits.nfp.com/Brother/2026/guidebook/

Our Mission, Vision & Culture

Our mission is to live our “at your side” promise to simplify and enrich the lives of our customers, employees, and communities. We aim to be where people and technology meet, providing products and solutions that enhance how people live, work, and create. We look to our strategic culture drivers - accountability, authenticity, boldness, and excellence - to enable us to consistently deliver on our vision, mission, and shared values. These drivers help us shape a culture that empowers the business to succeed.

About Where We Work

Brother’s corporate headquarters for the Americas is in Bridgewater, NJ, across from the Bridgewater Commons Mall. This location houses key corporate functions, including HR, legal, finance, IT, and supply chain, and a significant presence of our business unit leadership and marketing teams. Our manufacturing and distribution facility in Bartlett, TN spans an impressive 1.5 million square feet - equivalent to 26 football fields - and is located on Brother Boulevard. In addition to the distribution center operations team, this facility hosts several other departments, including our customer service group. Brother also has employees based in other locations, such as Westminster, CO, where many of our marketing and product engineering team members from the mobile solutions division operate, as well as our distribution centers in Richmond, VA and Perris, CA. Additionally, our outside sales teams work remotely within their territories, staying geographically close to the accounts they support to ensure they are always “at your side” for our customers.

Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE) Statement

Brother International Corporation ("Brother") is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local, state or federal laws. Brother is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities throughout the application or interview process. If you need an accommodation, please contact us at eoe_applicant_accommodations@brother.com .

jobs.title: Vice President, Technology
jobs.description:
Alliance for Audited Media seeking an experienced Vice President, Technology who will be responsible for the leadership and management of the organization's technology infrastructure, cybersecurity, enterprise applications, software development, and IT operations. This primarily position reports to the Chief Financial Officer/ Chief Operating Officer. This position leads the planning and execution of strategic technology initiatives and is accountable for technology investments and outcomes, while ensuring reliable, secure, and cost-effective technology services that support the organization's business objectives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS OF THE JOB

Lead the technology function and establish technology priorities and direction in partnership with executive leadership and in alignment with organizational goals, business needs, and strategic objectives.

Establish and maintain an effective technology governance framework for evaluating, prioritizing, and overseeing technology initiatives, investments, and resources.

Develop and manage the annual IT operating and capital budgets, including technology forecasting, resource planning, and evaluation of proposed technology investments.

Oversee the organization's technology platforms, business applications, infrastructure, and systems, including evaluation, modernization, integration, and lifecycle management.

Oversee cybersecurity, technology risk management, data protection, and related controls to safeguard organizational information and technology resources.

Manage enterprise infrastructure, including Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS, virtualization, servers, networking, backup, and disaster recovery.

Recommend and implement cost-effective technology solutions that ensure secure, reliable, and high-performing systems.

Oversee IT operations, help desk support, and relationships with technology vendors, contractors, and managed service providers, including contract performance and service delivery.

Supervise IT staff by providing leadership, mentoring, coaching, staff development and succession planning, and performance management.

Lead knowledge transfer and documentation efforts to preserve institutional knowledge, strengthen  business continuity, and reduce operational dependency.

Develop and maintain IT policies, procedures, documentation, and technology standards.

Serve as a strategic technology advisor to executive leadership, communicating technology priorities, investments, risks, opportunities, and results in support of informed business decisions.

Evaluate emerging technologies and industry practices and recommend solutions that improve organizational effectiveness, security, reliability, and operational efficiency.

OTHER KEY JOB FUNCTIONS

Collaborate with department leaders to identify opportunities for process improvement through technology.
Support enterprise data management and reporting initiatives that improve business decision-making.
Participate in cross-functional projects and organizational initiatives as needed.
Maintain current knowledge of emerging technologies, cybersecurity trends, and industry best practices and apply that knowledge to support organizational technology planning and decision-making.
Present technology plans, risks, priorities, and initiatives to executive leadership as needed, and as requested, to the Board of Directors.
Perform other duties as assigned.

JOB SPECIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.
Minimum 10 years of progressive IT experience.
Minimum 5 years leading technical teams or enterprise IT projects.
Experience developing and executing technology strategies, governance practices, and technology investment priorities aligned with organizational objectives.
Experience managing technology vendors, contractors, and managed service providers, including contract negotiations, performance management, and service delivery.
Experience overseeing cloud platforms, infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, data protection, and enterprise applications.
Experience leading application development or legacy system modernization, or cloud migration projects.
Strong knowledge of databases, systems integration, and enterprise technologies.
Excellent leadership, project management, vendor management, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to executive leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience with technologies such as Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS, or comparable enterprise platforms is preferred.
Experience with cybersecurity, data protection, business continuity, and disaster recovery practices is preferred.
Microsoft, Cisco, Azure, AWS, VMware, or related certifications preferred.

ENVIRONMENT:

Primarily remote work environment.
Periodic onsite presence at AAM's Schaumburg, Illinois office during the first nine months will be expected to support knowledge transfer and transition activities.
Occasional travel for company meetings, technology implementations, or vendor meetings as required.
Availability to work outside normal business hours during system implementations, maintenance windows, or emergency situations.

About Alliance for Audited Media

The Alliance for Audited Media is the industry’s assurance partner. Founded in 1914 by the Association of National Advertisers as the Audit Bureau of Circulations (ABC), AAM has evolved from verifying print circulation to providing assurance across the media and advertising ecosystem. In 2023, AAM merged with BPA Worldwide to become the largest not-for-profit media assurance organization governed by a board of directors representing agencies, marketers and publishers.

Our mission is to collaborate with the industry to set standards and develop assurance programs that bring greater transparency to channels including digital, print, retail media, events, out-of-home, ad tech and more.

AAM partners with leading organizations including the Association of National Advertisers (ANA), Interactive Advertising Bureau (IAB), IAB Tech Lab, Trustworthy Accountability Group (TAG), the Events Industry Council (EIC), Point of Care Marketing Association (POCMA) and others to set industry standards and develop assurance programs that promote greater transparency and accountability.

Together with our members and partners, we are committed to setting universal benchmarks for media transparency, helping develop accountability solutions and promoting excellence that elevates the entire industry.

As AAM continues to evolve its technology capabilities in support of its mission, the Vice President, Technology will play a key leadership role in ensuring that AAM's technology environment supports the organization's business objectives, innovation, security, and continued growth.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Engineering (821)
jobs.description:
At Protegrity, we lead innovation by using AI and quantum-resistant cryptography to transform data protection across cloud-native, hybrid, on-premises, and open source environments. We leverage advanced cryptographic methods such as tokenization, format-preserving encryption, and quantum-resilient techniques to protect sensitive data.

As a global leader in data security, our mission is to ensure that data isn’t just valuable but also usable, trusted, and safe.

Protegrity offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of innovation and collaboration, with the ability to make a meaningful impact on the industry while working alongside some of the brightest minds. Together, we are redefining how the world safeguards data, enabling organizations to thrive in a GenAI era where data is the ultimate currency. If you're ready to shape the future of data security, Protegrity is the place for you.

Protegrity is seeking a passionate and talented Senior Manager of Engineering to join our Engineering organization. This position is a remote role.

Role Overview

You enjoy leading teams that ship customer-facing product experiences at scale. You bring strong front-end engineering depth, pair it with pragmatic people leadership, and love building reusable platform capabilities that help multiple product teams move faster.

In this role you’ll lead 2–3 product teams (including the core UI team), set technical direction for a micro-frontend architecture and shell SDK, and stay close to the code—especially when a problem needs hands-on help. You’ll also champion AI-assisted development practices to accelerate delivery while keeping quality, security, and accessibility bar-high.

What You’ll Do

Lead 2–3 product engineering teams (including the core UI team), providing day-to-day management, coaching, mentoring, and performance support while maintaining a strong technical presence.
Set technical direction for the UI platform: micro-frontend architecture, React/TypeScript standards, shell SDK interfaces, module contracts, and shared design-system/theming patterns.
Drive engineering execution: sprint planning, technical prioritization, code reviews, and hands-on contributions to unblock delivery and improve reliability.
Establish and evolve CI/CD for independently deployable front-end modules, including build pipelines, artifact management, automated testing, and safe rollout practices.
Ensure reusable UI and service capabilities are well-designed and documented (including company-wide ‘skills files’/patterns), and guide integration with supporting backend services such as user management and authorization.
Partner closely with Product Management to define roadmap, scope features, and deliver high-impact product outcomes.
Define and maintain clear module contracts, API descriptors, and SDK interfaces to enable independent development across teams.
Promote scalable integration patterns including event-driven communication and shared state approaches across modules and services.
Drive engineering best practices across teams including coding standards, testing strategies, and development workflows (including AI-assisted tools where appropriate).

What You’ll Need

8+ years of software engineering experience with 3+ years leading and managing engineers (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
Strong React 18+ expertise (hooks, Suspense, StrictMode, error boundaries, lazy loading) and modern TypeScript patterns.
Deep experience with Webpack 5 and Module Federation or similar approaches to modular front-end architecture.
Experience designing and operating micro-frontend systems or other independently deployable UI architectures.
Solid experience integrating or developing backend services, including API design and microservices-based architectures.
Familiarity with event-driven communication patterns (pub/sub) and cross-module state management approaches.
Experience implementing or working with authentication and authorization patterns (e.g., JWT, RBAC).
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern development practices including testing and code quality standards.
Strong collaboration skills with product, design, and engineering teams, with the ability to balance technical decisions and delivery outcomes.

Nice to have

Experience with containerization and Kubernetes or similar cloud-native deployment models.
Strong understanding of UI architecture concepts such as design systems, theming, and responsive design.
Experience with accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1) and building inclusive user experiences.
Exposure to AI/LLM-powered UI experiences or developer productivity tools.

Should you accept this position, you must consent to and pass a Background Investigation, which includes (subject to country law), extended education, and additional criminal and civil checks.

We offer a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits with generous vacation and holiday time off. All employees are also provided access to ongoing learning & development. Ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace is our priority.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Market Solutions Engineering
jobs.description:
The New York Independent System Operator (NYISO) manages the efficient flow of electricity on more than 11,000 circuit-miles of high-voltage transmission lines, dispatching power from hundreds of generating units across the state.

The New York Independent System Operator (NYISO) applies cutting-edge technology to operating a reliable electricity system, managing competitive markets for wholesale electricity, and planning for the Empire State's energy future. The NYISO’s Market Structures department invites applications for a full-time Senior Manager, Market Solutions Engineering.

The Senior Manager, Market Solutions Engineering is responsible for setting technical direction and leading the research, market technology, production support, implementation, and external engagement functions that support NYISO’s energy, capacity, and TCC market systems. This position provides strategic leadership across Market Design, Market Operations, Grid Operations, Market Mitigation and Analysis, Information Technology, System & Resource Planning, and Product and Project Management to advance NYISO’s strategic initiatives and long-term market vision.

The Senior Manager leads the development and evolution of market technology solutions, oversees preliminary and feasibility simulation studies for future market products, and ensures market applications remain functional and aligned with market rules and reliability criteria. The role also directs projects that build upon the Energy Market System and Business Market System to support emerging resource technologies and New York State renewable integration objectives.

The position provides leadership for day-ahead and real-time energy market engineering support, production issue resolution, vendor and consultant engagement, implementation readiness, testing coordination, external research engagements, and ongoing technical support for market software and market participant inquiries.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES And RESPONSIBILITIES

Provide strategic leadership for Market Solutions Engineering and Market Research and Engineering teams, including research, prototype development, market technology strategy, implementation support, production support, and long-term market solution planning.
Lead collaboration with Market Design, Project and Product Management, Information Technology, Operations, Grid Operations, Market Mitigation and Analysis, System & Resource Planning, and other business areas through the full project lifecycle, from market design and requirements development through implementation, testing, deployment, and post-production support.
Direct engagement with vendors and consultants supporting NYISO production systems and market applications; review vendor-proposed solutions, provide direction on design notes development and ensure solutions align with market rules, operational needs, reliability criteria, and long-range market strategies.
Provide strategic direction to Grid Operations and Market Operations teams regarding production changes, market software enhancements, prioritization of improvements, and resolution of software issues encountered in day-ahead and real-time market operations.
Define, sponsor and lead studies of future market products and technologies using prototyping, simulations, historical data analysis, and other sound technical approaches to validate requirements, assess technical robustness, evaluate potential market outcomes and consumer impacts, identify market behavioral risks and confirm compliance objectives.
Present, explain and defend technical approaches, study results, implementation strategies and recommended solutions to senior management, stakeholders, vendors, and internal cross-functional teams.
Balance market operations and grid operations operational enhancements with NYISO’s long-term market plans and strategic planning priorities.
Lead the technical development of mathematical models and optimization-based solutions for energy, capacity, and TCC markets, including commitment, dispatch, pricing, resource adequacy modeling approaches to meet peak system demand and capacity accreditation factors used in resource adequacy models.
Administer and provide direction on software modifications to Security Constrained Unit Commitment, Real-Time Scheduling, unit commitment, dispatch and pricing programs, including enhancements related to MIP solution approaches, dynamic reserves procurement, account for constraint-specific transmission shortages, modeling generator duct firing operational limitations, participation models for Energy Storage Resources, Co-located Storage Resources, aggregation resources, distributed energy resources, large load participation models in wholesale electricity markets, scarcity pricing enhancements, external transaction pricing, and broader regional market initiatives.
Lead or coordinate proof-of-concept testing, user acceptance testing and implementation readiness activities for changes to core energy market algorithms and supporting market software.
Provide implementation support to product teams by reviewing requirements documents, reviewing and approving design notes, supporting user acceptance test plans, and ensuring enhancements and new features are ready for production deployment.
Oversee technical support to Market Monitoring, IT Quality Assurance, Stakeholder Services, Market Validation, and Operations for market participant questions, scheduling and pricing outcome validation, production investigations, and audit-related inquiries.
Support corporate SOC1 process and procedure audit principles by promoting best practices, periodic audit activities, traceable documentation, and disciplined production-support processes.
Direct, support, and maintain specialized operations and market-solution applications, including PMU applications, stand-alone visualization software, as applicable to the assigned functional portfolio.
Monitor FERC, regional ISO/RTO, academia, and industry developments; collaborate with other ISOs/RTOs on technology and business solution evaluation; and recommend technical and business evolution initiatives in coordination with NYISO senior management.
Represent NYISO on external industry advisory boards and in industry organizations such as PSERC, EPRI, CEATI, CIGRE, national labs, universities, and other research forums; participate in major national and international conferences and seminars.
Oversee external research engagements for NYISO, including active management of university and research organization collaborations, review of DOE, NSF, NYSERDA, and related proposals, and maintenance of an active research program aligned with NYISO market needs.
Supervise, train, develop, and mentor managers and professional staff supporting market solutions, research, software testing, market modeling, and implementation activities; establish priorities, develop talent, and build technical depth across the team.
Provide direction for teams that provide 24x7 on-call production support to resolve issues in a timely manner.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position has supervisory responsibility and may have both managerial and non-supervisory employees reporting to the position. The role is expected to provide leadership, coaching, prioritization, and performance direction for technical staff and subordinate leaders supporting market solutions, research, modeling, testing, implementation, and production-support activities.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Research, or another related technical field is required. Knowledge of Power Systems Engineering and Economics is preferred. A Master’s degree is strongly preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
A minimum of ten years of electrical engineering and/or software development experience is required, including technology leadership or supervisory experience in research, technology analysis, market systems, electric utilities, interconnected public service, or energy markets; or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
Experience should include knowledge of power system operations, system planning, electricity markets, computer systems, optimization modeling, application software development, data engineering, scripting, and shell programming. For the senior manager role, demonstrated progressive leadership of complex market technology initiatives, cross-functional implementation teams, vendor relationships, external research engagements, and production support functions is expected.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

None required.

Additional Requirements

Excellent verbal, written, presentation, interpersonal, organizational, teamwork, and management skills.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret scientific and technical journals, financial reports, legal documents, business periodicals, technical procedures, government regulations, and professional journals.
Ability to respond to inquiries or complaints from market participants, regulatory agencies, members of the business community, vendors, managers, and the public.
Ability to write reports, business correspondence, procedure manuals, speeches, articles, and materials that conform to prescribed style and format.
Ability to effectively present information to senior management, public groups, boards of directors, vendors, market participants, regulators, and cross-functional internal teams.
Ability to work with probability, statistical inference, advanced calculus, modern algebra, advanced statistical theory, geometry, trigonometry, optimization concepts, fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions, and to apply these concepts to practical situations.
Ability to define problems, collect and analyze data, establish facts, draw valid conclusions, interpret complex technical instructions, and apply logical or scientific thinking to abstract and concrete problems.
Advanced competency in Linux operating systems, shell programming including Sed and Awk, scripting languages such as Python, optimization modeling primarily in AMPL or GAMS, and fine-tuning solution tolerances in commercial solvers such as Gurobi or CPLEX.
Intermediate competency in Windows operating environments using Microsoft Office applications, e-mail, and internet programs.
Knowledge and understanding of market software, market software development processes, IT software development practices, project lifecycle activities, and production support disciplines.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, sit, and use hands to perform routine office tasks. The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Contact with staff and the public will occur. Travel may be required to attend and/or conduct meetings, conferences, and training. This position may require work on nights, weekends, or holidays.

At the NYISO, we realize the importance of balancing the availability of remote work with the inherent value of bringing people together to attain success in the areas of maximum collaboration, relationship building and growth, teamwork, innovation and problem solving, as well as professional development and mentoring. In this role, you will be required to work onsite from our Rensselaer, NY location several days per workweek, with the option to work remotely on the remaining days. You will also be expected to respond to all business needs that may require any increase to the regular onsite requirements.

The NYISO takes pride in recruiting, developing and retaining highly talented individuals. In addition to competitive salaries,

This role oversees all plant operations, maintenance, commissioning, and continued construction/expansion of the dedicated power plant, with full ownership of delivering reliable, high-availability electrical power to the Colossus AI training clusters. The position is responsible for driving operational excellence, ensuring 24/7 power reliability and quality, safety, environmental compliance, and leading cross-functional teams to achieve aggressive scale-up, availability, cost, and schedule objectives in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Provide strategic and operational leadership for the Memphis gas turbine power plant, including 24/7 operations, maintenance, commissioning, and ongoing construction and capacity expansion
Own end-to-end delivery of electrical power to the Colossus data center sites, ensuring industry-leading reliability, availability, power quality, and redundancy
Lead multidisciplinary teams of operators, maintenance technicians, engineers, contractors, and support staff in a 24/7 operational and construction environment
Oversee plant performance, commissioning, testing, and seamless integration with data center electrical infrastructure and load
Develop and execute comprehensive operations and maintenance strategies, including preventative/predictive maintenance, outage planning, hot gas path management, and OEM coordination for gas turbines, generators, balance of plant, and high-voltage electrical systems
Manage concurrent construction, equipment installation, civil works, and phased capacity expansions while maintaining safe, reliable operation of the existing plant
Ensure full compliance with environmental, safety, and regulatory requirements, including air permits, emissions controls, TDEC, EPA, OSHA, and local authorities
Partner closely with xAI data center operations, engineering, fuel suppliers, OEMs, utilities, and regulatory agencies
Formulate and execute operating budgets, fuel management, O&M, capital projects, and annual operating plans
Drive continuous improvement in plant availability, heat rate, emissions, cost, safety metrics, and operational processes
Establish and promote a culture of uncompromising safety, accountability, operational excellence, rapid execution, and collaboration
Serve as the site leader and primary representative to the Memphis community, regulators, and stakeholders
Recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing talent; manage staffing, resource allocation, and contractor oversight for both operations and construction

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, or other engineering discipline
8+ years of experience in power generation operations, plant management, or related industrial or aerospace operations
5+ years of leadership experience managing teams of operators, technicians, and engineers
Experience operating or managing gas turbine power plants (simple cycle or combined cycle)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
Experience managing large-scale gas turbine facilities (100 MW+), preferably with high-availability critical power applications (data centers, industrial, or similar)

Experience with high-voltage electrical systems, generators, switchgear, protection, and data center or industrial interconnection
Strong understanding of environmental permitting, air quality compliance, and regulatory reporting for combustion turbines
Experience in fast-paced, high-growth environments requiring simultaneous operations and major construction
Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, fuel costs, contractors, and complex stakeholder relationships
Excellent oral and written communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills
Unfazed by major, abrupt changes in strategic direction or aggressive timelines
Ability to work in a demanding, autonomously driven, start-up atmosphere

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
Ability to support and supervise plant operations and construction outside of normal business hours, including nights, weekends, and on-call response
Must be based at the Memphis, TN site
Willingness to work extended hours as needed to support plant reliability and construction milestones

jobs.description:
Location: Dallas, Nashville, Chicago, Atlanta

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Will you shape the future or will the future shape you?

The opportunity

As part of the Americas Tax Technology Group (ATTG), you will be part of an organization that designs, builds, and operates AI-enabled digital products that empower our Tax professionals and clients. ATTG partners closely with the Tax practice to deliver secure, scalable, and responsible technology solutions, including digital and mobile tools, data platforms, analytics, dashboards, visualization, and emerging generative AI–driven experiences.

Our work is guided by AI principles:

Human-centered and value-driven AI
Responsible, secure, and compliant by design
Reuse before build; platforms over point solutions
AI embedded into workflows, not bolted on
Rapid experimentation with disciplined scale

The Development Senior Manager (DM) sits within the Solution Delivery pillar, responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of AI-enabled products that support the Americas Tax practice.

This role blends people leadership, technical depth, and AI-informed decision making, ensuring products are delivered with speed, quality, and trust while aligning with firm architecture, security, and AI governance standards.

Your Key Responsibilities

Product Delivery Leadership:
Partner with Product Owners to design, plan, build, operate, and continuously improve one or more products within a portfolio, with a focus on AI-augmented capabilities
Own delivery outcomes including quality, reliability, performance, and long-term maintainability
Lead development teams to deliver secure, scalable, and cloud-native solutions, incorporating automation and AI where it drives measurable value
Ensure products meet 24x7 operational expectations, including leadership of urgent response teams for production issues

Agentic Engineering:
Drive the responsible adoption of generative AI and advanced analytics in product development, testing, support, and operations
Ensure AI solutions follow Responsible AI principles (security, privacy, explainability, compliance, and human oversight)
Promote reuse of AI patterns, components, accelerators, and platforms across products and portfolios
Embed AI into developer workflows (e.g., design, coding, testing, documentation, support) to improve speed and quality

Architecture, Standards & Platforms
Partner with Development Leads and Architects to create and maintain architecture artifacts including:
Infrastructure Architecture Documents (IAD)
Solution Design Documents (SDD)
AI architecture and integration patterns

Ensure adoption of Reference Architecture standards, development patterns, and engineering best practices
Drive consistency across teams while allowing flexibility for innovation and experimentation
Team & Talent Leadership

Lead and grow high-performing, inclusive development teams across onshore, offshore, and hybrid models
Set clear goals, assign work, manage performance, and conduct career development discussions
Coach teams to balance delivery excellence with innovation, leveraging AI as a force multiplier
Foster a culture of continuous learning, experimentation, and psychological safety
Coordinate closely with DevOps, Architecture, InfoSec, Data, and Platform teams
Create and maintain technical and AI roadmaps aligned with product and business strategy

Skills And Attributes For Success

Proven track record delivering mission-critical, 24x7 enterprise systems
Strong grounding in software engineering fundamentals and modern development practices
Deep understanding of distributed systems, Platforms and cloud-native architecture
Practical experience applying Agile / Lean delivery models
Ability to clearly articulate complex technical and AI-enabled solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Strong decision-making skills informed by data, quality metrics, and AI-assisted insights
Comfortable leading through ambiguity and driving predictable outcomes at scale

To qualify for the role you must have

Bachelor’s degree (Computer Science, Engineering, Accounting, Finance preferred) or equivalent experience
10–15 years of relevant experience
6+ years leading development teams using Agile/Lean practices
Approved technical certification is required
Design and deliver modern engineering solutions using Microsoft technology stack and AI technologies
Experience managing vendors and service providers
Strong executive presence and comfortable presenting to senior leadership

Ideally you will have

Master’s degree
Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and platform engineering
Exposure to project and portfolio management
Tax domain experience

What We Look For

We are looking for leaders who:

Believe AI should augment people, not replace them
Balance speed with trust, security, and compliance
Think in terms of platforms, ecosystems, and reuse
Are energized by coaching teams through change
Want to make a measurable impact on how Tax professionals work every day

If you’re excited to lead teams building AI-powered, responsible, and scalable solutions that matter, we’d love to hear from you.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

What We Offer You

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $101,700 to $294,800. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $122,000 to $335,100. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Data Engineering
jobs.description:
Dropbox is a Virtual First company. For this role, we are hiring in Zones 2 and 3. Please refer to our Compensation section below to see what neighborhoods fall under each Zone.

Role Description

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Data Engineering to lead the team responsible for Dropbox’s underlying data foundations that power our business as a whole. This is a hands-on engineering leader who owns the pipelines and data products that Product, GTM, Finance, and the CTO organization depend on to make decisions.

In this role, you will lead and grow a team of data engineers building and operating our ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and serving layers, as well as the self-serve analytics substrate that lets partner teams answer their own questions without bespoke engineering work.

The ideal candidate is a deeply technical, product-minded engineering leader who can hold a high bar on system reliability and data quality while partnering closely with Data Science, Business Intelligence Engineering, Analytics, and Product to turn fragmented, ticket-driven data work into durable, reusable data products.

Responsibilities

Data Quality & Observability: Establish and enforce a rigorous data quality culture: lineage, freshness monitoring, anomaly detection, and outcome-oriented, gaming-resistant quality metrics.
Self-Serve Platform: Lead the engineering of the self-serve analytics substrate, reducing bespoke request volume and increasing partner-team autonomy.
Cost & Efficiency: Own the unit economics of the data platform — compute and storage efficiency — and drive measurable improvements without sacrificing reliability.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner deeply with Data Science, BIE, Analytics, Product, Data Platform, and the CTO org to define the semantic layer, modeling standards, and data contracts that make downstream work trustworthy and fast.
Engineering Culture: Establish rigorous engineering practices — code review, testing, CI/CD for data, incident response, and postmortems — and champion the effective, measured use of AI coding tools to improve engineering productivity.
Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and grow a high-talent-density team of data engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, technical excellence, psychological safety, and continuous learning.

Requirements

8+ years of data engineering or backend/data infrastructure experience with increasing scope, ideally in high-scale environments.
3+ years of experience directly managing and growing engineering teams, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and team design.
Deep Technical Expertise: Proven track record building and operating large-scale batch and streaming pipelines (e.g., Spark, dbt, Airflow/orchestration) on a modern lakehouse or warehouse stack (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery).
Reliability & Quality: Demonstrated ownership of data SLAs, observability, lineage, and incident response for business-critical pipelines.
Systems & Modeling: Strong data modeling fundamentals and the ability to design a semantic layer and data contracts that serve many downstream consumers.
Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication and the ability to align engineering, data science, analytics, and business partners around shared reliability and quality goals.

Preferred Qualifications

Platform / Self-Serve Experience: Track record building self-serve data or analytics platforms that reduced bespoke request volume and increased partner autonomy.
AI-Forward Engineering: Experience integrating AI coding tools and LLM-based tooling into the engineering workflow, with a measured approach to impact and guardrails.
Cost Discipline: Demonstrated success improving compute/storage unit economics without regressing reliability.
Familiarity with modern data governance, privacy, and access-control practices.
Experience operating in a pod or embedded model serving multiple business partners.

Durable Skills

Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

Compensation

US Zone 1
This role is not available in Zone 1

US Zone 2
$202,700—$274,300 USD

US Zone 3
$180,200—$243,800 USD

The range(s) listed above is the expected annual salary/OTE (On-Target Earnings) for this role, subject to change. Please note, OTE are for sales roles only.

Salary/OTE is just one component of Dropbox’s total rewards package. All regular employees are also eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

Dropbox takes a number of factors into account when determining individual starting pay, including job and level they are hired into, location/metropolitan area, skillset, and peer compensation. We target most new hire offers between the minimum up to the middle of the range.

Dropbox uses the zip code of an employee’s remote work location to determine which metropolitan pay range we use. Current US Zone locations are as follows:

US Zone 1: San Francisco metro, New York City metro, or Seattle metro
US Zone 2: California (outside SF metro), Colorado, Connecticut (outside NYC metro), Delaware, Illinois (Chicago metro), Indiana (Chicago metro), Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan (Chicago metro), New Hampshire, New Jersey (outside NYC metro), New York (outside NYC metro), Oregon, Pennsylvania (D.C. metro), Pennsylvania (outside NYC metro), Texas (Austin metro) Virginia (DC metro), Washington (outside Seattle metro), Washington DC metro, West Virginia (DC metro), Wisconsin (Chicago metro)

Company Description

Together, these behaviors help build a workforce where technology amplifies human judgment, creativity, and impact.

jobs.title: Sr. Engineering Manager, MLOps
jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Founded in 2018, Quince was built to challenge the idea that nice things have to cost a lot. Our mission is simple: to make really high quality essentials for really low prices, produced fairly and sustainably. We believe everyone deserves exceptional craftsmanship and timeless design without the traditional markups. Quince is a direct-to-consumer (DTC) model that cuts out middlemen and leverages just-in-time manufacturing to minimize waste and maximize value.

Quince is a tech company disrupting the retail industry by putting AI, analytics and automation at the center of everything we do. Our unwavering commitment to excellence and company values guide our teams and actions:

Customer First: We prioritize customer satisfaction in every decision.
High Quality: True quality means premium materials and rigorous production standards you can feel good about.
Essential Design: We focus on timeless, functional essentials instead of chasing trends.
Always a Better Deal: Innovation and transparency ensure value for both customers and partners.
Social & Environmental Responsibility: We commit to sustainable materials, ethical production, and fair wages.

Quince partners with world-class manufacturers across the globe and serves millions of customers. With strong investor backing and a focus on sustainable growth, we are a company that is rapidly scaling while maintaining a commitment to quality, simplicity, and radical price transparency.

OUR TEAM AND SUCCESS

At Quince, you will be part of a high-performing team that is redefining what quality, value, and sustainability mean in modern retail. We are a destination for builders, innovators, and operators to come together and challenge the status quo. Our collective ambition is bold. We are creating an entirely new category and customer experience – one that democratizes luxury and provides high quality products at radically low prices. That mission demands a world-class team committed to excellence.

If you are motivated by impact, growth, and purpose, you will find a strong sense of belonging at Quince.

THE ROLE

Senior Engineering Manager, MLOps

We are seeking a Senior Engineering Manager, MLOps
to join our growing team. The ideal candidate is a technical visionary with a proven track record of building and scaling the underlying infrastructure that powers production-grade Machine Learning. You have a deep understanding of the ML lifecycle—from model development and distributed training to automated deployment and real-time monitoring—and you are passionate about treating infrastructure as a product for your "customers": Quince’s Data Scientists and AI Researchers. You are a self-starter who excels at identifying architectural bottlenecks and transforming them into seamless, automated "paved roads" that increase team velocity without sacrificing stability.

Thriving in an environment of rapid growth and ambiguity, you make high-judgment decisions on "build vs. buy" and prioritize technical roadmaps that align directly with e-commerce business outcomes. Above all, you are energized by a culture of distributed decision-making and extreme candor, where you will lead a high-performing team to set new standards for how AI is industrialized at scale to serve Quince customers.

Responsibilities

Define the MLOps Vision & Strategy: Architect a long-term roadmap that transitions ML workflows from manual scripts to a fully automated, self-service platform for all Quince Data Scientists and AI Researchers.
Own the "Paved Road" for Production: Build and maintain the end-to-end infrastructure for model training, deployment, and serving, ensuring researchers can move from "idea to production" with zero friction.
Drive Strategic Prioritization: Partner with business leaders to align infrastructure investments with core e-commerce drivers like real-time personalization, dynamic pricing, and inventory forecasting.
Lead "Build vs. Buy" Evaluations: Make high-judgment decisions on when to leverage cloud-native services (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI) versus building custom internal tools to optimize for cost, speed, and flexibility.
Guarantee System Scalability & Reliability: Oversee the uptime and performance of production ML services, ensuring the stack can handle massive traffic surges and seasonal spikes without degradation.
Manage Compute Governance & Costs: Direct the optimization of high-cost computational resources, such as GPU clusters and cloud instances, balancing high-performance training needs with fiscal responsibility.
Recruit and Mentor Top Talent: Build and lead a high-performing team of ML Infra and DevOps engineers, providing technical coaching, career pathing, and performance management.
Establish MLOps Standards: Drive the adoption of best practices in CI/CD for ML, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automated testing to ensure a modular and maintainable system.
Bridge the Research-Engineering Gap: Act as the primary cross-functional lead, translating the complex needs of AI Researchers into actionable engineering requirements for the infrastructure team.
Define and Track Velocity Metrics: Establish KPIs for the infrastructure team, such as model deployment frequency, mean time to recovery (MTTR), and infrastructure cost per inference.
Champion Operational Excellence: Lead root-cause analyses (RCAs) for production failures and foster a culture of accountability where systemic fixes are prioritized over "quick patches."
Stay Ahead of the AI Curve: Monitor emerging trends in LLM-ops, vector databases, and real-time feature engineering to ensure Quince’s infrastructure remains competitive and future-proof.

Qualifications

Required:

10+ years of industry experience, with at least 3-5 years in a leadership or management role specifically focused on ML Infrastructure, MLOps, or large-scale Data Platform engineering.
Proven track record of building and scaling MLOps platforms that support the full model lifecycle—from data ingestion and distributed training to real-time inference and monitoring.
Deep technical expertise in cloud-native infrastructure (preferably AWS) and orchestration tools like Kubernetes (EKS), Docker, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Pulumi).
Hands-on experience with ML frameworks and tooling, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Kubeflow, or SageMaker, and a strong opinion on how to integrate them into a cohesive developer experience.
Expertise in building and managing Feature Stores and high-throughput data pipelines (using tools like Spark, Flink, or Kafka) to ensure data consistency across training and serving.
Experience partnering with AI Research and Data Science teams to understand their unique workflows and translate research needs into robust, scalable engineering solutions.
Strong understanding of CI/CD for ML, including automated testing for models, model versioning, and "blue-green" or "canary" deployment strategies.
Demonstrated ability to manage high-cost compute resources, with experience optimizing GPU utilization and cloud spend in a hyper-growth environment.
Excellence in operational leadership, with a history of driving service availability, performance, and stability through rigorous on-call rotations and root-cause analysis.
A product-oriented mindset, with the ability to treat infrastructure as a platform and prioritize the roadmap based on researcher velocity and business ROI.
Exceptional communication and influence skills, capable of navigating ambiguity and building consensus across engineering, product, and data science leadership.
Kindness and high standards: You move fast and push for excellence, but you do so as a supportive team player who fosters a culture of psychological safety and extreme candor.

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range: $270,000 USD - $300,000 USD

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

jobs.description:
Chief Technology Officer (CTO)

An early-stage software company building tools for technical teams working with AI and robotics systems, helping them manage complex data and workflows to build more reliable automated systems. A hands-on leadership role owning technical strategy, architecture, engineering execution, and hiring across product engineering, infrastructure, and applied AI.

This is a senior technology leadership role with broad responsibility across enterprise IT, digital operations, cybersecurity, data, AI, applications, and technology-enabled products.

A major focus will be advancing responsible AI adoption, strengthening data and analytics capabilities, and evolving digital platforms for scale.

This opportunity suits a builder who thrives in a distributed, rapidly evolving environment where technology can create meaningful social impact.

Develop and execute a multi-year enterprise technology strategy and roadmap aligned with organizational priorities, growth plans, operational needs, and mission objectives.
Serve as a strategic technology advisor to executive leadership, providing guidance on technology investments, emerging technologies, risks, governance, architecture, and innovation opportunities.
Lead enterprise AI strategy, including identifying high-value use cases, establishing responsible-use standards and risk controls, evaluating tools, and driving implementation, adoption, training, and change management.

Establish organization-wide data governance, reporting standards, stewardship practices, business intelligence capabilities, dashboards, data quality processes, and Power BI initiatives.
Provide executive technology and product leadership for a mission-critical platform, overseeing architecture, cloud strategy, infrastructure, integrations, security, releases, vendors, scalability, and long-term sustainability.
Manage annual technology budgets, forecasts, contracts, licensing, purchasing, renewals, vendor negotiations, and multi-year investment plans while developing clear business cases for major technology decisions.
Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary technology and digital operations team, creating clarity around ownership, priorities, decision-making, accountability, and ways of working.
Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders, managed service providers, software vendors, implementation partners, and consultants to ensure resources remain aligned with organizational priorities.
Continuously improve technology governance, service quality, documentation, operational resilience, employee experience, and the organization's ability to use technology effectively at scale.

Demonstrated experience serving as the senior technology leader for a complex organization and developing and executing enterprise-wide technology strategies and roadmaps.

Experience leading CRM, data and analytics, digital platforms, enterprise applications, and significant technology implementations or transformations.
Demonstrated experience managing technology budgets, contracts, licensing, vendors, managed service providers, and implementation partners.
Experience evaluating, implementing, governing, and scaling AI-enabled solutions, with sound judgment regarding appropriate and responsible AI adoption.
Strong business acumen and the ability to translate organizational needs into practical technology priorities, investments, roadmaps, and execution plans.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technology concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong executive presence, relationship-building ability, and influence without relying solely on formal authority.
Comfortable operating as a builder in a mission-driven, distributed, high-growth, and continuously evolving environment.
Demonstrated ability to establish structure, governance, processes, and accountability where they may not yet fully exist.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience required; advanced degree or relevant certifications preferred.
Ability and authorization to work in the United States and work Eastern Time Zone hours.

jobs.title: Head of Salesforce Platform
jobs.description:
MMP Capital is seeking a senior Salesforce leader to own, scale, and continuously improve the company's Salesforce environment. This is not a traditional Salesforce Administrator role. MMP owns its Salesforce instance and needs a hands-on technical leader who can manage the platform as a strategic business system, support complex corporate workflows, and build the foundation for long-term scalability, automation, integrations, reporting, and governance.

The Head of Salesforce Platform will be responsible for Salesforce development, architecture, data model design, integration strategy, release management, security, platform governance, and technical debt management. The role will work closely with Sales, Operations, Credit, Funding, Servicing, Finance, Marketing, Technology, and executive leadership to ensure Salesforce supports MMP's current business processes and future operating model.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can code, architect, communicate with business leaders, manage priorities, and build a Salesforce team over time. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating in a fast-moving corporate environment and can translate business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions.

Key Responsibilities
Salesforce Technical Ownership and Architecture
Own the technical direction, architecture, and long-term roadmap for MMP Capital's Salesforce environment.
Design scalable Salesforce solutions across Sales, Operations, Credit, Funding, Servicing, Marketing, Finance, and executive reporting workflows.
Provide hands-on Salesforce development using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, validation rules, APIs, integrations, and related platform tools.
Own Salesforce data architecture, object design, field structure, automation patterns, permissions, roles, profiles, sharing rules, and security model.
Assess and reduce technical debt while improving platform scalability, maintainability, documentation, and system performance.

Development, Integrations, and Release Management
Lead Salesforce development and configuration efforts, balancing declarative automation with custom code where appropriate.
Design and support integrations between Salesforce and key systems, including lease / loan management systems, MuleSoft, document/OCR workflows, data warehouse, marketing platforms, third-party data providers, and operational systems.
Establish disciplined release management, sandbox usage, deployment controls, testing standards, change management, and production support processes.
Partner with internal stakeholders and external vendors to define requirements, review designs, manage delivery, and validate system changes.
Create and maintain documentation for architecture decisions, process flows, integrations, automations, and support procedures.

Business Partnership and Corporate Platform Leadership
Partner with Sales, Operations, Credit, Funding, Servicing, Finance, Marketing, Technology, and executive leadership to understand business needs and translate them into practical Salesforce solutions.
Help standardize and improve Salesforce-enabled workflows from lead intake through underwriting, funding, booking, servicing handoff, reporting, and management visibility.
Serve as the senior internal Salesforce point of contact for platform strategy, prioritization, governance, troubleshooting, and system improvement.
Communicate technical tradeoffs, risks, timelines, and implementation options clearly to business and executive stakeholders.
Support broader technology transformation initiatives, including data quality, reporting, automation, LMS integration, and future AI-enabled workflows.

Governance, Controls, and Roadmap
Create a Salesforce governance model covering intake, prioritization, approvals, development standards, testing, release cadence, documentation, and user adoption.
Develop and maintain a Salesforce roadmap aligned with MMP's business priorities, operating model, technology stack, and growth objectives.
Implement controls around user access, permission changes, data quality, duplicate management, system changes, and integration reliability.
Build reporting and monitoring around Salesforce health, user adoption, workflow exceptions, stale data, integration failures, and operational bottlenecks.
Ensure Salesforce is managed as a core enterprise platform rather than a collection of ad hoc requests and point solutions.

Team Building and Vendor Management
Help define the future Salesforce organization structure, including hiring needs, skill requirements, role responsibilities, and team operating cadence.
Hire, mentor, and manage Salesforce administrators, developers, analysts, or contractors as the platform and business needs scale.
Provide technical leadership and coaching to internal users, project teams, junior team members, and vendor resources.
Manage external Salesforce partners or consultants as needed, ensuring quality delivery, knowledge transfer, and alignment with MMP standards.

Required Experience and Skills
7+ years of Salesforce experience, including significant hands-on development and architecture responsibility.
Strong hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, APIs, integrations, data architecture, security, and deployment / release processes.
Experience owning, architecting, or leading a Salesforce platform in an enterprise or corporate environment.
Strong understanding of Salesforce platform governance, technical debt management, scalability, data quality, documentation, and roadmap development.
Experience supporting complex business processes and working cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, IT, Finance, Marketing, and executive leadership.
Ability to remain technically hands-on while also operating as a business-facing leader and platform owner.
Experience hiring, mentoring, managing, or building Salesforce teams, including administrators, developers, analysts, or vendor resources.
Strong communication skills, business judgment, problem-solving ability, and ownership mindset.
Ability to operate in a fast-moving, high-growth environment with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

Preferred Experience
Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I/II, Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, Application Architect, System Architect, or Technical Architect are preferred.
Experience in equipment finance, commercial lending, specialty finance, fintech, banking, leasing, or financial services is strongly preferred.
Experience integrating Salesforce with lease / loan management systems, MuleSoft, data warehouses, marketing automation platforms, document/OCR tools, or third-party data providers is a plus.
Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement, CRM Analytics, or Financial Services Cloud is a plus.
Experience building Salesforce operating models, change advisory processes, release calendars, and user adoption programs is a plus.

Systems and Tools
Salesforce Platform, Apex, LWC, Flows, SOQL, APIs, integrations, security, roles, profiles, permission sets, and sharing rules
Salesforce deployment tools, sandboxes, change sets, DevOps Center, Gearset, Copado, Git, or similar release management tools
Salesforce reporting, dashboards, CRM Analytics, Power BI, Tableau, or related BI tools
MuleSoft, REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, data warehouse, ETL/ELT, or integration tools
Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Microsoft Office, and related project / documentation tools

Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, Finance, or a related field preferred. Equivalent practical experience in Salesforce development, architecture, and platform leadership will also be considered.

Work Arrangement
This is a full-time role based out of MMP Capital's Melville, NY office

Job Conditions
This position supports a high-volume, fast-moving business environment and may require flexibility around production releases, system issues, business deadlines, and priority initiatives.
The role requires close collaboration with multiple departments and frequent interaction with business stakeholders, technology partners, vendors, and executive leadership.
The position requires the ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods of time.
MMP Capital operates under a team-based environment, and the employee may be asked to support related tasks within the scope and ability of the position.

Mountain View Electric Association (MVEA) is one of the fastest growing mission-driven and member-owned electric cooperatives in Colorado. With offices in Falcon and Limon, our service territory spans 5,000 square miles from the foothills outside of Colorado Springs through the rolling plains of eastern Colorado. 

While a lot has changed in our industry since we were incorporated as a not-for-profit electric cooperative in 1941, MVEA still operates on the values we started with years ago—integrity, accountability, innovation, and commitment to community. Today, 
MVEA is proud to provide safe, reliable, and affordable electricity to more than 58,500 members and over 68,500 meters in portions of eight counties.

Our electric cooperative is financially strong and experiences tremendous growth of over 2,000 accounts per year due to the expanding communities outside of Colorado Springs. MVEA has annual revenues of over $125 million and over 6,500 miles of distribution line. We are a respected leader in the distribution cooperative industry due to a long history of safety, reliable service, member engagement, financial health, rate stability, and employee dedication. 

To learn more about MVEA and the communities we serve, visit www.mvea.coop.

Competitive Salary and Outstanding Benefits Package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Long-Term Disability, Life, and Paid Time Off

Stable and Growing Company
Four Day Work Week (Monday through Thursday 7 a.m. to 5:30 p.m.)
Great Company Culture

GENERAL JOB SUMMARY:

Manages a variety of Engineering functions including drafting, RF design, document control and/or similar engineering support activities. Ensures the timely, thorough, and accurate completion of all Engineering projects. Oversees the preparation of new and modified designs. Ensures documentation packages are complete. Maintains part and project number assignments, drawing reproduction, and customer documentation. Selects, develops, and evaluates personnel to ensure the efficient operation of the function.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

Lead an RF & Microwave Design Engineering team in the design and development of frequency converters, synthesized frequency sources, solid-state power amplifiers (SSPAs), Direct-RF converters, and complex multi-function assemblies (MFAs) for aerospace and defense applications. Products will include frequency converters, synthesizers, Solid State Power Amplifiers (SSPAs), switched filter banks, tunable filters, and integrated transmit/receive (T/R) assemblies.
Manage personnel development, new business bids & proposals, and the successful design, development, and production release / transition to production of new products.
Manage employee development & operational improvements of the RF, Microwave, & Mixed Signal design group in support of company goals & objectives. Participate in recruiting & team development.
Technical responsibilities include leading the design of RF architectures and systems using chain analysis and frequency planning tools such as VSS.
Design of RF components using MWO, CST, HFSS, Sonnet, SPICE, etc.
Evaluation and selection of devices that are suitable for the applications & operating environment, meeting customer requirements. This includes the design and selection of LNAs, PAs, filters, mixers, frequency multipliers, isolators, couplers, phase locked oscillator, and synthesizers.
Perform trade studies for noise figure, power compression, linearity, and isolation.
Perform hardware layout, component evaluation, prototype construction, and test.
Prepare test methods and specifications, analyze and test hardware to verify performance.
Lead both internal and external PDR, CDR, and MRR design reviews, generating and delivering presentations to our internal leadership team and to customers.
Provide guidance on technology trends and help drive innovation to maintain our leading edge technical capabilities relative to competitors.

This position has supervisory responsibilities.

Extensive experience with devices, circuitry, and systems operating at RF, microwave, and millimeter-wave frequencies.

Knowledge of signal routing, mechanical layout, and packaging technologies for devices and subassemblies.
Ability to conceptualize initial component and system designs with block diagrams and cascade analyses.

Ability to organize results for design reviews and customer presentations.
Ability to communicate clearly with excellent verbal, written, & presentation skills.

Experience with Mixed Signal & Direct-RF / Direct-to-Digital products a plus.
Previous experience managing & developing technical employees.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to find creative and innovative solutions.
Strong lab skills using test equipment, and ability to tune and align circuitry.
Must be proficient with RF design software such as Cadence/AWR’s Microwave Office and/or ADS.

Safe-Guard Products International is the industry leader in automotive protection products and F&I solutions, partnering with the world's top OEM brands and a nationwide network of franchised and independent dealerships.
