As we accelerate AI transformation, we are seeking a proven Head of Software Engineering to lead the engineering organization responsible for our client-facing and internal operations platforms. This is a career-defining opportunity for a technology leader who has built AI-native engineering cultures, delivered AI-powered platforms in complex regulated industries, and knows how to win in both the automotive and insurance environments.

Role Overview

The Head of Software Engineering owns software engineering strategy and execution across Safe-Guard's core platform portfolio. You will lead a multi-team engineering organization that builds and operates the systems underpinning dealer enrollment, incentive programs, rating, quoting, and remitting workflows, claims adjudication, cancellations, payment processing, and direct-to-consumer product experiences. You will partner with Sales, Key Partner Management, Operations, and executive leadership to align engineering capacity and roadmaps with company strategy, and you will help champion Safe-Guard's vision of AI-native software development, operationalizing the use of Claude, Cursor, and similar LLMs and software tools across engineering teams.

Note : This role does not have responsibility for ERP / Financial Systems or Business Analytics / BI reporting platforms.

What You Will Do

Engineering Leadership & Team Development

Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing software engineering organization across multiple product domains, client-facing dealer and OEM platforms, internal operations systems, and direct-to-consumer applications.
Own recruiting, hiring, and retention of top engineering talent; build career progression that reward technical excellence and leadership growth at every level.
Establish and sustain a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous learning for engineers do their best work.
Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development conversations; actively develop direct reports into future leaders.
Partner with HR and Talent Acquisition to strengthen Safe-Guard's employer brand within the software engineering community.

Platform Ownership & Technical Strategy

Own the engineering roadmap and outcomes for Safe-Guard's client-facing platforms (dealer enrollment, rating, quoting, contract remittance, incentive management, direct-to-consumer) and internal platforms (claims adjudication, cancellations, and payments).
Define and help drive the technical architecture strategy, balancing modernization, and scalability, across a portfolio of applications serving automotive and insurance workflows.
Partner with Sales, Product Management, and Operations to translate business objectives into executable technical roadmaps, ensuring alignment between engineering capacity and company priorities.
Drive continuous improvement in system reliability, performance, and security; establish engineering standards for code quality, testing, observability, and incident response.
Make sound architectural and build/buy/partner decisions, clearly communicating trade-offs to senior leadership and stakeholders.

AI-Native Culture & Platform Development

Help champion Safe-Guard's AI vision by embedding AI-assisted development practices as standard practice across all engineering teams.
In collaboration with technology leadership, help design and delivery of AI-native platform capabilities, including intelligent automation in claims adjudication, contract processing, rating workflows, and dealer-facing experiences.
Build a team culture where engineers default to AI-first thinking: leveraging AI to accelerate development velocity, improve code quality, reduce operational work, and expand product capabilities.
Stay current on AI tooling and agentic AI approaches; bring informed recommendations to the technology and product leadership on emerging capabilities applicable to Safe-Guard's platforms.
Establish evaluation frameworks and responsible-use guidelines ensuring AI capabilities deployed in production meet Safe-Guard's quality, compliance, security, and reliability standards.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

Serve as the primary engineering voice in executive and cross-functional forums; communicate technical strategy, progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
Partner with Operations, Compliance, and Legal teams to ensure platforms meet the regulatory requirements of automotive and insurance administration.
Collaborate closely with our dealer network, OEM partners, and Key partner executive teams to incorporate external feedback into the platform roadmap.
Drive alignment across peer technology leaders—Product, Architecture, Data, Security, and IT to deliver cohesive, integrated platform experiences.

Delivery Excellence & Operational Maturity

Own end-to-end software delivery accountability ensuring teams execute with predictability, quality, and a consistent sense of urgency.
Implement and refine delivery practices, release cadences, and engineering health metrics that give leadership clear visibility into team performance and platform health.
Drive operational excellence: runbooks, post-incident reviews, and a culture of proactive reliability over reactive firefighting.
Identify and remove organizational and technical blockers that impede team velocity.

Experience

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

15+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including 7+ years leading engineering organizations of 70 or more engineers across multiple teams and domains including offshore contracting resources.
Demonstrated success building and scaling AI-native engineering cultures to fundamentally transform how engineering teams design and build software.
Hands-on experience building AI-powered production platforms; familiarity with LLMs, agentic AI architectures, and practical integration patterns for regulated business workflows.
Direct experience with AI-assisted development tooling including Anthropic's Claude, Cursor, and similar LLMs and products at team or organizational scale.
Proven track record in the automotive industry with direct experience working with dealer networks, OEM brands, or automotive F&I platforms strongly preferred.
Meaningful experience in insurance or insurance-adjacent domains (policy administration, claims processing, coverage rating and quoting, or similar regulated workflows).
Track record delivering complex, client-facing SaaS or platform products in a B2B environment where uptime, performance, and compliance are non-negotiable.

Technical & Domain Expertise

Strong command of modern software architecture patterns: microservices, event-driven systems, API-first design, cloud-native infrastructure, and DevSecOps practices.
Deep familiarity with the software development lifecycle: code quality standards, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, release management, and production observability.
Understanding of the regulatory and compliance landscape relevant to automotive protection products, vehicle service contracts, and insurance product administration.
Experience with payment processing platforms, financial transaction workflows, or claims administration systems is a strong advantage.

Leadership & Communication

Exceptional ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable narratives for executive, business, and cross-functional audiences.
Proven ability to build trust with internal and external customers operating as a credible technology partner, not just an internal function.
High emotional intelligence; skilled at navigating organizational complexity, building consensus across competing priorities, and leading through change.

We are seeking a Director, Forward Deployed Engineering to own the technical strategy, integration architecture, and deployment execution that enables Hippocratic AI to launch voice-forward AI agents in. This is one of the most technically creative roles in the company - defining how agentic AI connects to customers requirements, and to the technical infrastructure within complex and security-conscious health environments. You will translate customer needs into Hippocratic agent technical specs and iterate with both the customer and the internal tech team on developing AI agents. You will design the integration of Hippocratic agents with customer CRM ecosystems, data lakes, and API architectures, working within their data governance frameworks and IT approval processes. You will own the agent script development, integration architecture, technical approval playbooks, and deployment operations that translate signed enterprise contracts into live, production-grade implementations. You will grow and develop a talent-dense team of Forward Deployed Engineers.

Customer-Facing Technical Leadership

Lead technical discovery sessions with customer IT teams during the sales process — assessing integration requirements, identifying technical risks, defining deployment scope, and building the technical implementation plan that accompanies the commercial proposal

Customer AI Agent Development
Drive the translation of customer use case requirements into technical specs for AI agent development, from discovery through to UAT
Develop best practices for productive and rapid iteration and comprehensive testing of AI agent scripts. Maintain a continuous improvement playbook for script development that can be leveraged across customer engagements
Partner with Engineering to define AI agent building capabilities, integration platform capabilities, and technical infrastructure investments needed to support new customers

Integration Strategy, Technical Architecture and Security
Develop reference integration architectures for the platform's core deployment patterns, including integrations with CRM systems (Ex: Veeva, Salesforce Health Cloud), EHR (Ex: Epic, Cerner/Oracle Health), contact center and telephony platforms (Genesys, Five9, Amazon Connect, Twilio), and enterprise data lakes.
Design reliable and secure API-first integration patterns including REST APIs, webhooks, batch and real-time data synchronization
Working closely with the Hippocratic AI CISO, own the end-to-end process for navigating pharma IT security reviews, vendor qualification, and technical approval processes — building the documentation, processes, and institutional knowledge that make each subsequent approval faster.
Define and operationalize a repeatable deployment methodology for implementations — covering environment provisioning, integration configuration, data migration, testing protocols, UAT, go-live, rollback procedures and production monitoring. Oversee early deployments hands-on

What You Bring

Must‑Have:

Bachelor's degree or higher in a technical discipline (Computer Science, Engineering, Health Informatics, or Life Sciences). Advanced degrees or certifications in cloud architecture, or enterprise integration are a plus.
10+ years of experience in enterprise technical integration, forward deployment operations, solution engineering, or technical consulting in enterprise environments, preferably in healthcare.
5+ years of experience building and managing a team of forward deployment or integration engineers.
Strong technical fluency across API design and integration patterns and cloud infrastructure.
Demonstrated ability to engage credibly with enterprise CTOs, CISOs, enterprise architects, and IT governance teams — speaking their language and addressing their concerns with technical precision.
Comfort working in high-growth environments with limited structure, ambiguous requirements, fast pace, and high expectations for ownership, technical leadership, and cross-functional collaboration.

Nice‑to‑Have

Experience deploying AI, machine learning, conversational AI, or NLP platforms into enterprise environments.
Direct experience navigating enterprise IT security reviews, vendor qualification processes, and enterprise IT governance — including SOC 2, HIPAA technical safeguards, SIG questionnaires, and CISO-level security evaluations.
Hands-on knowledge of IT ecosystems including CRM platforms (Veeva, Salesforce Health Cloud), specialty pharmacy and hub systems, EHR systems, contact center platforms, safety databases, and enterprise data infrastructure.
Experience building and leading technical deployment or integration engineering teams.
Startup or early-stage company experience

jobs.description:
At Protegrity, we lead innovation by using AI and quantum-resistant cryptography to transform data protection across cloud-native, hybrid, on-premises, and open source environments. We leverage advanced cryptographic methods such as tokenization, format-preserving encryption, and quantum-resilient techniques to protect sensitive data. As a global leader in data security, our mission is to ensure that data isn’t just valuable but also usable, trusted, and safe.

Protegrity offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of innovation and collaboration, with the ability to make a meaningful impact on the industry while working alongside some of the brightest minds. Together, we are redefining how the world safeguards data, enabling organizations to thrive in a GenAI era where data is the ultimate currency. If you're ready to shape the future of data security, Protegrity is the place for you.

Protegrity is seeking a passionate and talented Senior Manager of Engineering to join our Engineering organization. This position is a remote role.

Role Overview

You enjoy leading teams that ship customer-facing product experiences at scale. You bring strong front-end engineering depth, pair it with pragmatic people leadership, and love building reusable platform capabilities that help multiple product teams move faster.

In this role you’ll lead 2–3 product teams (including the core UI team), set technical direction for a micro-frontend architecture and shell SDK, and stay close to the code—especially when a problem needs hands-on help. You’ll also champion AI-assisted development practices to accelerate delivery while keeping quality, security, and accessibility bar-high.

What You’ll Do

Lead 2–3 product engineering teams (including the core UI team), providing day-to-day management, coaching, mentoring, and performance support while maintaining a strong technical presence.
Set technical direction for the UI platform: micro-frontend architecture, React/TypeScript standards, shell SDK interfaces, module contracts, and shared design-system/theming patterns.
Drive engineering execution: sprint planning, technical prioritization, code reviews, and hands-on contributions to unblock delivery and improve reliability.
Establish and evolve CI/CD for independently deployable front-end modules, including build pipelines, artifact management, automated testing, and safe rollout practices.
Ensure reusable UI and service capabilities are well-designed and documented (including company-wide ‘skills files’/patterns), and guide integration with supporting backend services such as user management and authorization.
Partner closely with Product Management to define roadmap, scope features, and deliver high-impact product outcomes.

Promote scalable integration patterns including event-driven communication and shared state approaches across modules and services.

8+ years of software engineering experience with 3+ years leading and managing engineers (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
Strong React 18+ expertise (hooks, Suspense, StrictMode, error boundaries, lazy loading) and modern TypeScript patterns.
Deep experience with Webpack 5 and Module Federation or similar approaches to modular front-end architecture.
Experience designing and operating micro-frontend systems or other independently deployable UI architectures.
Solid experience integrating or developing backend services, including API design and microservices-based architectures.
Familiarity with event-driven communication patterns (pub/sub) and cross-module state management approaches.
Experience implementing or working with authentication and authorization patterns (e.g., JWT, RBAC).
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern development practices including testing and code quality standards.
Strong collaboration skills with product, design, and engineering teams, with the ability to balance technical decisions and delivery outcomes.

Experience with accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1) and building inclusive user experiences.
Exposure to AI/LLM-powered UI experiences or developer productivity tools.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Internal Platforms & Developer Experience
jobs.description:
Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.

Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.

Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.

As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.

We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.

We’re transforming the collecting experience with technology that brings authentication, grading, and trading into the modern era. Our products are equalizing the playing field by providing tools that make complex research analytics — including pricing, scarcity reports, and historic sales data — accessible to every collector, old or new. Our engineering mission is to democratize technology while promoting innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning throughout the organization.

Collectors is committed to utilize cybersecurity, risk and privacy best practices on our platforms, leveraging signal intelligence and observability at scale to protect our customers, employees and our brand. We’re looking for a Director of Internal Platforms and Developer Experience to join our Platform Engineering team to partner with the broader Product and Tech org and build the foundational systems that our engineers rely on to build, deploy and run our applications.

You’ll report to the VP of Engineering, Information Security and Platforms. Remote or hybrid candidates will also be considered. We believe that there is significant value in in-person collaboration. If you live within a 1 hour commuting distance to one of our offices, you will be required to be onsite most of the time. This will be discussed further as part of the recruiting process.

What You’ll Do

Define and drive the platform engineering strategy across infrastructure, developer experience, and AI enablement, ensuring alignment with broader organizational goals and technology roadmaps.
Lead and develop multiple engineering teams responsible for core infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, cloud services, and the internal developer platform, fostering a culture of reliability, ownership, and continuous improvement.
Own the vision for developer experience, ensuring internal teams have access to well-documented, self-service tooling and platforms that reduce friction and accelerate the path from code to production.
Establish and oversee AI enablement strategies, including the evaluation, integration, and governance of AI-assisted development tools and frameworks, ensuring teams can adopt AI capabilities responsibly and effectively.
Define guardrails and governance frameworks for AI adoption, partnering with security, legal, and compliance stakeholders to create policies that balance innovation velocity with risk management, data privacy, and responsible use.
Set standards for platform reliability, scalability, and security, driving investment in observability, incident response, infrastructure-as-code, and capacity planning to support the organization's growth.
Partner cross-functionally with product engineering, security, data, and architecture leaders to ensure platform capabilities meet current and emerging needs across the organization.
Champion a platform-as-a-product mindset, using internal feedback loops, adoption metrics, and developer satisfaction data to continuously iterate on the platforms and services your teams provide.

Who You Are

A seasoned engineering leader with 10+ years of experience in software or infrastructure engineering, including 5+ years managing engineering teams and at least 2+ years leading managers or multiple teams simultaneously.
Deeply technical with a strategic mindset. You've built or scaled platform and infrastructure organizations and can move fluidly between architectural decisions and organizational strategy without losing sight of either.
An expert in modern infrastructure and platform tooling, with hands-on experience across cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), container orchestration (k8s), CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD), infrastructure-as-code (Terrafor/Crossplane), and observability stacks.
A champion of developer experience. You've operated with a platform-as-a-product philosophy, and you have a track record of building internal tooling and self-service platforms that measurably improve developer productivity and satisfaction.
Fluent in the AI-assisted development landscape. You understand the current ecosystem of AI coding assistants, code generation tools, and LLM-based development frameworks, and you've led or contributed to organizational strategies for adopting them thoughtfully.
Governance-minded without being risk-averse. You know how to design guardrails and policies around emerging technology — particularly AI — that protect the organization without stifling innovation, and you're comfortable partnering with security, legal, and compliance teams to get there.
A strong cross-functional partner. You build trust easily with product engineering, architecture, security, and business stakeholders, and you're skilled at translating platform capabilities into business value.
Operationally excellent. You've managed cloud infrastructure budgets, vendor relationships, and capacity planning at scale, and you bring a disciplined approach to headcount planning and resource allocation.
An effective communicator who can articulate platform strategy and technical trade-offs to audiences ranging from individual contributors to executive leadership with equal clarity.

Salary Range

The salary range for this position is $212,000- $300,000. Actual compensation on this range varies based on a variety of non-discriminatory factors, including location, job level, experience, and skill set. This role may be eligible for bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation, please ask your recruiter for details.

Reasons To Join Us

Health Insurance: All full-time employees are eligible to enroll in Medical, Dental, and Vision.
Additional Benefits: Full-time employees are eligible for fertility, commuter, and educational assistance benefits.
401(K) Matching Plan: We are proud to offer a competitive 401k matching plan to our employees to support their future financial goals.
Vacation: All salaried employees are eligible for flexible time-off.
Holiday Pay: All regular, full-time employees are eligible for ten company paid holidays.

Fun Working Environment: Our team members are invited to participate in celebrations, holiday events, and team building activities.
Additional Resources: Collectors Tech Blog, PSA.

About The Job

In gTech Users and Products (gUP), our mission is to advocate for Google’s users by creating helpful and trusted experiences across the product ecosystem. We achieve this by meeting partners and consumers where they are with support and help, representing their needs with our product partners and proposing fixes and features that elevate their engagement with Google's diverse product ecosystem. Additionally we provide a range of product services that ensure our products are optimized for every user, no matter where they are in the world (e.g., localization, digitization, partner integration, and more).

The mission of the Platforms and Devices (P&D) team in gUP is to support users (end users, partners, small businesses, etc.) for Google’s consumer products and services such as Pixel, Google Fi, Home and Health, Google Store, Google subscriptions as well as Google Store.

As the Head of gUP P&D for Google Store Product and Customer Support Excellence, you will lead a high-performing team of Product Support Managers and assist cross-functional effort. You will act as a strategic consultant to the Google Store Product area, translating complex user feedback and friction points into actionable insights that shape the future of the Store portions of the Pixel ecosystem, Store product roadmaps and customer support strategies. Your mission is to advocate customer trust, mitigate fraud, and scale support operations through innovative AI and automation.

Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.

To learn more about gTech, check out our video .

Partner with the AI Architect Principal and AI Solution Architects to align agentic platform evolution with organizational priorities and technology roadmaps.
Collaborate with security and operations teams to ensure the platform is secure, compliant, and maintains high uptime and reliability.
Engage with leadership to align technical initiatives with organizational objectives.

Foster a high-performance culture emphasizing innovation, collaboration, and agile delivery.

Drive high standards of code quality, testing, and engineering practices.
Advocate for platform engineering best practices, ensuring systems are maintainable, extensible, and documented.

Operational Excellence

Implement observability and monitoring tools to proactively identify performance or security issues.
Ensure platform compliance with responsible AI, data privacy, and ethical ML principles.
Build and develop architecture audit process, and execute
Identify opportunities for automation, process improvements, and tooling that enhance platform reliability and efficiency.

Experience designing MLOps pipelines and AI Ops frameworks at enterprise scale

Through financial consulting rooted in data, technology, and AI, we help clients drive value—supporting the office of the CFO to drive end-to-end value creation.

Data & Analytics

Accordion's Data & Analytics (D&A) team offers cutting-edge, intelligent solutions to a global clientele, leveraging a blend of domain knowledge, sophisticated technology tools, and deep analytics capabilities to tackle complex business challenges.

We partner with Private Equity clients and their Portfolio Companies across diverse sectors, including Retail, CPG, Healthcare, Media & Entertainment, Technology, and Logistics.

We deliver data and analytical solutions designed to streamline reporting capabilities and enhance business insights across vast and complex data sets ranging from Sales, Operations, Marketing, Pricing, Customer Strategies, and more.

Lead end-to-end delivery of modern data platforms for our clients—owning scope, schedule, budget, and outcomes. You’ll run agile delivery teams, guide medallion/lakehouse architectures, and partner with clients to translate business goals into scalable solutions on Snowflake, Azure & Databricks.

Client leadership: Serve as the day-to-day executive contact; run steering committees, manage change requests, and drive stakeholder alignment and adoption.

10+ years of technology delivery with 5+ years leading data platform or analytics programs in consulting/professional services.
Proven success managing $1M–$5M+ multi-workstream programs with distributed teams.
Hands-on familiarity with Snowflake (warehouses, RBAC, performance/cost tuning) and Azure data services (ADF/Fabric, Databricks, Synapse, ADLS, networking & security).
Strong command of agile delivery (Scrum/Kanban), Jira/Azure DevOps, release planning, and CI/CD for data (Git-based workflows, environments).
Practical experience implementing medallion architectures and lakehouse patterns, data modeling, and data quality/observability.
Stakeholder management at VP/C-suite level; crisp written/oral communication and executive reporting.
Nice to have: regulated industries, FinOps for data platforms, data privacy/compliance (GDPR/CCPA), and analytics enablement (Power BI/Fabric).

Preferred Requirements

BS/MS in CS, IS, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
PMP, PMI-ACP, or SAFe; Snowflake SnowPro; Microsoft Azure (DP-203, AZ-305) a plus.

Programs delivered on-time/on-budget with measurable business outcomes (e.g., SLA improvements, cost per query reductions, faster time-to-insight).
Stable, secure, and cost-efficient Snowflake/Azure platforms with clear operating models and playbooks.
High client satisfaction (CSAT/NPS) and referenceable accounts.

jobs.title: Director Engineering - Synthetic Molecule Design and Development
jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

At Lilly, Synthetic Molecule Design and Development (SMDD) is involved in key activities for the development of synthetic active pharmaceutical ingredients from pre-clinical phases through commercialization of drug substances and drug products. Our scientists and engineers develop key technical and business solutions across the portfolio using their deep technical expertise to accelerate testing of the clinical hypothesis and overall drug development. SMDD delivers on these responsibilities by recognizing diverse talent and cultures are necessary to bring the next generation of life changing medicines to patients.

Position Summary

Our team is looking for experienced, creative, and energetic candidates to lead unit operation development and process optimization of synthetic drug candidates to support clinical trials, regulatory submission, and product commercialization. The position presents an opportunity to lead dynamic teams comprised of process chemists, analytical chemists, formulation scientists, and engineers.

Responsibilities

Possess fluent knowledge in unit operation design, process modeling, process equipment selection, and scale-up methodologies with a drive to challenge existing methods; create and apply cutting edge technology and novel platforms within a time constrained environment.
Familiarity and working knowledge of modern synthetic organic chemistry.
Demonstrate high learning agility with the ability to understand and exploit new scientific concepts and methods across multiple disciplines; be able to apply these learnings to a portfolio of small molecule, oligonucleotide, and synthetic peptide modalities.
Lead and/or supervise the design and development of new synthetic routes for the manufacture of active pharmaceutical ingredients using the most modern technologies, including continuous processing, automated reaction screening, PAT, and modeling and simulation.
Ability to lead a cross-disciplinary team to evaluate and refine new manufacturing routes, manufacturing technologies, and practices to deliver a challenging portfolio.
Comfortable with scientific uncertainty and the ability to translate hypotheses into action.
Encourage team members to take initiative and accountability to achieve goals; draws out and encourages others to share knowledge.
Provide technical guidance in the scale-up and demonstration of new chemical processes in development and commercial scale equipment. Participate in technology transfer activities to CRO/CMO organizations and Lilly manufacturing to ensure processes are technically sound, well developed and characterized, and safe.
Design laboratory experimentation in support of process design, definition, optimization, and technology transfer objectives. Ability to generate process (and property design) data based on a fundamental understanding of the underlying physical processes. Utilize advancements in technology (PAT) and modeling platforms to understand and direct experimental protocols.
Plan and manage short term and long-term development activities. Develop and/or review technical agendas and timelines for project work. Recommend resource allocation to accomplish projects according to plans, communicate progress and propose changes in timeline, objectives, or direction.
Collaborate with internal and external manufacturing partners to develop robust chemical process that are readily amenable to efficient drug substance manufacturing.
Collaborate closely with Product Delivery, Project Management, Quality, Manufacturing, and Regulatory scientists to execute and deliver material and information for clinical trials and regulatory submissions.
Embrace diverse thought, background, and experience to deliver innovative solutions.
Possess strong communication (oral, written), organizational, and leadership skills.
Supervise, mentor and develop scientific staff. Ensure continued technical and professional growth of group members, encourage efforts towards excellence and knowledge sharing.
Active participant in the external environment and the ability to recognize and apply external innovation and across the Lilly synthetic portfolio.
Possess deep understanding of the external global regulatory climate and emerging requirements. Ability to address key CMC regulatory questions that enable clinical studies and support marketing authorization applications.

Basic Qualifications

Ph.D. in chemical engineering or a closely related field with 8+ years of experience; or MS degree with 15+ years of experience.
Experience developing chemical processes the from mid-development cycle (proof of concept) to product commercialization required
Experience with technical transfer of processes into manufacturing operations required
Experience within the pharmaceutical sector is desired; however, other relevant experience may meet expectations. Prior experience in the development of an active ingredient and associated formulated product is acceptable. Relevant industrial sectors include agrochemicals, nutraceuticals, specialty chemicals, and personal care products.

Additional Skills/Preferences

Experience with authoring regulatory submissions and responding to regulatory questions.
Experience with modeling and simulation tools, data analytics, and predictive analytics.
Experience with online and offline analytical techniques and process analytical technologies (PAT).
Strong technical skills to supply business value.
Creativity and ability to transform ideas into marketable products and processes.
Knowledge and experience with management of a technical project.
Demonstrated leadership capabilities especially in a team environment.
Demonstrated ability to drive and accept change.
Demonstrated success in persuasion, influence and negotiation.
Good interpersonal skills and a sustained tendency for collaboration.
Ability to prioritize multiple activities and manage ambiguity.
Ability to influence others to promote a positive work environment.
Understanding and awareness of the external scientific and regulatory landscape.
Demonstrated initiative and risk-taking.
Demonstrated technical proficiency and ability to create ideas for future work plans.
Established external publication record.

Additional Information

Travel: 0 -10%
Position Local: Indianapolis, IN; Lilly Technology Center-North (LTC-N)

Experience working on public cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and associated deep understanding of failover, high-availability, and high scalability.

Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We're committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.

Pay And Benefits

Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
Pension / Retirement benefits
Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

As a Director of Software Engineering, you will lead the strategy, development, modernization, and delivery of mission-critical enterprise applications that power DTCC's core business capabilities. You will oversee multiple application development teams driving engineering excellence, cloud transformation, and scalable software solutions across the enterprise.

This role requires a proven application development leader with deep technical expertise, strong people leadership, and a track record of delivering complex software platforms. You will partner closely with Product, Architecture, and Business leaders to translate strategic objectives into secure, resilient, and high-performing applications that create measurable business value.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned application development leader with a proven track record of building and modernizing enterprise software platforms, leading high-performing engineering organizations, and delivering scalable solutions that drive business outcomes.

Lead & Deliver

Define engineering strategy, technology roadmaps, and delivery priorities aligned to business objectives.
Lead multiple application development teams responsible for building, modernizing, and supporting enterprise software solutions.
Drive execution across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), balancing delivery, quality, scalability, and operational excellence.
Develop and mentor engineering managers and senior engineers, fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Drive Application Development & Modernization

Lead engineering organizations responsible for delivering mission-critical enterprise applications that support core business capabilities.
Lead the design, development, modernization, and support of large-scale enterprise applications and distributed systems.
Guide architecture and design decisions involving cloud-native technologies, microservices, APIs, event-driven architectures, and containerized platforms.
Drive software engineering excellence through architecture reviews, development standards, code quality practices, automated testing, and engineering metrics.
Champion modern application development practices across the full SDLC, enabling teams to deliver scalable, secure, and resilient software solutions.
Establish engineering standards, development best practices, and CI/CD adoption across teams.
Partner with Product Owners, Business Analysts, and Architects to deliver scalable technical solutions that meet evolving business needs.
Drive modernization initiatives that reduce technical debt and accelerate adoption of cloud and emerging technologies, including AI-enabled capabilities.
Ensure solutions meet standards for performance, resiliency, security, maintainability, and regulatory compliance.

Partner & Influence

Collaborate with Product, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, and executive stakeholders to drive strategic technology decisions.
Communicate complex technical concepts in a way that enables informed business decisions.
Promote strong governance, risk management, and operational discipline across engineering teams.

**NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above. **

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred.
10+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including significant leadership of application development organizations.
Proven experience leading multiple engineering teams delivering enterprise-scale software applications.

Talents Needed For Success

Deep application development background with experience designing, building, scaling, and modernizing enterprise software applications.
Proven experience building, scaling, and leading enterprise application development organizations across multiple products, platforms, or business domains.
Hands-on software engineering background with experience designing or developing large-scale enterprise software systems.
Strong technical leadership in application architecture, microservices, APIs, cloud-native technologies, and distributed systems.
Experience leading full-stack engineering organizations and driving large-scale modernization initiatives.
Demonstrated success modernizing legacy applications and leading large-scale application transformation efforts.
Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, SDLC, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, and production support.
Proven ability to connect technology investments and architecture decisions to business outcomes.
Demonstrated success leading engineering managers and developing high-performing teams.
Strong executive presence, communication skills, and stakeholder management capabilities.
Strategic mindset with the ability to balance modernization, innovation, risk management, and execution.
Inclusive leadership style that values collaboration, accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading large-scale Java, .NET, or modern full-stack application development organizations.
Experience modernizing legacy applications and migrating enterprise platforms to cloud-native architectures.
Experience implementing microservices, API-first design, event-driven architectures, and containerized platforms.
Experience leveraging AI, automation, or advanced analytics within enterprise software solutions.
Financial services, capital markets, fintech, or other highly regulated industry experience.

Elite is the trusted automation platform for law firm operations across most of the world’s largest and most successful law firms. Elite has guided firms through every technology shift and today delivers the only cloud-native SaaS platform that unifies financial, invoice, time, and data management into a single system of action. With embedded AI, predictive analytics, and integrated payments, Elite’s products enable firms to shorten billing cycles, reduce write-offs, and unlock firm-wide insights, making financial operations the foundation for law firm innovation and growth. Learn more at elite.com.
Position Overview

Elite is hiring a Director , Platform & Intelligence Value Stream to own the value stream end to end — the shared platform foundation every Elite product is built on, together with the productization of our AI and data capabilities. You will own the roadmap for orchestration, conversational AI, rules, unified access, and the event backbone, and turn those services into a reusable foundation that our financial, work-to-cash, and internal business product lines build on rather than around.  
This is both a strategy role and a delivery role. You will carry the what and why for the stream — a single prioritized backlog, roadmap sequencing, and requirements translation through release commitment and delivery — pair daily with an engineering delivery unit, and lead a small standing team of domain and analyst talent. Because the platform is horizontal, you will sit upstream of every customer-facing product line, and you will be measured on the return the stream delivers rather than on output volume.  
Work Arrangement:
​ Remote ​  
Responsibilities

Own the Platform & Framework Foundation

Own the product roadmap for Elite's shared platform services — including workflow orchestration, conversational AI, and business rules — and sequence their maturity from foundation to scale.
Own the product direction for unified access and entitlements — authorization, user management, data-level security, and subscription-driven feature access across Elite applications.
Treat the platform as a product with internal customers, defining the patterns, contracts, and adoption paths by which other product teams consume shared services, so capability is built once and reused.
Partner with Engineering on the shared infrastructure and sequencing that let product teams build on the platform rather than around it.  

Productize AI & Data

Own productization of workflow- and agent-driven capabilities that move customers beyond traditional reporting toward AI that takes action inside their day-to-day financial and legal workflows.
Turn data assets into productized offerings on a modern cloud data platform, with clear value metrics and pricing.
Shape product and go-to-market strategy for integrations that give customers richer, real-time access to their data, including through third-party AI tools.  

Lead the Value Stream

Define and prioritize a single backlog around customer outcomes and return on investment, and drive it from backlog through release commitment and delivery.
Set quarterly outcomes for the stream and point the paired delivery unit at the highest-value work; own feasibility, trade-offs, escalations, and backlog readiness.
Lead and grow the stream's standing team of domain and analyst talent, raising the bar on domain depth and AI fluency.
Act as the product voice in architectural and platform prioritization, steering infrastructure investment toward the capabilities that drive customer outcomes and revenue.  

Build Governance In from the Start

Partner with Security and Architecture from the outset of each initiative to build data governance, access control, auditability, and appropriate safeguards into agentic products and integrations that handle privileged and financial data.
Ensure agents inherit user-level permissions, including data-level security, so intelligence and automation stay within firm entitlements by design.  

Commercialize and Enable

Define value metrics and commercial models that make return on investment legible to customers and to the business.
Enable Sales and Services with clear narratives, value propositions, and routing guidance for platform, AI, and data capabilities.
Use usage data, customer insight, and financial metrics to drive prioritization for adoption, retention, and revenue impact.

What You'll Do

Avalara is building the Agentic Content Studio Platform (ACSP), a next-generation platform designed to improve how global tax and compliance content is sourced, maintained, validated, and consumed across the business.

The Director of Engineering, Agentic Content Engineering, will lead the strategy, architecture, and execution of Agentic Content Studio Platform. This platform will support expansion into new content domains including VAT Advanced Sections, Registration, Business Licenses, XBorder Marketplace, and Communications, while also improving the efficiency and scalability of existing content operations through automation and AI-assisted workflows.

This role combines platform engineering, applied AI, workflow automation, and organizational leadership. Success in this role requires balancing technical innovation with operational rigor, measurable business outcomes, platform reliability, and responsible AI adoption.

The platform is expected to improve content scalability, accelerate onboarding of new content domains, reduce manual research effort, and enable content teams to operate through AI-assisted and human-reviewed workflows.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

Define and execute the engineering vision, architecture, and delivery roadmap for the Agentic Content Studio Platform.
Build scalable platform capabilities that support onboarding and maintenance of global compliance content across multiple domains.
Lead development of AI-assisted workflows that automate sourcing, extraction, transformation, validation, and maintenance of content.
Establish reliable human-in-the-loop operating models that combine AI-driven automation with researcher review and oversight.
Design secure, observable, and resilient platform services spanning orchestration, APIs, workflow automation, integrations, and content systems.
Enable downstream products and services such as AvaTax, ATC, and ATR to interact with platform capabilities through modern integration interfaces, including MCP where appropriate.
Define measurable engineering and operational metrics tied to platform reliability, quality, productivity, adoption, and business impact.
Partner closely with Product, Content Research, Applied AI, Architecture, and business stakeholders to align platform investments with company priorities.
Build and develop a high-performing engineering organization with strong technical depth, accountability, and execution discipline.
Drive pragmatic adoption of AI across engineering workflows, planning, delivery operations, observability, and decision-making processes.
Ensure governance, security, and responsible AI practices are incorporated into platform design and operational processes.

12-Month Success Outcomes

Deliver and operationalize a clear ACSP platform roadmap aligned to Avalara’s content expansion and productivity objectives.
Launch foundational platform capabilities supporting the first wave of new content domains and workflow automation initiatives.
Deliver production-ready AI-assisted workflows for sourcing and extracting international lodging content in targeted countries.
Deliver scalable workflows supporting generation and maintenance of VAT advanced section content across multiple countries.
Improve operational efficiency by reducing manual content research and maintenance effort through automation and reviewer-assisted workflows.
Establish reliable production integrations enabling downstream systems to consume platform capabilities through standardized interfaces.
Implement measurable operational metrics for reliability, automation coverage, quality, cycle time, and platform adoption.
Build a strong engineering leadership team with clear ownership, high accountability, and strong execution standards.

Applied AI Expectations

Apply AI to improve automation, scalability, quality, and operational efficiency.
Design agent-based workflows capable of coordinating multi-step content tasks with appropriate escalation and human review mechanisms.
Leverage AI to improve engineering execution, planning, observability, and operational workflows.
Drive adoption of AI capabilities as part of core platform functionality and engineering operations rather than isolated experimentation.
Ensure responsible use of AI through governance, transparency, monitoring, and risk controls.
Raise engineering team capability through coaching, standards, and practical implementation guidance.

What You’ll Need To Be Successful

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
12+ years of software engineering experience, including large-scale platforms or distributed systems.
5+ years of experience leading engineering managers and senior engineers in complex cross-functional organizations.
Proven experience leading platform strategy, architecture, and execution with measurable business outcomes.
Experience applying AI and automation to improve operational scale, quality, productivity, or customer impact.
Strong experience with distributed systems, APIs, workflow orchestration, integrations, and event-driven architectures.
Experience building platforms that support automation, operational observability, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to align engineering investments to business priorities.
Excellent execution rigor, technical judgment, communication skills, and organizational leadership.

Technical Expertise

Experience with LLMs, agent-based systems, RAG architectures, or equivalent AI platforms.
Strong engineering background in Python and modern AI application frameworks.
Experience building cloud-native systems on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Familiarity with MLOps practices including CI/CD, evaluation pipelines, monitoring, and model lifecycle management.
Strong platform and systems design experience focused on reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.

Leadership Characteristics

Demonstrated ability to build and mentor high-performing engineering organizations.
Strong product and platform mindset with a focus on customer and business outcomes.
Ability to communicate effectively with senior technical and executive stakeholders.
Pragmatic, execution-oriented leader capable of operating strategically while remaining technically engaged.

What Makes This a Bar-Raiser Role

AI Bar Raiser

At Avalara, this role is expected to be an AI Bar Raiser — a leader who elevates both the technical capability of the organization and the practical application of AI across engineering and operational workflows.

This individual is expected to apply advanced AI capabilities to materially improve how systems are designed, built, operated, and scaled, while driving measurable gains in engineering productivity, quality, automation, and business impact. The expectation is to create a culture of 10x productivity through the effective use of AI tools, modern engineering technologies, automation, and an agile execution mindset where speed is table stakes.

Bar Raiser

At Avalara, this role is expected to be a Bar Raiser who strengthens teams by improving technical judgment, accelerating organizational learning, mentoring engineers and leaders, and leaving platforms, processes, and operating models significantly better than they found them.

This role is expected to redefine how engineering, AI, and content operations work together at scale across Avalara.
Success requires building not only a technically strong platform, but also a durable operating model that improves execution speed, quality, scalability, and business impact.
The leader in this role must consistently raise the bar across architecture, engineering discipline, AI adoption, operational excellence, talent density, and cross-functional execution.
The ideal candidate combines deep technical judgment with strong organizational leadership and has a demonstrated track record of delivering complex platform transformations with measurable outcomes.
This is a highly visible leadership role with direct influence on Avalara’s AI strategy, content scalability, and long-term operational efficiency.

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness

Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity

Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

In gTech Users and Products (gUP), our mission is to advocate for Google’s users by creating helpful and trusted experiences across the product ecosystem. jobs.description:
Pioneering in America, from the first mile to the last. This is what drives us.

We’re proud to be Great Place to Work® certified—a reflection of our commitment to creating an environment where innovation thrives, and every voice matters. Apply today and be part of shaping the future with us!

Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here:
https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html

Position Overview:

Siemens Mobility is seeking a highly experienced Senior CBTC Technical Manager to serve as the technical authority for Communications-Based Train Control (CBTC) systems on complex transit and rail infrastructure projects. This role is ideal for a seasoned CBTC professional with expertise in system architecture, systems integration, requirements management, testing and commissioning, and customer-facing technical leadership.

As the project's CBTC technical lead, you will be responsible for guiding system design, integration, validation, migration, and change management activities while serving as the primary technical interface between Siemens, customers, and key project stakeholders.

What your day may look like:

Serve as the technical authority for CBTC systems, leading system architecture, requirements management, subsystem integration, and technical decision-making throughout the project lifecycle.
Act as the customer's trusted technical advisor, driving technical discussions, resolving complex system-level issues, and ensuring solutions align with operational, contractual, and performance requirements.
Lead multidisciplinary systems engineering and integration teams across signaling, train control, communications, cybersecurity, and safety disciplines to deliver complex rail infrastructure projects.
Oversee end-to-end CBTC integration, verification & validation, testing, migration, commissioning, and revenue service implementation, ensuring successful deployment of safety-critical train control systems.
Drive technical governance and project success by leading change control activities, managing technical risks, ensuring compliance with industry standards, and providing strategic technical guidance to project leadership and customers.

This posting outlines the primary responsibilities of the role, but is not all-inclusive; additional duties may be assigned in alignment with business needs.

To thrive in this role, you have:

Deep CBTC and rail signaling expertise with 10+ years of experience designing, integrating, testing, and deploying Communications-Based Train Control (CBTC) and train control systems within metro, transit, or rail infrastructure environments.
Proven technical leadership experience serving as a CBTC Technical Manager, Systems Engineering Manager, Lead Systems Engineer, Integration Manager, or similar role, with responsibility for system architecture, technical decision-making, and project delivery of complex signaling and train control solutions.
Strong systems engineering and integration background, including requirements management, subsystem integration, interface management, system verification & validation (V&V), testing, commissioning, migration planning, and revenue service implementation.
Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams across signaling, train control, communications, cybersecurity, safety, and infrastructure disciplines while driving technical excellence, schedule adherence, and project performance.
Customer-facing technical leadership skills, with the ability to serve as the primary technical interface to transit agencies, customers, and stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into actionable solutions and resolving critical system-level challenges.
Experience managing safety-critical rail systems, with a strong understanding of technical risk management, change control processes, regulatory compliance, and the successful deployment of operationally critical train control solutions.
Proven ability to lead technical governance and change management activities, including Change Control Boards (CCB), design reviews, technical issue resolution, and cross-functional decision-making while balancing contractual, schedule, cost, and performance requirements.

What will make you stand out:

Experience delivering CBTC projects for major transit agencies and/or prior experience with Siemens Mobility, Alstom, Hitachi Rail, Thales, Wabtec, Bombardier Transportation, Ansaldo STS, or similar rail signaling organizations is highly preferred.

Purpose is the reason a company exists. It's not about making money or selling products - it's the deeper "why" behind everything we do. It answers the question: What problem are we solving? What positive change are we creating?

For Siemens, our purpose has been clear for over 175 years: We create technology to transform the everyday, for everyone.

The world needs technologies that work. Technologies that matter. Technologies that solve today's challenges and help shape a better tomorrow. And that's exactly what we build. By bringing together the real world (factories, buildings, power grids, trains) with the digital world (software, data, AI, digital twins), we help our customers become more competitive, resilient, and sustainable.

Our technology is everywhere
- in trains and transportation,
we help move people faster, safer, and more sustainably.

VP, Global Engineering and Automation Enablement Role Overview

We are seeking a senior Technology Leader to own the architecture, scalability, and intelligent automation of our core FinTech platforms. This role is responsible for designing large-scale, cloud-native, distributed systems while leveraging AI-driven automation to improve platform efficiency, reliability, and operational scale.
The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in platform architecture and distributed systems with a strong point of view on using AI to automate infrastructure operations, optimize performance, and enable predictive, self-healing platforms. This is a highly technical leadership role with material influence over how the platform scales as the business grows.

VP, Global Engineering and Automation Enablement Key Responsibilities

Platform Architecture & Technical Strategy

Own the end-to-end platform architecture supporting core FinTech products and transaction flows
Define architectural standards for scalability, performance, resiliency, and system composability
Lead evolution from tightly coupled or monolithic systems toward distributed, service-oriented platforms
Establish clear system boundaries, ownership models, and architectural governance
Define and execute a multi-year platform roadmap aligned with growth, transaction scale, and product velocity

Scalability & Distributed System

Design platforms capable of handling high transaction volumes, burst traffic, and sustained throughput
Guide horizontal scaling strategies across compute, storage, data, and messaging layers
Lead architectural decisions around sharding, partitioning, caching, asynchronous processing, and concurrency
Continuously improve latency, throughput, and resource efficiency across the platform
Enable multi-region and multi-environment scalability where required

Cloud & Infrastructure Architecture

Architect cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) optimized for scale, availability, and operational efficiency
Define reference architectures for containerized workloads, microservices, and distributed runtimes
Lead Kubernetes and container platform adoption and standardization
Mature Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.) for consistent, scalable environments
Own capacity modeling, growth forecasting, and infrastructure lifecycle planning

AI-Driven Automation & Intelligent Platforms

Apply AI and machine learning techniques to automate platform operations and decision-making

Use AI for:
Capacity forecasting and demand prediction
Anomaly detection in platform performance and system behavior
Automated root-cause analysis and incident correlation
Predictive scaling and infrastructure optimization
Drive adoption of self-healing platform patterns where systems can respond automatically to failure or degradation
Enable data pipelines, feature stores, and runtime environments required to support AI-enabled platform services
Partner with data and engineering teams to productionize AI capabilities within core platform workflows

Platform Engineering & Developer Enablement

Build shared platform capabilities that abstract complexity and enable product teams to scale independently
Provide self-service infrastructure, golden paths, and opinionated platform tooling
Standardize CI/CD, runtime environments, observability, and deployment patterns
Reduce friction and cognitive load for application teams through strong platform design
Measure and improve developer experience as a platform outcome

Reliability, Performance & Intelligent Operations

Lead SRE practices focused on scalability, automation, and operational maturity
Define and track SLIs/SLOs centered on throughput, latency, availability, and platform health
Establish advanced observability (metrics, tracing, logging) as inputs to AI-driven insights
Lead analysis of scaling failures, performance bottlenecks, and systemic inefficiencies
Drive continuous improvement toward predictable, automated, and resilient operations

Required Qualifications

10+ years of experience designing and operating large-scale distributed systems
5+ years in senior technical leadership roles (Director, Principal, VP, or equivalent)
Deep expertise in platform architecture, cloud-native design, and system scalability
Strong hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP
Proven experience with microservices, event-driven architectures, and distributed data systems
Solid background in Infrastructure as Code and automation-first platform design
Experience applying AI/ML concepts to operational or platform use cases

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with high-volume transaction processing or real-time systems
Strong Kubernetes and container platform experience
Experience with event streaming platforms (Kafka or equivalent)
Background modernizing legacy platforms at scale
Experience with AI-assisted operations, AIOps, or intelligent monitoring platforms

Key Competencies

Systems-level architectural thinking with a strong scalability mindset
Ability to blend platform engineering and AI automation into practical solutions
Technical credibility with senior engineers, architects, and leadership
Pragmatic decision-maker who balances ideal architecture with real-world constraints
Strong communicator who can translate technical strategy into business impact

30-60-90 Day Success Plan

First 30 Days – Understand & Assess

Develop deep understanding of current platform architecture and scaling limits
Review system topology, transaction paths, and performance characteristics
Identify opportunities for automation, AI-driven optimization, and architectural simplification
Build strong relationships across engineering, data, and product leadership

Days 31–60 – Architect & Automate

Define target-state platform architecture with explicit scalability patterns
Prioritize architectural improvements with the highest scale and automation leverage
Introduce AI-enabled insights into observability, capacity, or incident analysis
Establish platform standards, reference architectures, and design principles

Days 61–90 – Scale & Industrialize

Deliver measurable improvements in throughput, latency, and platform stability
Advance automation toward self-service, self-scaling, and self-healing capabilities

Establish a culture of building intelligent systems designed to scale by default

What You'll Do

We’re looking for a strategic and technically strong engineering leader to drive innovation and scale for one of Avalara's flagship SaaS products—a $50M revenue-generating line with double-digit growth and a customer base in the hundreds of thousands. This is more than just a leadership role. It’s a chance to put your fingerprint on one of the top

AI-enabled platforms in the industry, steering both its near-term transformation and long-term innovation strategy.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

Lead and inspire engineering teams through a multi-year transformation, including replatforming legacy components and building modern, scalable infrastructure.
Drive innovation by weaving AI into the product’s core—working hand-in-hand with PMs and data scientists to deliver customer-facing, AI-powered experiences.
Own the product’s technical roadmap, ensuring it aligns with business objectives, customer demands, and long-term scalability goals.
Foster a culture of excellence, accountability, and forward-thinking engineering.
Act as a strategic advisor to executive leadership on AI integration, technical investment, and product growth strategy.

What You’ll Need To Be Successful

Proven success managing engineering organizations behind $50M+ product lines or similarly scaled SaaS platforms.
A bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Computer Science is required.
A solid engineering foundation—capable of understanding, building, and scaling complex systems.
Expertise in platform modernization (replatforming, scalability, microservices, etc.) coupled with a strong understanding of AI-driven product development.
A track record of building and mentoring high-performing teams, with a leadership style that’s both empowering and execution-focused.
Clear, strategic communication—comfortable engaging across technical, product, and business teams.

This Role Is For You If…

You're an engineering leader ready to scale something meaningful, not just maintain the status quo.
You see AI as a tool for product differentiation—not just a buzzword—and know how to apply it with intent.
You thrive in high-impact environments where visibility is high and the opportunity to influence is even higher.

What Makes This a Bar-Raiser Role

AI Bar Raiser

At Avalara, this role is expected to be an AI Bar Raiser — a leader who elevates both the technical capability of the organization and the practical application of AI across engineering and operational workflows.

This individual is expected to apply advanced AI capabilities to materially improve how systems are designed, built, operated, and scaled, while driving measurable gains in engineering productivity, quality, automation, and business impact. The expectation is to create a culture of 10x productivity through the effective use of AI tools, modern engineering technologies, automation, and an agile execution mindset where speed is table stakes.

Bar Raiser

At Avalara, this role is expected to be a Bar Raiser who strengthens teams by improving technical judgment, accelerating organizational learning, mentoring engineers and leaders, and leaving platforms, processes, and operating models significantly better than they found them.

This role is expected to redefine how engineering, AI, and content operations work together at scale across Avalara.
Success requires building not only a technically strong platform, but also a durable operating model that improves execution speed, quality, scalability, and business impact.
The leader in this role must consistently raise the bar across architecture, engineering discipline, AI adoption, operational excellence, talent density, and cross-functional execution.
The ideal candidate combines deep technical judgment with strong organizational leadership and has a demonstrated track record of delivering complex platform transformations with measurable outcomes.
This is a highly visible leadership role with direct influence on Avalara’s AI strategy, content scalability, and long-term operational efficiency.

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness

Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity

Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
