jobs.description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Personal Information We Collect

Your Privacy Choices

Team Overview

The Vulnerability Resiliency Engineering team is responsible for reducing exploitable risk across TransUnion's technology environment by transforming traditional vulnerability management into a modern VulnOps operating model.

Partnering closely with Security Operations, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Product Security, Cloud Infrastructure Security, and Engineering teams, the organization focuses on accelerating vulnerability discovery, disruption, remediation, validation, and risk reduction through automation and engineering-led ownership.

Reporting to the SVP of Cyber Defense, this leader will drive one of TransUnion's most critical cybersecurity transformation initiatives while building a scalable, AI-enabled approach to exposure management across first-party code, third-party dependencies, APIs, endpoints, and infrastructure This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.

Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

Define and execute TransUnion's VulnOps transformation strategy, shifting the organization from a traditional scan-and-backlog model to an engineering-led approach focused on eliminating exploitable exposure.
Lead the AI Vuln Research and Engineering, Vulnerability Resiliency Engineering, and Traditional Vulnerability Management Operations teams, overseeing a peak organization of approximately 25 engineers while evolving to a highly automated team of 11 to 14 specialized engineers.
Own the end-to-end vulnerability operating lifecycle, including discovery, prioritization, disruption, remediation, validation, and measurement to ensure clear accountability and durable risk reduction.
Establish and operationalize a patch-plus-disruption response model, including controls such as WAF rules, API protections, network isolation, quarantine capabilities, runtime protections, and virtual patching.
Drive consolidation of legacy vulnerability and exposure management platforms into a unified VulnOps ecosystem centered on Wiz, Cogent Security, and a common security data lake.
Partner with engineering teams to eliminate vulnerabilities before production through trusted images, CI/CD security controls, approved libraries, and automated remediation capabilities.
Scale automation and AI-driven remediation workflows to improve remediation efficiency and reduce mean time to remediate (MTTR) for critical vulnerabilities.
Define and manage executive-level operational metrics, including exploitable exposure, disruption effectiveness, remediation performance, vulnerability elimination rates, asset currency, and SLA compliance.
Lead cross-functional governance forums that drive accountability, exposure reduction, engineering alignment, technology lifecycle management, and automation adoption.
Represent Vulnerability Resiliency Engineering in executive leadership reviews, providing strategic updates on risk reduction outcomes, transformation progress, and operational performance.

Required Knowledge And Experiences

12+ years of cybersecurity experience, including vulnerability management, security operations, security engineering, or related disciplines, with at least 5 years leading managers and multi-team organizations.
Demonstrated success leading large-scale vulnerability management or security transformation initiatives that leverage automation, engineering ownership, and measurable risk reduction outcomes.
Deep understanding of vulnerability management frameworks, exposure management, threat-informed prioritization, and exploit disruption strategies within complex enterprise environments.
Proven experience driving organizational design, workforce transformation, talent development, and capability building while modernizing operational practices.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant leadership experience. Advanced degree preferred.

Required Technical Skills

Expertise with vulnerability and exposure management platforms, including Wiz, CrowdStrike, JFrog Xray, vulnerability scanners, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Cloud-Native Application Protection Platforms (CNAPP), and Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR) technologies.
Strong knowledge of vulnerability prioritization and risk-based remediation methodologies, including CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV), Exploit Prediction Scoring System (EPSS), and related frameworks.
Experience designing and implementing automated remediation, AI-driven security operations, CI/CD security controls, trusted image management, and engineering-owned vulnerability reduction programs.
Proven capability leading enterprise-scale platform rationalization, vendor consolidation, and migration initiatives utilizing centralized security data models and reporting platforms.
Strong executive communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to translate technical findings, exposure trends, and operational metrics into actionable business decisions.

Preferred Skills

We're also looking for the preferred skills below. Whether you are proficient or could use some brushing up, we're happy to support your career development and growth in:

Experience building or scaling AI-native or agentic vulnerability remediation capabilities.
Experience with Attack Surface Management (ASM) programs in addition to traditional vulnerability management disciplines.
Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and threat-informed defense methodologies.
Experience operating within financial services, fintech, or other highly regulated enterprise environments.
Experience building or scaling enterprise security data lakes, operational reporting platforms, or exposure intelligence programs.

Mintegral is a leading programmatic and interactive mobile advertising platform. Focused on the APAC region and radiating out globally. Powered by advanced AI technology, we provide global advertisers and developers with innovative, comprehensive experiences. With our efficient mobile marketing and monetization solutions, we help our clients exceed their marketing goals.

We have also created the Mindworks Creative Studio, which offers publishers and brands cutting-edge creative solutions, from traditional creative right through to the latest interactive ad formats. For more information, please visit our website: https://www.mintegral.com/en/

Core Objectives

Build Mintegral’s automated operations framework to improve deployment, monitoring, alerting, incident response, capacity planning, and resource management efficiency.
Optimize server, cloud, bandwidth, storage, and compute costs, improve resource utilization, and reduce cost per unit of traffic processed.

Improve the overall operating efficiency of global advertising systems, including request processing capacity, system latency, availability, elastic scaling, and failure recovery.
Support Mintegral’s global business growth by ensuring infrastructure and operations capabilities can efficiently support ad traffic, customer needs, and commercialization goals.

Duties and Responsibilities

Lead the planning, development, and continuous optimization of Mintegral’s global operations, infrastructure, and SRE systems to support large-scale ad requests, real-time bidding, and data processing systems.
Build and improve automated operations platforms and processes, including automated deployment, monitoring and alerting, capacity planning, incident management, resource scheduling, configuration management, cost analysis, and performance optimization.
Drive server and cloud infrastructure cost optimization, including resource pooling, elastic scaling, capacity governance, cost attribution, procurement strategy, and hybrid-cloud / multi-cloud architecture, with the goal of continuously reducing infrastructure costs.
Improve core system efficiency and reliability by optimizing the ad request pipeline, infrastructure performance, network latency, service availability, disaster recovery capabilities, and global node deployment strategy.
Establish a comprehensive observability framework, including logs, metrics, distributed tracing, real-time monitoring, SLA/SLO management, incident reviews, and risk early-warning mechanisms.
Work closely with engineering, algorithms, product, data, sales, and commercialization teams to ensure operations and infrastructure capabilities support business growth, customer delivery, and global market expansion.
Drive operations automation and intelligence by introducing or building AIOps, automated root cause analysis, anomaly detection, capacity forecasting, and intelligent resource scheduling capabilities.
Establish core metrics for cost, efficiency, and reliability, and regularly report infrastructure ROI, optimization progress, and business impact to the CEO and senior leadership team.
Depending on the level, lead or guide operations, SRE, infrastructure, or platform engineering teams, including technical management, talent development, and organizational planning.

Requirements

5+ years of experience in operations, SRE, infrastructure, platform engineering, or technical operations, preferably in large-scale internet platforms, ad tech platforms, cloud platforms, or distributed systems.
Proven success building automated operations systems, SRE frameworks, infrastructure platforms, or cost optimization mechanisms, with measurable impact on reliability, efficiency, or cost.
Strong knowledge of large-scale distributed systems, high-concurrency services, low-latency systems, global deployment, containerization, Kubernetes, cloud services, CDN, network optimization, and capacity planning.
Experience optimizing server costs, with familiarity in cloud cost governance, resource utilization optimization, FinOps, capacity management, elastic scaling, procurement strategy, or hybrid-cloud / multi-cloud architecture.

Strong data analysis skills and business awareness, with the ability to identify optimization opportunities from system operations data, cost data, and business traffic data.
Excellent cross-functional communication and execution skills, with the ability to work with engineering, algorithms, product, sales, commercialization, and executive teams to drive complex projects to completion.
Strong technical leadership, with the ability to define direction, drive execution, and, when needed, lead or mentor operations, SRE, infrastructure, and platform engineering teams.

jobs.title: Head of AEO & SEO
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Growth Marketing is a team of performance-driven marketers and channel specialists. We partner closely with growth product, regional and demand marketing, and sales to drive revenue through self-serve and sales motions. The SEO & AEO function specifically drives organic discovery ensuring Stripe is found, cited, and recommended when developers, founders, and finance leaders are searching for or asking about payments, financial infrastructure, and related topics.

What you’ll do

This role owns one of the most strategically important and evolving acquisition channels at Stripe. Organic search is already one of our largest and most efficient growth channels and the emergence of AI-powered answer engines represents a once-in-a-generation shift in how businesses discover software. The role requires someone who can operate at the intersection of content, product, engineering, and data and who can credibly engage with Stripe's executive team on the strategic importance of organic visibility. This is a rare opportunity to define what AEO means for a company like Stripe and to build the playbook that others will follow.

Responsibilities

Own the organic growth strategy end-to-end across SEO and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), including technical optimizations, content strategy, on-site experience, and visibility in general purpose assistants (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, etc.) and coding assistants (e.g. Claude, Codex, etc.)
Lead, develop, and retain a high-performing team of SEO and AEO specialists, fostering a culture of experimentation, operational excellence, and continuous learning
Drive measurable improvements in organic visibility, rankings, citations, traffic, signups, sales inbound and downstream activations across both AEO and SEO
Drive measurable improvements in how well AI tools are able to understand how Stripe’s products work and how to properly integrate them
Partner cross-functionally with product, engineering, content, growth, data science, and marketing to embed SEO/AEO best practices across Stripe's web properties, documentation, and product surfaces
Build and evolve the measurement framework for SEO and AEO: develop attribution models, define leading/lagging indicators, and quantify the revenue impact of organic channels
Own strategic roadmap for AEO: establish Stripe's point of view on how AI-generated answers reshape discovery, and position Stripe to win
Drive improvements across content quality, website architecture, and structured data to maximize discoverability
Represent organic growth performance and strategy across Stripe: translating complex technical SEO/AEO concepts into clear business impact narratives

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

10+ years of experience in SEO, with at least 3 years leading a team and 2+ years at a senior/leadership level engaging with executives
Demonstrated expertise in both technical SEO and content strategy, with a track record of driving significant organic growth at scale
Deep understanding of how AI-powered search and answer engines work (LLM-based retrieval, citation behavior, entity recognition) and a clear point of view on how to optimize for them
Ability to drive improvements across multiple levers: content, website architecture, product surfaces, structured data, measurement, and cross-functional influence
Strong analytical foundation: comfortable with data, attribution challenges, and building measurement frameworks that quantify the business impact of organic channels
Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts to executive audiences and build strategic alignment around organic growth investment
Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, product, content, and data science teams to implement SEO/AEO improvements at scale
Track record of building, developing, and retaining high-performing teams

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with developer-focused or technical B2B products where documentation, API references, and technical content are significant organic surfaces
Background in international SEO strategy, including managing organic growth across multiple markets and languages
Experience building programmatic or product-led SEO at scale (e.g., template pages, user-generated content, dynamic landing pages)
Demonstrated early-mover advantage in AEO evidence of monitoring, optimizing for, or measuring visibility in AI-generated answers
Comfort operating in a fast-paced, metrics-driven culture where you must build the case for investment through data and strategic narrative

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $210,200 - $315,200. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Drive measurable improvements in organic visibility, rankings, citations, traffic, signups, sales inbound and downstream activations across both AEO and SEO
Drive measurable improvements in how well AI tools are able to understand how Stripe’s products work and how to properly integrate them
Partner cross-functionally with product, engineering, content, growth, data science, and marketing to embed SEO/AEO best practices across Stripe's web properties, documentation, and product surfaces
Build and evolve the measurement framework for SEO and AEO: develop attribution models, define leading/lagging indicators, and quantify the revenue impact of organic channels
Own strategic roadmap for AEO: establish Stripe's point of view on how AI-generated answers reshape discovery, and position Stripe to win
Drive improvements across content quality, website architecture, and structured data to maximize discoverability
Represent organic growth performance and strategy across Stripe: translating complex technical SEO/AEO concepts into clear business impact narratives

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

10+ years of experience in SEO, with at least 3 years leading a team and 2+ years at a senior/leadership level engaging with executives
Demonstrated expertise in both technical SEO and content strategy, with a track record of driving significant organic growth at scale
Deep understanding of how AI-powered search and answer engines work (LLM-based retrieval, citation behavior, entity recognition) and a clear point of view on how to optimize for them
Ability to drive improvements across multiple levers: content, website architecture, product surfaces, structured data, measurement, and cross-functional influence
Strong analytical foundation: comfortable with data, attribution challenges, and building measurement frameworks that quantify the business impact of organic channels
Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts to executive audiences and build strategic alignment around organic growth investment
Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, product, content, and data science teams to implement SEO/AEO improvements at scale
Track record of building, developing, and retaining high-performing teams

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with developer-focused or technical B2B products where documentation, API references, and technical content are significant organic surfaces
Background in international SEO strategy, including managing organic growth across multiple markets and languages
Experience building programmatic or product-led SEO at scale (e.g., template pages, user-generated content, dynamic landing pages)
Demonstrated early-mover advantage in AEO evidence of monitoring, optimizing for, or measuring visibility in AI-generated answers
Comfort operating in a fast-paced, metrics-driven culture where you must build the case for investment through data and strategic narrative

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $210,200 - $315,200. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering Management
jobs.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

The engineering organization is a dynamic group of builders, thinkers, and problem-solvers focused on delivering scalable, AI-powered software products that improve how organizations work. We value clean architecture, intuitive experiences, operational excellence, and a culture of continuous improvement. Every engineer plays an important role in shaping the quality, reliability, and long-term success of our products.

About The Team

The Service Operations Business Unit brings together IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations Management (ITOM), and CMDB capabilities on the ServiceNow Platform. This product engineering organization builds the software that helps customers deliver resilient, intelligent, and efficient enterprise services.

The Service Operations product portfolio connects incident, request, fulfillment, infrastructure visibility, service mapping, trusted configuration data, automation, and AIOps into a unified operating model. By combining service delivery with operational intelligence and trusted operational context, these products help customers move toward proactive, AI-assisted, and increasingly self-healing operations at enterprise scale.

Together, these capabilities help customers modernize how they deliver and operate services, improve reliability, reduce manual effort, and drive measurable productivity outcomes on a single platform.

What You Get To Do In This Role

As a Director of Engineering, you will lead the teams that architect and build assistive and autonomous AI-native products to usher customers (IT departments using our IT service and operations management applications) into an agentic-first era. The work will span large-scale distributed systems, data ingestion, context creation and utilization, agentic harnesses, cost optimization, and agentic feedback loops to ensure value realization for our customers.

This role requires people leadership, thought leadership, deep technical expertise, strong architectural judgment, and a keen understanding of the scientific method to ship and refine real product through iterative experimentation. You will be accountable for the growth, health, and delivery outcomes of your teams.

Responsibilities Include

Lead and grow the engineering teams responsible for assigned problem areas within ITSM/ITOM products, working with product and engineering leaders to understand blockers and opportunities around AI-native evolution and value realization.
Own technical strategy and delivery for your teams. Set architectural direction, hold the bar on quality and reliability, and stay close enough to the work to validate hypotheses through evidence, not theory.
Hire, coach, and develop engineers, tech leads, and managers. Build inclusive, high-performing teams with clear career paths and durable ownership.
Drive evidence-based decision-making: formulate hypotheses, run experiments, measure outcomes, and use data to guide architectural decisions and product direction.
Lead the evolution of current solutions toward AI-native capabilities—identifying where agentic patterns, data utilization, or autonomous workflows can unlock customer value—and translate those recommendations into staffed, executable work.
Identify and address value realization gaps in agentic products that exist but aren’t delivering expected outcomes. Diagnose root causes (architecture, UX, data quality, feedback loops, cost) and direct targeted improvements.
Establish architecture patterns, engineering standards, and operating rhythms specific to your problem domain. Document tradeoffs, rationale, and implementation guidance to help teams move faster and make consistent decisions.
Collaborate across ITSM/ITOM engineering teams to share learnings, validate approaches, and accelerate adoption of patterns that work.
Collaborate with stakeholders across Product, Design, Security, Operations, Sales, and Customer Success — aligning on roadmap and release readiness, meeting security and compliance requirements, and feeding field and customer signal back into engineering priorities.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you have:

15+ years of related engineering experience, including 5+ years leading and managing engineering teams (including managers or team leads), or equivalent practical experience.
Strong experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, enterprise platforms, workflow systems, data-intensive products, integration frameworks, or cloud-scale infrastructure.
Deep understanding of system design for scale, reliability, observability, fault tolerance, data quality, security, and production readiness.
Strong technical depth in Java, Python, or similar programming languages.
Proven ability to define technical direction, influence architecture across teams, and translate ambiguous product strategy into executable engineering plans.
Demonstrated success hiring, developing, and retaining engineers and engineering leaders, and managing performance, career growth, and team health.
Ability to lead through formal authority and technical credibility alike, building alignment across peer engineering, Product, Design, Security, Operations, Sales, and Customer Success organizations.
Strong judgment in balancing long-term architecture with pragmatic execution, customer impact, engineering velocity, and business priorities.
Experience mentoring senior engineers, raising engineering standards, and building reusable patterns that create leverage across teams.
Experience with AI-powered products, automation platforms, AI-assisted workflows, or agentic systems is strongly preferred.
Ability to reason about AI-assisted enterprise workflows, including data quality, workflow correctness, evaluation, observability, safety controls, and human-in-the-loop review.
Experience with enterprise service management, IT operations, CMDB, discovery, service mapping, AIOps, observability, workflow automation, endpoint management, or operational intelligence is a strong plus.
Experience working with large-scale enterprise customers, production systems, and complex migration or modernization efforts is a plus.
Why Join Us
Shape the AI-native future of the Service Operations Business Unit product portfolio on the ServiceNow Platform.
Build and lead the teams delivering foundational product and platform capabilities that help enterprises deliver, operate, automate, and continuously improve services at scale.
Define how AI agents, automation, operational data, and human workflows come together to create safer, more reliable, and more productive enterprise operations.
Collaborate with teams that value craftsmanship, quality, innovation, accountability, and meaningful customer impact.

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $221,200 - $387,100
, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

Lead vendor and partner escalations as needed to restore service and resolve customer-impacting issues.

9+ years of experience in technical operations, network operations, production support, or related technology disciplines.
1+ years of leadership or management experience.
Experience leading teams in complex production environments.
Strong understanding of technical troubleshooting, service restoration, incident response, and operational support practices.
Experience with AI driven tools (Claude) and building agents for incident response support.

Kepner-Tregoe (KT) Problem Solving and Decision Making, Incident Leadership, or similar training.

Experience leading major incident management or Incident Command functions.
Experience operating within tiered support models spanning operations and engineering organizations.
Experience supporting hybrid environments across on-premises, co-location, and cloud platforms.
Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, AWS, and/or Google Cloud Platform.
Experience with observability, monitoring, and operational analytics platforms.

jobs.title: Enterprise Engineering Systems Director
jobs.description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

Building on The Aerospace Corporation's reputation as a trusted, impartial advisor with integrity and dedication to mission success, the Civil Systems Group (CSG) combines deep technical expertise with market-leading innovation to help our customers solve complex systems engineering and integration challenges. CSG is organized by core customer-facing lines of business to manage and grow programs within NASA, NOAA, and the NNSA, while extending our capabilities to other civilian federal government agencies fully integrated within Aerospace rules, regulations, processes, values, and behaviors.

We are looking for an Enterprise Engineering Systems Director
(Systems Director – Systems and Digital Engineering)
. As a Systems Director in the Civil Systems Group within Defense, you will provide leadership, planning and direction to an experienced team of engineers and work closely with Engineering Technical Managers to support the mission area of the Department of Energy (DOE) National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA) Office of Defense Programs (DP). You will lead and manage your team to accomplish systems engineering/analysis to various Defense Program tasks in support of our Nation. You will mentor your team to leverage Aerospace’s vast network of subject matter experts to bring innovative solutions to NNSA’s hardest problems. Additionally, you will look to identify new opportunities/challenges to leverage Aerospace capabilities to apply to our NNSA customer.

This is a full-time position based in Albuquerque, NM, Crystal City, VA, Colorado Springs, CO, or El Segundo, CA which requires a minimum of 4 days/week onsite work.

What You’ll Be Doing

Work closely with Principal Director and the rest of the management team to lead and manage Aerospace Enterprise Engineering team members with the challenging issues Aerospace is tackling for Defense Programs within the National Nuclear Security Administration.
Supports establishment of the Enterprise Engineering organization's objectives/goals with Principal Director and communicate them to your subordinates and interfacing organizations.
Provide strategic leadership and conducts activities consistent with corporate policies/practices, goals, and objectives.
Participates with higher management in determining the organization's structure and staff including resource needs (budget planning and allocation of resources).
Reports the organization's activities, progress, and achievements through written and oral reports to management, subordinates, and customers.
Coordinates work activities within the organization; monitors workload, work progress, and schedules; ensures completion of organization's work assignments within cost and schedule guidelines.
Seeks and identifies opportunities for additional, expanded, and new business and assists Sr. management in evaluating and pursuing new possibilities.
Cooperates and communicates frequently with customers to coordinate and report work progress, issues, and results.
Conducts staff performance reviews and recommends performance improvement, career development, salary, and promotion actions; establishes staffing needs; advises reassignments, training, transfers, and other staff deployments; and assists other supervisors in evaluating and assigning staff.
Directs technical group performing engineering design, analysis, or other research and development activities.
Lead from the front to influence customers to field more integrated solutions.

What You Need to be Successful - Systems Director – Systems Engineering and Digital Engineering

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in engineering, science, or another appropriate technical discipline
12 or more years of progressively responsible professional engineering/scientific experience
Experience in a managerial/leadership role with proven ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with all levels of contractors, customers, and corporate staff
Demonstrated networking, teaming, management, and leadership skills within a program office or matrixed technical organization, building and leading project teams, formulating task plans, ensuring product quality, and effectively interacting with customers.
Proven technical credibility across a broad set of systems engineering topics, and a deep understanding of the engineering of complex systems
Experience working with U.S. government agencies such as DOE/NNSA and DoD
Demonstrated strong interpersonal, organizational, written, and oral communication skills
Availability to travel domestically, up to 25% of the time
This position requires a current and active Top Secret or Q security clearance, which is issued by the U.S. government. U.S. citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance.

How You Can Stand Out

It would be impressive if you have one or more of these:

Advanced degree in engineering or math with specific experience in Systems/Digital Engineering
Familiarity with the DOE and NNSA National Laboratories in the Defense Programs Arena
Knowledge of the Aerospace Engineering and Technology Group (ETG) skills and capabilities
Demonstrated ability to create solutions to address national security needs
Holds a TS or DOE Q clearance with ability to obtain SCI

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. The grade-based pay range for this job is listed below. Individual salaries within that range are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge and skills.

(Min - Max)

$168,200.00 - $252,400.00

Pay Basis: Annual

Leadership Competencies

Our leadership philosophy is simple: every employee, regardless of level and role, can demonstrate leadership. At Aerospace, our commitment is our people. To cultivate our talent and ensure that we have a strong pipeline of future leaders, we want individuals who:

Operate Strategically
Lead Change  
Engage with Impact  
Foster Innovation  
Deliver Results

Ways We Reward Our Employees

During your interview process, our team will provide details of our industry-leading benefits.

Benefits vary and are applicable based on Job Type. A few highlights include:

Comprehensive health care and wellness plans
Paid holidays, sick time, and vacation
Standard and alternate work schedules, including telework options
401(k) Plan — Employees receive a total company-paid benefit of 8%, 10%, or 12% of eligible compensation based on years of service and matching contributions; employees are immediately eligible and vested in the plan upon hire
Flexible spending accounts
Variable pay program for exceptional contributions
Relocation assistance
Professional growth and development programs to help advance your career
Education assistance programs
An inclusive work environment built on teamwork, flexibility, and respect

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
LEGO Digital Play
will bring the LEGO brand into digital entertainment in new, innovative, and wholly-owned ways. Our mission is to ensure the LEGO Brand remains as powerfully a part of children’s lives in the coming decades as it has ever been. We aim to reach every kid on the planet, their parents, and adult fans of LEGO—and provide them with meaningful, magical, and playful new experiences.

We are at the earliest phases of this new company, offering a unique opportunity to build a new entity for the world's most beloved and trusted brand. Our culture is open, collaborative, intellectually rigorous, and creatively vibrant.

Role Summary

We are seeking a Director of Engineering to lead the architecture and development of a consumer-facing, living application that is a key component of a broader initiative under development at LEGO Digital Play. Your job is to lead technical decision-making and build a highly collaborative engineering environment built on communication, trust, and clear ownership and accountability. Although you will manage a small team of engineers, this is a “hands-on” role—at least, initially—requiring you to write code alongside your reports.

You will work closely with game designers, product managers, UX professionals, and marketers to guide sound, “future proof” development of the application and to continually ship new features.

This is a Hybrid role requiring 2-3 days per month in the office as well as occasional travel.

This role requires a strong analytical thinker with a passion for data analysis and a firm grasp of the product development process. Strong communication, leadership, and management skills are also a must.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership: Lead an engineering organization responsible for developing the digital/app component of a physical/digital hybrid product line.
Architecture and Future Proofing: Design durable and evolvable architecture capable of supporting the broader product line for years to come while minimizing tech debt.
Communication and Documentation: Ensure decisions are communicated appropriately and the work on the application is appropriately documented and accessible to stakeholders.
Product Planning: Assist the Director of Product Management in prioritizing features and sprint tasks.
Cross-Group Collaboration: Partner with the game designers, product managers, and UX professionals to craft a tightly integrated experience.
Management: Manage a small team of software engineers.
Problem Solving & Decision-Making: dentify challenges early and drive resolution—either directly or through escalation with clear recommendations.

Required Qualifications:

Experience in game development and technical leadership with work on multiple shipped titles.
Familiarity with cross-platform development, specifically the iOS, Android and Web platforms.
Experience with Games-as-a-Service architecture.
Fluency with scrum and/or similar project management methodologies.
Demonstrated success building and managing a small team.
Ability to operate in ambiguity while building structure and clarity.
Excellent communication and synthesis skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with hybrid physical/digital systems

Compensation

The salary for this position has a range of USD 195,000 – USD 263,000 based on anticipated responsibilities, market benchmarks, and organizational constraints. LEGO Digital Play carefully considers a wide range of compensation factors, including but not limited to prior experience, skills, expertise, location, internal equity, and other considerations permitted by law. The comprehensive remuneration details, inclusive of benefits, will be communicated upon finalisation of the employment offer.

We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Digital Play, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong. LEGO Digital Play is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age, religion and Veteran status) to apply for roles in our team.

Build systems and processes from the ground up and improve them continuously as we scale

jobs.description:
The Company You’ll Join

At Rebuy, we're on a mission to revolutionize shopping with intelligent, personalized experiences that wow customers around the globe. As a fully remote team, we power some of the fastest growing DTC brands like Tecovas, Momofuku, Dime Beauty, Liquid Death, Magic Spoon, OLLY, and many more.

We believe in ownership, drive, and empathy and strongly uphold that every team member plays a vital role in shaping the future of intelligent commerce. Our culture thrives on collaboration, creativity, and genuine passion. We don’t just build great tech - we build lasting partnerships, a strong community, and a place where people love to work.

The Role

As the VP of Engineering, you will own the engineering organization and the technical delivery of rebuyengine.com. You will lead the engineering pods (4–6 engineers each, one team captain per pod) and partner with the VP of Product on the roadmap and with the CEO/COO on operational execution. One of the main objectives will be to deliver the 2nd version of the API-first surface — the standardized REST tool set that makes Rebuy the cleanest API in the Shopify ecosystem for agents to call.

What You’ll Do:

Set engineering strategy, own technical architecture, direction and the bar for code, reliability, and security
Lead and grow the engineering organization; install the pod operating model, handle organizational design, and establish career progression paths
Ship the V2 REST API surface, the OpenAPI spec, and the agent-readiness layer
Own engineering KPIs: delivery velocity, system reliability, defect density, hiring quality
Partner on diligence-readiness — repo hygiene, IP assignment, security posture — for a strategic transaction.
Partner with the Product team to define technical vision, architecture standards, and product delivery roadmaps
Own the performance metrics for Rebuy engine (latency, errors, etc).
Responsible for all platform security
Review and optimize our entire tech stack, also assess all critical points of failure to add redundancies as needed.
Responsible for shipping high quality code.

Who You Are

We're looking for an experienced engineering executive who combines deep technical expertise with exceptional leadership skills. You're passionate about building world-class engineering organizations, developing high-performing teams, and delivering technology that drives meaningful business outcomes.

The Hard Skills

15+ years in engineering leadership; have led 30–50 person engineering organizations
Experience scaling SaaS platforms in ecommerce, martech, or developer tools
Proven success scaling high-growth SaaS platforms with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.
Deep expertise in software architecture, distributed systems, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and platform engineering.
Experience building API-first products and developer platforms using modern REST and OpenAPI standards.
Strong understanding of modern software development practices, CI/CD, DevOps, observability, incident management, and engineering operations.
Experience optimizing application performance, platform latency, database performance, cloud infrastructure, and large-scale distributed systems.
Strong opinions on API design and developer experience — OpenAPI, REST conventions, agent-tool patterns
Modern stack fluency (PHP/Node/React/Shopify ecosystem helpful)
Comfortable operating in an exit-process posture with discretion
Vast experience with large data sets and must be a database expert

The Soft Skills

Strong communication skills and ability to break down complex problems into easy-to-understand concepts.
Executive presence with the ability to inspire confidence, influence decision-making, and build trust across the organization.
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business strategies and executive recommendations.
Collaborative leader who builds strong partnerships across Product, Customer Success, Sales, Operations, and Executive Leadership.
Someone who carries a positive attitude, loves to be a problem-solver, is naturally self-motivated, and passionate about e-commerce.

Who You’ll Meet With

Now let's get into who you'll meet during our interview process! After you submit your application and it's been reviewed by our team, we will reach out to you inviting you to meet with us. From there, you can expect an interview process similar to this:

Recruiter Screen (30 min) — Initial conversation to learn more about you and answer your questions about Rebuy and this role.
Hiring Manager interview (30-45 min) — High level conversation but more in depth about the role.
COO Interview (30min) - A high level conversation with the co-founder, COO.
Panel Interview (45-60 min) — Meet with members of the engineering team to chat more in depth about your experience.
Presentation (3-5 business days) — A project-based assessment to show us your vision.
Final Interviews (15 min each) — Short conversations with our CEO and COO where you'll get to learn more about Rebuy.

The Perks You’ll Enjoy

Rebuy is a fully remote company across the U.S. and Canada that aims to provide all of our team with the resources, support and flexibility they need to thrive in their roles.

Team: We’ve got the best, brightest, most brilliant team members who are excited to meet you! We also like to think we have a good sense of humor.
Remote Work: With a strong internet connection, you’re able to work from anywhere within the U.S. and Canada.
PTO: We offer a flexible vacation policy, generous holiday schedule, parental leave and sick policy. There’s other policies too like a birthday holiday!
Amazing Benefits: 100% free health, dental, and insurance for you and your family. Don’t worry, there’s even more!
Retirement Plans: For our U.S. employees we offer 401(k) retirement plans and for our Canadian employees we offer a TFSA and RRSP retirement plans. You’ll also enjoy a 3% contribution of your gross salary, no matter where you’re located!

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets, and we pay differently based on those defined markets. The U.S. base pay range for this position is $225,000 - $300,000 USD annually. Pay within this range varies by work location and may also depend on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Your recruiter and hiring manager can share more about the specific salary range for the job location during the hiring process.

Disclosures:

Equal Opportunity Statement

Rebuy, Inc. is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.

Rebuy, Inc. aims to make rebuyengine.com accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email hr@rebuyengine.com.

jobs.title: VP/Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
🌊 About Sailor Health

America is undergoing one of the largest demographic shifts in its history as the Baby Boomer generation enters its later years. This shift will put unprecedented pressure on Medicare, which already spends more than $1 trillion each year caring for older adults. Yet the healthcare system is built backwards: reactive instead of preventative, measuring years of life instead of the quality of them.

Sailor Health is building a new care model for aging. We combine behavioral health, healthcare advocacy, wellness classes, and AI care agents into one virtual platform designed for older adults. AI coaches help patients navigate their health between visits, while AI copilots give providers the tools to deliver higher-quality, better-informed care. We partner with Medicare to make our platform affordable and accessible to older adults nationwide.

Sailor has exceptional product-market fit:

Exponential growth: We are honored to serve thousands of patients across all 50 states, with strong organic demand helping make Sailor one of the fastest-growing companies in healthcare.
AI-powered, deeply human care: We harness the power of AI while keeping human connection at the center of care, creating an experience that feels personal, continuous, and deeply human.
Backed by category-defining founders: We are supported by founders from Ramp, Nourish, Headway, Charlie Health, and Spring Health.

⭐ About the Role

We're hiring a VP/Head of Engineering to lead technology and product at Sailor. You'll set technical direction, lead product across both our patient and provider platforms, and report directly to our CEO.

You'll be building at the frontier of AI and healthcare: our AI Health Coach that measurably improves health outcomes, copilots that give clinicians superpowers, and a longitudinal data platform spanning the full care journey. Just as exciting is the how, because you'll get gritty reinventing engineering practices for a world where AI changes how software gets built.

We're looking for a player-coach with high slope, someone who loves to build, and a leader wants to do the defining work of their career. On hiring, your mandate is to build the "Navy SEALs" of engineering: small by design, high-trust culture, and extremely talent dense.

💻 Your Key Responsibilities

Build! This is a player-coach role. You'll ship production code weekly and set the standard for what AI-native development looks like at Sailor.
Lead product. You'll own the roadmap across our patient and provider platforms - we expect you to deeply understand business problems & decisions.
Run experiments. You'll bring a data-oriented, experimentation-first mindset to a consumer product for a generation that's never had one built for them. Launch fast, read the signal, iterate.
Recruit. You'll attract and close exceptional engineers, drawing on your network and making Sailor the place the best builders want to be.
Set technical direction. You'll make the architecture calls as we scale, balancing speed today against the platform we'll need at ten times the patient volume.
Reinvent how we build. AI is changing what a small team can ship, and you'll push that frontier inside Sailor. You'll define the practices, tooling, and culture that let us outbuild much larger orgs.
Mentor the team. You'll mentor engineers across experience levels and turn strong builders into exceptional ones.

✅ What We're Looking For

This role isn't for everyone. It's fast-paced, chaotic, and requires hard work. But if this excites you, we'd love to meet you.

You've led engineering at a high growth startup: you thrived in the chaos, grew the team, set the engineering bar, and made the people around you better.
You're a builder. You've written meaningful production code in the last six months and have no interest in becoming a pure people manager.
You're a talent magnet. You've hired exceptional engineers from your own network, closed hard candidates, and some of them would follow you again.
You've owned product, not just executed it. You've made roadmap calls, written specs, and sat directly with users without a PM in between.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager – AI and R&D Infrastructure
jobs.description:
HistoSonics
is a commercial-stage medtech company advancing the Edison® System, a novel non-invasive sonic beam therapy based on histotripsy. Since receiving FDA De Novo grant for the non-invasive destruction of liver tumors in 2023, the company has progressed beyond initial market entry into commercial expansion, reimbursement momentum, and ongoing clinical and pipeline development. In addition to its current liver tumor indication, HistoSonics is pursuing future indications across multiple applications including kidney, pancreas, prostate, neuro, women’s health, and other significant underserved human health areas, to realize the broader potential histotripsy across multiple disease states and medical specialties.

We offer an exciting work culture where cutting-edge science meets real-world application, and each team member’s contribution is important to our success in ensuring our physicians and their patients get what they need most.

Location:
Plymouth, MN

Position Summary (Why This Role Matters)

The Sr. Manager, AI and R&D Infrastructure leads the team responsible for cloud platforms, AI automation, and systems imaging capabilities across the CTO organization. This role ensures the reliability, security, compliance, and continuous evolution of critical infrastructure and tools that support software development, research, clinical operations, and product innovation. The position partners closely with technical and business leaders to execute strategy, develop talent, drive operational excellence, and foster a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities (What You’ll Do)

Provide leadership to a team of cloud platform engineers, agentic AI developers, and systems imaging specialists; establish a high-performance team culture grounded in engineering excellence, security by design, continuous learning, and clear accountability for outcomes
Attract, hire, develop, and retain top technical talent; actively shape the team’s organizational structure, role definitions, and career pathways to build durable capability aligned with HistoSonics’ long-term technical strategy
Contribute to and execute the AI and R&D Infrastructure team’s strategy and multi-quarter roadmap in partnership with the Sr. Director; translate the CTO organization’s technical and business objectives into a coherent set of product cloud platform, AI automation, and infrastructure investments that deliver measurable value
Operate with autonomy in setting day-to-day priorities; make informed recommendations about where the team’s time and resources are best invested, balancing immediate operational needs against strategic capability-building; communicate the rationale for these decisions clearly to stakeholders at all levels
Represent the AI and R&D Infrastructure team in Product Development organization planning, architecture forums, and cross-functional leadership discussions; advocate effectively for the team’s priorities, surface emerging risks and opportunities, and influence decisions that affect the broader CTO organization
Establish the team as a trusted, proactive partner across the organization by building and maintaining strong partnerships with the Sr. Director – Software Platforms and Technology Strategy, software engineering leadership, Information Systems, Security, Data Privacy, Quality, and Regulatory stakeholders.
In partnership with Information Systems and Security, establish and evolve product cloud infrastructure governance: policy-driven controls, reusable IaC templates and modules with best practices embedded, enforceable guardrails, and organizational standards for cost tracking, naming, tagging, alerting, logging, and observability; hold the team accountable for consistent application of these standards
Partner with Information Systems leaders for cloud resource hierarchy, subscription management, and management group governance at the highest organizational level; ensure compliance and security requirements for cloud infrastructure are tracked, communicated, and addressed
Guide the team in evaluating and adopting new cloud tools, architecture patterns, and platform capabilities; champion a culture of continuous improvement and deliberate technical evolution
Guide the team in maintaining Infrastructure as Code practices, reusable module libraries, and environment management strategies; ensure IaC standards are documented, governed, and accessible across the CTO organization
Drive the direction for agentic AI and automation capabilities across HistoSonics’ CTO org, clinical, Quality and operational domains, in partnership with the Sr. Director; identify high-value automation opportunities in partnership with CTO organization leadership and translate them into a prioritized delivery roadmap
Partner with Product and Information Systems Security to ensure the team builds agentic systems with rigorous governance, including appropriate guardrails, observability, human-in-the-loop controls, responsible use standards, and AI-specific risk analysis appropriate for a regulated medical device environment
Stay current on the evolving agentic AI landscape; evaluate emerging frameworks, foundation models, and AI platform capabilities; guide the team in adopting practices and tooling that advance HistoSonics’ AI automation maturity responsibly
Own the execution and contribute to the evolving strategy for Windows and Linux systems imaging, endpoint management, and configuration management across product computing systems; ensure the team’s practices meet the needs of both corporate and regulated R&D and laboratory use cases
Ensure product endpoint security standards, patch management processes, secrets managment, and configuration baselines are maintained in alignment with HistoSonics’ Information Systems security policies, best practices, and applicable regulatory requirements; maintain a strong working relationship with Information Systems leadership on endpoint compliance
Ensure all team activities comply with HistoSonics’ Quality Management System and applicable regulatory requirements including IEC 62304, FDA 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485, HIPAA, and SOC 2; oversee computer systems validation (CSV) activities for GxP-relevant infrastructure and validated computing environments managed by the team
Participate in architecture reviews, threat modeling, and change control processes as a senior representative of the AI and R&D Infrastructure function; ensure the team’s work is well-documented and that workflows, standards, and modules are accessible and understandable across the CTO organization
Own escalation and resolution of high-impact product development infrastructure incidents, pipeline failures, agent defects, and imaging issues; drive root cause analysis and ensure effective corrective actions that prevent recurrence
Other duties as assigned by the Sr. Director – Software Platforms and Technology Strategy

Qualifications And Skills

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus
10+ years of progressive experience in IT platform engineering, DevOps, infrastructure engineering, or related disciplines
4 years in a people leadership role managing technical teams of 5 or more engineers; demonstrated track record of building and scaling high-performing teams
Proven experience operating at a senior manager level, including contributing to team strategy, managing organizational structure, and influencing technical direction across a broader organization
Advanced knowledge of Azure cloud infrastructure and architecture; sufficient depth to provide technical direction, evaluate significant architectural decisions, and hold the team to high engineering standards across cloud platform, observability, CI/CD, IaC, and containerization domains. Working knowledge of AWS is a plus.
Experience with agentic AI concepts, LLM application patterns, and AI governance considerations; able to help shape direction for AI automation work, evaluate the team’s technical approach, and engage credibly with AI-related decisions
Working knowledge of Windows and Linux systems imaging, endpoint management, platform security practices, and hybrid cloud connectivity; sufficient to provide direction and evaluate team execution
Experience operating in a regulated environment (FDA, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, HIPAA, SOC 2); familiarity with computer systems validation (CSV) and 21 CFR Part 11 is strongly preferred; awareness of medical device cybersecurity frameworks including NIST and FDA guidance
Strong organizational influence: builds effective cross-functional partnerships, advocates credibly for the team’s priorities, navigates competing demands with sound judgment, and contributes meaningfully to broader CTO organization leadership discussions
Operates with meaningful autonomy and a bias toward action; comfortable holding ambiguity while driving clarity for the team; maintains a forward-thinking mindset and keen awareness of the downstream impact of organizational and technical decisions

Benefits:
We offer a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees. This includes health, dental, and vision insurance, life, short-term and long-term disability insurance, 401(k), paid time off, and more.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Employer will not sponsor visas for position.

jobs.description:
Job Description

INNOVATE without boundaries!

Milwaukee Tool, an industry-leading manufacturer of heavy-duty power tools, accessories, and hand tools for professional users worldwide, is looking for a talented, enthusiastic, and motivated leader to operate, evolve, and modernize the Oracle platform at the heart of our business. Come be a part of the IT team behind the most exciting and innovative tool company in the world and join the REDvolution!

Behind our doors you'll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to support the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you'll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.; Sponsorship is not available for this position at this time.

Your Role On Our Team

As the Director, IT – Oracle Platform, you will lead the team that owns Milwaukee Tool’s Oracle Fusion platform. With our Oracle Fusion foundation now live and established, your focus will be on ensuring operational excellence while evolving the platform through new capabilities that keep pace with our fast-growing business. You will lead a high-performing platform organization, partner with leaders across Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Finance, and others, and define the long-term platform strategy that turns Oracle into a durable competitive advantage. You will bring Extreme Ownership, Candor, Speed/Agility/Urgency, and a ONE-TEAM mentality to every aspect of the role.

You’ll Be DISRUPTIVE Through These Duties And Responsibilities

Lead, coach, and grow the Oracle Platform Team by recruiting and retaining top talent while building strong succession plans, career paths, and leadership capability.
Own the health, stability, security, performance, and scalability of Milwaukee Tool's Oracle Fusion platform in production.
Champion enterprise standardization and best practices while thoughtfully evaluating exceptions that create measurable business value.
Govern platform architecture, change control, release management, and solution standards to maintain a secure, scalable, global single-instance Oracle platform.
Define, communicate, and execute a multi-year Oracle platform roadmap aligned to enterprise priorities and business outcomes.
Partner with business and technology leaders to translate strategic priorities into standardized platform capabilities that enable long-term business growth.
Prioritize and deliver a continuous pipeline of new platform capabilities and module implementations while maintaining operational excellence.
Oversee internal teams and external partners, including system integrators and managed service providers, while owning platform investment, licensing strategy, vendor performance, and commercial outcomes.
Serve as the senior escalation point for critical platform issues and ensure disciplined operational support, risk management, and service continuity.
Communicate platform health, strategic progress, business outcomes, and investment priorities to executive leadership and steering committees.

The TOOLS You’ll Bring With You

15+ years of IT experience in large or midsize multinational manufacturing or supply chain organizations, including significant leadership of technical teams.
Demonstrated success leading an enterprise platform through implementation, operational stabilization, continuous evolution, and long-term modernization.
Deep, hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud, including enterprise implementations and ownership of a mature production platform.
Proven people leadership, including leading managers and multidisciplinary technical teams, with a track record of building high-performing organizations.
Demonstrated ability to define long-term platform strategy, prioritize competing demands, and deliver incremental business value.
Strong vendor, budget, and portfolio management experience, including system integrators and managed-services partners.
Broad knowledge of supply chain, manufacturing, and finance business processes and how they map to Oracle capabilities.
Exceptional collaboration, influence, and executive communication skills with stakeholders at all levels.
A bachelor’s degree in a related field is required; a master’s degree is preferred.

Other TOOLS We Prefer You To Have

Experience leading multiple enterprise platforms or a broader application portfolio.
Experience standing up or scaling a product-based platform operating model and steady-state support organization.
Familiarity with the broader Oracle ecosystem, including OTM/GTM, OIC integrations, and Fusion Cloud modules across Order Management, Procurement, Supply Chain Execution, and Finance.
Experience transitioning an organization from implementation into long-term platform ownership.
Track record of successfully delivering complex, multi-million-dollar business and IT programs.
Decisiveness in navigating ambiguity and translating complex business needs into scalable platform capabilities.
Ability to distill and communicate complex concepts into simple, clear messages for executive audiences.
Exposure to multi-vendor, multi-cultural, global IT delivery and the ability to lead distributed teams.
Relevant Oracle certifications.
Ability to travel to other Milwaukee Tool locations on occasion, as required.

Working Conditions

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Frequently required to stand, walk, bend, stretch, reach, and communicate effectively with others in the workplace.
Sitting for prolonged periods of time.
Prolonged exposure to computer screens.
Repetitive use of hands and fingers to operate office equipment, machinery, hand tools, and/or power tools.
Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.
May be required to wear personal protective equipment, including, but not limited to, safety glasses, gloves, and hearing protection.
May work in laboratories and/or controlled, enclosed, restricted areas
Noise levels may range from moderate to loud.
Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds at a time.
May require travel depending on company needs.

We Provide These Great Perks And Benefits

Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans
Generous 401(k) savings plan
Education assistance
On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service
And many more. Check out our benefits site HERE.

Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Director of Technology Operations
jobs.description:
Who we are:
At Arkana Laboratories, everyone has an important role to fill. Come join us and be a part of a team dedicated to making life better for those who need it most.

This place is packed with super-smart people who do their best work together. We work hard every day to advance our understanding of disease and provide world-class care to our patients in hopes of leaving our corner of the world a little better than we found it. While we are committed to improving the lives of thousands of patients, we never lose sight of the realization that they are the reason we get to create change in our field.

Built on generosity, teamwork, and the freedom to try new things, we take great pride in our work. Great ideas come from everywhere in this company and we celebrate each success and failure for the opportunity it gives us to keep reaching. For more than twenty years after our founder, Dr. Patrick Walker, wrote his goals on the back of a napkin, our people, culture, and values have remained strong.

About The Role

The Director of Technology Operations owns three functions: cloud and infrastructure engineering, the technology support desk, and information security. You will report to the Chief Technology Officer and have the opportunity to shape and grow the team.

Arkana is the nation's leading renal pathology practice. We hold one of the richest kidney biopsy datasets in the world, and we are building the infrastructure to expand our training of clinical AI models on it. That includes an NVIDIA Blackwell class GPU cluster that is unique in healthcare and Central Arkansas. It sits alongside a hybrid cloud platform, a laboratory information system being built in house, and usable clinical AI products. You will own the operations behind all of it.

This is a strategic leadership role with real technical stakes. You will set direction across service operations, infrastructure, and security in a HIPAA/HITRUST clinical environment where physicians and patients depend on uptime every day.

What You'll Do

Infrastructure and cloud

Direct the team designing, deploying, and operating our Blackwell class GPU training cluster, hybrid cloud platform (AWS preferred), and on premises clinical systems
Own the infrastructure roadmap and budget, including capacity planning for AI compute expansion, colocation and facilities decisions, and the migration path off legacy systems
Hire the right talent and develop your team as the function grows

Support desk and service operations

Lead the technology support function through its manager, serving a demanding environment that spans clinical operations, specialized laboratory instrumentation, and business systems
Own service quality in a high volume ticket environment where the equipment is often unique: laboratory devices, imaging systems, and clinical integrations that don't come with a standard playbook
Set service standards, drive measurable improvement in resolution and satisfaction, and mature the function as the company continues to grow

Information security

Own the InfoSec practice, currently a one person function, with accountability for security posture across HIPAA, HITRUST, and CAP requirements
Support the security and compliance dimensions of our pharmaceutical partnerships and Clinical Trials business line, a distinctive responsibility that spans data protection, sponsor requirements, and regulated research environments
Set the security roadmap, decide where to grow the practice versus partner with vendors, and represent security in audits and compliance reviews

Vendor and stakeholder leadership

Own vendor strategy and contract management across managed services, security tooling, and infrastructure providers
Partner with executive leadership on technology risk, business continuity, and the operational side of the technology roadmap

What We're Looking For

10+ years of progressive technology experience, including leading multi-function IT or technology operations organizations through managers
Demonstrated ownership of infrastructure or platform functions at meaningful scale, with enough technical depth to direct a principal level architect credibly
Experience with security accountability in a regulated environment; HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, or equivalent frameworks strongly preferred
Track record of building teams: hiring senior technical talent, developing managers, and running functions through growth
Budget ownership, vendor negotiation, and executive communication experience

Bonus Points

Healthcare, laboratory, or clinical technology operations background
Exposure to GPU, HPC, or ML infrastructure environments
Experience standing up or maturing a security practice
Service management maturity work (ITSM implementation, support desk transformation)

Location and Schedule

This position is onsite at our Little Rock headquarters. The lab is here, the hardware is here, and the teams you lead are here. The schedule is Monday through Friday, 8am to 5pm, onsite in Little Rock, Arkansas.

What we offer:
We know that health is more than doctor visits and life is more than work. We work hard at Arkana but in turn provide competitive salaries and generous benefit offerings.

Competitive salary
Generous paid time off and Paid Holidays

401(k) with immediate eligibility and match
Company-paid life insurance
Company-paid long term disability coverage
