jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Sr. Engineering Manager leads Current Power's engineering function and is accountable for the people, technical quality, capacity, and execution of project engineering and mechanical design. Reporting to the Vice President - Operations, this role directs the Sr. Mechanical Design Engineer and the Project Engineering team and ensures complex engineered-to-order electrical power, control, and electro-mechanical systems are delivered safely, accurately, and profitably from contract review through commissioning and closeout. The Engineering Manager combines functional leadership, portfolio oversight, and hands-on technical judgment while partnering with Operations, Supply Chain, Sales, Quality, customers, and suppliers to achieve scope, schedule, cost, quality, and performance commitments.

The Sr. Engineering Manager is a senior department leader responsible for engineering performance across multiple concurrent projects and disciplines. Employees in this position set departmental priorities, allocate resources, develop engineering talent, establish standards, approve critical technical decisions and releases, and serve as the escalation point for customer, project, and execution risks. Success requires balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term capability building, standardization, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Lead, coach, and develop the Sr. Mechanical Design Engineer and Project Engineering team, including work assignments, goal setting, feedback, performance management, succession planning, and career development.
Translate business and project priorities into an engineering resource and capacity plan; balance workloads across active projects and identify hiring, training, or outside support needs.
Own engineering execution across the full project lifecycle, including proposal support, contract review, design, procurement coordination, fabrication support, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), commissioning, and closeout.
Establish and monitor engineering plans, budgets, labor-hour forecasts, schedules, deliverables, and review milestones; take corrective action when cost, quality, scope, or schedule performance is at risk.
Ensure engineering work complies with contractual requirements, customer specifications, applicable codes and standards, safety expectations, and company procedures.
Review and approve critical engineering deliverables, including one-line diagrams, schematics, calculations, equipment selections, 3D models, fabrication drawings, bills of material, test plans, and release packages.
Serve as the technical authority and escalation point for low- and medium-voltage power distribution, switchgear, motor control centers, AC/DC drives, control systems, enclosures, skids, and integrated electro-mechanical equipment.
Lead formal design reviews, technical risk assessments, engineering change management, management of change (MOC), root-cause investigations, and lessons-learned activities.
Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, and Quality to improve manufacturability, material readiness, supplier alignment, assembly efficiency, test quality, and field serviceability.
Support Sales and customer-facing activities through scope definition, technical estimates, proposal reviews, contract clarifications, change-order support, and presentation of technical solutions.
Establish and maintain engineering standards and systems, including CAD/PDM practices, document and revision control, part-numbering and bill-of-material governance, templates, calculations, and workflow controls.
Establish and report engineering performance indicators for schedule adherence, labor-hour performance, quality, rework, capacity, and project outcomes; communicate status, decisions, and risks to leadership and stakeholders.
Recruit, onboard, train, and cross-train engineering personnel while promoting a safe, inclusive, accountable, and collaborative team culture.
Support FATs, commissioning, field investigations, warranty issues, and customer problem resolution as required.
Perform other related duties as assigned.

Demonstrated ability in the following leadership competencies:

Builds and Maintains Effective Relationships
Develops Self and Others
Builds Effective Teams
Courageous Leadership
Managing Vision and Purpose
Business Acumen
Drive for Results
Customer Focus
Decision Quality

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or another related engineering discipline from an accredited college or university.
Minimum of ten (10) years of progressive engineering experience in industrial electrical power and control systems, engineered-to-order manufacturing, system integration, or a related energy or manufacturing environment.
At least four (4) years of direct people leadership experience managing engineers or designers, including assigning work, coaching employees, developing talent, and managing performance.
Demonstrated experience leading multi-disciplinary engineering execution across multiple concurrent projects from contract review through manufacturing, testing, commissioning, and closeout.
Strong working knowledge of low- and medium-voltage power distribution, switchgear, motor control centers, AC/DC drives, control systems, and electro-mechanical equipment integration.
Proven ability to review and approve complex electrical and mechanical engineering deliverables and make sound technical decisions with incomplete or changing information.
Demonstrated ownership of engineering budgets, labor hours, schedules, resource plans, technical risk, and project financial performance.
Working knowledge of applicable industrial codes and standards, including NEC, NFPA, IEEE, NEMA, and UL requirements.
Strong leadership, business judgment, customer-facing communication, conflict-resolution, and stakeholder-management skills.
Proficiency with engineering document-control systems, ERP and project-management tools, and Microsoft Office applications.

Preferred Qualifications

Twelve (12) or more years of engineering and project-execution experience, including five (5) or more years in an engineering management role.
Professional Engineer (PE) license, Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, master's degree in engineering, or Master of Business Administration (MBA).
Experience with engineered-to-order switchgear, drives, motor control centers, power-conversion systems, control packages, or related equipment for industrial, drilling, marine, data-center, or energy applications.
Experience building or scaling engineering teams, standardizing engineering processes, and improving execution within a manufacturing or fabrication environment.
Working experience with AutoCAD Electrical, 3D CAD, PDM/PLM systems, and SAP or a similar ERP platform.
Experience supporting proposals, contract reviews, customer negotiations, supplier technical evaluations, and change-order management.

Physical & Working Conditions

Work primarily in an office environment with regular interaction in engineering, shop, fabrication, and testing areas.
Ability to walk, stand, climb stairs, and inspect equipment while wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE).
Occasional exposure to shop or field conditions, including noise, dust, weather, moving equipment, and energized-system hazards controlled through established procedures.
Occasional travel, extended work hours, weekends, or off-hours support may be required to meet project and customer needs.

Reporting Structure

This position reports directly to the Vice President - Operations. The Sr. Mechanical Design Engineer and the Project Engineering team, including the Senior Electrical Project Engineer and Project Engineers, report directly to this position. The Mechanical Design team reports through the Sr. Mechanical Design Engineer.

Planned Parenthood is the nation’s leading provider and advocate of high-quality, affordable sexual and reproductive health care for all people, as well as the nation’s largest provider of sex education. Planned Parenthood organizations serve all people with care and compassion, with respect, and without judgment, striving to create equitable access to health care. Through health centers, programs in schools and communities, and online resources, Planned Parenthood is a trusted source of reliable education and information that allows people to make informed health decisions. We do all this because we care passionately about helping people lead healthier lives.

Planned Parenthood Federation of America (PPFA) is a 501(c)(3) charitable organization that supports the independently incorporated Planned Parenthood affiliates, which operate non-profit health centers across the U.S. PPFA also works to educate the public on and advocate for issues of sexual and reproductive health. Formed as the advocacy and political arm of Planned Parenthood Federation of America, Planned Parenthood Action Fund is a separate non-profit membership organization tax-exempt under section 501(c)(4). The Action Fund engages in educational, advocacy, and limited electoral activity, including grassroots organizing, legislative advocacy, and voter education in furtherance of the Planned Parenthood mission.

Planned Parenthood Federation of America (PPFA) and Planned Parenthood Action Fund seeks a dynamic and effective Director, Development Operations Infrastructure Engineering. This job reports directly to the Senior Director of Development Operations and Infrastructure in the IT Ops department of PPFA. The IT Ops department implements the architectural and infrastructural components used by PPFA, and is critical to the success of Planned Parenthood, its patients, supporters, donors, and staff.

Purpose:

Director, Development Operations (DevOps) Infrastructure Engineering is responsible for the design and governance of PPFA’s web server infrastructure. Functionally, this includes compliance management (PCI), network (physical, virtual), security (firewalls, logging, IDP/IDS, CDN, access control), and server (physical, virtual, container) design. The role architects the behavior of complex infrastructure systems to silently provide an uninterrupted array of services that are purposely invisible to developers and users of our technology including PP patients and staff. The role defines our infrastructure technology stack, standards, and best practices for managing day to day operations. From an organizational standpoint, the Director manages the Infrastructure shared service which supports Web Development, Quality Assurance, Security, Product teams.

Engagement:

The Director will be part of the IT Ops team with specific focus on PPOL, Planned Parenthood’s web properties, and will work closely with the Application Development team, Information Security team, and more broadly members of the TSS division, third party vendors, as well as executive and operational staff within the PPFA National Office, affiliates, and ancillary organizations.

Delivery:

The Director will deliver by being a hands-on engineering team member, creating, assessing, monitoring, updating, and deploying infrastructure assets, CI/CD Tooling, Security and Compliance assets, all relating to PPFA’s websites in AWS.

Establish strategies for ensuring high availability of mission-critical PPFA online properties
Configuration management automation strategy
Geo distributed data centers
Content delivery network (CDN)
Caching strategies
Automated DNS cutovers based on application health checks
DDoS protection
Log Analysis Tools for intrusion correlation and mitigation

Designs infrastructure components to support our high availability strategy
Virtual machine architecture
Container architecture
Network architecture
Security systems architecture
High availability architecture
GeoLocation Failover and Redundancy

Designs multi-availability failover and cluster strategies
GeoLocation Availability
DNS Routing and Management Strategy
Multi-Region Deployment and Updates
Secure Routing and IDP Management

Security Reviews and Testing
Review CVE and Test Reports for Security Flaws
Perform Periodic Security Reviews
Advise on code compliance and security best practices
Ensure NIST, CIS, OWASP, and HIPAA regime compliance.

Management

Manages the shared service capacity to support product development initiatives for AppDev, QA, Product/Business and Information Security teams.
Co-Governs the Infrastructure team portfolio, helps define the team roadmap, and helps set priorities for project delivery Sets standards and best practices for managing day-to-day infrastructure operations
Partners with Senior Director, Development Operations to support and complete their technology vision
Provides Level 3 issue resolution support to resolve complex technical issues
Ensures all AZ Deployments are in sync
Ensures request routing aligns with performance strategies

Security

Defines security policies and standards in collaboration with security and legal partners
Ensures compliance with security policies and vulnerability mitigation through established standards and practices
Manages and performs security audits and remediations on a weekly basis, and implements proactive security measures
Manages security access controls, DNS, and Logging services

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities (KSAs):

Professional experience implementing nontrivial applications in Python, Typescript, and Bash required
Experience with compliance requirements and industry standards such as HIPAA, PCI, NIST, CIS, OWASP (required)

5+ years experience with System Hardening Regimes and Techniques, and IDP/IDS tools like Palo Alto

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Foundations
jobs.description:
Why Join AngelList

We’re solving some of the hardest problems in venture capital and private markets. You’ll work with a team that values precision, urgency, and long-term thinking. If you want to shape how startups are funded and built, this is the place.

About AngelList

We exist to accelerate innovation by increasing the number of successful startups in the world. We do this by building the financial infrastructure that makes it easier for more people to invest in world-changing companies.

AngelList is the nexus of venture capital and the startup community. We support $171B+ in assets and have powered investments into over 13,000 startups—over 300 of which are unicorns. Today, 57% of top-tier U.S. VC deals involve investors on AngelList. While our scale is large, our ambition is larger.

If you're excited to build the future of private markets, come build with us.

About The Role

$200B+ in assets and $90B in money movement run on infrastructure that about 50 engineers and a growing number of agents build on top of. We're hiring a Head of Engineering, Foundations to lead the team that owns it. This role reports directly to the CEO and has company-level scope.

Part of what this team owns is new. Agents are becoming first-class users of our own systems, and nobody has a settled answer for what a platform owes a non-human user: sandboxing, audit trails, rollback, all against systems that move real money. You'd be deciding how that works here.

As a Head of Engineering here, you'd be expected to personally ship, not just direct.

Responsibilities

Hire, coach, and grow a small team of high-performing engineers, and develop the staff and principal engineers who carry technical standards into other teams.
Build the platform the whole engineering org runs on: developer platforms, deployment pipelines, observability, and developer tooling.
Automate infrastructure as code on Kubernetes and AWS, using Pulumi, cdk8s, and ArgoCD.
Build the harnesses agents execute inside, including sandboxing, audit trails, and rollback against systems that move real money.
Set the engineering standards for reliability, operability, and architectural coherence, and sequence the quality work that keeps teams shipping quickly over time.

What We’re Looking For

12+ years in engineering, including 5+ leading teams.
A builder who leads. You write clean, well-tested code and have designed and shipped systems end to end, and you want to keep doing that while growing a team.
Leverage through senior engineers. You've developed staff and principal ICs who make other teams better.
Systems judgment. You've operated consequential infrastructure before. Kubernetes, AWS, and infrastructure-as-code experience helps, but judgment matters more than familiarity with our exact stack.
Developer experience as a product. You design infrastructure for the engineers using it rather than just operating it.
You author the standard. You have a clear point of view on what good infrastructure looks like and set it rather than inheriting it.

Working Here

If you don’t meet every requirement above, we still encourage you to apply. We value complementary strengths and operators who learn by doing.

We operate out of hubs in New York City and San Francisco. For most roles on those teams, we work from the office at least two days per week (Tuesdays and either Wednesday or Thursday). Exceptions may be made for exceptional individual contributor candidates in other locations.

Compensation

The compensation for this role consists of a competitive base salary, benefits, and equity package. The base salary for this role is $280,000+ annually but actual will vary based on a number of factors including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Full details about our Total Rewards package will be provided during the recruitment process.

Benefits

We support your life both in and outside of work.

What Guides Us

At AngelList, we are united in our purpose to accelerate innovation and build the future of private markets. Our beliefs and values shape what we work on and how we create impact. If the below resonate, we'd love to have you with us.

AngelList is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.description:
Build the future, spark innovation and align your career with purpose.

McKinstry is innovating the waste and climate harm out of the built environment and creating lasting impact. Together, we’re building a thriving planet.

Buildings are a leading contributor to the climate crisis, generating nearly 40% of total global energy-related carbon emissions. We’re making a lasting impact on our industry and within our communities by addressing the climate, affordability and equity crises through:

renewables and energy services
engineering and design
construction and facility services

To get where we’re going, we need big thinkers, problem solvers and collaborative mindsets. Does that sound like you?

The Opportunity with McKinstry

We are adding a Director, AI Engineering
to our team in Seattle, WA. The Director, AI Engineering owns the development of the company’s core AI technology and the platform it runs on, the enterprise engineering function, the technical strategy and reference architecture, and the production operations that keep released systems trusted. The role turns approved, requirements-backed use cases into secure, production-grade systems, agents, APIs, and integrations for every spoke, built once to a shared standard. Partners closely with enterprise AI strategy and leadership on use-case selection, prioritized roadmaps, enterprise architecture, to ensure the right systems and technical foundation.

Owns the AI technical strategy and reference architecture. Sets how AI systems are engineered: the reference architecture, integration patterns, agent platform, and build-versus-reuse calls that keep the portfolio coherent, built on McKinstry’s Filesystem-Driven Agent Architecture. Enterprise strategy and portfolio selection sit with leadership; this role owns the technical strategy that executes them.
Owns the AI platform and the agent harness. Builds and operates McKinstry’s core AI platform: the agent harness that turns a model into a governed capability (provider gateway, routing, context, memory, tool execution, output validation, and instrumentation), implemented on the Filesystem-Driven Agent Architecture, where every agent, skill, tool, and hook is defined in version-controlled files and folder location determines what is live. This is the platform the whole program builds on.
Owns the model-agnostic strategy and leads the build, buy, or host decision-making process. Keeps McKinstry portable across model providers through a provider-gateway layer, so changing a model or vendor is a configuration change, not a rebuild, with cost-tier routing and automatic failover. Owns the technical call on when to run managed models (Claude and peers), when to host models inside McKinstry’s own tenant for data sovereignty or cost, and when to fine-tune or stand up an in-house or open-source model. Integrates and operates the selected platforms and partners (Anthropic, Microsoft, cloud providers) to McKinstry standards, including evaluation, support escalation, and capacity management. Commercial terms and vendor strategy sit with leadership.
Owns the enterprise AI engineering function and standards. Runs the shared production build capability that serves every spoke, and sets the engineering standards, code-quality bar, and agent build-and-evaluation methodology, so systems are built once to a known standard instead of re-solved division by division.
Owns the AI marketplace. Owns the build and operation of the enterprise agent marketplace (McKinstry Labs): the catalog of approved, tested, reusable agents, skills, and tools that divisions discover and build on, so capability compounds across the company instead of being rebuilt spoke by spoke.
Chairs the architecture and production-readiness reviews. Owns the technical gate: nothing reaches production without passing it. A fully technical authority, separate from the strategy and governance chairs.
Engineers approved work into shipped systems. Takes the prioritized scope set by the domain directors and their product managers and engineers it into production: design, build, test, deploy, and the move from prototype to production-grade system. Owns delivery commitments and timelines. Every build starts from agreed requirements with a named business owner and is validated with end users.
Builds and leads the engineering team. Recruits, develops, and directs the AI, ML, software, and platform management and engineers; allocates capacity against agreed priorities. Accountable for throughput, quality, and the cost, risk, and value of what ships from experiment through sunset.
Owns production operations and the agent lifecycle. Runs deployment, monitoring, observability, LLMOps, versioning, and lifecycle management in production, including the evaluation harness and release gates that keep systems accurate and safe.
Owns the AI technology radar. Runs structured evaluations of emerging models, tools, and platforms and sets the program’s default technical position; escalates cross-division, client-facing, or spend-bearing calls for ratification.
Engineers security and responsible-AI controls into the build. Works with Information Security to build data protection, access control, model-access governance, prompt-injection defense, and output validation into the system, so guardrails live in code, not just policy. Implements the controls that satisfy RLSC and Data Governance policy.
Builds on the enterprise data foundation, not around it. Works with the Enterprise Data & AI Architect so every system reads and writes against the Four IDs and the MDM spine, and integrates into McKinstry systems such as Procore, Dynamics, and Fabric rather than standing up disconnected stores.

What You Need To Succeed At McKinstry

15+ years in software engineering, with hands-on experience shipping and operating production systems, and enough recent depth to set the technical bar, not only manage to it.
Demonstrated experience building and operating AI or ML applications in production (LLM applications, agents, RAG, evaluation, tool and function calling, multi-agent orchestration) as the person accountable for whether the system worked.
Platform depth: has built or operated an agent harness or runtime and a provider-abstraction layer, with sound judgment on managed, self-hosted, and open-source model tradeoffs across cost, latency, and data sovereignty.
Experience managing a team of 5+ direct reports, or 10+ including matrixed contributors, owning hiring, budget, and a delivery culture that balances exploration with production commitments.
Architecture judgment: can set a reference architecture and integration patterns for a portfolio of systems and hold teams and vendors to them, while building against an enterprise data layer owned elsewhere.
Fluent in modern cloud and AI delivery engineering (for example Azure, APIs, CI/CD, LLMOps, observability), able to integrate against enterprise systems and a master-data layer rather than building disconnected stores.
Can translate product requirements and data constraints into a build plan engineers execute, and validate the result with end users.
Security-by-design discipline: builds access control, data residency, model-access governance, prompt-injection defense, and output validation into the system rather than bolting them on later.
Strong written and verbal communication: can write a technical design an engineer builds from, and report engineering status and risk to executives without rework.
Comfortable owning the build, the platform, the technical strategy, and the solution architecture without owning enterprise strategy or product, engineering the right thing on a data spine owned elsewhere.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field; relevant experience may be substituted. Cloud or security engineering credentials preferred.

PeopleFirst Benefits

Competitive pay
401(k) with employer match and profit-sharing plan

jobs.title: Director, Mechanisms Engineering - Pharmaceutical Payloads
jobs.description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

As Director, Mechanisms Engineering - Pharmaceutical Payloads at Varda, you will build and lead the team responsible for Varda's in-orbit pharmaceutical manufacturing payloads—the core of Varda's commercial business. This role combines deep technical authority with team leadership, product definition, and development execution responsibility. You will own the successful development and flight of precision electromechanical fluid-handling systems that process and crystallize pharmaceutical compounds in microgravity—then survive hypersonic reentry and return to Earth for product recovery and hardware iteration. The payloads your team designs, builds, and flies will directly determine whether in-space pharmaceutical manufacturing becomes a commercial reality.

You will build and grow a team of payload engineers responsible for individual pharmaceutical payload missions while also owning the technical definition and evolution of Varda's pharma payload product line. This includes defining the system architecture, fluid system design philosophy, and development approach, and establishing the engineering standards and processes that enable reliable execution as Varda scales in both cadence and scope.

You'll expand Varda's pharmaceutical payload capability to a scaled, repeatable product line—building the team, technical standards, and development processes to get there.

This role is ideal for a technically exceptional leader who wants to build an elite team and own the first ever industrial manufacturing capability in space from strategy through execution.

Responsibilities

Build and lead a team of payload engineers, each responsible for executing individual pharmaceutical payload missions
Mentor engineers and develop future technical and people leaders
Own the pharmaceutical payload development roadmap—expanding Varda's pharmaceutical product portfolio, driving design iteration from flight data, and scaling mission cadence
Own pharmaceutical payload engineering execution against company goals and customer contracts, including schedule, cost, and technical performance
Manage a portfolio of concurrent payload development efforts and recurring mission executions, ensuring schedule, technical performance, and engineering quality across the portfolio
Define and maintain standards for payload design, analysis, integration, testing, mission execution, documentation, and project management
Work closely with avionics, software, thermal, systems, integration, and vehicle teams to define payload interfaces and constraints
Standardize processes for environmental test campaigns, mission operations, post-flight hardware inspection, and anomaly resolution
Drive continuous improvement through lessons learned and feedback from flight programs

Basic Qualifications

BS/BEng in Mechanical, Aerospace, Biomedical, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline
10+ years of experience designing, integrating, testing, and delivering complex electromechanical hardware involving precision fluid handling
3+ years of experience leading teams through full-cycle hardware development
Experience with electromechanical fluid systems in high-reliability or extreme environments (space, life support, medical devices, semiconductor process equipment, bioprocess systems)
Breadth across at least two adjacent hardware disciplines (e.g., avionics, mechanisms, software, structures, thermal, optics, test, etc.)
Demonstrated ability to set technical direction and deliver results through other engineers
Track record managing multiple concurrent engineering development efforts
Experience establishing and enforcing technical and programmatic standards across teams
Exceptional communication ability with diverse technical and executive audiences

Preferred Skills And Experience

Professional or academic exposure to chemical engineering, biomedical engineering, or a related process engineering discipline
Experience building, scaling, or managing hardware engineering teams
Experience owning technical roadmaps or standardized hardware product offerings
Experience developing or operating hardware for pharmaceutical, bioprocess, or sterile/cleanroom manufacturing applications
Familiarity with microgravity fluid behavior, capillary-driven flows, or two-phase fluid management
Familiarity with cGMP principles or regulated hardware environments
Significant experience planning and executing environmental testing (vibration, TVAC, EMI/EMC)

Pay Range

Salary range: $200,000 - $250,000/per year
This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA
Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance
You will be eligible for incentives in the form of stock options and/or long-term cash awards

Benefits

Varda offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support health, financial well‑being, and a high‑quality workplace experience. Below is an overview of what full‑time employees receive (at this time, interns receive a subset of benefits):

jobs.title: VP of Enterprise Technology and Business Operations
jobs.description:
Overview

As the Vice President of Enterprise Technology & Business Operations, you will be an integral member of the Customer Experience and Operations (CXO) leadership team and responsible for leading enterprise technology, business applications, teammate productivity, AI enablement, and shared business services that empower teammates, simplify operations, and accelerate business outcomes across AvidXchange. This role reports to the COO. This position is responsible for the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of multiple functions supporting internal teammates and operational partners, including Service Delivery, IT Service Management, Asset Management, Enterprise Business Applications, Teammate Productivity and Collaboration Tools, Internal AI Capabilities, and Operational Vendor Management. The Vice President Enterprise Technology & Business Operations will serve as a trusted business partner across the organization and work closely with Technology, Operations, Finance, Legal, Procurement, Product, Engineering, and other business leaders to deliver reliable services, improve business processes, and drive operational efficiencies. This leader will be responsible for developing organizational strategy, establishing operational metrics, managing budgets, overseeing service delivery models, and building high-performing teams that support the evolving needs of the business. The role leads multiple leaders and oversees a blended service delivery model consisting of internal teammates, managed service partners, contractors, and strategic operational vendors.

What You'll Do

Service Delivery and IT Operations

Oversee enterprise service delivery functions, including Service Desk operations, Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and Asset Management.
Govern Key Performance Indicators and operational metrics to drive visibility, accountability, and continuous improvement across service delivery functions.
Ensure fast, accurate, and reliable delivery of technology services to teammates.
Monitor and maintain service management processes and operational disciplines to support business needs.
Provide leadership and oversight for service delivery models that leverage both internal teams and managed service partners.
Partner with functional leaders to monitor service performance, operational outcomes, and service-level expectations across internal and external delivery teams.
Evaluate opportunities to optimize service delivery models and sourcing strategies to support business needs, scalability, and operational efficiency.
Lead strategic capacity planning to support organizational growth and evolving teammate needs.
Oversee hardware, software, and technology asset lifecycle management programs.

Business Applications and Productivity Solutions

Own the enterprise applications roadmap spanning CRM, HRIS, collaboration tools, workflow platforms, and shared business systems, driving standardization, simplification, and business process transformation.
Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities to improve workflows, automate processes, and increase operational efficiency.
Drive the adoption and effectiveness of teammate productivity tools and internal technology solutions.
Oversee internal application development resources and external partners supporting business functions and operational teams.
Provide governance and strategic oversight of contractor and third-party resources supporting application delivery.
Identify and execute technology and business process improvements related to applications, systems, and implementations.
Evaluate evolving business needs and recommend delivery models that balance internal capabilities and external partnerships.

AI and Innovation

Serve as a champion for enterprise AI adoption, identifying, prioritizing, and scaling AI use cases that improve productivity, automate workflows, accelerate decision-making, and transform business operations.
Establish governance and best practices for responsible AI usage, ensuring security, compliance, transparency, and measurable business outcomes.
Partner with business leaders to embed AI capabilities into enterprise workflows, teammate experiences, and shared services functions.

Strategic Vendor & Partner Management

Provide executive leadership and strategic oversight for operational vendor management functions supporting business operations.
Ensure third-party partnerships align with business objectives, service expectations, and operational priorities.
Support the governance and performance management of strategic business process outsourcing relationships.
Serve as an executive sponsor for key operational partnerships and outsourced service providers.
Collaborate with Procurement, Legal, Finance, and business leaders regarding significant vendor agreements, renewals, and partnership strategies.
Monitor operational outcomes, service performance, and business objectives to ensure external partnerships continue to deliver value.
Evaluate emerging technologies, service delivery models, and strategic partnerships to improve agility, reduce costs, and accelerate innovation.

Leadership and Business Partnership

Build cross-functional relationships and serve as a trusted advisor across the organization.
Collaborate with leadership teams to develop long-range plans, operational strategies, and investment priorities.
Develop and manage departmental budgets, forecasts, headcount planning, and operating expenses.
Lead a portfolio of services delivered through internal teams, managed service partners, contractors, and strategic third-party providers to ensure consistent service delivery and operational outcomes.
Contribute to policy-level discussions regarding standards, processes, metrics, and organizational priorities.
Identify priorities and communicate technology and operational impacts throughout the decision-making process.
Attract, recruit, develop, and retain high-performing talent while establishing mission and purpose for individuals and teams.
Contribute to succession planning and leadership development across the organization.
Lead initiatives that create operational efficiencies, cost reductions, increased automation, enhanced service reliability, and improved teammate experiences.
Contribute to building a high-performance organization that meets or exceeds business objectives.

Success Measures / What Success Looks Like

The leader will be expected to deliver measurable outcomes across service delivery, business technology, AI adoption, and operational excellence, including:

High teammate satisfaction and productivity through reliable, intuitive technology experiences and collaboration tools.
Consistent achievement of Service Level Agreements (SLAs), operational KPIs, and service quality targets across Service Desk, ITSM, and business applications.
Increased adoption and measurable business impact from AI-enabled teammate productivity and workflow automation solutions.
Improved operational efficiency through automation, process simplification, and optimized service delivery models.
High availability, performance, and user satisfaction across enterprise business applications and productivity platforms.
Strong vendor and partner performance, with clear accountability for service quality, value realization, and business outcomes.
Effective technology cost management, asset lifecycle governance, and scalable operating models that support business growth.
Improved teammate experience and reduced friction across onboarding, workplace technology, collaboration tools, and end-user support.

What We're Looking For

University degree or equivalent experience and minimum 15 years of relevant experience.
Proven executive leadership experience leading enterprise technology, business applications, shared services, or business technology organizations in high-growth environments.
Demonstrated success leading digital transformation, automation, AI adoption, or enterprise modernization initiatives.
Proven experience leading service delivery, technology operations, business applications, shared services, and/or related functions.
Experience overseeing service delivery models that utilize a combination of internal teams, managed services, contractors, and external partners.
Demonstrated experience providing executive oversight of strategic vendor relationships and outsourced service providers.
Experience developing operational strategies, policies, processes, and performance metrics.
Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, and resource planning.
Proven ability to communicate, partner, and influence across a matrix organization.
Experience building positive relationships with internal and external customers.
Strong leadership and organizational management skills.
Analytical mindset with the ability to develop and utilize operational metrics and performance indicators.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated ability to manage both virtual and direct teams.

Preferred Experience, Qualifications, And Skills

Experience within high-growth, B2B, financial technology, or technology-enabled services organizations.
Experience leading enterprise applications, digital workplace technologies, or productivity platforms.
Knowledge of IT service management principles and practices.
Experience leading organizational transformation and change initiatives.

AvidXchange is a leading provider of accounts payable (“AP”) automation software and payment solutions for middle-market businesses and their suppliers. Who You Are

Someone who understands that business is people centric. Connecting with others as humans first allows you to develop mutually beneficial working relationships.
Focused on making a difference for our customers. AvidXchange exists to help solve complex problems for our customers so we can all realize our potential.

What You’ll Get

AvidXchange teammates (we call them AvidXers) get the perks and prestige of a growing tech company paired with the flexibility of a founder-led startup. jobs.title: Director, Analytics Engineering
jobs.description:
Overview

Spotter empowers the world's best Creators with capital, data, and insights to scale their programming into sustainable media businesses. Through these partnerships, Spotter helps brands partner with creator-led franchises to unlock growth, amplify impact, and build lasting cultural relevance.

Spotter has already deployed over $1 billion
to YouTube Creators to reinvest in themselves and accelerate their growth. With a premium catalog that spans over 725,000 videos

What You’ll Do

As a Director, Analytics Engineering
at Spotter, you will lead efforts to deliver cutting-edge analytics engineering solutions that empower data-driven decision-making across the organization. You will play a key role in shaping the analytics engineering strategy, and driving innovation to ensure the organization maintains a competitive edge. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams, provide technical guidance and mentorship across the team, and establish best practices for Analytics Engineering.

Responsibilities

Partner with data engineers to ensure smooth, efficient, resilient, and agile knowledge delivery pipelines.
Interface with other business units to understand analytical needs and deliver datasets/tools in response.
Identify and capitalize on opportunities to improve ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, increasing scalability, security, extensibility, efficiency, and alignment with organizational goals.
Collaborate closely with data scientists, business analysts, and senior stakeholders to define analytics requirements and deliver innovative technical solutions that drive business outcomes.
Collect, organize, structure and profile data to build Analytics Ready Datasets for discovery of meaningful insights.

Work with massive amounts of digital data (Web, App, API) and sophisticated tools in an industry leading Big Data environment.
Quickly learn technical topics and communicate limitations when encountered.
Navigate ambiguous situations with momentum necessary to overcome uncertainty.

Who You Are

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Engineering, Computer Science, Analytics, Applied Math, Statistics, or Business Analytics; advanced degrees are highly preferred.
7+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related field.
Expertise in designing and maintaining scalable data pipelines and advanced ETL processes, with proficiency in relevant tools and technologies including Python, SQL, DBT, and at least one popular data warehousing platform (e.g. Redshift, BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, etc)
Strong technical background in data instrumentation, data QA, and maintaining data accuracy across complex environments.
Proven track record of developing and implementing automated reporting solutions and visualization tools, leveraging platforms such as TIBCO Spotfire and Power BI.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders at all levels, translating business needs into technical solutions.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity and provide strategic direction for analytics initiatives.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with experience guiding team members to success.

Note: Due to the proliferation of similarly capable business products today, skills in equivalent products are acceptable

Preferred

Knowledge of the YouTube or Content Creator industry

Personal Attributes

Strategic thinker with a proactive and forward-looking approach to analytics challenges and opportunities.
Detail-oriented and process-driven, with a passion for driving data accuracy and operational excellence.
Collaborative teamwork and knowledge sharing across diverse teams.
Resilient and adaptable in fast-paced, evolving environments, demonstrating agility in responding to shifting priorities.
Self-motivated and independent, capable of managing complex projects with minimal supervision while delivering high-quality outcomes.
Committed to continuous learning and staying ahead of industry advancements to bring innovative ideas to the organization.

Why Spotter

Medical insurance covered up to 100%
Dental & vision insurance
401(k) matching
Stock options
Discretionary PTO
Complimentary gym access
Autonomy and upward mobility
Diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture, where your voice matters.

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Networking is the foundation that enables customers to run mission-critical workloads at global cloud scale.

We're rearchitecting OCI's physical network control and management systems from the ground up to support the next generation of networking services. This is a unique opportunity to influence the architecture of one of the world's largest cloud networking platforms. We're looking for experienced leaders with proven record of building and operating large-scale distributed systems, deep understanding of distributed orchestration services, and a passion for growing high-performant teams to join our leadership team.

Lead and develop software engineering teams through engineering managers and technical leads.
Drive execution of technical and organizational priorities, ensuring delivery of reliable, scalable, and operable services.
Partner with teams across OCI Networking to design and deliver large-scale cloud infrastructure.
Establish strong engineering practices and operational excellence for production distributed systems.
Deliver complex projects on time with high quality while effectively managing dependencies, risks, and priorities.
Develop engineering leaders and create an environment that supports technical excellence, collaboration, and growth.

You should value simplicity and scale, thrive in a collaborative environment, and enjoy solving challenging distributed systems and cloud networking problems.

Basic Qualifications

8+ years of experience leading engineering teams building and operating highly available, production-grade distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.
Experience managing engineering managers and/or senior technical leaders.
Strong understanding of distributed systems and software architecture.
Familiarity with networking fundamentals and configuration management is highly desirable.
Experience with modern software development and deployment practices, including CI/CD pipelines, release automation, and large-scale deployment workflows.
Demonstrated ability to deliver complex engineering initiatives and collaborate effectively across organizational boundaries.
BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is continuing its rapid expansion across parts of North America, delivering next-generation cloud infrastructure to support enterprise and AI-driven workloads. As our cloud footprint continues to grow, we are seeking an accomplished executive to lead Cloud Hardware Support (CHS) across parts of North America.

This Senior Director will provide strategic and operational leadership for a rapidly growing regional organization, with responsibility spanning Build & Deployment, steady-state operations, hardware maintenance, and break-fix support across Oracle's cloud infrastructure.

The successful candidate will establish a scalable operating model that enables rapid regional expansion while maintaining operational excellence, customer service, and workforce effectiveness. This leader will build high-performing teams, standardize operations across multiple countries, and drive continuous improvement through automation, AI, process engineering, and operational innovation.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of Oracle's cloud operations across one of its fastest-growing regions.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

We are seeking a dynamic and visionary executive with a proven track record of leading hyperscale infrastructure organizations through periods of rapid growth and transformation. This leader will be responsible for scaling Cloud Hardware Support operations across parts of North America while ensuring the organization remains operationally efficient, customer-focused, and ready to support Oracle's continued cloud expansion.

Additional responsibilities include:

Provide executive leadership for Cloud Hardware Support operations across parts of North America, including Build & Deployment, production readiness, hardware lifecycle management, and break-fix operations.
Develop and execute a scalable regional operating model capable of supporting continued hyperscale growth across multiple countries.
Lead a large, geographically dispersed organization that is expected to grow significantly as Oracle expands its cloud footprint throughout the region.
Drive operational excellence by standardizing deployment methodologies, improving service delivery, and implementing best practices across all regional operations.
Champion the use of AI, automation, process engineering, and data-driven decision making to improve productivity, increase operational efficiency, and reduce the dependency between infrastructure growth and headcount expansion.
Build and develop high-performing leadership teams while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Partner closely with Engineering, Networking, Software Development, Product, Supply Chain, Data Center Engineering, and other cross-functional organizations to ensure successful delivery of new cloud regions and ongoing operational excellence.
Establish strong contractor, partner, and vendor relationships to support regional deployment and operational readiness.
Ensure customer commitments and operational service levels are consistently achieved while proactively managing operational risk.
Act as the senior Cloud Hardware Support leader across parts of North America, influencing strategic priorities and representing the organization with executive stakeholders across Oracle.

Preferred Skills And Experience

Executive leadership experience within hyperscale cloud infrastructure, cloud operations, hardware support, data center operations, or infrastructure engineering.
Proven experience leading large, geographically distributed organizations across multiple countries and cultures.
Demonstrated success scaling operations within rapidly growing cloud or technology organizations.
Strong understanding of hyperscale data center operations, infrastructure deployment, hardware lifecycle management, and operational support.
Proven track record of driving operational transformation through AI, automation, intelligent tooling, process engineering, and scalable operating models.
Experience leveraging emerging AI capabilities and operational analytics to improve workforce productivity, operational performance, and service quality.
Exceptional strategic thinking, organizational leadership, and execution capabilities.
Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior stakeholders across engineering, infrastructure, product, and business organizations.
Experience building high-performing leadership teams and developing organizational capability through periods of significant growth.
Demonstrated ability to manage complex regional operations while balancing customer requirements, operational excellence, and business priorities.

Leadership Competencies

Performance, drive, and execution—Holds self and others accountable for delivering shareholder value. Creates and instills a performance driven, results-orientation culture based on data and facts. Takes full accountability for the achievement of organizational results. Delivers audience-appropriate messages about financial performance and future expectations.
Collaboration—Fosters collaboration between business leaders. Facilitates consensus among diverse stakeholders with opposing viewpoints on critical issues. Drives a diverse and inclusive culture throughout the organization. Instills a sense of common purpose, joint mission, and mutual responsibility to create and support business outcomes. Aligns strategic priorities of own area with the direction and priorities of the broader organization.
Communicating for impact—Ensures clarity around organization's strategic intent and business objectives. Champions strategic initiatives in ways that generate organization-wide understanding and support. Builds confidence and inspires support through a convincing presentation style.
Inspirational leadership—Establishes and models authentic leadership across internal and external boundaries. Builds internal and external reputation as a strategic business leader. Inspires and empowers others toward achievement of goals and strategies. Employs and develops the right talent at every level.
Competitive edge—Predicts changes in customer expectations; takes advantage of opportunities to shape and re-shape market propositions. Builds long-term business value. Creates a culture of innovation and encourages entrepreneurship. Strategically develops a range of options/paths to achieve business objectives within a changing environment.
Change agility—Initiates strategic change initiatives in anticipation of a changing external environment. Champions organizational change initiatives in a way that helps people understand, appreciate, and support them. Guides the organization to remain flexible in a changing, competitive environment. Fosters creativity, measured risk-taking actions, and entrepreneurial thinking in others
Mastering complexity—Makes decisions about the long-term strategy to sustainably grow the business. Creates an environment that shapes and supports cross-functional analysis of problems and decision-making. Actively supports the resolution of ambiguous, complex problems that cross organizational boundaries. Creates an environment of personal accountability and ownership for problem-solving.

Education

A Bachelors’ degree is preferred. An advanced degree is a plus.

jobs.title: Sr Director of Design, Firefly
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Adobe Design is looking for an AI native, product-minded design leader to join our Adobe Design team to lead design for Firefly. This role will define the future of AI-powered creativity for creatives and creators.

Firefly operates in one of the most dynamic and competitive spaces in technology. New generative AI capabilities reach market daily. Our differentiation comes from being commercially safe, agnostic of models and deeply integrated, workflow-level experiences that make AI genuinely useful inside the tools that creatives and creators rely on.

This is not a role for someone who leads from behind the team. We are looking for a builder who leads builders - a hands-on strategic leader who combines product intuition, design craft, competitive fluency, and growth accountability to move Firefly’s experience forward with speed and conviction. You will own experience outcomes, not just design outputs.

This is a unique opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, 0-to-1 product environment and is energized by the challenge of shipping AI-native products at scale - pushing the boundaries of what’s possible while delivering measurable business impact.

Who you are

You are an experienced leader with a track record of building and shipping AI-native consumer grade products, preferably catering to creative markets. Your lead product thinking from the design seat. You bring a strong point of view to every room you enter, grounded in deep understanding of user behavior, competitive dynamics, and understand business mechanics. You know how to translate business goals into design strategy and design strategy into shipped products. You know how to influence business goals that you don’t own.

You are a steadying force in ambiguity. When market dynamics shifts and priorities evolve, you can contextualize this for the organization so your team stays focused and energized. You earn trust across functions through the quality of your judgment, showing prototypes of ideas that work, and follow-through on commitments.

You are driven by action and results. You take full ownership of your responsibilities and embody an entrepreneurial spirit that learns from failure and moves forward.

In this role, you will:

Own Product Experience Outcomes

Define and drive design strategy for Firefly tightly coupled to MAU growth, retention, and competitive differentiation - not as abstract vision, but as prioritized, actionable design initiatives with measurable goals.
Bring a clear, defensible point of view on which problems to solve, how to differentiate at the workflow level (Home, Boards, Mobile, Studio), and how design decisions map to business levers.
Drive fast, data-informed decision-making with clear experimentation loops. Balance intuition-led patterns with a test-and-learn approach grounded in user data, competitive analysis, and growth metrics.

Elevate Craft and Velocity Simultaneously

Personally lead regular design reviews that raise the quality bar across Firefly surfaces. Own workflow cohesion and proactively address UI debt. Even better institute organizational practices that allow us to get ahead of creating UI debt.
Increase execution speed by making decisions in the room, unblocking teams quickly, and creating clear pathways forward rather than surfacing blockers without solutions.
Guide non-designer builders (PMs, engineers experimenting with AI-generated UI) to shape their explorations into coherent, high-quality user experiences.

Drive Cross-Functional Alignment Through Influence

Show up as a decisive, strategic thought partner with Product Management, Engineering, Data Science, and Research leaders. Lead alignment conversations—don’t delegate them or defer to resourcing discussions.
Work with other design leaders who are responsible for Firefly’s agentic experiences and others who are contributing to the Firefly charter through dotted line relationships.
Build tighter cross-functional rhythms that result in faster decision-making and clearer accountability. When decisions are made in leadership forums, reliably communicate and cascade them to the design team.
Navigate Adobe’s matrixed organization with agility, working across multiple teams, functions, and structures to drive incremental, decisive progress.
Present frequently to SVPs, VPs, Senior Directors, and executive teams. Bring exceptional executive presence to influence senior stakeholders and C-staff through compelling storytelling and evidence-based design rationale.

Build and Develop World-Class Talent

Hire, grow, and retain exceptional designers. Develop team members who think in terms of growth, competitive differentiation, and data in addition to their existing superpower of design craft.
Lead with purpose: help designers overcome complex challenges, set career goals, and develop the product leadership muscles the team needs at this stage of Firefly’s maturity.
Foster an inclusive, empowering environment where feedback flows openly, ambiguity creates way to clarity, and the team stays focused on delivering impact.

Maintain Continuous Competitive Fluency

Operate with continuous competitive awareness—not episodic updates from PM. Know the landscape deeply enough to identify workflow-level differentiation opportunities and articulate them to the team and cross-functional partners.
Stay hands-on with emerging AI tools, methods, and processes. Champion and scale the use of AI-assisted design and coding tools within the team to accelerate output and experimentation.

What you need to succeed

Leadership: Proven experience leading and managing design teams at the Senior Director level or above, including managing multiple levels of managers. You inspire teams to act on behalf of better user and business outcomes.
Product Orientation: Demonstrated history of driving product experience strategy, interaction design, and craft for v1 or early-stage products. You’ve owned experience outcomes (activation, adoption, engagement, retention) - not just design deliverables that support these goals.
AI-Native Fluency: Deep, hands-on experience building AI-native or generative AI product experiences. You understand the design patterns, constraints, and opportunities unique to AI-powered workflows. This is not a nice-to-have for the AI product you would be leading.
Cross-Functional Influence: Ability to collaborate with and influence multiple SVPs, VPs, and Senior Directors. Exceptional executive presence and storytelling skills. You lead alignment as you see gaps.
Organizational Agility: Proven ability to navigate highly matrixed organizations, working across multiple teams, functions, and structures with decisiveness and clarity.
Craft Excellence: Superb visual and interaction design sensibility. Extensive knowledge of user-centered design principles, information architecture, and UX/UI methodologies. You actively raise the bar, not just set it.
Communication: Excellent written, oral, presentation, and storytelling skills. Ability to sell design strategy through to senior leadership and drive alignment through compelling narratives and evidence.
Steady Leadership: Demonstrated ability to provide calm, focused direction during periods of ambiguity and organizational change. You filter complexity for your team rather than amplifying it.

About Adobe Design

Adobe Design is the multidisciplinary, global organization behind Adobe experiences. Our full-stack team includes design researchers, design engineers, experience designers, brand designers, content strategists, and program managers dedicated to delivering exceptional experiences for Adobe users.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com.

AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:

jobs.title: Director of Data
jobs.description:
About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

We are looking for a Director of Data to own our data strategy and platform as we scale toward software-defined vehicles.

This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll set technical direction and stay close to the architecture and code, while building and managing a high-performing team responsible for high-volume, high-velocity vehicle and enterprise data.

You'll bring both the technical depth to make sound platform decisions and the people leadership to grow and run a team operating at scale.

We're hiring for this role in Palo Alto, Irvine, or Vancouver. We are happy to work with whichever location suits you best.

Responsibilities

Define and drive the data strategy and roadmap across vehicle telemetry, manufacturing, and enterprise data domains, aligning with engineering, product, and business stakeholders.
Own architecture decisions for large-scale data platforms (ingestion, storage, processing, and serving layers) handling high-volume streaming and batch data.
Stay hands-on: review designs and code, dive into pipeline or performance issues, and set technical standards by example, not just by policy.
Recruit, manage, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers and analytics professionals; own hiring plans, performance management, and career development.
Partner with quality, manufacturing, product, and software engineering teams to ensure data infrastructure supports reliability, safety, and product analytics needs.
Establish data governance, quality, and security standards across pipelines and platforms, ensuring compliance with relevant regulatory and privacy requirements.
Build and maintain stakeholder-facing reporting on platform health, data quality, and delivery against roadmap commitments.
Evaluate and integrate modern tooling (e.g., Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud data warehouses, AI/LLM-assisted engineering tools) to keep the platform and team ahead of scale demands.
Manage budget, vendor, and tooling decisions for the data organization.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

8–10 years of overall industry experience in data engineering or analytics, including 3+ years managing high-volume data engineering or analytics teams.
Demonstrated hands-on technical depth in building and operating large-scale data systems, proficiency in SQL and Python required, along with hands-on experience with Databricks required (additional experience with Spark or equivalent distributed data platforms a plus).
Track record of designing and scaling data architecture (ingestion, ETL/ELT, streaming, and storage) for high-volume, high-velocity data.
Experience hiring, developing, and retaining data engineering talent, with a demonstrated ability to balance IC-level technical involvement with people leadership.
Strong cross-functional partnership skills and being comfortable working with engineering, product, quality, and manufacturing stakeholders to translate business needs into data infrastructure.
Experience establishing data governance, quality, and security practices at an organizational level.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline; advanced degree a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in automotive, mobility, IoT, or another industry with high-volume sensor/telemetry data.
Experience integrating or prompting AI/LLM tools into engineering workflows.
Familiarity with dashboard/BI tooling (HEX, Tableau, Power BI, or similar) for stakeholder reporting.

We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program.

Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War and its allies’ core mission priorities, and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.

In this role, you will oversee the operational and people‑management foundation of a functional engineering group. You will consolidate labor demand across programs, manage daily resource allocation, and support programs in defining scoped, staffable engineering work. You will partner closely with technical experts to deliver engineering standards and training while guiding the development, performance, and career progression of the group’s engineering staff.

Schedule

This role follows a 9/80 schedule, with 9-hour shifts Monday through Thursday, an 8-hour shift every other Friday, and the alternating Friday off.

Responsibilities

Consolidates labor‑demand signals across programs into a unified view of committed, requested, and open needs.
Coordinates daily allocation of functional engineering resources to balance workload and support individual career growth.
Manages traffic control for resource requests by sequencing needs, staging work, and flagging conflicts early.
Tracks allocation and effort against work orders to identify and address over‑ or under‑utilization.
Oversees logistics for standards dissemination and training, including scheduling, completion tracking, and maintaining training pipelines.
Partners with technical experts to ensure engineering standards and training content are built, maintained, and delivered effectively.
Maintains qualification ladders and monitors progression toward independent qualification for new hires and transfers.
Helps programs break down engineering tasks into clearly scoped, staffable work packages with realistic schedule and effort expectations.
Identifies required skill sets for tasking and routes ambiguous or contested technical requests to the appropriate expert.
Leads people‑management activities including goal‑setting, performance reviews, coaching, career pathing, and administrative duties such as timekeeping, approvals, onboarding, and HR coordination.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor of Science (B.S.) in Engineering.
8 or more years of engineering leadership experience, including at least 2 years in aerospace and/or engineering.
Demonstrated experience in resource planning, scheduling, and managing technical staff.
Ability to manage data‑driven scheduling and cadence across multiple concurrent programs.
Demonstrated commitment to staff development and ability to balance program needs with individual growth.
Ability to collaborate as a peer with technical experts and appropriately route technical decisions.
Experience helping programs translate ambiguous engineering requests into scoped, staffable work packages.

Discipline‑specific technical depth in a relevant engineering domain.

Company‑paid life and AD&D insurance
Short‑ and long‑term disability coverage
Tuition reimbursement

As the first engineering leader in our Arlington office, you’ll have the opportunity to set the engineering culture and future hires at Remitly. You'll build with AI in the loop every day, as we become AI native at Remitly, while holding the correctness and trust bar a regulated money product demands. You will report to the Director of Engineering and work in a hybrid capacity from our Arlington, VA office.

You Will:

Provide technical leadership and lead complex, long-term, cross-team engineering effort and drive engineering strategy for the squads while solving the hardest technical challenges.
Partner with product and design stakeholders to prioritize the roadmap and translate strategic ambitions into actionable OKRs.
Be responsible for execution, including quarterly goals, resource allocation, and prioritization.
Hire and grow the engineering team, recruiting and onboarding experienced engineers.
Champion safe, effective adoption of AI/agentic coding tools to boost team productivity and product velocity.
Be a role model in upholding Remitly's cultural values and use them as a framework to mentor other engineers across the company to achieve their full potential.
Partner with leadership to influence and drive organizational design, contribution and prioritization.
Represent the team in cross-functional planning with Product, Design, Analytics, and partner engineering teams

You Have:

You have a BS (accepted) or MS (Preferred) in Computer Science or equivalent professional experience.
5+ years of software engineering experience, including hands-on technical management building full-stack software solution, API design, and interactions between servers and clients.
5+ years of recent experience hiring and managing technical teams, including performance management.
Expertise in at least one backend or full-stack programming language (e.g., Go, Kotlin, Java, TypeScript), with the ability to adapt to new languages/frameworks as needed.
Experience designing secure, scalable, performant software using cloud-based infrastructure (e.g., AWS).
Demonstrated aptitude and judgment for applying AI to developer productivity and, ideally, product features — including enabling safe AI tool adoption on the team.
