About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About The Role

Rippling is looking for a Senior Engineering Manager (M8) to lead the transformation of Payments Experience, owning the layer that powers how employers, employees, and contractors move money.

You will define a new standard for how people interact with money at Rippling. You will build experiences that are performant, intuitive, and AI-first,

abstracting away the complexity of payments while giving users clear answers, proactive guidance, and simple paths to resolution when things go wrong.

This team sits at the center of one of Rippling’s most critical workflows, bridging payroll logic and the underlying payment processing systems to ensure money moves accurately, reliably, and at scale. Your mandate will go beyond building experiences for individual products: you will platformize payments into reusable capabilities that can power any fintech product at Rippling, creating common primitives, workflows, and abstractions that allow teams to build and launch new financial products faster, while increasingly bringing existing product payment experiences onto this shared platform and owning that experience end-to-end over time.

This is a highly cross-functional role partnering closely with Money Movement, Tax, Contractor, and Global Payroll teams. You will own the full-stack experience for employers and their employees and contractors, while driving innovation in new product areas like contractor wallets and modern payout methods.

This is a unique opportunity to be the first leader fully owning Payments Experience at Rippling, shaping the strategy, architecture, organization, and product direction for a critical and rapidly growing domain.

What You Will Do

Own the Payments experience: Lead the systems and product layer that define how money moves through execution readiness, status, recovery, and user-facing resolution.
Build AI-first experiences: Use AI to make payments more proactive and understandable—surfacing anomalies, explaining payment outcomes, anticipating issues, answering questions, and helping users resolve problems without needing to understand the underlying complexity.
Platformize and unify payments experience across Rippling: Build reusable payment capabilities, APIs, workflows, and abstractions that can be leveraged across Rippling’s fintech products, enabling teams to launch new financial products faster while gradually bringing existing, product-specific payment experiences onto a common platform and taking increasing end-to-end ownership of the unified experience over time.
Shape long-term strategy: Define the roadmap for Payments Experience and the broader payments platform, with the opportunity to expand ownership into additional product-layer payment experiences across Rippling.
Define the product/platform boundary: Establish the architecture and operating model that separates shared payment capabilities from product-specific logic, enabling teams across Rippling to build new financial products quickly and consistently.
Build a world-class payments experience: Create fast, intuitive, and easy-to-understand experiences that abstract away payment complexity while maintaining high standards for latency, reliability, resilience, and global-scale performance.
Build the future of contractor payments: Own the “Balance” (wallet) product, enabling contractors to receive and manage earnings across multiple clients with modern withdrawal methods like crypto, instant transfer payment methods and more in the future.
Operate at global scale: Work with globally distributed engineering and non-engineering teams and ensure reliability across high-volume payment systems, with a strong focus on operational excellence, observability, fault tolerance, and recovery

What You Will Need

AI product mindset: Curiosity and experience applying AI to improve product experiences, automate workflows, surface insights, or make complex systems easier for users to understand and navigate.
Proven engineering leadership: Experience leading organizations of 10+ engineers, including senior and staff-level engineers, in high-scale distributed systems environments.
Platform-building mindset: Experience building shared platforms, APIs, or foundational capabilities that enable multiple product teams to move faster and avoid duplicated infrastructure.
Strong product sense: Ability to balance technical excellence with user experience and business outcomes, particularly in product-heavy engineering organizations.
Architectural leadership: Demonstrated ability to define and evolve the architecture of complex, highly available systems while making pragmatic tradeoffs between platform investment and near-term product velocity.
Experience building great experiences: A track record of turning complex workflows into simple, intuitive, and performant product experiences.
Operational rigor: High bar for reliability, correctness, observability, and system resilience—especially in critical financial or transactional systems.
Experience with mission-critical systems: Background in payments, fintech, payroll, banking, or similarly complex domains is preferred but not required.
Cross-functional leadership: Track record of partnering effectively with Product, Design, and other engineering teams to define and deliver end-to-end systems.
Global collaboration: Comfortable leading distributed teams and navigating complex workflows across time zones and geographies.
Strong communication and ownership: Ability to operate with autonomy, create clarity in ambiguous spaces, influence senior stakeholders, and set direction for a large technical domain.

jobs.title: Sr. Engineering Manager, Web Experience
jobs.description:
About The Team/Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Engineering Manager to lead the Mobility Web Experience Engineering organization responsible for delivering high-quality web applications and experiences that serve thousands of mobility customer interactions. You will lead an engineering team, build a strong engineering culture, and partner closely with Product, Design, Architecture, Security, and Infrastructure teams to deliver exceptional web experiences.

This role requires a leader who is passionate about developing people, driving engineering excellence, and executing large-scale initiatives while balancing speed, quality, and operational reliability.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Define, own, and execute the long-term engineering strategy for the WEX Mobility Web Experience, including card and vehicle management, mobility payments, and future web platform capabilities.
Partner with architects and technical leaders to define the technical vision and architecture for the web platform.
Develop and maintain the engineering roadmap, ensuring alignment with business priorities and industry best practices.
Foster a culture of innovation, continuous learning, collaboration, ownership, and operational excellence.
Continuously improve engineering processes to increase delivery velocity, quality, and developer productivity.
Lead complex cross-functional engineering initiatives from planning through execution, driving alignment across teams and stakeholders.
Partner closely with Product, UX, and business leaders to prioritize investments and deliver customer-centric web experiences.
Establish and monitor engineering metrics that improve delivery predictability, quality, reliability, and team effectiveness.
Drive effective planning, execution, and continuous improvement through regular operating mechanisms, including sprint planning, roadmap reviews, and operational reviews.
Partner with Product and business leaders to maintain a healthy roadmap and define measurable objectives and key results (OKRs).
Collaborate across Mobility engineering teams to promote reusable platforms, shared components, and engineering best practices.
Hire, develop, mentor, and retain high-performing engineering managers and software engineers.
Provide regular coaching, performance feedback, and career development to help team members reach their full potential.
Manage team capacity and staffing to ensure successful delivery of strategic priorities.
Communicate engineering strategy, progress, risks, and opportunities effectively to senior leadership and cross-functional partners.

Experience You'll Bring

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years of software engineering experience.
4+ years of engineering management experience leading software engineering teams.
Experience leading the development and delivery of modern, scalable web applications using frameworks such as Angular or React, and micro-frontend (MFE) architectures.
Strong understanding of modern web architectures, including single-page applications and micro-frontend patterns, application lifecycle management, and software engineering best practices.
Strong communication, organizational, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills.
Solid understanding of security, privacy, authentication, authorization, and data protection principles for web applications.
Experience leveraging automation, AI-assisted development tools, and engineering productivity practices to improve quality and delivery velocity.
Strong people leadership skills, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development for web engineering teams.
Ability to thrive in ambiguous environments, make thoughtful trade-offs, and lead teams through organizational and technical change.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience using analytics and customer insights to inform product and engineering decisions and improve user experiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Angular, React, or other modern web development technologies, as well as experience with Micro-frontend (MFE) architectures.
Experience building shared web platforms, component libraries, reusable frameworks, or design systems.
Experience building high-performance distributed systems at internet-scale companies.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, release automation, feature flag platforms, and web performance monitoring and observability.
Experience developing payment, fleet, financial technology (FinTech), or commercial card solutions.
Experience integrating with payment networks or card schemes.
Experience working with closed-loop or proprietary payment systems.

The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Non-sales roles are typically eligible for a quarterly or annual bonus based on their role and applicable plan. WEX's comprehensive and market competitive benefits are designed to support your personal and professional well-being. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurances, retirement savings plan, paid time off, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, and more. For more information, check out the "About Us" section.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Sales Engineering - US Central
jobs.description:
As a Director, Enterprise Sales Engineering, you will lead a team of frontline leaders, driving account strategy, deal execution, operational excellence, and team development across your region.

This is a strategic leadership role with regional impact within North America. You will act as a force multiplier by owning team and region performance, shaping execution standards, and partnering closely with Sales leadership to influence go to market strategy, improve outcomes, and scale impact beyond individual deals.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

Own in-field execution at a regional level by taking an executive presence role in strategic and high-impact opportunities and providing senior-level stakeholder alignment and technical credibility alongside your team.
Develop and operationalize a repeatable formula and methodology that can scale across a large customer base, enabling Datadog to accelerate enterprise growth by illustrating to customers how Datadog’s observability and security solutions quickly, simply, and efficiently deliver measurable business outcomes especially in a world increasingly dominated by Agentic AI.
Partner confidently with senior Sales leadership on regional strategy, multi-quarter planning, annual capacity planning, and forecast alignment operating 2-3 quarters ahead to anticipate resourcing needs and business priorities.
Oversee consistent, high-quality delivery across technical sales cycles in the region, including evaluations, customer engagements, and deal progression.
Lead, coach, and develop a team of Sales Engineering leaders, driving performance, engagement, and long-term career growth through regular feedback and structured development.
Hire and onboard top talent across ICs and manager-level roles, building a high-performing team and accelerating customer adoption through structured onboarding and enablement.
Manage regional operations including resource allocation, utilization, KPI tracking, productivity, and skills development to ensure effective coverage across the territory.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Marketing, Enablement, and Support at a senior level to align on regional strategy, GTM execution, and customer experience.
Drive operational excellence across the region by improving processes, maintaining data quality, scaling evaluation frameworks, and contributing to initiatives that improve team effectiveness and business impact.
Track competitive developments, market dynamics, and emerging technologies to ensure the team is equipped to position Datadog as a leader in cloud security.

Who You Are:

5+ years of experience leading frontline SE leaders in a customer-facing technical organization with proven ability to manage team performance, develop team members, and scale high-performing teams.
10+ years of experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a technical customer-facing role.
Demonstrated success leading solution engineering teams with senior stakeholders across Product, SRE, DevOps, and Engineering teams.
Is naturally proactive, constantly introducing new ideas and finding better and more efficient ways to help SEs deliver better outcomes for our customers.
Ability to operate at both strategic and operational levels, balancing multi-quarter planning with day to day team execution and priorities.
Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams and navigate complex joint selling motions, particularly with partners and channel organizations.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with both internal teams and customer executives.
Expert storytelling capabilities, with a strong ability to explain complex security concepts into everyday language that both technical and business audiences can understand.
Passion for building scalable processes and fostering a collaborative, inclusive team culture.
Track record of driving technical sales success at scale.
Exceptional leadership, coaching, and team-building capabilities, with experience scaling high-impact teams.
Background in public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), Kubernetes, APM/tracing, security, developer experience, observability or adjacent SaaS technology.
Deep understanding of sales methodologies such as MEDDICC, Command of Message (CoM), or similar frameworks.
Demonstrated capability of utilizing AI tooling and scaling it.
Willingness to travel as needed to support customer engagements or internal meetings.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth:

Best-in-breed onboarding
Generous global benefits
Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking
New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
An inclusive company culture, able to join our Community Guilds and Inclusion Talks

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

$180,000—$240,000 USD

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. jobs.title: Senior Director, Software Engineering
jobs.description:
At Collective Health, we’re transforming how employers and their people engage with their health benefits by seamlessly integrating cutting-edge technology, compassionate service, and world-class user experience design.
Role Overview Collective Health is transforming healthcare for millions who use our platform to understand, navigate, and pay for care. The Member Experience Engineering team builds every interface a member or Member Advocate interacts with: our web and mobile apps, plus the tools and AI powering our contact center.
We are hiring a Senior
  Director of Member Experience Engineering
to lead this organization. You will own the engineering strategy and execution across three connected domains:
Member digital experience

— the member web portal and mobile apps, including care navigation, secure messaging, benefits and claims views, and the notification systems that keep members informed.
Member Advocate tooling

— the internal application suite our advocates use to serve members, plus the platforms that make advocates faster and more accurate.
Contact center experience (our biggest opportunity)

— the AI, automation, and platform work that reduces call volume, deflects and resolves inquiries earlier, and makes every advocate interaction better. This includes our Contact-Center-as-a-Service (CCaaS) platform, Agent Assist, virtual assistants, IVR automation, and conversational analytics.

The main focus of the role is using AI to lower the cost and raise the quality of member support
— deflecting avoidable contacts, resolving inquiries in self-service, and giving advocates real-time, accurate answers when a human is the right channel.
What you'll do Set the strategy

for member experience engineering across web, mobile, advocate tooling, and the contact center — and translate it into a roadmap tied to measurable business outcomes (cost-to-serve, contact reduction, member and advocate satisfaction).
Lead the AI agenda for the contact center.

Drive the roadmap for Agent Assist , Smart Search, virtual assistants, IVR automation, and contact-deflection features. Push for real, defensible reductions in call demand and average handle time — not demos.
Own the call-center technology platform

, including our CCaaS migration and the integrations that connect telephony, chat, and digital channels into one member journey.
Own conversational and contact analytics

— topic tagging, quality monitoring at scale, and the reporting that tells us what members are calling about and which contacts we can prevent. Ensure this data actually steers the roadmap.
Deliver the member-facing digital experience

on web and mobile, meeting client and regulatory commitments (access controls, dependent access, SSO, privacy) on committed timelines.
Own the advocate tooling suite

— the internal applications that determine how efficiently and accurately advocates serve members.
Partner deeply

with our Customer Experience, Product and Design teams to build quality products for our members and member advocates
Build and grow the team

— hire, mentor, and develop engineering managers and senior engineers; set the bar for technical quality, security, and reliability in a HIPAA-regulated, PHI-handling environment.
Report up and out.

Communicate strategy, trade-offs, and results to executive leadership and represent engineering in cross-functional and client-facing forums.

To be successful in this role, you'll need: 15+ years

in software engineering with 5+ years leading engineering teams
, including managing managers.
Proven ownership of large-scale, member- or customer-facing web and mobile products
.
Contact center / customer support technology experience

— hands-on familiarity with CCaaS platforms, telephony/IVR, agent-assist tooling, and support-operations metrics (contact volume, deflection rate, average handle time, first-contact resolution, cost-to-serve, quality/CSAT).
Applied AI/ML fluency

, especially using LLMs / GenAI to reduce support demand: knowledge of Retrieval-Augmentented Generation (RAG), intent detection, conversational analytics, and automated quality monitoring. You know how to evaluate accuracy, manage hallucination risk, and measure whether an AI investment actually moved the metric.
Strong track record turning operational metrics into an engineering roadmap
and defending trade-offs to executives.
Excellent cross-functional leadership
across product, operations, design, data/insights, and external vendors.
Comfort operating in a regulated, data-sensitive domain
(healthcare/HIPAA a strong plus) where security and privacy are non-negotiable.

Nice to have:
Healthcare, health-benefits, insurance, or other regulated-industry experience.
Experience running a vendor selection and migration
for a major contact-center or AI platform.
Background scaling both customer-facing product engineering
and internal operational tooling
in the same org.

Pay Transparency Statement  This is a hybrid position based out of one of our offices: San Francisco, CA, Plano, TX, or Lehi, UT. Hybrid employees are expected to be in the office two days per week.  
The actual pay rate offered within the range will depend on factors including geographic location, qualifications, experience, and internal equity. In addition to the salary, you will be eligible for 1,000,000 stock options and benefits like health insurance, 401k, and paid time off . Learn more about our benefits at https://jobs.collectivehealth.com/benefits/.
San Francisco, CA Pay Range: $268,000 USD - $335,000 USD
Lehi, UT Pay Range: $214,400 USD - $268,000 USD
Plano, TX Pay Range: $235,840 USD - $294,800 USD
Why Join Us? Mission-driven culture that values innovation, collaboration, and a commitment to excellence in healthcare
Impactful projects that shape the future of our organization
Opportunities for professional development through internal mobility opportunities, mentorship programs, and courses tailored to your interests
Flexible work arrangements and a supportive work-life balance

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Collective Health is committed to providing support to candidates who require reasonable accommodation during the interview process. If you need assistance, please contact recruiting-accommodations@collectivehealth.com.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Dashiell, an operating unit of Quanta Services (trading as PWR), is a leading national provider of technical and construction services supporting critical electric infrastructure. We serve electric utilities, power generation, industrial, renewable, and energy markets with integrated capabilities spanning planning and system studies, engineering and design, maintenance and testing, program management, construction, and turnkey EPC delivery.

With more than 60 years of experience executing large, complex projects, Dashiell specializes in medium- and high-voltage electrical infrastructure and delivers safe, reliable solutions across the full project lifecycle. Backed by the scale, resources, and safety culture of Quanta Services, Dashiell partners with clients to build and maintain the infrastructure that powers communities and economies. Learn more at www.dashiell.com.

Primary Function

The Director of Engineering provides strategic leadership for Dashiell’s electrical substation engineering function, driving the technical direction, operational performance, and growth of the engineering discipline across all substation projects. This role holds full accountability for engineering quality, talent, and financial performance of the group. The position will be based in our Raleigh, NC office located at 11000 Regency Pkwy, Suite 107 Cary, NC 27518 and will report to Dashiell’s Vice President of Engineering.

Duties & Responsibilities

Employee may be called upon to perform any or all of the following functions:

Provide executive-level leadership for the Electrical/Substation engineering discipline, setting strategic direction and organizational goals for the Raleigh office and across all substation engineering groups.
Hold accountability for all substation engineering deliverables, technical quality, and client satisfaction across the portfolio, including physical design, protection and control, and relay engineering.
Lead development and implementation of substation engineering standards, design methodologies, QA/QC processes, and technology roadmaps for the Raleigh office.
Build and manage a high-performing substation engineering organization through talent acquisition, development, mentoring, and succession planning for the Raleigh office.
Serve as senior client executive for major utility, industrial, and renewable energy accounts, leading engineering pursuits and maintaining strategic relationships.
Collaborate with the Vice President of Engineering and executive leadership on business strategy, growth initiatives, and market positioning within the electrical infrastructure sector.
Manage the full engineering P&L for the Electrical/Substation function, including resource planning, budget management, project profitability, and financial forecasting.
Drive cross-functional coordination with construction, testing, project management, and business development teams to ensure seamless project delivery.
Oversee substation engineering proposals, scope development, fee estimation, and contract negotiations in support of business development.
Perform special projects and complete other duties as assigned or requested.

How You Will Make an Impact

Shape the future of Dashiell’s electrical substation engineering practice through strategic leadership, technical vision, and disciplined execution across the Raleigh office and beyond.
Drive revenue growth and market expansion in the electric utility, industrial, and renewable energy sectors through engineering excellence and strong client relationships.
Build an enduring, high-performing substation engineering organization that sustains Dashiell’s competitive advantage in the medium and high voltage electrical infrastructure market.

Required

Minimum Qualifications / Experience

Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university required; a power systems focus is strongly preferred. Master’s Degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 16 years of electrical substation engineering experience with at least 7 years in senior leadership and management roles.
Active Professional Engineer (PE) license required; ability to obtain licensure in multiple states required.
Extensive hands-on experience in high voltage substation engineering and design (138kV and above), including physical design, protection and control, relay engineering, and HV EPC project execution.
Proven executive engineering leadership with full P&L accountability for an engineering group or business unit.
Deep understanding of applicable engineering standards including NEC, NESC, IEEE, and ANSI as applied to substation design and construction.
Strategic thinking with the ability to set and execute organizational vision across multiple office locations and engineering disciplines.

Advise on development and oversee implementation of digital technologies, from PLM and ERP to our custom MES and QMS systems, that enable our manufacturing operations to efficiently scale while meeting customer requirements.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. Accenture is a leading solutions and services company that helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed across the enterprise, bringing together the talent of our approximately 786,000 people, our proprietary assets and platforms, and deep ecosystem relationships. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. Through our Reinvention Services we bring together our capabilities across strategy, consulting, technology, operations, Song and Industry X with our deep industry expertise to create and deliver solutions and services for our clients. Our purpose is to deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity, and we measure our success by the 360° value we create for all our stakeholders. Visit us at accenture.com.

We Are:

Technology Strategy, and we design and execute industry-relevant reinventions that allow organizations to realize exceptional business value from technology. Our vision is to become the world’s leading advisors
in harnessing technology and innovation as a force to reinvent and improve every business. Our mission is to help client business executives disrupt their industry
and utilize technology to capture market share.

Technology strategy leverages deep business expertise combined with technology know-how, empowering clients to be more competitive by leading initiatives that unlock value and drive growth. We enable leaders to act quickly and confidently as they pivot to the future. Known for our ability to execute at speed, we help our clients disrupt their markets through creating strategies that capabilities in operating model, enterprise architecture, and emerging technologies such as GenAI, rethinking business models for growth, efficiency, and customer satisfaction. We help clients determine clear, actionable paths to competitive agility by bringing them new thinking on business and technology.

You Are:

An expert at advising clients in the Healthcare industry
on technology strategies to achieve their vision and operational goals. You have an abundance of energy and drive, resilience, and a passion for collaborating with senior executives. You love continual learning and are intrigued by new challenges. You have a flair for breaking down complex issues into logical parts and constructing analyses driving actionable recommendations. You’ve got top notch communication and leadership skills and a natural talent for appreciating diverse perspectives and bringing out the best in teams.

In Technology Strategy you will:

Serve as trusted advisor to the C-suite defining strategy at the intersection of both technology and business .

Articulate a compelling technology vision with industry and functional expertise .

Shape the role of technology in business strategies to capture market share.

Identify and prioritize value creation opportunities based on detailed assessment and analysis of current technology footprint.

Drive strategic opportunities which incorporate innovative technology solutions into broader business transformations.

Develop operating models and business cases leveraging disruptive technologies.

Lead the creation of well-articulated thought leadership assets that present innovative insight, knowledge, guidance, and recommendations on a specific market-relevant technology strategy.

Pressure-test assumptions made by leadership teams, including AI-generated insights.

Validate AI-assisted analysis with logic, experience, and domain knowledge.

Use AI tools to accelerate research, synthesis, modeling, and scenario analysis.

Use critical judgement to Know when AI outputs are directionally useful vs. when they are unreliable.

As a Senior Manager you will:

Lead large, complex technology strategy engagements and/or multiple workstreams, providing overall leadership across teams while mentoring and developing junior practitioners

Serve as a trusted advisor to senior client leadership, including CIOs, CTOs, Digital Officers, and business executives, building long-term relationships that extend beyond immediate project delivery.

Shape and drive strategic conversations at the intersection of business and technology, helping clients define transformation roadmaps, operating models, and technology-enabled growth strategies.

Lead the development of thought leadership, market insights, assets, and intellectual capital aligned to emerging technology trends, including AI, digital core modernization, cloud, platform transformation, and technology operating model evolution.

Drive business development activities, including identifying opportunities, shaping solutions, developing proposals and statements of work (SOWs), and supporting pursuit strategy and client presentations.

Guide clients through complex decision-making and transformation initiatives, facilitating alignment across executive stakeholders and navigating ambiguity, organizational resistance, and competing priorities.

Lead cross-functional teams in the development of business cases, value realization strategies, and operating models enabled by disruptive technologies and AI-driven capabilities.

Provide executive-level oversight and quality assurance across strategic analyses, recommendations, and client deliverables, ensuring clear linkage between technology investments and business outcomes.

Coach teams on the effective use of AI-enabled tools for research, synthesis, modeling, and analysis, while applying critical judgment to validate outputs and recommendations.

Contribute to practice growth through capability building, recruiting, mentoring, and development of high-performing teams.

Here’s What You Need:

Minimum 8 years of proven experience in at least one of the following areas: operating model strategy, M&A, technology value and cost take-out, or technology-enabled revenue growth strategy

Minimum 8 years of experience developing business cases, strategic assessments, and executive-level recommendations

Minimum 4 years of experience leading teams and managing complex workstreams, including planning and structuring analytical work, facilitating executive and client workshops, and developing technology strategy recommendations

Minimum 3 years of strategy consulting experience at a leading consulting firm, or in an internal consulting role

Demonstrated experience managing client stakeholders and supporting executive-level discussions across business and technology organizations

Experience driving strategic technology transformation initiatives from assessment through execution planning

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

Bonus Points If:

Comfortable leveraging AI tools for research, synthesis, modeling, and analysis

Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and apply business judgment to validate recommendations

Understanding of data limitations, bias, governance, and model risk considerations

MBA or equivalent graduate degree

Demonstrated critical thinking skills with the ability to challenge assumptions, pressure-test recommendations, and develop creative solutions

Proven ability to mentor, coach, and develop junior team members into future leaders

Strong executive communication and relationship management skills with the ability to influence senior client stakeholders

Excellent presentation and storytelling skills, including the ability to synthesize complex information into clear executive-level messaging

Experience leading insight generation and strategic recommendations through advanced analytics, financial modeling, and visualization tools

Ability to develop practical transformation roadmaps supporting large-scale technology modernization initiatives

Experience managing multiple complex projects and priorities simultaneously within fast-paced consulting environments

Strong project and program management capabilities, including risk management, executive reporting, stakeholder alignment, and escalation management

Experience contributing to business development efforts, proposal development, and/or thought leadership initiatives

jobs.title: Microsoft M365 Senior Technology Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description:

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Job Description:

This job is responsible for building and leading a team to deliver technology products and services that meet business outcomes. Key responsibilities include developing a technology strategy, ensuring technology solutions comply with applicable standards, promoting design, engineering, and organizational practices, and advocating and advancing modern, Agile solution delivery practices. Job expectations may include coaching, mentoring, providing feedback and hands on career development, identifying emerging talent, fostering leadership skills, and managing stakeholders.

Technology Executive role over Microsoft 365 Operations, Collaboration, Voice and Video is a technology leader accountable for the strategic direction, operational excellence, reliability, security, and user experience of the enterprise Microsoft 365 ecosystem. This role oversees an organization of 200+ resources supporting the platforms and services that enable modern work across the organization, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Microsoft 365 Apps, Power Platforms, Teams Phone, meetings, webinars, town halls, Teams Rooms, and related collaboration technologies.

This role ensures Microsoft 365 services are secure, resilient, cost-effective, well-governed, and aligned to business outcomes.
The position requires deep operational leadership across collaboration, messaging, identity dependencies, telephony, audio/video services, service management, compliance enablement, vendor governance, platform adoption, and continuous improvement.
This role typically interacts with the EET head of Product Infrastructure and Engineering and the head of APSE EET Operations.
The position leads enterprise Microsoft 365 operations and partners closely with technology, risk, compliance, finance, HR, legal, facilities, and business leadership teams.

Responsibilities:

Builds and manages teams by performing financial activities to inform workforce strategy and hiring practices, setting and tracking maturity and quality objectives, and training employees/teams to address feedback and achieve quality and performance objectives
Facilitates performance and career development of employees/teams through performance reviews, coaching, and creating development plans that are needed to build competencies and skills
Manages solution delivery and application performance in production (app health, resiliency, performance, security, enterprise data management standards, audit exams and reviews), ensuring all relevant risk, financial, and compliance policies are met
Manages relationships with business and technology partners and leads and creates followership in Communities of Practice in the organization
Contributes to the technology strategy for their technical domain
Creates an inclusive and healthy working environment and helps to resolve organizational impediments/blockers
Ensures that execution is aligned with product strategy by working with product management and other stakeholders

Managerial Responsibilities:

This position may also have responsibilities for managing associates. At Bank of America, all managers at this level demonstrate the following responsibilities, in addition to those specific to the role, listed above.

Opportunity & Inclusion Champion: Models an inclusive environment for employees and clients, aligned to company Great Place to Work goals.
Manager of Process & Data: Demonstrates deep process knowledge, operational excellence and innovation through a focus on simplicity, data based decision making and continuous improvement.
Enterprise Advocate & Communicator: Communicates enterprise decisions, purpose, and results, and connects to team strategy, priorities and contributions.
Risk Manager: Ensures proper risk discipline, controls and culture are in place to identify, escalate and debate issues.
People Manager & Coach: Provides inspection, coaching and feedback to motivate, differentiate and improve performance.
Financial Steward: Actively manages expenses and budgets in alignment with objectives, making sound financial decisions.
Enterprise Talent Leader: Assesses talent and builds bench strength for roles across the organization.
Driver of Business Outcomes: Delivers results by effectively prioritizing, inspecting and appropriately delegating team work.

Enterprise Microsoft 365 Operational Leadership

Own end-to-end operational management of the Microsoft 365 platform, including service reliability, incident management, change governance, lifecycle management, performance monitoring, and executive reporting.
Establish the operating model, service standards, runbooks, escalation paths, and governance framework for Microsoft 365 services across the enterprise.
Drive operational excellence through automation, proactive monitoring, root-cause analysis, capacity management, and continuous service improvement.
Partner with infrastructure, network, identity, security, compliance, endpoint, legal, and business technology teams to ensure integrated service delivery.

Collaboration, Messaging and Productivity Services

Lead enterprise operations for Exchange Online, Outlook, calendaring, Microsoft Teams collaboration, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Microsoft 365 Apps, Power Platforms and related productivity workloads.
Manage operational roadmap alignment for new Microsoft 365 capabilities, including readiness planning, risk assessment, pilot execution, deployment, and sustainment.

Voice, Video and Meetings Operations

Oversee Teams meetings, webinars, town halls, audio conferencing, Teams Rooms, room systems, certified devices, and executive meeting experiences.
Establish quality management practices for voice and video services, including call quality analytics, network readiness, device standards, service health monitoring, and executive support models.
Coordinate with telecom carriers such as Cisco, managed service providers, network teams, facilities, AV teams, and security partners to ensure reliable end-to-end communications services.
Lead technical bridge calls and meetings for high-visibility executive events, including All Hands, Investor Days, and Quarterly Earnings.
Oversee internal teams and vendor partners supporting high-touch users for Trader Voice.

Security, Compliance and Risk Management

Ensure Microsoft 365 operations align with enterprise security, privacy, records management, compliance, legal hold, eDiscovery, data loss prevention, and information protection requirements.
Partner with cyber security and identity teams to manage administrative controls, privileged access, conditional access dependencies and secure configuration baselines.
Own operational risk management for collaboration and communications platforms, including service resilience, business continuity, third-party dependencies, and regulatory obligations.
Develop talent strategy, succession planning, technical capability uplift, and a high-accountability operating culture focused on customer experience and operational discipline.
Represent Microsoft 365 Operations in executive forums, audit reviews, major incident reviews, transformation programs, and enterprise technology planning.

Required Qualifications:

10+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, including senior ownership of Microsoft 365, unified communications, collaboration, messaging, or enterprise productivity platforms.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale operations for Microsoft Teams, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Microsoft 365 Apps, Teams Phone, Power Platforms, meeting rooms, and enterprise voice/video services.
Strong understanding of IT service management, incident/problem/change management, operational risk, resiliency, monitoring, automation, and executive-level service reporting.
Experience managing telecom operations, PSTN connectivity models, carrier relationships, voice routing, emergency calling requirements, and collaboration device ecosystems.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence senior stakeholders across security, compliance, legal, network, endpoint, identity, procurement, facilities, AV, and business groups.
Excellent executive communication skills with the ability to translate technical complexity into business impact, risk, investment needs, and operational priorities.

Desired Qualifications:

Experience operating Microsoft 365 in a highly regulated enterprise environment.
Experience with Microsoft Teams Admin Center, Microsoft 365 Admin Center, Microsoft Entra ID, PowerShell, Call Quality Dashboard, Teams Rooms Pro Management, compliance portals, and service health tooling.
Familiarity with Microsoft 365 E5 capabilities, information protection, retention, eDiscovery, Defender, Purview, Copilot readiness, and secure collaboration controls.
Experience leading modernization from legacy PBX, on-premises Exchange, traditional file shares, or fragmented collaboration platforms to Microsoft 365 cloud services.
Relevant certifications such as Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert, Microsoft 365 Certified: Collaboration Communications Systems Engineer Associate, ITIL, or equivalent industry credentials.

jobs.title: Vice President, Technology & Architecture
jobs.description:
Description -

HP is a technology company founded on the belief that companies should do more than simply generate profit. Having helped shape Silicon Valley decades ago, HP continues to invest deeply in innovation across its broad product portfolio to advance how people live and work. We envision a world where technology improves lives everywhere. At HP, great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time—and one idea can change the world. Today, HP is among the world’s most sustainable, just, and inclusive technology companies.

The CTO, Software
organization at HP is a global team of thousands of engineers and leaders shaping the future of how software and platform technologies power HP’s product portfolio. The organization is responsible for the vision, strategy, architecture, engineering, and operations of the software and platform technology stacks behind HP’s products. These include modern, AI-native, end-to-end platforms spanning developer experience, data and AI, security, infrastructure, reliability and device software, as well as software stacks for customer-facing HP applications. Our mission is to deliver magical, AI-enabled experiences to tens of millions of customers worldwide. Beyond powering today’s products, the organization also helps define and shape HP’s next era of growth through technology innovation and active engagement across the software and AI ecosystems.

The Vice President, Technology & Architecture
role serves as a strategic thought partner to the CTO, Software at HP and is accountable for defining the technology direction, architecture, and innovation roadmap that drives engineering excellence and sustained business impact at HP. This role oversees software and platform architecture, technology incubation, technology strategy, and technology advocacy functions. This senior leadership position is critical to advancing HP’s software-led business transformation and growth by driving innovation and enabling new efficiencies and operating models.

This role reports to the Chief Technology Officer, Software at HP. This leader will serve as a trusted partner to C-level executives and stakeholders across product and technology, with the opportunity to deliver sustained, company-wide impact at HP—a global technology leader and long-standing Fortune 100 company with more than 28,000 patents, over $55 billion in annual revenue, and 58,000 employees worldwide.

Responsibilities

Lead by example, fostering a culture of accountability, technology and architecture excellence, and a customer-first mindset across the organization.
Attract, build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of talented technologists, architects, and engineers with diverse expertise, perspectives, and backgrounds.
Lead central architecture, with responsibility for developing the end-to-end, full-stack architecture across platform and product software engineering, including architecture principles, target architecture blueprints, and architecture evolution and migration plans.
Lead a team of senior distinguished engineers focused on next-generation technology stacks and architectures across software, data and AI, security, infrastructure, and reliability engineering.
Lead technology incubation, with responsibility for building and sustaining incubation environments that support CTO, Software; global business unit; and stakeholder technology innovation initiatives, and for delivering the HP CTO Lab—a new full-stack software and platform sandbox for conducting proofs of concept in partnership with CTO, Software teams, internal stakeholders, and external partners and customers.
Lead technology strategy, with responsibility for the roadmap of platform and software stacks, technology and vendor solution evaluation for strategic initiatives, and technology ecosystem monitoring and engagement.
Lead technology advocacy, including technology thought leadership, external industry engagement, internal thought leadership, hackathons, Developer Day, and related initiatives.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field; a Ph.D. is preferred.
Current or prior experience operating at the VP level in technology or engineering within an established technology company.
15+ years of experience in technology, engineering, or related areas, including 8+ years leading organizations through senior leadership roles.
Proven success attracting top talent and building and leading high-performing teams that drive technology architecture, strategy, and innovation capabilities within large, complex product or engineering environments.
Experience driving technology innovation, strategy, and architecture within engineering organizations delivering capabilities for products used by millions of customers and/or large-scale commercial businesses generating more than $100 million in annual revenue.
Strong track record of improving operational efficiency and engineering effectiveness through strategic thinking and disciplined execution.
Experience leading or scaling functions such as technology architecture, innovation, and/or strategy.
Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and drive alignment across large, matrixed organizations with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical and operational topics clearly to executive audiences.
Strong collaboration and leadership presence, with a reputation for building trust, attracting top talent, and developing diverse, high-performing teams.

The pay range for this role is $320,000 to $350,000 USD annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to United States of America candidates only). Pay varies by work location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Benefits

HP offers a comprehensive benefits package for this position, including:

Health insurance
Dental insurance
Vision insurance
Long term/short term disability insurance
Employee assistance program
Flexible spending account
Life insurance
Generous time off policies, including;
4-12 weeks fully paid parental leave based on tenure
11 paid holidays
Additional flexible paid vacation and sick leave (US benefits overview [https://hpbenefits.ce.alight.com/])

HP is a technology company founded on the belief that companies should do more than just make a profit. Having helped launch Silicon Valley decades ago, HP is making significant investments in technology innovation today across its diverse product portfolio to advance how people live and work. At HP, we envision a world in which technology serves and enhances lives everywhere. We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time—and that it takes just one to change the world. Today, HP is among the most sustainable, just, and inclusive technology companies.

The CTO, Software team at HP is a global organization of thousands of talented engineers and leaders responsible for the vision, strategy, architecture, engineering, and operations of software, platforms, and technology stacks supporting the company’s product portfolio. Our mission is to deliver magical experiences for tens of millions of global customers, enabled by state-of-the-art AI-native applications and platforms (infrastructure, data, shared software, developer experience). The CTO, Software team also leads technical innovation and external engagements within the software and AI ecosystems and developer communities.

This role is pivotal to advancing HP’s software-led business transformation by accelerating product velocity, unlocking new digital business models, and scaling the impact of shared engineering capabilities across the company.

jobs.title: Senior Director: Global Engineering- Decatur, IL
jobs.description:
Senior Director: Global Engineering - Decatur, IL

This is a full-time, exempt position.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Senior Director, Global Engineering to design, build, and lead a centralized, fit-for-purpose global engineering function that enables safe, reliable, and efficient capital project delivery across global operations. This role will serve as the enterprise engineering leader for capital projects, accountable for engineering strategy, technical governance, engineering standards, resource capability, and engineering deliverables across the project lifecycle.

The role will partner closely with Project Management, Project Controls, Procurement, Operations, and Business Leadership to support capital project delivery through a clearly defined FEL stage-gate. Depending on project size, complexity, and risk profile, this leader will establish the appropriate engineering delivery model, including self-perform engineering, internal shared services, external engineering partners, offshore delivery centers, and global capability centers.

Scope And Accountability

This role is accountable for the engineering function, engineering governance, technical standards, engineering resource strategy, and quality of engineering deliverables across the capital project portfolio. The role will provide engineering leadership across FEL, FEED, detailed design, procurement support, construction support, commissioning support, and technical handover.

The role will work in close partnership with project management and project controls functions, which retain accountability for integrated project execution, schedule, cost control, and overall project delivery governance

Setting Engineering Strategy:
Develop and implement engineering strategies, standards, policies, and processes that align with business objectives and improve project execution.

Engineering Lifecycle Leadership:
Provide engineering support and technical assurance across the full capital project lifecycle, including conceptual design, FEL, FEED, detailed engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and technical handover. Ensure deliverables are complete, risk-based, cost-effective, and aligned with project objectives.

Building Integrated Engineering Services
:Create and optimize end-to-end engineering and mechanical services by leveraging synergies between Engineering and ADM Mechanical to design, fabricate, and install static processing equipment across the Decatur complex.Managing and Developing Teams: Lead, mentor, and develop engineering personnel while fostering a high-performance culture focused on collaboration, continuous improvement, and succession planning.Ensuring Compliance and Safety: Maintain adherence to technical standards, safety requirements, environmental regulations, and industry best practices throughout project execution.

jobs.description:
About Machina Labs

Engineering moves at software speed. Manufacturing doesn’t. Yet.

Machina Labs is changing that. We build intelligent, software-defined factories that produce complex metal structures directly from digital design. By integrating advanced metal forming, robotics, and automated production inside a flexible factory architecture, we enable customers to move from prototype to production in weeks, not years.

Backed by Lockheed Martin, Toyota, and NVIDIA, we’re building the manufacturing infrastructure that defense, aerospace, and advanced mobility programs will run on.

If you want to work on hard problems that matter and see them fly, drive, and defend, this is the place.

About The Role

Machina Labs is looking for a Director of Infrastructure & Security to build the secure, scalable technology foundation for our next stage of growth.

You’ll lead enterprise IT, cloud and DevOps infrastructure, cybersecurity, compliance, and physical security systems across Machina Labs’ commercial operations and Machina Bellator, our defense-focused subsidiary.

This is a build role. You’ll inherit capable teams and an existing technology foundation, but there is significant work ahead as Machina scales. You will define the infrastructure and security roadmap, strengthen our defense-compliant environment, build our Security Engineering capability, and ensure our systems can scale without slowing down the engineers and operators who rely on them.

You’ll report to the VP of Engineering – Software & IT and partner closely with leaders across Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, EHS, Legal, and the broader business.

This is a player-coach role for someone who can set strategy and build organizations while staying close enough to the technology to dive in when it matters.

What You’ll Do

Set the infrastructure and security strategy. Define and execute the strategy for IT, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, and security systems across Machina Labs and Machina Bellator as our teams, facilities, and defense programs scale.
Lead and grow the organization. Lead the IT and DevOps teams, define the organization needed for the next stage of growth, develop existing leaders, and build the Security Engineering function from the ground up.
Scale cloud and DevOps infrastructure. Guide the architecture, reliability, security, and cost management of our AWS environment in partnership with DevOps and Software Engineering. Establish scalable approaches to infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability, and production operations.
Build our cybersecurity capability. Establish and mature security operations across endpoint protection, SIEM and logging, threat detection and response, vulnerability management, incident response, and security architecture.
Lead technical defense compliance. Own the technology strategy, controls, documentation, and audit readiness required to support CMMC, NIST SP 800-171, DFARS, ITAR/EAR, and other requirements associated with our defense and aerospace programs.
Own physical security technology. Partner with EHS, which owns the broader physical security program, to architect and operate the technology behind facility security — including access control, surveillance, identity integration, monitoring, and related security systems.
Establish policy and governance. Partner with Legal, EHS, Compliance, Engineering, and Operations to create pragmatic security and IT policies that protect the company and satisfy customer and regulatory requirements without creating unnecessary friction.

What We’re Looking For

10+ years of experience across infrastructure, enterprise IT, cybersecurity, DevOps, or related technical functions, including significant experience leading technical teams and senior leaders.
Experience owning infrastructure and/or security in a complex engineering, manufacturing, aerospace, defense, or similarly regulated environment.
Demonstrated ability to build and scale technology functions, operating models, and teams — not simply operate established systems.
Strong working knowledge of modern enterprise IT, cloud infrastructure, networking, identity and access management, and cybersecurity architecture.
Experience with AWS or comparable cloud environments and modern DevOps practices.
Experience building or operating cybersecurity programs spanning areas such as endpoint security, logging/SIEM, vulnerability management, incident response, and detection and response.
Experience working with security and compliance frameworks such as CMMC or comparable regulated environments.
A builder mindset. You’re comfortable moving between long-term strategy, organizational design, and the technical details required to get something working.

Nice to Have

Experience in defense, aerospace, or another environment handling CUI, export-controlled information, or classified programs.
Experience taking an organization through CMMC certification or a comparable cybersecurity compliance program.
Experience working in ITAR/EAR-controlled environments.
Experience designing technology infrastructure for manufacturing facilities, engineering labs, or other complex physical environments.
Experience with physical security technologies such as access control, video surveillance, visitor management, and integrated identity systems.
Experience scaling infrastructure and security through a period of rapid company and facility growth.

$200,000 - $250,000 a year

jobs.description:
D-Wave Quantum Inc. (NASDAQ: QBTS)

is a leader in the development and delivery of quantum computing systems, software, and services. It is the world’s first commercial supplier of quantum computers, and the first and only to offer dual-platform quantum computing products and services, spanning both annealing and gate-model quantum computing technologies. D-Wave’s mission is to help customers realize the value of quantum today through enterprise-grade systems available on-premises and via its Leap™ quantum cloud service, which offers 99.9% availability and uptime. More than 100 organizations across commercial, government, and research sectors trust D-Wave to address complex computational challenges using quantum computing. Learn more about realizing the value of quantum computing today and how D-Wave is shaping the quantum-driven industrial and societal advancements of tomorrow: www.dwavequantum.com.

About The Role

D-Wave is seeking an experienced Vice President of Systems Engineering to build and lead a world-class Systems Engineering organization supporting our Gate Model Quantum Computing program. In this leadership role, you will define the systems engineering strategy, architecture, integration, and technical execution required to deliver scalable, fault-tolerant quantum computing systems.

You will lead the organization responsible for ensuring the Quantum Processing Unit (QPU), control electronics, cryogenic systems, calibration software, runtime software, cloud services, and system monitoring operate as a single, integrated platform that meets product, performance, and reliability objectives.

Working closely with Product Management, Research, Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, and Executive Leadership, you will establish the engineering processes, technical governance, and organizational capabilities needed to transform breakthrough quantum technology into commercial products.

What You'll Do

Define and execute the Systems Engineering vision, strategy, and roadmap supporting D-Wave's Gate Model Quantum Computing platform
Establish and continuously improve systems engineering processes, architecture governance, requirements management, verification, validation, and technical readiness practices across the organization
Partner with Product Management to translate customer and business requirements into achievable product specifications and integrated system architectures
Own the end-to-end system architecture, including decomposition of system requirements into subsystem requirements, interfaces, and verification strategies across the QPU, cryogenic systems, control electronics, calibration software, runtime software, and LEAP Quantum Cloud Service
Lead cross-functional system integration, verification, validation, and technical execution to ensure delivery of highly integrated quantum computing platforms
Drive resolution of complex system-level trade-offs while balancing technical performance, schedule, risk, manufacturability, and product objectives
Build strong partnerships across physics, hardware, software, product management, manufacturing, and operations to ensure alignment throughout the development lifecycle
Build, lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing Systems Engineering organization, including engineering managers and senior technical leaders
Develop organizational capabilities, engineering standards, and technical governance that enable scalable product development across multiple generations of quantum computing systems
Represent Systems Engineering as a senior technical leader with executive leadership, customers, strategic partners, and external stakeholders

About You

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline
15+ years of progressive systems engineering experience leading development of complex hardware and software products involving advanced technologies
10+ years leading multidisciplinary engineering organizations delivering integrated technical systems
Demonstrated success defining system architectures and delivering large-scale products from concept through commercialization
Extensive experience in systems engineering disciplines including architecture, requirements management, interface definition, system integration, verification, and validation
Proven ability to build, mentor, and lead engineering managers and highly technical multidisciplinary teams
Exceptional communication, collaboration, and executive leadership skills with the ability to align diverse technical organizations around common objectives
Demonstrated experience driving technical strategy while balancing engineering excellence, product delivery, schedule, and organizational priorities

A D-Waver's DNA

We look at the future and say “why not”; we see possibilities where others see problems or routines. We show the way ahead and are committed to achieving ambitious goals.
We practice straight talk and listen generously to each other with empathy. We value different opinions and points of views. We ensure that we connect outside as well as inside to learn from others and inspire each other.
We hold ourselves accountable for delivering results. We make decisions & take responsibility so that we can act & support each other.
As leaders we motivate & engage our teams to undertake beyond what they originally thought possible, by developing our teams & creating the conditions for people to grow and empower themselves through enabling & coaching.

Our Compensation Philosophy Is Simple But Powerful

We believe providing D-Wavers with company ownership, competitive pay, and a range of meaningful benefits is the start of creating a culture where people want to give the best they’ve got — not because they’re simply making money, but because they’ve fallen in love with our vision, mission, values, and team.

During the interview process, your Recruiter will review our total rewards (base, equity, bonus, perks, benefit, culture) offerings. The final offer is determined by your proficiencies within this level.

Inclusion

We celebrate diverse perspectives to drive innovation in our pursuit. Our employees range from distinguished domain experts with decades of experience in their respective fields, to bright and motivated graduates eager to make their mark. Our diverse and innovative team will make you feel appreciated, supported and empower your career growth at D-Wave.

The Fine Print

jobs.title: Director, Engineering, Android Device Platforms
jobs.description:
Join PatientPoint to be part of a dynamic team creating change in and around the doctor’s office. As a leading digital health company, we innovate
to positively impact
patient behaviors. Our purpose-driven approach offers an inspirational career
opportunity where you can contribute to improving health outcomes for millions of patients nationwide.

Location:
Remote within the United States
Travel Required
: Approximately 2–4 weeks per year
Job Summary

As Director of Engineering, Device Products & Operations, you will oversee software engineering across PatientPoint’s device-side product areas — field operations and device management tooling, exam-room patient engagement technology, waiting-room displays, and back-office systems — all running on Android and BrightSign devices in clinical and on-site settings.  
You will be the Engineering Manager for a mix of senior Engineering Leads and individual-contributor engineers, owning hiring, performance, and career growth directly, and stepping into the Engineering Lead’s technical-direction role yourself where a team needs it.  
This is a hands-on role: you’ll stay close to the code, contribute directly where it matters, champion AI-assisted and agentic ways of working across your teams, and make credible architecture calls — across Android (including custom Android ROM), AWS (IoT Core, Lambda, Bedrock AgentCore), and JavaScript/React front-ends — alongside staff engineers and PatientPoint’s Architecture Review Board.  
What  You’ll  Do

Own engineering outcomes across PatientPoint’s device product areas — field operations tooling, exam-room technology, waiting-room displays, and back-office systems.  
Serve as the Engineering Manager for a mix of senior Engineering Leads and individual-contributor engineers — owning hiring, performance, and career growth directly — and step into the Engineering Lead’s technical-direction role yourself where a team needs it.  
Stay close to the code: lead code reviews, contribute directly where needed, and guide teams on technical best practices.  
Champion AI-assisted and agentic engineering practices — in your own work, across your teams’ day-to-day development, and in the AI-powered capabilities we build into our products (e.g., automated device diagnostics).  
Coordinate priorities and dependencies across three or more concurrently active product areas with different tech stacks and team maturity.  
Represent the device product areas in cross-org architecture reviews (ARB/RFCs) and make architecture trade-off calls alongside staff-level engineers.  
Help engineers and Engineering Leads grow in their roles and career paths at PatientPoint.  
Represent engineering as an executive peer to Product and Design leadership in trio-level and product-level planning.  
Manage a blended team of full-time and contract engineers, onshore and offshore.  
Partner with senior engineering leadership on organizational design and resourcing, and represent the device product areas’ health and staffing needs to executive stakeholders.  

What We Need

12+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years leading engineering teams, with experience owning outcomes across three or more concurrent product areas or technical domains.  
Experience managing a blended team of senior technical/architectural leads, individual-contributor engineers, and full-time/contract engineers (onshore and offshore) — including direct hiring, performance, and career-growth responsibility.  
Hands-on experience building and operating software for Android — including custom Android ROMs, Mobile Device Management (MDM) and IoT device communication protocols (e.g., AWS IoT Core, BLE/GATT) — deep enough to credibly evaluate architecture and code from staff-level engineers. Working understanding of the constraints these devices run under: limited memory, storage, and processing power; intermittent network connectivity; remote update and rollback without a technician on site; and fleets spanning legacy to current Android releases.  
Experience with front-end frameworks (JavaScript or TypeScript), and with the backend services (e.g., Kotlin/HTTP4k, Node/serverless, or equivalent JVM/Node microservices) that support device fleets.  
Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude) in your own workflow, and experience driving adoption of AI-assisted or agentic practices across an engineering team.  

Desired Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field  
Experience operating in or leading a product-operating-model / product-trio structure.  
Comfort partnering with a central architecture function (ARB, RFC process, or equivalent) on org-wide technical standards.  
Familiarity with Android and BrightSign device-platform tooling — hybrid apps that pair native Android with web/JavaScript content rendered inside the native shell, signage-management platforms (e.g., SignageOS, Broadsign) layered on BrightSign hardware, APK distribution, and OS-upgrade programs.  
Experience with AI SDLC practices and guiding or contributing to AI-powered product capabilities (e.g., automated device diagnostics, self-healing device operations, or similar agentic/AI-driven features).  
Experience in vulnerability management and remediation, including SAST/SCA/DAST triage and architecture-level security reviews, across a device fleet or distributed system.  
Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry, including working knowledge of healthcare compliance requirements (PHI handling, HIPAA awareness) and how they influence architecture decisions for patient-facing devices.  
Experience developing, tracking, and promoting a data-driven delivery framework such as DORA metrics (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Mean Time to Restore, Change Failure Rate).  
Hands-on background in AOSP/customized Android ROM work (init/bootstrap-level work, root shell operations, AIDL/IPC).  
Hands-on experience with agent-orchestration frameworks or patterns (e.g., multi-agent/orchestrator-subagent pipelines, MCP-based tool access, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Strands Agents, or similar).  
Experience with Kotlin Multiplatform or similar cross-platform native architectures (shared business logic across Android, JVM/Linux, and other targets).  

What  You’ll  Need to Succeed

Ability to direct and lead teams to deliver product features and continuously improve software quality and development practices.  
Comfortable being a technical anchor, not just a manager — able to hold your own on architecture trade-offs with staff-level engineers, and to jump into code when needed.  
Strong ability to develop talent and help engineers grow into bigger roles.  
Excellent collaboration and communication skills, working effectively across Product, Design, and Architecture teams.  
Proven ability to establish engineering best practices, operational excellence, and execution discipline while fostering collaboration and innovation.  
Experience leading through organizational change and team transitions.  

Base Salary Band: $185,600 - $257,400
