jobs.description:
With a passion for life

Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.

Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.

Job Overview

Provides leadership and direction for the Systems Engineering and Simulation Engineering functions within R&D. Responsible for system architecture, requirements management, model-based systems engineering (MBSE), system integration, simulation-driven design, verification, validation, and risk management activities supporting the development of innovative medical devices.

Leads multidisciplinary teams to ensure the delivery of safe, effective, and compliant products that meet customer, clinical, regulatory, and business requirements. Drives the adoption of simulation technologies, digital engineering practices, and systems-based methodologies to improve product quality, development efficiency, and technical decision-making throughout the product lifecycle.

Job Responsibilities And Essential Duties

Lead Systems Engineering and Simulation Engineering teams supporting new product development and technology development programs.
Accountable for system-level engineering deliverables including requirements, architecture, modeling, simulation, integration, Human Factors, pre-clinical , verification, and validation activities.
Establish and maintain system architectures, functional decompositions, and interface definitions for complex medical device platforms.
Drive requirements engineering processes, ensuring complete traceability between user needs, design inputs, subsystem requirements, and verification evidence.
Lead the application of model-based systems engineering (MBSE) methodologies and digital engineering practices across development programs.
Oversee the development and validation of computational models and simulations used for system performance prediction, design optimization, and risk reduction.
Direct system integration activities and resolve complex cross-functional technical issues involving mechanical, electrical, software, controls, and disposables engineering disciplines.
Lead system-level risk management activities in accordance with ISO 14971 and company procedures.
Ensure simulation tools, methodologies, and models are appropriately validated and applied to support engineering and regulatory decision-making.
Drive system verification and validation strategies to demonstrate compliance with customer, clinical, regulatory, and quality requirements.
Serve as technical leader and subject matter expert for systems engineering and simulation-related activities across R&D programs.
Collaborate with clinical, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, marketing, and service organizations to ensure successful product development and commercialization.
Support regulatory submissions, technical reviews, audits, and inspections by providing systems engineering and simulation-related documentation and rationale.
Recruit, develop, mentor, and retain high-performing engineering talent while fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Identify and execute opportunities to improve engineering processes, tools, methodologies, and organizational capabilities.
Support Human Factors Engineering activities across the product development cycle.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Systems Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field; Master's degree preferred.
10+ years of progressive engineering experience, including at least 5 years of engineering leadership or people management experience.
Demonstrated experience in systems engineering, product development, and system integration within a regulated industry.
Experience applying systems engineering methodologies, requirements management, risk management, and verification/validation processes.
Experience with computational modeling, simulation, digital engineering, or model-based development tools.
Medical device development experience is strongly preferred, particularly in cardiovascular, critical care, or life-support technologies.
Experience working within FDA, ISO 13485, CE Mark, and other regulated product development environments.

Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Strong expertise in Systems Engineering principles and product development processes.
Knowledge of Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) methodologies, FEA and requirements management tools.
Experience with engineering simulation techniques, including multiphysics, fluid dynamics, thermal, structural, control systems, or related analytical methods.
Strong understanding of system architecture, integration, verification, validation, and risk management practices.
Knowledge of applicable standards, including FDA regulations, ISO 13485, IEC 60601, IEC 62304, and ISO 14971.
Demonstrated leadership, talent development, project management, and organizational capabilities.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to influence technical decision-making across disciplines.
Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

jobs.description:
Western Veterinary Partners (WVP):
Western Veterinary Partners is a mission-driven veterinary support organization headquartered in Denver, Colorado. We acquire, invest in, and support veterinary hospitals throughout the United States.

WVP supports the non-clinical aspects of veterinary hospitals while protecting each hospital’s clinical autonomy, local identity, and community relationships. Our partnership model gives veterinarians access to the operational capabilities and resources of a larger organization without sacrificing the culture that made their practices successful. Our work is guided by our values of integrity, collaboration, alignment, growth, support, and relationships.

Role Overview

Reporting to the SVP of Technology & Enterprise Strategy, the Director of Enterprise Data Engineering
is responsible for establishing the organization’s enterprise architecture practice and building a scalable enterprise data platform that supports business growth, operational excellence, and data-driven decision-making. This leader will define the enterprise technology and data platform strategy, oversee the implementation of the enterprise data warehouse, and partner with business and technology leaders to deliver secure, scalable, and integrated solutions.

Working closely with external implementation partners, the Director will provide technical oversight throughout platform development, assume ownership of the production environment following go-live, and establish the architecture and data engineering capabilities needed to support the organization’s long-term technology and analytics strategy.

Candidates located more than 50 miles from the Denver office may work remotely. Candidates based in Denver area are expected to work a hybrid schedule, with two days per week in the office.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Architecture & Technology Strategy

Establish the organization’s Enterprise Architecture function, including governance, standards, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps.
Develop and maintain enterprise technology strategies that support organizational growth, acquisitions, and digital transformation.
Partner with executive and business leaders to evaluate technology investments and align solutions with business objectives.
Define architectural standards for applications, integrations, cloud platforms, infrastructure, security, and data.
Evaluate emerging technologies and ensure enterprise solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with long-term business needs.

Data Platform & Engineering

Lead the implementation and ongoing evolution of the enterprise data warehouse and data platform.
Develop scalable data integration, modeling, and engineering capabilities that provide trusted, governed data for enterprise reporting, analytics and AI initiatives.
Establish data governance, data quality, and master data management practices to ensure trusted enterprise data.
Ensure the data platform meets performance, scalability, security, and disaster recovery requirements.
Partner with Business Data Analytics Lead and Director of Business Intelligence to deliver prioritized data platform capabilities, integrations, and enterprise data solutions.

Platform Ownership & Delivery

Serve as the technical owner of the enterprise data platform throughout implementation and into production.
Partner with external implementation vendors to review architecture, engineering designs, code quality, and technical deliverables.
Provide technical oversight through design, development, testing, deployment, and production readiness.
Assume ownership of the production environment following go-live, establishing operational support, monitoring, release management, and continuous improvement.
Develop and execute the roadmap for future platform enhancements and new technology capabilities.

Leadership & Organizational Development

Build, lead, and mentor the Enterprise Architecture and Data Engineering team.
Establish engineering standards, development practices, and operational processes that promote quality and consistency.
Manage technology vendors, implementation partners, budgets, and strategic technology investments.
Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.

Required

Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline.
10+ years of progressive professional IT experience (exclusive of education), including leadership experience in enterprise architecture, data engineering, enterprise applications, or data platform technologies.
Experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise data warehouses and modern data platforms.
Hands-on experience with one or more modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric).
Strong technical expertise in SQL, dbt, Git, data pipeline development and integration, dimensional modeling, semantic modeling, and Power BI.
Experience partnering with third-party implementation vendors and transitioning enterprise platforms into internal operational ownership.
Proven ability to build and lead technical teams, establish governance, and successfully deliver cross-functional technology initiatives.
Excellent communication, collaboration, and executive stakeholder management skills.

jobs.title: Director, Data Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

We are seeking a visionary Director, Data Engineering to architect the "data set of the future." This role is not just about reporting; it is about building the scalable, AI-ready infrastructure that will fuel our next generation of manufacturing innovation. You will move the organization beyond traditional data warehousing to a robust Data Lakehouse architecture, ensuring our enterprise data—from shop floor to point-of-sale—is clean, real-time, and ready for advanced GenAI and predictive modeling.

The ideal candidate is a technologist who fluently bridges the gap between the plant floor and the front office. You will be responsible for integrating complex operational data with high-velocity sales and commercial data to create a unified ecosystem. By connecting factory efficiency directly to customer demand and market trends, you will enable us to pivot from reactive operations to a truly predictive enterprise.

Key Responsibilities

Architecting the Future: Define and execute a data infrastructure roadmap centered on a Lakehouse architecture that integrates structured and unstructured data, enabling both real-time operational analytics and high-scale AI/ML workloads.
AI-Ready Foundation: Establish the data governance, cataloging, and lineage frameworks necessary to power secure, trusted AI models and Large Language Models (LLMs) across the enterprise.
Manufacturing Integration: Partner with OT and Engineering teams to ingest and operationalize IIoT and supply chain data, creating a unified data ecosystem that drives predictive maintenance and factory floor efficiency.
Modern Data Stack Leadership: Oversee the transition from legacy BI tools to modern, self-service analytics platforms, ensuring the organization has the agility to derive insights from the data lakehouse.
Data Ops & Governance: Lead the transition to MLOps and DataOps methodologies, ensuring data quality, security, and compliance in an increasingly automated environment.
Strategic Partnership: Collaborate with business unit leaders to identify and prioritize data products that drive measurable top-line growth or operational cost reductions.
Team Leadership: Build and mentor a high-performing team of data engineers, ML engineers, and data architects who are comfortable in both cloud-native environments and complex legacy manufacturing systems.

Requirements

Qualifications and Technical Requirements:

Strategic Experience: 15+ years in data strategy, architecture, and engineering, with at least 5 years in a leadership role driving organizational change.
5+ years in a leadership role managing data & analytics teams.
Architecture Expertise: Demonstrated experience designing and deploying Lakehouse architectures (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, or similar) at scale.
AI/ML Fluency: Proven experience operationalizing AI/ML models within an enterprise environment; deep understanding of data preparation for LLMs and generative AI.
Cloud Proficiency: Extensive experience with Azure (or equivalent cloud hyperscaler) data stacks (e.g., Synapse/Fabric, ADLS Gen2, Azure AI).
Tooling: Advanced proficiency in Python, Spark, and SQL; strong experience with CI/CD for data pipelines and infrastructure-as-code.
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related technical field.
Soft Skills: A "product manager" mindset for data; the ability to translate complex technical architectural debt into business-friendly value proposition

Essential/Preferred Skills

Experience with data governance frameworks and tools.
Exposure to advanced analytics, data science, or machine learning initiatives.
Experience in manufacturing, industrial, or eCommerce environments preferred.

Work Conditions And Physical Requirements

Ability to work in both office and manufacturing environments.
Availability to work outside of core business hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays when required for system upgrades or migrations.
Required to sit or stand for long periods of time.
The ability to lift 30-50 lbs without assistance.
Local and/or international travel will be required as needed (10-15%) including some extended stays on location for education or deployments. Must have a valid driver's license and Passport.

jobs.description:
The Director, Data Products & Engineering, leads the development, expansion, and delivery of Plymouth Rock’s enterprise data assets within the enterprise data lake on AWS. This role owns the end-to-end delivery of ingestion, transformation, and data availability pipelines and is measured on throughput, reliability, and speed of delivery. This role is responsible for ensuring that the enterprise data lake is complete, high-fidelity, low-latency, and continuously expanding to meet the needs of Business Intelligence, Machine Learning, and AI data services and consumption patterns.

Leader will partner closely with business and IT leaders, as well as the heads of Data Governance and Data Services, to ensure that Plymouth Rock’s data distribution and consumption are well organized, well governed, and accessible at speed and scale. This leader spends the majority of their time working within the data lake platform: reviewing pipeline designs, unblocking engineers, troubleshooting production issues, and driving delivery velocity of the data lake, all in service of the organization’s AI ambitions.

Responsibilities

Enterprise Data Product Strategy & Delivery

Draw from your deep and broad technical and management expertise to mentor senior engineers and managers, complete hands-on technical work, and provide leadership on complex technical issues, design tradeoffs, and feature and schedule prioritization.
Define the processes needed to achieve operational excellence in all areas including process management, resiliency and quality
Conduct research of strategic & emerging trends, lead proofs of concept and continuously drive innovation across the team
Lead the development of enterprise data products aligned to business and domains, ensuring data is structured, accessible, and reusable.
Define and prioritize the data roadmap in alignment with business needs, AI/ML use cases, and platform evolution.

Continuous, Rapid Data Expansion (Depth & Breadth)

Execute ingestion of structured, unstructured, and streaming data sources into the lake, closing data leakage gaps by capturing data directly from frontline systems.
Own hands-on delivery of the AWS data lake using S3, Glue, EMR, Lake Formation, Athena, Kinesis, and RDS/Aurora — architecting, reviewing, and, when needed, directly building pipeline components.
Drive continuous improvement of ingestion speed, pipeline reliability, and processing efficiency through concrete, measurable engineering changes each sprint.
Own production reliability of the data lake: monitoring, incident response, root-cause resolution, and prevention of recurring failures.
Partner with application teams to eliminate data leakage by capturing all data generated by frontline systems.

Data Engineering & Platform Execution

Deep hands-on experience with core AWS data services, including S3, Glue, EMR, Lake Formation, Athena, Kinesis, and RDS/Aurora
Optimize the storage patterns of all enterprise data assets to ensure accessibility, cost efficiency, stability, and reliability, while ensuring that data is curated, standardized, partitioned, and stored in the appropriate layer of the Data Lake medallion architecture.
Ensure ingestion metadata (including process and lineage) is complete, accurate, and consistent with governance standards, and that business tools/processes hosting and applying business semantics at the appropriate point in curation are stable and fast.
Lead teams of data engineers and product owners responsible for ingestion, transformation, and delivery of data across the enterprise data warehouse and data lake.
Continuously improve data ingestion speed, pipeline reliability, and processing efficiency.
Embed business context into data product development, ensuring outputs are actionable and aligned to operational needs.
Partner with Data Governance & Architecture to ensure data products align with standards. Ensure consistent, well-organized documentation.

Agile Product Execution & Scaled Delivery

Organize data platform into an agile product structure.
Ensure products squads deliver incrementally and are accountable for measurable outcomes aligned to the objectives of the data office.
Establish and manage agile delivery practices, including sprint cycles, backlog prioritization, and release management.
Coordinate Applications, Data Services, and AI/ML teams ensuring alignment across interdependent data ingestion, and consumption workstreams.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s degree in data science, Computer Science, Engineering, Actuarial Science, Business Administration, or a related field required.
Master's degree (MS in Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, or Information Management) preferred.

Experience Preferred

7+ years of experience in data management, engineering, or related disciplines.
3+ years of successful senior leadership experience managing enterprise data or analytics functions.
Expertise in data quality management and data architecture best practices, including strong understanding of AI/GenAI data needs, including text, image, and structured data preparation.
Expertise in agile development methods including implementing scale agile methods in a cross-functional environment.
P&C Insurance experience and working familiarity of insurance underwriting operations and platform systems preferred.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a track record of working effectively across technical and business teams.

The pay range for this position is $180,000 to $262,500 annually. Actual compensation will vary based on multiple factors, including employee knowledge and experience, role scope, business needs, geographical location, and internal equity.

We continuously invest in technology, our employees thrive in our empowering environment, and our customers are among the most loyal in the industry. , we’re on an exciting journey to help businesses scale securely by designing and implementing cutting-edge security and compliance programs. As a fast-growing startup, we specialize in a wide range of GRC (governance, risk, and compliance) services that support frameworks across SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, CMMC, NIST 800-171, NIST 800-53, and FedRAMP. We empower companies to meet regulatory requirements and enhance their cybersecurity posture from day one.

Get to know the GRC Engineering Team

Our GRC Engineering team

is the primary point of contact for Workstreet's clients. We bring deep framework compliance knowledge and program management to each engagement to ensure our clients' compliance goals are met. Our teammates are trusted advisors not only in the compliance space, but also operationally in the role of vCISO. We deliver quickly using common templates and methodologies and are adept at creative problem-solving. GRC Engineering Team

members also listen for and act as a centralized resource to advise clients on Workstreet's other service offerings to support their compliance, privacy, and information security goals.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Manager, GRC Engineering

who leads with a client-first philosophy and brings a proven track record of managing high-stakes client relationships with professionalism, care, and strategic insight. The ideal candidate is an experienced client relationship leader who understands that exceptional service is the foundation of everything we do — and who pairs that client focus with 8+ years of deep expertise in cybersecurity compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and NIST CSF.

Integrating quickly into the business within their first 15 days, the successful candidate will act as a high-level executive strategic partner to own account growth and long-term retention across a dedicated portfolio. In this role, you will serve as the trusted executive interface, driving proactive engagement and holistic account health while directing an operational pod that manages day-to-day delivery. You will handle escalations with urgency and poise, keeping clients continuously engaged, valued, and retained through high-impact strategic partnership.

What You'll Do

Own executive-level client relationships as the senior strategic point of contact for a high-priority portfolio, building deep trust, driving retention, and resolving high-stakes client escalations with absolute composure and urgency.
Provide overarching program governance across multiple compliance engagements, ensuring tech-sector clients remain fully prepared, informed, and calibrated throughout complex audits and certification lifecycles.
Supervise, mentor, and upscale a high-performing team of subordinate managers and GRC analysts, embedding a performance-driven culture focused on strict operational accountability and clear professional growth.
Drive departmental resource and capacity strategy, directing hiring, target profiles, and optimized workload allocation models to seamlessly support the business as it scales.
Establish and enforce rigorous quality benchmarks across the delivery team, verifying that every piece of technical documentation and client communication reflects the highest standard of execution.
Engage directly with US-based client executives and technology founders, executing proactive multi-channel communications to dismantle complex compliance roadblocks and provide tailored risk advisory.
Develop, execute, and maintain enterprise-grade security policies and procedures, translating dense global regulations (including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS, HiTRUST, and NIST/CMMC) into scalable, operational controls.
Partner cross-functionally with internal and external teams to systematically isolate, evaluate, and remediate technical cybersecurity risks and framework deficiencies.

Who You Are

Executive portfolio commander - Command high-complexity client engagements, dismantle high-stakes structural escalations at the leadership tier, and confidently influence senior C-suite stakeholders to preserve long-term loyalty.
Elite corporate communicator - Assert flawless, authoritative written and verbal English communication capable of effortlessly translating dense technical risk data into clear business value for diverse audiences.
Scale-oriented enterprise people leader - Bring 5+ years of dedicated experience leading, upskilling, and managing mid-sized technical or professional services teams, explicitly demonstrating the capability to lead through subordinate people managers.
Cybersecurity compliance authority - Command 8+ years of direct, hands-on execution designing, implementing, and defending mature compliance programs across global frameworks (including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS, HiTRUST, and NIST/CMMC).
Policy governance architect - Bring 8+ years of experience engineering and enforcing technical security policies that seamlessly align rigorous regulatory mandates with fluid business growth objectives.
High-velocity startup operator - Thrive within volatile, fast-growth technology ecosystems, possessing the immediate operational agility to fully integrate into an organization and absorb strategic client accounts within your first 15 days.
Disciplined program navigator - Command macro-level organization and program management mechanics to oversee multiple concurrent compliance engagements simultaneously without degrading delivery quality or missing deadlines.
Domain-native technology strategist - Verifiable tenure operating within cybersecurity-focused SaaS or technology corporations where security governance, risk assessment, and technical compliance serve as core business differentiators.

What Will Help You Succeed

Big 4 advisory or assurance tenure - Prior success directing technical IT compliance audits, data governance assessments, or complex risk assurance workflows inside elite environments like Deloitte, PwC, EY, or KPMG.
GRC consultancy lifecycle execution - Direct history managing compliance engineering functions or vCISO delivery tracks within a high-volume managed security services provider (MSSP) or specialized security consulting practice.
Validated industry credentials - Hold active, globally recognized professional security and audit designations such as CISA, CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, or CRISC.
Mastery of compliance automation architectures - Direct backend operational mastery navigating, configuring, and tracking continuous evidence collection inside automated platforms like Vanta, Drata, or Secureframe.

Role-Related Training: Reimbursement for the successful completion of approved training and certification courses relevant to your current role.
Competitive Compensation: A competitive base salary with regular performance reviews linked to merit-based appraisals and bonus opportunities.
Growth Opportunity: Early-stage company with significant room for career advancement.

What You'll Need To Thrive

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with candidates, hiring managers, and business leaders across global teams.
A reliable, high-speed internet connection and a professional home office environment that supports confidential conversations, virtual interviews, and uninterrupted collaboration.

You'll lead a team of four architects covering AEM, marketing communications (Adobe Campaign), fundraising systems, and analytics/personalization (Adobe Target). Business stakeholders know what they want — deeper donor relationships and more consistent giving. Personalization & Platform Strategy

Lead the technical evaluation and integration of personalization and journey-orchestration platforms — including Adobe Real-Time CDP, Adobe Journey Optimizer, and integrations with our Salesforce Marketing Cloud ecosystem — and make the architectural case for the solutions that best fit our existing technology investments.
Identify opportunities to take advantage of existing investments in the Adobe Experience Cloud and marketing profiles to drive engagement across platforms.
Own service delivery for web personalization, translating business goals into insight-driven, actionable campaigns.

Hands-On Delivery & Enablement

Build proof-of-concepts yourself, hands-on, that give marketing and fundraising leaders something real to react to — not just a roadmap slide.
Provide expert guidance on emerging tools and technology trends, and act as the technical translator between what the business wants and what is achievable.
Anchor the Fundraising Agile Release Train as a Systems Architect, working directly with senior leadership to realize value.

Generative AI Architecture

Lead the expansion of Generative AI across the organization's marketing technology systems, with strong attention to governance, safety, and sound technical design.
Guide architectural decisions as existing martech platforms increasingly incorporate LLM-driven capabilities.

Lead evaluation and selection of architectural standards, tools, and processes across the marketing technology stack.

jobs.title: Director, Systems Engineering
jobs.description:
JOB TITLE

Director, Systems Engineering

LOCATION

Worcester

DEPARTMENT NAME

Infrastructure Services and Architecture

DIVISION NAME

Worcester Polytechnic Institute - WPI

Job Description Summary

Reporting to the Assistant Chief Technology Officer, Infrastructure Services and Architecture, the Director of Systems Engineering will oversee the operation, administration, and engineering of the university's systems environment, including servers, storage, cloud computing, and virtualization, along with infrastructure DevOps, application system and security support, and Campus Safety Services. Information technology plays a vital and ever-expanding role in the institutional mission.

The institution's information technology environment is highly distributed and diverse, and the Director of Systems Engineering must be an adept and informed leader who can offer strategic vision, comprehensive planning, and direct technical involvement alongside the engineers who report to the role. This senior leadership role is responsible for ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the systems that support the university's educational and operational objectives, and for the reliability of the physical access control, video surveillance, emergency radio, and emergency phone systems that support campus safety.

Job Description

Strategic Leadership and Team Development

Develop and implement a comprehensive systems strategy aligned with the university's goals and objectives.
Provide strategic direction for systems operations and administration, storage, cloud computing and virtualization, application system and security support, and Campus Safety Services.
Collaborate with the Assistant CTO and other senior leaders to prioritize systems initiatives and align them with institutional priorities.
Develop staff, set clear performance expectations, and manage workload and operational tasks across the systems team.
Work with other groups within IT and other business units as needed to develop solutions for unique system requirements, including technical and regulatory requirements.

Systems, Storage, Virtualization, and Cloud Engineering

Working directly with the Systems Engineers who report to this role, direct the design, implementation, and management of the university's physical and virtual server infrastructure, enterprise storage and backup platforms, and AWS and Azure cloud environments.
Participate actively in solution design, technical review, and implementation planning alongside the engineering team.
Ensure efficient utilization of resources through effective virtualization, capacity planning, and lifecycle management.
Lead the evaluation, selection, and adoption of new platform technologies to enhance systems capabilities.
Ensure new implementations are documented, supportable, and aligned with institutional standards and architecture.

Systems Operations and Administration

Oversee the team that performs the day-to-day operation and administration of the university's systems environment, ensuring the stability, availability, and performance of all system components.
Ensure all key services, systems, and components are under appropriate monitoring and alerting.
Ensure operating system patching, firmware maintenance, and lifecycle activities are performed on a defined and predictable cadence.
Ensure that all documentation and databases are up to date and accurate, including asset inventory and configuration records.
Serve as the senior escalation point for the team during major incidents, directing the response, restoring service, and driving root cause analysis and preventive action to completion.
Ensure all systems incidents and service requests are fully resolved within the applicable SLA and maintain open lines of communication with other ITS teams, including the Service Desk.

DevOps, Automation, and Process Improvement

Manage the DevOps resource supporting the infrastructure organization, receiving strategic DevOps and automation requirements from the Assistant CTO and directing the work accordingly.
Identify commonly performed actions, repeated requests, and recurring requirements across every area reporting to this role, including systems operations, storage, virtualization, cloud, application system support, and Campus Safety Services.
Define, document, and standardize the processes behind that work so it can be measured and performed consistently by both full-time employees and the managed service provider.
Identify and prioritize the automation opportunities with the greatest return on team efficiency, and direct their design, build, and adoption.
Measure the effect of automation and process improvement on toil, cycle time, and error rates, and adjust priorities based on results.
Promote the adoption of automation and consistent operating practice across the teams reporting to this role.

Application System and Security Support

Own the systems and middleware layer beneath the university's enterprise and departmental applications, including database platforms, web services, and load balancing.
Ensure that these platforms are appropriately sized, patched, monitored, hardened, and recoverable.
Partner with application owners and the Office of Information Security to remediate vulnerabilities and apply security controls at the system and middleware layer.
Coordinate maintenance windows and upgrade planning with application stakeholders to minimize disruption to academic and administrative operations.

Campus Safety Services

Oversee the technology, operation, and support of campus safety systems, including physical card access, video surveillance, emergency radios, and the emergency phone system.
Ensure the security, reliability, and availability of these physical security and life-safety systems.
Oversee deployment, upgrade, and lifecycle planning for campus safety technology, including coverage associated with building renovation and construction projects.
Collaborate with Campus Police, Facilities, and external vendors and integrators to align technology capability with campus safety requirements.

Security, Compliance, and Resilience

Ensure all systems components meet institutional security and compliance requirements, and implement best practices for securing server, storage, virtualization, cloud, and campus safety infrastructure.
Ensure system designs and procedures are aligned with, and capable of enforcing, university policies and best practices.
Ensure backup, recovery, and business continuity capabilities are designed, documented, and regularly tested against defined recovery objectives.
Ensure vulnerabilities are remediated within institutional service level targets and provide the Information Security operations team with the access and tooling required to identify, locate, and isolate systems involved in security incidents.
Support audit activity and the production of control evidence, and assist Information Security in drafting policies that overlap with the systems team.

Budget, Vendor, and Resource Management

Develop and manage the operating and capital budget for the systems team and Campus Safety Services technology.
Ensure efficient use of resources and identify opportunities for cost savings and license optimization.
Oversee vendor relationships and negotiate contracts for systems, storage, cloud, and campus safety related services and products, interacting directly with vendors, resellers, and integrators.
Plan and forecast refresh and renewal cycles to support multi-year budget development.

Performs all other duties and responsibilities as assigned or directed by the supervisor.

Qualifications

4-year bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or Information Technology, or equivalent experience. A bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred.
Minimum of 7 years of experience, including direct leadership of a systems, infrastructure, or operations team.
Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to develop and retain technical staff.
Excellent strategic thinking and planning abilities.
Deep understanding of server, storage, virtualization, and cloud computing technologies across both Windows and Linux environments.
Working knowledge of the middleware layer supporting enterprise applications, including database platforms, web services, and load balancing.
Ability to direct DevOps and automation resources against strategic requirements set by the Assistant CTO.
Knowledge of physical access control, video surveillance, and emergency communications systems.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities, including the ability to serve as a senior escalation point during major incidents.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Experience developing and managing operating and capital budgets and negotiating with vendors.

Preferred Certifications: Certifications are preferred, not required, and no candidate is expected to hold all of them. Credentials relevant to WPI's technology stack include:

Windows Server: Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Administrator Associate (Exam AZ-802), or the predecessor Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate (Exams AZ-800 and AZ-801).
Cloud platforms: Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) or Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305); AWS Certified SysOps Administrator - Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect.
Red Hat Enterprise Linux: Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA, EX200) or Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE); the Red Hat Certified Specialist in Deployment and Systems Management (EX403) additionally covers Red Hat Satellite.
Nutanix: Nutanix Certified Professional - Multicloud Infrastructure (NCP-MCI), or Nutanix Certified Master - Multicloud Infrastructure (NCM-MCI).
NetApp: NetApp Certified Data Administrator, ONTAP (NCDA), or a NetApp Certified Implementation Engineer (NCIE) specialty such as Data Protection or SAN.
Rubrik: Rubrik Certified System Administrator (RCSA).

Salary Grade 11: $71,800– $75,000 per year (depending on experience)

Salary is based on related experience, expertise, and internal equity; generally, new hires can expect pay between the minimum and midpoint of the range.

Compensation at WPI

FLSA STATUS

United States of America (Exempt)

WPI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability. It seeks individuals from all backgrounds and experiences who will contribute to a culture of creativity, collaboration, inclusion, problem solving, innovation, high performance, and change making. It is committed to maintaining a campus environment free of harassment and discrimination.

By joining the American Red Cross you will touch millions of lives every year and experience the greatness of the human spirit at its best. Are you ready to be part of the world's largest humanitarian network?

Job Description

WHY CHOOSE US?

Joining The American Red Cross is like nothing else – it’s as much something you feel as something you do. You become a vital part of the world’s largest humanitarian network. Joining a team of welcoming individuals who are exceptional, yet unassuming. Diverse, yet uncompromising in unity. You grow your career within a movement that matters, where success is measured in people helped, communities made whole, and individuals equipped to never stop changing lives and situations for the better.

When you choose to be a force for good, you’ll have mentors who empower your growth along a purposeful career path. You align your life’s work with an ongoing mission that’s bigger than all of us. As you care for others, you’re cared for with competitive compensation and benefits. You join a community that respects who you are away from work as much as what you do while at work.

What You Need To Know About The Job

As Director of Marketing Technology Architecture
for the Fundraising and Marketing Technology Group (FMTG), you'll lead the technical strategy behind how the American Red Cross builds relationships with the millions of donors and blood donors it depends on. This is a new role, created because the organization is ready to move personalization and AI-driven marketing technology from concept to production — and needs someone who can turn that ambition into a tangible technical roadmap.

You'll lead a team of four architects covering AEM, marketing communications (Adobe Campaign), fundraising systems, and analytics/personalization (Adobe Target). Business stakeholders know what they want — deeper donor relationships and more consistent giving. Your job is to show them how they get there: architect the systems, mentor your team to build working proof-of-concepts and get marketing leaders excited about what's possible.

The work location for this exciting opportunity is virtual. The selected candidate will work 100% remotely from home and can be located anywhere in the United States but must work an east coast schedule.

WHERE YOUR CAREER IS A FORCE FOR GOOD (Key Responsibilities):

Personalization & Platform Strategy

Lead the technical evaluation and integration of personalization and journey-orchestration platforms — including Adobe Real-Time CDP, Adobe Journey Optimizer, and integrations with our Salesforce Marketing Cloud ecosystem — and make the architectural case for the solutions that best fit our existing technology investments.
Identify opportunities to take advantage of existing investments in the Adobe Experience Cloud and marketing profiles to drive engagement across platforms.
Own service delivery for web personalization, translating business goals into insight-driven, actionable campaigns.

Hands-On Delivery & Enablement

Build proof-of-concepts yourself, hands-on, that give marketing and fundraising leaders something real to react to — not just a roadmap slide.
Provide expert guidance on emerging tools and technology trends, and act as the technical translator between what the business wants and what is achievable.
Anchor the Fundraising Agile Release Train as a Systems Architect, working directly with senior leadership to realize value.

Generative AI Architecture

Lead the expansion of Generative AI across the organization's marketing technology systems, with strong attention to governance, safety, and sound technical design.
Guide architectural decisions as existing martech platforms increasingly incorporate LLM-driven capabilities.

Team Leadership & Roadmapping

Manage and mentor a team of four architects (AEM, marketing communications, fundraising systems, analytics/personalization), building a culture where proof-of-concepts — not just plans — drive decisions.
Own the department's technology architecture roadmap, working directly with business leaders to translate multi-year vision into deliverable increments.
Lead evaluation and selection of architectural standards, tools, and processes across the marketing technology stack.

+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

Scope: Establish operating policies and procedures that affect departments and subordinate sections and work units. Interpret company-wide policies and procedures. Develop budgets, schedules, and performance standards.

Note: Qualified candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. The American Red Cross does not sponsor employment visas.

+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED (required/minimum qualifications):

Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.*
Experience: Minimum of 10 years of experience in systems architecture or engineering.
Staff Management: 3 years in a direct staff management role.
Seven or more years working directly with analytics, audience management, and personalization technologies.
Five or more years of architecting CRM and marketing technology solutions within Adobe Experience Cloud (AEM, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Target, Adobe Analytics) or Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
Three or more years of experience developing applications with object-oriented programing or expertise in a modern scripting language.
Direct experience with a customer data platform or journey-orchestration tool (e.g., Adobe Real-Time CDP, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Salesforce Data Cloud/Journey Builder) is highly preferred.
Experience working in an Agile delivery environment, preferably using the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).
Thorough understanding of the Generative AI landscape, including hands-on experience implementing systems leveraging LLMs.
Demonstrated experience with web application security, privacy, and data governance.
Background in cloud-computing and Data Warehouses, with preference given for work with the AWS platform.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to lead and inspire a team in a collaborative environment.
Commitment to the non-profit sector and its values.

Travel: there may be some domestic travel associated with the position.

Combination of candidate’s education and general experience satisfies requirements so long as the total years equate to description’s minimum education and general experience years combined (Management experience cannot be substituted).

+++++++++++++++++

Physical Requirements

Physical requirements are those present in normal office environment conditions. Operational flexibility is required to meet sudden and unpredictable needs. Ability to use a personal computer, applicable software, and office equipment for sustained periods of time. May include sitting for long periods of time, driving a vehicle, and working under challenging conditions.

jobs.description:
Description

The Director of Datacenter Security Systems leads the global implementation of security controls within AWS datacenters. From creation through datacenter retirement, this role is accountable for delivering innovative security controls that meet the business needs for scale and speed. This role coordinates across design, construction, networking, and partner software teams to deliver physical and logical controls through software and process innovation, and is accountable for both building innovative solutions and operating them at fleet scale.

Infrastructure Security is looking for an experienced Director of Software Development to transform how we create and maintain datacenter security controls across Amazon. You will operate Tier-1 services foundational to AWS datacenter operations and define the approach for deploying security at the speed of modular builds while continuously raising the security bar across all of AWS.

This opportunity is multi-disciplinary, requiring depth of knowledge and experience in security solutions, software development, building design, product management, AWS services, and cost control. It requires a leader who can deliver security solutions within the context of business outcomes and drive iterative improvement in an environment where both the threat landscape and the pace of construction are changing rapidly.

You will draw from deep and broad technical expertise to guide software engineers, principal engineers, and development managers on system design, incremental delivery, and operational excellence. You will apply AI and machine learning to transform how your systems operate: from computer vision that performs real-time authorization decisions, to automated triage and anomaly detection, to intelligent provisioning that eliminates manual effort. This role has substantial visibility with senior executives and is built for a leader who thrives on pace, ambiguity, and building high-performing teams from the ground up.

Key job responsibilities

Own the end-to-end design, delivery, and operation of datacenter security systems globally, including access control, video surveillance, perimeter detection, and the software platforms that manage them
Transform cameras into active assurance mechanisms through computer vision that performs real-time physical authorization linked to work order systems, reducing reliance on manual observation for access verification
Deliver security infrastructure that ships at modular build speed: persistent hardware from construction through operations, standardized security kits, and zero-touch provisioning that eliminates per-site engineering effort
Build and operate a Tier-1 service owning the complete lifecycle of every networked security IoT device globally: onboarding, firmware management, credential rotation, health monitoring, and performance telemetry
Drive security economics that deliver equivalent or better outcomes at lower cost per site as the fleet scales
Define and deliver AI-driven capabilities including computer vision for real-time authorization, automated triage and anomaly detection, generative AI for development acceleration, and intelligent provisioning that eliminates manual effort
Lead and scale a high-performing engineering organization spanning software development, systems engineering, hardware engineering, and program management

A day in the life

This role spends most days working hand in hand with datacenter operations and datacenter engineering teams. You will advocate for logical security controls across AWS service teams to meet the demands of a modular datacenter build plan, ensuring that every layer of the defense-in-depth continuum is instrumented, measured, and delivering against the security bar at the speed the business requires.

About The Team

The Infrastructure Security Team is accountable for ensuring that the foundation of AWS operates and scales securely. This team is responsible for the security of the hardware supply chain, AWS datacenters, and the AWS network. We build operational security solutions that are critical to the operations of AWS infrastructure, including identity management, security telemetry and threat analysis, hardware component validation, and ensuring third-party suppliers meet the AWS security bar.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (or related field) or equivalent work experience
10+ years developing mission-critical system software, with 5+ years driving long-term engineering and product decisions at senior leadership level
Track record of delivering innovative cloud-based applications and services at scale
Proven ability to hire, develop, and retain an inclusive, high-performing organization of 100+ engineers
Experience scaling diverse, highly dynamic, and fast-growing technical and product teams across multiple geographies

Preferred Qualifications

15+ years managing and building software with very high availability and operational excellence requirements
Deep understanding of information security, privacy frameworks, and compliance requirements
Ability to effectively coordinate between technical teams and business stakeholders
Strong ability to build alignment to your teams' vision across diverse business leaders
Ability to drive enterprise-scale changes to existing systems
Effective written and oral communication with multiple levels of leadership involving both business and technical sides of the organization

As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. You'll spend your time balancing strategic leadership with hands-on technical engagement. You'll participate in design reviews for critical components like metadata management and storage tiering, then shift to performance calibration conversations with your team leads. About The Team

We are a team of engineers and technical leaders committed to building foundational cloud storage infrastructure that powers some of the world's most demanding workloads. Our vision is to make elastic file storage seamlessly scalable, reliable, and accessible to organizations of all sizes. You'll work alongside Principal Engineers, Product Managers, and peer teams across AWS Storage, collaborating to advance the state of cloud infrastructure. We serve customers ranging from startups experimenting with containerized workloads to enterprises managing petabytes of data, and your leadership will help shape how we evolve to meet their changing needs. Description

Amazon's Access Management Services (AMS) organization builds and operates the authorization backbone for all of Amazon. Our services govern who and what can access resources across the company — from group membership and ownership to policy evaluation and contingent authorization, to access lifecycle management. We secure authorization decisions at Amazon scale. Security is our top priority, but we also obsess over availability, latency, and cost-to-serve for the teams that depend on us.

AMS is looking for an experienced Senior Software Development Manager to lead the organization that builds, owns, and operates Amazon's attribute-based access control (ABAC) policy services. Your team defines how authorization policies are expressed, evaluated, and enforced across Amazon — making access decisions for every service and workflow that touches protected resources. You will own Tier-1 services foundational to Amazon's operations while driving a shift from manual, team-by-team policy configuration toward intelligent defaults and automated guardrails that reduce friction for builders without compromising the security bar. This is a hard problem — ABAC policy must be expressive enough to cover wildly diverse authorization use cases, reliable enough to bear deep operational dependencies, and performant enough to operate at a scale where even small design choices have outsized blast radius.

This team is in the middle of a fundamental acceleration. The rise of agentic AI across Amazon is reshaping how authorization works — and how we build it. We're applying generative AI to compress our own development cycles, transform how we operate Tier-1 services, and deliver new AI-native authorization capabilities that let Amazon's businesses safely adopt agentic workloads at speed. If you love transforming legacy processes, building high-performing teams, and operating at a pace that matches the moment, this role will fit. You'll have substantial visibility with senior executives and the mandate to move fast. You'll need strong instincts for security outcomes paired with a passion for customer experience — and the technical depth to guide and riase the bar on principal engineers, SDEs, and development managers on system design, incremental delivery, and operational excellence.

This role invents and delivers for internal customers and is inherently cross-functional and requires the ability to think big and collaborate with others as you work closely with teams across engineering, operations, finance, and security. We are looking for a critical thinker who thrives on solving challenges in partnership with teams across Amazon.

You make high-judgment decisions at speed — seeking the right inputs without waiting for perfect information

You dig into hard, ambiguous problems and don't flinch at complex distributed systems

You lead through your people, not over them — challenging teams to find the answer while knowing exactly when to step in with structure and urgency

You expect effort, reward results, and hold yourself to the same bar

You follow the data, think strategically about where the world is going, and still dive deep to stay close to tactical execution

You have a healthy intolerance for the status quo — you'd rather redesign a system than patch around its limitations

You juggle competing priorities without dropping quality in a fast-moving environment

You build trust quickly with senior stakeholders and partner teams who depend on your services

jobs.title: Head of Validation and Systems Engineering
jobs.description:
Join the team bringing advanced autonomy to the built world

At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and into the real world. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. Today, we're deploying autonomous systems on heavy construction equipment across the country, improving safety on job sites and accelerating schedules on critical infrastructure projects.

We're not here debating the future of AI. We're deploying it in the real world. In just two years, we've raised $350M and achieved the first fully autonomous excavator deployments in construction.

This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.

We are seeking a Head of Validation and Systems Engineering
to lead validation, verification, and systems engineering as an integrated discipline. In this role, you will define the criteria for every unsupervised deployment and serve as the technical authority on readiness, participating in critical launch decisions. You will develop a validation architecture where adding a new machine or capability is an incremental, evidence-based process. Rather than inheriting old frameworks, you will leverage cutting-edge research and create new best practices for an emerging industry.

Our machines already operate unsupervised at customer sites. Everything ahead—introducing more machine types, tackling new tasks each quarter, expanding to new sites—pushes the boundaries of the safety standards that have brought us this far.

What you will own

Safety validation of the system. Design the metrics, scenario libraries, and architectural coverage that quantify end-to-end behavioral safety — and make them hold up as the machine set and task set expand.
A validation architecture that generalizes. Decide what evidence is platform-independent and what must be re-established per machine, per task, per site. Turn the safety case into something composable instead of something rewritten.
Systems engineering. Own requirements decomposition and traceability from mission-level intent through subsystems, and use validation findings to expose the gaps, ambiguities, and conflicts that feed back into design.
V&V strategy and infrastructure. Choose the right instrument for each claim — log playback, closed-loop physics simulation, structured proving-ground testing, or on-site work — and specify the tooling and sim capability needed to make those instruments trustworthy across a growing fleet.
Hardware and functional safety. Validate the sensing, compute, and actuation kit we install on customer machines, including functional-safety readiness of safety-critical paths, as that kit is ported onto new platforms.
The org. Grow a team of software, systems, test, and hardware engineers plus data scientists, and scale it ahead of the machine count rather than behind it.
Decision-grade reporting. Define the KPIs — verification coverage, defect trends, release readiness, system maturity — and turn dense test data into the small number of charts that let leadership, customers, and insurers make a call.

What the first year looks like

A V&V framework and safety case structure that spans multiple machine types and an expanding task set, and that engineering, customers, and insurers all recognize as rigorous.
A scenario and coverage model built for the machines and tasks we have not shipped yet, not just the ones we have.
Readiness criteria that generalize — so the second platform, and the tenth, clear the bar faster than the first did without clearing a lower one.
A team that outlives any single launch.

Background

BS or advanced degree in engineering, physics, or another technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
10+ years in test planning and experimental design for safety-critical autonomous or robotic systems, with a bias toward safety and repeatability.
Track record building and leading multidisciplinary technical organizations — software, systems, hardware, test, and data science under one roof.
Depth in sensing and compute: cameras, lidar, radar, GNSS, IMUs, edge compute, embedded controllers.
Fluency in data analysis and test automation (Python, C/C++) sufficient to interrogate results yourself, not only to review them.
Experience running many parallel test activities across non-colocated teams, sites, and stakeholders.
Judgment about when a claim is proven and when it merely looks proven.

Ways to stand out

You have taken a driverless or unsupervised system through to real deployment and personally held the readiness gate — and then had to do it again for a second platform.
You have scaled a validation program across a heterogeneous fleet, multiple sites, or successive hardware generations.
You have authored or led a formal safety case, or contributed to safety standards work (UL 4600, ISO 26262, ISO 21448, or off-road equivalents).
Functional safety experience on vertically integrated or custom hardware.
Familiarity with heavy construction machines — excavators, articulated dump trucks, dozers, wheel loaders, motor graders.
A record of external technical contribution: publications, keynotes, standards bodies, or research leadership. We want this role visible in the field, and we will support that.

How we work

We are a startup, so we look for engineers with an appetite for agility. We do not compromise on safety and we still find ways to move extremely fast — the entire point of this role is that those two things are compatible when the evidence is good enough.

Our roles are often flexible. If you don't fit all the criteria, or are in another location (especially one where we have an office like SF or NY) please apply anyway! We'd love to consider you.

Interact with executive management to develop strategic direction for the department and functional areas.
Partner with executive leadership and stakeholders at all levels of the organization. Provide clear direction by translating strategic priorities and goals into defined tactical action plans and milestones. Work with cross functional leaders to understand and influence business strategy, set priorities, and define technology goals.
Act as a strategist and champion for enterprise architecture and design principles.

jobs.description:
Job Category:

Engineering

Job Family:

Systems & Controls Engineering

Job Description:

The Automation and Controls Engineering Senior Manager for product categories is responsible for managing, influencing and guiding product category specific initiatives to drive cohesive, scalable operational efficiency across US Operations. This leadership role serves as the primary product category level technical authority for automated plant floor systems, controls systems, and system engineering/development integration initiatives. A key liaison between corporate and plant resources, this role balances the needs of product category and plant priorities with scalable standardization at the "entire manufacturing network and corporate" level. This position ensures the work within automation, controls, systems and IT teams align with corporate, category, and plant needs. Acting as a key connection to plant resource teams, the role will drive scalable process improvement, improving executional discipline and partner experience, which reflect reliable, controlled, and stable plant floor operations.

We are hiring for two openings
in this role.

This role is 100% on-site (Monday-Friday) located at our Home Office in Green Bay, Wisconsin.

Relocation Benefits:
Receive a $10,000 relocation bonus PLUS a generous relocation package if relocating more than 50 miles for this position.

About our Green Bay, WI Home Office:

You’ll find lots to love in our beautiful home office in downtown Green Bay, Wisconsin. Our jeans-friendly environment has indoor and outdoor collaboration spaces, state-of-the-art R&D and sensory labs, culinary kitchens, a pilot plant, innovation center and more.

Take advantage of outdoor workspaces. Sample and provide feedback on new products from our R&D team. Enjoy free coffee, soda and popcorn. Take a short walk to restaurants, breweries, the YMCA and a weekly farmer’s market on the scenic Fox River. You can even see Lambeau Field from our top floor.

Open to current partners working remotely if located near a US plant location in Wisconsin, Southwest Missouri or Utah (Cache Valley).

What you’ll do:

Oversee the design, development, and implementation of advanced control systems, automation, and systems engineering. Own the program work within multiple product categories, across multiple manufacturing sites, to optimize operational efficiency, effectiveness and capability. Contribute to multiple large-scale projects that standardize work across categories.
Work closely with IT teams and corporate automation/controls/systems teams ensuring alignment of purpose and high-level organizational goals. Drive company projects and initiatives with manufacturing, process, and project engineering as well as operational excellence teams. Engage appropriate IT, Maintenance, or other teams for support.
Lead cross-functional initiatives aimed at enhancing data collection and optimizing operational processes. Ensure measurable improvements in key performance indicators, resulting in greater control, asset performance, standardization, and partner effectiveness at US locations. Propose projects, initiate change, and influence leaders and stakeholders to align on improvements and new processes. Leverage data to perform analysis and maximize asset utilization.
Spearhead operational strategy development for the product category. Help prioritize requests and opportunities by managing a backlog of opportunities through alignment with key stakeholders and leaders. Plan and manage projects and system implementations by considering impacts and risks to production processes, end users, and long-term goals.
With a viable level of credibility and plant floor experience, provide indirect and influential leadership within the plants. Acting as site governance, connecting to the large-picture business objectives through a plant and category lens. Through plant and corporate relationships, bring a strong plant floor voice to the corporate team structure and a deeper bigger picture perspective to plant teams.
Research best practices and understand industry trends to influence and develop documented best practices for system designs, architectures, AI and digitalization, and implementations. Influence and educate fellow Operations Systems/Controls partners on these best practices and standards.
Together with the leadership team, ensures compliance with Food Safety and Food Quality Plans in addition to customer requirements. Interprets and communicates customer requirements to plant production and/or support groups. Establish and Audit PCPs, CCPs and Standard Operating Procedures to define and monitor processes, to ensure customer requirements are met.
May be required to perform other job-related tasks.

What you need to succeed:

Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related technical field required. Masters/MBA Automation or Controls preferred.
12+ years of experience in Operations Systems, Control Systems, Process/Manufacturing Engineering, Automation, Robotics, AI, Digitalization, Software Systems required.
7+ years of experience in Plant Operations Management, Project Management, Project Engineering or Maintenance required.
Oversee long term goals aligned with company growth and impact plans to support a World Class Food Manufacturing team.
Understanding of industrial controls and components. Understanding of functional design documents. Database skills in tables, views, stored procedures, SQL queries, report generation, coding and scripting logic (e.g. Python is preferred). Solid Understanding of Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) concepts, programming logic and execution; prior experience in Rockwell suite of products is preferred. Ability to analyze large amounts of data to create useful and actionable information. Understanding of automation and robotics as it applies to manufacturing and operational success. Systems knowledge and proficiency with SCADA, HMI, MES, Historian, reporting/dashboard tools, and programming is preferred; experience with the Ignition SCADA Platform and the Perspective User Interface module is especially desirable. The ability to quickly pick up and learn new technologies.
Effective communications skills, both verbal and written. Demonstrated ability to guide others in achieving project and growth goals. Has demonstrated effectiveness in influencing others to meet industry and customer requirements. Demonstrated ability to influence others to achieve strategic growth plans and expected results.
Comprehensive understanding of production and manufacturing processes and their underlying principles. Demonstrated ability to reduce downtime and optimize resource allocation to improve overall operational efficiencies that drive results and profitability.
Demonstrated ability to meet project timelines, within scope and budget requirements. Project management experience to include contracts, scope development, and project accounting. Ability to manage and teach others to ensure projects are executed in a consistent/standardized approach.
Effectively manages project resources to optimize return on investment, evaluate of financial impact of technical decisions and contributes to forecasting and planning to ensure projects meet both performance and financial objectives.
Proficient in MS Office.
Ability to travel 25% - 50%. Could be higher for short intervals of time depending on business needs.

Eligible partners will receive:

Get not one, but TWO retirement benefits. When you join our employee-owned company, you’ll be part of our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) from day one. In addition to an 8% 401(k) match into the ESOP, Schreiber will contribute an extra amount – about 8% of your earnings – toward your retirement every year. That’s a company contribution of around 16% in retirement savings annually. That’s hard to beat!
Earn bonus pay. You’ll have an opportunity to earn incentive pay twice a year when we meet our company goals.
Ready to make a move? Receive a $10,000 relocation bonus PLUS a generous relocation package if relocating more than 50 miles for a U.S. Salaried position.
Childcare costs. Get up to $5,000 annually to help you with the cost of childcare. Monthly contributions toward childcare expenses, including independent babysitters.

jobs.title: Director, Embedded Software Engineering, Amazon Leo
jobs.description:
Description

The Director of Embedded Software Engineering will lead mission-critical embedded software development for Amazon Leo's satellite bus systems, ensuring our satellite constellation meets aggressive reliability, security, and performance targets from manufacturing through end-of-life operations.

This role owns all embedded software development and systems testing for satellite spacecraft systems — including flight software, real-time operating systems, avionics, and on-orbit software validation. You will architect the software that sits on the satellite, manage the end-to-end software stack to bring up the satellite, and lead comprehensive system testing to ensure spacecraft readiness for launch and on-orbit operations.

This is a highly technical leadership role requiring hands-on embedded software architecture expertise combined with the ability to build and scale high-performing engineering organizations. You will work in constrained hardware environments where computing resources (processing power, memory, power consumption) are severely limited. A satellite has 600+ unique processors — it's like having its own compact data center in space — requiring sophisticated embedded software solutions to coordinate this complexity.

Key job responsibilities

As a group leader, you will anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. The ability to take large, complex projects and break them down into manageable pieces, develop functional specifications, then deliver them in a successful and timely manner is expected. Maturity, judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence, analytical talent and leadership are essential to success in this role.

Embedded Software Architecture & Development

Define and implement end-to-end embedded software architecture for satellite bus systems
Lead development of real-time operating system (RTOS) implementations for spacecraft control, including scheduling algorithms and embedded design patterns
Architect Linux OS solutions for satellite systems
Drive hardware bring-up processes: boot, hardware verification, and comprehensive testing
Design and implement control systems, redundancy management, and health check software
Develop and oversee software for custom ASICs and FPGAs used in spacecraft systems
Architect solutions for complex application synchronization (e.g., global time clock syncing)
Address avionics systems challenges unique to spacecraft operations

Satellite Bus Software & Systems Testing

Lead software development for satellite bus systems, including:
Flight software and spacecraft control
Attitude determination and control systems (ADCS)
Power management and distribution
Thermal control systems
Command and data handling
Fault detection, isolation, and recovery (FDIR)
Onboard autonomy and health monitoring
Own systems test strategy and execution for satellite systems, including Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulation frameworks
Lead on-orbit software testing and validation for operational satellites
Establish multi-test environments and continuous test/deployment pipelines
Drive software quality from prototype satellites to production at scale

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

Provide close partnership with Hardware Engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle — from component design through integration and launch
Create documentation for worldwide regulatory bodies
Work closely with research teams to evaluate and simulate system-level performance
Provide technical leadership while meeting aggressive project schedules
Drive operational excellence and optimize system performance (e.g., battery usage, resource management)

Team Building & Organizational Leadership

Scale the embedded software engineering organization from current state to production needs
Hire and develop exceptional embedded software engineers and leaders
Manage multiple engineering teams as a leader of leaders (100+ people)
Foster a culture of innovation, speed, and technical excellence consistent with a "new space" mindset
Develop talent pipeline for specialized embedded systems expertise

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related STEM discipline
US Citizenship, Permanent Resident (Green Card), or Political Asylum status required
Min 10+ years of experience as a manager of managers leading multiple engineering teams
Proven track record building and scaling engineering organizations (70+ people)
Demonstrated ability to grow teams from scratch and scale to production operations
Experience managing directors, principal engineers, and senior technical leaders

Technical Experience

Senior Director, Software Engineering – Back Office Technology
