About Asurion

At Asurion, we don’t just redefine, we reinvent. We began by establishing a culture that rewards results and isn’t confined by hierarchy. As a result, we have achieved phenomenal growth. Today, this entrepreneurial spirit is as strong as ever. It’s in our DNA. We foster a culture where our team members collaborate daily to make a difference, for our clients, customers, and themselves. Our dynamic and inclusive environment ensures that each of our 20,000+ team members has the opportunity to reach their full potential while fulfilling the needs of more than 280 million consumers. We value leveraging cutting-edge and market-leading technologies to solve challenging and unique problems and innovate quickly. We embrace ruthless prioritization and iterative delivery to maximize the speed and value we deliver to our business and our customers. We work in

small, empowered, meritocratic teams where everyone has an equal voice and the best idea in the room wins.

Here in the Back Office Technology group, we deliver differentiating Finance and Supply Chain capabilities that power our replacement, repair, setup, and warranty products worldwide. We accomplish this through strong, goal-aligned partnerships with our business stakeholders, delivering innovative and intelligent software solutions that form our Back Office Platform.

Who’s a Great Match For Us

You Put Customers First: Build strong relationships with the global functions including but not limited to Supply Chain, Product, and Client Services organizations through the delivery of exceptional results.

You Collaborate and Then Commit: Partner across functions, facilitate delivery alignment, and lead with influence.
You Want to Reach Your Full Potential: Embrace and drive change, challenge the status quo, and promote continuous innovation.

What You’ll Do

As the Senior Director of Software Engineering – Back Office Technology, you will lead the technology strategy, engineering organization, platform transformation, and software delivery capabilities with a focus on Asurion's global Supply Chain, or other large functions. You will own the engineering and architecture strategy across the technology ecosystem, including our ERP platform and surrounding enterprise capabilities. You'll combine deep technical leadership with

enterprise-scale vision to simplify our technology landscape and build scalable, configurable, intelligent platforms through cloud, automation, data, and AI-driven transformation.

Technology & Engineering Leadership

Own the technology strategy across critical functional capabilities including inventory, order management, fulfillment, warehouse operations, reverse logistics, and end-to-end operational visibility across ERP and adjacent systems.
Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing, distributed software engineering organization of more than 50 engineers.
Define and enforce architecture principles, engineering standards, integration patterns, data ownership boundaries, and extensibility guardrails that enable autonomous teams while prioritizing standard platform capabilities, configuration over customization, reuse, and reduced technology complexity.
Define and execute an innovative product and technology vision that evolves the organization from service delivery to value generation.
Partner with cross-functional executives to shape the modernization roadmap, emphasizing automation, scalability, and intelligent systems.

Own the engineering and architecture strategy for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Functional Management and its surrounding technology ecosystem, establishing clear boundaries between ERP core capabilities, extensions, integrations, data platforms, and differentiated custom applications.
Establish a high-accountability model for strategic technology partners, system integrators, and vendors, ensuring internal teams retain architectural ownership and critical engineering capabilities.

ERP Transformation & Platform Strategy

Lead the transformation of functional technology toward a simplified, scalable, configurable, and composable Back Office platform.
Establish clear principles for buy vs. build, configuration vs. customization, platform reuse, extensibility, and technology lifecycle management.
Challenge legacy business processes, technical assumptions, and solution patterns; partner with leaders to simplify processes before automating them.
Drive standardization and reuse across platform capabilities while preserving flexibility where it creates meaningful business differentiation.
Establish a product and platform operating model with persistent teams accountable for business outcomes, engineering quality, platform health, and continuous improvement.
Create and execute a deliberate strategy for retiring legacy applications, redundant capabilities, brittle integrations, and accumulated technical debt.
Build a multi-year transformation roadmap with measurable outcomes across business value, engineering productivity, reliability, cost, and platform adoption.

AI, Automation & Innovation

Champion AI and automation strategies that improve processes, operational decision-making, and efficiency.
Transform the software development lifecycle through AI-enabled engineering and end-to-end automation, materially improving productivity, quality, delivery cycle time, and value realization.
Identify opportunities to fundamentally redesign processes using AI, intelligent automation, and agentic capabilities, not simply automate existing workflows.
Cultivate a culture of experimentation and scalable adoption of emerging technologies.
Use data and analytics to continuously measure business outcomes and technology effectiveness.
Establish patterns and governance for safely moving AI capabilities from experimentation into scalable, production-grade enterprise solutions.

Operational Excellence

Embed Agile, CI/CD, and DevOps practices to accelerate delivery, improve predictability, and strengthen feedback loops.
Establish engineering practices and measurable SLOs for availability, performance, resilience, recoverability, and observability across business-critical platforms.
Partner closely with Security, Enterprise Architecture, and Product organizations to ensure compliance, security, and alignment.

Leadership & Organizational Growth

Mentor and develop engineering and leadership talent, emphasizing collaboration, empowerment, and innovation.
Continuously evolve team topology, skills, leadership capabilities, and ways of working to align the engineering organization with the target platform architecture and product operating model.
Recruit and retain diverse, high-performing technical talent aligned with Asurion’s culture of ownership and excellence.
Lead through influence, accountability, and clear communication of strategic goals.

Requirements

10+ years of progressive technology leadership, including significant leadership of enterprise software engineering organizations.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale ERP or enterprise platform transformation, preferably within Supply Chain or Back Office.
Proven ability to transform legacy/customized environments toward standardized, configurable, cloud-based platforms.
Demonstrated experience establishing architecture and engineering strategies across complex enterprise ecosystems.
Experience leading engineering leaders and organizations at significant scale, including organizational design and talent transformation.
Demonstrated ability to influence senior business stakeholders and Technology executives and challenge established business and technology assumptions.
Proven track record of translating technology transformation into measurable business, financial, operational, and engineering outcomes.

Preferred Skills

Experience with Microsoft D365 Finance and Supply Chain Management (previously Finance & Operations) or similar ERP platforms.
Expertise in cloud technologies (Azure preferred) and modern integration patterns.
Understanding of AI-driven automation, data engineering, and intelligent process design.
Strong grasp of CI/CD, Agile, and DevOps practices.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and business teams.
Proven ability to lead change, drive innovation, and deliver measurable business value.

Why Asurion

You’ll be at the center of transforming how technology empowers our global Supply Chain organization. You’ll lead teams that build modern, intelligent systems that are secure, scalable, and efficient, shaping the backbone. If you’re passionate about software engineering, data-driven innovation, and AI-enabled transformation, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact

jobs.title: Senior Director, Applied Research
jobs.description:
Overview:

At Capital One, we are creating trustworthy and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been leading the industry in using machine learning to create real-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to building world-class applied science and engineering teams and continue our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

Team Description:

The AI Foundations team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. Our work touches every aspect of the research life cycle, from partnering with Academia to building production systems. We work with product, technology and business leaders to apply the state of the art in AI to our business.

This is a people manager role that will lead teams to drive strategic direction through collaboration with Applied Science, Engineering and Product leaders across Capital One. As a well-respected people leader, you will guide and mentor a team of applied scientists. You will be expected to be an external leader representing Capital One in the research community, collaborating with prominent faculty members in the relevant AI research community.

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, machine learning engineers and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how customers interact with their money.
Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Pytorch, AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, Lightning, VectorDBs, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data.
Build AI foundation models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation.
Engage in high impact applied research to take the latest AI developments and push them into the next generation of customer experiences.
Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals.

The Ideal Candidate:

You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers.
Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them.
Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea.
A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You’re passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond.
Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing AI foundation models and solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms.
Has a deep understanding of the foundations of AI methodologies.
Experience building large deep learning models, whether on language, images, events, or graphs, as well as expertise in one or more of the following: training optimization, self-supervised learning, robustness, explainability, RLHF.
An engineering mindset as shown by a track record of delivering models at scale both in terms of training data and inference volumes.
Experience in delivering libraries, platform level code or solution level code to existing products.
A professional with a track record of coming up with new ideas or improving upon existing ideas in machine learning, demonstrated by accomplishments such as first author publications or projects.
Possess the ability to own and pursue a research agenda, including choosing impactful research problems and autonomously carrying out long-running projects.

Key Responsibilities:

Partner with a cross-functional team of scientists, machine learning engineers, software engineers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered platforms and solutions that change how customers interact with their money.
Build AI foundation models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation.
Engage in high impact applied research to take the latest AI developments and push them into the next generation of customer experiences.
Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Pytorch, AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, Lightning, VectorDBs, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data.
Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals.

Basic Qualifications:

PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, AI, Mathematics, or related fields plus 6 years of experience in Applied Research or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, AI, Mathematics, or related fields plus 8 years of experience in Applied Research
At least 5 years of people leadership experience

Preferred Qualifications [choose applicable set based on focus of role]:

PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering or related fields
LLM
PhD focus on NLP or Masters with 10 years of industrial NLP research experience
Core contributor to team that has trained a large language model from scratch (10B + parameters, 500B+ tokens)
Numerous publications at ACL, NAACL and EMNLP, Neurips, ICML or ICLR on topics related to the pre-training of large language models (e.g. technical reports of pre-trained LLMs, SSL techniques, model pre-training optimization)
Has worked on an LLM (open source or commercial) that is currently available for use
Demonstrated ability to guide the technical direction of a large-scale model training team
Experience working with 500+ node clusters of GPUs Has worked on LLM scaled to 70B parameters and 1T+ tokens
Experience with common training optimization frameworks (deep speed, nemo)

Behavioral Models
PhD focus on topics in geometric deep learning (Graph Neural Networks, Sequential Models, Multivariate Time Series)
Member of technical leadership for model deployment for a very large user behavior model
Multiple papers on topics relevant to training models on graph and sequential data structures at KDD, ICML, NeurIPs, ICLR
Worked on scaling graph models to greater than 50m nodes Experience with large scale deep learning based recommender systems
Experience with production real-time and streaming environments
Contributions to common open source frameworks (pytorch-geometric, DGL)
Proposed new methods for inference or representation learning on graphs or sequences
Worked datasets with 100m+ users

Optimization (Training & Inference)
PhD focused on topics related to optimizing training of very large language models
5+ years of experience and/or publications on one of the following topics: Model Sparsification, Quantization, Training Parallelism/Partitioning Design, Gradient Checkpointing, Model Compression

Finetuning
PhD focused on topics related to guiding LLMs with further tasks (Supervised Finetuning, Instruction-Tuning, Dialogue-Finetuning, Parameter Tuning)
Demonstrated knowledge of principles of transfer learning, model adaptation and model guidance
Experience deploying a fine-tuned large language model

Data Preparation
Numerous Publications studying tokenization, data quality, dataset curation, or labeling
Leading contributions to one or more large open source corpus (1 Trillion + tokens)
Core contributor to open source libraries for data quality, dataset curation, or labeling

jobs.title: Director, S3 Storage
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) provides industry-leading scalability, data availability, security, and performance for object storage. Through the use of pioneering techniques in large-scale distributed computing, developers can durably store their data on AWS’s proven computing infrastructure to achieve virtually limitless storage capacity at minimal cost. Amazon S3 provides simple APIs that can be used to store and retrieve any amount of data at any time. Customers of all sizes, from day one startups to the world’s largest enterprises, use Amazon S3 to deliver next-generation applications that range from data analytics to AI to photo and video archives. While S3 has seen tremendous growth since launch in 2006, we are still in the early stages of realizing its full potential.

As a Director of Software Development for the S3 Storage Engine organization, you will be responsible for leading a group of top talent in the design and development of S3’s core storage distributed system. We build innovative software solutions to provide S3 customers secure, durable, available and performant storage with infinite scalability and extremely low cost. In this role you will drive the roadmap, deliver new functionality and architectures, and raise the bar for operational excellence. You’ll lead multiple engineering teams through managers across different geographic locations. You'll spearhead new technologies that change what is possible within S3. You'll be a leader in the business as well, owning the financial health of your services. You’ll personally engage with C-suite customers to represent the Amazon S3 business.

Success in this role requires a leader experienced in establishing and building relationships with a wide range of peers, including senior AWS executives, customers at all levels of experience and responsibility, deeply technical software and systems engineers within the team, and internal organizations. This leader must have the proven skills to easily switch between weighing in on complex engineering details, taking a long-term view of the business, growing and developing the next generation of AWS leadership, and overall operating as a large-scale organization leader. It requires an ability to prioritize work for the direct team and partner teams, establish goals, and focus attention on the most important inputs to drive the desired business outcomes. This leader must be capable of scaling themselves and their team to meet the ever-increasing demands of a fast-growing business. You’ll need to excel at hiring and developing your technical talent. S3 operates at massive scale and stores critical data for customers world-wide, so a passion and discipline around operational excellence is key. Come work hard and make history with Amazon S3!

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science (related field) or equivalent work experience
10+ years' experience architecting fault tolerant and high available systems
5+ years' experience managing people with 3+ years of managing multiple managers/teams.
5+ years' experience owning 24x7x365 service operations

Preferred Qualifications

A leadership position in a team delivering solutions at scale.
Master’s or PhD in Computer Science or Engineering with a minimum of 10 years of relevant software development and engineering management experience.

jobs.description:
Description

This opportunity is for U.S. citizens who have served in the U.S. Armed Forces including Reserves, National Guard, and service member spouses.

How would you like to be a part of Earth’s most customer-centric company? You would work with teams of front-line responders who support the operations of some of the world’s most powerful data centers. Our Data Center Engineering Operations team maintain and operate our critical infrastructure systems so that they are prepared to stand up against any situation.

AWS has the world’s largest cloud computing portfolio. As an Amazonian you will work in some of the most sophisticated, safe, and secure data centers in the world. Our Chief Engineers (CE) help keep them that way by working with the brightest minds from around the globe to help test and implement the newest technology and work practices to meet the demands of a changing market.

We have a passion for learning and evolving, it’s how we have helped define ourselves as leaders in the industry. Let’s work hard, have fun, and make history!

Key job responsibilities

Act as the primary escalation point for all facilities-related issues. Oversee operation and management of routine and emergency services on a variety of critical systems such as: switchgear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc.
Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures, and troubleshooting of facility within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA).
Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians and responsible for working with Facility Manager (FM) to set team culture.
Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams
May assist in the build out of new facilities and assist in projects to increase current facility efficiency - Working outside of normal business hours for routine maintenance as required, including responding to out-of-hours emergency calls. - Communicate complex technical information to a non-technical audience. - Work with IT managers and other business leaders to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability and efficiency - Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff
Establish building performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of the critical facility operations and maintenance.
Utilize Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook and other basic administrative tools to perform day to day tasks Physical Requirements: Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

A day in the life

This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment that supports servers that must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. Equipment will include but is not limited to stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

The CE directs, trains and supports technicians in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment-specific training exercises is also expected. They manage projects from conception to completion. These projects involve independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering on key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities.

About The Team

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
3+ years of mission critical facilities (example: hospital, military facility, public safety facility, etc.) experience including industrial electrical and mechanical systems
Experience with reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in data center engineering or operations
Experience in construction or project management
Experience leading technical teams through daily operations and maintenance evolutions
Must be able to work in an environment that involves walking, stooping, bending, and climbing to access equipment.

jobs.description:
Job Family

IT - Development

About Us

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests.

Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

Who We Are

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group serving approximately 23.9 million customers worldwide.* For more information, visit transamerica.com. 

Job Description Summary

The Senior Director of Software Engineering provides leadership in the development of new web and cloud technologies to support an agile digital business. Define enterprise web and cloud strategies, grow capabilities, and develop the team by providing technology vision and leadership, career development, and mentoring in design, framework and platform decisions. Define and communicate delivery plans, manage team budgets, and partner with leaders in key business and IT groups to deliver value through efficient use of development resources.

Responsibilities

Job Description

Provide technical guidance and leadership to the development teams to deliver quality solutions utilized by multiple lines of business. Continue to drive the team toward delivery of the best end to end design solutions for the enterprise.
Interact with executive management to develop strategic direction for the department and functional areas.
Partner with executive leadership and stakeholders at all levels of the organization. Provide clear direction by translating strategic priorities and goals into defined tactical action plans and milestones. Work with cross functional leaders to understand and influence business strategy, set priorities, and define technology goals.
Act as a strategist and champion for enterprise architecture and design principles.
Lead white board discussions and presentations with key stakeholders, executive leadership, and enterprise architecture team.
Identify opportunities to utilize third-party software development frameworks, open source libraries, and APIs in agile, and speed to market focused development for business partners.
Ensure high quality service is achieved by providing oversight, monitoring key performance indicators, internal controls, and keeping abreast of market events and industry changes. Bring a passion to stay on top of technical trends, experiment with new technologies, and participate in internal and external technology communities.
Act quickly and appropriately to solve problems, bring clarity, and minimize the impact of unforeseen circumstances.
Drive a culture of change and innovation which constructively challenges the status quo and leads to prudent experimentation. Have a growth mindset with the ability to adopt new practices and spearhead adoption.
Oversee the quality, delivery, performance, cost, and scope for cloud and web development initiatives.
Develop staff through coaching, provide timely performance feedback and assessments and establish performance and development plans. Mentor current and future leaders, ensuring a constantly rising bar in technical excellence and professional growth.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, math, engineering, or other technical field, or equivalent experience
Twelve years of experience with database design techniques/philosophies, modern distributed applications, and microservices
Ten years of experience in delivery of large-scale design projects involving interaction with a broad spectrum of enterprise operational functions
Eight years of experience managing a diverse team and leading cross-functional teams.
Strong background in the execution of DevOps methodologies and continuous integration/continuous deliver, and accomplishments in architecture and strategy.
Experience managing vendor relationships, including product/service evaluation, contract negotiations, and on-going relationship management
Familiarity with modern UI development frameworks (e.g. Angular, React, Vue.js) and web technologies (e.g. HTTP, HTML, JS, CSS)
Results oriented with a strong customer focus
Strong communication skills to delivery highly relevant and effective information to the Board, executives, and employees.
Ability to synthesize ambiguous and complex information in a way the leads to substantive actionable outcomes.
Proactive mindset to drive change, question assumptions and push for innovation solutions.
Ability to work as part of a team and independently
Analytical and problem-solving skills
Technical communication skills and the ability to present information to all levels of the organization
Problem-solving and technical communication skills
Ability to work in a highly matrixed environment and identify, define, and resolve organizational issues
Creative analytical thinker
Ability to prioritize workload to meet tight deadlines

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree
Experience with advanced analytics and machine learning concepts and technology implementations
Understanding of big data and real time data processing architecture and ecosystems
Experience with solution architecture and implementation
Technology or platform certifications (e.g. AWS, Microsoft)
Knowledge of the financial services industry

Hybrid Office Environment

Frequent Travel 25 to 50%

qualifications, experience, geography, work location designation (in-office, hybrid, remote) and operational needs. Salary may vary above and below the stated amounts, as permitted by applicable law.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
Chief Technology Officer

Acru Inc. · Seed-stage · San Francisco / remote-friendly · Founding technical leader

About Acru
Acru is building a consumer loyalty platform where rewards are real, dollar-stable value the customer actually owns — issued by the brand, backed 1:1 by USDC, and portable across a network of brands. Instead of points that expire and reset to zero, consumers earn stable-value rewards they can hold, spend across participating brands, or cash out to their bank. Merchants get their own branded currency and keep the customer relationship and the data — not a bank's rebate. We are post-patent-filing, raising a seed round, and moving from a controlled multi-merchant pilot into full platform build.
The role
You will be the founding CTO—the technical co-founder alongside others. You own every architectural decision: the issuance-and-settlement engine, custody and security of the USDC reserve, money movement enforced in code, the multi-tenant merchant architecture, and a phased AI roadmap. You will make every build-vs-buy call, hire and lead a small senior team, and stand in investor technical diligence alongside the CEO. This is the seat that decides the architecture, not the seat that executes someone else's.
The CEO has deep loyalty-domain experience (MyPoints, $0–$64M) and stays actively involved in token-economics decisions; you bring the implementation depth. Both of you are in the room for technical diligence.
What you'll own in Year 1
●  Reward issuance & settlement:
deterministic conversion of purchases into stable-value USDC rewards, settling in about two seconds on Base.
●  Custody & reserve security:
hot/cold wallet architecture, key management (KMS/HSM), signing policy, incident response. A key compromise is existential, not a bug.
●  Money movement in code:
partner-originated ACH (never in-house Nacha origination), strict idempotency, an async return-state machine, return-code handling, and the fraud controls at the one place where the reserve, the funding model, and live payouts meet.
●  Multi-tenant, cross-brand architecture:
a pluggable merchant-connector model and a real double-entry ledger from day one, scaling toward a network of brands with a shared, portable balance.
●  Consumer wallet:
embedded, email login, dollar-denominated, no seed phrase — crypto made invisible to the consumer.
●  Phased AI:
an agent-legibility layer that exposes a consumer's real dollar balance to external commerce agents, plus reward-graph, fraud/sybil, personalization, and churn models trained on real transaction data.

Our stack
●  USDC on Base (an Ethereum L2 — sub-cent transfers are what make sub-dollar rewards economic).
●  Embedded wallets (Privy, now part of Stripe, or Coinbase Embedded Wallets).
●  A proprietary ERC-20 extension (patent pending) for role-based issuance and lifecycle controls.
● Partner ODFI / payments platform for ACH; Plaid for account verification.
● REST / GraphQL APIs for POS, e-commerce, and CRM integration.

What we're looking for
● Production ML and applied data engineering at scale — fraud detection, real-time inference, a recommendation/reward graph.
● EVM smart-contract development — Solidity, ERC-20 extensions, upgradeable proxy patterns.
● Production experience on an Ethereum L2 (ideally Base) with USDC settlement and reserve custody, and with partner-originated ACH, including return handling and idempotency.
●  A track record of building and leading small, high-output engineering teams from zero.
● Consumer product sensibility — you are shipping consumer-facing products, not just infrastructure.
● Comfort defending the architecture in investor technical diligence.

Compensation
Market-rate cash salary plus meaningful founding equity. And additional benefits. Hybrid.
Regulatory context (so you can gauge fit)
We operate under the GENIUS Act—the U.S. stablecoin law enacted in July 2025—with implementing rules now being finalized and the framework taking effect in January 2027. Rewards are commerce-earned, stable-value, and USDC-backed — never yield-bearing. If you have built compliant money movement, you will recognize the shape of the problem.
How to apply
Email chazb@acru.life with a short note and anything that shows how you think about custody, ledgers, or money movement. Skip the generic cover letter — we would rather see how you reason.

Position Summary:

The Vice President, Head of Information Technology (IT) will lead IT strategy, operations, and digital enablement for a growing, clinical-stage biotechnology organization, ensuring a secure, scalable, and compliant technology environment that supports R&D, clinical development, quality, corporate functions, and future commercialization.

This leader will serve as a strategic thought partner to the executive team, helping to shape and execute a technology roadmap that aligns with the company’s scientific, operational, and business priorities. The VP, IT will be responsible for evaluating organizational needs, recommending technology investments, and making pragmatic, hands-on decisions that strengthen infrastructure, enterprise applications, cybersecurity, data and analytics capabilities, and end-user experience.

In this role, the VP, IT will oversee core IT operations, including cloud infrastructure, networks, storage, databases, disaster recovery, telecommunications, and vendor management. While also advancing fit-for-purpose systems and processes that enable scalability, compliance, and business effectiveness. The ideal candidate will bring both strategic vision and a roll-up-your-sleeves approach, with the ability to introduce practical automation and AI-enabled solutions where appropriate to improve efficiency, decision-making, and organizational performance.

Responsibilities:

Develop and execute an enterprise IT strategy and multi-year technology roadmap aligned with the company’s scientific, clinical, operational, and business priorities.
Serve as a strategic advisor to senior leadership, partnering across functions to assess needs, prioritize investments, and ensure technology enables business goals and future scale.
Lead and manage IT operations, including infrastructure, cloud environments, networks, enterprise systems, and end-user services, ensuring reliability, performance, and scalability.
Evaluate, select, implement, and optimize enterprise technologies and business applications that support R&D, clinical development, quality, finance, HR, and other core functions.
Drive digital enablement across the organization, including systems integration, data accessibility, analytics, workflow automation, and practical AI-enabled solutions that enhance efficiency and decision-making.
Establish and maintain appropriate IT governance, cybersecurity, data privacy, risk management, business continuity, and disaster recovery capabilities for a regulated biotech environment.
Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities to improve processes, strengthen collaboration, and increase organizational effectiveness through technology.
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing IT function, including internal talent and external vendors, consultants, and managed service providers.
Oversee vendor selection, vendor performance, and build-versus-buy decisions to ensure solutions are fit for purpose, cost-effective, and aligned with company stage and priorities.
Manage the IT budget and technology investments with a focus on scalability, efficiency, and responsible resource allocation.
Lead technology change management and user adoption efforts to ensure new systems and tools are successfully implemented and embraced across the organization.
Build a technology foundation that supports the company’s continued growth and positions the organization for future commercial readiness.

Qualifications and Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
15+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, including senior leadership roles within biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, life sciences, or other regulated environments.
Demonstrated experience supporting clinical-stage, R&D-focused, or growth-stage organizations; experience helping prepare an organization for future commercial scale is a plus.
Proven success building, scaling, and modernizing IT capabilities, systems, and processes within a growing organization.
Experience developing and executing technology roadmaps that align with evolving business needs and organizational stage.
Strong knowledge of cloud-based infrastructure, cybersecurity, enterprise applications, data environments, and regulated system landscapes.
Experience evaluating, selecting, implementing, and optimizing technologies that support core business and scientific functions, including platforms relevant to clinical-stage or regulated environments.
Demonstrated ability to assess and introduce practical automation, analytics, and AI-enabled capabilities to improve efficiency, decision-making, and business performance.
Strong business acumen and the ability to serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on technology strategy, priorities, and tradeoffs.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable guidance for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Proven ability to lead through influence, collaborate cross-functionally, and drive alignment across scientific, operational, and corporate teams.
Hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves leadership style, with the judgment to operate strategically while remaining close to key decisions and execution.
Pragmatic, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to balance speed, scalability, risk, and compliance in a fast-paced environment.
Strong people leadership skills, with experience developing talent, fostering accountability, and effectively leveraging external partners and vendors.
High integrity, sound judgment, and a strong sense of ownership.

About Upstream Bio:

Upstream Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing treatments for severe inflammatory respiratory diseases. The Company is developing verekitug, the only known antagonist currently in clinical development that targets and inhibits the receptor for thymic stromal lymphopoietin (TSLP), a cytokine which is a clinically validated driver of inflammatory response positioned upstream of multiple inflammatory pathways. With more than 500 participants treated with verekitug across its clinical development programs and positive Phase 2 results in chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps (CRSwNP) and severe asthma, verekitug has a substantial body of clinical evidence supporting its advancement into Phase 3 development in both diseases. Verekitug is also being evaluated in an ongoing Phase 2 trial in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). Upstream Bio is focused on leveraging verekitug’s differentiated mechanism, potency, and potential for extended dosing to develop a treatment which may deliver best-in-class efficacy and quarterly dosing for patients underserved by today’s standard of care. To learn more, please visit www.upstreambio.com.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) Infrastructure Engineering, Data Center Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) spans 120 Availability Zones within 38 geographic Regions around the world, with announced plans for 10 more Availability Zones and three more Regions — making AWS the most extensive global cloud infrastructure provider and one of the fastest-growing enterprise technology companies ever. Amazon's AWS Data Centers (DC) are a major component of worldwide cloud-computing infrastructure and are industry-leading examples of mission-critical facilities.

Engineers in AWS work to design resilient, cost-effective DC facilities. We are responsible for achieving world-class uptime for our customers and developing a fleet of buildings emphasizing security, safety, and efficiency, while finding new ways to meet AWS's growing demand. We justify and communicate the technical decisions we make directly to AWS leadership and work hard to drive continuous advancements in our designs.

As an Engineering Manager at AWS, you will have the opportunity to impact changes in our current design and establish design procedures and protocols for future systems. AWS Engineering is responsible for the design of all electrical and mechanical systems within all Amazon DCs worldwide. The team works directly with operations, security teams, field engineering, and construction management to implement designs that are functional, practical, and innovative.

The team is seeking a Senior High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) Infrastructure Engineering Manager with demonstrated expertise in the design, analysis, and deployment of high-voltage direct current distribution systems, with specific emphasis on 800VDC bus architectures or comparable voltage classes (e.g., ±400V, 600VDC, 1500VDC) in industrial, utility, transportation, renewable energy, or large-scale power infrastructure applications.

This is a highly specialized, foundational engineering role on a newly formed team chartered to design and develop a next-generation, facility-scale High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) power architecture purpose-built for Generative AI compute loads. This is a greenfield, industry-defining effort — reference designs at this scale and application do not broadly exist in the data center industry. As such, we are seeking engineers with deep domain expertise in high-power HVDC and power conversion systems who bring the intellectual foundation and engineering rigor to translate that expertise into a novel data center context. Direct data center experience is welcomed but is not a prerequisite for this role

You will be responsible for delivery of projects, applying design quality controls, and providing technical guidance to team members. As a subject matter expert, you will be responsible for the design of prototypical DC facilities, localization of conceptual innovations, solving large-scale implementation issues, and building strong relationships with the regional industry. This role represents a rare opportunity to define a new class of data center power infrastructure from the ground up. The successful candidate will not be expected to know all the answers on day one — they will be expected to have the engineering depth, intellectual rigor, and collaborative mindset to help build them.

Anticipated travel: up to 25%

Key job responsibilities

Develop strategic solutions that meet or exceed quality requirements and fall within budgetary and redundancy requirements
Conceive, initiate, and lead projects with widespread impact on infrastructure design, innovation, and implementation
Set the standard for engineering, test, and best practices; drive process improvements across the organization
Decompose complex problems into straightforward and actionable solutions
Be a leader within the group and within internal and external teams that support our data centers
Provide technical oversight of the Regional Electrical and Mechanical Basis of Design (BOD)
Serve as a technical advisor for AWS datacenter electrical and mechanical designs
Work with internal teams to understand user requirements
Work with local agencies having jurisdiction and certification agencies to ensure compliance with federal, state, and municipal requirements and building codes

A day in the life

In this role, you'll lead the technical strategy for data center infrastructure design across your region, working on complex projects that impact how we deliver capacity and innovation globally. You might spend your morning reviewing electrical and mechanical designs with your engineering team, then transition to presenting a business case to leadership on a new cooling technology that could reduce costs without compromising reliability. Later, you could be collaborating with construction teams to solve implementation challenges on an active project, or meeting with local agencies to ensure our designs meet all compliance requirements. You'll also mentor engineers on your team, helping them develop their expertise in mission-critical systems while fostering a culture of creative problem-solving and continuous improvement.

About The Team

We are a global engineering organization dedicated to designing resilient, cost-effective data center facilities that support AWS's rapid growth. Our team includes Architects, Mechanical Engineers, Electrical Engineers, and Control Engineers who work collaboratively to challenge conventional thinking and develop innovative solutions. We partner closely with operations, security, field engineering, and construction management teams to ensure our designs are not only technically sound but also practical and implementable. Our vision is to establish design procedures and protocols that set industry standards while meeting the evolving demands of cloud infrastructure. You'll be joining a group that values technical excellence, creative problem-solving, and strong cross-functional relationships with both internal teams and regional industry partners.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

jobs.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

We are seeking a highly technical Design Portfolio Manager to join our GDSCM team, focusing on the Basis of Design (BOD) and Programmatic Design Change Management (PDCM) programs. This role requires deep technical expertise across multiple engineering disciplines and the ability to evaluate complex design changes across 300+ in-flight projects.

As a Design portfolio Manager, you will serve as a technical expert evaluating design change requests across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, architectural, controls, plumbing, fire protection, and thermal systems. You will conduct feasibility analyses, coordinate technical reviews with principal engineers across all disciplines, and manage the end-to-end lifecycle of design changes from initiation through implementation.

You will work closely with Design Engineering, Construction Management, Procurement, Finance, and Product teams to ensure design changes are properly vetted, funded, and executed.

Key job responsibilities

Technical Design Evaluation

Evaluate complex design changes across multiple engineering disciplines including electrical power distribution, mechanical cooling systems, structural loads, civil site work, architectural layouts, controls systems, plumbing infrastructure, and fire protection systems
Analyze technical specifications, construction drawings, equipment datasheets, and system integration requirements to assess design change feasibility and impact
Understand and explain the complexity of data center designs including power distribution from utility to rack level, cooling system architectures, backup power systems, and building infrastructure
Identify technical dependencies and cross-discipline impacts when evaluating proposed design changes
Assess constructability, maintainability, and operational implications of design modifications
Review and validate technical calculations including electrical load calculations, cooling capacity requirements, structural load analysis, and hydraulic calculations

Design Change Management

Manage portfolio of design changes across multiple in-flight projects, ensuring alignment with business priorities and technical requirements
Conduct feasibility analyses and production readiness assessments for proposed design changes, evaluating technical risk, schedule impact, and cost implications
Coordinate technical reviews with principal engineers across mechanical, electrical, structural, civil, architectural, controls, plumbing, and fire protection disciplines
Develop and maintain implementation plans, tracking design change execution from approval through site deployment
Present design change recommendations and cost implications to senior leadership, clearly articulating technical complexity and business impact
Evaluate design improvements and innovations, assessing their applicability across the global portfolio

Cross-Discipline Collaboration

Collaborate with Mechanical Engineers on cooling system design, HVAC configurations, piping layouts, and thermal management strategies
Work with Structural Engineers on foundation design, seismic requirements, equipment support structures, and building loads

Coordinate with Architectural teams on building layouts, space planning, and building envelope design
Interface with Controls Engineers on building management systems, monitoring systems, and automation strategies
Partner with Fire Protection Engineers on fire suppression systems, detection systems, and life safety requirements

Stakeholder Coordination

Partner with Design Management teams to understand project-specific requirements, constraints, and technical challenges
Collaborate with Finance teams on cost validation, funding strategies, and budget tracking for design changes
Work with Construction Management and Procurement teams to assess schedule impacts, supply chain constraints, and constructability
Engage with Product and Solutions teams to evaluate new equipment, emerging technologies, and design approaches
Coordinate with Commissioning teams to ensure design changes support testing and startup requirements

Process Improvement

Identify opportunities to streamline design change workflows and reduce execution timelines while maintaining technical rigor
Develop and maintain technical documentation including standard operating procedures, design standards, technical specifications, and RACI matrices
Contribute to automation initiatives and tooling improvements for design change management
Support integration of cost validation frameworks and bulk funding mechanisms
Drive continuous improvement in technical review processes and design quality standards

Track and report on design change metrics including approval timelines, cost avoidance, implementation status, and technical quality
Maintain design change databases and dashboards for cross-functional visibility
Support BOD release planning and coordination to minimize redesign impacts
Participate in weekly leadership reviews presenting program status, key decisions, and technical recommendations

Basis of Design (BOD) Establishes and governs the foundational technical standards for all global data center designs, ensuring consistency and quality across the portfolio.

jobs.description:
Overview:

At Capital One, we are creating trustworthy and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been leading the industry in using machine learning to create real-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to building world-class applied science and engineering teams and continue our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

Team Description:

The AI Foundations team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. Our work touches every aspect of the research life cycle, from partnering with Academia to building production systems. We work with product, technology and business leaders to apply the state of the art in AI to our business.

This is a people manager role that will lead teams to drive strategic direction through collaboration with Applied Science, Engineering and Product leaders across Capital One. As a well-respected people leader, you will guide and mentor a team of applied scientists. You will be expected to be an external leader representing Capital One in the research community, collaborating with prominent faculty members in the relevant AI research community.

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, machine learning engineers and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how customers interact with their money.
Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Pytorch, AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, Lightning, VectorDBs, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data.
Build AI foundation models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation.
Engage in high impact applied research to take the latest AI developments and push them into the next generation of customer experiences.
Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals.

The Ideal Candidate:

You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers.
Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them.
Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea.
A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You’re passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond.
Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing AI foundation models and solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms.
Has a deep understanding of the foundations of AI methodologies.
Experience building large deep learning models, whether on language, images, events, or graphs, as well as expertise in one or more of the following: training optimization, self-supervised learning, robustness, explainability, RLHF.
An engineering mindset as shown by a track record of delivering models at scale both in terms of training data and inference volumes.
Experience in delivering libraries, platform level code or solution level code to existing products.
A professional with a track record of coming up with new ideas or improving upon existing ideas in machine learning, demonstrated by accomplishments such as first author publications or projects.
Possess the ability to own and pursue a research agenda, including choosing impactful research problems and autonomously carrying out long-running projects.

Key Responsibilities:

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Manager, AWS S3 Tables
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon S3 Tables is the first cloud object store with built-in Apache Iceberg support, purpose-built for storing and querying tabular data at massive scale. It is fully managed, continuously optimizing, and delivers up-to 10x higher transactions per second than Iceberg tables on general purpose S3 buckets, all within the same foundation that gives S3 eleven nines of durability. Customers are bringing their most demanding analytics workloads to S3 Tables, from streaming ingestion of IoT and application telemetry to multi-petabyte lakehouses powering multiple AWS and partner query engines, and a growing wave of AI agents that query data directly through the Model Context Protocol. Our mission is simple and ambitious which is to make S3 Tables the best place on Earth to store and query Iceberg data, and reinvent what an analytics-native object store can be.

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Manager to lead the multi-team S3 Tables organization. In this role, you will own the technical vision, multi-year roadmap, and execution for the service, working at a scale that very few engineers in the industry ever encounter. Your organization will ship innovations that customers feel directly in query latency, cost per terabyte scanned, ingestion throughput, and the simplicity of running an open lakehouse on AWS.

This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, open-source table formats, and large-scale analytics. You will help define how Iceberg evolves in the cloud, partnering with the Apache Iceberg community and with engine teams across AWS and partners to make sure S3 Tables is the gravitational center of the open analytics ecosystem. Internally, you will partner with S3 storage, indexing, and control plane teams, and with AWS analytics leadership, to deliver a service that is both deeply integrated and uncompromisingly open.

We want a leader who thinks big, invents on behalf of customers, and is energized by problems that only show up at S3 scale. The bar is high and the opportunity to shape how the world stores and analyzes its data is higher.

S3 Tables is a new, fast moving team building within the most durable and scalable storage system ever built. We are early in our journey, the product is young, the customer base is growing quickly, and the surface area in front of us is large. We are doing this in the open with Apache Iceberg, obsessing over customer workloads, and inventing in places others assume are solved. If you want to help build something into what it can become, rather than maintain what already is, this is the team.

Key job responsibilities

Lead and grow a multi-team organization of senior engineers and engineering managers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, deep ownership, and customer obsession.
Define and execute a 1 to 3 year technical roadmap, balancing near-term customer wins with long-horizon bets on query performance, table maintenance, metadata scale, and Iceberg evolution.
Drive architectural decisions for distributed systems at exabyte scale, including metadata services, compaction and optimization pipelines, snapshot and transaction management, and engine integrations.
Make S3 Tables the highest performing, most cost effective home for Apache Iceberg anywhere, and contribute back to the Iceberg open source project.
Partner with product, business, and AWS analytics leadership to translate customer needs into engineering priorities that move adoption and trust.
Establish operational excellence standards across availability, durability, latency, and throughput, and lead the org in exceeding them as the service scales.

Description

We are looking for a Senior SDM to lead the Apollo charter within the Software Foundation Management organization. Apollo is Amazon's internal deployment platform, responsible for deploying software to thousands of services across every AWS partition and fabric, including GovCloud and ADC regions. Apollo processes millions of deployments annually and is a Tier-1 platform system critical to Amazon's operational backbone. We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead multiple engineering teams building and operating next generation of Apollo's core deployment infrastructure at Amazon scale focused on managed intent based Deployments. You will own the technical vision, operational excellence, and people development for a multi-team engineering organization across multiple teams. You will drive the strategy for Apollo's control plane services, deployment automation, and platform reliability while ensuring Amazon's deployment infrastructure remains resilient, scalable, and secure across all partitions.

Key job responsibilities

You will set the long-term technical direction for Apollo's deployment platform, balancing innovation with operational rigor for a system that underpins Amazon's entire software delivery lifecycle. You will lead a team of SDMs and Principal/Senior Engineers, building organizational capability while delivering on ambitious roadmaps. You will own the end-to-end operational posture of Apollo, driving improvements in detection, mitigation, and prevention of large-scale incidents across a globally distributed system. We are looking for a Senior Software Development Manager to lead EMR's Workload Management organization. In this role, you will own the technical vision, roadmap, and execution for EMR's workload orchestration, interactive analytics, identity and access control, and observability platform — the systems that handle every job submitted and every interactive session launched across all EMR compute models.

THE POSITION

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

As the Infrastructure Engineering Director, you'll own FanDuel's foundational cloud and outpost-based infrastructure layer. You'll establish operational excellence, standardization, and reliability across compute, networking, Kubernetes, and cloud provisioning that everything else runs on. This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you set the standard for how infrastructure operates, not just keeping systems running but making them run predictably, with clear processes, documented procedures, and a culture that values doing things right.

This role lands at a critical juncture. FanDuel is scaling rapidly across new markets and cloud footprints. Your infrastructure foundation must handle that growth without creating operational chaos or cost surprises. You'll drive standardization (provisioning, observability, disaster recovery, cost attribution), establish discipline (operational runbooks, change management, incident response), and build an infrastructure team that operates with rigor and purpose. You'll manage vendor relationships, own cloud spend and capacity planning, and balance cost optimization with reliability and resilience.

By connecting infrastructure behavior to real business impact, you'll drive improvements in reliability, performance, cost, and operational maturity. You'll partner closely with Platform Engineering leadership and product teams to ensure our foundation actually supports what they need to build.

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.

THE GAME PLAN

Everyone on our team has a part to play

Establishing infrastructure strategy and standards across cloud provisioning, observability, disaster recovery, and cost governance. Standardization removes ambiguity and makes operations safer and faster.
Building and scaling the infrastructure engineering team with operational rigor and discipline. Hiring for people who care about documentation, reliability, and unglamorous work. Creating career paths and developing infrastructure engineers into senior and leadership roles.
Owning disaster recovery strategy, RTO/RPO definitions, testing, and organizational readiness. If DR hasn't been tested, it doesn't exist.
Establishing SLOs/SLIs for foundational infrastructure services. Making clear tradeoffs between cost optimization and reliability; these aren't opposing goals but they require transparency.

AWS (including Outposts), Kubernetes (EKS, 100+ clusters) , Kong Gateway & Kong Mesh, Terraform, Helm and Datadog

to lead software engineering teams, drive technical excellence, and oversee the successful delivery of scalable, high-quality software solutions. This role requires strong engineering leadership, strategic thinking, and the ability to align technology execution with business objectives.
The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in software architecture, engineering management, Agile delivery, technical strategy, team development, and large-scale software delivery. You will play a critical role in building high-performing engineering teams, improving development practices, managing technical initiatives, and ensuring the successful execution of complex software projects.

Key Responsibilities:

1.Engineering Leadership & Technical Strategy

Lead and manage multiple software engineering teams responsible for designing, developing, testing, and delivering high-quality software products.
Define and execute engineering strategies aligned with company goals, product vision, and technology roadmaps.
Establish engineering standards, development methodologies, coding practices, and technical governance frameworks.
Drive software architecture decisions, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, and aligned with business requirements.
Collaborate with CTO, Product, Architecture, QA, DevOps, and Business teams to define technical priorities and delivery strategies.
Provide technical leadership and guidance to engineering managers, architects, and senior engineers.
Evaluate emerging technologies, tools, and engineering practices to improve productivity and innovation.
Ensure engineering teams follow industry best practices, including Agile development, CI/CD, automation, code quality, and DevOps principles.
Promote a culture of engineering excellence, ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Act as a strategic technology advisor for engineering initiatives and organizational growth.

2. Software Delivery & Engineering Operations

Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of multiple software development initiatives.
Ensure engineering teams consistently deliver high-quality software within defined timelines and business priorities.
Establish engineering metrics and performance indicators to monitor delivery efficiency, quality, and team productivity.
Identify technical risks, dependencies, and delivery challenges, and implement effective mitigation strategies.
Partner with Project Managers and Product Owners to ensure successful execution of product development initiatives.
Improve software development processes, workflows, and operational efficiency across engineering teams.
Drive adoption of modern engineering practices such as Test-Driven Development (TDD), Behavior-Driven Development (BDD), Continuous Integration, Continuous Deployment, and automated testing.
Ensure effective collaboration between Software Engineering, QA, DevOps, Security, Product, and Business teams.
Monitor engineering capacity, resource allocation, and workload distribution across teams.
Support planning and prioritization of engineering initiatives based on business impact and technical requirements.

3. Engineering Team Management & Talent Development

Build, mentor, and develop high-performing software engineering teams.
Lead engineering managers, team leads, senior engineers, and technical specialists.
Define team structures, roles, responsibilities, and career development paths.
Support recruitment, onboarding, and retention strategies for engineering talent.
Evaluate technical skills and participate in hiring decisions for software engineers, architects, and contract engineering resources.
Conduct performance reviews using structured feedback processes and engineering KPIs.
Coach engineering leaders to improve technical decision-making, team management, and delivery capabilities.
Promote a culture of collaboration, innovation, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.
Establish mentoring programs and technical growth initiatives across engineering teams.
Encourage engineers to adopt best practices in software design, coding standards, testing, and system reliability.

4. Architecture, Quality & Engineering Excellence

Partner with architects and senior engineers to define scalable software architecture and technical solutions.
Ensure engineering teams follow secure coding practices and software quality standards.
Establish processes for code reviews, technical documentation, testing strategies, and release management.
Drive improvements in system performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
Promote automation across development, testing, deployment, and operational processes.
Ensure engineering teams maintain strong technical documentation and knowledge management practices.
Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt and improve long-term platform sustainability.
Collaborate with Security and Infrastructure teams to maintain compliance and operational reliability.

5. Stakeholder Collaboration & Business Alignment

Serve as a key communication bridge between engineering teams, executive leadership, product teams, and business stakeholders.
Translate business objectives into technical strategies and actionable engineering initiatives.
Provide regular updates on engineering progress, risks, technical challenges, and delivery outcomes.
Collaborate with Product Management to define technical feasibility, timelines, and implementation strategies.
Partner with executive leadership on technology investments, resource planning, and engineering growth initiatives.
Support strategic decision-making through technical insights, data analysis, and engineering metrics.
Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external technology partners.

6. Contractor & Resource Management

Evaluate and approve the need for contract software engineers based on project requirements and business priorities.
Collaborate with Talent Acquisition and staffing partners to identify qualified engineering resources.
Review technical requirements, candidate profiles, and skill alignment for contract positions.
Manage engineering resource planning to ensure teams have the required capabilities and capacity.
Ensure effective onboarding, integration, and performance management of contract engineering resources.
Optimize engineering workforce strategy through a balance of full-time employees and external technical resources.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
8+ years of experience in software engineering, with significant experience in engineering leadership and management roles.
Proven experience leading software engineering teams and managing large-scale software development initiatives.
Strong understanding of software architecture, system design, cloud technologies, and modern engineering practices.
Experience with Agile methodologies, Scrum, DevOps, CI/CD, and software delivery frameworks.
Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and strategic planning skills.
Experience managing engineering managers, team leads, and senior technical professionals.

Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud is preferred.
Ability to analyze technical challenges and make effective business-aligned decisions.
Experience with engineering tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, or similar platforms.

Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to operate in a fast-paced technology environment.
