jobs.title: VP of Technology - Head Architect, TurboTax
jobs.description:
Overview

We are the largest provider of tax preparation software and services with TurboTax serving ~35M households and over 140M members trust Credit Karma with their financial profile. We're searching for an experienced, innovative VP of Technology (Engineering) leader - as a Head Architect - who has deep SaaS experience delivering new products and experiences to the market that will be loved by millions of users. In this role, the leader will lead the Consumer Platform that enables Intuit to power the prosperity of consumers by serving their needs at various points in their financial journey, from tax to credit to saving on expenses to access to money and growing wealth. Consumer Platform, oriented around the pillars of Tax, Personal Finance, and Money, will focus on helping consumers lift the burden of tax prep with AI and assisted tax prep and lay the foundation to create a year-round relationship centered on money benefits, financial products, and financial guidance.

Consumer Platform is powered by world-class Tax (TurboTax and ProTax) and Credit Karma capabilities. This leader will propel a high-performing team to its next phase of growth. This individual will rely on their business acumen, strategic thinking, hands-on technical/coding experience, AI proficiency and experience, and data skills to drive customer and business outcomes at scale. They will be comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, balancing precision with speed. They will leverage their expertise to guide and inspire the team, attract, and develop top talent, and be both a business leader and technology leader.

What You'll Do Here

We are looking for a Head Architect - Vice President, Technology, to lead architecture for the Consumer Platform. We are looking for a leader that has a passion for solving e2e problems for developers and customers. This role will report to the SVP of Engineering
As a hands-on technical leader, you will own and drive the overall architecture for Consumer Platform by translating business strategy into a durable technology strategy, with a deeper focus and ownership of Tax Platform capabilities. You will do so in close partnership with business leadership, Tax and Credit Karma PD teams, functional teams and broader Intuit TechEcosystem
Be the talent stewards of Distinguished Engineers and Principal Engineers in the organization by defining their focus areas in partnership with PD leadership and coaching them

Responsibilities

Technology Strategy and Architecture for Consumer Platform
Define and drive the technology strategy for Consumer Platform by partnering with Business Leadership and broader Intuit TechEcosystem to accelerate the business growth aspirations. Ensure technical governance of technologies being developed and partner with others to deliver end to end solutions. Evaluate solution designs to confirm technical feasibility, alignment with business objectives, and incorporation of critical non-functional requirements. Use, integrate, identify gaps and propose solutions across all technology assets in the company to ensure we have a cohesive platform. Emphasize development of AI Native solutions which leverage AI to the fullest extent to deliver customer benefit

Boundaryless Collaboration
Able to operate in a complex org structure and collaborating with multiple stakeholders globally. Partner with business and technology teams to prioritize roadmaps, requirements, balancing business needs with financial and technology constraints. Establish alignment of vision, strategy & delivery working with cross-functional teams (PM, PD, XD, Care..) and stakeholders, including senior leaders across geographies.

Operational & Engineering Excellence
Establish and improve engineering and operational excellence efforts across the Consumer Platform that drive a productive environment for developers and high availability for our customers. Result-oriented and deliver huge outcomes. Sets clear objectives and goals for the team and enables the team to deliver and use operating mechanisms to continually assess progress and improve. Establishes the data driven processes needed to achieve operational & engineering excellence. Foster Engineering culture within the team and across organizations.

Build a high-performance culture
Grow and coach engineering talent, acts as a talent magnet to attract, nurture and retain senior talent including Engineering Directors, managers, engineers, and architects. Develops and drives strategy to hire, develop and mobilize talent for the organization.

Speed as a Habit
Can operate in a fast-moving environment, make quick data driven customer backed decisions and execute fiercely to deliver outcomes.

Customer Obsession
Is a staunch advocate for the developers and customers. Stays close to customer problems and solves for them with urgency.

Qualifications

15+ years of product and platform development experience with BS/MS in computer science or equivalent
3+ years in a leadership, managing and coaching globally distributed teams and influencing third party technology strategy
Demonstrated outstanding craft delivering SaaS at scale
Demonstrated experience and expertise is developing full stack applications across multiple areas from architecture, services, applications, data, analytics, AI and marketing technologies
Demonstrated ability to deliver customer outcomes with AI and data powered experiences
Track record of developing high performing organizations and working in a highly collaborative environment across multiple organizations
Demonstrated to operate with high level objectives and deliver with velocity
Demonstrated ability to deliver bold, innovative outcomes
Demonstrated ability to drive big transformations - organizational, technology, business outcomes. Able to operate strategically and tactically in the details
Exceptional business acumen, strategic thinking, and ability to identify patterns and opportunities across a complex ecosystem of products and services
Have a firm understanding of systems engineering and high-availability design.
Experience in operating at different levels of altitude across the entire software development lifecycle
Skilled in creating strong partnerships, influencing stakeholders, and driving business outcomes across data, product, marketing, and sales
Demonstrates ability to research & learn new technologies and business processes independently and apply them as needed.
Passion for facilitative leadership, collaboration and lead teams across boundaries.
Demonstrated ability to communicate and collaborate at all levels - from front line engineers to senior leaders and executive leadership

Footer

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position will be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The Expected Base Pay Range For This Position Is

Mountain View $384,500 - $520,500

jobs.title: Head of Product Development Engineering
jobs.description:
About Ethernovia, Inc.

Ethernovia is developing the future of Ethernet-based networks to realize the full potential of software-defined and autonomous vehicles, robotics and other intelligent machines. Founded in 2018, the company's breakthrough data transport and acceleration technology is ushering in a new era of connectivity and capabilities in the vehicle and at the edge, including highly reliable autonomy, over-the-air servicing and AI-backed applications.

Ethernovia's co-founders are serial technology entrepreneurs with multiple prior successful ventures together. We are well-funded and backed by some of the worlds' leading technology investors, having secured $154M
($90+M Series-B and $64M Series-A) in total funding
to date:

Ethernovia Raises Over $90 Million Series B to Scale Leading-Edge Autonomy and Physical AI Networking Chips
Ethernovia Raises $64 Million to Accelerate the Revolution of Vehicle Networks | Business Wire
(financial backers include: Porsche SE, Qualcomm, AMD, Western Digital, Maverick Silicon, Socratic Partners, Conduit Capital, and CDIB-TEN Capital)

Ethernovia has been recognized in EE Times' prestigious list of the Top 100 Startups for 2025.
March 2026: Ethernovia Announces HSB-Enabled Networking Board for NVIDIA Holoscan Platforms
January 2024: Our CEO Ramin Shirani Named MotorTrend Software-Defined Vehicle Innovator Awards Winner (ethernovia.com)
September 2023: Continental and Ethernovia Announce Partnership to Develop Automotive Switch in 7nm  - Ethernovia
Connected Car News: Helios, Continental, Ethernovia, Avanci, BMW, Mapbox, Porsche, SEMA, Honda, UltraSense, Flex Logix, Diodes Inc., Garmin, Toyota & Caruso | auto connected car news

With talented employees on 4 continents, we have filed 50+ patents to date.

Join Ethernovia's team to make a lasting impact on the future of packet processor-centric networking solutions to support the real-time sensor, Physical AI, and control data demands of software-defined autonomy across vehicles, robots and intelligent machines. Come share in our success with pre-IPO shares, competitive compensation, and great benefits while growing your knowledge and career with world class talent. We are looking for talented engineers and leaders who have an entrepreneurial spirit and want to drive cutting edge designs from concept to silicon to the future of mobility.

Head of Product Development Engineering

Summary:

The Head of Product Development Engineering will be responsible for taking Ethernovia's products from NPI to HVM.

This position requires a leader who is hands-on with semiconductor product development
. You will bridge the gap between world-class networking chip designs and high-volume, automotive-grade silicon manufacturing. The position is based in San Jose, CA.

Key Responsibilities:

End-to-end product test and hardware ownership
from pre-silicon to post-silicon, working with Arch, Design, SW/FW, DFT, System, Test (ATE/BI/SLT) and Q&R.
Execute NPI bring-up
for high-speed Ethernet switch and PHY products ensuring signal integrity and power/performance standards are maintained at scale.
Drive the execution of the manufacturing flow from wafer starts to sample delivery. Own test strategy across wafer test, final test and system level test.
Own characterization, ATE to system correlation, productization and manufacturing specs and margins
(transistor to pmic, part to part, aging and grr)
Own yield improvement across process/package/test, drive test time and test cost reduction
, while maintaining and meeting automotive quality requirements.

Required Experience & Skills:

Professional Background

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field
12+ years of experience in fabless semiconductor operations
, specifically for complex, high-performance SOCs or networking ICs.
Must have direct experience with ATE and SLT testing, characterization
, ATE to system correlation, productization and silicon/package qualification.
Must have direct experience working with foundries, assembly houses, test houses, and OSATs
in the development of high-volume products from NPI through HVM.
Expertise with iJTAG, Scan, MBIST, Sensor, SerDes, LSIO/HSIO testing on ATE, bare-metal, functional DVFS
and benchmark testing at SLT and security fusing.
Experience productizing high-speed communications chips using ATE and System characterization and correlation data, balancing PPY (power/perf/yield)
Experience navigating the Automotive electronics ecosystem, including IATF 16949, ISO 26262, Safe launch and PPAP (Production Part Approval Process).
Experience working in fast paced start-up environment building cutting edge products.

Technical Leadership & Skills:

Understanding of high-bandwidth data-path products (Ethernet, Switching, or high-speed SerDes).
Expert level experience with yield management systems, data analysis, scripting tools, and statistical data analysis using JMP.
Understanding of product life cycle from concept to end of life and leading pre-silicon review and readiness to enable seamless post-silicon bring-up

Nice to Have (The "Competitive Advantage"):

Familiarity with their latest FinFET process node, and QFN, LGA/BGA assembly process for automotive products.
Experience delivering high speed SerDes products to Tier-1 automotive OEMs.
Experience managing contractors and leadership experience.

What You Can Expect From Ethernovia:

Technology depth and breadth expansion that can't be found in a large company
Opportunity to grow your career as the company grows
Pre IPO stock options
Cutting edge technology
World class team
Competitive base salary
Flexible hours
Medical, dental and vision insurance for employees

The actual offered base salary for U.S. locations will vary depending on factors such as work location, individual qualifications, specializations, years of experience, skills, job-related knowledge, and internal equity. The annual salary range for this position is $220,000 - $280,000. The compensation package will also include incentive compensation in the form of pre-IPO ISO options, in addition to base salary and a full range of medical and other benefits.

Position Summary

Blue Origin is seeking a Senior Manager of MEP Facility Engineering to lead a multidisciplinary team of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and process piping engineers. This team designs new and modified facility systems and oversees the health and reliability of existing systems across multiple Blue Origin locations. The Senior Manager is responsible for the technical quality, execution, and professional growth of the team, partnering closely with operations, manufacturing, and program stakeholders to deliver facility infrastructure that enables Blue Origin's mission. This is a people-leadership role requiring the ability to manage and develop engineers who are distributed across several sites.

Key Responsibilities

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and process piping engineers distributed across multiple locations.
Oversee the design of new and modified facility systems — including HVAC, electrical power and distribution, plumbing, and process piping — ensuring designs are safe, code-compliant, constructible, and cost-effective.
Direct the ongoing monitoring and assessment of existing system health, driving proactive maintenance, reliability improvements, and timely resolution of deficiencies.
Establish and enforce engineering standards, design review gates, and quality processes to ensure consistent, high-quality deliverables across all sites.
Balance and prioritize workload across the team to meet project schedules and shifting program demands while managing to budget and headcount.
Partner with operations, manufacturing, program management, and construction/integration teams to align facility engineering scope with customer needs and program milestones.
Review and approve engineering deliverables; ensure appropriate involvement of licensed professional engineers (PEs) and adherence to signed-and-sealed requirements where applicable.
Support capital planning, project scoping, and resource forecasting for facility expansion and modification efforts.
Recruit, hire, and onboard engineering talent to scale the team in line with growing demand.
Travel between sites as needed to support the team, engage stakeholders, and assess systems and projects in the field.

10+ years of relevant engineering experience, including experience in facilities, building systems, or industrial MEP design.
3+ years of experience leading or managing engineering teams.
Demonstrated technical breadth across two or more MEP disciplines (mechanical, electrical, plumbing, process piping).
Experience managing distributed or multi-site teams.
Strong understanding of applicable building codes, standards, and the design/construction lifecycle.

Professional Engineer (PE) license.

Experience with process piping systems and specialty fluids/gases.
Familiarity with design tools such as Revit/BIM and common-data-environment workflows.
Experience partnering with operations and manufacturing on facility turnover and commissioning.
Track record of building and scaling in-house engineering capability.

jobs.description:
Brief Description

Role summary

The Global Director, Software and Digital Strategy owns the multi-year strategy and commercial architecture for the combined software portfolio spanning both platforms — procedure planning, predictive modeling, treatment confirmation, remote capability, and outcomes data. This role defines what the software portfolio must become, in what sequence, and how it is monetized, including the path from bundled software to a recurring software revenue model. The role sits in the upstream organization and partners closely with the hardware portfolio lead, platform R&D teams in the US and France, regulatory, clinical, and downstream commercial teams.

This is a strategy and commercial-model role, not a software engineering role.

Responsibilities

Own the combined software portfolio strategy across both platform brands: portfolio architecture, sequencing, convergence decisions, and the business case for each software investment.
Build and maintain the software commercial model: packaging and tiering, bundled versus subscription versus per-procedure structures, pricing corridors, and the multi-year path to recurring software revenue.
Lead pricing and willingness-to-pay research with hospitals and IDNs, including procurement pathway analysis for software in capital-equipment environments.
Define and track software adoption metrics across the installed base, and partner with downstream marketing and sales on installed-base conversion programs.
Partner with regulatory and clinical leadership on SaMD pathway planning, release-cadence strategy for regulated software, and evidence requirements that support commercial claims.
Run competitive intelligence on procedure planning, navigation, and guidance software, and translate it into portfolio and positioning decisions.
Synthesize voice-of-customer input from physicians, advisory panels, and field teams into software requirements and roadmap priorities.
Support corporate and investor materials with software portfolio and revenue-model content as directed.

Qualifications

8+ years of relevant work experience in medical technology, including software, SaMD, or digital product strategy, portfolio management, or upstream marketing.
Demonstrated experience building commercial models for software sold alongside capital equipment (subscription, per-procedure, or hybrid), including hospital procurement dynamics.
Working knowledge of FDA regulation of medical device software (510(k), SaMD frameworks) and the constraints it places on release cadence and claims.
Experience partnering with distributed R&D organizations; comfort operating across US and European teams.
Strong financial modeling and business-case skills; able to defend assumptions with senior leadership.
Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred.

Preferred

Interventional radiology, interventional oncology, surgical robotics, or imaging domain experience.
Experience commercializing planning, navigation, or AI-enabled imaging software.
Experience in a private-equity-backed or high-growth environment.
French language ability a plus.

About the Opportunity

Early education is one of the most important determinants of childhood outcomes, a critical support for working families, and a $175B market that remains underserved by modern technology. The organization is the largest, fastest growing, and most loved platform in early ed, trusted by millions of educators and families every day. It is a three-time recipient of a prestigious industry award, backed by top investors.

Our Team

The team is passionate, talented, and customer-focused. They embody core leadership principles in their work and culture. The organization is a distributed team with remote employees across every US time zone, as well as select offices in the US and internationally.

Who You Are

This individual takes ownership beyond their remit and does not wait for a clean, fully-scoped mandate before moving. They lead through strong managers, but do not hide behind them: when something needs fixing, they are just as likely to jump in and fix it themselves as they are to coach someone else through it. They think critically and move fast, comfortable making calls with incomplete information and adjusting as they learn more.

This person will thrive in this role if they get energy from operating across multiple different functions, some they know deeply, some they are learning as they go, and they are honest with themselves and others about which is which. They will thrive here if they see an evolving scope as an opportunity rather than a liability.

What You'll Do

Own the tech stack and teams that run operations at the organization.
Lead established technical systems architecture and admin teams, redesigning the go-to-market stack for efficiency in an AI-first world.
Personally own and drive select high-priority workstreams and initiatives directly, not solely through delegation.
Deliver impactful, company-wide capabilities that improve business outcomes and drive key decisions, while supporting the business’s operating cadence.
Manage a team of managers and individual contributors across functions, stepping in directly wherever the situation requires it.
Drive AI-native transformation across every function owned, including hands-on build where appropriate.

What You've Done

Led a multi-function technical or operational organization, managing managers across domains.
Owned outcomes, not just outputs. Achieved business impact like growth, efficiency, conversion, retention, not just dashboards or insights. This role will help shape the future of the company.
Worked closely enough with data engineering, software engineering, or technical systems to troubleshoot issues directly, not just interpret reports from others.
Operated in a mid-size, high-growth company where building was required without inheriting mature infrastructure.
Navigated a role or organization structure that changed shape over time, and adapted their own scope and approach accordingly.
Built AI-native workflows or tooling that materially changed how a team or company operated, not incremental automation, but real step-function change in how work got done.
Collaborated closely with C-suite and executive leaders to shape strategy using data, including creating structure in ambiguity.

This role is not a fit if...

You prefer a role with a fully-defined, static scope; this organization and mandate are still being shaped, and will continue to shift based on where strengths land.
You lead primarily through delegation and expect managers to fully own execution; this role requires you to personally step in and drive work directly, not just direct others.
You rely on authority to get things done; success in this role requires influencing across teams with competing priorities, not just managing within your organization.

jobs.description:

We are the largest provider of tax preparation software and services with TurboTax serving ~35M households and over 140M members trust Credit Karma with their financial profile. We're searching for an experienced, innovative VP of Technology (Engineering) leader - as a Head Architect - who has deep SaaS experience delivering new products and experiences to the market that will be loved by millions of users. In this role, the leader will lead the Consumer Platform that enables Intuit to power the prosperity of consumers by serving their needs at various points in their financial journey, from tax to credit to saving on expenses to access to money and growing wealth. Consumer Platform, oriented around the pillars of Tax, Personal Finance, and Money, will focus on helping consumers lift the burden of tax prep with AI and assisted tax prep and lay the foundation to create a year-round relationship centered on money benefits, financial products, and financial guidance.

Consumer Platform is powered by world-class Tax (TurboTax and ProTax) and Credit Karma capabilities. This leader will propel a high-performing team to its next phase of growth. This individual will rely on their business acumen, strategic thinking, hands-on technical/coding experience, AI proficiency and experience, and data skills to drive customer and business outcomes at scale. They will be comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, balancing precision with speed. They will leverage their expertise to guide and inspire the team, attract, and develop top talent, and be both a business leader and technology leader.

What You'll Do Here

We are looking for a Head Architect - Vice President, Technology, to lead architecture for the Consumer Platform. We are looking for a leader that has a passion for solving e2e problems for developers and customers. This role will report to the SVP of Engineering
As a hands-on technical leader, you will own and drive the overall architecture for Consumer Platform by translating business strategy into a durable technology strategy, with a deeper focus and ownership of Tax Platform capabilities. You will do so in close partnership with business leadership, Tax and Credit Karma PD teams, functional teams and broader Intuit TechEcosystem
Be the talent stewards of Distinguished Engineers and Principal Engineers in the organization by defining their focus areas in partnership with PD leadership and coaching them

Responsibilities

Technology Strategy and Architecture for Consumer Platform
Define and drive the technology strategy for Consumer Platform by partnering with Business Leadership and broader Intuit TechEcosystem to accelerate the business growth aspirations. Ensure technical governance of technologies being developed and partner with others to deliver end to end solutions. Evaluate solution designs to confirm technical feasibility, alignment with business objectives, and incorporation of critical non-functional requirements. Use, integrate, identify gaps and propose solutions across all technology assets in the company to ensure we have a cohesive platform. Emphasize development of AI Native solutions which leverage AI to the fullest extent to deliver customer benefit

Boundaryless Collaboration
Able to operate in a complex org structure and collaborating with multiple stakeholders globally. Partner with business and technology teams to prioritize roadmaps, requirements, balancing business needs with financial and technology constraints. Establish alignment of vision, strategy & delivery working with cross-functional teams (PM, PD, XD, Care..) and stakeholders, including senior leaders across geographies.

Operational & Engineering Excellence
Establish and improve engineering and operational excellence efforts across the Consumer Platform that drive a productive environment for developers and high availability for our customers. Result-oriented and deliver huge outcomes. Sets clear objectives and goals for the team and enables the team to deliver and use operating mechanisms to continually assess progress and improve. Establishes the data driven processes needed to achieve operational & engineering excellence. Foster Engineering culture within the team and across organizations.

Build a high-performance culture
Grow and coach engineering talent, acts as a talent magnet to attract, nurture and retain senior talent including Engineering Directors, managers, engineers, and architects. Develops and drives strategy to hire, develop and mobilize talent for the organization.

Speed as a Habit
Can operate in a fast-moving environment, make quick data driven customer backed decisions and execute fiercely to deliver outcomes.

Customer Obsession
Is a staunch advocate for the developers and customers. Stays close to customer problems and solves for them with urgency.

Qualifications

15+ years of product and platform development experience with BS/MS in computer science or equivalent
3+ years in a leadership, managing and coaching globally distributed teams and influencing third party technology strategy
Demonstrated outstanding craft delivering SaaS at scale
Demonstrated experience and expertise is developing full stack applications across multiple areas from architecture, services, applications, data, analytics, AI and marketing technologies
Demonstrated ability to deliver customer outcomes with AI and data powered experiences
Track record of developing high performing organizations and working in a highly collaborative environment across multiple organizations
Demonstrated to operate with high level objectives and deliver with velocity
Demonstrated ability to deliver bold, innovative outcomes
Demonstrated ability to drive big transformations - organizational, technology, business outcomes. Able to operate strategically and tactically in the details
Exceptional business acumen, strategic thinking, and ability to identify patterns and opportunities across a complex ecosystem of products and services
Have a firm understanding of systems engineering and high-availability design.
Experience in operating at different levels of altitude across the entire software development lifecycle
Skilled in creating strong partnerships, influencing stakeholders, and driving business outcomes across data, product, marketing, and sales
Demonstrates ability to research & learn new technologies and business processes independently and apply them as needed.
Passion for facilitative leadership, collaboration and lead teams across boundaries.
Demonstrated ability to communicate and collaborate at all levels - from front line engineers to senior leaders and executive leadership

Footer

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position will be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). jobs.title: Principal Engineer / Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Principal Engineer / Director of Engineering

$250,000 - $275,000+ base + equity | San Francisco Bay Area | Predominantly in-person

SODA has partnered with a neurotechnology company developing software and medical technology used in brain health treatment. The first generation of the technology works and is already being used with patients. Your challenge is to decide what comes next.

This is a senior technical role for someone who wants architectural ownership, not a calendar dominated by people management. You’ll inherit a complex system spanning brain imaging, cloud infrastructure, distributed processing, algorithms and medical devices, then define its next generation.

The Opportunity

The initial application focuses on depression. The longer term technical challenge is building a modular architecture capable of supporting many future applications across neurological and psychiatric conditions.

You’ll work directly with the founders, remain close to the engineering and lead an initial team of around five engineers. The architecture isn’t predetermined. You’ll understand what exists, decide what needs to change and lead the work to build it.

What You'll Do

Build a technical understanding of the system from brain scan to stimulation
Define the architecture for the next generation of the technology
Architect an MVP designed to support multiple future clinical applications
Turn architectural decisions into a clear engineering roadmap
Lead execution while remaining close to difficult technical problems
Guide an initial engineering team of around five people
Partner with founders on major technical and product decisions

What You'll Bring

Essential:

Deep software engineering and architectural problem-solving ability
Experience designing complex cloud, distributed or data-intensive systems
Technical leadership experience while remaining close to engineering
Ability to understand interconnected systems and make sound architectural trade-offs

Desirable:

Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux and Python
Exposure to regulated software, healthcare or medical devices
Experience with imaging, MRI/DICOM, scientific computing or C#

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement. The right mindset matters as much as the right CV.

What's In It For You

$275,000+ base salary plus equity
Ownership of an architecture that hasn't yet been defined
Direct technical partnership with the founding team
Complex engineering spanning software, compute, imaging and physical devices
Technology already being used to support patient treatment

Interested?

If you’re a Principal Engineer ready for broader technical ownership, or a Director who still wants to engineer, this role sits deliberately between those paths.

You’ll inherit something that works. The opportunity is to understand it, challenge it and architect what it becomes next.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Safety
jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games.
Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord only works at our scale if people feel safe showing up — and building the systems that make that possible is exactly what our Safety engineering org does.

We classify content, route reports, make and audit enforcement decisions, and build the tools our operations partners use to handle everything automation doesn't. The work is a mix of deep backend infrastructure, AI-driven automation, and tight collaboration with the people who do nuanced review. As Discord grows into new surfaces like commerce and ads, the platform we build matters more.

We're hiring a Director of Engineering to lead Safety Infrastructure Engineering at Discord. The org is roughly 20 engineers across two teams with two EM direct reports. You'll report to the senior Director of Safety and work closely with T&S Operations, Safety ML, Safety Product, Legal, Policy, Security, and Core Tech.

What You'll Do

Lead and grow two engineering teams covering our safety backend: the decision platform, classification systems, content understanding, intake and routing pipelines, and observability
Drive the automation roadmap with Safety ML. Decide where AI belongs in the loop, where humans still win, and hold the line on quality, latency, and cost
Own the queue routing and internal tooling our ops teams and vendor partners rely on, and partner with T&S Operations on golden sets, QA, appeals, and evals that turn operational signal into better systems
Consolidate fragmented systems onto infra and set the bar for engineering quality: on-call, incident response, technical review, and ownership
Hire, coach, and grow senior leaders

Who You Are

5+ years as a software engineer with a strong backend and distributed systems background, and 5+ years as an EM including 2+ years managing managers. Experience running 20+ engineers through multiple EMs
Strong infrastructure instincts. You can hold your own in architecture discussions on event-driven systems, service migrations, and platform design
Fluent in AI and ML systems enough to partner credibly with an ML org and make good calls about where automation belongs in a decision pipeline
Experienced working closely with ops or human-in-the-loop teams. You get the rhythm of QA, calibration, appeals, and ground-truth work, and build tools that respect the people using them
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, with a history of partnering effectively across engineering, ML, data science, policy, legal, and product teams.
Practical about throughput, vendor management, and unit economics
An empathetic and experienced recruiter and coach. People you've managed want to work with you again

Bonus

A strong passion for Discord and/or gaming, and an appreciation for the communities we serve.
Trust & Safety, fraud, integrity, or abuse engineering at a consumer platform
Building ML platforms, MLOps, or automated decisioning at scale
Managing vendor-based ops (BPO, content review, third-party tools), or building internal tools where ops or review teams are the primary user
Payments, fraud, or commerce infra

Candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area (Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano, and Sonoma counties). Relocation assistance may be available.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $400,000 to $450,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.

Why Discord?

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

jobs.description:
FIND YOUR MISSION

Missions are accomplished with people, driving towards a greater purpose. At ClearCo, our mission is to help our 3000+ clients achieve theirs. When talking to our own team of A players, you’ll find that it’s not only the opportunity to drive this mission forward that keeps us thriving. It’s the freedom, flexibility, and support ClearCo provides which contributes to our professional development and the pursuit of our personal missions and passions outside of work. Learn more about our state of the art, cloud-based talent platform and why you should consider joining us here.

SENIOR TECHNICAL SOFTWARE ENGINEERING MANAGER

Finding, engaging and retaining top talent is challenging in today’s work environment. We should know because we’ve been helping small and medium-sized businesses do just that through our unique talent management SaaS platform for almost twenty years. As a leader in talent management software, we’ve also learned a thing or two about what it takes to run an amazing company. So if you’re looking to join an organization that cares about its engineers, believes team collaboration is a better way to problem solve, and provides a supportive environment where you can advance your career, come join our engineering team at ClearCo! We’re a rapidly growing and financially stable company with a bright future and lots of opportunities.
The salary for this role will be between $175,000-$195,000 depending on experience.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Reporting to the Director of Software Engineering, as a Senior Technical Software Engineering Manager at ClearCo, you will join our talented, collaborative, and inclusive engineering team to help grow our team’s capabilities to expand our best-in-class HR platform. Our team has a diverse set of backgrounds and perspectives, which has helped us build the amazing culture that we have today. That culture, along with our core value of “Listen to Many, Execute as One”, has enabled us to not only create an excellent technical platform but also an environment where everyone’s voice can be heard. We’re very proud of the culture we’ve built.
In this role, you will:

Lead the engineering team responsible for our Platform Architecture and Shared Services that span technologies, frameworks, and other components that contribute to the application development ecosystem.
Analyze existing systems and processes to identify bottlenecks and opportunities for improvements.
Contribute to long term vision and the strategy to achieve the vision for the technology organization.
Lead collaboration across technology teams to foster innovation and follow guidelines around re-usability of frameworks and governance of architecture patterns.
Own and drive the engineering roadmap for the Platform team as we modernize our architecture from monolithic to services-oriented to support rapid growth.
Coach, mentor, and provide performance feedback to direct reports to help them further develop their skills and guide them on their career paths.
Design, test, code, and instrument new solutions (work on POCs as needed).
Collaborate with senior management to establish team policies, develop resource plans, and evaluate individual performance.
Partner with Product Management, UX, and Tech Leads to drive product innovation and technical excellence
Foster a collaborative, high-performing engineering culture that emphasizes continuous learning and growth

WHAT WE'D LIKE YOU TO HAVE

SaaS Architecture Expertise & Decision Making
: 10+ years’ of experience involved in building and supporting SaaS products at scale, with the ability to quickly make difficult architectural and technical decisions.
Modernization Leadership
: Software-first leader with 5+ years of people leadership experience who has modernized legacy codebases and platforms from reactive operations to proactive platform engineering.
AI-First Development
: Well-versed in AI-assisted and AI-first development practices, with hands-on experience using AI platforms to accelerate development, testing, code reviews, and security scans. Embraces AI and its potential to transform how we deliver high-quality products to our clients.
Culture of Experimentation
: Fosters an engineering environment that challenges the status quo, values experimentation, and fast follow-ups. Fosters a collaborative engineering culture that values continuous learning, mentorship, and innovation.
People and Project Management
: Possesses a track record of delivering complex projects on schedule while maintaining code quality and team well-being. Proven experience working with strong personalities, ensuring the team remains focused and on-track.

OUR TECHNOLOGY STACK

You’re probably wondering what we use for our tech stack, so we’ll list the major ones below.
Back-end: C#/.NET Core, Postgres, MySQL/Entity Framework, ElasticSearch, RabbitMQ, Redis
Front-end: React, TypeScript, WebSockets, Sass
AI tools: GitHub Copilot, Claude, Revo
Infrastructure: AWS using EC2, S3, Aurora...and the list goes on and on

WHAT YOU WILL LOVE ABOUT ClearCo

The people!
Our employees and customers consistently express the best thing about ClearCo is our close-knit, exceptionally talented team. Check out our G2 reviews to see what people are saying about our solutions.
A commitment to inclusion & belonging
. Engagement = Inclusion. Your uniqueness powers our vision of a world where organizations perform optimally with empowered managers and engaged employees. Not only will you transform how we do business, but you will be a catalyst to change the world of work for our 3,000+ customers.
Outstanding benefits
. Flexible vacation, medical/dental/vision, 401k with match, and even pet insurance. We’ve got your back so you can live your best life. See the full list here.
It's about Listening to Many and Executing as One
: We listen to many voices then we stack hands and move forward as one team. Learn more about all our core values here
Professional growth
. We have promoted 24% of our team members annually compared to 11% across the industry and open new roles to our employees first.
Our environment!
We celebrate success and believe in transparency and teamwork to get us there. We invest in collaboration tools so you can meet with your team face to face. You can even drop in for a virtual coffee break, connect with your ClearCo mentor, or jump into a training session with our Learning Managers. Learn more here or check out our Great Places to Work Certification and Glassdoor reviews

Day (United States of America)

Advance a partner and automation-enabled operating model.
Lead infrastructure and security architecture direction and roadmap investments.

jobs.title: VP, Design - Virtual Expert Platform
jobs.description:
Overview

Intuit is a global platform company that is on a mission to power prosperity around the world for consumers and businesses. Across our leading brands – Turbo Tax, Credit Karma, QuickBooks, and Mailchimp
– Intuit serves over 100M customers and is one of the few companies in the world to have both a thriving consumer and business ecosystem. Intuit is known for its innovation track record, customer centricity, and its consistent recognition as a top place to work.

Intuit Customer Success (ICS) is evolving from a traditional support function into a core growth and experience engine for Intuit. As part of our AI-powered, services-led platform strategy, ICS orchestrates advanced AI capabilities and human expertise to deliver “done-for-you” experiences that drive revenue growth, deepen customer confidence, and strengthen long-term retention across the Intuit ecosystem. Powered by the world’s largest expert network and the Virtual Expert Platform (VEP)
, we are embedding AI + HI directly into the customer journey to create a durable competitive advantage.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an innovative, AI-native VP of Design
to provide executive leadership across ICS and VEP - the organization shaping how AI and human expertise work together to power a multi-billion-dollar services ecosystem and unlock an incremental $10B growth opportunity for Intuit.

This leader will ensure that our capabilities are delivered as a coherent platform while enabling high-impact, end-to-end service experiences through world-class service design. You will lead an integrated design organization spanning platform product design and service design—along with research, design technology, operations, and design labs - aligning platform capability development, embedded service experiences, and go-to-market strategy into a unified system that drives adoption and growth.

This isn’t just a leadership role; it is an opportunity to architect the future of AI-powered, expert-driven financial services and redefine how millions of customers access trusted expertise by leading the platform design for the intersection of AI + HI.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

This is a high-impact executive role where you will own the end-to-end design strategy for our global expert and customer experiences.

Platform Product Design: Lead the design for the core capabilities used widely across the Intuit ecosystem by both customers and experts.
Service Design Enablement: Orchestrate complex, end-to-end service journeys that connect consumers, small businesses, and accountants with experts in real-time. Drive service design across ICS to ensure AI and HI (Human Intelligence) experiences are cohesive, scalable, and effective across virtual and embedded models.
Vision & Strategy: Champion a bold, long-term vision for customer and experience experiences.
Design at Scale: Lead a massive design organization in building component libraries and design systems that power innovation across all Intuit offerings.
ICS Expert Studio Oversight: Oversee the Expert Studio that supports service adoption, business growth, and deep customer understanding.
Influence & Partner: Act as a strategic partner to key stakeholders across every segment of Intuit, balancing short-term execution with long-term Design-driven innovation.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and ICS leaders to define strategy and deliver end-to-end (E2E) experiences.
Inspire and Coach: Lead and grow a high-performance culture of designers, fostering a culture of innovation, creativity, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Impact & Key Metrics

Platform Adoption: Measure the usability and effectiveness of VEP-powered experiences embedded across Intuit products.
Growth Outcomes: Drive increased customer engagement, confidence, and adoption of expert-led services.
AI + HI Effectiveness: Improve customer resolution rates and expert productivity through optimized AI-powered workflows.
Experience Quality: Deliver measurable improvements in clarity and consistency across all ICS service journeys.

Qualifications

We are looking for a dynamic, passionate leader who can thrive in a fast-paced, complex environment.

Platform Leadership: Deep experience designing and scaling end-to-end platform experiences that connect multiple products into a unified ecosystem, anchored by strong design systems.
Service Design: Lead service design experiences, tying together the entire ecosystem and all the invisible strings that make a customer’s experience work.
Design Craft & Holistic Design Approach: You bring a passion for design excellence, valuing interaction, visual, content, motion, and research - and know how to unify them into cohesive systems.
Customer-Obsession: You anchor strategy in customer needs and outcomes, balancing vision with measurable impact.
Strategic Leadership & Influence: Comfortable influencing across all levels of the organization with both, well-informed perspectives.
AI & Conversational Mastery: Familiarity with web, mobile, and conversational technologies and how they impact the feasibility of AI-driven design solutions.
Strategic Storytelling: Masterful ability to visualize complex concepts and articulate a strategic vision that inspires developers, partners, and customers alike.

Footer

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position will be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

San Diego $338,000 - $457,500

jobs.title: VP Enterprise Technology
jobs.description:
Serena & Lily

VP, Enterprise Technology

Technology Leadership Role – Vice President Level |Full-Time | Remote

Serena & Lily is investing in its enterprise systems as a strategic priority — improving how the business plans, sources, manages product information, and operates across merchandising and finance. The VP, Enterprise Technology owns the systems and teams at the center of that effort: ERP (NetSuite), Merchandising, Planning, Product Information Management (PIM), FP&A, and the integrations connecting them to the digital channel and supply chain. Reporting to the SVP, Technology, this role provides a single accountable leader for the reliability, delivery, and ongoing evolution of this portfolio.
This is a people-first engineering leadership role. The VP builds and develops the team, partners deeply with Merchandising, Planning, and Pricing business leaders to understand process needs, and drives the implementation and ongoing support of the enterprise systems portfolio. Strong engineering judgment combined with genuine understanding of how these business domains work — and what good looks like for the business — is what defines success in this role.

Primary Responsibilities

Enterprise Systems Operations & Delivery

Own the delivery and ongoing support of the enterprise business application portfolio — ERP (NetSuite), Merchandising, Assortment Planning, PIM, and FP&A — partnering closely with business stakeholders to translate process requirements into reliable, scalable solutions.
Lead or participate in the evaluation, selection, and implementation of business systems — PLM, PIM, Assortment Planning, and FP&A tools — managing requirements, vendor assessment, integration design, and go-live execution in support of the company’s enterprise systems strategy.
Leverage and optimize agentic AI engines across the software delivery pipeline, building on what’s already been adopted and accelerating adoption across engineering.
Ensure reliability, data integrity, and security across enterprise systems and integrations; partner with DevOps / Infrastructure and Enterprise Architecture on observability, deployment pipelines, and environment management.
Contribute to the multi-year technology roadmap alongside Enterprise Architecture; participate in the technical evaluation and selection of software platforms, tools, and vendor partners — assessing architectural fit, integration complexity, and long-term supportability.

Engineering Leadership & Team Development

Lead, coach, and grow the Enterprise Systems engineering organization — spanning ERP, Merchandising and Planning systems, and business application integrations — building a capable, engaged team bench.
Develop engineering managers and technical leads; define clear roles, levels, and growth paths.
Cultivate an engineering culture of ownership, craftsmanship, and continuous improvement.
Protect run-and-operate capacity for always-on business systems (NetSuite / ERP, Merchandising, Planning, PIM, and integrations) so project and implementation work does not starve operations.
Drive predictable delivery — improving throughput, release predictability, and first-time quality.
Own hiring, performance management, career development, leveling, and succession across the engineering function; set a high bar for technical excellence and accountability.
Own the engineering budget — headcount, tooling, vendor contracts, and capex / opex allocation — in partnership with Finance and the SVP, Technology.

Quality & Engineering Health

Partner with Quality Engineering to embed quality into engineering teams — agentic automated testing, clear definitions of done, and shared quality tooling — rather than relying on a downstream QA gate.
Establish and monitor engineering health metrics (delivery flow, defect rates, reliability, and technical debt).

Cross-Functional Partnership

Serve as the primary technology partner for Merchandising, Planning, and Finance / FP&A leaders — translating business process requirements into technical solutions, aligning on priorities, and driving the operability improvements that support the company’s strategic goals.
Collaborate with TechOps & Security, Data, and business stakeholders to deliver measurable business outcomes.
Serve as a senior escalation point for major production incidents affecting digital or enterprise systems.
Manage ongoing relationships with key technology vendors and partners — including contract renewals, roadmap alignment, and escalation — to protect platform continuity and leverage.

Measures of Success

Technical Depth & Craft: measurable growth in technical depth and craft across the organization — reflected in the complexity of systems teams can own and the consistency of modern engineering practices in everyday use.
Talent & Team Health: a deep, well-developed engineering bench with strong retention, engagement, and a healthy leadership pipeline.
Operational Reliability and Observability: high availability and performance across storefront, ERP, and infrastructure, with measurable progress in logging, alerting, and incident response through standardized observability tooling.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.
15+ years of software engineering experience, with 5+ years leading engineering teams and managing managers at scale.
Proven track record building and developing high-performing engineering teams supporting business-critical applications, with demonstrated skill developing managers, growing talent, and creating accountability at scale.
Familiarity with modern application architecture (API-first, cloud-native, headless integrations) and how these patterns apply to connecting enterprise business systems with commerce and digital channels.
Experience participating in software and vendor selection — defining evaluation criteria, running structured assessments, and making build-vs-buy recommendations; familiarity with eCommerce compliance requirements including PCI-DSS and CCPA.
Strong command of modern cloud architecture (AWS preferred), CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and observability.
Deep experience with enterprise / ERP systems (NetSuite strongly preferred) and business applications in a retail or DTC context — including Merchandising, Assortment Planning, PIM, or FP&A platforms.
Experience leading or contributing to the implementation of business systems such as PLM, PIM, Assortment Planning, or FP&A platforms — including requirements gathering, vendor selection, integration design, and rollout.
Retail, consumer products, or DTC eCommerce experience strongly preferred.

Skills & Attributes

A leader who centralizes for commonality and leverage, not control — builds shared capability while keeping teams fast and autonomous.
Excellent people leader who develops talent, builds trust, and sets a high bar with empathy.
Strong systems thinker who balances run-the-business reliability with build-the-future delivery.
Clear communicator who translates fluently between engineering and business stakeholders.
Passionate about engineering craft, quality, and continuous improvement.

Compensation

$230-250k per year is the anticipated starting base pay for this role. This range represents the low and high end of the anticipated base salary range for this role. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as experience, education, and skills.
This role is eligible for performance-based bonus compensation and equity
Employees (and their families) are covered by medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance should they choose to participate in Serena & Lily's benefits. Employees can enroll in our company's 401k plan. During the first year of employment, full-time employees accrue twenty-one days of PTO and seven paid holidays throughout the year.

About Serena & Lily

Serena & Lily is a design-driven home furnishings company founded on the principle that beautiful, expertly crafted products should be accessible to all. We create furniture, bedding, lighting, and décor that elevates everyday life. With a commitment to quality, sustainability, and exceptional customer experience, we have grown into a beloved lifestyle brand trusted by customers across North America.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Serena & Lily is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description

Associate Director, IT Commercial Sales Data and Analytics

Gilead Sciences, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company that has pursued and achieved breakthroughs in medicine for more than three decades, with the goal of creating a healthier world for all people. The company is committed to pursuing scientific invention to prevent and treat life-threatening diseases, including HIV, Viral hepatitis and Cancer. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering, Plant Control
jobs.description:
About Helion

We are a fusion power company based in Everett, WA, with the mission to build the world's first fusion power plant, enabling a future with unlimited clean electricity. Our vision is a world with clean, reliable, and affordable energy for everyone.

Since Helion's founding in 2013, we have raised $1.5 billion from long-time investors such as Sam Altman, Mithril, and Capricorn Investment Group as well as new investors including Thrive Capital, LightSpeed Venture Capital, SoftBank, and others to propel us forward. Our current prototype, Polaris, has reached record-breaking plasma temperatures of 150 million degrees Celsius (13 keV). Helion is continuing to iterate and on the path to the world's first fusion power plant, Orion.

This is a pivotal time to join Helion. You will tackle real-world challenges with a team that prizes urgency, rigor, ownership, and a commitment to delivering hard truths – values essential to achieving what no one has before. Together, we will change the future of energy, because the world can't wait.

Why This Role Matters

A Fusion power plant only produces useful results if something can control it, observe it, and make sense of what it did. The means firmware on the controllers that fire the pulses, supervisory automation that coordinates the machine as a system, the network and infrastructure backbone, and data pipelines that capture events spanning nanoseconds to years. The machine and facility are first of their kind, which means the software is too.

You will lead and scale the team that builds it. This means more than just hiring the right people. It means establishing software engineering as a core functional discipline by creating processes that enable the team to do their best work and building the structure around how software and hardware teams interact at Helion.

What You Will Be Doing

Lead and grow the Plant Control Software team, a multidisciplinary team across firmware, application software, networking, infrastructure, and cybersecurity.
Own delivery of the plant control software stack across its embedded, supervisory, networking, and data layers.
Partner closely with electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, fuel cycle, systems engineering, operations, and science. Our software ships against hardware on a shared schedule and the coordination across those boundaries is a core responsibility.
Establish the engineering principles that will be the foundation for this team as it grows including how it plans, reviews, tests, deploys, responds to faults, and hands off to operations.

Required Skills

10+ years of experience building complex control systems for hardware 3+ years of experience in a leadership role building and managing a multidisciplinary software team (software engineers, firmware/embedded engineers, with a diversity of level from early career to senior).
Depth in real-time, embedded, or control software for physical systems, sufficient to hold technical direction with a senior team.
A track record of delivering software against hardware on a shared schedule in an environment where the hardware is the product.
Experience hiring, and growing engineers over time.
The ability to work fluently across disciplinary boundaries with electrical engineers, mechanical engineers, systems engineers, operators, and scientists.
A degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Benefits

Our total compensation package includes benefits, including but not limited to:

Medical, Dental, and Vision plans for employees and their families
31 Days of PTO (21 vacation days and 10 sick days)
10 Paid holidays, plus company-wide winter break
Up to 5% employer 401(k) match
Short term disability, long term disability, and life insurance
Paid parental leave and support (up to 16 weeks)
Annual wellness stipend

Helion is an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the interview process, please let us know.

Compensation Range: $250K - $290K

jobs.title: VP of Technology - Head Architect, TurboTax
jobs.description:
Overview

We are the largest provider of tax preparation software and services with TurboTax serving ~35M households and over 140M members trust Credit Karma with their financial profile. We're searching for an experienced, innovative VP of Technology (Engineering) leader - as a Head Architect - who has deep SaaS experience delivering new products and experiences to the market that will be loved by millions of users. In this role, the leader will lead the Consumer Platform that enables Intuit to power the prosperity of consumers by serving their needs at various points in their financial journey, from tax to credit to saving on expenses to access to money and growing wealth. Consumer Platform, oriented around the pillars of Tax, Personal Finance, and Money, will focus on helping consumers lift the burden of tax prep with AI and assisted tax prep and lay the foundation to create a year-round relationship centered on money benefits, financial products, and financial guidance.

Consumer Platform is powered by world-class Tax (TurboTax and ProTax) and Credit Karma capabilities. This leader will propel a high-performing team to its next phase of growth. This individual will rely on their business acumen, strategic thinking, hands-on technical/coding experience, AI proficiency and experience, and data skills to drive customer and business outcomes at scale. They will be comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, balancing precision with speed. They will leverage their expertise to guide and inspire the team, attract, and develop top talent, and be both a business leader and technology leader.

What You'll Do Here

We are looking for a Head Architect - Vice President, Technology, to lead architecture for the Consumer Platform. We are looking for a leader that has a passion for solving e2e problems for developers and customers. This role will report to the SVP of Engineering
As a hands-on technical leader, you will own and drive the overall architecture for Consumer Platform by translating business strategy into a durable technology strategy, with a deeper focus and ownership of Tax Platform capabilities. You will do so in close partnership with business leadership, Tax and Credit Karma PD teams, functional teams and broader Intuit TechEcosystem
Be the talent stewards of Distinguished Engineers and Principal Engineers in the organization by defining their focus areas in partnership with PD leadership and coaching them

Responsibilities

Technology Strategy and Architecture for Consumer Platform
Define and drive the technology strategy for Consumer Platform by partnering with Business Leadership and broader Intuit TechEcosystem to accelerate the business growth aspirations. Ensure technical governance of technologies being developed and partner with others to deliver end to end solutions. Evaluate solution designs to confirm technical feasibility, alignment with business objectives, and incorporation of critical non-functional requirements. Use, integrate, identify gaps and propose solutions across all technology assets in the company to ensure we have a cohesive platform. Emphasize development of AI Native solutions which leverage AI to the fullest extent to deliver customer benefit

Boundaryless Collaboration
Able to operate in a complex org structure and collaborating with multiple stakeholders globally. Partner with business and technology teams to prioritize roadmaps, requirements, balancing business needs with financial and technology constraints. Establish alignment of vision, strategy & delivery working with cross-functional teams (PM, PD, XD, Care..) and stakeholders, including senior leaders across geographies.

Operational & Engineering Excellence
Establish and improve engineering and operational excellence efforts across the Consumer Platform that drive a productive environment for developers and high availability for our customers. Result-oriented and deliver huge outcomes. Sets clear objectives and goals for the team and enables the team to deliver and use operating mechanisms to continually assess progress and improve. Establishes the data driven processes needed to achieve operational & engineering excellence. Foster Engineering culture within the team and across organizations.

Build a high-performance culture
Grow and coach engineering talent, acts as a talent magnet to attract, nurture and retain senior talent including Engineering Directors, managers, engineers, and architects. Develops and drives strategy to hire, develop and mobilize talent for the organization.

Speed as a Habit
Can operate in a fast-moving environment, make quick data driven customer backed decisions and execute fiercely to deliver outcomes.

Customer Obsession
Is a staunch advocate for the developers and customers. Stays close to customer problems and solves for them with urgency.

Qualifications

15+ years of product and platform development experience with BS/MS in computer science or equivalent
3+ years in a leadership, managing and coaching globally distributed teams and influencing third party technology strategy
Demonstrated outstanding craft delivering SaaS at scale
Demonstrated experience and expertise is developing full stack applications across multiple areas from architecture, services, applications, data, analytics, AI and marketing technologies
Demonstrated ability to deliver customer outcomes with AI and data powered experiences
Track record of developing high performing organizations and working in a highly collaborative environment across multiple organizations
Demonstrated to operate with high level objectives and deliver with velocity
Demonstrated ability to deliver bold, innovative outcomes
Demonstrated ability to drive big transformations - organizational, technology, business outcomes. Able to operate strategically and tactically in the details
Exceptional business acumen, strategic thinking, and ability to identify patterns and opportunities across a complex ecosystem of products and services
Have a firm understanding of systems engineering and high-availability design.
Experience in operating at different levels of altitude across the entire software development lifecycle
Skilled in creating strong partnerships, influencing stakeholders, and driving business outcomes across data, product, marketing, and sales
Demonstrates ability to research & learn new technologies and business processes independently and apply them as needed.
Passion for facilitative leadership, collaboration and lead teams across boundaries.
Demonstrated ability to communicate and collaborate at all levels - from front line engineers to senior leaders and executive leadership

Footer

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position will be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The Expected Base Pay Range For This Position Is

Mountain View $384,500 - $520,500

jobs.title: VP, Design - Virtual Expert Platform
jobs.description:
Overview

Intuit is a global platform company that is on a mission to power prosperity around the world for consumers and businesses. Across our leading brands – Turbo Tax, Credit Karma, QuickBooks, and Mailchimp
– Intuit serves over 100M customers and is one of the few companies in the world to have both a thriving consumer and business ecosystem. Intuit is known for its innovation track record, customer centricity, and its consistent recognition as a top place to work.

Intuit Customer Success (ICS) is evolving from a traditional support function into a core growth and experience engine for Intuit. As part of our AI-powered, services-led platform strategy, ICS orchestrates advanced AI capabilities and human expertise to deliver “done-for-you” experiences that drive revenue growth, deepen customer confidence, and strengthen long-term retention across the Intuit ecosystem. Powered by the world’s largest expert network and the Virtual Expert Platform (VEP)
, we are embedding AI + HI directly into the customer journey to create a durable competitive advantage.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an innovative, AI-native VP of Design
to provide executive leadership across ICS and VEP - the organization shaping how AI and human expertise work together to power a multi-billion-dollar services ecosystem and unlock an incremental $10B growth opportunity for Intuit.

This leader will ensure that our capabilities are delivered as a coherent platform while enabling high-impact, end-to-end service experiences through world-class service design. You will lead an integrated design organization spanning platform product design and service design—along with research, design technology, operations, and design labs - aligning platform capability development, embedded service experiences, and go-to-market strategy into a unified system that drives adoption and growth.

This isn’t just a leadership role; it is an opportunity to architect the future of AI-powered, expert-driven financial services and redefine how millions of customers access trusted expertise by leading the platform design for the intersection of AI + HI.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

This is a high-impact executive role where you will own the end-to-end design strategy for our global expert and customer experiences.

Platform Product Design: Lead the design for the core capabilities used widely across the Intuit ecosystem by both customers and experts.
Service Design Enablement: Orchestrate complex, end-to-end service journeys that connect consumers, small businesses, and accountants with experts in real-time. Drive service design across ICS to ensure AI and HI (Human Intelligence) experiences are cohesive, scalable, and effective across virtual and embedded models.
Vision & Strategy: Champion a bold, long-term vision for customer and experience experiences.
Design at Scale: Lead a massive design organization in building component libraries and design systems that power innovation across all Intuit offerings.
