Chief Advancement Officer - College of Engineering
jobs.description:
Carnegie Mellon University (CMU) seeks a seasoned and inspirational fundraising professional to serve as the next Chief Advancement Officer (CAO) for the College of Engineering. Joining Dean Burcu Akinci at the outset of her tenure and serving as an integral member of the Dean’s senior management team, the CAO will provide bold strategic vision, leadership, and direction for all fundraising, alumni engagement, and stewardship activities for COE. This is a unique opportunity for a proven development professional to partner with a dynamic and energetic dean to further advance and deliver on the College’s mission.

The new CAO will join the College of Engineering at a moment of transition, working with a new dean who is a long-standing member of the College of Engineering in a variety of academic and leadership roles, and at a moment of reflection and reprioritization following the end of a comprehensive campaign. The CAO will serve as a key partner as the Dean frames and realizes her vision for COE, and will provide leadership and management for the vision, direction, planning, and execution of fundraising and alumni relations activities for the College. This individual will bring a thoughtful, proactive, collaborative, and entrepreneurial approach to leveraging COE’s existing relationships as well as positioning the Dean and other key leadership to connect with philanthropists, entrepreneurs, alumni, and business leaders who may not yet be engaged with the College.

The CAO will inherit a high-performing team specializing in individual gifts, corporate philanthropy, and foundation support, as well as alumni relations. The CAO will lead the team to launch systematic initiatives to identify and cultivate the next generation of donors – domestically and internationally – while maintaining and strengthening ties to existing donors and seeking out new philanthropic opportunities. The CAO will lead by example, carrying a personal portfolio of major gift prospects.

The CAO will be active and visible on campus and in the greater community and will possess a deep appreciation for and the ability to clearly articulate the role and importance of a research university, as well as the achievements and aspirations of COE, to a broad and diverse audience.

Core responsibilities include:

Advancement Strategy and Leadership

Provide leadership and management of the vision, direction, planning, and execution of fundraising and alumni engagement activities for the College of Engineering.
Serve as a senior advisor to the Dean and a key member of the College’s leadership team in shaping and implementing a comprehensive and effective advancement strategy.
Identify, articulate, and prioritize fundraising and engagement opportunities aligned with the College’s strategic objectives.
Set strategy for and support the Dean’s and senior faculty members’ advancement and external engagement activities.

Fundraising & External Engagement

Lead the cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship of individual and foundation donors in support of the College.
Personally manage a portfolio of major and principal gift prospects and donors, including alumni and philanthropic leaders.
Collaborate with faculty and academic leadership to translate research and educational strengths into compelling fundraising opportunities.
Engage with the Dean’s Advocacy Council, setting their collective sights on the new Dean’s priorities. Set strategy for recruitment, engagement, and stewardship of the College’s advisory boards, councils, and volunteer leaders.

Collaboration and Integration

Coordinate with central foundation relations, major gift officers, planned giving officers, CAOs of other colleges, and other teams to secure increased investment in the College of Engineering.
Collaborate closely with central university advancement departments, including donor relations, alumni relations, advancement services, and strategic philanthropic initiatives.
Partner with advancement information services to define, measure, and report on advancement outcomes and performance.
Closely liaise with the College’s Partnership Office to identify and interact with prospective donors who also represent industry and or government entities.

Operations, Reporting, and Management

Report on the results of all advancement activities related to the College of Engineering.
Manage the College’s interest in the University’s database of donors and prospects in alignment with University standards and systems.
Devise and implement metrics to measure the performance of the advancement activities within the College of Engineering.
Develop and manage the advancement office budget and allocate resources to support strategic priorities.

Team Leadership

Lead, coach, and evaluate the performance of professional and support staff engaged in advancement and alumni relations.
Build a high-performing, collaborative, and service-oriented advancement team.

The next CAO will have proven success leading development staff through the process of setting and achieving annual and long-range fundraising goals with an ability to transform new ideas into executable and enduring programs. The successful candidate must be a self-starter who operates with a sense of urgency and thinks strategically, analytically, and entrepreneurially, as well as a seasoned team leader adept at maximizing, leveraging, and advocating for a talented staff, and facilitating team success.

Lastly, the next CAO must possess a demonstrated commitment to the highest ethical standards and exhibit the credibility, maturity, and sophistication to effectively engage and partner with key internal and external stakeholders.

Qualifications:

At least ten years of progressively responsible advancement or development experience in higher education, with at least five years in a management or leadership role; experience in a campaign environment is strongly preferred.
Advanced knowledge of major gift fundraising, corporate and foundation giving, and comprehensive campaigns.
Demonstrated success in developing and managing relationships with deans, faculty leaders, volunteer leadership, and major donors or prospects.
Staff and program management experience in a complex organization.
Excellent writing, interpersonal, analytical, and organizational skills.
Ability to initiate, analyze, monitor, evaluate, and adapt strategic advancement plans to achieve revenue and engagement goals.
Cultural sensitivity and ability to work effectively with a diverse alumni and donor population, domestically and internationally.
In-depth knowledge of university governance, administration, and operations.
Strong supervisory, coaching, and mentoring skills.
High level of integrity, discretion, and sound judgment.
Energetic, self-motivated, adaptable, and collaborative leadership style.
Commitment to the mission and values of the University and the College of Engineering.
Bachelor’s degree required; master’s degree preferred or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Requirements:

Successful completion of a pre-employment background check

All applications, nominations, and inquiries are welcome. Applications should include a cover letter and resume.

You will cultivate, guide, and scale a dynamic organization focused on enterprise software, big data, healthcare interoperability (e.g., FHIR/HL7), clinical/claims analytics, real-world evidence (RWE), and medical AI/ML applications. Leading this specialized pre-sales engine, you will partner closely with Sales leadership to drive consumption, maximize ARR, and help healthcare providers, payers, and pharmaceutical organizations achieve transformational business and patient outcomes. You will scale and operate a world-class tier of field engineers to accelerate Databricks' dominance within the HLS vertical.

Vice President, Engineering

Toronto or RemoteFull-time

TL;DR

Company: Sensei Labs
Product: Conductor — the AI-powered operating system for strategic programs
Reports to: CTO
Team: 7 direct reports (4 software engineers, 2 quality engineers, and the Platform/DevOps team)
Partnering closely: 2-person Product team and 4-person GTM team
Location: [Toronto / remote]

About Us

Sensei Labs builds Conductor, an enterprise strategy execution platform that governs billions of dollars in program value across hundreds of enterprise programs. Our customers are Fortune 500 transformation offices, global consultancies, and private equity value creation teams. Conductor covers the full lifecycle from portfolio planning through benefits realization, with our Harmony AI layer woven into every surface rather than bolted on.

We've been in the market for more than ten years, we're SOC-2 compliant with a single-tenant architecture, and we do all of it with a deliberately small team. That's the interesting part of this job.

We launched a full rewrite of our Conductor platform a few months ago and are midway through the effort to reach Conductor Modern. Over the next year (or so), this will give us the chance to migrate all our customers and partners to the new version and sunset our old code.

The role

You'll own engineering execution for Conductor: how the team is structured, how work gets from idea to production, and how quickly and reliably we ship. You'll drive the technical strategy and architecture direction, and you'll own the machine that turns that direction into shipped software.

This is a hands-on leadership role, not a role that manages managers. With six engineers, you'll be in the code, in the reviews, and in the architecture discussions — while also being the person accountable for delivery, hiring, growth, and the team's day-to-day health. If you want a position where you can both set long-term strategy and have immediate day-to-day impact, this is the seat.

As part of our modernization, you’ll be directly involved in any remaining architectural and technical decisions for Conductor Modern and be a key part of planning for the customer migration and the ultimate sunsetting of the existing codebase.

This is the third leg of the Sensei Labs stool, along with our established Product and GTM leaders. You’ll work closely with them to shape and implement Product’s vision and to enable our GTM team to sell and deliver value to our customers and partners.

What You'll Own

Delivery. Planning, sequencing, and shipping against a roadmap you help build with Product. Predictable releases, visible progress, honest tradeoffs.
The team. Coaching and growing six engineers, running performance and career conversations, hiring as we scale, and keeping the bar high without burning people out.
Cloud platform and reliability. Architecture, scalability, cost, and operational excellence for a single-tenant enterprise SaaS platform. Uptime, performance, and security posture are yours. You'll lead our Platform/DevOps team alongside product engineering, setting direction for infrastructure and application architecture, performance and scalability, cloud cost management, and the tooling that the rest of engineering builds on. Uptime, operational excellence, and security posture are yours.
AI in the product. Partnering with Product on how Harmony AI evolves — agentic workflows, retrieval, evaluation, guardrails, and permission-aware AI behavior in an enterprise context.
AI in how we build. Making our SDLC substantially faster and more automated: AI-assisted coding, code review, and test generation; CI/CD; automated quality gates. We want an engineering org where a small team ships like a large one, and you'll be the one who builds that.
Engineering–Product partnership. Working shoulder to shoulder with Product on discovery, scope, and sequencing. You'll be expected to have opinions about the product, not just the plumbing.
Enterprise trust. Security, compliance, and the technical side of customer and prospect conversations when it matters.

What We're Looking For

Cloud infrastructure and application architecture at depth.

You've architected, built, and operated production cloud SaaS at meaningful scale — not just supervised it. You're fluent across both layers: the application architecture (service boundaries, data modeling, API design, and the patterns that keep a large codebase evolvable) and the infrastructure underneath it. Hands-on depth in Azure and/or GCP is essential, along with container orchestration on Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, networking and identity, and the observability and cost discipline that keep a cloud platform healthy as it grows. You understand multi-tenancy versus single-tenancy tradeoffs, data isolation, performance under enterprise load, and what "SOC-2 compliant" actually costs an engineering team.

Real product instinct.

You've worked in product-led environments where engineering shapes what gets built. You can push back on a spec, spot the simpler solution, and reason about customer value — especially in complex B2B software where the user is an enterprise operator, not a consumer.

Team leadership with your hands still dirty.

You've led and grown engineering teams (roughly 5–20 people) as a player-coach. You've hired well, given hard feedback, and relentlessly tuned the delivery process.

AI fluency, both directions.

You've shipped AI or LLM-backed features into production — and you've also rebuilt how a team works using AI-assisted development and automated SDLC tooling. You can tell the difference between AI that creates leverage and AI that creates cleanup work.

Startup temperament.

You're comfortable being both the strategist and the person who fixes the flaky test. You'd rather own an outcome than a headcount number.

Nice to have

Enterprise PPM, EPMO, transformation, or professional services domain experience
Experience with Microsoft 365 / SAP / Jira / Power BI integration ecosystems
Background in selling or supporting technical evaluations with Fortune 500 or PE buyers
Experience taking a mature product through an AI-era re-platforming or modernization

Your first year

By 90 days — you know the codebase, the team, and the roadmap; you've shipped something meaningful yourself; and you've given us a clear read on our biggest delivery and technical risks.
By 6 months — the development lifecycle is measurably faster, with AI-assisted workflows and automated quality gates that the team actually uses. Release cadence is predictable.
By 12 months — engineering is a genuine competitive advantage: shipping AI capability into Conductor at a pace that surprises much larger competitors, with a team that's grown in both size and capability.

Why this role

Small team, real enterprise customers, an established product, and an unusually good excuse to rebuild how software gets made. You won't be one VP among many, and you won't be managing a slide deck about AI transformation — you'll be doing it, on a product whose entire premise is helping large organizations actually execute.

You're as comfortable reviewing a PR or debugging a pipeline failure as you are setting quarterly roadmap priorities or presenting a platform strategy to senior leadership.

You think in systems - how pipelines, orchestration, governance, and observability connect to produce a trustworthy platform - and you know how to build a team that operates with both craft and urgency. You develop engineers, set a high technical bar, and create an environment where people grow.

Plans & Aligns - Ensures individual actions support company mission; communicates effectively; understands urgency and plans accordingly
Balances Stakeholders - Understands internal and external stakeholder requirements, expectations, and needs and acts fairly despite conflicting demands of stakeholders.
Influence and Leadership - fostering a community of knowledge-sharing, collaboration, mentorship, and forward-thinking across the organization.

Camaraderie - Day to day you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You’re an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others.
Openness - Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You’re curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others.
Grit - You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You’re committed, earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude.
Integrity - Simply put, do what you say and say what you'll do. You’re honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example.

Culture at Scribd, Inc.

We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

About The Team

Scribd’s Data Platform team builds the data pipelines, storage layers, and developer tooling that power analytics, experimentation, ML, and product features across Scribd, Everand, and Slideshare. We’re in the middle of a multi-year investment to modernize our data architecture, with a strong focus on building well-modeled, governed, and trusted data that teams across the company can rely on.

At Scribd, data drives everything—from product decisions and experimentation to understanding subscriber behavior and key business metrics. This role sits at the center of that effort and will play a critical part in shaping how data is structured, governed, and leveraged across the organization — including enabling trusted, well-governed data foundations for analytics and emerging AI-driven experiences.

About The Role

As a Senior Manager, Data Engineering, you'll lead a team responsible for building trusted, reusable data products that power analytics, experimentation, AI, and decision-making across Scribd.

This role combines technical leadership, engineering management, and execution leadership. You'll remain close to the technical work by guiding architecture, reviewing designs, and contributing hands-on where your expertise creates the greatest leverage. You'll establish engineering standards, guide architecture and design decisions, partner closely with stakeholders across the business, and help build a high-performing team that delivers trusted, reusable data products.

You'll work closely with our Principal Data Engineer, who leads the technical direction of our Platform Engineering function, while partnering with the Director of Data Platform on long-term strategy, organizational planning, and cross-functional priorities.

What You’ll Do

Provide technical, delivery, and people leadership for the Data Engineering team responsible for building data pipelines, trusted Medallion datasets, and reusable data products.
Establish engineering standards for data modeling, pipeline design, reliability, observability, and operational excellence.
Drive architecture discussions and design reviews, helping engineers make thoughtful technical decisions.
Lead execution across multiple concurrent initiatives by bringing clarity to ambiguous problems, partnering with technical leads to prioritize work, manage dependencies, and deliver predictable outcomes.
Coach, mentor, and grow a team of Data Engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Partner closely with Product, Analytics, Data Science, and Engineering teams to translate business needs into scalable data solutions.
Build strong cross-functional relationships while balancing short-term delivery with long-term investments in reusable data foundations.
Collaborate closely with Data Platform Engineering to influence and evolve the platform capabilities that enable scalable data development across Scribd.

You Have

10+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform, or related data roles.
3+ years leading engineering teams, including coaching, performance management, and organizational development.
Deep expertise building scalable data platforms and production-grade data pipelines.
Strong experience with dimensional modeling, data architecture, and designing reusable analytical datasets.
Advanced SQL skills and strong experience with Python, Scala, or similar programming languages.
Experience with distributed data processing frameworks such as Spark.
Experience working with modern cloud data platforms such as Databricks, Delta Lake, Snowflake, or BigQuery.
Proven experience driving complex cross-functional initiatives from concept through production.
Experience leading technical architecture discussions and engineering design reviews.
Strong technical judgment and the ability to balance pragmatic delivery with long-term architectural thinking.
Excellent communication skills and experience influencing technical decisions across multiple engineering teams.

Preferred Skills

Experience with Databricks and Delta Lake.
Experience building modern data platforms and Medallion-style architectures.
Experience with data governance, lineage, or metadata management.
Experience supporting AI, ML, or analytics workloads through high-quality data foundations.
Experience working in subscription, payments, or consumer product domains

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering - Procore AI Infrastructure & Operations
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a talented Senior Manager, Software Engineering to join Procore in its journey to revolutionize a historically underserved industry.

As a Senior Manager, Software Engineering at Procore, you will have the unique opportunity to lead and evolve our Procore AI Platform that is bringing the power of AI to the construction industry. We will be expanding our platform and infrastructure to support multiple jurisdictions and geographies. This role places you at the heart of our mission to expand into new regulated and international markets.

This position will report to our VP of Engineering, Procore AI organization. The position will be a three days per week hybrid role in our Austin office. We’re looking for someone to join us immediately.

This position requires US citizenship to work on FedRAMP-compliant projects. Candidates must be eligible to work on federal government projects requiring FedRAMP authorization.

What you’ll do:

Own the strategy, execution, and ongoing operation of Procore AI infrastructure and its expansion across geographic and sovereign zones — delivering the core capabilities to scale horizontally, automate delivery, and meet jurisdictional and regulatory requirements.
Manage a high-performing team of software and infrastructure engineers, supporting their professional and technical growth through constructive feedback, performance reviews, and career development support.
Lead the design and build-out of infrastructure (AWS and GCP) and repeatable deployment patterns to stand up Procore AI in new geographic and sovereign zones. This includes configuration-driven frameworks that make each new zone faster to launch, and CI/CD improvements that raise developer efficiency and operational maturity across the platform.
Partner closely with other Procore AI engineering teams to define integration requirements and accelerate the adoption of new platform features.
Drive architectural consistency across zones so new-region launches reuse a common, well-governed foundation rather than one-off builds.
Ensure each zone meets its data-residency, security, and regulatory requirements (e.g., FedRAMP/NIST 800-53, GDPR, regional sovereignty), partnering with security and compliance to achieve and maintain authorizations.
Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level objectives (SLOs) for the platform's reliability and scalability.
Collaborate across engineering and product teams to create infrastructure design documents and clear integration guides for engineering teams.

What we're looking for:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
8+ years of experience in software development with a solid background in infrastructure, operations, and scalable system architecture.
3+ years of experience managing diverse and geographically dispersed engineering teams, with a demonstrated commitment to leading high-performing teams, driving product deliverables, and supporting professional growth.
Deep, hands-on expertise in GCP and Kubernetes/GKE, utilizing Terraform for infrastructure-as-code. Familiarity with AWS environments is also required.
Proven track record building advanced continuous delivery systems and self-service capabilities that automate complex code and model deployments to streamline AI-first delivery velocity and reliability
Proven expertise architecting, operating, and scaling horizontal platforms or shared services using modern distributed-systems patterns, and defining modular, configuration-driven frameworks that reduce developer onboarding and integration time.
Proven experience managing day-to-day AI infrastructure, including orchestrating AI models, deploying autonomous agents in production, and implementing online evaluation frameworks to monitor LLM outputs and guardrails.
Solid understanding of data residency requirements, regional compliance frameworks, and vulnerability management to ensure secure data & AI operation in regulated environments.

Preferred Experience:

Experience with AI cost monitoring and optimization is a plus

Additional Information

Base Pay Range:

198,240.00 - 272,580.00 USD Annual

This role may also be eligible for Equity Compensation and/or Bonus Incentive Compensation. Procore is committed to offering competitive, fair, and commensurate compensation. Actual compensation will be based on a candidate’s job-related skills, experience, education or training, and location.

This position requires access to technology, software, and data that is controlled or restricted under U.S. law, regulation, executive order, or government contract.

For Los Angeles County (unincorporated) Candidates:

Procore will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the requirements of applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

A criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship on the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: 1. appropriately managing, accessing, and handling confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information, as well as accessing Procore's information technology systems and platforms; 2. interacting with and occasionally having unsupervised contact with internal/external customers, stakeholders, and/or colleagues; and 3. exercising sound judgment.

Area Vice President, Solutions Engineering
jobs.description:
Description

About the Role

We’re seeking a sharp, trusted, and highly autonomous Area Vice President, Solutions Engineering to help drive NinjaOne’s continued growth across the enterprise market. This is a builder role and an opportunity to help shape how we engage complex enterprise customers across the region while developing and guiding Solutions Engineers supporting the business. You will play a key role in defining technical engagement models, scaling enterprise technical wins, and setting the standard for pre-sales excellence across North America. As a player and coach, you will own the strategic technical relationship with prospects, customers, and partners while partnering closely with Enterprise Sales to influence deal strategy and drive measurable impact. You will lead and develop a team of Solutions Engineers while remaining hands-on in complex opportunities, ensuring customers clearly understand the value of the NinjaOne platform and how it supports their IT operations at scale. You will collaborate closely with Sales Leadership, Enablement, Product, and Customer teams to ensure alignment across the technical sales motion while helping build the playbooks, tools, and repeatable processes that allow the enterprise business to scale across the region.

Location:
Hybrid - Remote in Austin, TX

Travel:
~30%, including strategic customer meetings, industry events, and internal collaboration

What You’ll Be Doing

Own the full pre-sales technical experience across the enterprise space in North America, guiding prospects through evaluation, product demos, architecture design, and proof-of-concept stages
Collaborate closely with Account Executives and Sales Leadership to drive regional growth and align technical value to customer infrastructure and operational goals
Lead and mentor Solutions Engineers supporting the region while remaining hands-on in strategic deals, stepping into complex technical evaluations, architecture discussions, and proof-of-concept engagements where executive technical leadership is needed
Own the technical strategy, identifying repeatable technical patterns across opportunities and translating those insights into scalable pre-sales playbooks, demo standards, and enablement for the broader SE team
Partner with onboarding and Customer Success teams to accelerate time-to-value and ensure long-term adoption across large, distributed enterprise environments
Support the review and alignment of technical content within RFIs, and customer evaluation processes providing subject matter expertise without owning full proposal management
Serve as a strategic voice between Sales and Product surfacing regional customer feedback identifying feature gaps and influencing roadmap direction
Build and maintain reusable technical assets including lab environments, demo flows, battlecards, and scripts to support a scalable AE-to-SE model
Represent NinjaOne at regional industry events, conferences, and customer forums
Help shape the future of the Enterprise SE function contributing to playbooks, processes, and cross-functional alignment across the organization
Other duties as assigned

Technical Requirements

Proficiency in Windows environments, registry services performance troubleshooting
Familiarity with Linux and macOS systems and basic command-line troubleshooting
Strong understanding of networking concepts including DNS VPNs firewalls and endpoint protections
Hands-on experience with RMM tools ITSM platforms and endpoint lifecycle management
Scripting experience in PowerShell, JavaScript, and or VBScript is strongly preferred
Comfortable navigating complex IT ecosystems and integrating with existing infrastructure
Experience with Salesforce, Jira, Highspot, or equivalent systems

About You

10+ years in pre-sales engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting supporting enterprise B2B SaaS customers
Experience leading and developing Solutions Engineers while maintaining hands-on credibility in complex enterprise or public sector sales cycles

jobs.description:
Director of OT Engineering
Location: Spartanburg County, SC
Type: Direct Hire
The Position
Our client is seeking a Director of OT Engineering to lead the strategy, architecture, and delivery of the infrastructure platforms supporting mission-critical operational technology environments.
This role combines senior technical leadership with team management and long-term infrastructure planning. The Director will oversee the full OT infrastructure stack, including Active Directory, identity and access management, virtualization, enterprise storage, security appliances, backup and recovery, and platform services. The position requires a technically deep leader who understands how enterprise infrastructure technologies must be designed and operated differently within OT, ICS, and critical infrastructure environments.
Working closely with the Director of OT Cybersecurity and other operational leaders, this individual will ensure OT infrastructure is resilient, secure, scalable, and aligned with both operational requirements and cybersecurity standards.
Key Responsibilities
OT Infrastructure Strategy & Architecture
Define and execute the OT engineering strategy, architecture standards, and multi-year infrastructure roadmap.
Align infrastructure investments with operational reliability, cybersecurity, resiliency, scalability, and business objectives.
Establish technical standards and reference architectures across OT compute, identity, storage, virtualization, endpoint, and platform services.
Evaluate emerging technologies and determine appropriate adoption within highly controlled OT environments.
Lead major infrastructure modernization, lifecycle, and platform transformation initiatives.

Leadership & Team Development
Lead and develop a team of OT infrastructure, systems, endpoint, and platform engineers.
Provide technical direction, architectural oversight, coaching, and escalation support for complex engineering issues.
Establish clear engineering standards, operating procedures, documentation requirements, and technical governance.
Build team capability through mentoring, structured training, cross-training, and professional certification programs.
Support workforce planning, performance management, succession planning, and long-term team development.

Identity & Access Management
Own Active Directory architecture, administration, and governance across OT environments.
Lead hybrid identity strategy spanning Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.
Govern Group Policy, directory services, identity lifecycle management, service accounts, and privileged access.
Establish and maintain OT IAM standards including RBAC, MFA, Conditional Access, PAM, and Privileged Identity Management.
Ensure identity architecture supports OT security requirements without compromising operational availability.

Compute, Virtualization & Platform Engineering
Oversee OT virtualization and compute platforms including VMware vSphere/ESXi, Proxmox VE, and Kubernetes.
Define standards for clustering, high availability, capacity management, lifecycle management, and performance optimization.
Ensure platform architecture supports resilient and highly available OT workloads.
Provide technical oversight for private cloud, containerization, and next-generation infrastructure initiatives as appropriate.

Storage, Backup & Recovery
Own the OT storage strategy across SAN, NAS, object storage, and software-defined storage platforms.
Define backup, replication, retention, and recovery standards for critical OT workloads.
Lead disaster recovery and business continuity planning, testing, and execution for OT infrastructure.
Ensure recovery objectives are documented, tested, and aligned with operational risk requirements.

Security Infrastructure
Oversee the engineering and integration of security appliances supporting OT environments, including next-generation firewalls, NAC, IPS, and related platforms.
Partner with OT Cybersecurity leadership to ensure infrastructure architecture aligns with segmentation, access control, monitoring, and threat mitigation strategies.
Support deployment and governance of privileged access management platforms such as CyberArk, BeyondTrust, FortiPAM, or equivalent solutions.
Ensure infrastructure configurations align with IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, CIS Benchmarks, and internal security standards.

Operational Excellence & Governance
Establish and enforce configuration management, change control, patching, lifecycle, and documentation standards.
Ensure infrastructure changes are implemented safely within mission-critical and production-sensitive OT environments.
Drive capacity planning, infrastructure health monitoring, performance management, and technical risk reduction.
Support observability and monitoring capabilities using platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic, or similar technologies.
Maintain accurate architecture diagrams, configuration documentation, standards, and operating procedures.

Vendor, Budget & Executive Leadership
Manage strategic vendor relationships, licensing, support agreements, procurement, and technical service providers.
Own or contribute to OT engineering budgets, forecasting, capital planning, and technology investment decisions.
Lead vendor evaluations, contract negotiations, and platform selection initiatives.
Provide executive-level reporting on infrastructure health, availability, capacity, risk, roadmap progress, and major engineering initiatives.
Lead cross-functional initiatives involving OT engineering, cybersecurity, networking, operations, facilities, and other technical teams.

Required Qualifications
15+ years of infrastructure engineering experience, including 8+ years supporting OT, ICS, industrial, or other critical infrastructure environments.
Significant leadership experience managing senior infrastructure, systems, or platform engineering teams.
Expert-level experience designing and governing Microsoft Active Directory within complex enterprise or OT environments.
Deep experience with hybrid identity platforms including Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, Entra Connect, and privileged identity management.
Strong experience designing and supporting OT security infrastructure including next-generation firewalls, NAC, and IPS technologies.
Advanced experience with VMware vSphere/ESXi, Proxmox VE, or comparable enterprise virtualization technologies.
Strong knowledge of enterprise storage technologies including SAN, NAS, Ceph, backup, replication, and disaster recovery platforms.
Production experience supporting Kubernetes or containerized infrastructure.
Strong understanding of OT/ICS architecture, segmentation, industrial environments, and operational availability requirements.
Working knowledge of IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, CIS Benchmarks, and related cybersecurity standards.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex infrastructure programs involving multiple technical and operational teams.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with PAM platforms such as CyberArk, BeyondTrust, FortiPAM, or equivalent.
Experience with Palo Alto, Fortinet, or similar enterprise security platforms.
Familiarity with OpenStack or other private cloud technologies.
Hands-on experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic, or related observability platforms.
Director-level budget ownership, procurement, and vendor negotiation experience.
Experience operating within NERC CIP, IEC 62443, or similarly regulated critical infrastructure environments.
Certifications such as VCP, CKA, CISSP, Microsoft infrastructure certifications, or equivalent.

Since 2003, Entrata has evolved from a visionary, student-led startup into a global leader in AI-driven property management technology. Today, we power the industry's most essential operating system, serving owners and residents worldwide through a comprehensive suite of intelligent leasing, payment, and communication tools powered by cutting-edge AI. At Entrata, we create an environment where different perspectives are valued and respected. Those perspectives challenge assumptions, strengthen our decisions, and raise the bar as we reshape the global living experience through AI-powered solutions.

Director of Engineering Payments provides strategic leadership and operational oversight for software engineering teams responsible for Entrata’s payments platform and money-movement capabilities. . About Us:

webAI is pioneering the future of artificial intelligence by establishing the first distributed AI infrastructure dedicated to personalized AI. We recognize the evolving demands of a data-driven society for scalability and flexibility, and we firmly believe that the future of AI lies in distributed processing at the edge, bringing computation closer to the source of data generation. Our mission is to build a future where a company's valuable data and intellectual property remain entirely private, enabling the deployment of large-scale AI models directly on standard consumer hardware without compromising the information embedded within those models. We are developing an end-to-end platform that is secure, scalable, and fully under the control of our users, empowering enterprises with AI that understands their unique business. We are a team driven by truth, ownership, tenacity, and humility
, and we seek individuals who resonate with these core values and are passionate about shaping the next generation of AI.

About the Role:

This person will lead a highly skilled team of engineers who work directly with our most strategic customers to deploy, configure and integrate our technology into complex environments. Sitting at the intersection of engineering, product and customer success, you’ll play a critical role in bridging the gap between what we build and how it’s delivered. You’ll shape deployment strategy, drive technical excellence, and ensure we consistently deliver high-impact solutions that meet real-world customer needs. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who thrives in dynamic, customer-facing environments and is passionate about scaling both people and processes.

Lead and manage the Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team, ensuring effective collaboration between engineering and client-facing functions.
Oversee project scoping, deployment, and customization of core technology at customer sites or in virtual deployments.

Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to deliver successful outcomes.
Hire, mentor, and grow a high-performing FDE team, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and technical excellence.
Define and track KPIs for deployed projects, ensuring timely delivery and client satisfaction.
Drive continuous improvement in deployment processes, tools, and methodologies.
Manage relationships with key clients during the deployment phase, serving as an escalation point for technical challenges.

Requirements & Skills:

10+ years of experience in software engineering, technical consulting or deployment roles, with at least 5 years in a leadership capacity.
Proven experience leading engineering or deployment teams in client-facing environments.
Strong technical background in areas like applied AI engineering, cloud infrastructure, APIs, data platforms, etc.
Excellent project management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Strong problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management abilities.

Job Description

As the Director of Engineering for Xplor’s Laundry SaaS business unit, you will be responsible for the delivery, quality and scalability of the software platforms serving the North American laundry and dry-cleaning market. In this role, you will lead engineering teams focused on new product development, platform reliability and technical debt reduction. You will also be responsible for the release and support engineering function with the goal of continual improvement in the customer experience.

Location:
Salt Lake City or Mountain Time Zone

Key Areas of Responsibility

Delivery & Technical Performance

Deliver the product roadmap on schedule by improving existing development processes and building new ones that increase throughput and predictability
Raise platform reliability and performance through disciplined engineering practices — uptime, latency, incident reduction and faster mean time to recovery
In addition to supporting SaaS product delivery, build and maintain the integrated payments capabilities, ensuring secure, compliant and highly available transaction processing
Own release management, QA and support engineering for Laundry SaaS solutions, reducing defect escape rates and improving customer satisfaction
Partner with Product to shape roadmap priorities and technical trade-offs necessary to deliver commercial targets while maximizing customer satisfaction
Continuously improve engineering efficiency by driving higher developer productivity through AI-assisted development practices, optimizing cloud infrastructure cost per customer, and accelerating software delivery.

• Build an AI-first engineering culture by driving adoption of AI-assisted development practices, coaching teams on emerging AI capabilities, and establishing repeatable engineering standards.

5+ years of experience leading engineering teams at a B2B SaaS technology company, including managers

Proven record of improving platform uptime, performance and defect rates in a production SaaS environment

Experience scaling SaaS architecture and the agile operating cadence behind it

Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.

The Role

We are currently seeking a Director of Engineering for our Institutions Engineering Team. You will assume engineering leadership over our investor solutions and research product suite and take ownership of technology delivery across our Institutional segment and sophisticated investor product offerings.

You’ll lead a multi-disciplinary team of software engineers, platform architects, and engineering managers. The ideal candidate brings strong technical depth in scalable cloud-native systems alongside proven leadership in scaling engineering teams and executing complex product roadmaps.

Addepar takes a market-based approach to pay. A successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on the role, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions.

The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target base salary for roles in Colorado, California, and New York. The current range for this role is $214,000 - $335,000 (base salary) + bonus + equity + benefits.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Additionally, these ranges reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.

What You’ll Do

Strategic Leadership

Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing engineering organization dedicated to the Institutional segment
Establish clear engineering goals, operational metrics, and delivery standards aligned with company objectives and create a high-performing engineering culture
Collaborate with Engineering, Product and Design leadership to drive Addepar strategy across all of our engineering organizations
Drive the technical vision, co-ordination and delivery across all products and solutions within our Institutional segment

Technology & Product Delivery

Partner closely with Product Management, Design, and GTM to define, prioritize, and execute product roadmaps
Implement robust Agile software development practices to ensure predictable, high-quality, and timely releases
Guide architectural decisions to ensure scalable, secure, and resilient system design suitable for institutional security and compliance standards
Champion engineering best practices, including automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and robust monitoring/observability platforms

Who You Are

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
8+ years of engineering leadership experience with a track record of managing managers, architects, and software engineers.
Proven experience delivering enterprise/institutional software platforms with stringent security, regulatory, and uptime requirements
Deep familiarity with modern cloud architecture, microservices, API design, data pipelines, and enterprise security frameworks
5+ years experience with financial risk frameworks and asset management in either a SaSS environment or financial institutions

Our Values

Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

Title:
Head of Product Engineering

Reports to:
Chief Operating Officer

Location:
Herndon, VA (Hybrid)

Position Summary

Everfox is seeking an accomplished Head of Product Engineering responsible for leading Everfox's global engineering organization, responsible for developing, integrating, and delivering Everfox’s portfolio of mission-critical software, hardware, and integrated defense technology solutions across the company's cybersecurity portfolio.

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, this executive transforms product strategy into world-class engineering execution by driving engineering excellence, delivery predictability, software quality, operational scalability, and engineering talent development. Equally important, this executive will be expected to increase execution discipline, simplify processes, and operate with great transparency throughout the development lifecycle.

This role partners closely with executive leaders reporting to the COO to ensure enterprise-wide processes operate as one integrated data driven system. Together, these leaders produce best in class defense technology at speed, scale, and with disciplined rigor required for the missions our customers protect.

This executive will modernize engineering practices, strengthen development operations, improve execution rigor, and build an engineering organization capable of supporting Everfox's continued growth and product innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership Expectations

This Role Will

Create a culture of execution and operational excellence.
Build trust through transparency, accountability, and disciplined decision-making.
Lead organizational transformation while maintaining employee engagement.
Drive cross-functional collaboration across Product, Technology, Sales, Professional Services, Customer Success, and corporate functions.
Make data-driven decisions balancing customer priorities, technical quality, and business outcomes.

Engineering Leadership & Delivery

Lead all global software engineering organizations responsible for designing, building, testing, integrating, and sustaining Everfox products.
Translate company, product, and technology strategies into a clear engineering strategy, operating model, organizational structure, and execution roadmap.
Enhance an engineering culture centered on mission accountability, innovation, technical excellence, speed, collaboration, and disciplined execution.
Lead a strong engineering leadership team and create scalable organizational structures capable of supporting continued organic growth, new products, and future acquisitions.
Establish engineering as a high-performing execution organization focused on quality, speed, predictability, and accountability.
Drive consistent on-time delivery against product roadmaps and customer commitments.
Build scalable engineering processes that improve productivity while maintaining exceptional software quality.
Establish engineering metrics, operating rhythms, and governance that provide executive visibility into execution.

Engineering Operations

Own engineering planning, execution, resource allocation, and capacity management.
Drive engineering operational excellence through standardized development methodologies and continuous improvement.
Implement best practices across Agile development, CI/CD, automated testing, and release management.
Improve engineering velocity while reducing technical debt and operational risk.
Lead engineering budget planning and workforce strategy in partnership with the COO.

Partnership With Product & Technology

Partner closely with the Chief Product Officer to:

Translate product roadmaps into executable engineering plans.
Ensure engineering capacity aligns with business priorities.
Improve predictability of roadmap delivery.
Balance innovation with customer commitments.

Partner Closely With The Chief Technology Officer To

Operationalize technology strategy and architectural direction.
Scale emerging technologies into production-ready capabilities.
Ensure engineering standards align with long-term technology strategy.
Accelerate adoption of AI-enabled engineering tools, automation, and secure software development practices.

Engineering Excellence

Establish a culture centered on quality, accountability, continuous improvement, and execution excellence.
Champion modern software engineering practices across the organization.
Improve engineering productivity through automation, tooling, AI-assisted development, and streamlined workflows.
Reduce defect rates while improving release frequency and product reliability.
Create scalable engineering standards across architecture implementation, coding practices, testing, and security.
Establish succession plans and develop the next generation of technical and engineering leaders.

Customer Delivery & Compliance

Maintain an understanding of the missions, operating environments, threats, and technical challenges facing Everfox customers.
Ensure engineering decisions reflect the realities of operating within government, defense, intelligence, and critical-infrastructure environments.
Champion solutions that are resilient, secure, scalable, interoperable, maintainable, and capable of operating within demanding or contested environments.
Engage with key government and international customers as senior technical leaders when required.
Partner with customers and internal teams to translate operational needs into scalable product capabilities rather than one-off engineering solutions wherever possible.
Maintain appropriate awareness of global defense markets, allied-nation requirements, sovereignty considerations, export environments, and evolving cybersecurity expectations.

Quality, Security & Engineering Rigor

Embed security, quality, reliability, safety, compliance, and resilience into engineering processes from the beginning of product development.
Establish strong technical governance while maintaining the speed and flexibility expected of a modern defense technology organization.
Strengthen engineering architecture and technical review mechanisms.
Ensure appropriate configuration management, documentation, traceability, test automation, verification, and validation.
Proactively identify and address technical debt and systemic engineering risks.
Partner with cybersecurity, quality, legal, compliance, and government-security organizations to meet applicable regulatory, customer, contractual, and security requirements.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured through:

Increase engineering execution predictability and product-development velocity.
Improve the integration of hardware, software, systems, and product engineering.
Reduce unnecessary process complexity and engineering cycle time.
Improve product quality, reliability, security, and scalability.
Strengthen accountability and transparency across the product-development lifecycle.
Increase reuse of technology, architectures, platforms, components, and engineering capabilities.
Improve engineering capacity planning and return on engineering investment.
Build stronger partnerships among Product, Engineering, Technology, Operations, Programs, and Go-to-Market.
Develop a strong engineering leadership bench and technical talent pipeline.
Successfully scale engineering capabilities to support Everfox’s organic growth, global expansion, and anticipated M&A.
Consistently move differentiated technologies from concept to fielded customer capability faster and more effectively.

Qualifications Required

Significant progressive leadership experience within engineering, product development, or technology organizations, including substantial experience leading senior engineering leaders and large multidisciplinary teams.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline; advanced degree preferred.
20+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience, including executive leadership of large software engineering organizations.
Proven experience leading engineering organizations within enterprise software, cybersecurity, defense technology, or highly regulated industries.
Demonstrated success scaling engineering organizations through periods of rapid growth and transformation.
Strong financial and business acumen with the ability to connect engineering investment to company and customer outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to lead across organizational boundaries and influence senior technical and business executives.
Experience leading Agile engineering organizations.
Strong understanding of secure software development, cloud technologies, AI-enabled engineering, automation, and modern development platforms.
Experience delivering software to U.S. Government, Intelligence Community, or Department of Defense customers is strongly preferred.
Active security clearance or ability to obtain one preferred.

jobs.title: Sr. Value Engineering Manager, Value Engineering
jobs.description:
Description

Ever wondered what it takes to build Amazon's massive global network — and how we make sure every dollar spent on construction delivers maximum value?

We're looking for a Senior Value Engineering Manager who will own cost engineering and value engineering on large-scale construction projects and help shape the future of AI-powered cost intelligence. This isn't a back-office analytics role — you'll be influencing multi-million-dollar supplier negotiations, presenting to senior leadership, and support building the tools that will transform how Amazon Global Procurement Organization models, negotiates and manages construction cost worldwide.

Construction is one of our largest and most complex procurement categories. Every project is different — unique site conditions, local labor markets, permit requirements, and material constraints mean that each costing cycle demands a fresh bottom-up deep dive: decomposing cost structures, stress-testing assumptions against local market realities, and building analytics that reflect the true cost drivers of that specific build. You'll bring deep construction industry expertise and pair it with a forward-looking mindset, co-creating AI-driven tools that scale your impact far beyond individual projects.

Key job responsibilities

Deliver independent, bottom-up construction cost estimates for North America Design & Construction stakeholders across retrofit, expansion, and new-build projects spanning multiple building types and fulfillment network segments.

Develop cost estimates from early-stage concepts through RFP-ready construction documents, selecting appropriate methodologies and analytical depth based on project maturity and available information.

Own estimating strategies for repeatable multi-site programs by developing scalable templates while producing detailed bottom-up estimates for complex, site-specific projects requiring advanced analytical judgment.

Generate conceptual ROM estimates to support early project planning, business case development, investment decisions, and funding approvals.

Lead should-cost modeling, benchmarking, and Value Engineering analyses to identify cost optimization opportunities while preserving design intent, quality, constructability, schedule, and operational requirements.

Leverage AI-powered tools to improve estimating efficiency through automated data gathering, benchmarking, and cost analysis while applying engineering judgment to validate outputs and resolve complex or ambiguous scopes.

Drive development of scalable AI-enabled estimating solutions by curating project and market cost data, validating model performance, and identifying opportunities to automate routine estimating activities.

Partner with preconstruction managers, design engineers, sourcing teams, category managers, and business stakeholders to validate assumptions, communicate cost risks, evaluate alternatives, and influence cost-informed decisions throughout project development.

Establish estimating best practices through peer reviews, continuous improvement initiatives, and maintenance of current labor, material, equipment, subcontractor, and market pricing databases to ensure consistent, accurate, and defensible cost models.

About The Team

The Sourcing Excellence team helps Amazon answer two fundamental questions: **Are we buying the right product?** (Value Engineering) and **Are we paying the right price?** (Cost Engineering). **Value Engineering** ensures Amazon is investing in the right solutions by optimizing specifications, design, materials, and performance to maximize business value while meeting operational requirements. **Cost Engineering** establishes cost transparency and price confidence through bottom-up cost estimation, should-cost modeling, benchmarking, market intelligence, and cost driver analysis to determine what products and services should cost.

Together, these disciplines provide transparent, fact-based insights that enable informed sourcing, design, and investment decisions throughout the project lifecycle. Our vision is to make cost and value transparency a strategic capability across the organization, ensuring every investment delivers the optimal balance of cost, quality, performance, and operational requirements. Today, the team supports billions of dollars in managed spend across multiple global categories and continues to scale its impact through AI-enabled solutions, standardized mechanisms, and cross-functional partnerships.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
Experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, Development Manager, Owner's project management representative or in other Commercial Development and Construction related disciplines
Experience developing bottom-up cost models, should-cost models, cost benchmarks, cost driver analysis, and analytical frameworks to support complex construction or capital investment decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience operating within at least two disciplines within the construction industry, such as Contracting, Owners Representation, Architecture, Design and Engineering, Commercial Development, analysis and control of construction costs or similar
Experience in project management in construction and contracts management
AI&Automation: Comfortable working with AI and automation as a default part of your workflow — not as an experiment, but as how things get done. You should be willing to use AI-powered tools for cost benchmarking, estimating, modelling and pattern recognition, curate project data to feed scalable models, validate automated outputs with expert judgment, and identify where automation can absorb routine work so you can focus on the complex and ambiguous. Experience contributing to AI tool development in an estimating or procurement context is a strong differentiator.
Data Management & Cost Estimation Software
Experience managing structured cost data and supporting back-end estimation workflows — organizing inputs, maintaining cost libraries, and ensuring data integrity across project portfolios. Proficiency with CostX or equivalent takeoff and cost modeling software is strongly preferred. Familiarity with Amazon's internal estimating systems and tools is a plus but not required; what matters most is a demonstrated ability to pick up new platforms quickly and maintain discipline in data management practices.

WHO WE ARE 

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.
Role Overview

Zeta Global is seeking a hands-on Senior Engineering Manager to lead the Loyalty product that powers the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP).
Reporting to Sr. Director, Engineering, this leader will own the technical execution, architecture, roadmap, and delivery for one or more core loyalty features. The role requires strong technical judgment, exceptional engineering leadership, and the ability to drive complex initiatives across multiple engineering teams.
Zeta Loyalty helps brands move beyond static loyalty programs with intelligent experiences designed to deepen engagement. The next gen Zeta Loyalty platform is envisioned to be AI-powered and agentic.
This is a technical leadership role. The Senior Engineering Manager is expected to remain actively involved in architecture, design reviews, technical decision-making, and production operations while developing engineers and technical leads and delivering reliable Loyalty product capabilities at scale.
Loyalty Product Mission

Zeta Loyalty provides a configurable program definition, member foundation, reference data, rules engine, and offer capabilities required to launch enterprise grade loyalty programs.
Rather than simply managing points, this product creates a flexible loyalty platform that enables brands to define their program, reward customer behaviors, and evolve their loyalty strategy without requiring custom engineering.
The key mission of the product is tightly integrating with other services of the ZMP, such as identity, events, messaging and seamlessly executing the loyalty program rules based on user behavior. Additionally, there is an urgent need to integrate Loyalty with AthenaOS, Zeta’s AI-powered assistant, to bring predictive intelligence, real-time activation, conversational AI into the loyalty domain.
Scope of Ownership

Own the complete Loyalty product suite, which includes, but not limited to:
Customizable loyalty programs
Configurable reward rules
Flexible tiering structure
Reward points tracking
Tight Integration with system notification & user messaging frameworks
Omnichannel support
Unified ZMP Identity
Unified ZMP Analytics

The Senior Engineering Manager is accountable for the architecture, implementation, operational excellence, observability, monitoring & reliability of the owned products.
Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

Lead the architecture and technical direction for assigned domains.
Translate product strategy into executable engineering roadmaps.
Participate in quarterly planning and deliver the workloads on a timely manner, with high quality
Drive technical design for services, APIs, schemas, background jobs.

jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Enterprise Security Products is a newly launched group building intelligent, cloud-agnostic security tools using AI-first development practices. We don't just talk about AI — we build AI security products with AI, and we need a leader who sets that standard. This is a ground-floor opportunity to build and lead a high-performing engineering organization where experimentation is the norm, shipping is measured in hours not quarters, and every decision you make shapes the trajectory of the team, the product, and the business. If you've been waiting for a role where you can combine the strategic scope of senior leadership with the hands-on intensity of a startup founder — this is it.

Key job responsibilities

Build and lead a world-class engineering organization. Recruit, develop, and retain top engineering talent. Stand up multiple development teams from the ground up, establishing the structures, rituals, and expectations that define how a high-performing org operates — without the bureaucracy.
Set technical vision and product strategy: Partner with security researchers, applied scientists, product managers, and UX designers to translate customer problems into bold technical bets. Drive the multi-year roadmap for AI-powered security products that protect Amazon's business customers at scale. Your decisions will shape architecture, product direction, and competitive positioning.
Champion AI-native development at the org level: Establish an AI-first engineering culture across your teams; from agentic coding workflows to AI-assisted design and testing. Don't just encourage adoption; measure it, iterate on it, and make it a force multiplier for velocity and quality. You set the bar for how this org builds.
Drive execution with startup urgency: Manage multiple concurrent initiatives across teams while maintaining the speed and focus of a small, scrappy operation. Decompose ambiguous, high-stakes problems into actionable plans. Remove blockers ruthlessly. Ship fast, learn from what you ship, and iterate.
Define and advance AI/ML capabilities: Lead strategic decisions on agentic systems, RAG architectures, conversational interfaces, and intelligent automation pipelines. Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and make high-judgment build vs. buy decisions that keep the team on the forefront of AI.
Own operational excellence and security posture: Establish industry-leading reliability, performance, and security practices across your services. Build scalable, reusable mechanisms that simplify operations and accelerate delivery. Ensure your teams operate with the rigor of Amazon and the agility of a startup.
Influence beyond your org: Drive cross-organizational initiatives, build consensus with senior stakeholders, and write compelling vision documents and strategic narratives. Proactively identify technology gaps and opportunities that extend beyond your immediate scope.
Develop leaders, not just engineers: Grow technical leads and managers through coaching, high-accountability ownership, and real responsibility. Foster a culture where every team member thinks and acts like a founder.

A day in the life

You start the morning reviewing a product vision draft for a new AI-powered security capability. By mid-morning, you're in a design review challenging your tech leads on system architecture, pushing for simplicity and speed to first customer. After lunch, you're pairing with your SDMs on org planning, figuring out how to staff an ambitious new initiative without slowing the two that are already in flight. You spend part of the afternoon with your product and science partners, aligning on roadmap priorities and debating where agentic AI will create the most customer value. Before end of day, you check in on a rapid prototype your team shipped to internal users yesterday, the feedback is already rolling in. You don't manage from a distance. You're in the details, in the code reviews, in the customer conversations, and in the arena with your teams every day.

About The Team

Amazon Enterprise Security Products is built by builders who tackle challenges others might consider too ambitious. We're a small team where there are no layers between you and the decision, no waiting quarters to see your work reach customers. Every team member brings an owner's mentality. If there's a problem worth solving, we solve it. No mission is beyond reach, no detail beneath our attention. We move fast, we ship fast, and we learn from what we ship. This is where builders who want to make the impossible routine come to do their best work.

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of engineering experience
5+ years of engineering team management experience
10+ years of planning, designing, developing and delivering consumer software experience
Experience partnering with product or program management teams
Experience managing multiple concurrent programs, projects and development teams in an Agile environment
Experience with AI/ML technologies

Preferred Qualifications

Experience designing and developing large scale, high-traffic applications
Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or related technical field
Track record of building engineering teams and culture from early stage or greenfield
