jobs.title: Sr Release Manager, Design Engineering
jobs.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

We are seeking a highly technical Design Portfolio Manager to join our GDSCM team, focusing on the Basis of Design (BOD) and Programmatic Design Change Management (PDCM) programs. This role requires deep technical expertise across multiple engineering disciplines and the ability to evaluate complex design changes across 300+ in-flight projects.

As a Design portfolio Manager, you will serve as a technical expert evaluating design change requests across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, architectural, controls, plumbing, fire protection, and thermal systems. You will conduct feasibility analyses, coordinate technical reviews with principal engineers across all disciplines, and manage the end-to-end lifecycle of design changes from initiation through implementation.

You will work closely with Design Engineering, Construction Management, Procurement, Finance, and Product teams to ensure design changes are properly vetted, funded, and executed.

Key job responsibilities

Technical Design Evaluation

Evaluate complex design changes across multiple engineering disciplines including electrical power distribution, mechanical cooling systems, structural loads, civil site work, architectural layouts, controls systems, plumbing infrastructure, and fire protection systems
Analyze technical specifications, construction drawings, equipment datasheets, and system integration requirements to assess design change feasibility and impact
Understand and explain the complexity of data center designs including power distribution from utility to rack level, cooling system architectures, backup power systems, and building infrastructure
Identify technical dependencies and cross-discipline impacts when evaluating proposed design changes
Assess constructability, maintainability, and operational implications of design modifications
Review and validate technical calculations including electrical load calculations, cooling capacity requirements, structural load analysis, and hydraulic calculations

Design Change Management

Manage portfolio of design changes across multiple in-flight projects, ensuring alignment with business priorities and technical requirements
Conduct feasibility analyses and production readiness assessments for proposed design changes, evaluating technical risk, schedule impact, and cost implications
Coordinate technical reviews with principal engineers across mechanical, electrical, structural, civil, architectural, controls, plumbing, and fire protection disciplines
Develop and maintain implementation plans, tracking design change execution from approval through site deployment
Present design change recommendations and cost implications to senior leadership, clearly articulating technical complexity and business impact
Evaluate design improvements and innovations, assessing their applicability across the global portfolio

Cross-Discipline Collaboration

Partner with Electrical Engineers on power distribution design, generator sizing, UPS configurations, switchgear specifications, and high-voltage systems
Collaborate with Mechanical Engineers on cooling system design, HVAC configurations, piping layouts, and thermal management strategies
Work with Structural Engineers on foundation design, seismic requirements, equipment support structures, and building loads
Engage with Civil Engineers on site grading, stormwater management, utility routing, and site infrastructure
Coordinate with Architectural teams on building layouts, space planning, and building envelope design
Interface with Controls Engineers on building management systems, monitoring systems, and automation strategies
Partner with Fire Protection Engineers on fire suppression systems, detection systems, and life safety requirements

Stakeholder Coordination

Partner with Design Management teams to understand project-specific requirements, constraints, and technical challenges
Collaborate with Finance teams on cost validation, funding strategies, and budget tracking for design changes
Work with Construction Management and Procurement teams to assess schedule impacts, supply chain constraints, and constructability
Engage with Product and Solutions teams to evaluate new equipment, emerging technologies, and design approaches
Coordinate with Commissioning teams to ensure design changes support testing and startup requirements

Process Improvement

Identify opportunities to streamline design change workflows and reduce execution timelines while maintaining technical rigor
Develop and maintain technical documentation including standard operating procedures, design standards, technical specifications, and RACI matrices
Contribute to automation initiatives and tooling improvements for design change management
Support integration of cost validation frameworks and bulk funding mechanisms
Drive continuous improvement in technical review processes and design quality standards

Program Execution

Track and report on design change metrics including approval timelines, cost avoidance, implementation status, and technical quality
Maintain design change databases and dashboards for cross-functional visibility
Support BOD release planning and coordination to minimize redesign impacts
Participate in weekly leadership reviews presenting program status, key decisions, and technical recommendations

About The Team

The Global Design Standards and Change Management (GDSCM) organization within Data Center Engineering is responsible for establishing and maintaining design standards across the global data center portfolio. Our team manages three mission-critical programs:

Basis of Design (BOD) Establishes and governs the foundational technical standards for all global data center designs, ensuring consistency and quality across the portfolio.

Programmatic Design Change Management (PDCM) Manages design change requests across 300+ in-flight projects.

360 Equipment Qualification Program (360 EQP) Qualifies equipment and technologies for deployment across the global portfolio, evaluating emerging solutions and driving standardization of critical systems.

Together, these programs deliver capacity across the AMER, APAC, and EMEA regions.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

6+ years of data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance experience
6+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
Knowledge of critical data center mechanical and electrical equipment
Experience in data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance
Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities
Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities

Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region
Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production

Sr. Manager, Engineering, Enterprise Platform

US Remote
About SailPoint

SailPoint is the leader in identity security for the cloud enterprise. Our identity security solutions secure and enable thousands of companies worldwide, giving our customers unmatched visibility into the entirety of their digital workforce and ensuring every identity has the right access to do their job, no more, no less.
Built on a foundation of AI and ML, our Atlas Platform delivers the right level of access to the right identities and resources at the right time, matching the scale, velocity, and changing needs of today's cloud-oriented, modern enterprise across human, machine, and AI identities.
About the Role

As a Senior Engineering Manager on the Enterprise Platform, you will lead one or more senior engineering teams responsible for core platform capabilities that the rest of SailPoint builds on. These teams own backend services, APIs, data stores, and the distributed systems that power the Atlas Platform at scale.
As a highly technical leader, you will own the operating rhythm and delivery health of your team(s), help solve complex challenges around scalability and reliability, reduce technical debt, and shape where the team invests. You will be expected to reach productivity quickly and to operate close enough to the work to know its real state at any time.
Stakeholder management is a significant aspect of this role. You will work closely with Product Management, Design, Architecture, Quality, DevOps, and customer-facing teams. You should proactively seek alignment with other engineering teams and stakeholders by deeply understanding your team's technology, building strong relationships, and insisting on high-quality solutions.
You will report to a Senior Director of Engineering.
Key Responsibilities

·       Own the day-to-day operating cadence of your team(s), including planning, prioritization, standups, and retrospectives, and use that cadence to stay close to the work, surface risks early, and keep delivery predictable.
·       Partner with Product Management to set a clear strategic direction and roadmap, and translate it into sequenced, well-scoped execution.
·       Engage substantively in technical decisions, fluent enough at the architectural level to discuss tradeoffs with senior engineers, challenge design decisions, and guide the team toward sound, scalable solutions.
·       Coach, grow, and develop engineers along their career paths, and shape the team through hiring and performance management.
·       Drive scalability, reliability, and technical-debt reduction, and determine where engineering investment should be made.
·       Manage risk, dependencies, and cross-team commitments, resolving issues proactively rather than escalating them.
·       Allocate resources across competing priorities and make clear, defensible tradeoff decisions under load.
Requirements

·       8+ years in a Software Engineering Management role on backend services exposing APIs.
·       5+ years of hands-on experience as a Software Engineer.
·       Deep knowledge of complex, scaling SaaS products, agile processes and workflows, and experience implementing them.
·       Technical fluency at the architectural level, enabling easy discussions with engineers and the ability to challenge technical decisions.
·       Experience with microservice architecture and distributed systems that utilize load balancing, horizontal scalability, and high availability.
·       Experience across a modern backend stack, such as polyglot services (Java, Go, Rust), event-driven and workflow-orchestration systems (Kafka, SQS, Temporal), and relational and NoSQL data stores (MySQL, DynamoDB).
·       Extensive experience architecting, designing, and operating applications in an AWS cloud environment.
·       Experience supporting and developing containerized CI/CD deployment such as Docker and Kubernetes.
·       BS in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.
Roadmap and Timeline to Success

Within the first 30 days you will:

·       Onboard into your new role and get familiar with our product offering, platform, and technology.
·       Get to know your engineers and leads, understand what motivates them, and identify their areas of development.
·       Take ownership of your team's operating cadence, planning, standups, and retrospectives, so you have a direct, firsthand read on the team's work and its status.
·       Seek to deeply understand the business problems and common engineering challenges your team owns, and begin forming your own view of them.
·       Interview stakeholders to understand business goals, the product roadmap, and the challenges ahead.
By 90 days you will:

·       Motivate, encourage, and challenge your team(s) to find optimal synergy.
·       Understand the technical challenges ahead and actively participate in technical decision-making.
·       Understand your team's decision-making process and challenge them to find more optimal solutions.
·       Know the real status of your team's critical-path work at any time, without needing it surfaced for you.
·       Have regular syncs with your stakeholders and own the cross-team commitments your team has made.
·       Be implementing fast, iterative improvements to delivery and quality.
By 6 months you will:

·       Be making significant, measurable progress on technical debt while balancing new feature delivery and defect resolution.
·       Have a team that is consistently delivering on its commitments by deadline.
·       Have earned the trust of your team and become a respected partner to your stakeholders.
·       Be attracting and motivating excellent engineers who care about great teams and great software.
·       Have your personal goals on track.
By 1 year you will:

·       Have a team whose size and skills are aligned to your roadmap and operating efficiently.
·       Have a team consistently achieving real business results and incremental milestones.
·       Maintain a culture of continuous learning by coaching and developing your engineers along their chosen career paths.
·       Consistently use data to objectively measure impact and optimize engineering processes.
·       Consistently meet deadlines and coordinate with technical team members to deliver quality results.

Benefits and Compensation listed vary based on the location of your employment and the nature of your employment with SailPoint.

As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the SailPoint Corporate Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission, along with potential eligibility for equity participation. SailPoint maintains broad salary ranges for its roles to account for variations in knowledge, skills, experience, market conditions and locations, as well as reflect SailPoint’s differing products, industries, and lines of business. Candidates are typically placed into the range based on the preceding factors as well as internal peer equity. $158,900 - $267,860.00 Base salaries for employees based in other locations are competitive for the employee’s home location.

1. Health and wellness coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance
2. Disability coverage: Short-term and long-term disability
3. Life protection: Life insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D)
4. Additional life coverage options: Supplemental life insurance for employees, spouses, and children

jobs.title: Engineering Director
jobs.description:
About Bestow

Life insurance is one of the world's most important products. It's also one of the hardest to build, distribute, and modernize. Bestow exists to change that.

Bestow is a leading vertical technology platform serving some of the largest and most innovative life insurers. Our platform unifies the fragmented, legacy value chain, enabling carriers to launch products in weeks instead of years. Carriers choose us to scale and operate at unprecedented speed, powered by AI and automation.

Bestow isn't selling policies. We're building the infrastructure that helps an entire industry move faster, reach more people, and deliver on its promise.

Backed by leading investors (Goldman Sachs, Hedosophia, NEA, Valar, 8VC) and trusted by major carriers, Bestow is powered by a team that moves with precision, purpose, and heart. If you want to help reimagine a centuries-old industry with lasting impact, join us.

Bestow offers flexible remote/hybrid work, meaningful benefits, equity, and substantial growth opportunities.

Bestow uses E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit E-Verify.gov .

About The Team

The Engineering team is the core of Bestow, driving all technology for our SaaS platform that empowers insurance carriers. We build and operate the systems that serve our enterprise carrier partners across the entire lifecycle of a life insurance policy, our consumers, and our employees. Our major functional teams are product engineering, infrastructure engineering, IT, data and analytics, and technical program management. Engineering partners closely with Product Management, Experience Design, and Delivery Management to define and prioritize the roadmap and to hold our commitments to carrier partners and to the business.

As Director of Engineering, you will lead two closely coupled groups:

Implementation Platform Configuration (IPC) owns how a carrier's products come to life on our platform.
Enrollment Platform Core owns the workflow that keeps enrollment safe to change while multiple partner implementations are in flight.

Our primary technologies are a microservices architecture in Golang, Python, and TypeScript on PostgreSQL, integrated over gRPC, REST, and asynchronous messaging, with event sourcing in our configuration and domain layers. We deploy and operate on Kubernetes in Google Cloud Platform. This role reports to the VP of Engineering, manages a group of Engineering Managers, and is open to Remote (US).

What You'll Do

Bestow is looking for a Director of Engineering to contribute in the following ways:

Set technical direction. Define and drive the technical vision for Implementation Platform Configuration and Enrollment Platform Core, and make sure it ladders up to Bestow's platform strategy. Provide architectural oversight across the configuration layer, the enrollment workflow engine, and the event-sourced domain services, keeping them scalable, reliable, secure, and performant.
Push repeatability over bespoke work. Make each new carrier implementation cost less and ship faster than the last by favoring configuration-driven patterns over hand-built per-partner solutions.
Lead beyond your reporting line. Own initiatives whose success depends on teams that do not report to you. Own the interfaces between your teams and the ones you depend on, and resolve ownership ambiguity before it becomes an incident or a slipped date.
Own delivery commitments. Hold your teams' commitments to carrier partners, including UAT handoff dates, and represent status accurately to executive leadership.
Head off requirements churn at the source. Partner with Product, Delivery Management, Underwriting, and Compliance to surface missing requirements and cross-team dependencies during discovery, when a gap costs a conversation rather than a release.
Own your incident posture. Drive urgency and priority grading, insist on real root-cause analysis, look across incidents for systemic causes, and close the loop on follow-up actions. Hold the principle that the team owning a service owns its operation.
Build a testing strategy that scales. Automated coverage, human-readable outcomes for underwriting and compliance reviewers, and repeatable regression runs in place of thousand-case manual test efforts.
Grow the leadership bench. Lead, mentor, and grow a group of Engineering Managers. Run performance management with rigor: career ladder expectations, scorecards, calibration, direct feedback, and personalized growth plans. Maintain bench depth so a single departure does not put a partner commitment at risk.
Own hiring for your organization. Act as hiring manager for your open requisitions, own the funnel with recruiting, and raise the bar with every hire. Manage contractor and vendor partners to the same expectations, calibration, and quality bar as our full-time engineers.
Direct AI adoption personally. Set the strategy for where AI changes how we build rather than delegating it. Drive adoption of AI development tooling and AI-first delivery practices, establish standards for AI-generated code that reduce technical debt instead of accelerating it, and coach engineers and managers against the AI competencies in our career ladders.
Represent Bestow externally. Speak credibly with carrier partners, vendors, and other technology companies, including in technical due diligence and vendor negotiations.

Who You Are

Experienced as a manager of managers. Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience, 8+ years of professional software development experience, and 5+ years of progressive engineering management experience including managing managers. You will lead 2 to 3 Engineering Managers and roughly 20 to 30 engineers.
Deep in distributed systems. Proven ability to design, build, and operate microservices architectures at scale, including event-driven and event-sourced designs.
Fluent in our stack. Golang and/or Python backend services, API design over gRPC and REST, asynchronous messaging patterns, and extensive PostgreSQL experience covering schema design, data modeling, and query performance. Cloud platform experience, with a preference for Google Cloud Platform and Kubernetes.
An advocate for agentic engineering. You have transformed at least one team to fully embrace agentic engineering.
Credible across boundaries you do not own. You can reason about the frontend composition layer, data platform, and infrastructure well enough to negotiate interfaces, review designs, and resolve cross-team failures without escalating everything.
Able to go deep when it matters. You can contribute changes to your teams' codebases and engage credibly in architectural decisions at any time.
Serious about testing. An advocate for automated testing and test-driven development, with real opinions on how to test configuration and rules at scale.
Organized under competing priorities. You define and track key metrics, drive accountability across teams, and consistently meet committed dates and SLAs across multiple teams and partner commitments at once.
A builder of teams. Proven ability to attract, hire, mentor, and retain engineering talent, including developing senior engineers and early-career managers.
A clear communicator. You can explain a complex system and its trade-offs to an executive, a carrier partner, and an engineer in the same day.
Desirable, not required. Life insurance, annuities, or another regulated-industry background is a strong plus, as is delivering implementations for enterprise or carrier partners under contractual dates.

TOTAL REWARDS

At Bestow, we’re proud to be awarded for our team members, innovative products, and culture. Our standard benefits include:

Competitive salary and equity based on role
Policies and managers that support work/life balance, like our flexible paid time off and parental leave programs
100% paid-premium option for medical, dental, and vision insurance
Lifestyle stipend to support your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing
Flexible work-from-home policy and open to remote
Remote and WFH options, as well as a beautiful, state-of-the-art office in Dallas’ Deep Ellum, for those who prefer an office setting
Employee-led diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives

Recent Employer Awards Include

Best Place for Working Parents 2023 + 2024 + 2025
Great Place to Work Certified, 2022 + 2023 + 2024 + 2025
Built In Best Places to Work, 2022 + 2023 + 2025
Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Texas 2022 + 2023
Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Financial Services and Insurance 2022 + 2023 + 2024

We value diversity at Bestow. The company will hire, recruit, and promote regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every team member.

Thanks for considering a job at Bestow!

At Dragos, the mission is personal. The systems we protect deliver the water you drink, power your home, and keep the hospitals your community depends on running. Those critical infrastructure systems that power our civilization around the world are under attack every day by adversaries. When those systems fail, people are immediately at risk. Dragos is looking for an experienced Director of Engineering to lead a multi-team engineering organization building and sustaining our OT cybersecurity products, most notably the Dragos Platform. This role reports to the VP of Engineering, leads a minimum of four engineering managers, and is accountable for an overall organization of 35 to 50 people.

You will own a set of discipline-based engineering communities, such as frontend, backend, data, AI, etc. each led by a manager with a team of engineers in that discipline. Engineers from these communities staff cross-functional product teams that are led day to day by a tech lead and a product manager, with your managers serving in an advisory and coaching capacity. Success in this role means your managers and engineers raise the technical bar everywhere they are deployed, and that you drive department-wide improvements alongside your engineering and product director peers.

Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineering managers, each accountable for a discipline-based engineering community. Own their performance, growth, and effectiveness as people leaders.
Provide substantive technical guidance to your managers and their teams on software design and architecture, code quality practices, testing strategy, and review discipline. Stay close enough to the work to add real value in a design or code review.
Set the standard for AI-assisted engineering. Evaluate and roll out AI development tooling, define practices for its effective and responsible use, and coach your managers on where it accelerates delivery and where human judgment and review remain essential.
Own and drive key initiatives across the engineering department, working alongside your director peers on engineering standards, delivery practices, tooling, onboarding, and reduction of technical debt.
Partner closely with product directors to staff and support cross-functional product teams, balancing engineering capacity against roadmap commitments and resolving competing priorities at the lowest possible level.
Coach the tech leads and engineers in your organization so that product teams they support consistently deliver reliable, secure, and maintainable software.
Be accountable for the long-term health of the services and codebases your organization owns, including operational readiness and support for deployed product.
Build influential working relationships across engineering, product, and the wider business. Resolve the majority of disagreements yourself, and escalate the remainder promptly with clear context.
Own technical hiring for your organization: shape roles, run interview panels, and raise the bar on selection and onboarding.

8+ years leading software engineering teams, including 3+ years managing managers
Experience leading an engineering organization of 20 or more people across multiple teams
Strong technical background as a practicing software engineer and working fluency across technical architectures, including frontend, data, networking, backend, etc.
Demonstrated fluency with AI development tooling, including coding assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-assisted review and test generation, plus a clear point of view on how to adopt it across a team
Cybersecurity experience at a product company shipping commercial software to external customers
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the range to move between executive updates, peer negotiation, and detailed technical review
Experience supporting agile, cross-functional teams that pair engineering with product management
Experience with performance evaluation, promotion recommendations, and performance improvement processes

Experience with OT or ICS environments, threat detection, or asset visibility products
Experience integrating engineering teams following an acquisition

jobs.title: Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering
jobs.description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.

About The Role

We're building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close the gap between the value our enterprise customers expect from Cursor and the value they're actually getting. FDEs don't advise, they embed directly with customer engineering teams, build production-grade Cursor workflows, and transfer the habits and culture that compound long after the engagement ends. The measure of success is what's different at day 30, not what got shipped.

We're looking for a Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and help scale this team. You'll manage a growing team of FDEs working across our most strategic enterprise accounts, own what makes a world-class FDE engagement, and stay close enough to the work to escalate, coach, and course-correct in real time. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, owning both project delivery and the day-to-day relationship, while also identifying and scoping new opportunities. You'll also build our partner FDE track — training and enabling GSI and consulting partners who extend this motion at scale.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines deep technical credibility, strong people management, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating.

What you’ll do

Sell
Own the full arc from technical discovery to executive close — partnering with Sales and Account teams to qualify opportunities, leading architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints, and scoping engagements with enough precision to de-risk delivery before a line of code is written
Build and present proposals that translate ambiguous customer problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI
Sell the vision and the plan to C-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it
Drive deal strategy on strategic accounts; your technical credibility is a direct lever on close rates for six- and seven-figure engagements

Deliver

Serve as executive technical sponsor on your region's highest-priority engagements and manage stakeholder relationships from IC engineers to C-suite
Ensure delivery quality across your team's projects: appropriate scoping, milestone tracking, technical standards, and clean handoffs to customer engineering teamsTranslate between business outcomes and technical implementation in both directions
Identify and escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions
Manage active engagements: escalate on complex builds, coach FDEs on scoping and delivery decisions, and step in directly on accounts where the stakes are highest
Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time

Manage People

Lead, develop, and scale a team of 6–8 Forward Deployed Engineers working strategic FDE projects
Hire top-tier FDE talent; set clear expectations, technical performance standards, and career growth paths for a team where "excellent" means actually shipping in production
Coach FDEs through the hardest problems in the field — scoping under deal pressure, building alongside senior technical stakeholders, and knowing when to protect scope vs. when to flex
Build and scale the partner FDE track — train, enable, and hold the quality bar for GSI and consulting partners who carry the FDE motion forward at volume

You may be a fit if

You have 8+ years of experience leading technical teams that build and ship in production — Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a similar function where writing and reviewing code is part of the job
You have experience with software development and coding in Python, Javascript/Typescript
You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures
You can diagnose a complex enterprise engineering environment quickly, identify the highest-leverage intervention, and scope a meaningful engagement
You've built and scaled IC-level technical teams and know what excellence looks like in the field: sharp scoping, clean delivery, and knowledge that stays at the customer long after the engagement closes

jobs.title: Director, Security Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Description

Oversees the creation of advanced testing tools and their integration into engineering workflows, ensuring teams are fully equipped to identify and address critical security weaknesses efficiently. Develops and refines escalation protocols for security violations, overseeing communication with executive leadership and key stakeholders. Provides high-level oversight on compliance assessments. Directs teams on using advanced tools and techniques for data security such as encryption, hashing, masking, and access management to ensure the confidentiality and integrity of sensitive information.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Security Monitoring - Security Tool Design and Development:

Drives execution of a comprehensive security strategy, ensuring that Oracle's goals are met.
Directs lines of business working on security assessments across a wide range of complex products and services, prioritizing critical vulnerabilities and coordinating mitigation efforts.
Oversees the creation of advanced testing tools and their integration into engineering workflows, ensuring lines of business are fully equipped to identify and address critical security weaknesses efficiently.
Leads security design and code reviews at an Oracle-wide level, ensuring strict adherence to internal and external obligations, and strengthening security posturing.

Event Response:

Develops and refines escalation protocols for security violations, overseeing communication with executive leadership and key stakeholders.
Establishes and enforces comprehensive protocols for event containment and mitigation, coordinating high-level cross-functional response efforts.
Directs post-event review sessions at a strategic level to identify significant improvement areas, integrating feedback into ongoing security processes.

Compliance:

Provides high-level oversight on compliance assessments.
Ensures adherence to internal and external obligations across Oracle.
Oversees strategic management of inventory, operability, and accountability of company assets, driving implementation of advanced tracking systems.

Business Continuity Support:

Drives the strategic development of business continuity and disaster recovery plans, processes, and procedures.
Verifies the availability and resilience of critical systems and data, directing strategies to handle major disruptions.
Leads improvements to meet evolving standards regarding certifications and audits.

Data Security and Privacy:

Directs lines of business on using advanced tools and techniques for data security such as encryption, hashing, masking, and access management to ensure the confidentiality and integrity of sensitive information.
Drives the review of documentation and procedures, identifying and implementing improvements in data security practices.

Research and Innovation:

Directs industry security knowledge advancement, encouraging the use of research and innovation to develop cutting-edge security solutions.
Guides line of business's efforts on addressing evolving threats and vulnerabilities.
Advises lines of business on using novel techniques that solve unique security problems through creative and effective solutions.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

Oversees and guides multiple teams on managing complex projects or initiatives, monitoring timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable to ensure strategic objectives are met.
Serves as a role model for appropriately delegating work, setting priorities, and ensuring alignment with business needs.
Coaches others on adjusting resources or project timelines in anticipation of business changes.

Collaboration & Partnership:

Role models leading cross-functional collaborative efforts to ensure alignment of expectations and strategic objectives.
Empowers team to build and maintain partnerships with business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to address barriers and contribute to organizational success.
Drives transparency and inclusivity by modeling actively seeking, listening to, and leveraging diverse perspectives.

Problem Solving:

Shares problem-solving strategies across teams, providing oversight on complex operational and/or technical issues, as needed.
Coaches teams on analyzing highly complex data and/or information to identify solutions to ambiguous issues and provides direction on identifying root causes to prevent recurrence of issues.

Continuous Learning:

Pursues strategic learning opportunities to maintain expertise and apply best practices at the organizational level.
Creates opportunities for team members and leaders to build their expertise in new areas, coaching them to build innovative skills.
Identifies skill gap trends across the organization, and upholds a culture that places significant emphasis on sharing knowledge and pursuing learning opportunities that advance the organization.
Evaluates efficiency of learning strategies and recommends adjustments as needed.

Continuous Improvement:

Empowers team to own the development and implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the department.
Coaches teams to gain buy-in for ideas and to seek feedback on approaches and methods for continued improvement.
Prioritizes and reviews the roadmap of improvement initiatives to ensure alignment with strategic direction and maximize return on investments.

Performance and Development:

Serves as a role model for driving performance across teams through tailored feedback and coaching in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations.
Drives consistency in the application of talent development procedures and socializes performance expectations across the organization.
Ensures that individual development goals are aligned with organizational strategic initiatives.
Collaborates with HR to implement talent strategy through hiring and promotion processes.

Qualifications

Range and benefit information provided in this posting are specific to the stated locations only

Candidates are typically placed into the range based on the preceding factors as well as internal peer equity.

Medical, dental, and vision insurance, including expert medical opinion

Paid time off: Flexible Vacation is provided to all eligible employees assigned to a salaried (non-overtime eligible) position. Accrued Vacation is provided to all other employees eligible for vacation benefits. For employees working at least 35 hours per week, the vacation accrual rate is 13 days annually for the first three years of employment and 18 days annually for subsequent years of employment. Vacation accrual is prorated for employees working between 20 and 34 hours per week. Employees working fewer than 20 hours per week are not eligible for vacation.
11 paid holidays

jobs.title: Vice President, Technology Development and Business Operations
Director, Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Director, Software Engineering

Director, Software Engineering

Mastercard's Business Experimentation & Optimization (BEO) program is seeking a Director, Software Engineering to lead the design, delivery, and evolution of our data platforms, analytics capabilities, and customer-facing solutions. This leader will be responsible for a global engineering organization that develops and operates the end-to-end data and analytics ecosystem powering customer insights and decision-making.

The role will initially focus on leading teams responsible for data ingestion, data engineering and data pipelines, custom analytics, and insight delivery, partnering closely with Product, Data Science, Analytics, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, high-quality solutions that create measurable customer and business value. Over time, this leader will expand their scope to assume ownership of key customer-facing products and experiences, helping shape the future vision and technology strategy for the BEO platform.

As part of the Services Technology organization, BEO is undergoing a significant technology transformation to modernize how we generate and deliver insights to our customers. This is a highly visible technical leadership opportunity to drive innovation through cloud-native platforms, modern data architectures, AI-enabled capabilities, and emerging technologies including agentic workflows. The successful candidate will play a critical role in shaping the next generation of experimentation, analytics, and insight delivery capabilities across the platform.

This hybrid role is based in Arlington, VA and requires three days per week onsite. The leader will manage a global organization of approximately 25 engineers and engineering leaders, including 4–5 direct reports across the United States, India, and Europe. Success in this role requires strong technical leadership, working with ambiguity in a rapidly changing ecosystem, stakeholder management, and the ability to drive execution across globally distributed teams.

Role

Lead engineering teams responsible for ingesting, transforming, and managing large-scale data assets that power analytics and customer-facing insights.
Build and scale modern data platforms, APIs, and applications that support experimentation, measurement, reporting, and advanced analytics use cases.
Partner closely with Product, Data Science, and Analytics teams to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
Lead modernization efforts leveraging cloud technologies, AI-enabled workflows, and automation to improve speed, quality, and customer outcomes.
Champion improvements in developer experience, engineering tooling, and best practices, including the adoption of AI to improve productivity and engineering effectiveness.
Lead, coach, and develop engineers and engineering managers across global, cross-functional teams.
Identify, assess, and mitigate technical risks in collaboration with senior technology leaders.
Foster a culture of innovation, experimentation, and continuous technical learning.
Set high standards for engineering excellence and elevate team performance.
Navigate complex cross-team dependencies and drive alignment across stakeholders.
Promote agile ways of working and enable teams to adapt quickly to changing priorities and insights.
Engage and influence senior stakeholders on technology direction and product decisions.
Anticipate and plan for future scaling needs aligned with business growth and customer demand.

All About You

Proven experience as an Engineering leader in an agile, production-scale environment.
Experience leading multiple engineering teams and developing engineering leaders in a global, distributed setup.
Strong track record of defining architecture, design, and delivery of large-scale, multi-team systems.
Hands-on familiarity with full-stack, data, and cloud technologies such as Databricks, AWS (Data Services + Agentic/ML Services including EMR, Agent Core, Bedrock etc), .NET/C#, Java, Spring Boot, React, Python, Spark, or similar.
Strong technical foundation with ability to quickly learn and adopt new technologies.
Relentless focus on customer value, business outcomes, and delivery excellence.
Experience improving engineering organizations, structures, and delivery processes at scale.
Ability to influence across teams, functions, and geographies to drive technical alignment.
Proven success leading distributed global teams across multiple regions.
Strong understanding of SDLC methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and when to apply them.
Proven ability to build, mentor, and retain high-performing engineering leaders
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence executive, business, and technical stakeholders.
Strong analytical thinking and decision-making capabilities in ambiguous and complex environments.
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best-in-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on-site fitness facilities in some locations.

Pay Ranges

Arlington, Virginia: $195,000 - $323,000 USD

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
About Teikametrics

Teikametrics is revolutionizing retail through our patented Artificial Retail Intelligence platform. Our proprietary orchestration layer functions as prompt intelligence, verticalizing AI for Amazon, Walmart, TikTok and emerging marketplace use cases.

About The Role

Teikametrics is seeking a visionary and operationally excellent leader to join our team as Chief Technology Officer (CTO). Reporting directly to the CEO, this strategic yet hands-on role will drive our technology and product development as we continue our rapid growth trajectory from $50M to $100M+ in ARR.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of AI-powered marketplace optimization. You'll lead the technical roadmap for our competitive advantage: a patented orchestration layer that creates IP around retail intelligence while platforming our advertising capabilities across major marketplaces.

How You'll Spend Your Time

Operational Excellence & Team Leadership

Lead and scale engineering teams across distributed locations (US and India)
Drive a culture of operational excellence and engineering best practices globally
Build and mentor a world-class distributed engineering organization
Foster collaboration between US-based and India-based engineering teams

Technical Roadmap & Architecture

Own and execute the technical roadmap aligned with our AI-powered marketplace platform strategy
Simplify and expand Teikametrics' infrastructure via scalable microservices using the latest cloud technologies (Serverless and NoSQL formats)
Design and implement technical solutions to support scaling ARR
Drive innovation in our patented orchestration layer and AI capabilities

Infrastructure & Integration

Execute infrastructure to rapidly expand data pipelines across multiple major marketplaces including Amazon, Walmart, Meta, TikTok, Google, Shopify, and more
Collaborate with Product and Senior Leadership to design and execute technology supporting business requirements
Ensure platform scalability, reliability, and performance as we grow

Strategic Partnership

Partner closely with the CEO and leadership team on technology strategy
Translate business objectives into technical initiatives
Champion the technical vision for our artificial retail intelligence platform

Who You Are

10-15+ years of experience building SaaS technology and leading engineering teams in Big Data environments (Consumer retail and Banking industries a plus)
Degree in Computer Science from a leading technical institution
Proven experience leading large, remote teams across the US and India at leading SaaS companies
Technical expertise in scalable microservices using the latest cloud technologies
Demonstrated success managing distributed teams with engineering presence in India
Strong AI/ML background with experience in generative AI, LLMs, or related technologies
Operational excellence mindset with track record of building high-performing, distributed engineering cultures

What Can Help You Stand Out

eCommerce and marketplace experience, particularly working with platforms like Amazon, Shopify, Google, Walmart, eBay, TikTok
Deep AI expertise, especially in prompt engineering, orchestration layers, or verticalized AI applications
Experience in retail technology or advertising technology platforms
Track record of scaling engineering organizations through hypergrowth phases (2-5x)
Strong product sensibility and experience partnering closely with product teams

WHY TEIKAMETRICS?

Shape the future of Artificial Retail Intelligence with our patented technology
Lead technical innovation at a company with strategic backing from industry leaders
Work on cutting-edge AI applications with real-world impact across major marketplaces
Drive significant business outcomes during a pivotal growth phase ($50M to $100M+ ARR)
Lead and develop talented engineering teams across two continents
Partner directly with visionary leadership team and CEO

OUR COMPETITIVE ADVANTAGE

Patented orchestration layer that creates defensible IP in the AI-powered marketplace optimization space
Strategic partnerships including licensing deals with Walmart and major marketplace integrations
Strong investor backing from retail and technology leaders who bring strategic value
Market timing: Positioned at the intersection of AI, eCommerce, and marketplace advertising

$200,000 - $250,000 a year

The successful candidate's starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to: skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes potential opportunities for bonus or commissions, and equity grants. Speak with your recruiter for more information.

WORKING AT TEIKAMETRICS

Join us! We hire talented individuals remotely across the following states: Arkansas, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Indiana, Kentucky, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Hampshire, New Jersey, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, and West Virginia. Competitive cash
A robust benefits package effective on day one!
Generous stock option packages and investment opportunities
Remote friendly - we hire in 25 states and 3 countries

jobs.title: Director, Developer Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Developer Platform Engineering based in United States.

This is a senior engineering leadership opportunity focused on shaping how software is built, tested, deployed, and operated across a large engineering organization.

You will own the strategy and evolution of developer platforms, tooling, and practices that enable hundreds of engineers to deliver software faster and more reliably.

The role combines technical vision, platform modernization, developer experience, and organizational leadership at significant scale.

You will partner closely with Product Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, SRE, and Architecture to reduce operational complexity and accelerate delivery.

A major focus will be modernizing CI/CD, release engineering, testing infrastructure, local development, and self-service capabilities.

You will also lead the responsible adoption of AI-powered engineering tools and establish metrics that demonstrate improvements in developer productivity.

This role is ideal for an experienced platform leader who can translate a compelling technical vision into measurable enterprise-wide impact.

Accountabilities

Define and execute the long-term strategy and roadmap for a unified Developer Platform, standardizing software development lifecycle practices across a large engineering organization.
Own the developer experience end to end, from local development through production, identifying and eliminating friction across development, builds, testing, deployment, and operations.
Modernize CI/CD platforms and establish standardized, scalable delivery pipelines, including GitOps and progressive delivery practices such as canary and blue/green deployments.
Establish scalable infrastructure and strategies for unit, integration, end-to-end, and performance testing to improve software quality and release confidence.
Lead the adoption of AI-powered and agentic engineering tools for coding, testing, documentation, and other development workflows while establishing responsible-use practices.
Develop self-service platform capabilities that allow engineering teams to move faster while reducing operational complexity and dependency on centralized teams.
Establish developer productivity and platform health KPIs, including relevant frameworks and dashboards, to measure outcomes and guide technology investment.
Partner with Product Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, SRE, Architecture, and other stakeholders to align priorities, resolve dependencies, and drive platform adoption.
Lead large-scale engineering transformation initiatives, balancing modernization goals with reliability, scalability, and business continuity.
Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing Developer Platform organization, including mentoring managers and senior technical leaders.
Build organizational alignment around platform strategy and communicate technical priorities, progress, and business impact effectively to executive stakeholders.
Drive the first-year priorities of establishing a unified platform strategy, improving developer productivity, standardizing delivery practices, expanding AI-enabled engineering capabilities, and scaling the organization.

Requirements

10+ years of experience in software engineering, with significant experience leading platform engineering, developer infrastructure, or developer productivity organizations.
5+ years of experience managing managers within large-scale technical organizations.
Proven track record defining and executing platform strategies that support organizations with hundreds of engineers.
Deep expertise in CI/CD, DevOps, developer experience, software delivery, and engineering productivity practices.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale engineering transformations and modernizing development and delivery ecosystems.
Strong executive communication and stakeholder-influence skills, with the ability to build alignment across complex technical organizations.
Hands-on knowledge of cloud-native technologies and Kubernetes environments across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.
Experience with CI/CD technologies such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins and GitOps tools such as ArgoCD or Flux.
Familiarity with modern build systems such as Gradle, Bazel, or Nx and testing infrastructure spanning unit, integration, end-to-end, and performance testing.
Experience with progressive deployment approaches, including canary releases, blue/green deployments, feature flags, internal developer platforms, and developer portals.
Knowledge of developer experience measurement frameworks such as DORA or SPACE and observability platforms.
Experience with AI-powered developer tools, including solutions such as GitHub Copilot, Anthropic-based tools, or agentic engineering workflows.
Strong organizational leadership, talent development, strategic thinking, and change-management capabilities.
Ability to balance technical depth with business judgment and communicate complex engineering concepts clearly to executive and cross-functional audiences.
A growth mindset and willingness to apply even when not every preferred qualification is met.

Benefits

Base salary: $200,000–$250,000 annually in the United States, with final compensation based on experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location.
Performance-based bonus eligibility tied to individual and company performance.
Remote-friendly work environment with flexibility for U.S.-based employees.
$150 monthly Connectivity Plus stipend to support remote-work-related expenses.
$200 annual home office reimbursement.
Medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage.
401(k) plan with company matching.
Paid parental and caregiver leave.

This is a hands-on leadership role

You know what it takes to deliver reliable, compliant software to regulated financial institutions, and you build systems that make quality visible, not judgment-based.

jobs.title: Head of Forward Deployed Engineering
jobs.description:
About Cape

Cape is America’s privacy-first mobile carrier. Our mission is to be a force for good in global wireless. Cape was founded in 2022 by people who believe privacy is a fundamental right, not a luxury to be traded away. Our journey began when our founder recognized a critical vulnerability in our modern world: everyone relies on the same stagnant cellular infrastructure and legacy systems that track our every movement, monitor and profile our connections, and lose and sell our personal data.

Instead of accepting the status quo, we decided to fix it. National security professionals, journalists, parents, and everyone in between can stay connected and have privacy.

We didn’t just build a layer on top of old tech; we built America’s most private and secure mobile carrier from the ground up. By building our own network from scratch, we are able to design and build a suite of privacy and security features that no other carrier on the planet can offer.

Today, Cape provides our secure network to consumers, businesses, and government agencies alike. We closed our Series C in March 2026, and we are scaling rapidly, with the goal of giving people back control of their most personal information.

The Team

At Cape, we are the architects of a privacy-centric movement that is just getting started. We are relentless builders, constantly innovating at the edge of what's possible in telecommunications. We operate on a foundation of high trust and high expectations. Our structure is flat, and collaboration matters more than hierarchy. As a member of our team, you will collaborate with world-class engineers, architects, and visionaries, and work across organizational lines to solve "impossible" problems and deliver mission-critical results for our users every single day.

The Problem

The commercial cellular network represents trillions of dollars in private investment worldwide. It is performant, highly available, near ubiquitous, and the spec is mature and well understood. It’s the perfect transport layer for government use cases, if only they could trust the network. But they cannot: that infrastructure is easily disrupted and surveilled, and existing solutions are typically clunky, proprietary, and fail at the first sign of a contested RF environment.

Cape started at first principles to build a secure network architecture that operates through assumed compromised physical infrastructure. Now we need to solve operational capabilities at scale. How do we provide security-first, resilient communications for operators at the tactical edge? How do we ensure connectivity without compromise when the backhaul is being actively jammed, intercepted, or physically severed?

We are moving from validated technology to mission-critical infrastructure
that works in contested environments when failure is not an option. Leading this team of engineers is a high stakes, critical role and will be deeply rewarding for the right person.

The Role

Cape’s platform gives customers end-to-end control of their digital identity, even as they connect to untrusted networks, optimizing for resiliency, privacy, and security at every turn. As the Head of Federal Engineering, you will gain rare insight into the world’s most challenging environments. You will own the technical execution of the federal business, partnering with Business Development and Product to bridge the gap between our core technology and the specific, demanding requirements of our government partners.

You will cultivate a high-performing technical team, providing the mentorship needed to deliver outcomes in highly regulated spaces. Your charge is to grow the business and empower your engineers to work autonomously in remote locations, making great technical decisions to build the most overlooked yet critical components of modern Command and Control (C2)--the transport layer.

Core Responsibilities

Architect and execute the technical vision for our federal engineering organization, building the secure, resilient, and scalable network and platform that our nation's most critical missions depend on. Your leadership will directly translate our privacy-first ethos into capabilities that protect and empower those in public service.
Lead, mentor, and inspire a world-class team of engineers dedicated to solving the nation's toughest Command and Control challenges. You will foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and unwavering integrity, empowering your team to deliver solutions that meet the highest standards of excellence and impact.
Serve as the key technical partner to our federal customers, translating their complex mission requirements into tangible, deployed solutions. You will build and nurture deep relationships, ensuring that we are not just a vendor, but a trusted partner in advancing national security and public trust.
Take complete ownership and serve as the technical owner for our federal customers. You will ensure that our engineering practices, security protocols, and delivery timelines set a new standard for what is possible in government technology.
Steer our engagement with the unique challenges and opportunities of the federal landscape. You will be the bridge between our core technology and the specific, demanding requirements of our government partners, ensuring our solutions are always at the vanguard of innovation and mission-ready.

What We Value

Proven ability to learn continuously, work independently, and make decisions with minimal supervision.
A belief that the best leaders empower their teams to achieve the impossible. You are a mentor and a force-multiplier, dedicated to growing the next generation of engineering leaders and fostering a culture where every individual can do their best work in service of the mission.
The ability to take a thoughtful, practical approach to problem-solving that considers tradeoffs and avoids over-engineering.
Skill and comfort working in a constantly evolving environment with dynamic objectives and iteration with users.
The ability to work collaboratively in teams of technical and non-technical individuals and understand how technical decisions impact the customer.
Understanding of cryptographic systems and how to design privacy conscious solutions.
The ability to learn new technology and concepts, even without in-depth experience.
The ability to balance a forward-looking vision with the concrete realities of government requirements and constraints. You find creative yet practical paths to deploy modern technology within highly regulated environments, ensuring solutions are not just innovative, but also accreditable and effective.
You are more than a technical leader; you are a diplomat and a strategist. You excel at building strong, collaborative relationships with government partners and internal stakeholders, translating mission needs into technical reality with clarity and conviction.

What We Require

Engineering background in Computer Science, Mathematics, Computer Engineering, Physics or similar field.
Demonstrated success leading engineering teams that have built, deployed, and sustained software solutions for U.S. government, defense, or intelligence community customers.
Understanding of modern software architecture, particularly for secure, scalable, and distributed systems. Experience with both cloud (e.g., AWS GovCloud, Azure Government) as well as air-gapped environments, and familiarity with federal security compliance standards (e.g., FedRAMP, RMF, STIGs) is helpful.
Proven ability to define a technical strategy and execute against it, aligning engineering efforts with both customer mission objectives and broader business goals.
The ability to articulate complex technical concepts with authority and clarity to a wide range of audiences, from your own engineers to senior government officials and non-technical stakeholders.
An active U.S. Top Secret (TS) security clearance is strongly preferred. At a minimum, you must have the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

We offer competitive compensation that is geo-adjusted
based on your location
, along with meaningful equity so you share in the value you help create. Salary range for this role in New York, New York is $200,000-$275,000 depending on experience and interview performance.

Our benefits include:

401(k) match
100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your dependents
12 weeks paid parental leave (for all parents, no waiting period)
Stipends for
Family-forming needs
Gender-affirming care

Our Culture & Values

We hire excellent people, give them outsized responsibility, and trust them to execute. Every person at Cape has a proven track record of tackling hard problems and winning.
We believe that personal privacy and national security are not at odds, and that they can be reconciled through strong technology.
We believe companies exist to build awesome things and take care of the people who build them, so we offer top-tier healthcare, 401(k) matching, and a generous vacation policy that our team actually uses to recharge.
We believe that a stronger company and a better product are built by people from all walks of life. We hire without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, disability, or Veteran status. If you are great at what you do, you belong here.

How To Apply

Click the link below to apply.

We reserve the right to make use of any unsolicited resumes received from outside recruiting agencies and / or individual recruiters without being responsible for payment of any fees asserted from the use of unsolicited resumes.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer.
