jobs.title: Director, Head of Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Every day, our team members do amazing things in pursuit of our shared purpose to build trust with our clients, partners, subcontractors, and teammates. No matter your background, education, or career path, if you share our vision to create extraordinary experiences, you belong at HITT
.

Director, Head of Software Engineering

Job Description

HITT is seeking a Head of Software Engineering to build a modern, AI-native software engineering practice from the ground up. This is a senior leadership role for an engineering executive with a builder’s mindset: someone who has seen firsthand how agentic, AI-enabled development is changing the way software gets made — and who knows how to turn that shift into a durable advantage for one of the nation’s largest general contractors. They bring the vision, technical depth, and people leadership to define how software gets built at HITT as the firm scales.

Reporting to the Chief Information Officer, the Head of Software Engineering will establish HITT’s agentic engineering practice from scratch — setting the technical vision, standing up lean, agile product teams, and creating the standards, workflows, and culture that let small teams of AI-fluent engineers deliver high-quality software at a pace traditional development organizations cannot match. This leader understands that tools are only half the story: lasting change comes from people, and they will be as invested in recruiting and developing talent as in technology itself.

The Head of Software Engineering is accountable for the structure and growth of the engineering organization, the delivery of applications and platforms that serve HITT’s project teams and jobsites nationwide, and the development of a new generation of AI-enabled engineering talent — hiring builders who already work this way and training HITT’s existing developers in new methods. The role partners closely with senior leaders across the firm and serves as a visible champion for the responsible, high-leverage use of AI in how HITT builds.

Responsibilities

Agentic Engineering Practice

Design, launch, and lead HITT’s agentic engineering practice from the ground up, defining the operating model, team structure, and software development lifecycle for AI-enabled delivery
Establish standards, guardrails, and best practices for agentic development — including AI coding agents and assistants, prompt and context engineering, human-in-the-loop review, automated testing, and evaluation
Select, implement, and evolve the AI development toolchain (coding agents, LLM platforms, orchestration frameworks, and integrations), reassessing regularly as the landscape advances
Partner with the CIO on the enterprise technology, data, and AI roadmap, ensuring the engineering practice accelerates HITT’s broader digital transformation
Ensure the software the practice ships are reliable, fast, and usable in high-velocity, decentralized field environments with users of many backgrounds

Talent, Recruiting & Enablement

Recruit and hire engineers and engineering leaders who thrive in lean, agile, AI-augmented teams, and position HITT as a destination for top AI-native engineering talent
Design and deliver training and enablement programs that upskill HITT’s existing developers in AI-enabled development methods: from hands-on workshops and pairing to internal playbooks and certification
Build a deep talent bench and clear career paths within the engineering function to ensure succession for senior roles
Foster a culture of experimentation — fail fast and pivot — while managing risk responsibly

Delivery & Engineering Excellence

Bring structure, accountability, and delivery discipline to the software engineering function, balancing execution (≈60%) with innovation (≈40%)
Implement lean, agile delivery practices built on small batches, rapid iteration, continuous integration and deployment, and measurable outcomes
Engineer security, quality, and compliance into every product, in alignment with HITT’s zero trust cybersecurity strategy and NIST-aligned frameworks
Define engineering KPIs and provide ongoing transparency to the executive team on velocity, quality, adoption, and business value delivered
Leverage external partners strategically while avoiding over-reliance on consultants, building enduring in-house engineering capability

Executive Leadership & Cross-Functional Influence

Serve as a strategic advisor to executive and operational leaders on what modern, AI-enabled software development makes possible for the business
Partner with operations, virtual design and construction (VDC), preconstruction, and corporate functions to identify high-value opportunities for custom software, automation, and agentic workflows
Represent HITT’s engineering practice externally, in recruiting, industry forums, and the broader technology community, to attract talent and partnerships
Champion responsible AI use, model governance, and data stewardship across the software portfolio

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred
12+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering teams or organizations; experience building a team, practice, or product organization from scratch is strongly preferred
Current, hands-on experience with AI-enabled and agentic software development, including AI coding agents and assistants (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor), LLM APIs, agent frameworks and orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, and evaluation practices
Demonstrated success recruiting strong engineers and training existing developers in new tools, methods, and ways of working
Proven track record leading lean, agile teams that ship, balancing innovation with operational discipline in a complex enterprise
Deep grounding in modern software engineering practice: cloud-native architecture, APIs and integration, CI/CD, DevSecOps, and test automation
Strong product sense and user empathy; experience delivering software for field-based or operational users (construction, engineering, manufacturing, logistics) is a plus
Executive-level communication and presentation skills; able to build conviction with C-suite audiences and translate deep technical topics for business leaders
Financial and vendor management acumen, with experience owning budgets and managing platform and tooling ecosystems

About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

As the Senior Engineering Manager for the Payroll Platform team, you’ll lead a high-impact engineering team for building the foundational platform within payroll organization that enable and support critical flows around payroll processing, approvals, corrections and many more.

jobs.description:
About Chalk

Chalk is building the data platform that powers the future of machine learning applications. We tear down complexity, latency, and scale barriers that have traditionally constrained ML capabilities. Our platform combines Rust-speed performance with elegant tools that developers love to use. Leading companies depend on Chalk for everything from stopping fraudulent credit card swipes, verifying identities, and maximizing clean energy capture. We've recently raised a $50 million Series A, led by Felicis.

About the role

Working directly with our founders, you'll serve as the engineering site lead for our New York office. You'll start by directly managing individual contributor engineers and tech leads, and as we scale the team, you'll hire and develop engineering managers beneath you — building the leadership layer of our NYC organization from the ground up.
This is a rare opportunity to define the technical strategy, organizational structure, and engineering culture of a fast-growing AI infrastructure startup. You'll collaborate with brilliant folks, including Putnam and Advent of Code winners, former Jane Street quants, and Rust compiler contributors — all dedicated to bending the curve of what's possible in AI inference.

We're in the office 5 days a week. When unavoidable conflicts come up, we’re flexible. This is not a hybrid role.

What you will do

Serve as the engineering site lead for New York, with ownership of all NYC engineering
Directly manage engineers building Chalk's data platform, and hire and grow engineering managers as the site scales
Partner with the founding team to set technical strategy and shape our long-term product and platform roadmap
Design the organizational structure, hiring plan, and leadership pipeline for a rapidly growing engineering site
Establish engineering processes and operating rhythms that enable high velocity without sacrificing quality
Work directly with customers and executives to understand requirements and ensure Chalk's platform solves real-world ML challenges
Define and champion Chalk's engineering culture in New York — you'll set the bar for how we attract, develop, and retain top talent

What we're looking for

10+ years of engineering experience with 5+ years of engineering management
Experience managing managers, or a clear readiness to build and lead a multi-layer organization

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.

We are a fast-growing startup commercializing next-generation electrochemical technology. We are seeking a visionary, hands-on Director of Engineering to join our executive leadership team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between breakthrough laboratory science and multi-megawatt commercial deployment. You will own the entire engineering lifecycle: from multi-cell electrochemical stack scale-up to BOP design, process engineering, and ultimate field commissioning. As a key strategic partner to the CEO and Board, you will ensure our systems are uncompromisingly safe, cost-optimized, and strictly built for manufacturability.

jobs.description:
Full Position Salary Range: $106,635 - $165,284

If selected for the position, the hiring range is $106,635 - $135,959 (based on qualifications and experience)

BENEFITS

The Town of Matthews offers a comprehensive benefits package including bilingual incentive pay, vacation and sick leave, increased vacation accrual for qualified service with another government agency, shared sick leave, medical insurance, paid parental leave, health reimbursement account (HRA), dental plan, vision insurance, North Carolina Local Government Employees Retirement Plan, 457 and 401K Retirement Accounts, flexible medical & dependent care spending accounts, EAP, group and voluntary life insurance & AD&D, short-term disability, long-term disability, accident plans, hospital indemnity plans, and critical illness insurance, and tuition reimbursement.
POSITION SUMMARY

Performs executive-level professional engineering and administrative work directing the Town's Engineering Department and serves as the Town Engineer. Responsible for engineering operations, capital project delivery, development engineering, engineering standards, infrastructure planning, consultant management, and departmental leadership. Work is performed under the general supervision of the Assistant Town Manager and is evaluated through conferences and review of records for quality of overall construction in the Town, the relationship with the development community, and acceptance by the general community.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

(The duties listed below are intended only as illustrations of the various types of work that may be performed. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related, or a logical assignment to the class.)
Plans, organizes, and directs all engineering services in the Town and the work of the department to provide timely, thorough, and effective response to construction within the Town.
Directs plan review, site inspection, project design, and construction-industry relations functions to assure quality construction projects for the Town.
Supervises department; trains, develops, provides performance coaching and evaluation to create a skilled and motivated staff.
Serves as the Town's principal engineering advisor to the Town Manager, Board of Commissioners, and other departments.
Develops long-range engineering strategies consistent with the Town's Strategic Plan.
Advises executive leadership on infrastructure investment priorities.
Develops departmental performance measures; identifies operational efficiencies and continuous improvement opportunities.
Represents the Engineering Department as a member of the Town's executive leadership team.
Supervises the preparation of construction plans, bid packages, design criteria, analysis, specifications, plans, rights of way maps, investigations, cost estimates, and tabulation of contract bids for construction projects; authorizes contract payments; establishes schedules for work; recommends selection of consultants and contractors.
Signs and seals engineering documents.
Oversees the capital improvement process engineering design of infrastructure for the Town; coordinates design needs with other departments, other related staff, and user needs; ensures designs meet long-term quality and functionality as well as regulatory requirements; updates and applies Town engineering standards to achieve desired outcomes.
Oversees consultants and contracted engineers, including selection, negotiating scope, administering and managing contracts, assuring the preparation of reports and engineering records, evaluating performance, and reviewing invoices.
Collaborates with the North Carolina Department of Transportation on projects as necessary.
Develops long-range transportation, drainage, sidewalk, and infrastructure improvement plans.
Oversees stormwater and sediment control plan review, site inspection, and handling of citizen complaints in collaboration with Mecklenburg County; enforces stormwater regulations.
Reviews applications for development permits; ensures development plans comply with applicable ordinances, codes, and regulations.
Reviews and approves plans for proposed subdivisions and planned unit developments.
Administers the department budget, authorizes purchases, and monitors expenditures for compliance with Town of Matthews budgeting policies and procedures.
Identifies, prepares, and administers federal, state, and regional grant opportunities for infrastructure improvements.
Makes field visits to observe and collaborate with staff, meet construction industry officials, and observe construction quality and community impact.
Develops and delivers technical presentations for the Board of Commissioners; simplifies complex engineering data and project specifics into understandable reports and recommendations for public officials, non-engineering staff, and the community.
Develops special projects, strategies, designs, or other activities to support Town and departmental management; researches issues and prepares reports; advises management, construction industry, elected officials, and others on related matters.
Maintains files and records; prepares reports.
Performs related duties as required.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

(The knowledge, skills, and abilities listed in this specification are representative of the class but are not an all-inclusive list.)
Comprehensive knowledge of and ability to apply engineering principles and practices as applied to land development and related to design and construction of infrastructure.
Broad knowledge of transportation, stormwater, and site civil engineering, with comprehensive knowledge of at least one of these.
Thorough knowledge of related laws, ordinances, codes, and regulations affecting utility, public works, and construction by the Town or by contractors.
Considerable knowledge of leadership and organizational development.
Considerable knowledge of effective supervisory practices related to employee communication, motivation, performance coaching, and evaluation.
Considerable knowledge of municipal personnel, budgeting, and purchasing policies and practices.
Knowledge of Capital Improvement Program development.
Ability to present technical information and communicate effectively, both orally and in writing.
Ability to read and interpret laws, codes, ordinances, plans, specifications, and blueprints and to compare and interpret them with various aspects of construction in progress.
Ability to perform difficult engineering computations and to make comprehensive recommendations on engineering problems; skill in the use of civil engineering instruments.
Ability to establish effective working relationships with employees, various departments, public officials, engineers, contractors, developers, consultants, construction workers, and the general public.
Ability to prepare and conduct effective public presentations; and to read and prepare complex records and reports.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Must be able to physically perform the basic life operational support functions of climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, reaching, standing, walking, pulling, lifting, grasping, fingering, talking, and hearing.
Must be able to perform sedentary work exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally, and a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to move objects.
Must possess the visual acuity to maintain records and reports, review maps and drawings, inspect work for quality of methods and materials, operate a computer terminal, and use measuring devices.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT

Must be conscious of potential hazards and safety practices to avoid injury to others and themselves; May be subject to hazards including working in both inside and outside environments, in extreme hot and cold weather, and exposure to various hazards such as construction noise and hazards, proximity to moving mechanical parts, vibrations, dust, mists, fumes, oils, tight quarters, and narrow passageways. This position is subject to all State and Federal OSHA regulations, including, but not limited to the following: bloodborne pathogens, hazard communication/GHS, personal protective equipment, slips, trips, and falls, etc.
EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university in Civil Engineering or a closely related field.
At least eight (8) years of progressively responsible engineering experience, including a minimum of five (5) years of supervisory or management experience in municipal engineering, public infrastructure, or consulting engineering; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

CERTIFICATE AND LICENSE REQUIREMENTS

Must possess or be able to obtain a valid North Carolina Driver's License within 60 days of employment with a safe driving record. (If you possess a South Carolina Driver’s License and maintain residence in South Carolina, you are not required to attain a North Carolina Driver's License.)
Current licensure as a Professional Engineer in North Carolina or the ability to secure licensure within six months of hire is mandatory.

CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT

The Town of Matthews requires background checks to be conducted on the final candidate(s) applying for any position with the Town of Matthews. For this position, final candidates must pass a background process to include, but are not limited to, work history verification, professional/personal reference checks, pre-employment drug screening and physical, criminal background, and driving record checks, etc. During the selection process, candidates may be asked to take a skills test and/or participate in other assessments.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager (Web Platform)
jobs.description:
1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.
We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 75,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 1 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

About Engineering At Headway

Building a new mental healthcare system at Headway is only possible because of the scale and leverage that software can provide. The engineering team at Headway is a small but mighty team using technology to build that future (and have a fun time while doing it!).

Principles That Guide Us

Focus on the mission: We view software as a means of effecting change in the world, not as an end unto itself. We write software to empower our patients and therapist to better solve the problems they're facing.
Ship small, learn fast: We are building new and novel products and believe that we learn what our users need by quickly shipping and iteration
Everything is a product: Whether it's our patient search experience or a developer productivity improvement, we treat everything we build at Headway as a product with end-users in mind.
Optimize for trust: We believe that engineers should be continually learning. To learn effectively and to be productive, engineers must feel safe asking questions and discussing mistakes.

Tools We Use

Languages: TypeScript
Libraries & Frameworks: React, Remix, Next.js
Monitoring: Datadog, PagerDuty, Sentry
Version Control: Github
AI Tools: Cursor, Claude, Gemini, Eddy (our in-house cloud agent harness)

About This Role

As a Senior Engineering Manager for Web Platform, you will be responsible for leading and growing the engineering team through people development, strategic planning, and close partnership with Engineering Leadership, Product, and Design. You will play a leading role in defining the team's roadmap, making a clear and well-supported case for platform investment across the organization, and ensuring the team's work directly enables Headway's product and business goals. This role requires strong organizational leadership and strategic communication: the platform only delivers its full value when the rest of engineering understands what it makes possible.

Who You Are

We're looking for experienced engineering team leaders and people managers who are relationship-obsessed, drive results, and enable their teams to build for technical excellence. As a Senior Engineering Manager at Headway, you will work closely with Engineering Leadership, Product, Design, and Business teams to help shape the future of the engineering organization. This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate, mission-aligned engineering leader to make an immediate impact on our rapidly scaling engineering team.

Below are additional experiences we think help engineering managers succeed at Headway:

You have 5+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager
You have 10+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, with depth in modern frontend and web technologies
You have experience leading platform, infrastructure, or developer experience teams and understand how to make the case for foundational work in an organization driven by product outcomes
You are a strong strategic communicator who can translate platform investments into clear business value for non-technical stakeholders and executive leadership
You have a track record of building alignment across multiple product teams, navigating competing priorities, and driving a shared roadmap forward
You are proactive in creating organizational visibility for your team's work through documentation, metrics, and stakeholder engagement, not just through the work itself
You are able to build and maintain strong cross-functional relationships with Design and Product, keeping platform and product roadmaps in sync

Our interview process

After you apply to Headway, here are some details of what to expect during the interview process.

Initial screen: You'll connect with someone in recruiting so you can learn more about the team, Headway's mission and exciting growth, and we can get a better idea of your background.
First rounds: You'll meet with an engineering leader on the team to go deeper into your team and people leadership experiences.

jobs.description:
1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.
We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 75,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 1 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

About Engineering At Headway

Building a new mental healthcare system at Headway is only possible because of the scale and leverage that software can provide. The engineering team at Headway is a small but mighty team using technology to build that future (and have a fun time while doing it!).

Principles That Guide Us

Focus on the mission: We view software as a means of effecting change in the world, not as an end unto itself. We write software to empower our patients and therapist to better solve the problems they're facing.
Ship small, learn fast: We are building new and novel products and believe that we learn what our users need by quickly shipping and iteration
Everything is a product: Whether it's our patient search experience or a developer productivity improvement, we treat everything we build at Headway as a product with end-users in mind.
Optimize for trust: We believe that engineers should be continually learning. To learn effectively and to be productive, engineers must feel safe asking questions and discussing mistakes.

Tools We Use

Languages: TypeScript
Libraries & Frameworks: React, Remix, Next.js
Monitoring: Datadog, PagerDuty, Sentry
Version Control: Github
AI Tools: Cursor, Claude, Gemini, Eddy (our in-house cloud agent harness)

You will play a leading role in defining the team's roadmap, making a clear and well-supported case for platform investment across the organization, and ensuring the team's work directly enables Headway's product and business goals. This role requires strong organizational leadership and strategic communication: the platform only delivers its full value when the rest of engineering understands what it makes possible.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, AI Agents
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an experienced engineering leader to lead and scale Asana’s flagship AI Teammates Pillar within our Core/AI Organization. Reporting directly to the Head of Engineering, AI & AWM, you will oversee an engineering area encompassing four key teams: AI Teammates Platform (AITP), AI Teammates Experience (AITX), AI Chat Experience, and Agent Orchestration. In this role, you will lead engineering managers and senior technical leaders to drive the end-to-end strategy, execution, and architecture that define how humans and AI collaborate in Asana, turning frontier LLM capabilities into trusted, reliable, high-value product workflows for enterprise customers worldwide.

This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What You’ll Achieve

Drive Strategy & Execution Across the AI Teammates Pillar: Lead, set direction, and align goals/metrics across four core engineering teams (Platform, Experience, Chat, and Agent Orchestration) to execute on Asana’s flagship AI vision while balancing business, customer, and technical needs.
Architect Enterprise-Grade AI Platforms & Systems: Own the end-to-end technical strategy across model rollouts, eval infrastructure, tool orchestration, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and proactivity engines—enabling Asana to operate reliable agentic systems for top-tier enterprise customers.
Define Next-Generation Human-AI Collaboration: Lead product and platform engineering teams delivering full-screen and docked chat surfaces, discovery/onboarding flows, in-product explainability, human-in-the-loop workflows, and ROI/governance experiences for administrators.
Pioneer Multi-System Agent Orchestration: Build integrations, Agent Skills, and MCP frameworks that allow AI Teammates to act as the central control point for complex, multi-step workflows across external tools like Slack, Salesforce, coding agents, and internal systems.
Scale Engineering Leadership & Culture: Plan and implement the scaling of your engineering organization. Recruit, close, and retain top engineering talent and managers, develop leadership capabilities across teams, and foster an inclusive environment centered on engineering excellence and psychological safety.
Bridge Cross-Functional & External Strategic Alignment: Align technical, product, and business perspectives across R&D, Product, Design, Security, and Legal, while maintaining close strategic partnerships with frontier AI labs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic).

About You

Proven Leadership Experience: 8+ years of software engineering experience with 4+ years leading multiple engineering teams or managers, with a track record of driving multi-team strategy and delivering complex production systems.
AI & Agentic Systems Expertise: Deep understanding of applied AI, LLM evaluation frameworks, agent/tool orchestration, Model Context Protocol (MCP), proactivity models, and production observability.
Systems & Product Engineering Mastery: Experience spanning backend/systems reliability, complex full-stack product interfaces, and enterprise governance/permissions models operating at scale.
Strategic Trade-off & Risk Management: Proven ability to balance short-term customer deliverables with long-term architectural investments and navigate ambiguity over multiple quarters.
Excellence in People & Organizational Growth: Demonstrated commitment to attracting, hiring, and mentoring senior engineers and managers while championing diversity, equity, and inclusion.
Exceptional Communication: Strong capability to bridge business, product, and technical contexts to align executive stakeholders, internal engineering partners, and enterprise clients.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

jobs.description:
Role and Responsibilities

The candidate will lead the engineering organization for a top contract manufacturer in the additive manufacturing industry, primarily focused on laser powder bed fusion and turnkey manufacturing support for customer-designed components.
The Director of Engineering is responsible for the strategic vision of the engineering team, aligning processes, tools, and innovation with the overall company growth plans. Due to the breadth of manufacturing scope we handle, this role requires considerable background knowledge in powder bed fusion, post-processing, heat treating, destructive and non-destructive testing, and finishing methods.
The ideal candidate has experience in a production environment, balancing safety, quality, cost, execution, and innovation to create an environment for company success and sustainable growth. Excellent interpersonal skills are critical for properly communicating with customers and internal stakeholders.
As a small business, this position requires the flexibility to seamlessly move from board room to production floor to address priorities.
Key focus areas for this position include:
Shaping the strategy of the company with input on industry trends and technology advancements
Supporting business development by serving customers well with technical support
Defining and optimizing engineering processes to enable consistent and efficient execution of work
Promoting continuous improvement, on-time delivery, and quality output
Solving problems as they arise with a collaborative approach
Driving innovation through industry/academic partnerships, consortiums, and internal RandD

Engineering and Manufacturing

Lead a team of Additive Manufacturing Engineers and Production Engineers through quoting, digital order loading, process definition, and technical support for production. This scope includes:
Assess design for manufacturability, material selection, equipment selection, and design optimization
Guide customers in the selection of materials
Develop content and best practices for design and manufacturability by establishing design guidelines to ensure lessons learned and best practices are documented
Create build files, layouts, and use cost estimation models
Prepare bills of material (BOM) and routings in an Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system
Lead and provide technical direction for technicians
Provide "hands-on" support with printing and inspection equipment
Manage acquisition of necessary capital, maintenance contracts, consumables, and software to support growth strategies
Read and understand dimensional drawings, including GDandT
Analyze and specify post-processing steps such as heat treatment, finish machining, and coatings
Support and guide the root cause and corrective action (RCCA) process for technical issues

Customer Programs

Promote growth with key customers, new parts, and new industries by leading and supporting New Product Introduction (NPI).
Focus technology and process development to enable high-volume production.
Support the Project Management team in the following ways:
Assist in assembling quotations in response to customer RFQ's
Lead customer projects as the assigned project engineer
Prepare project schedules to define project scope deliverables
Lead and/or participate in regular customer meetings
Monitor and manage project costs in respect to the established budget
Anticipate problems and concerns relevant to project management and provide timely solutions
Coordinate document submittals, approvals, distribution, and revision control
Initiate purchase requisitions for tools, fixtures, operational equipment, and outside services
Maintain a strong working relationship with the customer
Occasional travel may be required to support project or program goals

Engineering echnical Programs / RandD

Lead advanced technical engineering programs (material/product/process development)
Lead statistical process control initiatives
Lead operational and supply chain cost reduction and optimization projects
Provide guidance on facility improvements, equipment selection, and in-sourcing

Qualifications And Education Requirements

Engineering degree in a related discipline (additive manufacturing, mechanical, metallurgical, etc.)
Minimum 12 years of experience in a production environment, including additive manufacturing, CNC machining, heat treating, and/or other metal fabrications technologies.
Prior experience must include technical roles and senior-level decision making roles with budget control.
Experience with the following software: CAD (e.g. SolidWorks, Catia), Build Preparation/Slice software (e.g. Materialise Magics, 3DExpert), Microsoft Office Suite

Masters or PhD in additive manufacturing or related engineering discipline
Previous experience working for a Contract Manufacturer in laser powder bed fusion

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Core Product
jobs.description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Harvey is evolving from a suite of individual tools into a unified, agentic platform for all legal knowledge work. We are building more than just a chat interface; we are building the orchestration layer that allows legal professionals to automate complex workflows, reason over vast datasets, and execute multi-step tasks across the entire legal lifecycle.

The Core Product pillar sits at the center of this evolution. As the primary entry point and engagement driver for the Harvey ecosystem, this team is responsible for architecting the platform foundations and user experiences that power the next generation of AI-native legal applications. You will ensure we build a cohesive, agentic platform that serves as the operating system for the future of legal work, while continuing to drive significant engagement and growth for Harvey.

What You'll Do

Lead the Flagship Experience: You’ll oversee some of the most important surface areas of Harvey, including homepage, core chat experience, document Q&A and more.
Architect a Platform: You’ll guide the transition of our core features into a scalable, agentic platform that the rest of our product and engineering teams can build and integrate upon.
Scale the Organization: Harvey is growing fast. Help us scale our engineering organization across the globe by hiring and retaining world-class software engineering and AI talent.
Shape the Structure: You’ll work with other leaders to shape the organization, both in terms of skill set and geographic footprint.

What You Have

Product-Minded Engineering Leader: You have a track record of shipping best-in-class products (consumer or enterprise) that drive significant user and business value.
GenAI Expertise: You’ve built and scaled innovative features using Generative AI and understand the nuances of AI product development.
Scaling Teams & Organizations: You have 5+ years of experience leading larger organizations, including other managers and senior individual contributors, ideally across startups and larger enterprises.
High-Growth Veteran: You thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments (startups/scale-ups) and know how to maintain technical excellence during rapid scaling.
Strategic Partner: You work effectively with senior leaders across Product, Design, and Research to define and execute complex company objectives.

320,000-360,000 USD

In close partnership with senior ICs, you will shape the platform’s strategy and technical direction.

Own the technical strategy and roadmap for ML training & serving, covering large-scale model training, model deployment workflows, GPU infrastructure, and low-latency model serving at scale.
Lead and grow a team of platform engineers while remaining deeply engaged in technical strategy and architectural trade-offs in close partnership with senior ICs.
Continuously evolve ML training & serving infrastructure to stay ahead of the frontier — anticipating where AI and ML are heading and building the infrastructure that makes those capabilities possible at Affirm before they become urgent needs. This includes large-scale training and serving of transformer-based models, GPU compute, reinforcement learning, and whatever comes next.
Partner with ML modeling, product, and infrastructure leadership to ensure ML training & serving infrastructure accelerates Affirm's most critical ML initiatives.
Establish engineering excellence across the organization: reliability, observability, developer experience, and operational rigor.
Recruit, develop, and retain world-class platform engineers.

10+ years of industry experience in software and/or machine learning engineering, with significant hands-on software engineering experience, including 4+ years managing engineering teams.
Deep expertise in building and operating large-scale ML infrastructure, with substantial experience in one or more of model training systems, model serving, deployment workflows, or GPU infrastructure.
Strong understanding of ML data needs — training datasets, data quality, reproducibility, evaluation data, and how data shapes model behavior and platform design.
Fluency with modern ML: deep neural networks, transformer architectures, reinforcement learning, large-scale GPU training and serving.
Strong systems thinking — comfortable reasoning from low-level infrastructure decisions to broad architectural trade-offs.
Track record of building platforms that meaningfully accelerate the productivity and impact of ML teams.
Experience on the applied ML modeling side is a plus — understanding how models are built makes you a better platform builder.
Proven track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing engineers, including coaching senior ICs and creating opportunities for them to expand their technical leadership.
Experience navigating ambiguity and leading through organizational complexity.
Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.

We need someone who has lived inside Pre-FEED and FEED. Someone who knows what a design basis package actually looks like at 3 AM before a gate review, who has directed engineers through datasheet cycles, and who has felt the pain of building the same thing from scratch on every project.

Shape Candid's delivery methodology and standards as we scale from early clients to a repeatable practice

15+ years in capital project execution, with significant time in power generation, gas-to-power, LNG, midstream, or petrochemical facilities

The Flink Platform team is at the forefront of building a robust, serverless control plane for Confluent’s fully managed Flink offering. Vision & Execution: Own the overall roadmap and execution for the Flink Control Plane. Define the strategy for job orchestration (submission, scaling, recovery) and serverless resource management.

Engineering Excellence: Work with engineering teams and product management on critical aspects of product definition, architectural design, and delivery. Influence the overall domain health and operational hygiene for the platform.
Scale & Performance: Drive the control plane's evolution to support 10x growth in compute pools, statements, and tenants per region. Lead initiatives that eliminate hotspots in the metadata and orchestration layers so customer-facing operations remain fast and predictable under load.
People Development: Manage and coach a diverse team. Your primary mission is to mentor junior and mid-level developers, providing them with the architectural context and leadership skills to reach Staff levels.
Collaboration: Work closely with engineering leadership and key stakeholders across Confluent Cloud to drive cross-team efforts to solve complex distributed system challenges at scale – strong cross-org partnership is core to the role.

Ready to build what's next? Let’s get in motion.

We are a fusion power company based in Everett, WA, with the mission to build the world's first fusion power plant, enabling a future with unlimited clean electricity. Our vision is a world with clean, reliable, and affordable energy for everyone.

Our current prototype, Polaris, has reached record-breaking plasma temperatures of 150 million degrees Celsius (13 keV). Helion is continuing to iterate and on the path to the world's first fusion power plant, Orion.

This is a pivotal time to join Helion. You will tackle real-world challenges with a team that prizes urgency, rigor, ownership, and a commitment to delivering hard truths – values essential to achieving what no one has before. Together, we will change the future of energy, because the world can't wait.

What You Will Be Doing

The capacitor bank is the beating heart of a Helion machine: it stores the energy for every fusion pulse, delivers it in under a millisecond, and takes it back. You will own the organization that architects, designs, qualifies, and produces hardware for Orion, our first fusion power plant.

You Will

Own the architecture of Orion's capacitor bank and its interdependencies with the machine core: requirements, decomposition, and the interfaces that let the bank, core, and controls behave as one machine
Lead and mentor a cross-functional team of electrical and mechanical engineers designing and qualifying pulsed power circuit modules for each section of the machine with ownership spanning pulsed power electrical design, mechanical and thermal solutions, and the high precision low voltage control interfaces that command them
Drive manufacturable design: partner day-to-day with manufacturing engineering to move modules from prototype test to production at rate, against a capacitor line building megajoules of pulsed power energy capacity per week
Own cost, schedule, and reliability for the module portfolio: make the architecture and design trades, set the qualification bar for hardware that must survive million-pulse campaigns and be accountable for hitting the objectives on a schedule you influenced
Work day-to-day with Research, Science, and Controls to keep module designs ahead of what the physics and operations teams learn from running machines
Build the team: hire, develop, and set the design-review and engineering standards that let the organization move from prototype to production without losing rigor
In your first year, you will baseline the Orion bank architecture, stand up the qualification program for the first production modules, and have production-intent hardware under test.

Required Skills

Bachelor's or master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a related field
10+ years developing complex electromechanical hardware, including 4+ years leading multidisciplinary engineering teams (Electrical, Mechanical, Firmware, Thermal)
A track record of taking hardware from prototype through qualification into production, and of the design-for-manufacture judgment that makes that transition fast
Technical depth in at least one of: power electronics or pulsed energy systems, high-reliability electromechanical design, or high-volume hardware production with fluency across the others
Demonstrated ownership of cost, schedule, and reliability at program scale, including making and defending hard trades
Cross-functional leadership strength: this role succeeds through tactical and strategic partnership with research, science, controls, and manufacturing
Experience scaling engineering teams and processes through a prototype-to-production transition

About The Job

Head of Engineering

We're hiring a Head of Engineering to reinvent how legal work gets done in the age of AI.

Boundless is a Series C legal tech company based in Seattle, backed by Pioneer Square Labs, Trilogy, Foundry Group (Brad Feld) and Silver Lake. We operate in 10+ countries and have helped over 100,000 people and companies navigate immigration. We build tech-powered immigration solutions for two audiences: corporate HR teams managing high volumes of employer-sponsored cases, and individuals navigating family and naturalization cases.

We have in-house lawyers and are building a world-class AI-powered services firm. Anthropic is not coming for this. Immigration is vertical, regulated, and workflow-deep, and we are racing to build the defining AI product in the category.

Why this role exists

We are rebuilding our software platform and engineering infrastructure from the ground up, and we need a Head of Engineering to lead the team.

You will inherit a real customer base, a real platform, and a great team of engineers.

Immigration is complex, with endless edge cases and global scale. We are building intelligent automation, orchestration, and decision-making to support the agentification of legal workflows, with the checks and balances required to ensure accuracy in a regulated domain and to enable the lawyers who ultimately own legal decisions. The engineering challenge is a team and a system that can handle this complexity without sacrificing accuracy, observability, or speed, at the scale required to reliably serve thousands of people every year.

However, this is not a caretaker role. The world is changing around us and the team is in the midst of transitioning to both an AI-native customer product and an AI-native development process. You will need to drive change with us, and partner with our existing engineering, product, design, legal and operations teams to build a world-class AI-native platform for legal services, and continue to evolve our development infrastructure towards being a truly AI-native “software factory”.

We are looking for someone who can hold the whole picture: the customer, the team, the platform, the AI layer, the delivery system - and how they interact. Someone who makes hard calls, thinks in years not months, and builds an organization that top-tier engineers find exciting and satisfying to be part of.

We are a remote-first team with a small in-person office in Seattle. We want someone based in Seattle and expect you to be in the office a minimum of 2-days per week.

What You Will Do

Own engineering delivery end to end. Roadmap execution, quality, on-call, and the operational health of a platform that customers depend on daily.
Evolve team design as the work changes. Service boundaries and team boundaries move together.
You’ll be a true player-coach: expected to ship code yourself while leading the team and staying close to the details of everything we build.
Drive the AI transition through the team, not around it. Every engineer should be building with LLMs, retrieval, and structured tools as a default.
Build the foundational infrastructure that operating teams use to deploy, monitor, and manage agents and LLM-powered customer features at enormous scale.
Continue our transition towards a “software factory” engineering model, overhauling dev processes, systems, tools, and culture.
Partner with product, design, legal and operations as a peer. Engage thoughtfully in tradeoff conversations about scope, sequencing, and what "done" means in a regulated domain.
Set the technical bar in design reviews and hard tradeoff conversations. Make sure architecture decisions get written down and give the team durable context. Help us build a platform that both engineers and operating teams pine for after they leave.
Grow engineers into architectural thinking by giving them opportunities to step up, and pushing their thinking constructively.

Who You Are

You are a builder. You set new benchmarks for output and want a role where your team ships with autonomy and speed. Not a role where you wait for consensus.
You have 10+ years in engineering and 4+ years managing engineers, including managing managers or senior ICs.
You move fast by making decisions quickly, not by cutting corners. You know the difference between a reversible call and one that will come back to haunt us.
You hire well and manage out when you need to. You have built a team you were proud of and you can describe what made it work.
You have shipped AI into production and led a team through the shift. You have views on retrieval, evaluation, latency, and where LLMs break down, and you know when to use AI and when another tool is the right call.
You have been the technical decision-maker, not just the person who runs the process. You can lead a design review and change the answer.
You think in systems. You can hold the team, the platform, the AI layer, and the business constraints in your head at once and see where they don't line up.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering - Applications
jobs.description:
Seeq makes data analytics software for a big market that's often overlooked by tech companies: industrial process data. Think pharmaceutical manufacturers, wind farms, and energy companies with tons of equipment and sensors. Our software engineers tackle hard problems in streaming calculation, storage, and distributed computing, leveraging the latest features in Java, Kotlin, React, Python, Kubernetes and many other frameworks and technologies. We believe that AI is an exciting revolution in developer tooling and features we will bring to our customers, while also presenting new and real challenges to how people interact with each other.

We are looking for an engineering leader with a proven track record of managing technical teams and taking them to the next level. We have a solid set of development squads in place with a good foundation of processes, engineering talent, and a history of delivering best-in-class software. This position will lead the end-user facing squads, roughly half the engineering team, and expand our engineering capacity as we continue to grow our customer base and market aspirations.

Our company was founded 100% remote and we're proud of it. We've been good at remote for over 13 years and have used that advantage to create a global team despite our modest company size. Our engineers work anywhere in a compatible time zone (our core hours are 8am-12pm Pacific). We use a variety of collaboration tools, like Zoom, Slack, and our homegrown Qube Virtual Office, which make us feel like we're in the same building together. We use agile tenets to iterate on both our product and development processes. We have a wonderful team of kind-hearted, talented engineers that love to collaborate, teach each other new tricks, and build products that exceed our customers' expectations.

Our technology stack utilizes JVM languages (Java, Kotlin), Python, TypeScript/React and some C#/.NET. The core of our product is a full-featured calculation engine that can perform complex math and execute machine learning algorithms on streaming time series data. Our SaaS architecture is Kubernetes based, with clusters in a dozen global regions on both AWS and Azure.

Requirements

You love computers and programming. You have a degree in Computer Science or a related technical field or equivalent experience.

You are a hands-on technical leader - your skills and knowledge are current because you have been contributing in meaningful ways to technical teams even as you have advanced in leadership roles.

You have experience in distributed computing and deep knowledge of the cloud ecosystem.

You have deep experience and knowledge of enterprise software development lifecycles, including Agile methodologies (we generally use Scrumban here), CI/CD pipelines, discovery, design, quality assurance and support.

Current and past colleagues would describe you as an inspiring, humble, empathetic, and compassionate leader. You listen well and you are transparent with your thinking. You can influence without relying on hierarchy or authority.

You are a great mentor and coach, and you provide clear guidance. You are not a micro-manager, and you allow your folks and others outside your organization to make mistakes and support them as they learn and adjust.

You lead with curiosity. You actively seek out knowledge, learn quickly, and love to teach.

You are skilled at managing and resolving conflict among individuals, teams, team leaders, and your peers.

You are disciplined with a high attention to detail, reliable communication, and a steady hand.

You are up for traveling periodically to spend time with your team and the company and get some face-to-face time.

You know how to balance life & work despite the demands of a high-level leadership position.

You want to work with a bunch of really smart people that love working together. And you want to work at a scaleup with lots of happy customers, good investors, and a bright future.

Benefits

Seeq is a remote-first (only) company founded by serial entrepreneurs. Our executive team and board of directors have extensive experience with successful startup ventures in high-growth environments.

We are founded on the idea that companies need better solutions for quickly and easily getting business insight from their industrial process data. Our mission is to provide software and services that convert that data into meaningful information that the business can use to improve profitability.

We have a wonderful, kind-hearted, talented team that loves to collaborate, lead by example, and exceed our customers' expectations. We are certified as a great place to work, an emerging startup, the Technology Fast 500, and Inc. Magazine's Best Places to Work.

About Zania

Zania is building AI agents for enterprise governance, risk, and compliance teams to execute complex workflows with full explainability. Series A, $18M raised from NEA, Anthropic, and Menlo Ventures. Founded by a former founding security engineer at Airbnb and builder of Microsoft Security Copilot. We're not building another dashboard — we're replacing entire workflows with agents that do the work.

Why this role exists

We need a Head of Engineering who will own engineering end-to-end: architecture decisions, hiring, shipping cadence, and team culture. This is not a "manage managers" role. This is a hands-on technical leader who scales the team from ~5 to 20+ engineers in the next 12 months while personally ensuring the product is world-class.

What we're looking for — non-negotiables

1. Builder first, manager second.
This person was (or could be) the strongest engineer on any team they've been part of. They chose management not because they plateaued technically, but because they were a founder or realized leadership was the highest-leverage way to multiply themselves. They can read a PR, spot an architectural mistake, and rewrite it themselves if needed.
2. Founder DNA.
Prior experience as a technical founder or very early engineering leader (employee #1–10) at a startup that shipped real product under real constraints. They know what it means to make decisions with incomplete information, cut scope ruthlessly, and hold a team accountable to weekly ship cycles — not quarterly roadmaps.
3. Proven ability to scale a team from small to 20+.
They've hired 10–20 engineers in a compressed timeline without lowering the bar. They have a system for how to source, close, and onboard fast. Ideally they have a personal network of strong engineers in the Bay Area they'd bring with them or recruit from.
4. AI-native mindset. Not "interested in AI"
— actively building with LLMs, agents, tool-use, and orchestration frameworks today. They understand prompt engineering, evaluation, context window management, and the difference between demo-ware and production-grade AI systems. Experience with agentic architectures is strongly preferred.
5. Shipping velocity as a core value.
They measure engineering health by what's in production, not what's in Jira. They set aggressive timelines and hold the team to them. They know how to unblock engineers, kill unnecessary process, and create a culture where deploying daily is normal.
6. Deep, not wide.
We do not want a "mezzanine" leader — someone who operates through layers, delegates everything, and speaks in frameworks. This person goes deep on specific systems, debugs production issues at 2am, and explains architecture tradeoffs to a customer on a sales call.
What you'll do
Own all engineering output: product quality, velocity, reliability, and security.
Build the engineering team from current size to 15–20 in 12 months. Personally involved in every hire.
Set and enforce a shipping culture — weekly demos, continuous deployment, minimal process overhead.
Partner directly with the CEO on product direction, prioritization, and customer-facing technical conversations.
Architect and evolve the platform (LLM orchestration, agentic workflows, compliance automation) for enterprise scale.
Establish lightweight but real engineering practices: CI/CD, observability, on-call, code review standards.

Signals we look for

Founded or co-founded a technical startup (even if it didn't work out).
Scaled an eng team through a Series A/B at a product-led company.
Has shipped AI/ML products to production — not research, not POCs.
Deep in the Bay Area engineering community — knows who to call.
Background in security, infrastructure, or enterprise SaaS is a plus.
Has operated in a domain where correctness matters (fintech, security, health, compliance).

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
8+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in a technical leadership or founding engineering role at a product-led company
Demonstrated experience scaling an engineering team from small to 20+ engineers, with a proven ability to hire, develop, and retain senior technical talent
Deep, hands-on experience shipping AI/ML or agentic systems to production at enterprise scale
Strong written and verbal communication skills — you will partner directly with the CEO and represent engineering in customer-facing technical conversations

Comp

Significant equity + competitive cash — structured to attract a builder, not a caretaker. Reports directly to CEO.

Summary

objectives and outcomes. (#LZ1)

Detailed Description

Strategy and Leadership

Executive Reporting: Monitor and communicate the state of in field reliability, key risks, and the status of new product reliability to executive leadership and cross-functional partners. Drive

focused improvements to ensure field reliability stays within company targets and KPIs.

Reliability Resources and Budget Management: Define budget goals and manage resource growth/expansion for the Reliability Engineering function, including tools, testing equipment &

laboratories, and personnel.

Technical

Design for Reliability (DfR): Integrate reliability and maintainability principles into the product lifecycle from the initial design phase. Champion proactive methodologies such as prediction

models and lessons learned into Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA) hand in hand with the hardware and software design teams.

New Product Qualification: Plan, execute and report required destructive and non-destructive verification during product development, such as cross sectioning, shadow moiré, solderability, X-

ray etc. Drive improvements and mitigations where needed.

Reliability Testing & Validation: Proactively influence and oversee the development and execution of rigorous test plans, including Accelerated Life Testing (ALT), environmental testing, and qualification testing to predict and validate product warranty and lifespan. Drive mitigations and improvements needed based on the results from various functions such as design, manufacturing and suppliers.
Failure Analysis and Prevention: Lead and manage the Root Cause Analysis (RCA) program for critical and chronic failures, ensuring long-term corrective actions are implemented and

validated to prevent recurrence.

Ongoing Reliability Assurance: Maintain and influence ongoing reliability tests based on customer requirements and design criticalities. Inform and influence required ORTs based on

experience and field performance of predecessors.

Proactive Risk Assessment: Run risk assessments as required with failures simulated or seen during development/ in field.

Team Development & Culture

Team Leadership and Mentorship: Recruit, hire, mentor, and manage a team of Reliability Engineers and/or Site Reliability/ Failure Analysis Engineers. Provide technical guidance and training on advanced reliability principles and tools.

Proficiency in reliability analysis tools (ReliaSoft ,Weibull++, ALTA Pro, BlockSim) or a similar software.
Leadership and Mentoring: Proven experience managing and developing high-performing engineering teams.
Communication: Excellent ability to distill complex technical information into clear, actionable insights for technical teams, executive leadership, and business stakeholders.

Physical Demands

The job works in generally good conditions with occasional exposure (10% - 33%) to noise, odours, dust, drafts, chemicals, operating machinery, temperature extremes, hazardous substances, etc.
Duties of this role may include sustained visual concentration on small areas, such as monitors/screens, sustained visual concentration on numbers/legal documents.
Occasional overnight travel is required.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Aerospace, Systems, or Software/Computer Science).
Minimum of 10+ years of industry experience in Reliability Engineering, Design Engineering, or Test Engineering, with 5+ years in a leadership/management role.
Expertise in proactive and reactive reliability methodologies (e.g., FMEA, MTBF/MTTF, RCA, Weibull Analysis).

You will lead a team of strong software engineers and managers and act as a force multiplier for our internal customers. jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
Head of Engineering
Location:

Seattle, WA, Full-Time

We're hiring a Head of Engineering to reinvent how legal work gets done in the age of AI.

Boundless is a Series C legal tech company based in Seattle, backed by Pioneer Square Labs, Trilogy, Foundry Group (Brad Feld) and Silver Lake. We operate in 10+ countries and have helped over 100,000 people and companies navigate immigration. We build tech-powered immigration solutions for two audiences: corporate HR teams managing high volumes of employer-sponsored cases, and individuals navigating family and naturalization cases. 

We have in-house lawyers and are building a world-class AI-powered services firm. Anthropic is not coming for this. Immigration is vertical, regulated, and workflow-deep, and we are racing to build the defining AI product in the category.

Why this role exists

We are rebuilding our software platform and engineering infrastructure from the ground up, and we need a Head of Engineering to lead the team.

You will inherit a real customer base, a real platform, and a great team of engineers. 

Immigration is complex, with endless edge cases and global scale. We are building intelligent automation, orchestration, and decision-making to support the agentification of legal workflows, with the checks and balances required to ensure accuracy in a regulated domain and to enable the lawyers who ultimately own legal decisions. The engineering challenge is a team and a system that can handle this complexity without sacrificing accuracy, observability, or speed, at the scale required to reliably serve thousands of people every year.

However,  this is not a caretaker role. The world is changing around us and the team is in the midst of transitioning to both an AI-native customer product and an AI-native development process. You will need to drive change with us, and partner with our existing engineering, product, design, legal and operations teams to build a world-class AI-native platform for legal services, and continue to evolve our development infrastructure towards being a truly AI-native “software factory”.

We are looking for someone who can hold the whole picture: the customer, the team, the platform, the AI layer, the delivery system - and how they interact. Someone who makes hard calls, thinks in years not months, and builds an organization that top-tier engineers find exciting and satisfying to be part of. 

We are a remote-first team with a small in-person office in Seattle. We want someone based in Seattle and expect you to be in the office a minimum of 2-days per week.

What you will do

Build the team. Retain our top performers, hire more top-tier engineers, and lead, inspire, challenge, level, structure, and grow the team. 
Own engineering delivery end to end. Roadmap execution, quality, on-call, and the operational health of a platform that customers depend on daily.
Evolve team design as the work changes. Service boundaries and team boundaries move together. 
You’ll be a true player-coach: expected to ship code yourself while leading the team and staying close to the details of everything we build. 
Drive the AI transition through the team, not around it. Every engineer should be building with LLMs, retrieval, and structured tools as a default.
Build the foundational infrastructure that operating teams use to deploy, monitor, and manage agents and LLM-powered customer features at enormous scale. 
Continue our transition towards a “software factory” engineering model, overhauling dev processes, systems, tools, and culture.
Partner with product, design, legal and operations as a peer. Engage thoughtfully in tradeoff conversations about scope, sequencing, and what "done" means in a regulated domain.
Set the technical bar in design reviews and hard tradeoff conversations. Make sure architecture decisions get written down and give the team durable context. Help us build a platform that both engineers and operating teams pine for after they leave.
Grow engineers into architectural thinking by giving them opportunities to step up, and pushing their thinking constructively. 

Who you are

You are a builder. You set new benchmarks for output and want a role where your team ships with autonomy and speed. Not a role where you wait for consensus.
You have 10+ years in engineering and 4+ years managing engineers, including managing managers or senior ICs. 
You move fast by making decisions quickly, not by cutting corners. You know the difference between a reversible call and one that will come back to haunt us. 
You hire well and manage out when you need to. You have built a team you were proud of and you can describe what made it work.
You have shipped AI into production and led a team through the shift. You have views on retrieval, evaluation, latency, and where LLMs break down, and you know when to use AI and when another tool is the right call.
You have been the technical decision-maker, not just the person who runs the process. You can lead a design review and change the answer.
You think in systems. You can hold the team, the platform, the AI layer, and the business constraints in your head at once and see where they don't line up.
You have taste. You can build teams and systems where agents and humans work in harmony without overbuilding.
You have worked in a domain where correctness has consequences: legal, healthcare, financial services, or public safety. You understand why accuracy and auditability are non-negotiable.

Good signals, not requirements

You have worked at both large and small companies and have a preference for small. You understand speed to impact but also know what matters at scale.
Founder or CTO experience.
You have scaled a team through a platform rebuild or replatforming, and can talk about what you got wrong.
Experience with workflow automation.
Prior work with vector search, semantic retrieval, or document understanding systems at production scale.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering - Application, Cloud and Offensive Security
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Director of Engineering for the Application, Cloud and Offensive security teams in the Security Engineering organization. Snowflake is the AI Data Cloud powering enterprises worldwide to store, process, and build intelligent applications on their most sensitive data. As AI has become more deeply embedded in what Snowflake and its customers do, the threat landscape has evolved at the same pace. This Director role was created directly in response to that convergence: a wide mandate with real influence across three security pillars and the visibility to shape how one of the most consequential technology platforms in the world stays ahead of emerging threats.

AS A DIRECTOR OF ENGINEERING AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

Define and execute the security strategy across three core pillars: application security, cloud security assurance, and offensive security (including the red team program), setting direction and driving measurable outcomes across all three pillars.
Build and develop a high-performing security engineering organization, hiring top talent and creating a culture of rigor, ownership, and continuous improvement
Drive the offensive security program including red team operations, adversarial simulations, and proactive threat modeling to stay ahead of emerging attack vectors in an AI-accelerated threat landscape
Partner closely with engineering, product, and infrastructure leadership to embed security into Snowflake's AI products and cloud architecture from the ground up, not as an afterthought
Own the cloud security assurance function, ensuring Snowflake's cloud environment meets the security standards expected by enterprise customers and regulators worldwide
Translate security risk into business impact, communicating program status, emerging threats, and strategic priorities to executive stakeholders with clarity and confidence
Influence company-wide security posture through cross-functional collaboration with Legal, Compliance, Trust, and the broader CISO organization

OUR IDEAL DIRECTOR OF ENGINEERING, PRODUCT SECURITY WILL HAVE:

12+ years of progressive experience in security engineering, with significant tenure in leadership roles overseeing multi-domain security programs (or equivalent experience)
Deep expertise across at least two of the three pillars: application security, cloud security, or offensive security, with working knowledge across all three
Proven track record building and scaling high-performing security engineering teams in a fast-paced enterprise technology environment
Strong command of cloud security architecture across AWS, Azure, or GCP, including cloud-native security controls, identity, and infrastructure security
Experience leading or overseeing a red team or offensive security program, with a clear understanding of adversarial tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs)
Exceptional ability to partner with product and engineering organizations, influencing secure-by-design practices and embedding security without creating velocity drag
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent experience

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

Experience securing AI/ML workloads, large language model infrastructure, or AI-adjacent attack surfaces
Familiarity with security for multi-tenant cloud data platforms at enterprise scale
Industry certifications such as CISSP, OSCP, GREM, or equivalent
Contributions to industry security research, conference presentations, or open-source security tooling

WHY JOIN OUR SECURITY TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

Snowflake's security team sits at the intersection of two of the most consequential forces in enterprise technology: AI adoption at scale and the rapidly evolving threat landscape that comes with it. As the platform enterprises worldwide trust with their most sensitive data, Snowflake's security posture is a competitive advantage, not just a compliance checkbox. That framing changes what this team gets to do and the resources it gets to work with.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee’s duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

Drive the Adaptive & Embedded Computing Group’s (AECG) business development and product definition efforts for semi-custom solutions: ASICs, custom SoCs and custom FPGAs, including derivatives of mainstream AMD standard products. This role will focus on identifying and winning strategic custom projects, managing complex customer engagements, and shaping AMD’s long-term custom business in embedded markets.
